                </CardDescription>
                <CardTitle className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">
                  出納レシート簡易入力
                </CardTitle>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="p-4 pt-0 text-[11px] text-amber-800 flex justify-between items-center">
                <span>日用品・お小遣い受渡</span>
                <Link href="/gh/money" className="text-amber-950 font-bold underline">入力画面 →</Link>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </div>

          {/* 現場業務2カラム：服薬・バイタルチェックリスト ＆ 夜間巡回チェックボード */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
            {/* 服薬・バイタルチェックリスト */}
            <Card className="border-amber-200 shadow-2xs">
              <CardHeader className="pb-3 border-b border-amber-100 flex flex-row items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold text-amber-950 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <HeartPulse className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600" />
                    本日の服薬・バイタルチェックリスト
                  </CardTitle>
                  <CardDescription className="text-xs">
                    各入居者の体温、血圧、朝・夕の服薬完了チェック
                  </CardDescription>
                </div>
                <Button asChild size="sm" variant="ghost" className="h-8 text-xs text-amber-900">
                  <Link href="/gh/daily-log">全件入力フォーム →</Link>
                </Button>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="pt-4 space-y-2.5">
                {residents.map(r => {
                  const vital = vitals.find(v => v.resident_id === r.id);
                  const isStay = stayResidentIds.has(r.id);

                  return (
                    <div key={r.id} className="p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                      <div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span className="font-bold text-slate-900">{r.name} 様</span>
                          <span className="font-mono text-slate-500">({r.room_number}号室)</span>
                          {isStay && (
                            <Badge className="bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border-blue-300 text-[10px] py-0">
                              外泊中
                            </Badge>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        {vital ? (
                          <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-600 mt-1 flex items-center gap-3">
                            <span>体温: <strong className="font-mono">{vital.temperature || '--'}℃</strong></span>
                            <span>血圧: <strong className="font-mono">{vital.blood_pressure || '--'}</strong></span>
                            <span>脈拍: <strong className="font-mono">{vital.pulse || '--'}</strong></span>
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <div className="text-[11px] text-amber-700 mt-0.5">
                            {isStay ? '外泊のため本日バイタル免除' : '本日バイタル未入力'}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        {vital ? (
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            <Badge className="bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300 text-[10px]">
                              朝服薬 ✓
                            </Badge>
                            <Badge className="bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300 text-[10px]">
                              夕服薬 ✓
                            </Badge>
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="border-amber-300 text-amber-800 bg-amber-50 text-[10px]">
                            未チェック
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            {/* 夜間巡回チェック ＆ 申し送りノート */}
            <Card className="border-amber-200 shadow-2xs">
              <CardHeader className="pb-3 border-b border-amber-100 flex flex-row items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold text-amber-950 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Moon className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600" />
                    夜間巡回（22:00, 2:00, 6:00）＆ 申し送りノート
                  </CardTitle>
                  <CardDescription className="text-xs">
                    定時巡回による安否確認・施錠・睡眠状態および日勤への申し送り
                  </CardDescription>
                </div>
                <Button asChild size="sm" variant="outline" className="h-8 text-xs border-indigo-300 text-indigo-800">
                  <Link href="/gh/daily-log">日誌入力 +</Link>
                </Button>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="pt-4 space-y-3">
                {recentDailyLogs.length > 0 ? (
                  recentDailyLogs.map(log => (
                    <div key={log.id} className="p-3 rounded-lg border border-indigo-100 bg-indigo-50/30 text-xs space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-indigo-100 pb-1.5">
                        <span className="font-bold text-indigo-950 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600" />
                          {log.log_date} ({log.shift_type === 'night' ? '夜勤・宿直' : '日勤'})
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-slate-500 text-[11px]">担当: {log.staff_name}</span>
                      </div>

                      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-[11px] font-mono">
                        <div className="p-1.5 bg-white rounded border border-indigo-100">
                          <span className="text-slate-500 block text-[10px]">22:00 巡回:</span>
                          <span className="font-bold text-indigo-900">{log.patrol_22 || '消灯・異常なし'}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="p-1.5 bg-white rounded border border-indigo-100">
                          <span className="text-slate-500 block text-[10px]">02:00 巡回:</span>
                          <span className="font-bold text-indigo-900">{log.patrol_01 || '就寝中・施錠良'}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="p-1.5 bg-white rounded border border-indigo-100">
                          <span className="text-slate-500 block text-[10px]">06:00 巡回:</span>
                          <span className="font-bold text-indigo-900">{log.patrol_04 || '起床準備・平穏'}</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {log.general_notes && (
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-700 bg-white/80 p-2 rounded border border-indigo-100">
                          <span className="font-bold text-indigo-900">申し送り:</span> {log.general_notes}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ))
                ) : (
                  <div className="p-6 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground bg-slate-50 rounded-lg">
                    登録済みの夜間巡回記録はありません。「日誌入力」から記録できます。
                  </div>
                )}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* 全ロール共通：居室・ユニット別ステータスボード */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      <Card className="border-amber-200 shadow-2xs">
        <CardHeader className="pb-3 border-b border-amber-100 flex flex-row items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold text-amber-950 flex items-center gap-2">
              <Bed className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600" />
              居室・ユニット別 入居ステータスボード（全{units.length}室）
            </CardTitle>
            <CardDescription className="text-xs">
              居室番号、入居者名、障害支援区分（区分1〜6）、外泊・在室状況
            </CardDescription>
          </div>
          <Button asChild variant="ghost" size="sm" className="h-8 text-xs text-amber-900">
            <Link href="/gh/residents">居室・入居者詳細 →</Link>
          </Button>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="pt-4">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
            {units.map(unit => {
              const resident = residents.find(r => r.unit_id === unit.id || r.room_number === unit.room_number);
              const isStay = activeStays.some(s => s.resident_id === resident?.id);

              return (
                <div
                  key={unit.id}
                  className={`p-3 rounded-xl border transition-all ${
                    unit.is_occupied
                      ? isStay
                        ? 'bg-blue-50/60 border-blue-300 ring-1 ring-blue-300'
                        : 'bg-amber-50/50 border-amber-300'
                      : 'bg-slate-50 border-dashed border-slate-300 text-slate-400'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs mb-1">
                    <span className="font-mono font-black text-amber-950 text-sm">
                      {unit.room_number}号室
                    </span>
                    {unit.is_occupied ? (
                      isStay ? (
                        <Badge className="bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0 border-blue-300">
                          外泊中
                        </Badge>
                      ) : (
                        <Badge className="bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 text-[9px] px-1.5 py-0 border-emerald-300">
                          入居中
                        </Badge>
                      )
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-bold">空室</span>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {resident ? (
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <div className="font-bold text-xs text-slate-900 truncate">
                        {resident.name} 様
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] px-1 py-0 border-amber-300 text-amber-900 font-mono">
                          区分{resident.support_level}
                        </Badge>
                        {resident.receives_special_benefit === 1 && (
                          <Badge className="bg-teal-100 text-teal-800 text-[9px] px-1 py-0 border-teal-300">
                            補足給付
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-400 pt-1">
                      空室（待機者あり）
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>

          <div className="mt-4 pt-3 border-t border-amber-100 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 text-xs text-amber-900">
            <span className="font-bold text-amber-950">支援区分内訳:</span>
            {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6].map(level => (
              <div key={level} className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <span className="font-medium text-muted-foreground">区分{level}:</span>
                <strong className="font-mono">{levelCounts[level] || 0}名</strong>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

import { getDbConnection } from '@/lib/db-client';
import Database from 'better-sqlite3';

let isGhDbInitialized = false;

export function getGhDb(): Database.Database {
  const db = getDbConnection('gh');
  if (!isGhDbInitialized) {
    initGhDatabase(db);
    isGhDbInitialized = true;
  }
  return db;
}

function initGhDatabase(db: Database.Database) {
  db.exec(`
    -- 1. GH事業所・実費設定
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gh_settings (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      facility_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      capacity INTEGER DEFAULT 10,
      standard_rent INTEGER DEFAULT 35000,
      special_benefit_deduction INTEGER DEFAULT 10000, -- 特定障害者特別給付費（市町村家賃補助）
      breakfast_price INTEGER DEFAULT 300,
      lunch_price INTEGER DEFAULT 450,
      dinner_price INTEGER DEFAULT 550,
      utilities_cost INTEGER DEFAULT 12000,           -- 水光熱費
      daily_supplies_cost INTEGER DEFAULT 3000,       -- 日用品費
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      updated_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    );

    -- 2. ユニット・居室管理
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gh_units (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      unit_name TEXT NOT NULL,       -- 例: '本館 1号館', 'サテライト荘'
      room_number TEXT NOT NULL,     -- 例: '101', '102'
      floor INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
      capacity INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
      is_occupied INTEGER DEFAULT 0, -- 0: 空室, 1: 入居中
      notes TEXT,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    );

    -- 3. GH入居者管理（障害支援区分・居室紐付け）
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gh_residents (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      furigana TEXT,
      recipient_number TEXT,
      support_level INTEGER DEFAULT 3, -- 障害支援区分: 1〜6 (自立/区分なしは0)
      unit_id TEXT,
      room_number TEXT,
      rent_amount INTEGER DEFAULT 35000,
      receives_special_benefit INTEGER DEFAULT 1, -- 特定障害者特別給付費（1万円控除対象）
      service_start_date TEXT,
      service_end_date TEXT,
      status TEXT DEFAULT 'active',               -- 'active', 'hospitalized', 'left'
      guardian_name TEXT,
      guardian_contact TEXT,
      emergency_contact TEXT,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      updated_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      FOREIGN KEY (unit_id) REFERENCES gh_units(id)
    );

    -- 4. 外泊トラッカー（帰省・入院・食事連動）
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gh_overnight_stays (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      resident_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      stay_type TEXT DEFAULT 'home', -- 'home'(帰省), 'hospital'(入院), 'other'(外泊)
      start_date TEXT NOT NULL,      -- 開始日
      end_date TEXT,                 -- 終了日
      return_addition_eligible INTEGER DEFAULT 1, -- 帰宅時加算対象（月6日以内）
      deduct_breakfast INTEGER DEFAULT 1,         -- 朝食代0円連動
      deduct_dinner INTEGER DEFAULT 1,            -- 夕食代0円連動
      reason TEXT,
      notes TEXT,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      FOREIGN KEY (resident_id) REFERENCES gh_residents(id)
    );

    -- 5. 夜間巡回・生活記録・バイタル
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gh_daily_logs (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      log_date TEXT NOT NULL,
      staff_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      shift_type TEXT DEFAULT 'night', -- 'night'(夜勤・宿直), 'day'(日勤・世話人)
      patrol_22 TEXT,                  -- 22:00 巡回状況
      patrol_01 TEXT,                  -- 01:00 巡回状況
      patrol_04 TEXT,                  -- 04:00 巡回状況
      general_notes TEXT,
      incident_notes TEXT,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    );

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gh_vital_and_meds (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      resident_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      record_date TEXT NOT NULL,
      temperature REAL,
      blood_pressure TEXT,             -- 例: '120/80'
      pulse INTEGER,
      med_morning INTEGER DEFAULT 1,   -- 朝服薬 (1:完了, 0:未/不要)
      med_noon INTEGER DEFAULT 0,      -- 昼服薬
      med_evening INTEGER DEFAULT 1,   -- 夕服薬
      med_night INTEGER DEFAULT 1,     -- 就寝前服薬
      meal_breakfast INTEGER DEFAULT 1,-- 朝食実食 (1:食べた, 0:欠食)
      meal_lunch INTEGER DEFAULT 0,    -- 昼食実食
      meal_dinner INTEGER DEFAULT 1,   -- 夕食実食
      notes TEXT,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      FOREIGN KEY (resident_id) REFERENCES gh_residents(id),
      UNIQUE(resident_id, record_date)
    );

    -- 6. 預かり金出納帳（お小遣い・レシート管理）
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gh_resident_money_ledgers (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      resident_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      transaction_date TEXT NOT NULL,
      transaction_type TEXT NOT NULL,   -- 'income'(預かり/年金), 'expense'(支出/買物)
      category TEXT NOT NULL,           -- 'お小遣い', '年金受給', '医療費', '日用品', '理美容', 'レシート精算'
      amount INTEGER NOT NULL,
      balance_after INTEGER NOT NULL,
      description TEXT,
      receipt_number TEXT,
      checked_by TEXT,                  -- 確認者（世話人・管理者）
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      FOREIGN KEY (resident_id) REFERENCES gh_residents(id)
    );

    -- 7. 実費精算＆個人請求書
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gh_monthly_billings (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      resident_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      target_month TEXT NOT NULL,       -- YYYY-MM
      stay_days INTEGER DEFAULT 30,     -- 入居日数
      rent_base INTEGER DEFAULT 35000,
      rent_subsidy_deduction INTEGER DEFAULT 10000, -- 特定給付費控除
      rent_net INTEGER DEFAULT 25000,   -- 差引家賃個人負担
      breakfast_count INTEGER DEFAULT 30,
      lunch_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
      dinner_count INTEGER DEFAULT 30,
      meal_total INTEGER DEFAULT 25500,
      utilities_cost INTEGER DEFAULT 12000,
      supplies_cost INTEGER DEFAULT 3000,
      other_expenses INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
      total_resident_payment INTEGER NOT NULL, -- 個人請求総額
      kokuho_service_units INTEGER DEFAULT 0,  -- 国保連給付費算定単位数
      is_locked INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      FOREIGN KEY (resident_id) REFERENCES gh_residents(id),
      UNIQUE(resident_id, target_month)
    );

    -- 8. 事故・ヒヤリハット記録（管理者最終決裁）
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gh_incidents (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      resident_id TEXT,
      occurred_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      incident_type TEXT NOT NULL, -- 'accident', 'near_miss'
      title TEXT NOT NULL,
      description TEXT NOT NULL,
      severity TEXT DEFAULT 'low',
      status TEXT DEFAULT 'pending_approval', -- 'draft', 'pending_approval', 'approved'
      reporter_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      approver_name TEXT,
      approved_at TEXT,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    );

    -- 9. 日中活動先連携・会議録（サビ管）
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS gh_coordination_logs (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      resident_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      target_date TEXT NOT NULL,
      organization_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      coordinator_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      purpose TEXT NOT NULL,
      content TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    );

    -- インデックス
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_gh_residents_unit ON gh_residents(unit_id);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_gh_overnight_resident ON gh_overnight_stays(resident_id, start_date);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_gh_vital_resident_date ON gh_vital_and_meds(resident_id, record_date);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_gh_money_resident_date ON gh_resident_money_ledgers(resident_id, transaction_date);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_gh_billings_month ON gh_monthly_billings(resident_id, target_month);
  `);

  // カラム追加マイグレーション
  const addColumns = [
    { table: 'gh_residents', col: 'plan_start_date TEXT' },
    { table: 'gh_residents', col: 'plan_end_date TEXT' },
    { table: 'gh_residents', col: 'monitoring_due_date TEXT' },
    { table: 'gh_residents', col: 'certificate_expiry TEXT' },
    { table: 'gh_residents', col: 'daytime_activity TEXT' },
    { table: 'gh_settings', col: 'caretaker_fte_ratio REAL DEFAULT 4.2' },
    { table: 'gh_settings', col: 'night_staff_count INTEGER DEFAULT 1' },
    { table: 'gh_settings', col: 'waiting_count INTEGER DEFAULT 3' },
  ];
  for (const { table, col } of addColumns) {
    try {
      db.exec(`ALTER TABLE ${table} ADD COLUMN ${col}`);
    } catch (e) {
      // 既に存在する場合はスキップ
    }
  }

  // 初期シードデータ投入（未投入時のみ）
  const count = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM gh_settings').get() as any;
  if (count.cnt === 0) {
    seedGhInitialData(db);
  } else {
    // 既存レコードの補完更新
    try {
      db.exec(`
        UPDATE gh_residents SET 
          plan_start_date = COALESCE(plan_start_date, '2026-05-01'),
          plan_end_date = COALESCE(plan_end_date, '2026-10-31'),
          monitoring_due_date = COALESCE(monitoring_due_date, '2026-10-25'),
          certificate_expiry = COALESCE(certificate_expiry, '2027-03-31'),
          daytime_activity = COALESCE(daytime_activity, '就労継続支援A型（かがやきワーク）')
        WHERE plan_end_date IS NULL;
        UPDATE gh_residents SET plan_end_date = '2026-10-20', monitoring_due_date = '2026-10-18' WHERE id = 'res_001';
        UPDATE gh_residents SET certificate_expiry = '2026-11-15', daytime_activity = '就労継続支援B型（かがやきファクトリー）' WHERE id = 'res_002';
        UPDATE gh_residents SET daytime_activity = '生活介護（あおぞらデイ）' WHERE id = 'res_003';
      `);
      const incCount = (db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM gh_incidents').get() as any).cnt;
      if (incCount === 0) {
        db.prepare(`
          INSERT INTO gh_incidents (id, resident_id, occurred_at, incident_type, title, description, severity, status, reporter_name)
          VALUES ('inc_001', 'res_001', '2026-10-10 19:30', 'near_miss', '洗面台での足元のふらつき', '夕食後に居室へ戻る際、スリッパが滑りバランスを崩しかけた。怪我なし。滑り止めマットを設置対応。', 'low', 'pending_approval', '世話人 佐々木')
        `).run();
      }
      const coordCount = (db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM gh_coordination_logs').get() as any).cnt;
      if (coordCount === 0) {
        db.prepare(`
          INSERT INTO gh_coordination_logs (id, resident_id, target_date, organization_name, coordinator_name, purpose, content)
          VALUES ('coord_001', 'res_001', '2026-10-08', '就労継続支援A型 かがやきワーク', 'サビ管 山本', '日中作業状況と生活リズムの共有', 'A型での軽作業の集中力は良好。夜間の睡眠状況が作業効率に直結するため、消灯時刻（22:30）の遵守をホーム側で促すことを申し合わせた。')
        `).run();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // 補完失敗は無視
    }
  }
}

    // 入居者（6名）

      { id: 'res_006', name: '小林 陽子', furi: 'コバヤシ ヨウコ', rec: '1234567896', level: 3, uid: 'u202', room: '202', rent: 35000, sub: 0, start: '2024-05-01' }, // 給付費対象外
    ];
    const insRes = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO gh_residents (id, name, furigana, recipient_number, support_level, unit_id, room_number, rent_amount, receives_special_benefit, service_start_date)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)

    }

    insMoney.run('m_002', 'res_001', '2026-10-05', 'expense', 'お小遣い', 5000, 60000, '本人希望による週間小遣い出金', '世話人 佐々木');

    `);
    insVital.run('v_001', 'res_001', today, 36.5, '118/76', 72, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1);
    insVital.run('v_002', 'res_002', today, 36.8, '124/82', 78, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1);
    insVital.run('v_003', 'res_003', today, 36.4, '130/85', 70, 1, 1, 1, 1, 1);

    // 月次請求書（当月見込み）
    const targetMonth = today.slice(0, 7);
    const insBill = db.prepare(`
      INSERT OR IGNORE INTO gh_monthly_billings (
        id, resident_id, target_month, stay_days, rent_base, rent_subsidy_deduction, rent_net,
        breakfast_count, lunch_count, dinner_count, meal_total, utilities_cost, supplies_cost, total_resident_payment
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `);
    for (const res of residents) {
      const netRent = res.sub ? Math.max(0, res.rent - 10000) : res.rent;
      const meal = (28 * 300) + (28 * 550); // 23,800円
      const total = netRent + meal + 12000 + 3000;
      insBill.run(`bill_${res.id}_${targetMonth}`, res.id, targetMonth, 28, res.rent, res.sub ? 10000 : 0, netRent, 28, 0, 28, meal, 12000, 3000, total);
    }
  })();
}

'use server';

import { getGhDb } from '../lib/db';
import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';
import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';

export async function addMoneyTransaction(formData: FormData) {
  try {
    const db = getGhDb();
    const id = `money_${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    const residentId = formData.get('residentId') as string;
    const transactionDate = formData.get('transactionDate') as string || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const transactionType = formData.get('transactionType') as string; // 'income' | 'expense'
    const category = formData.get('category') as string;
    const amount = parseInt(formData.get('amount') as string) || 0;
    const description = formData.get('description') as string || '';
    const receiptNumber = formData.get('receiptNumber') as string || null;
    const checkedBy = formData.get('checkedBy') as string || '世話人';

    if (amount <= 0) {
      return;
    }

    db.transaction(() => {
      // 最新残高を取得
      const lastTx = db.prepare(`
        SELECT balance_after FROM gh_resident_money_ledgers
        WHERE resident_id = ?
        ORDER BY transaction_date DESC, created_at DESC
        LIMIT 1
      `).get(residentId) as any;

      const currentBalance = lastTx ? lastTx.balance_after : 0;
      const newBalance = transactionType === 'income' ? currentBalance + amount : currentBalance - amount;

      if (newBalance < 0 && transactionType === 'expense') {
        throw new Error(`残高不足です（現在の預かり金残高: ${currentBalance.toLocaleString()}円）`);
      }

      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO gh_resident_money_ledgers (
          id, resident_id, transaction_date, transaction_type, category, amount, balance_after, description, receipt_number, checked_by
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(id, residentId, transactionDate, transactionType, category, amount, newBalance, description, receiptNumber, checkedBy);
    })();

    revalidatePath('/gh/money');
    revalidatePath('/gh/dashboard');
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.error('addMoneyTransaction error:', e);
  }
}

'use client';
import React, { useTransition } from 'react';
import { Trash2, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { deleteResident } from './actions';

interface DeleteGhResidentButtonProps {
  residentId: string;
  residentName: string;
  roomNumber?: string;
}

export function DeleteGhResidentButton({
  residentId,
  residentName,
  roomNumber,
}: DeleteGhResidentButtonProps) {
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const handleDelete = () => {
    const roomText = roomNumber ? `（${roomNumber}号室）` : '';
    const ok = window.confirm(
      `【確認】入居者「${residentName} 様」${roomText}の台帳を削除しますか？\n※割り当てられていた居室は自動的に空室に戻ります。`
    );
    if (!ok) return;

    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await deleteResident(residentId);
      if (res && !res.success) {
        alert(res.error || '入居者の削除に失敗しました');
      }
    });
  };

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={handleDelete}
      disabled={isPending}
      title="入居者を削除・退去"
      className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 rounded-lg transition-colors border border-transparent hover:border-rose-200 disabled:opacity-50"
    >
      {isPending ? (
        <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-rose-600" />
      ) : (
        <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
      )}
    </button>
  );
}

'use server';

import { getGhDb } from '../lib/db';
import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';
import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';

export async function addResident(formData: FormData) {
  try {
    const db = getGhDb();
    const id = `res_${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    const name = formData.get('name') as string;
    const furigana = formData.get('furigana') as string;
    const recipientNumber = formData.get('recipientNumber') as string;
    const supportLevel = parseInt(formData.get('supportLevel') as string) || 3;
    const unitId = formData.get('unitId') as string;
    const roomNumber = formData.get('roomNumber') as string;
    const rentAmount = parseInt(formData.get('rentAmount') as string) || 35000;
    const receivesSpecialBenefit = formData.get('receivesSpecialBenefit') === '1' ? 1 : 0;
    const serviceStartDate = formData.get('serviceStartDate') as string || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

    db.transaction(() => {
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO gh_residents (
          id, name, furigana, recipient_number, support_level, unit_id, room_number,
          rent_amount, receives_special_benefit, service_start_date, status
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'active')
      `).run(id, name, furigana, recipientNumber, supportLevel, unitId, roomNumber, rentAmount, receivesSpecialBenefit, serviceStartDate);

      if (unitId) {
        db.prepare('UPDATE gh_units SET is_occupied = 1 WHERE id = ?').run(unitId);
      }
    })();

    revalidatePath('/gh/residents');
    revalidatePath('/gh/dashboard');
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.error('addResident error:', e);
  }
}

export async function addOvernightStay(formData: FormData) {
  try {
    const db = getGhDb();
    const id = `stay_${randomUUID().slice(0, 8)}`;
    const residentId = formData.get('residentId') as string;
    const stayType = formData.get('stayType') as string || 'home';
    const startDate = formData.get('startDate') as string;
    const endDate = formData.get('endDate') as string || null;
    const reason = formData.get('reason') as string || '';

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO gh_overnight_stays (
        id, resident_id, stay_type, start_date, end_date, return_addition_eligible, deduct_breakfast, deduct_dinner, reason
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 1, 1, 1, ?)
    `).run(id, residentId, stayType, startDate, endDate, reason);

    revalidatePath('/gh/residents');
    revalidatePath('/gh/dashboard');
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.error('addOvernightStay error:', e);
  }
}

export async function deleteResident(residentId: string) {
  try {
    if (!residentId) {
      return { success: false, error: '入居者IDが指定されていません' };
    }
    const db = getGhDb();

    // 割当居室IDの取得
    const resident = db.prepare('SELECT unit_id FROM gh_residents WHERE id = ?').get(residentId) as any;
    const unitId = resident?.unit_id;

    db.transaction(() => {
      // 関連データの削除（子テーブル全件）
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM gh_overnight_stays WHERE resident_id = ?').run(residentId);
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM gh_vital_and_meds WHERE resident_id = ?').run(residentId);
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM gh_resident_money_ledgers WHERE resident_id = ?').run(residentId);
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM gh_monthly_billings WHERE resident_id = ?').run(residentId);
      try {
        db.prepare('DELETE FROM gh_daily_records WHERE resident_id = ?').run(residentId);
      } catch (e) {}
      try {
        db.prepare('DELETE FROM gh_coordination_logs WHERE resident_id = ?').run(residentId);
      } catch (e) {}

      // 入居者本体の削除
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM gh_residents WHERE id = ?').run(residentId);

      // 居室の空室化（該当居室に他の入居者がいなければ is_occupied = 0 に戻す）
      if (unitId) {
        const remaining = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM gh_residents WHERE unit_id = ? AND status = 'active'").get(unitId) as any;
        if (!remaining || remaining.cnt === 0) {
          db.prepare('UPDATE gh_units SET is_occupied = 0 WHERE id = ?').run(unitId);
        }
      }
    })();

    try {
      revalidatePath('/gh/residents');
      revalidatePath('/gh/dashboard');
      revalidatePath('/gh/settings');
    } catch (e) {}
    return { success: true };
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.error('deleteResident error:', e);
    return { success: false, error: e?.message || '入居者の削除に失敗しました' };
  }
}

import React from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { getGhDb } from '../../lib/db';
import { PrintButton } from '@/components/ui/PrintButton';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { ArrowLeft, Printer, Users } from 'lucide-react';

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

export default async function GhProvisionRecordsPage(props: {
  searchParams?: Promise<{ month?: string; residentId?: string }>;
}) {
  const searchParams = await props.searchParams;
  const currentMonthStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 7);
  const targetMonth = searchParams?.month || currentMonthStr;
  const db = getGhDb();

  const settings = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM gh_settings LIMIT 1').get() as any || {
    facility_name: 'グループホーム かがやきの家',
    capacity: 10
  };

  const residents = db.prepare(`
    SELECT r.*, u.unit_name
    FROM gh_residents r
    LEFT JOIN gh_units u ON r.unit_id = u.id
    WHERE r.status = 'active'
    ORDER BY r.room_number ASC
  `).all() as any[];

  const selectedResidentId = searchParams?.residentId || (residents[0]?.id || '');
  const selectedResident = residents.find(r => r.id === selectedResidentId) || residents[0];

  // 日付の配列生成
  const [yearStr, monthStr] = targetMonth.split('-');
  const year = parseInt(yearStr, 10);
  const month = parseInt(monthStr, 10);
  const daysInMonth = new Date(year, month, 0).getDate();

  // 外泊データの取得
  const overnightStays = selectedResident ? db.prepare(`
    SELECT * FROM gh_overnight_stays
    WHERE resident_id = ?
      AND (
        (start_date <= ? AND (end_date IS NULL OR end_date >= ?))
        OR (start_date LIKE ?)
      )
  `).all(
    selectedResident.id,
    `${targetMonth}-${String(daysInMonth).padStart(2, '0')}`,
    `${targetMonth}-01`,
    `${targetMonth}-%`
  ) as any[] : [];

  let stayDays = 0;
  let overnightDays = 0;
  let returnAdditionDays = 0;
  let breakfastCount = 0;
  let dinnerCount = 0;

  const rows = [];
  for (let d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) {
    const dStr = String(d).padStart(2, '0');
    const dateStr = `${targetMonth}-${dStr}`;
    const dateObj = new Date(year, month - 1, d);
    const dayOfWeek = ['日', '月', '火', '水', '木', '金', '土'][dateObj.getDay()];

    // 外泊判定
    const matchingStay = overnightStays.find(s => {
      const start = s.start_date;
      const end = s.end_date || '9999-12-31';
      return dateStr >= start && dateStr <= end;
    });

    let serviceStatus = '1'; // 1: 在館（通常）
    let serviceLabel = '在館';
    let returnAddition = '-';
    let breakfast = '〇';
    let dinner = '〇';
    let remarks = '';

    if (matchingStay) {
      if (matchingStay.stay_type === 'hospital') {
        serviceStatus = '3';
        serviceLabel = '入院';
        remarks = '入院（外泊加算対象外）';
      } else {
        serviceStatus = '2';
        serviceLabel = '外泊';
        remarks = matchingStay.notes || '外泊（帰省）';
      }

      overnightDays++;

      if (matchingStay.return_addition_eligible === 1) {
        returnAddition = '〇';
        returnAdditionDays++;
      }

      if (matchingStay.deduct_breakfast === 1) {
        breakfast = '-';
      } else {
        breakfastCount++;
      }

      if (matchingStay.deduct_dinner === 1) {
        dinner = '-';
      } else {
        dinnerCount++;
      }
    } else {
      stayDays++;
      breakfastCount++;
      dinnerCount++;
    }

    rows.push({
      day: d,
      dayOfWeek,
      serviceStatus,
      serviceLabel,
      returnAddition,
      breakfast,
      dinner,
      remarks,
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* 画面ヘッダー（印刷時非表示） */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 print:hidden">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <Link
            href="/gh/billing"
            className="text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground flex items-center gap-1 font-medium"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            実費請求へ戻る
          </Link>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-amber-950">
              共同生活援助 サービス提供実績記録票（別表2）
            </h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-amber-800">
              厚生労働省標準様式（別表2）準拠。在館・外泊日数、帰宅時加算、食事実績の法定記録原本
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {selectedResident && (
          <PrintButton
            label="実績記録票を印刷 / PDF"
            className="bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white font-bold h-9 text-xs shadow-sm"
          />
        )}
      </div>

      {/* 絞り込みツールバー（印刷時非表示） */}
      <Card className="border-amber-200 bg-amber-50/20 shadow-xs print:hidden">
        <CardContent className="pt-4 pb-4">
          <form className="flex flex-wrap gap-4 items-end" method="GET">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-700">対象月</label>
              <input
                type="month"
                name="month"
                defaultValue={targetMonth}
                className="flex h-9 rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-xs"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1 min-w-[200px]">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-700">入居者</label>
              <select
                name="residentId"
                defaultValue={selectedResidentId}
                className="flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-xs"
              >
                {residents.map(r => (
                  <option key={r.id} value={r.id}>
                    {r.room_number}号室 {r.name} 様（区分{r.support_level}）
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <Button type="submit" className="h-9 px-4 bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 font-bold text-white">
              表示更新
            </Button>
          </form>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* A4印刷用紙コンテナ */}
      {selectedResident && (
        <div className="print-a4-sheet bg-white w-[210mm] min-h-[297mm] h-[297mm] p-[9mm_10mm_9mm_10mm] box-border text-black mx-auto shadow-2xl border border-gray-300 print:shadow-none print:border-none print:m-0 flex flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden">
          {/* ヘッダー */}
          <div>

              </h2>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold print:text-[12px]">
                【 令和{year - 2018}年（{year}年） {month} 月分 】
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="flex justify-between items-end mb-3 print:mb-1.5 text-xs print:text-[10px] leading-tight">
              <div className="space-y-0.5">

                <p className="text-sm print:text-[12px] border-b border-black inline-block min-w-[220px] pb-0.5 font-bold">
                  氏名： {selectedResident.name}　様（居室: {selectedResident.room_number}号室）
                </p>
                <p>障害支援区分： <span className="font-bold">区分{selectedResident.support_level}</span></p>

'use server';

import { getGhDb } from '../lib/db';
import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';

export async function updateGhSettings(formData: FormData) {
  try {
    const db = getGhDb();
    const facilityName = (formData.get('facility_name') as string)?.trim() || 'グループホーム（共同生活援助）事業所';
    const capacity = parseInt(formData.get('capacity') as string, 10) || 10;
    const standardRent = parseInt(formData.get('standard_rent') as string, 10) || 35000;
    const specialBenefitDeduction = parseInt(formData.get('special_benefit_deduction') as string, 10) || 10000;
    const breakfastPrice = parseInt(formData.get('breakfast_price') as string, 10) || 300;
    const lunchPrice = parseInt(formData.get('lunch_price') as string, 10) || 450;
    const dinnerPrice = parseInt(formData.get('dinner_price') as string, 10) || 550;
    const utilitiesCost = parseInt(formData.get('utilities_cost') as string, 10) || 12000;
    const dailySuppliesCost = parseInt(formData.get('daily_supplies_cost') as string, 10) || 3000;

    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE gh_settings
      SET facility_name = ?, capacity = ?, standard_rent = ?, special_benefit_deduction = ?,
          breakfast_price = ?, lunch_price = ?, dinner_price = ?, utilities_cost = ?,
          daily_supplies_cost = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      WHERE id = 'gh_default'
    `).run(
      facilityName, capacity, standardRent, specialBenefitDeduction,
      breakfastPrice, lunchPrice, dinnerPrice, utilitiesCost, dailySuppliesCost
    );

    revalidatePath('/gh/settings');
    revalidatePath('/gh/dashboard');
    revalidatePath('/gh/billing');
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('updateGhSettings error:', error);
  }
}

export async function addGhRoom(formData: FormData) {
  try {
    const db = getGhDb();
    const unitName = (formData.get('unit_name') as string)?.trim() || '本館 1号館';
    const roomNumber = (formData.get('room_number') as string)?.trim();
    const floor = parseInt(formData.get('floor') as string, 10) || 1;
    const capacity = parseInt(formData.get('capacity') as string, 10) || 1;
    const notes = (formData.get('notes') as string)?.trim() || '';

    if (!roomNumber) {
      return;
    }

    const id = `u_${Date.now()}`;
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO gh_units (id, unit_name, room_number, floor, capacity, is_occupied, notes)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0, ?)
    `).run(id, unitName, roomNumber, floor, capacity, notes);

    revalidatePath('/gh/settings');
    revalidatePath('/settings');
    revalidatePath('/gh/residents');
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('addGhRoom error:', error);
  }
}

export async function deleteGhRoom(roomId: string) {
  try {
    if (!roomId) {
      return { success: false, error: '居室IDが指定されていません' };
    }
    const db = getGhDb();

    // 入居者の有無をチェック
    const occupied = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM gh_residents WHERE unit_id = ? AND status = 'active'").get(roomId) as any;
    if (occupied && occupied.cnt > 0) {
      return { 
        success: false, 
        error: '入居者が割り当てられているため削除できません。先に入居者を退去または別の居室へ移動してください。' 
      };
    }

    // 過去の退去済み履歴があれば unit_id を null にクリア
    db.prepare('UPDATE gh_residents SET unit_id = NULL WHERE unit_id = ?').run(roomId);

    // 居室本体の削除
    db.prepare('DELETE FROM gh_units WHERE id = ?').run(roomId);

    try {
      revalidatePath('/gh/settings');
      revalidatePath('/settings');
      revalidatePath('/gh/residents');
      revalidatePath('/gh/dashboard');
    } catch (e) {}
    return { success: true };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('deleteGhRoom error:', error);
    return { success: false, error: error?.message || '居室の削除に失敗しました' };
  }
}

'use server';

import { getHoudayDb } from '../lib/db';
import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';

export async function saveHoudayAttendance(formData: FormData) {
  try {
    const db = getHoudayDb();
    const childId = formData.get('child_id') as string;
    const targetDate = (formData.get('target_date') as string)?.trim() || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const serviceType = (formData.get('service_type') as string) || 'school_day';
    const status = (formData.get('status') as string) || 'present';
    const arrivalTime = (formData.get('arrival_time') as string)?.trim() || '15:00';
    const departureTime = (formData.get('departure_time') as string)?.trim() || '17:30';
    const snackConsumed = formData.get('snack_consumed') === '1' ? 1 : 0;
    const pickupSchool = formData.get('pickup_school') === '1' ? 1 : 0;
    const dropoffHome = formData.get('dropoff_home') === '1' ? 1 : 0;
    const supportNote = (formData.get('support_note') as string)?.trim() || '';
    const staffName = (formData.get('staff_name') as string)?.trim() || '担当指導員';

    if (!childId) {
      return;
    }

    const id = `att_${childId}_${targetDate}`;
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO houday_attendance (
        id, child_id, target_date, service_type, status,
        arrival_time, departure_time, snack_consumed,
        pickup_school, dropoff_home, support_note, staff_name
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      ON CONFLICT(child_id, target_date) DO UPDATE SET
        service_type = excluded.service_type,
        status = excluded.status,
        arrival_time = excluded.arrival_time,
        departure_time = excluded.departure_time,
        snack_consumed = excluded.snack_consumed,
        pickup_school = excluded.pickup_school,
        dropoff_home = excluded.dropoff_home,
        support_note = excluded.support_note,
        staff_name = excluded.staff_name
    `).run(
      id, childId, targetDate, serviceType, status,
      arrivalTime, departureTime, snackConsumed,
      pickupSchool, dropoffHome, supportNote, staffName
    );

    revalidatePath('/houday/attendance');
    revalidatePath('/houday/dashboard');
    revalidatePath('/houday/billing');
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('saveHoudayAttendance error:', error);
  }
}

          <div className="bg-white px-4 py-2 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 flex items-center gap-3">
            <Calendar className="w-5 h-5 text-sky-600" />
            <form method="GET" className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <input
                type="date"
                name="date"
                defaultValue={selectedDate}
                className="px-2 py-1 border rounded text-sm font-bold text-slate-700"
              />
              <button
                type="submit"
                className="px-3 py-1 bg-sky-600 text-white rounded text-xs font-bold hover:bg-sky-700 transition-colors"
              >
                表示
              </button>
            </form>
          </div>

          <Link
            href={`/houday/attendance/provision-records?month=${selectedDate.slice(0, 7)}`}
            className="px-3 py-2 bg-sky-700 hover:bg-sky-800 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all shadow-sm flex items-center gap-1.5"
          >
            <FileText className="w-4 h-4" />
            実績記録票（様式第7）
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 区分アラートバナー */}
      <div className="p-4 rounded-xl border bg-white flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 shadow-sm">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <div className={`p-2.5 rounded-lg ${isSchoolDay ? 'bg-sky-100 text-sky-700' : 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-700'}`}>
            <School className="w-5 h-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">
              対象日: {selectedDate}
              <span className={`ml-2 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-black ${
                isSchoolDay ? 'bg-sky-100 text-sky-800 border border-sky-300' : 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border border-amber-300'
              }`}>
                {isSchoolDay ? '🏫 学校開学日（平日放課後単価: 区分1〜3）' : '🏖️ 学校休業日（土日祝・長期休暇単価）'}
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
              ※国保連請求時の基本報酬サービスコードが自動で「{isSchoolDay ? '授業終了後' : '休業日'}」に連動します。
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 児童別通所記録カード一覧 */}
      <div className="space-y-4">
        {children.map((c) => {
          const rec = recordMap.get(c.id);
          const isPresent = rec ? rec.status === 'present' : false;
          const snackDone = rec ? rec.snack_consumed === 1 : true; // デフォルトはおやつ提供
          const pickupSchool = rec ? rec.pickup_school === 1 : c.pickup_needed === 1;
          const dropoffHome = rec ? rec.dropoff_home === 1 : c.pickup_needed === 1;

          return (
            <div
              key={c.id}
              className={`bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border p-5 transition-all ${
                rec ? 'border-sky-300 ring-1 ring-sky-100' : 'border-slate-200'
              }`}
            >
              <form action={saveHoudayAttendance}>
                <input type="hidden" name="child_id" value={c.id} />
                <input type="hidden" name="target_date" value={selectedDate} />
                <input type="hidden" name="service_type" value={currentServiceType} />

                <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-4 pb-4 border-b border-slate-100">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-full bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-sm">
                      {c.name.slice(0, 1)}
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        <span className="font-black text-slate-800 text-base">{c.name}</span>
                        <span className="text-xs bg-sky-50 text-sky-700 font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-sky-200">
                          {c.grade}
                        </span>
                        <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">{c.school_name}</span>
                      </div>
                      {c.allergies && c.allergies !== 'なし' && (
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-rose-600 font-bold mt-0.5">
                          ⚠️ アレルギー: {c.allergies}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* 出欠ステータス選択 */}
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-100 p-1 rounded-lg">
                      <label className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer transition-colors ${
                        isPresent ? 'bg-sky-600 text-white shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
                      }`}>
                        <input
                          type="radio"
                          name="status"
                          value="present"
                          defaultChecked={rec ? rec.status === 'present' : true}
                          className="sr-only"
                        />
                        出席
                      </label>
                      <label className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer transition-colors ${
                        rec && rec.status === 'absent' ? 'bg-rose-600 text-white shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
                      }`}>
                        <input
                          type="radio"
                          name="status"
                          value="absent"
                          defaultChecked={rec?.status === 'absent'}
                          className="sr-only"
                        />
                        欠席
                      </label>
                      <label className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-bold cursor-pointer transition-colors ${
                        rec && rec.status === 'cancelled' ? 'bg-amber-600 text-white shadow-sm' : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
                      }`}>
                        <input
                          type="radio"
                          name="status"
                          value="cancelled"
                          defaultChecked={rec?.status === 'cancelled'}
                          className="sr-only"
                        />
                        利用なし
                      </label>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 font-mono text-xs">
                        <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                        <input
                          type="time"
                          name="arrival_time"
                          defaultValue={rec?.arrival_time || '15:00'}
                          className="px-1.5 py-1 border rounded text-xs"
                        />
                        <span>〜</span>
                        <input
                          type="time"
                          name="departure_time"
                          defaultValue={rec?.departure_time || '17:30'}
                          className="px-1.5 py-1 border rounded text-xs"
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* おやつ・送迎・活動日誌 */}
                <div className="pt-3 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 items-center">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
                    <label className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 cursor-pointer bg-amber-50 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-amber-200">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        name="snack_consumed"
                        value="1"
                        defaultChecked={snackDone}
                        className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 rounded"
                      />
                      <Cookie className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600" />
                      <span>おやつ提供（100円実費計上）</span>
                    </label>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600 bg-slate-50 px-3 py-2 rounded-lg border border-slate-200">
                      <Bus className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600" />
                      <label className="flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer">
                        <input
                          type="checkbox"
                          name="pickup_school"
                          value="1"
                          defaultChecked={pickupSchool}
                          className="w-3.5 h-3.5"
                        />
                        <span>学校迎</span>
                      </label>
                      <label className="flex items-center gap-1 cursor-pointer ml-1">
                        <input
                          type="checkbox"
                          name="dropoff_home"
                          value="1"
                          defaultChecked={dropoffHome}
                          className="w-3.5 h-3.5"
                        />
                        <span>自宅送</span>
                      </label>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="md:col-span-2 flex items-center gap-3">
                    <div className="flex-1">
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        name="support_note"
                        placeholder="個別支援活動内容（宿題、レゴ、体幹運動など指導員の記録）"
                        defaultValue={rec?.support_note || ''}
                        className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 border rounded-lg text-xs"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div className="w-32">
                      <input
                        type="text"
                        name="staff_name"
                        placeholder="担当指導員"
                        defaultValue={rec?.staff_name || '指導員 佐々木'}
                        className="w-full px-2 py-1.5 border rounded-lg text-xs"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <button
                      type="submit"
                      className="px-4 py-1.5 bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-700 text-white rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-colors whitespace-nowrap flex items-center gap-1 shadow-sm"
                    >
                      <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      保存
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </form>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


================================================================================

import React from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { getHoudayDb } from '../../lib/db';
import { PrintButton } from '@/components/ui/PrintButton';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Card, CardContent } from '@/components/ui/card';
import { ArrowLeft, Printer, Users } from 'lucide-react';

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

export default async function HoudayProvisionRecordsPage(props: {
  searchParams?: Promise<{ month?: string; childId?: string }>;
}) {
  const searchParams = await props.searchParams;
  const currentMonthStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 7);
  const targetMonth = searchParams?.month || currentMonthStr;
  const db = getHoudayDb();

  const settings = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM houday_settings LIMIT 1').get() as any || {
    facility_name: '放課後等デイサービス事業所',
    capacity: 10
  };

  const children = db.prepare(`
    SELECT * FROM houday_children
    WHERE status = 'active'
    ORDER BY name ASC
  `).all() as any[];

  const selectedChildId = searchParams?.childId || (children[0]?.id || '');
  const selectedChild = children.find(c => c.id === selectedChildId) || children[0];

  // 日付の配列生成
  const [yearStr, monthStr] = targetMonth.split('-');
  const year = parseInt(yearStr, 10);
  const month = parseInt(monthStr, 10);
  const daysInMonth = new Date(year, month, 0).getDate();

  // 通所記録の取得
  const attendances = selectedChild ? db.prepare(`
    SELECT * FROM houday_attendance
    WHERE child_id = ? AND target_date LIKE ?
    ORDER BY target_date ASC
  `).all(selectedChild.id, `${targetMonth}-%`) as any[] : [];

  // カレンダーの取得
  const calendars = db.prepare(`
    SELECT * FROM houday_calendar
    WHERE target_date LIKE ?
  `).all(`${targetMonth}-%`) as any[];

  let totalDays = 0;
  let schoolDaysCount = 0;
  let vacationDaysCount = 0;
  let pickupCount = 0;
  let snackCount = 0;

  const rows = [];
  for (let d = 1; d <= daysInMonth; d++) {
    const dStr = String(d).padStart(2, '0');
    const dateStr = `${targetMonth}-${dStr}`;
    const dateObj = new Date(year, month - 1, d);
    const dayOfWeek = ['日', '月', '火', '水', '木', '金', '土'][dateObj.getDay()];
    const isWeekend = dayOfWeek === '日' || dayOfWeek === '土';

    const cal = calendars.find(c => c.target_date === dateStr);
    const isSchoolDay = cal ? cal.day_type === 'school_day' : !isWeekend;

    const att = attendances.find(a => a.target_date === dateStr);

    let dayTypeLabel = isSchoolDay ? '開学' : '休業';
    let serviceStatus = '-';
    let serviceLabel = '-';
    let startTime = '';
    let endTime = '';
    let duration = '';
    let transportLabel = '-';
    let snack = '-';
    let remarks = '';

    if (att && att.status === 'present') {
      totalDays++;
      if (isSchoolDay) schoolDaysCount++;
      else vacationDaysCount++;

      serviceStatus = '1';
      serviceLabel = '通所';
      startTime = att.arrival_time || (isSchoolDay ? '14:30' : '10:00');
      endTime = att.departure_time || (isSchoolDay ? '17:30' : '16:00');
      duration = isSchoolDay ? '3.0h' : '6.0h';

      // 送迎
      if (att.pickup_school === 1 && att.dropoff_home === 1) {
        transportLabel = '往復';
        pickupCount += 2;
      } else if (att.pickup_school === 1) {
        transportLabel = '迎え';
        pickupCount += 1;
      } else if (att.dropoff_home === 1) {
        transportLabel = '送り';
        pickupCount += 1;
      }

      if (att.snack_consumed === 1) {
        snack = '〇';
        snackCount++;
      }

      remarks = att.support_note || (isSchoolDay ? '放課後活動' : '休業日創作活動');
    } else if (att && att.status === 'absent') {
      serviceStatus = '2';
      serviceLabel = '加算欠席';
      remarks = '欠席時対応加算算定';
      totalDays++;
    }

    rows.push({
      day: d,
      dayOfWeek,
      dayTypeLabel,
      serviceStatus,
      serviceLabel,
      startTime,
      endTime,
      duration,
      transportLabel,
      snack,
      remarks,
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* 画面ヘッダー（印刷時非表示） */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 print:hidden">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <Link
            href="/houday/attendance"
            className="text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground flex items-center gap-1 font-medium"
          >
            <ArrowLeft className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            通所記録へ戻る
          </Link>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-900">
              放課後等デイサービス 障害児通所給付費実績記録票（様式第７）
            </h1>
            <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
              児童福祉法・こども家庭庁標準様式（様式第7）準拠。開学/休業日区分、送迎加算、指導実績の法定記録原本
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {selectedChild && (
          <PrintButton
            label="実績記録票を印刷 / PDF"
            className="bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-700 text-white font-bold h-9 text-xs shadow-sm"
          />
        )}
      </div>

      {/* 絞り込みツールバー（印刷時非表示） */}
      <Card className="border-sky-200 bg-sky-50/20 shadow-xs print:hidden">
        <CardContent className="pt-4 pb-4">
          <form className="flex flex-wrap gap-4 items-end" method="GET">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-700">対象月</label>
              <input
                type="month"
                name="month"
                defaultValue={targetMonth}
                className="flex h-9 rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-xs"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1 min-w-[200px]">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-700">児童氏名</label>
              <select
                name="childId"
                defaultValue={selectedChildId}
                className="flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-xs"
              >
                {children.map(c => (
                  <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                    {c.name}（{c.grade} / {c.school_name}）
                  </option>
                ))}
              </select>
            </div>

            <Button type="submit" className="h-9 px-4 bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-700 font-bold text-white">
              表示更新
            </Button>
          </form>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* A4印刷用紙コンテナ */}
      {selectedChild && (
        <div className="print-a4-sheet bg-white w-[210mm] min-h-[297mm] h-[297mm] p-[9mm_10mm_9mm_10mm] box-border text-black mx-auto shadow-2xl border border-gray-300 print:shadow-none print:border-none print:m-0 flex flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden">
          {/* ヘッダー */}
          <div>
            <div className="text-center mb-3 print:mb-1.5">
              <h2 className="text-xl md:text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight print:text-[18px] print:mb-0.5">
                放課後等デイサービス 障害児通所給付費実績記録票（様式第７）
              </h2>
              <p className="text-sm font-semibold print:text-[12px]">
                【 令和{year - 2018}年（{year}年） {month} 月分 】
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="flex justify-between items-end mb-3 print:mb-1.5 text-xs print:text-[10px] leading-tight">
              <div className="space-y-0.5">
                <p>受給者証番号： <span className="font-mono font-semibold text-sm print:text-[11px]">{selectedChild.recipient_number || '2810099999'}</span></p>
                <p className="text-sm print:text-[12px] border-b border-black inline-block min-w-[220px] pb-0.5 font-bold">
                  支給決定児童氏名： {selectedChild.name}　様（保護者: {selectedChild.guardian_name} 様）
                </p>
                <p>学校・学年： <span className="font-bold">{selectedChild.school_name}（{selectedChild.grade}）</span></p>
              </div>
              <div className="text-right space-y-0.5">
                <p>支給決定量： <span className="font-bold text-sm print:text-[11px]">{selectedChild.grant_days || 23}</span> 日/月</p>
                <p>事業所番号： <span className="font-mono font-semibold">2810099999</span></p>
                <p>事業者及びその事業所名： <span className="font-semibold">{settings.facility_name}</span></p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* テーブル */}
            <table className="w-full border-collapse border border-black text-xs print:text-[10px] text-center table-fixed">
              <thead>
                <tr className="bg-gray-100 print:bg-gray-200 font-bold h-7 print:h-[6.5mm]">
                  <th className="border border-black p-0.5 w-[6%]">日付</th>
                  <th className="border border-black p-0.5 w-[6%]">曜日</th>
                  <th className="border border-black p-0.5 w-[9%] text-[10px] print:text-[9px]">開学区分</th>
                  <th className="border border-black p-0.5 w-[11%] text-[10px] print:text-[9px]">提供状況</th>
                  <th className="border border-black p-0.5 w-[9%] text-[10px] print:text-[9px]">開始時間</th>
                  <th className="border border-black p-0.5 w-[9%] text-[10px] print:text-[9px]">終了時間</th>
                  <th className="border border-black p-0.5 w-[9%] text-[10px] print:text-[9px]">送迎加算</th>
                  <th className="border border-black p-0.5 w-[7%] text-[10px] print:text-[9px]">おやつ</th>
                  <th className="border border-black p-0.5 w-[22%]">指導内容・活動記録</th>
                  <th className="border border-black p-0.5 w-[12%] text-[10px] print:text-[9px]">保護者印</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {rows.map((row) => (
                  <tr
                    key={row.day}
                    className={`h-[6.2mm] print:h-[5.8mm] ${
                      row.dayOfWeek === '土' ? 'bg-blue-50/40 print:bg-transparent' : row.dayOfWeek === '日' ? 'bg-red-50/40 print:bg-transparent' : ''
                    }`}
                  >
                    <td className="border border-black p-0.5 font-medium">{row.day}</td>
                    <td className={`border border-black p-0.5 font-medium ${row.dayOfWeek === '日' ? 'text-red-600 print:text-black' : row.dayOfWeek === '土' ? 'text-blue-600 print:text-black' : ''}`}>
                      {row.dayOfWeek}
                    </td>
                    <td className="border border-black p-0.5 font-bold text-[10px] print:text-[9px]">
                      {row.dayTypeLabel}
                    </td>
                    <td className="border border-black p-0.5 font-bold">{row.serviceLabel}</td>
                    <td className="border border-black p-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] print:text-[9px]">{row.startTime}</td>
                    <td className="border border-black p-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] print:text-[9px]">{row.endTime}</td>
                    <td className="border border-black p-0.5 font-bold">{row.transportLabel}</td>
                    <td className="border border-black p-0.5 font-bold">{row.snack}</td>
                    <td className="border border-black p-0.5 text-left px-1.5 text-[10px] print:text-[9px] truncate">
                      {row.remarks}
                    </td>
                    <td className="border border-black p-0.5"></td>
                  </tr>
                ))}

                {/* 合計行 */}
                <tr className="bg-gray-100 print:bg-gray-200 font-bold h-7 print:h-[7mm]">
                  <td className="border border-black p-1 text-center" colSpan={2}>当月合計</td>
                  <td className="border border-black p-1 text-center font-mono font-bold text-xs" colSpan={2}>
                    算定日数: {totalDays}日
                  </td>
                  <td className="border border-black p-1 text-center font-mono font-bold text-[10px]" colSpan={2}>
                    開学:{schoolDaysCount}日 / 休業:{vacationDaysCount}日
                  </td>
                  <td className="border border-black p-1 text-center font-mono font-bold text-xs">
                    送迎: {pickupCount}回
                  </td>
                  <td className="border border-black p-1 text-center font-mono font-bold text-xs">
                    {snackCount}食
                  </td>
                  <td className="border border-black p-1 text-right pr-2 text-[10px]" colSpan={2}>
                    当月利用日数: <strong className="font-mono">{totalDays}</strong>日 / 上限: <strong className="font-mono">{selectedChild.grant_days || 23}</strong>日
                  </td>
                </tr>
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>

          {/* フッター署名押印欄 */}
          <div className="mt-3 print:mt-2 flex justify-between items-start text-xs print:text-[10px]">
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <p className="text-muted-foreground font-mono text-[10px] print:text-[9px]">
                ※ サービス提供状況コード: 1=通所（基本報酬算定）, 2=欠席時対応加算算定
              </p>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground text-[10px] print:text-[9px]">
                ※ 上記のとおり指定放課後等デイサービスの提供を受けたことを確認いたします。（確認年月日: 令和　年　月　日）
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-5 print:gap-4 text-center shrink-0">
              <div>
                <p className="mb-1 text-[11px] print:text-[9.5px] font-semibold">管理者</p>
                <div className="w-13 h-13 print:w-11 print:h-11 border border-black rounded-full mx-auto flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] print:text-[8.5px] text-muted-foreground">
                  印
                </div>
              </div>
              <div>
                <p className="mb-1 text-[11px] print:text-[9.5px] font-semibold">児発管</p>

'use server';

import { getHoudayDb } from '../lib/db';
import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';

export async function recalculateHoudayMonthlyBillings(formData: FormData) {
  try {
    const db = getHoudayDb();
    const targetMonth = (formData.get('target_month') as string)?.trim() || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 7);

    // 設定取得
    const settings = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM houday_settings WHERE id = ?').get('houday_default') as any || {
      snack_price: 100,
      activity_material_cost: 1000,
    };

    const children = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM houday_children WHERE status = 'active'").all() as any[];

    db.transaction(() => {
      for (const c of children) {
        // 通所実績集計
        const atts = db.prepare(`
          SELECT * FROM houday_attendance
          WHERE child_id = ? AND target_date LIKE ? AND status = 'present'
        `).all(c.id, `${targetMonth}%`) as any[];

        const attendanceDays = atts.length;
        const schoolDayCount = atts.filter(a => a.service_type === 'school_day').length;
        const vacationDayCount = atts.filter(a => a.service_type === 'vacation').length;
        const snackCount = atts.filter(a => a.snack_consumed === 1).length;
        const snackTotalCost = snackCount * settings.snack_price;
        const materialCost = attendanceDays > 0 ? settings.activity_material_cost : 0;
        const actualCost = snackTotalCost + materialCost;

        // 送迎回数
        let transportCount = 0;
        for (const a of atts) {
          if (a.pickup_school) transportCount += 1;
          if (a.dropoff_home) transportCount += 1;
        }

        // 国保連単位数
        // 平日放課後: 610単位/日, 休業日: 714単位/日, 送迎: 54単位/回
        const baseUnits = (schoolDayCount * 610) + (vacationDayCount * 714);
        const transportUnits = transportCount * 54;
        const kokuhoUnits = baseUnits + transportUnits;

        const grandTotal = actualCost; // 自己負担無償化（0円）想定

        const id = `hbill_${c.id}_${targetMonth}`;
        db.prepare(`
          INSERT INTO houday_monthly_billings (
            id, child_id, target_month, attendance_days,
            school_day_count, vacation_day_count,
            snack_count, snack_total_cost, material_cost,
            transport_count, kokuho_units,
            guardian_copay_amount, guardian_actual_cost, guardian_grand_total
          ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 0, ?, ?)
          ON CONFLICT(child_id, target_month) DO UPDATE SET
            attendance_days = excluded.attendance_days,
            school_day_count = excluded.school_day_count,
            vacation_day_count = excluded.vacation_day_count,
            snack_count = excluded.snack_count,
            snack_total_cost = excluded.snack_total_cost,
            material_cost = excluded.material_cost,
            transport_count = excluded.transport_count,
            kokuho_units = excluded.kokuho_units,
            guardian_actual_cost = excluded.guardian_actual_cost,
            guardian_grand_total = excluded.guardian_grand_total
        `).run(
          id, c.id, targetMonth, attendanceDays,
          schoolDayCount, vacationDayCount,
          snackCount, snackTotalCost, materialCost,
          transportCount, kokuhoUnits,
          actualCost, grandTotal
        );
      }
    })();

    revalidatePath('/houday/billing');
    revalidatePath('/houday/dashboard');
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('recalculateHoudayMonthlyBillings error:', error);
  }
}

'use client';
import React, { useTransition } from 'react';
import { Trash2, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { deleteHoudayChild } from './actions';

interface DeleteHoudayChildButtonProps {
  childId: string;
  childName: string;
}

export function DeleteHoudayChildButton({ childId, childName }: DeleteHoudayChildButtonProps) {
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const handleDelete = () => {
    const ok = window.confirm(
      `【確認】児童「${childName}」さんの台帳を削除しますか？\n※関連する通所記録・支援計画書も同時に削除されます。`
    );
    if (!ok) return;

    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await deleteHoudayChild(childId);
      if (res && !res.success) {
        alert(res.error || '削除に失敗しました');
      }
    });
  };

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={handleDelete}
      disabled={isPending}
      title="児童台帳を削除"
      className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 rounded-lg transition-colors border border-transparent hover:border-rose-200 disabled:opacity-50"
    >
      {isPending ? (
        <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-rose-600" />
      ) : (
        <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
      )}
    </button>
  );
}

'use server';

import { getHoudayDb } from '../lib/db';
import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';

export async function createHoudayChild(formData: FormData) {
  try {
    const db = getHoudayDb();
    const name = (formData.get('name') as string)?.trim();
    const furigana = (formData.get('furigana') as string)?.trim() || '';
    const dateOfBirth = (formData.get('date_of_birth') as string)?.trim() || '';
    const grade = (formData.get('grade') as string)?.trim() || '小1';
    const schoolId = (formData.get('school_id') as string)?.trim() || null;
    const recipientNumber = (formData.get('recipient_number') as string)?.trim() || '';
    const grantDays = parseInt(formData.get('grant_days') as string, 10) || 23;
    const hasMedicalCare = formData.get('has_medical_care') === '1' ? 1 : 0;
    const guardianName = (formData.get('guardian_name') as string)?.trim();
    const guardianContact = (formData.get('guardian_contact') as string)?.trim();
    const pickupNeeded = formData.get('pickup_needed') === '1' ? 1 : 0;
    const allergies = (formData.get('allergies') as string)?.trim() || 'なし';
    const notes = (formData.get('notes') as string)?.trim() || '';

    if (!name || !guardianName || !guardianContact) {
      return;
    }

    // 学校名取得
    let schoolName = '';
    if (schoolId) {
      const sch = db.prepare('SELECT school_name FROM houday_schools WHERE id = ?').get(schoolId) as any;
      if (sch) schoolName = sch.school_name;
    }

    const id = `ch_${Date.now()}`;
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO houday_children (
        id, name, furigana, date_of_birth, grade, school_id, school_name,
        recipient_number, grant_days, has_medical_care, guardian_name,
        guardian_contact, pickup_needed, allergies, notes, status
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'active')
    `).run(
      id, name, furigana, dateOfBirth, grade, schoolId, schoolName,
      recipientNumber, grantDays, hasMedicalCare, guardianName,
      guardianContact, pickupNeeded, allergies, notes
    );

    revalidatePath('/houday/children');
    revalidatePath('/houday/dashboard');
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('createHoudayChild error:', error);
  }
}

export async function deleteHoudayChild(childId: string) {
  try {
    if (!childId) {
      return { success: false, error: '児童IDが指定されていません' };
    }
    const db = getHoudayDb();

    db.transaction(() => {
      // 関連データのクリーンアップ（子テーブル全件）
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM houday_attendance WHERE child_id = ?').run(childId);
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM houday_plans WHERE child_id = ?').run(childId);
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM houday_monthly_billings WHERE child_id = ?').run(childId);
      try {
        db.prepare('DELETE FROM houday_coordination_logs WHERE child_id = ?').run(childId);
      } catch (e) {
        // テーブルがない場合は無視
      }
      // 児童本体の削除
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM houday_children WHERE id = ?').run(childId);
    })();

    try {
      revalidatePath('/houday/children');
      revalidatePath('/houday/dashboard');
      revalidatePath('/houday/attendance');
      revalidatePath('/houday/plans');
    } catch (e) {}
    return { success: true };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('deleteHoudayChild error:', error);
    return { success: false, error: error?.message || '児童の削除に失敗しました' };
  }
}
