                  min={1}
                  max={31}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 border rounded-lg text-sm font-bold text-sky-700"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="bg-sky-50 p-3 rounded-lg border border-sky-200 space-y-2">
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  name="has_medical_care"
                  value="1"
                  className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-600 rounded"
                />
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700">医療的ケア児（喀痰吸引・経管栄養等）</span>
              </label>
              <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  name="pickup_needed"
                  value="1"
                  defaultChecked
                  className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-600 rounded"
                />
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700">送迎サービスを利用する（学校・自宅）</span>
              </label>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 mb-1">保護者氏名 *</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                name="guardian_name"
                placeholder="例: 佐藤 一郎"
                required
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg text-sm"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 mb-1">保護者緊急連絡先 *</label>
              <input
                type="tel"
                name="guardian_contact"
                placeholder="例: 090-1234-5678"
                required
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 border rounded-lg text-sm"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 mb-1">アレルギー・配慮事項</label>
              <input
                type="text"
                name="allergies"
                placeholder="例: 卵アレルギー、大きな音が苦手"
                defaultValue="なし"
                className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 border rounded-lg text-sm"
              />
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-slate-600 mb-1">備考・特記事項</label>
              <textarea
                name="notes"
                rows={2}
                placeholder="好きな遊び、こだわりなど"
                className="w-full px-3 py-1.5 border rounded-lg text-sm"
              />
            </div>

            <button
              type="submit"
              className="w-full py-2.5 bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-700 text-white rounded-lg font-bold text-sm shadow transition-colors flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
            >
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
              児童を台帳に登録
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>

        {/* 児童台帳一覧 */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-2 space-y-4">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 p-6">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center justify-between mb-4 border-b pb-3">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Users className="w-5 h-5 text-sky-600" />
                登録利用児童一覧（{children.length}名）
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-normal">
                定員10名枠 / 支給量管理中
              </span>
            </h2>

            <div className="space-y-4">
              {children.map((c) => (
                <div
                  key={c.id}
                  className="p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white hover:border-sky-300 transition-colors shadow-sm"
                >
                  <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span className="text-base font-bold text-slate-800">{c.name}</span>
                          <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">({c.furigana})</span>
                          <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-sky-100 text-sky-700 text-xs font-bold rounded">
                            {c.grade}
                          </span>
                          {c.has_medical_care === 1 && (
                            <span className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-rose-100 text-rose-700 text-xs font-bold rounded flex items-center gap-1 border border-rose-200">
                              <ShieldAlert className="w-3 h-3" />
                              医療的ケア該当
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">
                          <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                            <School className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                            {c.school_name || '未設定'}
                            {c.dismissal_time && `（下校 ${c.dismissal_time}）`}
                          </span>
                          <span className="font-mono">
                            受給者証: {c.recipient_number || '未登録'}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <div className="text-right">
                        <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">支給量:</span>
                        <span className="ml-1 text-sm font-bold text-sky-700">{c.grant_days}日</span>
                        <span className="text-xs text-slate-400">/月</span>
                      </div>
                      <DeleteHoudayChildButton childId={c.id} childName={c.name} />
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="mt-3 pt-3 border-t border-slate-100 grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-xs">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-slate-600">
                      <Phone className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                      <span>保護者: {c.guardian_name} ({c.guardian_contact})</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-slate-600">
                      <Bus className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                      <span>送迎: {c.pickup_needed ? '希望あり（学校・自宅）' : '不要（保護者送迎）'}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      {c.allergies && c.allergies !== 'なし' ? (
                        <span className="text-rose-600 font-bold bg-rose-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-rose-200">
                          ⚠️ {c.allergies}
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-slate-400">アレルギー: 特になし</span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { getHoudayDb } from '../lib/db';
import { getRole, setRole } from '@/lib/auth';
import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';
import {
  Users,
  Bus,
  Calendar,
  Cookie,
  FileSpreadsheet,
  AlertCircle,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  School,
  ArrowRight,
  ShieldCheck,
  UserCheck,
  Receipt,
  Settings,
  AlertTriangle,
  HeartHandshake,
  HeartPulse,
  Activity,
  Smile,
  Sparkles
} from 'lucide-react';
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

async function switchHoudayRoleAction(formData: FormData) {
  'use server';
  const newRole = formData.get('role') as 'admin' | 'service_manager' | 'staff';
  if (newRole) {
    await setRole(newRole);
    revalidatePath('/houday/dashboard');
    revalidatePath('/houday/layout');
  }
}

export default async function HoudayDashboardPage() {
  const db = getHoudayDb();
  const role = (await getRole()) || 'staff';
  const isAdmin = role === 'admin';
  const isServiceManager = role === 'service_manager';
  const isStaff = role === 'staff';

  const today = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const currentMonth = today.slice(0, 7);

  // 1. 設定＆基本情報
  const settings = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM houday_settings WHERE id = ?').get('houday_default') as any || {
    facility_name: '放課後等デイサービス',
    capacity: 10,
    snack_price: 100,
    activity_material_cost: 1000,
    qualified_staff_ratio: 0.67,
    base_staff_count: 3
  };

  // 2. 本日が開学日か休業日か判定
  const calendarRecord = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM houday_calendar WHERE target_date = ?').get(today) as any;
  const dayOfWeek = new Date().getDay();
  const isWeekend = dayOfWeek === 0 || dayOfWeek === 6;
  const isSchoolDay = calendarRecord ? calendarRecord.day_type === 'school_day' : !isWeekend;

  // 3. 児童一覧＆来所実績
  const children = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM houday_children WHERE status = 'active' ORDER BY name ASC").all() as any[];
  const totalChildren = children.length;

  const todayAttendances = db.prepare(`
    SELECT a.*, c.name as child_name, c.grade, c.school_name, c.allergies, c.guardian_contact, c.grant_days
    FROM houday_attendance a
    JOIN houday_children c ON a.child_id = c.id
    WHERE a.target_date = ?
    ORDER BY a.arrival_time ASC
  `).all(today) as any[];

  const presentCount = todayAttendances.filter(a => a.status === 'present').length;
  const snackCount = todayAttendances.filter(a => a.snack_consumed === 1).length;

  // 定員超過チェック（定員10名）
  const isCapacityExceeded = presentCount > (settings.capacity || 10);
  const isCapacityNear = presentCount === (settings.capacity || 10);

  // 4. 本日の送迎運行
  const todayTransports = db.prepare(`
    SELECT t.*, v.vehicle_name, v.plate_number
    FROM houday_transport_logs t
    JOIN houday_vehicles v ON t.vehicle_id = v.id
    WHERE t.transport_date = ?
    ORDER BY t.depart_time ASC
  `).all(today) as any[];

  // 5. 5領域個別支援計画アラート（児発管向け：6ヶ月周期）
  const plans = db.prepare(`
    SELECT p.*, c.name as child_name, c.grant_days
    FROM houday_plans p
    JOIN houday_children c ON p.child_id = c.id
    WHERE p.status = 'active'
    ORDER BY p.plan_end_date ASC
  `).all() as any[];

  const planAlerts = plans.map(p => {
    const endDate = new Date(p.plan_end_date);
    const todayDate = new Date(today);
    const diffDays = Math.ceil((endDate.getTime() - todayDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
    return {
      plan: p,
      diffDays,
      isExpired: diffDays < 0,
      isUrgent: diffDays >= 0 && diffDays <= 30
    };
  }).filter(p => p.isExpired || p.isUrgent);

  // 6. 受給者証の月間支給量（利用日数）消化集計（当月）
  const monthlyUsageRecords = db.prepare(`
    SELECT child_id, COUNT(*) as used_days
    FROM houday_attendance
    WHERE target_date LIKE ? AND status = 'present'
    GROUP BY child_id
  `).all(`${currentMonth}%`) as any[];
  const usageMap: Record<string, number> = {};
  monthlyUsageRecords.forEach(u => {
    usageMap[u.child_id] = u.used_days;
  });

  // 7. 実費請求集計（おやつ代＆創作活動費）
  const monthlyBillings = db.prepare(`
    SELECT b.*, c.name as child_name
    FROM houday_monthly_billings b
    JOIN houday_children c ON b.child_id = c.id
    WHERE b.target_month = ?
  `).all(currentMonth) as any[];

  const totalSnackActualCost = monthlyBillings.reduce((sum, b) => sum + (b.snack_total_cost || 0), 0);
  const totalMaterialCost = monthlyBillings.reduce((sum, b) => sum + (b.material_cost || 0), 0);
  const totalActualCost = totalSnackActualCost + totalMaterialCost;

  // 8. 学校・相談支援連携会議録
  const coordinationLogs = db.prepare(`
    SELECT l.*, c.name as child_name
    FROM houday_coordination_logs l
    JOIN houday_children c ON l.child_id = c.id
    ORDER BY l.target_date DESC
    LIMIT 4
  `).all() as any[];

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* 画面ヘッダー ＆ ロール切り替え */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-white p-4 sm:p-5 rounded-2xl border border-sky-200 shadow-2xs">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Badge className="bg-sky-100 text-sky-900 border-sky-300 font-bold text-xs">
              放課後等デイサービス
            </Badge>
            <span className="text-xs text-sky-800 font-medium">本日: {today}</span>
            {isSchoolDay ? (
              <Badge className="bg-blue-100 text-blue-900 border-blue-300 text-xs">
                学校開学日（平日放課後給付）
              </Badge>
            ) : (
              <Badge className="bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 border-amber-300 text-xs">
                学校休業日（土曜・長期休暇給付）
              </Badge>
            )}
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-800 tracking-tight mt-1">
            放デイ 運行管理ダッシュボード
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-0.5">
            定員10名管理、5領域療育計画、送迎運行＆安全装置点検、おやつ実費、学校連携
          </p>
        </div>

        {/* 3ロール切り替えスイッチ */}
        <div className="bg-sky-50/80 p-1.5 rounded-xl border border-sky-200 flex items-center gap-1">
          <span className="text-[11px] font-bold text-sky-900 px-2">表示ロール:</span>
          <form action={switchHoudayRoleAction} className="inline">
            <input type="hidden" name="role" value="admin" />
            <button
              type="submit"
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                isAdmin 
                  ? 'bg-rose-600 text-white shadow-xs' 
                  : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-white/60'
              }`}
            >
              管理者
            </button>
          </form>

          <form action={switchHoudayRoleAction} className="inline">
            <input type="hidden" name="role" value="service_manager" />
            <button
              type="submit"
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                isServiceManager 
                  ? 'bg-sky-600 text-white shadow-xs' 
                  : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-white/60'
              }`}
            >
              児発管
            </button>
          </form>

          <form action={switchHoudayRoleAction} className="inline">
            <input type="hidden" name="role" value="staff" />
            <button
              type="submit"
              className={`px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all ${
                isStaff 
                  ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-xs' 
                  : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-white/60'
              }`}
            >
              児童指導員・保育士
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* ロール①：管理者（admin）専用ビュー */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {isAdmin && (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 rounded-xl text-xs text-rose-950 font-bold flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600" />
              管理者ダッシュボード：定員10名管理（定員超過減算防止）・国保連請求・実費徴収・人員配置基準・安全装置点検承認
            </span>
            <Link href="/houday/settings" className="text-rose-700 hover:underline flex items-center gap-1">
              放デイ設定・車両管理へ →
            </Link>
          </div>

          {/* 管理者KPIサマリーカード */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
            {/* 1日10名定員＆減算防止アラート */}
            <Card className="border-rose-200 bg-white shadow-2xs">
              <CardHeader className="p-4 pb-2">
                <CardDescription className="text-xs text-rose-900 font-medium flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span>本日利用実績（定員10名）</span>
                  <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-600" />
                </CardDescription>
                <CardTitle className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-800 font-mono">
                  {presentCount} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">/ 定員 {settings.capacity || 10}名</span>
                </CardTitle>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="p-4 pt-0 text-[11px] flex justify-between items-center">
                {isCapacityExceeded ? (
                  <span className="text-rose-600 font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                    <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> 定員超過警告！
                  </span>
                ) : isCapacityNear ? (
                  <span className="text-amber-700 font-bold">定員満枠（適正）</span>
                ) : (
                  <span className="text-emerald-700 font-bold">空き枠あり（予約可能）</span>
                )}
                <span className="text-slate-500">定員超過減算なし</span>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            {/* 人員配置基準（基準2名＋半数有資格） */}
            <Card className="border-rose-200 bg-white shadow-2xs">
              <CardHeader className="p-4 pb-2">
                <CardDescription className="text-xs text-rose-900 font-medium flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span>人員配置基準 充足状況</span>
                  <UserCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                </CardDescription>
                <CardTitle className="text-2xl font-black text-emerald-700 font-mono">
                  基準適合
                </CardTitle>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="p-4 pt-0 text-[11px] text-slate-600 flex justify-between items-center">
                <span>指導員・保育士: <strong>3名配置</strong></span>
                <span className="text-emerald-700 font-bold">有資格比率 67%</span>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            {/* 実費徴収集計（おやつ＋創作教材） */}
            <Card className="border-rose-200 bg-white shadow-2xs">
              <CardHeader className="p-4 pb-2">
                <CardDescription className="text-xs text-rose-900 font-medium flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span>当月実費徴収 見込合計</span>
                  <Cookie className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600" />
                </CardDescription>
                <CardTitle className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-800 font-mono">
                  {totalActualCost.toLocaleString()} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">円</span>
                </CardTitle>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="p-4 pt-0 text-[11px] text-slate-600 flex justify-between items-center">
                <span>おやつ: {totalSnackActualCost.toLocaleString()}円</span>
                <span>教材: {totalMaterialCost.toLocaleString()}円</span>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            {/* 送迎運行＆安全点検ログ承認 */}
            <Card className="border-rose-200 bg-white shadow-2xs">

                  {todayTransports.length} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">便運行</span>

              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="p-4 pt-0 text-[11px] text-emerald-700 flex justify-between items-center">

                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> 置き去り防止装置 点検済

                <Link href="/houday/transport" className="underline hover:text-slate-900">詳細 →</Link>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </div>

          {/* 管理者専用アクション ＆ 国保連・上限額管理 */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
            <Card className="border-sky-200 shadow-2xs">
              <CardHeader className="pb-3 border-b border-sky-100 flex flex-row items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Receipt className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-600" />
                    国保連請求CSV一括出力 ＆ 上限額管理結果票
                  </CardTitle>
                  <CardDescription className="text-xs">

                  </CardDescription>
                </div>
                <Button asChild size="sm" className="h-8 text-xs bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-700 font-bold">
                  <Link href="/houday/billing">請求・集計画面へ →</Link>
                </Button>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="pt-4 space-y-3 text-xs">
                <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-sky-50/70 border border-sky-100 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <span className="font-bold text-sky-950 block">国保連伝送CSV生成（令和6年改正告示準拠）</span>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-sky-700">学校開学日/休業日別基本単位・加算一括算定</span>
                  </div>
                  <Badge className="bg-sky-600 text-white">出力準備完了</Badge>
                </div>

                <div className="p-3 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 block">利用者負担上限額管理結果票（複数事業所併用児）</span>

                  </div>
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="border-slate-300">対象2名</Badge>
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            {/* 送迎車両・置き去り防止装置 管理者承認ボード */}
            <Card className="border-indigo-200 shadow-2xs">
              <CardHeader className="pb-3 border-b border-indigo-100 flex flex-row items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Bus className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600" />
                    送迎車両 安全装置・置き去り防止点検 承認状況
                  </CardTitle>
                  <CardDescription className="text-xs">
                    児童福祉法上の義務化要件：後部座席見回りおよび自動降車ブザー点検
                  </CardDescription>
                </div>
                <Button asChild size="sm" variant="outline" className="h-8 text-xs border-indigo-300 text-indigo-800">
                  <Link href="/houday/transport">運行簿詳細 →</Link>
                </Button>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="pt-4 space-y-2.5">
                {todayTransports.map(t => (
                  <div key={t.id} className="p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-slate-900">
                        <span>{t.vehicle_name}</span>
                        <span className="text-slate-500 font-mono text-[11px]">({t.depart_time} 発)</span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-600 mt-0.5">
                        運転者: {t.driver_name} ｜ 添乗員: {t.attendant_name}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-right">
                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-bold text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-emerald-200">
                        <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        管理者点検承認済
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* ロール②：児童発達支援管理責任者（児発管：service_manager）専用ビュー */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {isServiceManager && (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <div className="p-3 bg-sky-50 border border-sky-200 rounded-xl text-xs text-sky-950 font-bold flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <FileSpreadsheet className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-600" />
              児童発達支援管理責任者ダッシュボード：5領域個別支援計画（6ヶ月更新）・支給量枠管理・関係機関連携・指導記録総括
            </span>
            <span className="text-sky-800 text-[11px]">
              こども家庭庁告示準拠「5領域支援（健康、運動、認知、言語、社会性）」完全対応
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* 児発管KPIサマリー */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <Card className="border-sky-300 bg-white shadow-2xs">
              <CardHeader className="p-4 pb-2">
                <CardDescription className="text-xs text-sky-900 font-medium flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span>5領域個別支援計画 更新アラート</span>
                  <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600" />
                </CardDescription>
                <CardTitle className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-800 font-mono">
                  {planAlerts.length} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">名が期限間近/満了</span>
                </CardTitle>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="p-4 pt-0 text-[11px] text-amber-800">
                <span>6ヶ月周期の再アセスメント・更新対象</span>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            <Card className="border-sky-300 bg-white shadow-2xs">
              <CardHeader className="p-4 pb-2">
                <CardDescription className="text-xs text-sky-900 font-medium flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span>通所受給日数 消化管理</span>
                  <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-600" />
                </CardDescription>
                <CardTitle className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-800 font-mono">
                  枠内適正利用
                </CardTitle>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="p-4 pt-0 text-[11px] text-slate-600">
                <span>月間支給量上限オーバー警告なし</span>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            <Card className="border-sky-300 bg-white shadow-2xs">
              <CardHeader className="p-4 pb-2">
                <CardDescription className="text-xs text-sky-900 font-medium flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span>学校・相談支援 機関連携</span>
                  <HeartHandshake className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                </CardDescription>
                <CardTitle className="text-2xl font-black text-slate-800 font-mono">
                  {coordinationLogs.length} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">件（直近連携録）</span>

              </CardHeader>

              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
            {/* 5領域個別支援計画 策定・更新期限管理リスト */}
            <Card className="border-sky-200 shadow-2xs">
              <CardHeader className="pb-3 border-b border-sky-100 flex flex-row items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2">

                  </CardTitle>
                  <CardDescription className="text-xs">

                  </CardDescription>
                </div>
                <Button asChild size="sm" variant="ghost" className="h-8 text-xs text-sky-800">
                  <Link href="/houday/plans">計画一覧 →</Link>
                </Button>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="pt-4 space-y-3">
                {children.map(c => {
                  const plan = plans.find(p => p.child_id === c.id);
                  const usedDays = usageMap[c.id] || 0;
                  const grantDays = c.grant_days || 23;
                  const usagePercent = Math.min(100, Math.round((usedDays / grantDays) * 100));

                  return (
                    <div key={c.id} className="p-3 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-slate-50/70 text-xs space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

                        </div>
                        <div className="w-full h-2 bg-slate-200 rounded-full overflow-hidden">
                          <div 
                            className={`h-full ${usagePercent >= 90 ? 'bg-amber-500' : 'bg-sky-600'}`} 
                            style={{ width: `${usagePercent}%` }}
                          />
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            {/* 学校・相談支援事業所 連絡調整・担当者会議録 */}
            <Card className="border-sky-200 shadow-2xs">
              <CardHeader className="pb-3 border-b border-sky-100 flex flex-row items-center justify-between">

                  <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2">

                          {log.organization_name}
                        </Badge>
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono">{log.target_date}</span>
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-700 leading-relaxed bg-white/80 p-2 rounded border border-emerald-100">
                      <strong>【{log.purpose}】</strong> {log.content}
                    </p>

                </Button>

            </Card>
          </div>
        </div>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}

      {/* ========================================================================= */}

          <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 rounded-xl text-xs text-emerald-950 font-bold flex items-center justify-between">
            <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Activity className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
              児童指導員・保育士ダッシュボード：本日の来所出欠・おやつアレルギー警戒・送迎運行・5領域療育日報
            </span>
            <span className="text-emerald-800 text-[11px]">
              直通クイックボタンから打刻・運行確認を素早く行えます
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* 直通クイックボタン群 */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
            <Button asChild className="h-12 bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-700 text-white font-bold text-xs shadow-xs">
              <Link href="/houday/attendance">
                <Users className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                [出欠・来所打刻]
              </Link>
            </Button>

            <Button asChild className="h-12 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-bold text-xs shadow-xs">
              <Link href="/houday/transport">
                <Bus className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                [送迎配車運行]
              </Link>
            </Button>

            <Button asChild className="h-12 bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white font-bold text-xs shadow-xs">
              <Link href="/houday/attendance">
                <Cookie className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                [おやつチェック]
              </Link>
            </Button>

            <Button asChild className="h-12 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-bold text-xs shadow-xs">
              <Link href="/houday/attendance">
                <FileSpreadsheet className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                [5領域療育記録]
              </Link>
            </Button>
          </div>

          {/* 現場指導員用ボード */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
            {/* 本日の来所・出欠ボード ＆ アレルギー警戒 */}
            <div className="lg:col-span-2 bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xs border border-slate-200 p-5 space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-3">
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-sky-600" />
                    本日の来所・出欠ボード ＆ アレルギー誤配防止チェック
                  </h2>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                    登所・退所時刻、アレルギー警戒バッジ（卵・乳・小麦等）、おやつ喫食
                  </p>
                </div>
                <Badge className="bg-sky-100 text-sky-900 border-sky-300">
                  来所: {presentCount}名
                </Badge>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-3">
                {todayAttendances.map(a => (

                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between">
                      <div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm">{a.child_name} さん</span>
                          <span className="text-[11px] bg-sky-100 text-sky-800 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-bold">
                            {a.grade}
                          </span>
                          <span className="text-slate-500 text-[11px]">{a.school_name}</span>
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] bg-white text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300">
                            機嫌: {a.child_mood || '良好'}
                          </Badge>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 mt-1 text-[11px] text-slate-600">
                          <span className="font-mono flex items-center gap-1">
                            <Clock className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-400" />
                            {a.arrival_time} 〜 {a.departure_time}
                          </span>

                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                        {/* アレルギー警告 */}
                        {a.allergies && a.allergies !== 'なし' ? (
                          <Badge className="bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border-rose-300 text-xs font-bold px-2 py-1">
                            ⚠️ アレルギー: {a.allergies}
                          </Badge>
                        ) : (
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 bg-white">
                            アレルギーなし
                          </Badge>
                        )}

                        {/* おやつ喫食 */}
                        {a.snack_consumed ? (
                          <Badge className="bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 border-amber-300 text-xs font-bold">
                            🍪 おやつ済
                          </Badge>
                        ) : (
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                            おやつ未
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* 5領域療育記録＆保護者連絡メモ */}
                    <div className="pt-2 border-t border-slate-200/60 bg-white/80 p-2.5 rounded-lg space-y-1">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-[11px]">
                        <span className="font-bold text-slate-700">5領域 療育日報・活動メモ:</span>
                        <span className="text-slate-400 font-mono text-[10px]">担当: {a.staff_name || '指導員'}</span>
                      </div>
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">
                        {a.support_note || '本日は集団遊び（リトミック・バランス感覚ゲーム）に参加。指示をよく聞き、笑顔で過ごせました。'}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* 送迎運行ボード（学校お迎え・自宅送り） */}
            <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xs border border-slate-200 p-5 space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-3">
                <div>
                  <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Bus className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600" />
                    送迎運行ボード
                  </h2>
                  <p className="text-xs text-slate-500">
                    学校お迎え・自宅送り便 ＆ 降車後置き去り確認
                  </p>
                </div>
                <Button asChild size="sm" variant="ghost" className="h-8 text-xs text-indigo-800">
                  <Link href="/houday/transport">運行簿 →</Link>
                </Button>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-3">
                {todayTransports.map(t => (
                  <div key={t.id} className="p-3.5 rounded-xl border border-indigo-100 bg-indigo-50/40 text-xs space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="font-bold text-indigo-950 text-sm">{t.vehicle_name}</span>
                      <span className="font-mono text-indigo-700 bg-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-indigo-200 font-bold">
                        {t.depart_time} 発
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-slate-600">
                      運転: <strong>{t.driver_name}</strong> ｜ 添乗: <strong>{t.attendant_name}</strong>
                    </div>

                    <div className="p-2 bg-emerald-50 rounded border border-emerald-200 text-emerald-900 text-[11px] font-bold flex items-center justify-between">
                      <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                        <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                        降車時 置き去り防止確認
                      </span>
                      <span className="bg-emerald-600 text-white text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded">
                        点検完了
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';

  LayoutDashboard,
  Users,
  CalendarCheck,
  Bus,
  FileSpreadsheet,
  Receipt,
  Settings,
  Sparkles,
  ChevronDown,
  Building,
  LogOut,
  Home
} from 'lucide-react';

import { getFacilityName } from '@/lib/facilityHelper';
import { ServiceModeDropdown } from '@/components/ServiceModeDropdown';

import { getRole } from '@/lib/auth';

export default async function HoudayLayout({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  const facilityName = getFacilityName('houday');
  const role = (await getRole()) || 'staff';
  const isAdmin = role === 'admin';
  const isServiceManager = role === 'service_manager';
  const isStaff = role === 'staff';

  const roleLabel = isAdmin ? '管理者' : isServiceManager ? '児発管' : '児童指導員・保育士';
  const roleBadgeColor = isAdmin 
    ? 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border-rose-300' 
    : isServiceManager 
      ? 'bg-sky-100 text-sky-900 border-sky-300' 
      : 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300';

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 flex flex-col font-sans">
      {/* 放デイ専用トップバー（シアン・スカイブルー基調） */}
      <header className="bg-sky-600 text-white shadow-md sticky top-0 z-50">
        <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between h-16">
            {/* サービスブランド */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <div className="w-10 h-10 rounded-xl bg-white/20 backdrop-blur-sm flex items-center justify-center font-black text-xl shadow-inner border border-white/30 text-white">
                放
              </div>
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">

                  <span className="bg-sky-800 text-sky-100 text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium border border-sky-400/40">
                    放課後等デイサービス
                  </span>
                  <span className={`text-[10px] px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold border ${roleBadgeColor}`}>
                    {roleLabel}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-sky-100/90 font-light">
                  5領域支援・送迎運行管理・学校開学連動・保護者実費請求システム
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* サービス切替＆法人統括 */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <ServiceModeDropdown currentMode="houday" variant="transparent" />

              <Link
                href="/corporate/dashboard"
                className="hidden sm:flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-sky-800/80 hover:bg-sky-900 text-sky-100 hover:text-white px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium transition-colors border border-sky-500/50"
              >
                <Building className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                法人統括
              </Link>

              <form action={logout} className="m-0 p-0">
                <button
                  type="submit"
                  className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-colors shadow-2xs cursor-pointer"
                  title="ログアウト"
                >
                  <LogOut className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>ログアウト</span>
                </button>
              </form>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* サブナビゲーションバー */}
        <nav className="bg-sky-700/60 border-t border-sky-500/30 overflow-x-auto">
          <div className="max-w-7xl mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8">
            <div className="flex space-x-1 sm:space-x-2 py-2">
              <Link
                href="/houday/dashboard"
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium text-white hover:bg-white/15 transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"
              >
                <LayoutDashboard className="w-4 h-4" />
                ダッシュボード
              </Link>
              <Link
                href="/houday/children"
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium text-white hover:bg-white/15 transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"
              >
                <Users className="w-4 h-4" />
                児童台帳
              </Link>
              <Link
                href="/houday/attendance"
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium text-white hover:bg-white/15 transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"
              >
                <CalendarCheck className="w-4 h-4" />
                通所記録・おやつ
              </Link>
              <Link
                href="/houday/transport"
                className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium text-white hover:bg-white/15 transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"
              >
                <Bus className="w-4 h-4" />
                送迎運行管理簿

                5領域個別支援計画
              </Link>
              {/* スタッフ権限時は「実費請求＆国保連」「設定・車両」を非表示 */}
              {!isStaff && (
                <>
                  <Link
                    href="/houday/billing"
                    className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium text-white hover:bg-white/15 transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"
                  >
                    <Receipt className="w-4 h-4" />
                    実費請求＆国保連
                  </Link>
                  {isAdmin && (
                    <Link
                      href="/houday/settings"
                      className="flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-medium text-white hover:bg-white/15 transition-colors whitespace-nowrap"
                    >
                      <Settings className="w-4 h-4" />
                      設定・車両
                    </Link>
                  )}
                </>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>
        </nav>
      </header>

      {/* メインコンテンツ */}
      <main className="flex-1 max-w-7xl w-full mx-auto px-4 sm:px-6 lg:px-8 py-6">
        {children}
      </main>

      {/* フッター */}
      <footer className="bg-white border-t border-slate-200 py-4 text-center text-xs text-slate-500">
        {facilityName} 業務管理システム（児童福祉法・5領域ガイドライン・安全装置点検義務準拠）
      </footer>
    </div>
  );
}


================================================================================
File: src/app/(houday)/houday/lib/db.ts

import { getDbConnection } from '@/lib/db-client';
import Database from 'better-sqlite3';

let isHoudayDbInitialized = false;

export function getHoudayDb(): Database.Database {
  const db = getDbConnection('houday');
  if (!isHoudayDbInitialized) {
    initHoudayDatabase(db);
    isHoudayDbInitialized = true;
  }
  return db;
}

function initHoudayDatabase(db: Database.Database) {
  db.exec(`
    -- 1. 放デイ事業所設定
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS houday_settings (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      facility_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      capacity INTEGER DEFAULT 10,                 -- 定員10名
      snack_price INTEGER DEFAULT 100,             -- おやつ実費代（1回）
      activity_material_cost INTEGER DEFAULT 1000, -- 創作教材費（月額）
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      updated_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    );

    -- 2. 送迎車両マスター
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS houday_vehicles (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      vehicle_name TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- 例: '1号車 (セレナ)', '2号車 (タント)'
      plate_number TEXT,                          -- 例: '神戸 500 あ 12-34'
      capacity INTEGER DEFAULT 6,                  -- 乗車定員
      has_safety_alarm INTEGER DEFAULT 1,          -- 置き去り防止安全装置装備 (1:有, 0:無)
      notes TEXT,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    );

    -- 3. 学校マスター・年間開学カレンダー
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS houday_schools (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      school_name TEXT NOT NULL,                   -- 例: '神戸市立中央小学校', '県立神戸特別支援学校'
      school_type TEXT DEFAULT 'elementary',      -- 'elementary', 'junior_high', 'high', 'special_needs'
      dismissal_time TEXT DEFAULT '14:30',        -- 通常下校時間
      early_dismissal_time TEXT DEFAULT '11:45',  -- 短縮授業下校時間
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    );

    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS houday_calendar (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      target_date TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,            -- YYYY-MM-DD
      day_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'school_day', -- 'school_day'(開学日・放課後), 'vacation'(休業日・土日祝/長期休暇)
      description TEXT,                            -- '夏休み', '運動会振替休' 等
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    );

    -- 4. 児童台帳（保護者、学校、受給者証）
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS houday_children (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      furigana TEXT,
      date_of_birth TEXT,
      grade TEXT,                                  -- 例: '小3', '中1', '高2'
      school_id TEXT,
      school_name TEXT,
      recipient_number TEXT,                       -- 通所受給者証番号
      grant_days INTEGER DEFAULT 23,               -- 支給量（月上限日数）
      has_medical_care INTEGER DEFAULT 0,          -- 医療的ケア児該当 (1:要ケア, 0:非該当)
      guardian_name TEXT NOT NULL,                 -- 保護者氏名
      guardian_contact TEXT NOT NULL,             -- 保護者連絡先
      home_address TEXT,
      pickup_needed INTEGER DEFAULT 1,             -- 送迎希望 (1:希望, 0:不要)
      allergies TEXT,                              -- アレルギー・配慮事項
      notes TEXT,
      status TEXT DEFAULT 'active',                -- 'active', 'suspended', 'graduated'
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      updated_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      FOREIGN KEY (school_id) REFERENCES houday_schools(id)
    );

    -- 5. 通所記録・出席・おやつ実食
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS houday_attendance (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      child_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      target_date TEXT NOT NULL,                   -- YYYY-MM-DD
      service_type TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- 'school_day'(授業終了後), 'vacation'(休業日)
      status TEXT DEFAULT 'present',               -- 'present'(出席), 'absent'(欠席), 'cancelled'(キャンセル)
      arrival_time TEXT,                           -- 来所時刻
      departure_time TEXT,                         -- 退出時刻
      snack_consumed INTEGER DEFAULT 1,            -- おやつ提供 (1:提供・実費計上, 0:無)
      pickup_school INTEGER DEFAULT 1,             -- 学校迎え利用 (1:有, 0:無)
      dropoff_home INTEGER DEFAULT 1,              -- 自宅送り利用 (1:有, 0:無)
      support_note TEXT,                           -- 指導員記録・活動内容
      staff_name TEXT,                             -- 担当指導員
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      FOREIGN KEY (child_id) REFERENCES houday_children(id),
      UNIQUE(child_id, target_date)
    );

    -- 6. 送迎運行管理＆置き去り防止点検記録簿
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS houday_transport_logs (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      transport_date TEXT NOT NULL,                -- YYYY-MM-DD
      trip_type TEXT NOT NULL,                     -- 'pickup_school'(学校迎え), 'pickup_home'(自宅迎え), 'dropoff_home'(自宅送り)
      vehicle_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      driver_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      attendant_name TEXT NOT NULL,                -- 添乗員（安全確認担当）
      depart_time TEXT,
      arrive_time TEXT,
      safety_alarm_checked INTEGER DEFAULT 1,      -- 置き去り防止ブザー・装置確認 (1:完了)
      seat_check_confirmed INTEGER DEFAULT 1,      -- 車内後部座席見回り確認 (1:児童置き去りゼロ確認)
      children_ids TEXT,                           -- カンマ区切りの児童IDリスト
      notes TEXT,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      FOREIGN KEY (vehicle_id) REFERENCES houday_vehicles(id)
    );

    -- 7. 5領域個別支援計画書（児発管）
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS houday_plans (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      child_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      status TEXT DEFAULT 'active',                -- 'draft', 'active', 'archived'
      plan_start_date TEXT NOT NULL,
      plan_end_date TEXT NOT NULL,
      creator_name TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- 作成者（児童発達支援管理責任者）
      overall_goal TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- 全体目標（長期目標）
      short_term_goal TEXT NOT NULL,               -- 短期目標
      -- 5領域の具体的支援内容
      domain_health_life TEXT,                     -- ① 健康・生活
      domain_motor_sensory TEXT,                   -- ② 運動・感覚
      domain_cognition_behavior TEXT,              -- ③ 認知・行動
      domain_language_communication TEXT,          -- ④ 言語・コミュニケーション
      domain_social_relationship TEXT,             -- ⑤ 人間関係・社会性
      school_cooperation TEXT,                     -- 学校・関係機関連携
      family_support TEXT,                         -- 保護者支援・意向
      guardian_agreed_date TEXT,                   -- 保護者同意・交付日
      monitoring_date TEXT,                        -- 次回モニタリング予定日
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      updated_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      FOREIGN KEY (child_id) REFERENCES houday_children(id)
    );

    -- 8. 保護者実費請求＆国保連集計
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS houday_monthly_billings (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      child_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      target_month TEXT NOT NULL,                  -- YYYY-MM
      attendance_days INTEGER DEFAULT 0,           -- 通所日数
      school_day_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,          -- 平日放課後利用回数
      vacation_day_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,        -- 休業日利用回数
      snack_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,               -- おやつ提供回数
      snack_total_cost INTEGER DEFAULT 0,          -- おやつ代実費合計 (snack_count * 100円)
      material_cost INTEGER DEFAULT 1000,          -- 創作活動費
      transport_count INTEGER DEFAULT 0,           -- 送迎利用回数
      kokuho_units INTEGER DEFAULT 0,              -- 国保連算定単位数
      guardian_copay_amount INTEGER DEFAULT 0,     -- 保護者法定自己負担額（上限管理後）
      guardian_actual_cost INTEGER DEFAULT 0,      -- 保護者実費請求合計 (おやつ + 教材費)
      guardian_grand_total INTEGER DEFAULT 0,      -- 保護者請求総額
      is_locked INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      FOREIGN KEY (child_id) REFERENCES houday_children(id),
      UNIQUE(child_id, target_month)
    );

    -- 9. 学校・相談支援連携会議録（児発管）
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS houday_coordination_logs (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
      child_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      target_date TEXT NOT NULL,
      organization_name TEXT NOT NULL, -- '神戸市立中央小学校 (特別支援学級 担任)', '相談支援事業所 すまいる'
      coordinator_name TEXT NOT NULL,
      purpose TEXT NOT NULL,          -- '個別支援計画策定カンファレンス', '学校での過ごし方・情緒安定の共有'
      content TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
      FOREIGN KEY (child_id) REFERENCES houday_children(id)
    );

    -- インデックス
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_houday_children_school ON houday_children(school_id);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_houday_att_child_date ON houday_attendance(child_id, target_date);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_houday_trans_date ON houday_transport_logs(transport_date);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_houday_plans_child ON houday_plans(child_id);
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_houday_billings_child_month ON houday_monthly_billings(child_id, target_month);
  `);

  // カラム追加マイグレーション
  const addColumns = [
    { table: 'houday_attendance', col: "domain_tags TEXT DEFAULT 'health,motor'" },
    { table: 'houday_attendance', col: "child_mood TEXT DEFAULT '良好'" },
    { table: 'houday_attendance', col: 'manager_approved INTEGER DEFAULT 0' },
    { table: 'houday_transport_logs', col: 'manager_approved INTEGER DEFAULT 1' },
    { table: 'houday_settings', col: 'qualified_staff_ratio REAL DEFAULT 0.67' },
    { table: 'houday_settings', col: 'base_staff_count INTEGER DEFAULT 3' },
  ];
  for (const { table, col } of addColumns) {
    try {
      db.exec(`ALTER TABLE ${table} ADD COLUMN ${col}`);
    } catch (e) {
      // 既に存在する場合はスキップ
    }
  }

  // 初期シードデータ投入（未投入時のみ）
  const count = db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM houday_settings').get() as any;
  if (count.cnt === 0) {
    seedHoudayInitialData(db);
  } else {
    try {
      const coordCnt = (db.prepare('SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt FROM houday_coordination_logs').get() as any).cnt;
      if (coordCnt === 0) {
        db.prepare(`
          INSERT INTO houday_coordination_logs (id, child_id, target_date, organization_name, coordinator_name, purpose, content)
          VALUES ('hcoord_1', 'child_1', '2026-10-09', '神戸市立中央小学校（特別支援学級 担任）', '担任 高橋先生', '学校生活での集中持続時間とクールダウン方法の共有', '国語・算数授業中の離席傾向が減少傾向にあることを確認。放デイでの5領域個別療育（運動・感覚遊び）が情緒安定に寄与している旨を担任と共有した。')
        `).run();
      }
    } catch (e) {
      // 補完失敗は無視
    }

    // 既存のハードコード名称のクリーンアップ
    try {
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE houday_settings 
        SET facility_name = '放課後等デイサービス事業所' 
        WHERE facility_name = '放課後等デイサービス にじいろキッズ'
      `).run();
    } catch (e) {
      // 無視
    }
  }
}

        id, child_id, target_month, attendance_days, school_day_count, vacation_day_count,
        snack_count, snack_total_cost, material_cost, transport_count, kokuho_units,
        guardian_copay_amount, guardian_actual_cost, guardian_grand_total
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `);
    for (const c of children) {
      const days = c.days > 20 ? 20 : c.days;
      const snackCost = days * 100;
      const matCost = 1000;
      const actualCost = snackCost + matCost;
      const kokuhoUnits = days * 610; // 平日放課後 610単位相当
      insBill.run(`hbill_${c.id}_${targetMonth}`, c.id, targetMonth, days, days, 0, days, snackCost, matCost, days * 2, kokuhoUnits, 0, actualCost, actualCost);
    }
  })();
}

'use server';

import { getHoudayDb } from '../lib/db';
import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';

export async function createHoudayPlan(formData: FormData) {
  try {
    const db = getHoudayDb();
    const childId = formData.get('child_id') as string;
    const planStartDate = (formData.get('plan_start_date') as string)?.trim();
    const planEndDate = (formData.get('plan_end_date') as string)?.trim();
    const creatorName = (formData.get('creator_name') as string)?.trim() || '児発管 井上';
    const overallGoal = (formData.get('overall_goal') as string)?.trim();
    const shortTermGoal = (formData.get('short_term_goal') as string)?.trim();
    const domainHealthLife = (formData.get('domain_health_life') as string)?.trim() || '';
    const domainMotorSensory = (formData.get('domain_motor_sensory') as string)?.trim() || '';
    const domainCognitionBehavior = (formData.get('domain_cognition_behavior') as string)?.trim() || '';
    const domainLanguageCommunication = (formData.get('domain_language_communication') as string)?.trim() || '';
    const domainSocialRelationship = (formData.get('domain_social_relationship') as string)?.trim() || '';
    const schoolCooperation = (formData.get('school_cooperation') as string)?.trim() || '';
    const familySupport = (formData.get('family_support') as string)?.trim() || '';
    const guardianAgreedDate = (formData.get('guardian_agreed_date') as string)?.trim() || null;
    const monitoringDate = (formData.get('monitoring_date') as string)?.trim() || null;

    if (!childId || !planStartDate || !planEndDate || !overallGoal || !shortTermGoal) {
      return;
    }

    const id = `plan_${childId}_${Date.now()}`;
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO houday_plans (
        id, child_id, status, plan_start_date, plan_end_date, creator_name,
        overall_goal, short_term_goal,
        domain_health_life, domain_motor_sensory, domain_cognition_behavior,
        domain_language_communication, domain_social_relationship,
        school_cooperation, family_support, guardian_agreed_date, monitoring_date
      ) VALUES (?, ?, 'active', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(
      id, childId, planStartDate, planEndDate, creatorName,
      overallGoal, shortTermGoal,
      domainHealthLife, domainMotorSensory, domainCognitionBehavior,
      domainLanguageCommunication, domainSocialRelationship,
      schoolCooperation, familySupport, guardianAgreedDate, monitoringDate
    );

    revalidatePath('/houday/plans');
    revalidatePath('/houday/dashboard');
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('createHoudayPlan error:', error);
  }
}

'use server';

import { getHoudayDb } from '../lib/db';
import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';

export async function updateHoudaySettings(formData: FormData) {
  try {
    const db = getHoudayDb();
    const facilityName = (formData.get('facility_name') as string)?.trim() || '放課後等デイサービス事業所';
    const capacity = parseInt(formData.get('capacity') as string, 10) || 10;
    const snackPrice = parseInt(formData.get('snack_price') as string, 10) || 100;
    const activityMaterialCost = parseInt(formData.get('activity_material_cost') as string, 10) || 1000;

    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE houday_settings
      SET facility_name = ?, capacity = ?, snack_price = ?,
          activity_material_cost = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      WHERE id = 'houday_default'
    `).run(facilityName, capacity, snackPrice, activityMaterialCost);

    revalidatePath('/houday/settings');
    revalidatePath('/houday/dashboard');
    revalidatePath('/houday/billing');
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('updateHoudaySettings error:', error);
  }
}

export async function addHoudayVehicle(formData: FormData) {
  try {
    const db = getHoudayDb();
    const vehicleName = (formData.get('vehicle_name') as string)?.trim();
    const plateNumber = (formData.get('plate_number') as string)?.trim() || '';
    const capacity = parseInt(formData.get('capacity') as string, 10) || 6;
    const hasSafetyAlarm = formData.get('has_safety_alarm') === '1' ? 1 : 0;
    const notes = (formData.get('notes') as string)?.trim() || '';

    if (!vehicleName) {
      return;
    }

    const id = `veh_${Date.now()}`;
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO houday_vehicles (id, vehicle_name, plate_number, capacity, has_safety_alarm, notes)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(id, vehicleName, plateNumber, capacity, hasSafetyAlarm, notes);

    revalidatePath('/houday/settings');
    revalidatePath('/settings');
    revalidatePath('/houday/transport');
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('addHoudayVehicle error:', error);
  }
}

export async function deleteHoudayVehicle(vehicleId: string) {
  try {
    if (!vehicleId) {
      return { success: false, error: '車両IDが指定されていません' };
    }
    const db = getHoudayDb();

    db.transaction(() => {
      // 該当車両に紐づく送迎運行記録の安全な整理
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM houday_transport_logs WHERE vehicle_id = ?').run(vehicleId);
      // 車両本体の削除
      db.prepare('DELETE FROM houday_vehicles WHERE id = ?').run(vehicleId);
    })();

    try {
      revalidatePath('/houday/settings');
      revalidatePath('/settings');
      revalidatePath('/houday/transport');
    } catch (e) {}
    return { success: true };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('deleteHoudayVehicle error:', error);
    return { success: false, error: error?.message || '車両の削除に失敗しました' };
  }
}

'use server';

import { getHoudayDb } from '../lib/db';
import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';

export async function createHoudayTransportLog(formData: FormData) {
  try {
    const db = getHoudayDb();
    const transportDate = (formData.get('transport_date') as string)?.trim() || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const tripType = (formData.get('trip_type') as string) || 'pickup_school';
    const vehicleId = formData.get('vehicle_id') as string;
    const driverName = (formData.get('driver_name') as string)?.trim() || '運転手';
    const attendantName = (formData.get('attendant_name') as string)?.trim() || '指導員（添乗）';
    const departTime = (formData.get('depart_time') as string)?.trim() || '14:30';
    const arriveTime = (formData.get('arrive_time') as string)?.trim() || '15:20';
    const safetyAlarmChecked = formData.get('safety_alarm_checked') === '1' ? 1 : 0;
    const seatCheckConfirmed = formData.get('seat_check_confirmed') === '1' ? 1 : 0;
    const childrenIds = (formData.get('children_ids') as string)?.trim() || '';
    const notes = (formData.get('notes') as string)?.trim() || '';

    if (!vehicleId) {
      return;
    }

    const id = `tr_${Date.now()}`;
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO houday_transport_logs (
        id, transport_date, trip_type, vehicle_id, driver_name,
        attendant_name, depart_time, arrive_time, safety_alarm_checked,
        seat_check_confirmed, children_ids, notes
      ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(
      id, transportDate, tripType, vehicleId, driverName,
      attendantName, departTime, arriveTime, safetyAlarmChecked,
      seatCheckConfirmed, childrenIds, notes
    );

    revalidatePath('/houday/transport');
    revalidatePath('/houday/dashboard');
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('createHoudayTransportLog error:', error);
  }
}

import React from 'react';
import { getDbConnection } from '@/lib/db-client';
import { Clock, Calendar, CheckCircle2, ShieldCheck, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';

export const metadata = {
  title: '勤怠・残業・有休管理簿 | 就労継続支援A型 かがやきワーク',
};

export default function TypeAAttendancePage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams?: { date?: string };
}) {
  const db = getDbConnection('type_a');
  const today = searchParams?.date || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  let attendances: any[] = [];
  try {
    attendances = db.prepare(`
      SELECT a.*, c.name as client_name
      FROM attendance_records a
      JOIN clients c ON a.client_id = c.id
      WHERE a.date = ?
      ORDER BY a.clock_in ASC
    `).all(today) as any[];
  } catch (e) {
    attendances = [];
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2">
            <Clock className="w-7 h-7 text-indigo-600" />
            就労継続支援A型 勤怠 ＆ 年5日有休管理簿
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            出退勤打刻・実働時間・時間外割増・労基法第39条年5日有休取得義務の管理
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white px-4 py-2 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 flex items-center gap-3">
          <Calendar className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-600" />
          <form method="GET" className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <input
              type="date"
              name="date"
              defaultValue={today}
              className="px-2 py-1 border rounded text-xs font-bold text-slate-700"
            />
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="px-3 py-1 bg-indigo-600 text-white rounded text-xs font-bold hover:bg-indigo-700"
            >
              表示
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">

        </div>

          <div className="text-xs text-emerald-600 font-bold mt-1">時間外なし（安全就業）</div>
        </div>
      </div>

          {today} 出勤・打刻記録一覧
        </div>

                <th className="p-3.5">残業時間</th>
                <th className="p-3.5">就業場所</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y text-slate-700">
              {attendances.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={7} className="p-6 text-center text-slate-400">
                    本日の打刻データがありません。
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                attendances.map((a) => (
                  <tr key={a.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50">
                    <td className="p-3.5 font-bold text-slate-900">{a.client_name}</td>
                    <td className="p-3.5">
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 font-bold">
                        {a.status === 'present' ? '出勤' : a.status}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3.5 font-mono">{a.clock_in || '09:00'}</td>
                    <td className="p-3.5 font-mono">{a.clock_out || '15:00'}</td>
                    <td className="p-3.5 font-bold font-mono">{a.work_hours || 4.5}時間</td>
                    <td className="p-3.5 font-mono">{a.overtime_hours || 0}時間</td>
                    <td className="p-3.5">
                      {a.work_location === 'offsite' ? (
                        <span className="text-amber-700 font-bold bg-amber-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">施設外就労</span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-slate-600">事業所内</span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))
              )}
            </tbody>

import React from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { getDbConnection } from '@/lib/db-client';
import { FileSpreadsheet, PlusCircle, CheckCircle2, Clock } from 'lucide-react';

export const metadata = {
  title: '個別支援計画（就労・一般就労移行） | 就労継続支援A型 かがやきワーク',
};

export default function TypeAPlansPage() {
  const db = getDbConnection('type_a');
  let plans: any[] = [];
  try {
    plans = db.prepare(`
      SELECT p.*, c.name as client_name
      FROM support_plans p
      JOIN clients c ON p.client_id = c.id
      ORDER BY p.start_date DESC
    `).all() as any[];
  } catch (e) {
    plans = [];
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2">
            <FileSpreadsheet className="w-7 h-7 text-indigo-600" />
            就労継続支援A型 個別支援計画書（就労目標・一般就労移行）
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            サービス管理責任者による就労支援目標、一般就労移行へのステップ、6ヶ月モニタリング管理
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden">
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-200 font-bold text-slate-800 text-sm">
          個別支援計画書一覧（{plans.length}件）
        </div>
        <div className="divide-y text-xs text-slate-700">
          {plans.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-8 text-center text-slate-400">登録された支援計画がありません。</div>
          ) : (
            plans.map((p) => (
              <div key={p.id} className="p-4 hover:bg-slate-50 flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-900 text-sm">{p.client_name}</span>
                    <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800 text-[11px] font-bold">
                      就労継続目標
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-slate-500 mt-1">
                    期間: {p.start_date} 〜 {p.end_date} ｜ 目標: {p.long_term_goal || '安定した就労継続と体力向上'}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <Link
                    href={`/plans/${p.id}`}
                    className="px-3 py-1.5 bg-indigo-50 hover:bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-700 font-bold rounded text-xs transition-colors"
                  >
                    計画書プレビュー
                  </Link>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import React from 'react';
import { getDbConnection } from '@/lib/db-client';
import { CalendarCheck, Calendar, CheckCircle2, Clock, Wrench } from 'lucide-react';

export const metadata = {
  title: '通所記録・作業実績 | 就労継続支援B型 かがやき工房',
};

export default function TypeBAttendancePage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams?: { date?: string };
}) {
  const db = getDbConnection('type_b');
  const today = searchParams?.date || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  let attendances: any[] = [];
  try {
    attendances = db.prepare(`
      SELECT a.*, c.name as client_name
      FROM attendance_records a
      JOIN clients c ON a.client_id = c.id
      WHERE a.date = ?
      ORDER BY a.clock_in ASC
    `).all(today) as any[];
  } catch (e) {
    attendances = [];
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2">
            <CalendarCheck className="w-7 h-7 text-emerald-600" />
            就労継続支援B型 通所記録 ＆ 作業実績
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            通所・退出時刻、作業時間（4.0h）、作業種別（軽作業・クラフト・PC作業）、出来高個数
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white px-4 py-2 rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 flex items-center gap-3">
          <Calendar className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600" />
          <form method="GET" className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <input
              type="date"
              name="date"
              defaultValue={today}
              className="px-2 py-1 border rounded text-xs font-bold text-slate-700"
            />
            <button
              type="submit"
              className="px-3 py-1 bg-emerald-600 text-white rounded text-xs font-bold hover:bg-emerald-700"
            >
              表示
            </button>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="bg-white rounded-xl shadow-sm border border-slate-200 overflow-hidden">
        <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-200 font-bold text-slate-800 text-sm">
          {today} 通所・作業実績一覧
        </div>
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-left text-xs">
            <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-slate-600 font-bold border-b">
              <tr>
                <th className="p-3.5">氏名</th>
                <th className="p-3.5">通所ステータス</th>
                <th className="p-3.5">来所時刻</th>
                <th className="p-3.5">退出時刻</th>
                <th className="p-3.5">実作業時間</th>
                <th className="p-3.5">作業種別</th>
                <th className="p-3.5 text-right">出来高実績</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y text-slate-700">
              {attendances.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={7} className="p-6 text-center text-slate-400">
                    本日の通所データがありません。
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                attendances.map((a) => (
                  <tr key={a.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50">
                    <td className="p-3.5 font-bold text-slate-900">{a.client_name}</td>
                    <td className="p-3.5">
                      <span className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 font-bold">
                        {a.status === 'present' ? '通所' : a.status}
                      </span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3.5 font-mono">{a.clock_in || '09:30'}</td>
                    <td className="p-3.5 font-mono">{a.clock_out || '15:30'}</td>
                    <td className="p-3.5 font-bold font-mono">{a.work_hours || 4.0}時間</td>
                    <td className="p-3.5">
                      <span className="text-slate-700 font-medium">部品組み立て・検品</span>
                    </td>
                    <td className="p-3.5 text-right font-mono font-bold text-emerald-700">
                      120 個
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

};

export default function TypeBPlansPage() {
  const db = getDbConnection('type_b');
  let plans: any[] = [];
  try {
    plans = db.prepare(`
      SELECT p.*, c.name as client_name
      FROM support_plans p
      JOIN clients c ON p.client_id = c.id
      ORDER BY p.start_date DESC
    `).all() as any[];
  } catch (e) {
    plans = [];
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2">
            <FileSpreadsheet className="w-7 h-7 text-emerald-600" />
            就労継続支援B型 個別支援計画書（工賃向上 ＆ 居場所づくり）
          </h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500 mt-1">
            サービス管理責任者による個別支援目標、作業能力の向上、工賃目標設定、6ヶ月モニタリング管理
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

        <div className="p-4 border-b border-slate-200 font-bold text-slate-800 text-sm">
          個別支援計画書一覧（{plans.length}件）
        </div>
        <div className="divide-y text-xs text-slate-700">
          {plans.length === 0 ? (

                      工賃向上・社会参加目標
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-slate-500 mt-1">

export interface BillingRuleRecord {
  rule_key: string;
  category: string;
  rule_name: string;
  rule_value: number;
  unit_label: string;
  description: string;
  effective_from: string;
  updated_at: string;
}

import { getAiModelInstance } from '@/lib/ai/modelFactory';

/**
 * システム設定から指定されたAIモデルインスタンスを取得する共通ヘルパー
 */
async function getActiveAiModel() {
  return getAiModelInstance({ useSearchGrounding: true });
}

/**
 * 現在DBに保存されている加算・減算ルール全件を取得
 */
export async function getAllBillingRules(): Promise<BillingRuleRecord[]> {
  try {
    const rules = db.prepare(`
      SELECT rule_key, category, rule_name, rule_value, unit_label, description, effective_from, updated_at 
      FROM billing_rules 
      ORDER BY category ASC, rule_key ASC
    `).all() as BillingRuleRecord[];
    return rules;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to get billing rules:', error);
    return [];
  }
}

function buildWageFactCheckLinks(prefecture?: string, primaryUrl?: string): FactCheckLink[] {
  const links: FactCheckLink[] = [];

  links.push({

    url: 'https://www.mhlw.go.jp/stf/seisakunitsuite/bunya/koyou_roudou/roudoukijun/minimumichiran/',
    category: 'permanent_portal',
    badgeLabel: '恒久公式窓口',
    description: '厚生労働省労働基準局が管理する本省の常設公式ページです（URL変更時でも確実にアクセス可能）。'
  });

  links.push({
    title: '厚生労働省 全都道府県労働局（所在地・公式HP案内）',
    url: 'https://www.mhlw.go.jp/kouseiroudoushou/shozaiannai/roudoukyoku/',

    description: '各都道府県の労働局が公示する地方最低賃金の公式発表ページ一覧です。'
