"use client"

import { useState, useEffect, useMemo } from "react"
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { SubmitButton } from "@/components/SubmitButton"
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label"
import { Checkbox } from "@/components/ui/checkbox"
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea"
import { saveAttendanceRecord } from "./actions"
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { Clock, MapPin, Sparkles, AlertCircle, CheckCircle2, Users } from "lucide-react"
import { getClientDayHolidayInfo } from "@/lib/compliance/holidayUtils"

function TimeSelect({ 
  name, 
  label, 
  defaultValue, 
  value: controlledValue, 
  onChange: onControlledChange, 
  minHour = 8, 
  maxHour = 18 
}: { 
  name: string, 
  label: string, 
  defaultValue?: string, 
  value?: string, 
  onChange?: (val: string) => void, 
  minHour?: number, 
  maxHour?: number 
}) {
  const initialTime = controlledValue ?? defaultValue ?? "";
  const [internalHour, setInternalHour] = useState(initialTime ? initialTime.split(':')[0] : "")
  const [internalMinute, setInternalMinute] = useState(initialTime ? initialTime.split(':')[1] : "")
  
  const hour = controlledValue !== undefined ? (controlledValue ? controlledValue.split(':')[0] : "") : internalHour;
  const minute = controlledValue !== undefined ? (controlledValue ? controlledValue.split(':')[1] : "") : internalMinute;
  const value = hour && minute ? `${hour}:${minute}` : ""

  const hours = Array.from({ length: maxHour - minHour + 1 }, (_, i) => (i + minHour).toString().padStart(2, '0'));

  const handleHourChange = (newH: string) => {
    if (controlledValue === undefined) setInternalHour(newH);
    const newMin = minute || "00";
    if (onControlledChange) {
      onControlledChange(newH ? `${newH}:${newMin}` : "");
    }
  };

  const handleMinuteChange = (newM: string) => {
    if (controlledValue === undefined) setInternalMinute(newM);
    const newHr = hour || "09";
    if (onControlledChange) {
      onControlledChange(newHr ? `${newHr}:${newM}` : "");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-1">
      <Label className="text-xs font-semibold">{label}</Label>
      <input type="hidden" name={name} value={value} />
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
        <select 
          className="flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-2 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring"
          value={hour} 
          onChange={e => handleHourChange(e.target.value)}
          aria-label={`${label} 時`}
        >
          <option value="">--</option>
          {hours.map(h => (
            <option key={h} value={h}>{h}</option>
          ))}
        </select>
        <span className="font-bold">:</span>
        <select 
          className="flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-2 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring"
          value={minute} 
          onChange={e => handleMinuteChange(e.target.value)}
          aria-label={`${label} 分`}
        >
          <option value="">--</option>
          {Array.from({ length: 60 }, (_, i) => i.toString().padStart(2, '0')).map(m => (
            <option key={m} value={m}>{m}</option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>
  )
}

export function AttendanceForm({ 
  clients, 
  todayStr,
  initialData,
  records = [],
  offsiteWorkplaces = [],
  staffList = [],
  clientShifts = [],
  hasMeal = true,
  hasTransportation = true,
  hasVisitSupport = true,
  hasAbsenceSupport = true
}: { 
  clients: any[], 
  todayStr: string,
  initialData?: any,
  records?: any[],
  offsiteWorkplaces?: any[],
  staffList?: any[],
  clientShifts?: any[],
  hasMeal?: boolean,
  hasTransportation?: boolean,
  hasVisitSupport?: boolean,
  hasAbsenceSupport?: boolean
}) {

  const router = useRouter()
  const [status, setStatus] = useState(initialData?.status || "present")
  const [isAbsenceAddition, setIsAbsenceAddition] = useState(initialData?.is_absence_addition === 1)
  const [isVisitSupport, setIsVisitSupport] = useState(initialData?.visit_support_used === 1)
  const [workType, setWorkType] = useState(initialData?.work_type || "in_facility")
  const [recordDate, setRecordDate] = useState(initialData?.record_date || todayStr)
  const [clientId, setClientId] = useState(initialData?.client_id || "")

  // 時間管理
  const [clockIn, setClockIn] = useState(initialData?.clock_in || "09:00")
  const [clockOut, setClockOut] = useState(initialData?.clock_out || "16:00")
  const [breakTimeMinutes, setBreakTimeMinutes] = useState(initialData?.break_time_minutes ?? 60)

  // 施設外・内勤 分割時間管理
  const [offsiteStartTime, setOffsiteStartTime] = useState(initialData?.offsite_start_time || "10:00")
  const [offsiteEndTime, setOffsiteEndTime] = useState(initialData?.offsite_end_time || "12:00")
  const [inFacilityStartTime, setInFacilityStartTime] = useState(initialData?.in_facility_start_time || "13:00")
  const [inFacilityEndTime, setInFacilityEndTime] = useState(initialData?.in_facility_end_time || "15:00")
  const [offsiteWorkplaceId, setOffsiteWorkplaceId] = useState(initialData?.offsite_workplace_id || "")
  const [offsiteStaffId, setOffsiteStaffId] = useState(initialData?.offsite_staff_id || "")

  // シフト自動判定案内
  const [shiftNotice, setShiftNotice] = useState<string>("")

  // 初期データ読み込み
  useEffect(() => {
    if (initialData) {
      setStatus(initialData.status || "present")
      setIsAbsenceAddition(initialData.is_absence_addition === 1)
      setIsVisitSupport(initialData.visit_support_used === 1)
      setWorkType(initialData.work_type || "in_facility")
      setRecordDate(initialData.record_date || todayStr)
      setClientId(initialData.client_id || "")
      setClockIn(initialData.clock_in || "09:00")
      setClockOut(initialData.clock_out || "16:00")
      setBreakTimeMinutes(initialData.break_time_minutes ?? 60)
      setOffsiteStartTime(initialData.offsite_start_time || "10:00")
      setOffsiteEndTime(initialData.offsite_end_time || "12:00")
      setInFacilityStartTime(initialData.in_facility_start_time || "13:00")
      setInFacilityEndTime(initialData.in_facility_end_time || "15:00")
      setOffsiteWorkplaceId(initialData.offsite_workplace_id || "")
      setOffsiteStaffId(initialData.offsite_staff_id || "")
      setShiftNotice("")
    }
  }, [initialData, todayStr])

  // 利用者や日付が変更されたとき、新規作成ならシフト情報または曜日別パターンから公休判定・予定時間を自動反映
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!initialData && clientId && recordDate) {
      const shift = clientShifts?.find(s => s.client_id === clientId && s.target_date === recordDate);
      const client = clients?.find(c => c.id === clientId);

      if (shift) {
        if (shift.is_holiday === 1) {
          setStatus('holiday');
          setShiftNotice(`※ シフト表の【${shift.holiday_type || '公休'}】設定に基づき、自動判定されました`);
          return;
        } else {
          // 出勤予定
          setStatus('present');
          const wt = shift.work_type || (shift.is_offsite === 1 ? 'out_facility' : 'in_facility');
          setWorkType(wt);
          if (shift.scheduled_in) setClockIn(shift.scheduled_in);
          if (shift.scheduled_out) setClockOut(shift.scheduled_out);
          if (shift.offsite_start_time) setOffsiteStartTime(shift.offsite_start_time);
          if (shift.offsite_end_time) setOffsiteEndTime(shift.offsite_end_time);
          if (shift.in_facility_start_time) setInFacilityStartTime(shift.in_facility_start_time);
          if (shift.in_facility_end_time) setInFacilityEndTime(shift.in_facility_end_time);

          // 就労先IDの補完（シフト側になければ曜日別パターンから参照）
          if (shift.offsite_workplace_id) {
            setOffsiteWorkplaceId(shift.offsite_workplace_id);
          } else if (client?.weekly_schedule_pattern) {
            try {
              const p = typeof client.weekly_schedule_pattern === 'string'
                ? JSON.parse(client.weekly_schedule_pattern)
                : client.weekly_schedule_pattern;
              const dObj = new Date(recordDate);
              const dayP = p[dObj.getDay().toString()];
              if (dayP?.offsite_workplace_id) {
                setOffsiteWorkplaceId(dayP.offsite_workplace_id);
              }
            } catch (e) {}
          }

          setShiftNotice(`※ シフト表の出勤予定（${shift.scheduled_in || '10:00'}〜${shift.scheduled_out || '15:00'}、${wt === 'both' ? '内勤＋施設外' : wt === 'out_facility' ? '施設外' : '内勤'}）を自動反映しました`);
          return;
        }
      } else if (client) {
        // 個別シフト未登録の場合: 曜日別定例パターン（weekly_schedule_pattern）をチェック
        let matchedPattern: any = null;
        if (client.weekly_schedule_pattern) {
          try {
            const parsed = typeof client.weekly_schedule_pattern === 'string'
              ? JSON.parse(client.weekly_schedule_pattern)
              : client.weekly_schedule_pattern;
            const dObj = new Date(recordDate);
            matchedPattern = parsed[dObj.getDay().toString()];
          } catch (e) {}
        }

        if (matchedPattern) {
          if (matchedPattern.is_holiday) {
            setStatus('holiday');
            setShiftNotice(`※ 曜日別定例パターンの【${matchedPattern.holiday_type || '公休'}】設定に基づき、自動判定されました`);
            return;
          } else {
            setStatus('present');
            const wt = matchedPattern.work_type || 'in_facility';
            setWorkType(wt);
            const sTime = matchedPattern.start_time || client.work_start_time || '10:00';
            const eTime = matchedPattern.end_time || client.work_end_time || (wt === 'out_facility' ? '16:00' : '15:00');
            setClockIn(sTime);
            setClockOut(eTime);
            if (matchedPattern.offsite_workplace_id) {
              setOffsiteWorkplaceId(matchedPattern.offsite_workplace_id);
            }
            setBreakTimeMinutes(client.break_time_minutes ?? 60);
            const typeLabel = wt === 'both' ? '内勤＋施設外' : wt === 'out_facility' ? '施設外就労' : '内勤';
            setShiftNotice(`※ 利用者台帳の曜日別設定（${sTime}〜${eTime}、${typeLabel}）を初期反映しました`);
            return;
          }
        }

        // 利用者台帳（定休日・定例設定）フォールバック判定
        const holidayInfo = getClientDayHolidayInfo(recordDate, client);
        if (holidayInfo.isHoliday) {
          setStatus('holiday');
          setShiftNotice(`※ 利用者台帳の【${holidayInfo.holidayLabel || '公休'}】設定に基づき、自動で公休判定されました`);
          return;
        }
        
        // デフォルト出勤
        setStatus('present');
        setClockIn(client.work_start_time || '10:00');
        setClockOut(client.work_end_time || '15:00');
        setBreakTimeMinutes(client.break_time_minutes ?? 60);
        setShiftNotice('');
      }
    }
  }, [clientId, recordDate, initialData, clientShifts, clients]);

  const showAbsenceAdditionForm = status === "absent" && isAbsenceAddition
  const isPresent = status === "present"
  
  // 選択された利用者の今月の欠席時対応加算の取得回数を計算 (編集中のレコードは除外)
  const absenceAdditionCount = useMemo(() => {
    if (!clientId || !records) return 0;
    return records.filter(r => 
      r.client_id === clientId && 
      r.is_absence_addition === 1 &&
      r.id !== initialData?.id
    ).length;
  }, [clientId, records, initialData]);

  const isOverLimit = absenceAdditionCount >= 4;

  const applyExampleSplitTimes = () => {
    setWorkType('both');
    setOffsiteStartTime('10:00');
    setOffsiteEndTime('12:00');
    setInFacilityStartTime('13:00');
    setInFacilityEndTime('15:00');
    setClockIn('10:00');
    setClockOut('15:00');
    setBreakTimeMinutes(60);
    toast.info('「10:00〜12:00 施設外 / 13:00〜15:00 内勤」をセットしました');
  };

  const applyExampleSplitTimesReverse = () => {
    setWorkType('both');
    setInFacilityStartTime('10:00');
    setInFacilityEndTime('12:00');
    setOffsiteStartTime('13:00');
    setOffsiteEndTime('15:00');
    setClockIn('10:00');
    setClockOut('15:00');
    setBreakTimeMinutes(60);
    toast.info('「10:00〜12:00 内勤 / 13:00〜15:00 施設外」をセットしました');
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (formData: FormData) => {
    try {
      const res = await saveAttendanceRecord(formData);
      if (res && !res.success) {
        toast.error(res.error);
        return;
      }
      toast.success("勤怠データを保存しました");
      if (res?.recordDate) {
        router.push(`/attendance?date=${res.recordDate}`);
        router.refresh();
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast.error(e.message || "エラーが発生しました");
    }
  };

  return (
    <form action={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="recordDate">日付</Label>
          <Input type="date" id="recordDate" name="recordDate" required value={recordDate} onChange={e => setRecordDate(e.target.value)} />
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="clientId">利用者</Label>
          <select 
            id="clientId" 
            name="clientId" 
            required 
            className="flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
            value={clientId}
            onChange={e => setClientId(e.target.value)}
          >
            <option value="">選択してください</option>
            {clients?.map(c => (
              <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.full_name}</option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-2">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <Label htmlFor="statusSelect">勤怠ステータス</Label>
            {status === 'holiday' && (
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-blue-700 bg-blue-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-blue-200">
                公休
              </span>
            )}
            {status === 'absent' && !isAbsenceAddition && (
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-amber-800 bg-amber-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-amber-300">
                欠勤（加算なし・無給）
              </span>
            )}
            {status === 'absent' && isAbsenceAddition && (
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-rose-700 bg-rose-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-rose-300">
                欠席時加算 算定中
              </span>
            )}
            {status === 'pto' && (
              <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-purple-700 bg-purple-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-purple-200">
                有給
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
          <select 
            id="statusSelect" 
            className="flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring"
            value={
              status === 'present' ? 'present' :
              status === 'holiday' ? 'holiday' :
              status === 'pto' ? 'pto' :
              (status === 'absent' && isAbsenceAddition) ? 'absent_addition' : 'absent_normal'
            }
            onChange={(e) => {
              const val = e.target.value;
              if (val === 'present') {
                setStatus('present');
                setIsAbsenceAddition(false);
              } else if (val === 'holiday') {
                setStatus('holiday');
                setIsAbsenceAddition(false);
              } else if (val === 'pto') {
                setStatus('pto');
                setIsAbsenceAddition(false);
              } else if (val === 'absent_normal') {
                setStatus('absent');
                setIsAbsenceAddition(false);
              } else if (val === 'absent_addition') {
                setStatus('absent');
                setIsAbsenceAddition(true);
              }
            }}
          >
            <option value="present">出勤</option>
            <option value="holiday">公休（事業所の休日・個人の所定休日）</option>
            <option value="absent_normal">欠勤（有給を使わない休み・無給欠勤 / 加算なし）</option>
            {hasAbsenceSupport && (
              <option value="absent_addition">欠席（欠席時対応加算を算定 / 94単位）</option>
            )}
            <option value="pto">有給（年次有給休暇取得）</option>
          </select>

          <input type="hidden" name="status" value={status} />
          <input type="hidden" name="isAbsenceAddition" value={isAbsenceAddition ? "true" : "false"} />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* シフト自動判定のアラート/案内 */}
      {shiftNotice && (
        <div className="p-2.5 rounded-md bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 text-xs text-blue-900 flex items-center gap-2">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 shrink-0" />
          <span>{shiftNotice}</span>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 公休・有休・欠勤（加算なし）時の案内 */}
      {(status === 'holiday' || status === 'pto' || (status === 'absent' && !isAbsenceAddition)) && (
        <div className="p-4 border rounded-md bg-amber-50/50 border-amber-200 text-sm text-amber-900 space-y-1">
          <div className="font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600" />
            {status === 'holiday' 
              ? '本日は「公休」として記録されます' 
              : status === 'pto'
                ? '本日は「有給休暇」として記録されます'
                : '本日は「欠勤（有給を使わない休み・加算なし）」として記録されます'}
          </div>
          <p className="text-xs text-amber-800 leading-relaxed">
            {status === 'holiday' 
              ? '出退勤時間は不要です。シフト連動により、本体事業所の必要人員配置の分母から除外されます。'
              : status === 'pto'
                ? '有給休暇管理簿に消化実績が反映されます。保存ボタンを押して記録を確定してください。'
                : '出退勤時間は記録されず、有給休暇も消化されません。欠席時対応加算は算定（請求）されませんのでご安心ください。'}
          </p>
        </div>
      )}

      {isPresent && (
        <div className="p-4 border rounded-md bg-muted/10 space-y-6">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
            <TimeSelect 
              name="clockIn" 
              label="出勤時間" 
              value={clockIn} 
              onChange={setClockIn} 
            />
            <TimeSelect 
              name="clockOut" 
              label="退勤時間" 
              value={clockOut} 
              onChange={setClockOut} 
            />
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <Label htmlFor="breakTimeMinutes" className="text-xs font-semibold">休憩(分)</Label>
              <Input 
                type="number" 
                id="breakTimeMinutes" 
                name="breakTimeMinutes" 
                min="0" 
                value={breakTimeMinutes} 
                onChange={e => setBreakTimeMinutes(parseInt(e.target.value) || 0)} 
                className="h-9"
                onWheel={(e) => e.currentTarget.blur()} 
              />
            </div>
            <div className="space-y-1">
              <Label htmlFor="workType" className="text-xs font-semibold">勤務形態</Label>
              <select 
                id="workType" 
                name="workType" 
                value={workType} 
                onChange={e => setWorkType(e.target.value)} 
                className="flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                <option value="in_facility">施設内（内勤のみ）</option>
                <option value="out_facility">施設外（終日施設外就労）</option>
                <option value="both">施設内＋施設外（時間分割・併用）</option>
                <option value="remote">在宅</option>
              </select>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 施設内＋施設外 併用（時間分割）の設定カード */}
          {workType === 'both' && (
            <div className="p-4 rounded-md bg-amber-50/70 border border-amber-300 space-y-4 shadow-sm">
              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-amber-200 pb-2">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold text-amber-950">
                  <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-700" />
                  施設外就労と内勤の時間分割設定（指定基準・常時配置連動）
                </div>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Button 
                    type="button" 
                    variant="outline" 
                    size="sm" 
                    onClick={applyExampleSplitTimes}
                    className="h-7 text-xs border-amber-400 bg-white hover:bg-amber-100 text-amber-900"
                  >
                    <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1 text-amber-600" />
                    外10~12 / 内13~15
                  </Button>
                  <Button 
                    type="button" 
                    variant="outline" 
                    size="sm" 
                    onClick={applyExampleSplitTimesReverse}
                    className="h-7 text-xs border-amber-400 bg-white hover:bg-amber-100 text-amber-900"
                  >
                    <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1 text-amber-600" />
                    内10~12 / 外13~15
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
                {/* 施設外就労ブロック */}
                <div className="p-3 bg-white rounded border border-amber-200 space-y-3">
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold text-amber-900 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500" />
                    ① 施設外就労の時間帯
                  </div>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                    <TimeSelect 
                      name="offsiteStartTime" 
                      label="施設外 開始" 
                      value={offsiteStartTime} 
                      onChange={setOffsiteStartTime} 
                    />
                    <TimeSelect 
                      name="offsiteEndTime" 
                      label="施設外 終了" 
                      value={offsiteEndTime} 
                      onChange={setOffsiteEndTime} 
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-2 pt-2 border-t border-amber-100">
                    <div>
                      <Label htmlFor="offsiteWorkplaceId" className="text-xs">施設外就労先</Label>
                      <select 
                        id="offsiteWorkplaceId" 
                        name="offsiteWorkplaceId" 
                        value={offsiteWorkplaceId}
                        onChange={e => setOffsiteWorkplaceId(e.target.value)}
                        className="flex h-8 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-2 py-1 text-xs shadow-sm mt-1"
                      >
                        <option value="">-- 選択してください --</option>
                        {offsiteWorkplaces?.map((wp: any) => (
                          <option key={wp.id} value={wp.id}>{wp.name}</option>
                        ))}
                      </select>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <Label htmlFor="offsiteStaffId" className="text-xs font-semibold text-amber-950 flex items-center gap-1">
                        <span>引率職員（専任同行スタッフ・基準必須）</span>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-rose-600 font-bold">*未選択は配置違反</span>
                      </Label>
                      <select 
                        id="offsiteStaffId" 
                        name="offsiteStaffId" 
                        value={offsiteStaffId}
                        onChange={e => setOffsiteStaffId(e.target.value)}
                        className="flex h-8 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-2 py-1 text-xs shadow-sm mt-1 focus:border-amber-500 font-medium"
                      >
                        <option value="">-- 引率職員を選択してください --</option>
                        {staffList?.map((s: any) => (
                          <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>👤 {s.name}</option>
                        ))}
                      </select>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* 施設内（内勤）ブロック */}
                <div className="p-3 bg-white rounded border border-blue-200 space-y-3">
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-900 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-blue-500" />
                    ② 施設内（内勤）の時間帯
                  </div>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                    <TimeSelect 
                      name="inFacilityStartTime" 
                      label="内勤 開始" 
                      value={inFacilityStartTime} 
                      onChange={setInFacilityStartTime} 
                    />
                    <TimeSelect 
                      name="inFacilityEndTime" 
                      label="内勤 終了" 
                      value={inFacilityEndTime} 
                      onChange={setInFacilityEndTime} 
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-slate-600 bg-slate-50 p-2.5 rounded border border-slate-200 mt-2">
                    <p className="font-semibold text-slate-800">💡 常時配置への反映効果：</p>
                    <p className="mt-1">
                      施設外就労の時間帯は本体配置の必要人数から除外され、内勤時間帯は事業所本体の内勤利用者として正しくカウントされます。
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          
          {/* 終日施設外就労の場合 */}
          {workType === 'out_facility' && (
            <div className="p-4 rounded-md bg-orange-50/50 border border-orange-200 space-y-4">
              <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-orange-800">施設外就労の詳細（指定基準に基づく記録）</div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label htmlFor="offsiteWorkplaceId">施設外就労先</Label>
                  <select 
                    id="offsiteWorkplaceId" 
                    name="offsiteWorkplaceId" 
                    value={offsiteWorkplaceId}
                    onChange={e => setOffsiteWorkplaceId(e.target.value)}
                    className="flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm"
                  >
                    <option value="">-- 選択してください --</option>
                    {offsiteWorkplaces?.map((wp: any) => (
                      <option key={wp.id} value={wp.id}>{wp.name}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label htmlFor="offsiteStaffId" className="font-semibold text-orange-950 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <span>引率職員（専任同行スタッフ・基準必須）</span>
                    <span className="text-xs text-rose-600 font-bold">*未選択は人員基準違反</span>
                  </Label>
                  <select 
                    id="offsiteStaffId" 
                    name="offsiteStaffId" 
                    value={offsiteStaffId}
                    onChange={e => setOffsiteStaffId(e.target.value)}
                    className="flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm focus:border-orange-500 font-medium"
                  >
                    <option value="">-- 引率職員を選択してください --</option>
                    {staffList?.map((s: any) => (
                      <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>👤 {s.name}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
          
          {/* 食事提供加算・送迎加算（設定で有効な場合のみ表示） */}
          {(hasMeal || hasTransportation) && (
            <div className={`grid grid-cols-1 ${hasMeal && hasTransportation ? 'md:grid-cols-2' : ''} gap-6 pt-4 border-t border-muted-foreground/20`}>
              {hasMeal && (
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                    <Checkbox id="mealProvided" name="mealProvided" value="true" defaultChecked={initialData?.meal_provided === 1} />
                    <Label htmlFor="mealProvided" className="font-medium cursor-pointer">食事提供体制加算を算定する</Label>
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-2 pl-6">
                    <Label htmlFor="mealIntake">食事摂取量</Label>
                    <select id="mealIntake" name="mealIntake" defaultValue={initialData?.meal_intake || ""} className="flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm">
                      <option value="">--</option>
                      <option value="全量">全量</option>
                      <option value="半分">半分</option>
                      <option value="少し">少し</option>
                      <option value="なし">なし</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
              
              {hasTransportation && (
                <div className="space-y-4">
                  <Label className="font-medium">送迎加算を算定する</Label>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 pl-6">
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 mb-2">
                        <Checkbox id="pickupUsed" name="pickupUsed" value="true" defaultChecked={initialData?.pickup_used === 1 || initialData?.transportation_used === 1} />
                        <Label htmlFor="pickupUsed" className="cursor-pointer">迎え（往路）</Label>
                      </div>
                      <Label htmlFor="pickupDriver">迎え運転手</Label>
                      <Input id="pickupDriver" name="pickupDriver" defaultValue={initialData?.pickup_driver || ""} className="bg-background h-9" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 mb-2">
                        <Checkbox id="dropoffUsed" name="dropoffUsed" value="true" defaultChecked={initialData?.dropoff_used === 1} />
                        <Label htmlFor="dropoffUsed" className="cursor-pointer">送り（復路）</Label>
                      </div>
                      <Label htmlFor="dropoffDriver">送り運転手</Label>
                      <Input id="dropoffDriver" name="dropoffDriver" defaultValue={initialData?.dropoff_driver || ""} className="bg-background h-9" />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          {/* 訪問支援特別加算（設定で有効な場合のみ表示） */}
          {hasVisitSupport && (
            <div className="pt-4 border-t border-muted-foreground/20 space-y-4">
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                <Checkbox 
                  id="visitSupportUsed" 
                  name="visitSupportUsed" 
                  value="true" 
                  checked={isVisitSupport}
                  onCheckedChange={(checked) => setIsVisitSupport(checked === true)}
                />
                <Label htmlFor="visitSupportUsed" className="font-medium cursor-pointer">訪問支援特別加算を算定する（居宅等を訪問して支援を実施）</Label>
              </div>

              {isVisitSupport && (
                <div className="p-3 bg-muted/40 rounded-md border space-y-3">
                  <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-primary">※厚労省通知に基づく訪問支援の記録必須項目</div>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <Label htmlFor="visitLocation" className="text-xs">訪問先（居宅・施設等）</Label>
                      <Input id="visitLocation" name="visitLocation" defaultValue={initialData?.visit_location || "利用者居宅"} placeholder="例: 利用者居宅" className="h-8 text-sm" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <Label htmlFor="visitStaffName" className="text-xs">訪問担当支援員名</Label>
                      <Input id="visitStaffName" name="visitStaffName" defaultValue={initialData?.visit_staff_name || ""} placeholder="例: 佐藤 支援員" className="h-8 text-sm" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <Label htmlFor="visitStartTime" className="text-xs">訪問開始時刻</Label>
                      <Input id="visitStartTime" name="visitStartTime" type="time" defaultValue={initialData?.visit_start_time || ""} className="h-8 text-sm" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <Label htmlFor="visitEndTime" className="text-xs">訪問終了時刻</Label>
                      <Input id="visitEndTime" name="visitEndTime" type="time" defaultValue={initialData?.visit_end_time || ""} className="h-8 text-sm" />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <Label htmlFor="visitContent" className="text-xs">支援内容（心身状況の把握・就労継続に向けた相談等）</Label>
                    <textarea 
                      id="visitContent" 
                      name="visitContent" 
                      defaultValue={initialData?.visit_content || ""} 
                      rows={2} 
                      placeholder="例: 体調不良による欠席に伴い居宅を訪問。体調回復状況と通所再開に向けた相談援助を実施。" 
                      className="w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm" 
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {showAbsenceAdditionForm && (
        <div className="p-4 border rounded-md bg-rose-50/40 border-rose-300 space-y-4 shadow-sm">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2 border-b border-rose-200 pb-2">
            <div className="font-semibold text-rose-950 flex items-center gap-2">
              <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-rose-600 inline-block" />
              <span>欠席時対応加算（94単位）の算定記録</span>
            </div>
            <div className="text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border border-rose-200">
              当月の算定実績: {absenceAdditionCount} / 4回
            </div>
          </div>

          {isOverLimit && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-destructive/10 text-destructive border border-destructive/20 rounded-md text-sm font-medium">
              ⚠️ 今月の欠席時対応加算の算定回数がすでに {absenceAdditionCount} 回に達しています。国保連請求上の算定上限は月に4回までです。
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="text-xs text-rose-800 bg-rose-100/50 p-2.5 rounded border border-rose-200 leading-relaxed">
            ※ 欠席時対応加算を算定するためには、急な連絡の事実確認（日時・手段・対応者）および相談援助内容（体調の把握や次回利用調整等）の記録が指導監査上必須となります。
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-4 pt-1">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <TimeSelect name="contactTime" label="連絡を受けた時間" defaultValue={initialData?.contact_time || ""} />
              
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="contactMethod">連絡手段</Label>
                <select id="contactMethod" name="contactMethod" defaultValue={initialData?.contact_method || "電話"} className="flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring">
                  <option value="電話">電話</option>
                  <option value="メール">メール</option>
                  <option value="LINE/アプリ">LINE/アプリ</option>
                  <option value="家族からの伝言">家族からの伝言</option>
                  <option value="その他">その他</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="contactPerson">連絡者氏名・続柄</Label>
                <Input type="text" id="contactPerson" name="contactPerson" placeholder="例: 本人、母（山田 花子）" defaultValue={initialData?.contact_person || "本人"} className="bg-background" />
              </div>
              
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="handledBy">対応した職員の氏名</Label>
                <Input type="text" id="handledBy" name="handledBy" placeholder="例: 佐藤 支援員" defaultValue={initialData?.handled_by || ""} className="bg-background" required />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="absenceReason" className="text-destructive">欠席の理由（体傷病名や具体的な症状など）</Label>
              <Textarea 
                id="absenceReason" 
                name="absenceReason" 
                required 
                placeholder="例: 発熱（38度）、腹痛のため"
                className="bg-background min-h-[80px]"
                defaultValue={initialData?.absence_reason || ""}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="absenceCondition">当日の利用者状況（様子など）</Label>
              <Textarea 
                id="absenceCondition" 
                name="absenceCondition" 
                placeholder="例: 声に元気がなく、食欲もないとのこと。"
                className="bg-background min-h-[80px]"
                defaultValue={initialData?.absence_condition || ""}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="consultationDetails">相談援助の内容（療養上のアドバイス・受診勧奨など）</Label>
              <Textarea 
                id="consultationDetails" 
                name="consultationDetails" 
                placeholder="例: 水分補給をしっかり行い、無理せず休養するよう伝えた。症状が続く場合は受診を勧奨した。"
                className="bg-background min-h-[80px]"
                defaultValue={initialData?.consultation_details || ""}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="nextScheduledDate">次回の利用予定日（確認・調整した内容）</Label>
              <Input type="date" id="nextScheduledDate" name="nextScheduledDate" className="bg-background" defaultValue={initialData?.next_scheduled_date || ""} />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-4 border-t">
        {initialData && (
          <a href="/attendance" className="inline-flex items-center justify-center whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium ring-offset-background transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2 disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 border border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-10 px-4 py-2">
            キャンセル
          </a>
        )}
        <SubmitButton className="h-10 px-8 w-full sm:w-auto">保存する</SubmitButton>
      </div>
    </form>
  )
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Users, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { bulkRegisterPresent } from './actions';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';

export function BulkAttendanceButton({ 
  targetDate, 
  targetDepartmentId = 'all',
  activeDepartments = []
}: { 
  targetDate: string; 
  targetDepartmentId?: string; 
  activeDepartments?: any[];
}) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const router = useRouter();

  const currentDep = activeDepartments.find(d => d.id === targetDepartmentId);
  const locLabel = targetDepartmentId === 'all' ? '全' : (currentDep?.name || '指定拠点');

  const handleBulkRegister = async () => {
    if (!confirm(`【${targetDate}】の未登録利用者（${locLabel}）を通常出席（09:30〜15:30、休憩60分）として一括登録しますか？\n（既に登録済みの記録は上書きされません）`)) {
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await bulkRegisterPresent(targetDate, targetDepartmentId);
      if (res.success) {
        toast.success(res.message || '一括出席登録が完了しました');
        router.refresh();
      } else {
        toast.error(res.error || '一括登録に失敗しました');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(`エラーが発生しました: ${err.message}`);
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Button
      type="button"
      onClick={handleBulkRegister}
      disabled={loading}
      className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-medium shadow-sm h-12 px-5 gap-2"
    >
      {loading ? (
        <>
          <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
          <span>一括登録中...</span>
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <Users className="h-4 w-4" />
          <span>{targetDepartmentId !== 'all' ? `${locLabel}未登録者を一括出席` : '当日全員一括出席登録'}</span>
        </>
      )}
    </Button>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Calendar as CalendarIcon, RotateCcw } from "lucide-react";

interface Props {
  currentDateStr: string;   // e.g. "2026-10-05"
  todayStr: string;         // e.g. "2026-10-05"
}

export function CalendarMonthPicker({ currentDateStr, todayStr }: Props) {
  const router = useRouter();

  const targetDate = new Date(currentDateStr);
  const currentYear = targetDate.getFullYear();
  const currentMonth = targetDate.getMonth(); // 0-11
  const currentMonthStr = `${currentYear}-${String(currentMonth + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;

  const prevMonthDate = new Date(currentYear, currentMonth - 1, 1);
  const nextMonthDate = new Date(currentYear, currentMonth + 1, 1);
  const prevMonthStr = `${prevMonthDate.getFullYear()}-${String(prevMonthDate.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-01`;
  const nextMonthStr = `${nextMonthDate.getFullYear()}-${String(nextMonthDate.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-01`;

  // クイックジャンプ用の過去月計算
  const getPastMonthStr = (monthsAgo: number) => {
    const d = new Date();
    d.setDate(1); // 月末日（31日等）による日付溢れ・翌月繰り上がりを防止
    d.setMonth(d.getMonth() - monthsAgo);
    return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-01`;
  };

  const handleMonthChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.target.value) {
      router.push(`/attendance?date=${e.target.value}-01`);
    }
  };

  const handleJump = (dateStr: string) => {
    router.push(`/attendance?date=${dateStr}`);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
      {/* 年月表示と前後ボタン */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <div className="flex items-center bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border rounded-lg p-0.5 shadow-xs">
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => handleJump(prevMonthStr)}
            className="h-8 px-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:text-slate-900"
            title="前月へ"
          >
            <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4 mr-0.5" />
            前月
          </Button>

          <Button
            variant={currentMonthStr === todayStr.substring(0, 7) ? "secondary" : "ghost"}
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => handleJump(todayStr)}
            className="h-8 px-2.5 text-xs font-bold"
            title="現在の月に戻る"
          >
            今月
          </Button>

          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => handleJump(nextMonthStr)}
            className="h-8 px-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:text-slate-900"
            title="次月へ"
          >
            次月
            <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 ml-0.5" />
          </Button>
        </div>

        {/* 年月ピッカー（直接年月を指定して過去へジャンプ） */}
        <div className="relative flex items-center">
          <input
            type="month"
            value={currentMonthStr}
            onChange={handleMonthChange}
            className="h-8 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border rounded-lg shadow-xs focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
            title="年月を直接選択して過去の実績へジャンプ"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 過去月クイックショートカット */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto text-[11px] text-slate-500">
        <span className="shrink-0 text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1 mr-0.5">
          <CalendarIcon className="w-3 h-3" />
          過去実績:
        </span>
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          className="h-7 px-2 text-[11px] border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100"
          onClick={() => handleJump(getPastMonthStr(1))}
        >
          先月
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          className="h-7 px-2 text-[11px] border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100"
          onClick={() => handleJump(getPastMonthStr(2))}
        >
          2ヶ月前
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          className="h-7 px-2 text-[11px] border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100"
          onClick={() => handleJump(getPastMonthStr(3))}
        >
          3ヶ月前
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          className="h-7 px-2 text-[11px] border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100"
          onClick={() => handleJump(getPastMonthStr(6))}
        >
          半年前
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          className="h-7 px-2 text-[11px] border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100"
          onClick={() => handleJump(getPastMonthStr(12))}
        >
          1年前
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
