'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { deleteAttendanceRecord } from './actions';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

export function DeleteAttendanceButton({ recordId }: { recordId: string }) {
  const [isDeleting, setIsDeleting] = useState(false);

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!window.confirm('この出退勤記録を削除してもよろしいですか？\n（月次確定済みのデータがある場合は削除できません）')) {
      return;
    }

    setIsDeleting(true);
    try {
      const res = await deleteAttendanceRecord(recordId);
      if (res.success) {
        toast.success('出退勤記録を削除しました');
      } else {
        toast.error(res.error || '削除に失敗しました');
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error('削除処理中にエラーが発生しました');
    } finally {
      setIsDeleting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={handleDelete}
      disabled={isDeleting}
      className={buttonVariants({ variant: "destructive", size: "sm" })}
    >
      {isDeleting ? '削除中...' : '削除'}
    </button>
  );
}


================================================================================
File: src/app/attendance/actions.ts
================================================================================

'use server'

import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache'
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'
import { z } from 'zod'
import { db, resolveServiceModeForAttendance, sanitizeForeignKeyId } from '@/lib/db'
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid'
import { getRole, assertCanAccessClient } from '@/lib/auth'
import { isMonthLocked } from '@/app/billing/actions'
import { logAudit } from '@/lib/audit'
import { attendanceSchema, getFirstZodErrorMessage } from '@/lib/validations'
import { getClientDayHolidayInfo } from '@/lib/compliance/holidayUtils'
import { consumePtoDays, restorePtoDays } from '@/app/attendance/pto/actions'

export async function saveAttendanceRecord(formData: FormData) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole()
    if (!role) return { success: false, error: '認証されていません。ログインしてください。' }

    const clockInStr = formData.get('clockIn') as string
    const clockOutStr = formData.get('clockOut') as string
    const status = formData.get('status') as string || 'present'
    const isAbsenceAddition = formData.get('isAbsenceAddition') === 'true'

    const parseResult = attendanceSchema.safeParse({
      clientId: formData.get('clientId'),
      recordDate: formData.get('recordDate'),
      status: status,
      clockIn: clockInStr ? clockInStr : null,
      clockOut: clockOutStr ? clockOutStr : null,
      breakTimeMinutes: parseInt(formData.get('breakTimeMinutes') as string) || 0,
      workType: formData.get('workType') || 'in_facility',
      isAbsenceAddition: isAbsenceAddition,
      absenceReason: formData.get('absenceReason') as string || '',
      mealProvided: formData.get('mealProvided') === 'true',
      mealIntake: formData.get('mealIntake') as string || '',
      transportationUsed: formData.get('transportationUsed') === 'true' || formData.get('pickupUsed') === 'true' || formData.get('dropoffUsed') === 'true',
      pickupUsed: formData.get('pickupUsed') === 'true',
      dropoffUsed: formData.get('dropoffUsed') === 'true',
      pickupDriver: formData.get('pickupDriver') as string || '',
      dropoffDriver: formData.get('dropoffDriver') as string || '',
      visitSupportUsed: formData.get('visitSupportUsed') === 'true',
      visitLocation: formData.get('visitLocation') as string || '',
      visitStaffName: formData.get('visitStaffName') as string || '',
      visitStartTime: formData.get('visitStartTime') as string || '',
      visitEndTime: formData.get('visitEndTime') as string || '',
      visitContent: formData.get('visitContent') as string || '',
      contactTime: formData.get('contactTime') as string || '',
      contactMethod: formData.get('contactMethod') as string || '',
      contactPerson: formData.get('contactPerson') as string || '',
      handledBy: formData.get('handledBy') as string || '',
      absenceCondition: formData.get('absenceCondition') as string || '',
      consultationDetails: formData.get('consultationDetails') as string || '',
      nextScheduledDate: formData.get('nextScheduledDate') as string || '',
      offsiteWorkplaceId: (formData.get('offsiteWorkplaceId') as string) || null,
      offsiteStaffId: (formData.get('offsiteStaffId') as string) || null,
      offsiteStartTime: (formData.get('offsiteStartTime') as string) || null,
      offsiteEndTime: (formData.get('offsiteEndTime') as string) || null,
      inFacilityStartTime: (formData.get('inFacilityStartTime') as string) || null,
      inFacilityEndTime: (formData.get('inFacilityEndTime') as string) || null,
    })

    if (!parseResult.success) {
      return { success: false, error: getFirstZodErrorMessage(parseResult.error) }
    }
    const parsedData = parseResult.data
    await assertCanAccessClient(parsedData.clientId);

    // 欠席理由の必須チェック
    if (isAbsenceAddition && !parsedData.absenceReason) {
      return { success: false, error: '欠席時対応加算を算定する場合は、欠席理由の入力が必須です。' }
    }

    const yearMonth = parsedData.recordDate.substring(0, 7); // YYYY-MM

    // 月次確定ロックチェック（月次請求確定後の改変防止）
    if (await isMonthLocked(yearMonth)) {
      return { success: false, error: `【警告】${yearMonth}月は請求データが月次確定ロックされているため、勤怠データを登録・更新できません。変更が必要な場合は管理者にロック解除を依頼してください。` }
    }

    // 変更前の勤怠ステータスを確認（有休の自動増減連動用）
    const prevRecord = db.prepare(`
      SELECT status FROM attendance_records 
      WHERE client_id = ? AND record_date = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
    `).get(parsedData.clientId, parsedData.recordDate) as { status: string } | undefined;
    const prevWasPto = prevRecord && (prevRecord.status === 'pto' || prevRecord.status === 'paid_leave');
    const newIsPto = parsedData.status === 'pto' || parsedData.status === 'paid_leave';
    db.transaction(() => {
      // H-1 欠席時対応加算の算定要件チェック（厚労省告示基準・解釈通知）
      if (parsedData.isAbsenceAddition) {
        // ① 連絡の事実確認（指導監査基準: 連絡日時、対応者、相談援助内容が必須）
        if (!parsedData.contactTime || !parsedData.handledBy || !parsedData.consultationDetails) {
          throw new Error('【警告】欠席時対応加算を算定するには、利用者または家族との「連絡日時」「対応職員名」「相談援助内容」の記録が指導監査上必須です。');
        }

        // ② 月4回上限チェック（厚労省告示基準）
        const existingAbsenceCount = db.prepare(`
          SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt 
          FROM attendance_records 
          WHERE client_id = ? AND is_absence_addition = 1 AND record_date LIKE ? AND record_date != ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
        `).get(parsedData.clientId, `${yearMonth}-%`, parsedData.recordDate) as any;

        if ((existingAbsenceCount?.cnt || 0) >= 4) {
          throw new Error(`【警告】欠席時対応加算は1月につき最大4回までしか算定できません（厚労省告示基準）。既に今月は${existingAbsenceCount.cnt}回算定されています。`);
        }

        // ③ 前日の無連絡欠席チェック
        const prevDateObj = new Date(parsedData.recordDate);
        prevDateObj.setDate(prevDateObj.getDate() - 1);
        const prevDateStr = prevDateObj.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        const prevRecord = db.prepare(`
          SELECT status, is_absence_addition, contact_time
          FROM attendance_records
          WHERE client_id = ? AND record_date = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
        `).get(parsedData.clientId, prevDateStr) as any;

        if (prevRecord && prevRecord.status === 'absent' && !prevRecord.contact_time) {
          // 前日無連絡の場合は当日の連絡記録が詳細であることを確認
          if (!parsedData.absenceCondition) {
            throw new Error('【警告】前日に連絡なしの欠席が記録されています。当日の心身の状況・欠席理由（状況）を詳細に記録してください。');
          }
        }
      }

      // 実績記録票または給与明細確定後の改変防止
      const lockedProvision = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM monthly_provision_records WHERE client_id = ? AND target_month = ? AND is_locked = 1').get(parsedData.clientId, yearMonth);
      const lockedPayslip = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM payslips WHERE client_id = ? AND target_month = ? AND is_locked = 1').get(parsedData.clientId, yearMonth);
      if (lockedProvision || lockedPayslip) {
        throw new Error(`【警告】${yearMonth}月は実績記録票または給与明細が確定ロックされているため、勤怠データを登録・更新できません。`);
      }

      // 契約期間・受給者証有効期間の整合性チェック
      const clientProfile = db.prepare('SELECT full_name, department_id, allowance_days, service_start_date, contract_end_date, valid_from, valid_to FROM clients WHERE id = ?').get(parsedData.clientId) as any;
      if (clientProfile) {
        if (clientProfile.service_start_date && parsedData.recordDate < clientProfile.service_start_date) {
          throw new Error(`【契約期間外エラー】${clientProfile.full_name}さんの利用開始日（${clientProfile.service_start_date}）より前の日付は勤怠登録できません。`);
        }
        if (clientProfile.contract_end_date && parsedData.recordDate > clientProfile.contract_end_date) {
          throw new Error(`【契約期間外エラー】${clientProfile.full_name}さんは退所済み（契約終了日: ${clientProfile.contract_end_date}）のため、以降の日付は勤怠登録できません。`);
        }
        if (clientProfile.valid_to && parsedData.recordDate > clientProfile.valid_to) {
          throw new Error(`【受給者証期限切れエラー】${clientProfile.full_name}さんの受給者証有効期間（〜${clientProfile.valid_to}）が終了しているため、勤怠登録できません。`);
        }
      }

      // H-4 支給量（月間上限日数）超過チェック（出勤日 + 欠席時対応加算算定日）
      const consumesAllowance = parsedData.status === 'present' || parsedData.isAbsenceAddition;
      if (consumesAllowance && clientProfile?.allowance_days) {
        const currentDaysCount = db.prepare(`
          SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt 
          FROM attendance_records 
          WHERE client_id = ? AND (status = 'present' OR is_absence_addition = 1) AND record_date LIKE ? AND record_date != ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
        `).get(parsedData.clientId, `${yearMonth}-%`, parsedData.recordDate) as any;
        
        const newTotal = (currentDaysCount.cnt || 0) + 1;
        if (newTotal > clientProfile.allowance_days) {
          throw new Error(`【警告】${clientProfile.full_name}さんは今月の支給量（上限日数: ${clientProfile.allowance_days}日）を超過しています。これ以上の利用（出勤・欠席加算）を登録するとレセプト返戻の対象となります。`);
        }
      }

      // 施設外就労の定員70%上限規制チェック（厚労省指定基準: 拠点別定員の70%上限判定）
      const isNewOffsite = parsedData.status === 'present' && (parsedData.workType === 'out_facility' || parsedData.workType === 'both');
      if (isNewOffsite) {
        const clientDeptId = clientProfile?.department_id;
        let capacity = 20;
        let deptName = '事業所';

        if (clientDeptId) {
          const dept = db.prepare('SELECT name, capacity FROM departments WHERE id = ?').get(clientDeptId) as any;
          if (dept && dept.capacity && dept.capacity > 0) {
            capacity = dept.capacity;
            deptName = dept.name || '拠点';
          }
        } else {
          // department_id 未設定時の全社フォールバック
          const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT capacity_class FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any;
          if (facility?.capacity_class) {
            if (facility.capacity_class.includes('40')) capacity = 40;
            else if (facility.capacity_class.includes('60')) capacity = 60;
            else if (facility.capacity_class.includes('80')) capacity = 80;
            else if (facility.capacity_class.includes('81')) capacity = 100;
            else capacity = 20;
          }
        }

        const maxOffsiteAllowed = Math.floor(capacity * 0.7);

        // 同一拠点内の施設外就労者数のみをカウント（attendance_records と clients を JOIN）
        const currentOffsiteCount = clientDeptId
          ? (db.prepare(`
              SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt 
              FROM attendance_records a
              JOIN clients c ON a.client_id = c.id
              WHERE a.record_date = ? 
                AND a.client_id != ? 
                AND a.status = 'present' 
                AND (a.is_offsite = 1 OR a.work_type IN ('out_facility', 'both'))
                AND c.department_id = ?
                AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
            `).get(parsedData.recordDate, parsedData.clientId, clientDeptId) as any)
          : (db.prepare(`
              SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt 
              FROM attendance_records a
              WHERE a.record_date = ? 
                AND a.client_id != ? 
                AND a.status = 'present' 
                AND (a.is_offsite = 1 OR a.work_type IN ('out_facility', 'both'))
                AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
            `).get(parsedData.recordDate, parsedData.clientId) as any);

        const newOffsiteTotal = (currentOffsiteCount?.cnt || 0) + 1;
        if (newOffsiteTotal > maxOffsiteAllowed) {
          throw new Error(`【警告】${parsedData.recordDate}の${deptName}における施設外就労者数（${newOffsiteTotal}名）が利用定員（${capacity}名）の70%上限（最大${maxOffsiteAllowed}名）を超過します。厚労省の指定基準に抵触するため登録できません。`);
        }
      }

      const finalClockIn = parsedData.status === 'present' ? parsedData.clockIn : null;
      const finalClockOut = parsedData.status === 'present' ? parsedData.clockOut : null;
      const finalBreakTime = parsedData.status === 'present' ? parsedData.breakTimeMinutes : 0;
      const finalWorkType = parsedData.status === 'present' ? parsedData.workType : null;
      // 出勤（present）時は欠席加算フラグ・理由を強制クリア（同一日の出勤基本報酬と欠席加算の二重請求を防止）
      const isActuallyAbsence = parsedData.status === 'absent';
      const finalAbsenceReason = (isActuallyAbsence && parsedData.isAbsenceAddition) ? parsedData.absenceReason : null;
      const finalIsAbsenceAddition = (isActuallyAbsence && parsedData.isAbsenceAddition) ? 1 : 0;
      const finalMealProvided = parsedData.mealProvided ? 1 : 0;
      const finalMealIntake = parsedData.mealProvided ? parsedData.mealIntake : null;
      const finalTransportationUsed = parsedData.transportationUsed ? 1 : 0;
      const finalPickupUsed = parsedData.pickupUsed ? 1 : 0;
      const finalDropoffUsed = parsedData.dropoffUsed ? 1 : 0;
      const finalPickupDriver = parsedData.transportationUsed ? parsedData.pickupDriver : null;
      const finalDropoffDriver = parsedData.transportationUsed ? parsedData.dropoffDriver : null;
      const finalVisitSupportUsed = parsedData.visitSupportUsed ? 1 : 0;
      const finalVisitLocation = parsedData.visitSupportUsed ? parsedData.visitLocation : null;
      const finalVisitStaffName = parsedData.visitSupportUsed ? parsedData.visitStaffName : null;
      const finalVisitStartTime = parsedData.visitSupportUsed ? parsedData.visitStartTime : null;
      const finalVisitEndTime = parsedData.visitSupportUsed ? parsedData.visitEndTime : null;
      const finalVisitContent = parsedData.visitSupportUsed ? parsedData.visitContent : null;

      const finalContactTime = (isActuallyAbsence && parsedData.isAbsenceAddition) ? parsedData.contactTime : null;
      const finalContactMethod = (isActuallyAbsence && parsedData.isAbsenceAddition) ? parsedData.contactMethod : null;
      const finalContactPerson = (isActuallyAbsence && parsedData.isAbsenceAddition) ? parsedData.contactPerson : null;
      const finalHandledBy = (isActuallyAbsence && parsedData.isAbsenceAddition) ? parsedData.handledBy : null;
      const finalAbsenceCondition = (isActuallyAbsence && parsedData.isAbsenceAddition) ? parsedData.absenceCondition : null;
      const finalConsultationDetails = (isActuallyAbsence && parsedData.isAbsenceAddition) ? parsedData.consultationDetails : null;
      const finalNextScheduledDate = (isActuallyAbsence && parsedData.isAbsenceAddition) ? parsedData.nextScheduledDate : null;

      const is_offsite = (parsedData.workType === 'out_facility' || parsedData.workType === 'both') ? 1 : 0;
      const is_telework = parsedData.workType === 'remote' ? 1 : 0;

      const isOffsiteWork = parsedData.status === 'present' && (parsedData.workType === 'out_facility' || parsedData.workType === 'both');
      const finalOffsiteWorkplaceId = isOffsiteWork ? sanitizeForeignKeyId('offsite_workplaces', parsedData.offsiteWorkplaceId) : null;
      const finalOffsiteStaffId = isOffsiteWork ? sanitizeForeignKeyId('staff', parsedData.offsiteStaffId) : null;
      const finalOffsiteStartTime = isOffsiteWork ? (parsedData.offsiteStartTime || null) : null;
      const finalOffsiteEndTime = isOffsiteWork ? (parsedData.offsiteEndTime || null) : null;
      const finalInFacilityStartTime = isOffsiteWork ? (parsedData.inFacilityStartTime || null) : null;
      const finalInFacilityEndTime = isOffsiteWork ? (parsedData.inFacilityEndTime || null) : null;

      const stmt = db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO attendance_records (
          id, client_id, record_date, status, clock_in, clock_out,
          break_time_minutes, work_type, is_offsite, is_telework, is_absence_addition, absence_reason, meal_provided, meal_intake,
          transportation_used, pickup_used, dropoff_used,
          transportation_service_used, pickup_service, dropoff_service,
          pickup_driver, dropoff_driver, visit_support_used, visit_location, visit_staff_name, visit_start_time, visit_end_time, visit_content, contact_time, contact_method, contact_person, handled_by, absence_condition, consultation_details, next_scheduled_date, offsite_workplace_id, offsite_staff_id, offsite_start_time, offsite_end_time, in_facility_start_time, in_facility_end_time, deleted_at
        ) VALUES (
          ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, NULL
        )
        ON CONFLICT(client_id, record_date) DO UPDATE SET
          status = excluded.status,
          clock_in = excluded.clock_in,
          clock_out = excluded.clock_out,
          break_time_minutes = excluded.break_time_minutes,
          work_type = excluded.work_type,
          is_offsite = excluded.is_offsite,
          is_telework = excluded.is_telework,
          is_absence_addition = excluded.is_absence_addition,
          absence_reason = excluded.absence_reason,
          meal_provided = excluded.meal_provided,
          meal_intake = excluded.meal_intake,
          transportation_used = excluded.transportation_used,
          pickup_used = excluded.pickup_used,
          dropoff_used = excluded.dropoff_used,
          transportation_service_used = excluded.transportation_service_used,
          pickup_service = excluded.pickup_service,
          dropoff_service = excluded.dropoff_service,
          pickup_driver = excluded.pickup_driver,
          dropoff_driver = excluded.dropoff_driver,
          visit_support_used = excluded.visit_support_used,
          visit_location = excluded.visit_location,
          visit_staff_name = excluded.visit_staff_name,
          visit_start_time = excluded.visit_start_time,
          visit_end_time = excluded.visit_end_time,
          visit_content = excluded.visit_content,
          contact_time = excluded.contact_time,
          contact_method = excluded.contact_method,
          contact_person = excluded.contact_person,
          handled_by = excluded.handled_by,
          absence_condition = excluded.absence_condition,
          consultation_details = excluded.consultation_details,
          next_scheduled_date = excluded.next_scheduled_date,
          offsite_workplace_id = excluded.offsite_workplace_id,
          offsite_staff_id = excluded.offsite_staff_id,
          offsite_start_time = excluded.offsite_start_time,
          offsite_end_time = excluded.offsite_end_time,
          in_facility_start_time = excluded.in_facility_start_time,
          in_facility_end_time = excluded.in_facility_end_time,
          deleted_at = NULL
      `);

      stmt.run(
        uuidv4(),
        parsedData.clientId,
        parsedData.recordDate,
        parsedData.status,
        finalClockIn,
        finalClockOut,
        finalBreakTime,
        finalWorkType,
        is_offsite,
        is_telework,
        finalIsAbsenceAddition,
        finalAbsenceReason,
        finalMealProvided,
        finalMealIntake,
        finalTransportationUsed,
        finalPickupUsed,
        finalDropoffUsed,
        finalTransportationUsed,
        finalPickupUsed,
        finalDropoffUsed,
        finalPickupDriver,
        finalDropoffDriver,
        finalVisitSupportUsed,
        finalVisitLocation,
        finalVisitStaffName,
        finalVisitStartTime,
        finalVisitEndTime,
        finalVisitContent,
        finalContactTime,
        finalContactMethod,
        finalContactPerson,
        finalHandledBy,
        finalAbsenceCondition,
        finalConsultationDetails,
        finalNextScheduledDate,
        finalOffsiteWorkplaceId,
        finalOffsiteStaffId,
        finalOffsiteStartTime,
        finalOffsiteEndTime,
        finalInFacilityStartTime,
        finalInFacilityEndTime
      );

      // 現場実務連動: 日次支援記録カルテ（support_records）への下書き自動同期
      try {
        const existingSupport = db.prepare(`
          SELECT id, task_content, staff_comment 
          FROM support_records 
          WHERE client_id = ? AND record_date = ?
        `).get(parsedData.clientId, parsedData.recordDate) as any;

        // まだ支援記録が存在しない場合に下書きを自動生成
        if (!existingSupport) {
          if (parsedData.status === 'present') {
            let autoLocation = '事業所内';
            let autoTaskContent = '施設内作業（軽作業・PC作業等）';
            let autoStaffComment = '定刻に通所。意欲的に作業に取り組み、良好なペースで作業を遂行した。';

            if (parsedData.workType === 'out_facility') {
              let workplaceName = '施設外就労先企業';
              if (finalOffsiteWorkplaceId) {
                const wp = db.prepare('SELECT name FROM offsite_workplaces WHERE id = ?').get(finalOffsiteWorkplaceId) as any;
                if (wp?.name) workplaceName = wp.name;
              }
              autoLocation = workplaceName;
              autoTaskContent = `施設外就労作業（${workplaceName}）`;
              autoStaffComment = `施設外就労先（${workplaceName}）にて実務に従事。指示に従い集中して作業を実施。体調等の大きな異変なし。`;
            } else if (parsedData.workType === 'remote') {
              autoLocation = '在宅（テレワーク）';
              autoTaskContent = '在宅就労作業';
              autoStaffComment = '在宅にて就労作業を実施。始業・終業時の連絡確認済み。業務の進捗良好。';
            }

            db.prepare(`
              INSERT INTO support_records (
                id, client_id, record_date, task_content, staff_comment,
                service_start_time, service_end_time, service_location
              ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            `).run(
              uuidv4(),
              parsedData.clientId,
              parsedData.recordDate,
              autoTaskContent,
              autoStaffComment,
              parsedData.status === 'present' ? parsedData.clockIn : null,
              parsedData.status === 'present' ? parsedData.clockOut : null,
              autoLocation
            );
          } else if (parsedData.status === 'absent' && parsedData.isAbsenceAddition) {
            // 欠席時対応加算の記録をカルテ側にも自動反映
            const autoTaskContent = `欠席（理由: ${parsedData.absenceReason || '体調不良等'}）`;
            const autoStaffComment = `【欠席時対応】${parsedData.contactTime ? `${parsedData.contactTime}に` : ''}${parsedData.contactPerson || '本人'}より連絡あり。状況: ${parsedData.absenceCondition || '体調不良等'}。対応内容: ${parsedData.consultationDetails || '休養を促し次回通所予定を確認'}。次回通所予定: ${parsedData.nextScheduledDate || '未定'}（対応者: ${parsedData.handledBy || '職員'}）`;

            db.prepare(`
              INSERT INTO support_records (
                id, client_id, record_date, task_content, staff_comment,
                service_location
              ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
            `).run(
              uuidv4(),
              parsedData.clientId,
              parsedData.recordDate,
              autoTaskContent,
              autoStaffComment,
              '電話・連絡'
            );
          }
        }
      } catch (supportErr) {
        console.warn('支援記録自動連動スキップ（計画未作成または個別制約）:', supportErr);
      }
    })() // Execute the transaction

    // 監査ログに記録
    await logAudit({
      action: 'update',
      targetTable: 'attendance_records',
      targetId: `${parsedData.clientId}:${parsedData.recordDate}`,
      details: {
        clientId: parsedData.clientId,
        date: parsedData.recordDate,
        status: parsedData.status,
        workType: parsedData.workType,
        isAbsenceAddition: parsedData.isAbsenceAddition
      }
    });

    // 有給休暇の自動消化・返還連動
    try {
      if (!prevWasPto && newIsPto) {
        await consumePtoDays(parsedData.clientId, 1);
      } else if (prevWasPto && !newIsPto) {
        await restorePtoDays(parsedData.clientId, 1);
      }
    } catch (ptoErr) {
      console.error('有給自動消化/返還エラー:', ptoErr);
    }

    try {
      revalidatePath('/attendance', 'layout');
      revalidatePath('/', 'layout');
      revalidatePath('/support-records');
      revalidatePath('/billing/payroll');
    } catch (e) {}
    return { success: true, recordDate: parsedData.recordDate }
  } catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof Error && (error.message.includes('【警告】') || error.message.startsWith('【'))) {
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }
    console.error('勤怠保存エラー:', error)
    return { success: false, error: '勤怠の保存に失敗しました' };
  }
}

export async function deleteAttendanceRecord(id: string) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole()
    if (!role) return { success: false, error: '認証されていません' };
    resolveServiceModeForAttendance(id);

    const record = db.prepare('SELECT client_id, record_date, status FROM attendance_records WHERE id = ?').get(id) as any;
    if (record) {
      await assertCanAccessClient(record.client_id);
      const yearMonth = record.record_date.substring(0, 7);
      if (await isMonthLocked(yearMonth)) {
        return { success: false, error: `【請求ロック済】${yearMonth}月は国保連請求データが月次確定ロックされているため、勤怠レコードを削除できません。変更が必要な場合は管理者にロック解除を依頼してください。` };
      }
      const lockedProvision = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM monthly_provision_records WHERE client_id = ? AND target_month = ? AND is_locked = 1').get(record.client_id, yearMonth);
      const lockedPayslip = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM payslips WHERE client_id = ? AND target_month = ? AND is_locked = 1').get(record.client_id, yearMonth);
      if (lockedProvision || lockedPayslip) {
        return { success: false, error: `【警告】${yearMonth}月は実績記録票または給与明細が確定ロックされているため、勤怠データを削除できません。` };
      }
    }

    db.prepare('UPDATE attendance_records SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?').run(id)

    // 有給休暇レコードを削除した場合は有休残日数を自動返還
    if (record && (record.status === 'pto' || record.status === 'paid_leave')) {
      try {
        await restorePtoDays(record.client_id, 1);
      } catch (ptoErr) {
        console.error('有給自動返還エラー:', ptoErr);
      }
    }
    try {
      revalidatePath('/attendance', 'layout');
      revalidatePath('/', 'layout');
      revalidatePath('/support-records');
      revalidatePath('/billing/payroll');
    } catch (e) {}
    return { success: true }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('勤怠削除エラー:', error)
    if (error instanceof Error && error.message.includes('【警告】')) {
      return { success: false, error: error.message };
    }
    return { success: false, error: '勤怠データの削除に失敗しました' };
  }
}

/**
 * 現場UX改善: 指定日の在籍利用者全員（未登録者のみ）を一括で通常出席として登録する
 */
export async function bulkRegisterPresent(targetDate: string, targetDepartmentId: string = 'all') {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role) return { success: false, error: '認証されていません' };

    if (!targetDate || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(targetDate)) {
      return { success: false, error: '日付の指定が正しくありません' };
    }

    const yearMonth = targetDate.substring(0, 7);
    if (await isMonthLocked(yearMonth)) {
      return { success: false, error: `【請求ロック済】${yearMonth}月は国保連請求がロックされているため一括登録できません。` };
    }

    let clientsQuery = `
      SELECT id, full_name, uses_meal_provision, uses_transportation, work_start_time, work_end_time, break_time_minutes, regular_holidays, weekly_schedule_pattern, department_id 
      FROM clients 
      WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (status IS NULL OR status = 'active')
    `;
    const queryParams: any[] = [];
    if (targetDepartmentId && targetDepartmentId !== 'all') {
      clientsQuery += ` AND department_id = ?`;
      queryParams.push(targetDepartmentId);
    }
    clientsQuery += ` ORDER BY full_name`;

    const clients = db.prepare(clientsQuery).all(...queryParams) as any[];

    let locLabel = '全体';
    if (targetDepartmentId && targetDepartmentId !== 'all') {
      const dep = db.prepare('SELECT name FROM departments WHERE id = ?').get(targetDepartmentId) as any;
      if (dep) locLabel = dep.name;
    }
    if (clients.length === 0) {
      return { success: false, error: `${locLabel}に登録されている利用者がいません` };
    }

    const existingRecords = db.prepare(`
      SELECT client_id FROM attendance_records WHERE record_date = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
    `).all(targetDate) as { client_id: string }[];
    const existingClientIds = new Set(existingRecords.map(r => r.client_id));

    const toInsert = clients.filter(c => !existingClientIds.has(c.id));
    if (toInsert.length === 0) {
      return { success: true, message: `${locLabel}の利用者は全員勤怠が登録済みです（スキップ: 0名）`, count: 0 };
    }

    // 当日の利用者シフトを取得
    const clientShifts = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM client_shifts WHERE target_date = ?
    `).all(targetDate) as any[];
    const shiftMap = new Map(clientShifts.map(s => [s.client_id, s]));

    const insertStmt = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO attendance_records (
        id, client_id, record_date, status,
        clock_in, clock_out, break_time_minutes, work_type,
        meal_provided, transportation_used, pickup_used, dropoff_used,
        transportation_service_used, pickup_service, dropoff_service,
        is_absence_addition, is_offsite, offsite_start_time, offsite_end_time, in_facility_start_time, in_facility_end_time, offsite_workplace_id,
        created_at, updated_at, deleted_at
      ) VALUES (
        ?, ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?,
        0, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, NULL
      )
      ON CONFLICT(client_id, record_date) DO UPDATE SET
        status = excluded.status,
        clock_in = excluded.clock_in,
        clock_out = excluded.clock_out,
        break_time_minutes = excluded.break_time_minutes,
        work_type = excluded.work_type,
        meal_provided = excluded.meal_provided,
        transportation_used = excluded.transportation_used,
        pickup_used = excluded.pickup_used,
        dropoff_used = excluded.dropoff_used,
        transportation_service_used = excluded.transportation_service_used,
        pickup_service = excluded.pickup_service,
        dropoff_service = excluded.dropoff_service,
        is_absence_addition = 0,
        is_offsite = excluded.is_offsite,
        offsite_start_time = excluded.offsite_start_time,
        offsite_end_time = excluded.offsite_end_time,
        in_facility_start_time = excluded.in_facility_start_time,
        in_facility_end_time = excluded.in_facility_end_time,
        offsite_workplace_id = excluded.offsite_workplace_id,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        deleted_at = NULL
    `);

    let presentCount = 0;
    let holidayCount = 0;

    db.transaction(() => {
      for (const c of toInsert) {
        const shift = shiftMap.get(c.id);
        let matchedPattern: any = null;
        if (c.weekly_schedule_pattern) {
          try {
            const p = typeof c.weekly_schedule_pattern === 'string'
              ? JSON.parse(c.weekly_schedule_pattern)
              : c.weekly_schedule_pattern;
            const dObj = new Date(targetDate);
            matchedPattern = p[dObj.getDay().toString()];
          } catch (e) {}
        }

        const holidayInfo = getClientDayHolidayInfo(targetDate, c, shift);
        const isHoliday = holidayInfo.isHoliday;

        if (isHoliday) {
          // 公休として自動判定・登録
          insertStmt.run(
            uuidv4(),
            c.id,
            targetDate,
            'holiday',
            null, null, 0, null,
            0, 0, 0, 0,
            0, 0, 0,
            0, null, null, null, null, null
          );
          holidayCount++;
        } else {
          // 出勤として登録（シフトまたは曜日別パターンの予定時間・勤務形態・就労先を自動反映）
          const usesMeal = c.uses_meal_provision ? 1 : 0;
          const usesTrans = c.uses_transportation ? 1 : 0;
          
          let clockIn = shift?.scheduled_in;
          let clockOut = shift?.scheduled_out;
          let workType = shift?.work_type || (shift?.is_offsite === 1 ? 'out_facility' : undefined);
          let offsiteWorkplaceId = shift?.offsite_workplace_id || null;

          if (!clockIn) {
            clockIn = matchedPattern?.start_time || c.work_start_time || '10:00';
          }
          if (!clockOut) {
            clockOut = matchedPattern?.end_time || c.work_end_time || (matchedPattern?.work_type === 'out_facility' ? '16:00' : '15:00');
          }
          if (!workType) {
            workType = matchedPattern?.work_type || 'in_facility';
          }
          if (!offsiteWorkplaceId && matchedPattern?.offsite_workplace_id) {
            offsiteWorkplaceId = matchedPattern.offsite_workplace_id;
          }
          const safeOffsiteWorkplaceId = sanitizeForeignKeyId('offsite_workplaces', offsiteWorkplaceId);

          const breakTime = c.break_time_minutes ?? 60;
          const isOffsite = (workType === 'out_facility' || workType === 'both' || shift?.is_offsite === 1) ? 1 : 0;
          const offsiteStart = shift?.offsite_start_time || (workType === 'out_facility' ? clockIn : null);
          const offsiteEnd = shift?.offsite_end_time || (workType === 'out_facility' ? clockOut : null);
          const inFacilityStart = shift?.in_facility_start_time || (workType === 'in_facility' ? clockIn : null);
          const inFacilityEnd = shift?.in_facility_end_time || (workType === 'in_facility' ? clockOut : null);

          insertStmt.run(
            uuidv4(),
            c.id,
            targetDate,
            'present',
            clockIn,
            clockOut,
            breakTime,
            workType,
            usesMeal,
            usesTrans,
            usesTrans,
            usesTrans,
            usesTrans,
            usesTrans,
            usesTrans,
            isOffsite,
            offsiteStart,
            offsiteEnd,
            inFacilityStart,
            inFacilityEnd,
            safeOffsiteWorkplaceId
          );
          presentCount++;
        }
      }
    })();

    try {
      revalidatePath('/attendance', 'layout');
      revalidatePath('/', 'layout');
      revalidatePath('/billing/payroll');
    } catch (e) {}
    return { 
      success: true, 
      count: toInsert.length, 
      message: `${toInsert.length}名の一括勤怠反映が完了しました（出勤: ${presentCount}名、公休自動判定: ${holidayCount}名）` 
    };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('一括出席登録エラー:', error);
    return { success: false, error: `一括登録に失敗しました: ${error.message}` };
  }
}

/**
 * 現場スマホ・タブレット向け：送迎乗降・出退勤クイックトグル
 */
export async function toggleQuickAttendanceField(
  clientId: string,
  targetDate: string,
  actionType: 'clock_in' | 'clock_out' | 'toggle_pickup' | 'toggle_dropoff'
) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role) return { success: false, error: '認証エラー' };
    await assertCanAccessClient(clientId);

    const now = new Date();
    const timeStr = `${String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, '0')}`;

    const existing = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM attendance_records
      WHERE client_id = ? AND record_date = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
    `).get(clientId, targetDate) as any;

    if (!existing) {
      // レコードがない場合は新規作成（論理削除済みの行がある場合も考慮してUPSERT）
      const client = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM clients WHERE id = ?`).get(clientId) as any;
      const id = uuidv4();
      const clockIn = actionType === 'clock_in' ? timeStr : (client?.work_start_time || '10:00');
      const clockOut = actionType === 'clock_out' ? timeStr : null;
      const pickup = actionType === 'toggle_pickup' ? 1 : 0;
      const dropoff = actionType === 'toggle_dropoff' ? 1 : 0;
      const transUsed = pickup || dropoff ? 1 : 0;

      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO attendance_records (
          id, client_id, record_date, status, clock_in, clock_out,
          break_time_minutes, work_type, 
          pickup_service, dropoff_service, transportation_service_used,
          pickup_used, dropoff_used, transportation_used,
          created_at, updated_at
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, 'present', ?, ?, 60, 'in_facility', ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
        ON CONFLICT(client_id, record_date) DO UPDATE SET
          status = 'present',
          clock_in = excluded.clock_in,
          clock_out = excluded.clock_out,
          pickup_service = excluded.pickup_service,
          dropoff_service = excluded.dropoff_service,
          transportation_service_used = excluded.transportation_service_used,
          pickup_used = excluded.pickup_used,
          dropoff_used = excluded.dropoff_used,
          transportation_used = excluded.transportation_used,
          updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
          deleted_at = NULL
      `).run(id, clientId, targetDate, clockIn, clockOut, pickup, dropoff, transUsed, pickup, dropoff, transUsed);
    } else {
      // 既存レコードの更新
      if (actionType === 'clock_in') {
        const newClockIn = existing.clock_in ? null : timeStr;
        db.prepare(`
          UPDATE attendance_records
          SET clock_in = ?, status = 'present', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
          WHERE id = ?
        `).run(newClockIn, existing.id);
      } else if (actionType === 'clock_out') {
        const newClockOut = existing.clock_out ? null : timeStr;
        db.prepare(`
          UPDATE attendance_records
          SET clock_out = ?, status = 'present', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
          WHERE id = ?
        `).run(newClockOut, existing.id);
      } else if (actionType === 'toggle_pickup') {
        const currentPickup = (existing.pickup_service === 1 || existing.pickup_used === 1) ? 1 : 0;
        const currentDropoff = (existing.dropoff_service === 1 || existing.dropoff_used === 1) ? 1 : 0;
        const newPickup = currentPickup === 1 ? 0 : 1;
        const newUsed = newPickup === 1 || currentDropoff === 1 ? 1 : 0;
        db.prepare(`
          UPDATE attendance_records
          SET pickup_service = ?, pickup_used = ?,
              transportation_service_used = ?, transportation_used = ?,
              updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
          WHERE id = ?
        `).run(newPickup, newPickup, newUsed, newUsed, existing.id);
      } else if (actionType === 'toggle_dropoff') {
        const currentPickup = (existing.pickup_service === 1 || existing.pickup_used === 1) ? 1 : 0;
        const currentDropoff = (existing.dropoff_service === 1 || existing.dropoff_used === 1) ? 1 : 0;
        const newDropoff = currentDropoff === 1 ? 0 : 1;
        const newUsed = currentPickup === 1 || newDropoff === 1 ? 1 : 0;
        db.prepare(`
          UPDATE attendance_records
          SET dropoff_service = ?, dropoff_used = ?,
              transportation_service_used = ?, transportation_used = ?,
              updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
          WHERE id = ?
        `).run(newDropoff, newDropoff, newUsed, newUsed, existing.id);
      }
    }

    revalidatePath('/attendance', 'layout');
    revalidatePath('/', 'layout');
    return { success: true };
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('クイック勤怠更新エラー:', err);
    return { success: false, error: err.message };
  }
}

export default async function AttendancePage(props: { searchParams?: Promise<{ editId?: string; date?: string; departmentId?: string }> }) {
  const role = await getRole()
  const searchParams = await props.searchParams
  const editId = searchParams?.editId

  const activeDepartments = getActiveDepartments();
  const isGeneralStaff = role === 'staff';
  const rawDepartmentId = searchParams?.departmentId;
  const activeDepartmentId = isGeneralStaff
    ? (rawDepartmentId && activeDepartments.some(d => d.id === rawDepartmentId) ? rawDepartmentId : activeDepartments[0]?.id)
    : (rawDepartmentId && activeDepartments.some(d => d.id === rawDepartmentId) ? rawDepartmentId : 'all');

  let initialData = null
  if (editId) {
    initialData = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM attendance_records WHERE id = ?').get(editId)
  }

  let clientsQuery = `
    SELECT c.id, c.full_name, c.weekly_schedule_pattern, c.regular_holidays, c.work_start_time, c.work_end_time, c.break_time_minutes, c.department_id, d.name as department_name 
    FROM clients c
    LEFT JOIN departments d ON c.department_id = d.id
    WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND (c.status IS NULL OR c.status = 'active')
  `;
  const clientParams: any[] = [];
  if (activeDepartmentId !== 'all') {
    clientsQuery += " AND c.department_id = ?";
    clientParams.push(activeDepartmentId);
  }
  clientsQuery += " ORDER BY c.full_name";
  const clients = db.prepare(clientsQuery).all(...clientParams) as any[];

  const offsiteWorkplaces = db.prepare('SELECT id, name FROM offsite_workplaces ORDER BY name').all() as any[]
  const staffList = db.prepare('SELECT id, name FROM staff WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY name').all() as any[]
  const facilitySettings = db.prepare('SELECT show_quick_attendance_checker, transportation_addition, meal_provision_addition, visit_support_addition FROM facility_settings WHERE id = ?').get('default') as any || {}
  const serviceMode = await getServiceMode();
  const serviceTypeKey = serviceMode === 'type_b' ? 'type_b' : 'type_a';

  const showQuickChecker = facilitySettings.show_quick_attendance_checker === 1
  const hasTransportation = isAdditionEnabled(serviceTypeKey, 'transportation', db)
  const hasMeal = isAdditionEnabled(serviceTypeKey, 'meal_provision', db)
  const hasVisitSupport = isAdditionEnabled(serviceTypeKey, 'visit_support', db)
  const hasAbsenceSupport = isAdditionEnabled(serviceTypeKey, 'absence_support', db)


  const todayStr = toLocalISODate(new Date())
  const selectedDateStr = searchParams?.date || todayStr

  // Use selected date to determine the month to display
  const targetDate = new Date(selectedDateStr)
  const currentYear = targetDate.getFullYear()
  const currentMonth = targetDate.getMonth()
  
  const currentMonthStart = `${currentYear}-${String(currentMonth + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-01`
  const nextMonthStart = toLocalISODate(new Date(currentYear, currentMonth + 1, 1))

  // 前日・翌日の算出
  const curDateObj = new Date(selectedDateStr)
  const prevDayObj = new Date(curDateObj)
  prevDayObj.setDate(curDateObj.getDate() - 1)
  const nextDayObj = new Date(curDateObj)
  nextDayObj.setDate(curDateObj.getDate() + 1)
  const prevDayStr = toLocalISODate(prevDayObj)
  const nextDayStr = toLocalISODate(nextDayObj)

  const shifts = db.prepare(`
    SELECT * FROM client_shifts 
    WHERE target_date >= ? AND target_date < ?
  `).all(currentMonthStart, nextMonthStart) as any[]

  let recordsQuery = `
    SELECT 
      a.*, 
      c.full_name as client_full_name,
      c.department_id as client_department_id,
      w.name as offsite_workplace_name,
      s.name as offsite_staff_name
    FROM attendance_records a
    JOIN clients c ON a.client_id = c.id
    LEFT JOIN offsite_workplaces w ON a.offsite_workplace_id = w.id
    LEFT JOIN staff s ON a.offsite_staff_id = s.id
    WHERE a.record_date >= ? AND a.record_date < ?
      AND a.deleted_at IS NULL

  const monthlyStats = {

                </p>

            )}

            {/* 当日の施設外就労・引率体制サマリー（どの職員が引率しているか） */}
            {staffingStatus.offsiteAssignments && staffingStatus.offsiteAssignments.length > 0 && (

                  <span>【当日の施設外就労・引率体制一覧】</span>
                </div>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5">
                  {staffingStatus.offsiteAssignments.map((oa, idx) => (
                    <div key={idx} className={`p-2.5 rounded-md border shadow-xs ${oa.isCompliant ? 'bg-white/90 border-emerald-200' : 'bg-rose-50/90 border-rose-300'}`}>
                      <div className="font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                        <span className="truncate">🏢 {oa.workplaceName}</span>
                        <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0 border-slate-300">
                          {oa.clientCount}名参加
                        </Badge>
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-1.5 flex items-center gap-1 text-xs">
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground">引率担当:</span>
                        {oa.staffName ? (
                          <span className="font-bold text-emerald-800 flex items-center gap-1">
                            <UserCheck className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                            {oa.staffName}
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="font-bold text-rose-600 flex items-center gap-1">
                            <UserX className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-500" />
                            未配置（要登録）
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      {oa.clients && oa.clients.length > 0 && (
                        <div className="mt-1.5 text-[11px] text-slate-600 border-t border-slate-100 pt-1">
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground block">参加利用者:</span>

                    </Badge>

                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">対象日: {selectedDateStr} の出退勤・勤務形態・加算・引率</p>
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Link href={`/attendance?date=${prevDayStr}&departmentId=${activeDepartmentId}`} className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm", className: "h-8 px-2.5 text-xs" })}>
                  <ChevronLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />
                  前日 ({prevDayStr.slice(5)})
                </Link>
                {selectedDateStr !== todayStr && (
                  <Link href={`/attendance?date=${todayStr}&departmentId=${activeDepartmentId}`} className={buttonVariants({ variant: "secondary", size: "sm", className: "h-8 px-2.5 text-xs font-bold" })}>
                    今日に戻る
                  </Link>
                )}
                <Link href={`/attendance?date=${nextDayStr}&departmentId=${activeDepartmentId}`} className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm", className: "h-8 px-2.5 text-xs" })}>
                  翌日 ({nextDayStr.slice(5)})
                  <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 ml-1" />
                </Link>
              </div>
            </CardHeader>

            <CardContent className="pt-6">
              <AttendanceForm 
                clients={clients || []} 
                todayStr={selectedDateStr} 
                initialData={initialData} 
                records={records}
                offsiteWorkplaces={offsiteWorkplaces}
                staffList={staffList}
                clientShifts={shifts}
                hasMeal={hasMeal}
                hasTransportation={hasTransportation}
                hasVisitSupport={hasVisitSupport}
                hasAbsenceSupport={hasAbsenceSupport}
              />

            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="shadow-sm">
            <CardHeader className="bg-primary/5 border-b pb-4 space-y-3">
              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
                <div>
                  <CardTitle className="text-xl flex items-center gap-2">
                    <CalendarIcon className="w-5 h-5 text-primary" />
                    <span>{currentYear}年{currentMonth + 1}月 の勤怠カレンダー</span>
                  </CardTitle>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                    日付をクリックすると当日の実績入力フォームおよび一覧へジャンプします。
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs shrink-0">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1 font-medium text-emerald-800">
                    <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 inline-block"></span> 人員充足
                  </span>
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1 font-medium text-rose-800">
                    <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-rose-500 inline-block"></span> 人員不足(警告)
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* 年月クイックピッカー・過去月ショートカット */}
              <CalendarMonthPicker currentDateStr={selectedDateStr} todayStr={todayStr} />

              {/* 月間実績サマリーバナー */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 lg:grid-cols-7 gap-2 p-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border rounded-lg text-center text-xs shadow-2xs">
                <div className="border-r last:border-r-0 border-slate-100">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground block">延べ出勤</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-700">{monthlyStats.totalPresent} 名</span>
                </div>
                <div className="border-r last:border-r-0 border-slate-100">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground block">延べ有休取得</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold text-blue-700">{monthlyStats.totalPto} 日</span>
                </div>
                <div className="border-r last:border-r-0 border-slate-100">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground block">延べ欠勤</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-600">{monthlyStats.totalAbsent} 名</span>
                </div>
                <div className="border-r last:border-r-0 border-slate-100">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground block">施設外就労延べ</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold text-indigo-700">{monthlyStats.totalOffsite} 名</span>
                </div>
                <div className="border-r last:border-r-0 border-slate-100">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground block">送迎(迎)</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold text-teal-700">{monthlyStats.totalPickup} 回</span>
                </div>
                <div className="border-r last:border-r-0 border-slate-100">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground block">送迎(送)</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold text-teal-700">{monthlyStats.totalDropoff} 回</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground block">食事提供</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold text-amber-700">{monthlyStats.totalMeal} 食</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardHeader>

            <CardContent className="p-6">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1 text-center mb-2 font-medium text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                <div className="text-red-500">日</div>
                <div>月</div>
                <div>火</div>
                <div>水</div>
                <div>木</div>
                <div>金</div>
                <div className="text-blue-500">土</div>
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1">
                {calendarCells.map((cell, idx) => {
                  if (!cell) {
                    return <div key={`empty-${idx}`} className="h-16 sm:h-24 bg-muted/20 rounded-md" />
                  }
                  const isSelected = cell.dateStr === selectedDateStr
                  const isToday = cell.dateStr === todayStr
                  const dailyRecords = records.filter(r => r.record_date === cell.dateStr)
                  const presentCount = dailyRecords.filter(r => r.status === 'present').length
                  
                  // Calculate how many clients are scheduled to work today
                  let shiftCount = 0;
                  clients.forEach(c => {
                    const shift = shifts.find(s => s.client_id === c.id && s.target_date === cell.dateStr);
                    const holidayInfo = getClientDayHolidayInfo(cell.dateStr, c, shift);
                    if (!holidayInfo.isHoliday) {
                      shiftCount++;
                    }
                  });

                  const dayStaffing = monthlyStaffingMap[cell.dateStr];
                  const hasClients = (dayStaffing?.clientPresentCount || 0) > 0;
                  const isStaffShortage = hasClients && dayStaffing && !dayStaffing.isCompliant;

                  return (
                    <a 
                      key={cell.dateStr}
                      href={`/attendance?date=${cell.dateStr}`}
                      className={`h-16 sm:h-24 border rounded-md p-1 sm:p-2 flex flex-col items-center justify-start transition-colors hover:bg-accent relative ${
                        isSelected 
                          ? 'ring-2 ring-primary border-transparent bg-primary/5' 
                          : isStaffShortage 
                            ? 'bg-rose-50/70 border-rose-300 hover:bg-rose-100/70' 
                            : 'bg-background'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="w-full flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span className={`text-sm font-medium ${isToday ? 'bg-primary text-primary-foreground rounded-full w-6 h-6 flex items-center justify-center' : ''}`}>
                          {cell.day}
                        </span>
                        {isStaffShortage && (
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-rose-600 font-bold sm:hidden">⚠️</span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className="mt-auto w-full flex flex-col gap-0.5">
                        {shiftCount > 0 && (
                          <span className="hidden sm:inline-flex text-[9px] bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 px-1 rounded-sm w-full justify-center">
                            予定:{shiftCount}名
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {presentCount > 0 && (
                          <span className="hidden sm:inline-flex text-[9px] bg-green-100 text-green-800 px-1 rounded-sm w-full justify-center">
                            実績:{presentCount}名
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {hasClients && dayStaffing && (
                          dayStaffing.isCompliant ? (
                            <span className="hidden sm:inline-flex text-[8px] bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200 px-0.5 rounded-sm w-full justify-center">
                              ✓充足
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="inline-flex text-[8px] bg-rose-200 text-rose-900 font-bold border border-rose-300 px-0.5 rounded-sm w-full justify-center animate-pulse">
                              ⚠️不足(-{Math.floor(dayStaffing.shortageMinutes / 60)}h)
                            </span>
                          )
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </a>
                  )
                })}
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="shadow-sm">
            <CardHeader className="bg-primary/5 border-b pb-4 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <CardTitle className="text-xl flex items-center gap-2">
                <span>{selectedDateStr.split('-')[1]}月{selectedDateStr.split('-')[2]}日 の勤怠一覧</span>
                <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs font-semibold bg-white">
                  {filteredRecords.length} 名記録済
                </Badge>
              </CardTitle>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Link href={`/attendance?date=${prevDayStr}`} className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm", className: "h-8 px-2 text-xs" })}>
                  <ChevronLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-0.5" />
                  前日
                </Link>
                {selectedDateStr !== todayStr && (
                  <Link href={`/attendance?date=${todayStr}`} className={buttonVariants({ variant: "secondary", size: "sm", className: "h-8 px-2 text-xs font-bold" })}>
                    今日
                  </Link>
                )}
                <Link href={`/attendance?date=${nextDayStr}`} className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm", className: "h-8 px-2 text-xs" })}>
                  翌日
                  <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5 ml-0.5" />
                </Link>
              </div>
            </CardHeader>

            <CardContent className="p-0">
              {filteredRecords && filteredRecords.length > 0 ? (
                <>
                  <div className="hidden md:block">
                    <Table>
                  <TableHeader className="bg-muted/50">
                    <TableRow>
                      <TableHead className="w-[18%] py-4 pl-8 sm:pl-12">利用者名</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="w-[12%] py-4">ステータス</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="w-[22%] py-4">出退勤</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="w-[33%] py-4">勤務形態・現場・引率・加算</TableHead>
                      <TableHead className="w-[15%] py-4 text-center">操作</TableHead>
                    </TableRow>
                  </TableHeader>
                  <TableBody>
                    {filteredRecords.map(record => {
                      const isOffsite = record.work_type === 'out_facility' || record.work_type === 'both' || record.is_offsite === 1;
                      const isMissingStaff = isOffsite && record.status === 'present' && !record.offsite_staff_id;

                      return (
                        <TableRow key={record.id} className={isMissingStaff ? "bg-amber-50/40" : ""}>
                          <TableCell className="py-4 pl-8 sm:pl-12 font-medium">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                              <span>{record.client_full_name}</span>
                              {isMissingStaff && (
                                <span title="引率職員が未登録です" className="text-amber-600 font-bold text-xs shrink-0">
                                  ⚠️
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="py-4">
                            {record.status === 'present' && <Badge variant="outline" className="border-emerald-500 text-emerald-800 bg-emerald-50">出勤</Badge>}
                            {record.status === 'absent' && record.is_absence_addition === 1 && (
                              <Badge variant="destructive">欠席（加算算定）</Badge>
                            )}
                            {record.status === 'absent' && record.is_absence_addition !== 1 && (
                              <Badge variant="outline" className="border-amber-400 text-amber-900 bg-amber-50">欠勤（加算なし）</Badge>
                            )}
                            {record.status === 'holiday' && <Badge variant="secondary">公休</Badge>}
                            {record.status === 'pto' && <Badge variant="outline" className="border-blue-400 text-blue-900 bg-blue-50">有給</Badge>}
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="py-4 whitespace-nowrap">
                            {record.status === 'present' ? (
                              <span className="text-sm">
                                {record.clock_in ? record.clock_in.substring(0, 5) : '-'} 〜 {record.clock_out ? record.clock_out.substring(0, 5) : '-'}
                                <span className="text-muted-foreground ml-2">(休:{record.break_time_minutes})</span>
                              </span>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-muted-foreground text-sm">-</span>
                            )}
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="py-4">
                            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 items-start">
                              {/* 形態＆加算バッジ */}
                              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">
                                {record.status === 'present' && record.work_type === 'out_facility' && (
                                  <Badge variant="secondary" className="bg-orange-100 text-orange-900 border-orange-300 font-semibold">
                                    終日施設外
                                  </Badge>
                                )}
                                {record.status === 'present' && record.work_type === 'both' && (
                                  <Badge variant="secondary" className="bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 border-amber-300 font-semibold">
                                    内勤＋施設外
                                  </Badge>
                                )}
                                {record.status === 'present' && record.work_type === 'remote' && (
                                  <Badge className="bg-indigo-600 text-white">在宅</Badge>
                                )}
                                {record.status === 'present' && (!record.work_type || record.work_type === 'in_facility') && (
                                  <Badge variant="outline" className="border-slate-300 text-slate-600 text-[11px]">
                                    施設内（内勤）
                                  </Badge>
                                )}
                                {record.is_absence_addition === 1 && <Badge variant="destructive">欠席加算(94単位)</Badge>}
                                {record.meal_provided === 1 && <Badge variant="outline" className="border-slate-300 text-slate-700 text-[11px]">食事</Badge>}
                              </div>

                              {/* 施設外就労時の就労先および引率職員情報 */}
                              {record.status === 'present' && isOffsite && (
                                <div className="p-1.5 rounded bg-white/90 border border-slate-200 text-xs w-full max-w-sm space-y-1 shadow-2xs">
                                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-slate-700 truncate">
                                    <Building2 className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-500 shrink-0" />
                                    <span className="font-medium text-slate-800">
                                      {record.offsite_workplace_name || <span className="text-amber-800 font-semibold">現場未指定</span>}
                                    </span>
                                  </div>
                                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-1">
                                    {record.offsite_staff_name ? (
                                      <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-900 font-bold text-[11px]">
                                        <UserCheck className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-700 shrink-0" />
                                        <span>引率: {record.offsite_staff_name}</span>
                                      </span>
                                    ) : (
                                      <a
                                        href={`/attendance?date=${selectedDateStr}&editId=${record.id}`}
                                        className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-rose-100 hover:bg-rose-200 text-rose-800 font-bold text-[11px] transition-colors"
                                      >
                                        <UserX className="w-3 h-3 text-rose-600 shrink-0" />
                                        <span>引率未登録 (クリックして設定)</span>
                                      </a>
                                    )}
                                  </div>
                                </div>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </TableCell>
                          <TableCell className="py-4 text-center">
                            <div className="flex justify-center gap-2">
                              <a href={`/attendance?date=${selectedDateStr}&editId=${record.id}&departmentId=${activeDepartmentId}`} className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm" })}>
                                編集
                              </a>
                              <DeleteAttendanceButton recordId={record.id} />
                            </div>
                          </TableCell>
                        </TableRow>
                      )
                    })}
                  </TableBody>
                    </Table>
                  </div>

                  {/* モバイル・スマホ用カード表示 */}
                  <div className="block md:hidden p-3">
                    <MobileAttendanceCardList records={filteredRecords} selectedDateStr={selectedDateStr} />
                  </div>
                </>
              ) : (
                <div className="p-8 text-center text-muted-foreground">
                  この日の勤怠データはありません。
                </div>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client';

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Printer, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Calendar } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";

export function AttendancePrintNav({ 
  clients, 
  currentClientId, 
  currentMonth,
  latestDataMonth
}: { 
  clients: any[]; 
  currentClientId: string; 
  currentMonth: string;
  latestDataMonth?: string;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();

  const handleClientChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLSelectElement>) => {
    router.push(`/attendance/print?clientId=${e.target.value}&month=${currentMonth}`);
  };

  const handleMonthChange = (val: string) => {
    router.push(`/attendance/print?clientId=${currentClientId}&month=${val}`);
  };

  // 前月・翌月の計算
  const [yearStr, monthStr] = currentMonth.split('-');
  const y = parseInt(yearStr, 10);
  const m = parseInt(monthStr, 10);
  
  const prevDate = new Date(y, m - 2, 1);
  const prevMonthStr = `${prevDate.getFullYear()}-${String(prevDate.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  
  const nextDate = new Date(y, m, 1);
  const nextMonthStr = `${nextDate.getFullYear()}-${String(nextDate.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;

  const today = new Date();
  const thisMonthStr = `${today.getFullYear()}-${String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3">
      {/* クイック月切替バッジ */}
      <div className="hidden lg:flex items-center gap-1 bg-slate-100 p-0.5 rounded-md border border-slate-200 text-xs">
        {latestDataMonth && latestDataMonth !== thisMonthStr && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleMonthChange(latestDataMonth)}
            className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
              currentMonth === latestDataMonth 
                ? 'bg-emerald-600 text-white shadow-xs' 
                : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-200'
            }`}
          >
            実績確定月 ({latestDataMonth.replace('-', '年')}月)
          </button>
        )}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => handleMonthChange(thisMonthStr)}
          className={`px-2 py-1 rounded text-xs font-semibold transition-all ${
            currentMonth === thisMonthStr 
              ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-xs' 
              : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-200'
          }`}
        >
          当月 ({thisMonthStr.replace('-', '年')}月)
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* 対象利用者セレクタ */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-slate-600 font-medium">
        <span>対象者:</span>
        <select 
          value={currentClientId} 
          onChange={handleClientChange}
          className="rounded border border-slate-300 bg-white px-2 py-1.5 text-xs text-slate-800 shadow-xs focus:border-slate-500 focus:outline-none max-w-[150px]"
        >
          <option value="all">全利用者（一括印刷）</option>
          {clients.map(c => (
            <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
              {c.full_name}
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </div>

      {/* 対象年月セレクタとページング */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          className="h-8 w-8 p-0 text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900"
          onClick={() => handleMonthChange(prevMonthStr)}
          title="前月へ"
        >
          <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
        </Button>
        <input 
          type="month" 
          value={currentMonth} 
          onChange={(e) => handleMonthChange(e.target.value)}
          className="rounded border border-slate-300 bg-white px-2 py-1 text-xs text-slate-800 shadow-xs focus:border-slate-500 focus:outline-none h-8"
        />
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          className="h-8 w-8 p-0 text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900"
          onClick={() => handleMonthChange(nextMonthStr)}
          title="翌月へ"
        >
          <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
        </Button>
      </div>

      {/* 印刷実行ボタン */}
      <Button 
        onClick={() => window.print()}
        className="gap-1.5 bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 shadow-xs font-bold h-8"
        size="sm"
      >
        <Printer className="h-4 w-4" />
        出勤簿を印刷 (A4縦)
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}
