import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { ChevronLeft } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { AttendancePrintNav } from "./AttendancePrintNav";
import { AutoFitText } from "@/components/AutoFitText";
import { 
  getClientDayHolidayInfo, 
  getClientDayScheduleInfo,
  calculateActualWorkMinutes 
} from "@/lib/compliance/holidayUtils";

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

export default async function AttendancePrintPage({ 
  searchParams 
}: { 
  searchParams: Promise<{ month?: string; clientId?: string }> 
}) {
  const params = await searchParams;
  const today = new Date();
  const currentMonthStr = `${today.getFullYear()}-${String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;

  // 実績データが存在する最新月を取得（デフォルトフォールバック用）
  const latestRecordRow = db.prepare(`
    SELECT substr(record_date, 1, 7) as latest_month 
    FROM attendance_records 
    WHERE deleted_at IS NULL 
    ORDER BY record_date DESC 
    LIMIT 1
  `).get() as any;
  const latestDataMonth: string = latestRecordRow?.latest_month || currentMonthStr;

  // 当月に実績が1件もなく、かつパラメータ未指定の場合は実績が存在する最新月を優先表示
  const currentMonthCount = db.prepare(`
    SELECT count(*) as count 
    FROM attendance_records 
    WHERE record_date LIKE ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
  `).get(`${currentMonthStr}-%`) as any;
  
  const targetMonth: string = params.month || ((currentMonthCount?.count > 0) ? currentMonthStr : latestDataMonth);

  const selectedClientId = params.clientId || "all";

  const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any || {};
  const isTypeB = facility.service_type === 'type_b' || facility.service_type === 'B' || facility.facility_name?.includes('B型');
  
  const allClients = db.prepare(`
    SELECT * FROM clients 
    WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (status IS NULL OR status = 'active')
    ORDER BY full_name ASC
  `).all() as any[];

  const targetClients = selectedClientId === "all" 
    ? allClients 
    : allClients.filter(c => c.id === selectedClientId);

  const [yearStr, monthStr] = targetMonth.split('-');
  const year = parseInt(yearStr, 10);
  const month = parseInt(monthStr, 10);
  const warekiYear = year >= 2019 ? `令和${year - 2018}` : `平成${year - 1988}`;

  const daysInMonth = new Date(year, month, 0).getDate();
  const daysList = Array.from({ length: daysInMonth }, (_, i) => {
    const d = i + 1;
    const dStr = String(d).padStart(2, '0');
    const dateStr = `${targetMonth}-${dStr}`;
    const dayOfWeek = new Date(year, month - 1, d).getDay();
    const dayKanji = ["日", "月", "火", "水", "木", "金", "土"][dayOfWeek];
    return { day: d, dateStr, dayKanji, dayOfWeek };
  });

  // 対象月の全勤怠レコード
  const allRecords = db.prepare(`
    SELECT ar.*, ow.name as offsite_name
    FROM attendance_records ar
    LEFT JOIN offsite_workplaces ow ON ar.offsite_workplace_id = ow.id
    WHERE ar.record_date LIKE ? AND ar.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY ar.record_date ASC
  `).all(`${targetMonth}-%`) as any[];

  // 対象月の全シフトレコード（公休・予定の反映用）
  const allShifts = db.prepare(`
    SELECT * FROM client_shifts
    WHERE target_date LIKE ?
  `).all(`${targetMonth}-%`) as any[];

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-100 text-slate-900 print:bg-white print:p-0">
      {/* 印刷コントロールバー */}
      <header className="sticky top-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-between border-b bg-white/95 px-6 py-3 shadow-sm backdrop-blur print:hidden">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <Link href="/attendance">
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="gap-1 text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900">
              <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
              勤怠管理へ戻る
            </Button>
          </Link>
          <div className="h-4 w-px bg-slate-200" />
          <h1 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-800">
            月間出勤簿・利用実績表 印刷 ({warekiYear}年{month}月分)
          </h1>
        </div>

        <AttendancePrintNav 
          clients={allClients} 
          currentClientId={selectedClientId} 
          currentMonth={targetMonth} 
          latestDataMonth={latestDataMonth}
        />
      </header>

      {/* 印刷プレビュー領域 */}
      <main className="p-4 md:p-8 print:p-0 space-y-8 print:space-y-0 flex flex-col items-center print:block">
        <style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: `
          @page {
            size: A4 portrait;
            margin: 10mm;
          }
          @media print {
            html, body {
              width: 100% !important;
              height: 100% !important;
              margin: 0 !important;
              padding: 0 !important;
              background: white !important;
              color: black !important;
              -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact !important;
              print-color-adjust: exact !important;
            }
            header, nav, .print\\:hidden {
              display: none !important;
            }
            main {
              display: block !important;
              width: 100% !important;
              margin: 0 !important;
              padding: 0 !important;
            }
            .page-sheet {
              width: 190mm !important;
              height: 277mm !important;
              max-height: 277mm !important;
              margin: 0 auto !important;
              padding: 0 !important;
              box-sizing: border-box !important;
              border: none !important;
              box-shadow: none !important;
              display: flex !important;
              flex-direction: column !important;
              overflow: hidden !important;
              
              /* 1人につきA4用紙1枚を厳格に保持 */
              page-break-after: always !important;
              break-after: page !important;
              page-break-inside: avoid !important;
              break-inside: avoid !important;
            }
            .page-sheet + .page-sheet {
              page-break-before: always !important;
              break-before: page !important;
            }
            .page-sheet:last-of-type,
            .page-sheet:last-child {
              page-break-after: auto !important;
              break-after: auto !important;
            }
            .page-break {
              page-break-after: always !important;
              break-after: page !important;
            }
            /* テーブル親要素：フレックス伸張で余白をすべて埋める */
            .table-container {
              flex: 1 1 0% !important;
              min-height: 0 !important;
              display: flex !important;
              flex-direction: column !important;
              margin-top: 1.5mm !important;
              margin-bottom: 1.5mm !important;
              overflow: hidden !important;
            }
            /* テーブル本体：親要素の高さ100%にストレッチ */
            table.attendance-table {
              width: 100% !important;
              height: 100% !important;
              table-layout: fixed !important;
              border-collapse: collapse !important;
            }
            table.attendance-table thead {
              height: 6mm !important;
              flex-shrink: 0 !important;
            }
            table.attendance-table th {
              padding: 1mm 0.5mm !important;
              font-size: 9px !important;
              line-height: 1.1 !important;
              background-color: #f1f5f9 !important;
              -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact !important;
              print-color-adjust: exact !important;
            }
            table.attendance-table tbody {
              height: calc(100% - 6mm) !important;
            }
            table.attendance-table tr {
              page-break-inside: avoid !important;
              break-inside: avoid !important;
            }
            table.attendance-table td {
              font-size: 8.5px !important;
              line-height: 1.1 !important;
              padding: 0.5mm 0.5mm !important;
              vertical-align: middle !important;
            }
            /* 下部法定集計エリア：固定サイズ＆改ページ禁止 */
            .statutory-bottom-section {
              flex-shrink: 0 !important;
              margin-top: auto !important;
              page-break-inside: avoid !important;
              break-inside: avoid !important;
            }
            .statutory-summary-table {
              height: 18.5mm !important;
            }
            .statutory-remarks-box {
              height: 22.0mm !important;
              min-height: 22.0mm !important;
            }
          }
        `}} />

        {targetClients.map((client, cIdx) => {
          const clientRecords = allRecords.filter(r => r.client_id === client.id);
          const clientShifts = allShifts.filter(s => s.client_id === client.id);
          
          let totalPresentDays = 0;
          let totalInFacilityDays = 0;
          let totalOffsiteDays = 0;
          let totalTeleworkDays = 0;
          let totalPtoDays = 0;
          let totalHolidayDays = 0;
          let totalAbsentDays = 0;
          let totalWorkMinutes = 0;
          let totalBreakMinutes = 0;
          let scheduledDays = 0;
          let scheduledMinutes = 0;

          const rows = daysList.map(d => {
            const rec = clientRecords.find(r => r.record_date === d.dateStr);
            const shift = clientShifts.find(s => s.target_date === d.dateStr);
            const schedule = getClientDayScheduleInfo(d.dateStr, client, shift);
            
            let statusLabel = "";
            let checkIn = "";
            let checkOut = "";
            let breakMin = 0;
            let workMin = 0;
            let note = "";
            let isActual = false;
            let isScheduled = false;

            if (schedule.isWorkDay) {
              scheduledDays++;
              const schedMinutes = calculateActualWorkMinutes(schedule.scheduledIn, schedule.scheduledOut, schedule.breakMinutes);
              scheduledMinutes += schedMinutes;
            }

            if (rec) {
              isActual = true;
              if (rec.status === 'present') {
                totalPresentDays++;
                if (rec.is_offsite === 1) {
                  totalOffsiteDays++;
                  statusLabel = "施設外";
                  note = rec.offsite_name ? `施設外就労: ${rec.offsite_name}` : "施設外就労";
                } else if (rec.is_telework === 1) {
                  totalTeleworkDays++;
                  statusLabel = "在宅";
                  note = "在宅就労支援";
                } else {
                  totalInFacilityDays++;
                  statusLabel = "出勤";
                  note = "施設内就労（事業所内作業）";
                }

                checkIn = (rec.clock_in || rec.check_in) ? (rec.clock_in || rec.check_in).substring(0, 5) : "";
                checkOut = (rec.clock_out || rec.check_out) ? (rec.clock_out || rec.check_out).substring(0, 5) : "";
                breakMin = rec.break_time_minutes ?? 60;
                workMin = rec.actual_work_time_minutes || calculateActualWorkMinutes(checkIn, checkOut, breakMin);
                totalWorkMinutes += workMin;
                totalBreakMinutes += breakMin;
              } else if (rec.status === 'paid_leave' || rec.status === 'pto') {
                totalPtoDays++;
                statusLabel = "有給";
                note = "年次有給休暇";
              } else if (rec.status === 'absent_with_addition' || (rec.status === 'absent' && rec.is_absence_addition === 1)) {
                totalAbsentDays++;
                statusLabel = "欠席加算";
                note = "欠席時対応加算（体調不良等の相談援助）";
              } else if (rec.status === 'absent') {
                totalAbsentDays++;
                statusLabel = "欠勤";
                note = "自己都合欠勤";
              } else if (rec.status === 'holiday') {
                totalHolidayDays++;
                statusLabel = "公休";
                note = "定例公休日";
              }
            } else {
              // 実績レコード未登録日: 予定スケジュール・定休日を反映
              if (schedule.isHoliday) {
                totalHolidayDays++;
                statusLabel = schedule.holidayLabel;
                note = "定例公休日";
              } else {
                // 出勤予定日
                isScheduled = true;
                statusLabel = "出勤予定";
                checkIn = schedule.scheduledIn ? `${schedule.scheduledIn}` : "";
                checkOut = schedule.scheduledOut ? `${schedule.scheduledOut}` : "";
                breakMin = schedule.breakMinutes;
                const calcWork = calculateActualWorkMinutes(checkIn, checkOut, breakMin);
                workMin = calcWork;
                note = `${schedule.workTypeLabel}予定`;
              }
            }

            return {
              ...d,
              statusLabel,
              checkIn,
              checkOut,
              breakMin,
              workMin,
              note,
              isActual,
              isScheduled
            };
          });

          const totalWorkHours = (totalWorkMinutes / 60).toFixed(1);
          const scheduledHours = (scheduledMinutes / 60).toFixed(1);
          const isLast = cIdx === targetClients.length - 1;

          return (
            <div key={client.id} className="contents">
              <div 
                style={{
                pageBreakAfter: !isLast ? 'always' : 'auto',
                breakAfter: !isLast ? 'page' : 'auto',
                pageBreakBefore: cIdx > 0 ? 'always' : 'auto',
                breakBefore: cIdx > 0 ? 'page' : 'auto',
              }}
              className={`page-sheet mx-auto w-[190mm] h-[277mm] max-w-[190mm] max-h-[277mm] p-0 box-border bg-white shadow-2xl border border-slate-300 flex flex-col justify-between overflow-hidden print:w-[190mm] print:h-[277mm] print:max-w-[190mm] print:max-h-[277mm] print:p-0 print:border-none print:shadow-none print:m-0 print:overflow-hidden ${!isLast ? 'page-break mb-10' : ''}`}
            >
              {/* 出勤簿ヘッダー */}
                <div className="flex justify-between items-start border-b-2 border-slate-900 pb-1.5 shrink-0">
                  <div className="flex-1 mr-4">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="text-[8.5px] font-mono text-slate-500 bg-slate-100 px-1 py-0.2 rounded border border-slate-200">
                        {isTypeB ? '障害者総合支援法準拠 / 工賃支払基礎・利用実績確認様式' : '労働基準法第108条準拠 / 実地指導検査確認様式'}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                    <h2 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 mt-0.5">
                      {isTypeB ? '月 間 利 用 実 績 表 （出勤簿）' : '出 勤 簿 （月間利用実績表）'}
                    </h2>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-slate-700 mt-0.5">
                      <span className="shrink-0 font-medium">事業所名:</span>
                      <div className="max-w-[260px]">
                        <AutoFitText text={facility.facility_name || (isTypeB ? '就労継続支援B型事業所' : '就労継続支援A型事業所')} maxFontSizePt={9.5} minFontSizePt={6.5} className="font-bold" />
                      </div>
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono">（事業所番号: {facility.facility_number || '2810099999'}）</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3 shrink-0">
                    <div className="text-right">
                      <div className="text-base font-bold font-mono text-slate-900">
                        {warekiYear}年 {month}月分
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 font-mono">
                        受給者番号: {client.recipient_number || '-'}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex gap-1.5">
                      <div className="text-center">
                        <div className="border border-slate-400 bg-slate-50 px-2 py-0 text-[8px] font-bold">施設長</div>
                        <div className="h-10 w-9 border-b border-l border-r border-slate-400 flex items-center justify-center text-[8.5px] text-slate-400">印</div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-center">
                        <div className="border border-slate-400 bg-slate-50 px-2 py-0 text-[8px] font-bold">サビ管</div>
                        <div className="h-10 w-9 border-b border-l border-r border-slate-400 flex items-center justify-center text-[8.5px] text-slate-400">印</div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-center">
                        <div className="border border-slate-400 bg-slate-50 px-2 py-0 text-[8px] font-bold">担当者</div>
                        <div className="h-10 w-9 border-b border-l border-r border-slate-400 flex items-center justify-center text-[8.5px] text-slate-400">印</div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* 利用者名・月間集計サマリー */}
                <div className="mt-1.5 flex justify-between items-center bg-slate-50 border border-slate-300 px-3 py-1 text-xs rounded h-[9.5mm] shrink-0">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-600 shrink-0">利用者氏名:</span>
                    <div className="min-w-[120px] max-w-[200px]">
                      <AutoFitText text={client.full_name} maxFontSizePt={11} minFontSizePt={8} className="font-bold text-slate-900" />
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-slate-500 text-[10px] shrink-0">様</span>
                    <span className="text-[9px] text-slate-400 font-mono">（所定:{client.work_start_time || '10:00'}〜{client.work_end_time || '16:00'}）</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex gap-3 text-xs font-mono">
                    <div>{isTypeB ? '通所実績' : '実出勤'}: <strong className="text-slate-900 font-bold">{totalPresentDays}</strong> 日</div>
                    <div>施設外: <strong className="text-slate-900 font-bold">{totalOffsiteDays}</strong> 日</div>
                    {!isTypeB && <div>有給: <strong className="text-slate-900 font-bold">{totalPtoDays}</strong> 日</div>}
                    <div>公休: <strong className="text-slate-900 font-bold">{totalHolidayDays}</strong> 日</div>
                    <div>{isTypeB ? '利用時間' : '実働'}: <strong className="text-slate-900 font-bold">{totalWorkHours}</strong> h</div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* 日別出退勤明細テーブル（親コンテナが残り高さを満たし、テーブル全体が100%均等ストレッチ） */}
                <div className="table-container flex-1 min-h-0 flex flex-col my-1 overflow-hidden">
                  <table className="attendance-table w-full h-full border-collapse border border-slate-400 table-fixed text-[9px]">
                    <thead className="shrink-0">
                      <tr className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 text-center font-bold h-[5.5mm]">
                        <th className="border border-slate-400 py-1 px-0.5 w-[4.5%]">日</th>
                        <th className="border border-slate-400 py-1 px-0.5 w-[4.5%]">曜</th>
                        <th className="border border-slate-400 py-1 px-0.5 w-[8.5%]">区分</th>
                        <th className="border border-slate-400 py-1 px-0.5 w-[8%]">{isTypeB ? '通所' : '出勤'}</th>
                        <th className="border border-slate-400 py-1 px-0.5 w-[8%]">{isTypeB ? '退所' : '退勤'}</th>
                        <th className="border border-slate-400 py-1 px-0.5 w-[6.5%]">休憩</th>
                        <th className="border border-slate-400 py-1 px-0.5 w-[7.5%]">{isTypeB ? '作業' : '実働'}</th>
                        <th className="border border-slate-400 py-1 px-1 w-[45%]">施設外就労先 / 業務内容 / 備考</th>
                        <th className="border border-slate-400 py-1 px-0.5 w-[7.5%]">本人印</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="h-full">
                      {rows.map(r => {
                        const isSun = r.dayOfWeek === 0;
                        const isSat = r.dayOfWeek === 6;
                        const rowBg = isSun ? 'bg-rose-50/50' : (isSat ? 'bg-blue-50/50' : '');

                        return (
                          <tr 
                            key={r.day} 
                            className={`text-center ${rowBg}`}
                          >
                            <td className="border border-slate-300 px-0.5 py-0 font-mono text-[9px]">{r.day}</td>
                            <td className={`border border-slate-300 px-0.5 py-0 font-bold text-[9px] ${isSun ? 'text-rose-600' : (isSat ? 'text-blue-600' : '')}`}>
                              {r.dayKanji}
                            </td>
                            <td className="border border-slate-300 px-0.5 py-0 font-medium text-[9px]">
                              {r.isScheduled ? (
                                <span className="text-slate-400 text-[8px]">{r.statusLabel}</span>
                              ) : (
                                <span className={r.statusLabel === '施設外' ? 'text-emerald-700 font-bold' : r.statusLabel === '有給' ? 'text-amber-700 font-bold' : ''}>
                                  {r.statusLabel}
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </td>
                            <td className="border border-slate-300 px-0.5 py-0 font-mono text-[9px]">
                              {r.isScheduled ? (
                                <span className="text-slate-400 text-[8px]">{r.checkIn ? `${r.checkIn}(予)` : '-'}</span>
                              ) : (
                                r.checkIn || '-'
                              )}
                            </td>
                            <td className="border border-slate-300 px-0.5 py-0 font-mono text-[9px]">
                              {r.isScheduled ? (
                                <span className="text-slate-400 text-[8px]">{r.checkOut ? `${r.checkOut}(予)` : '-'}</span>
                              ) : (
                                r.checkOut || '-'
                              )}
                            </td>
                            <td className="border border-slate-300 px-0.5 py-0 font-mono text-[9px]">
                              {r.breakMin > 0 ? (
                                r.isScheduled ? <span className="text-slate-400 text-[8px]">{r.breakMin}分</span> : `${r.breakMin}分`
                              ) : '-'}
                            </td>
                            <td className="border border-slate-300 px-0.5 py-0 font-mono text-[9px]">
                              {r.workMin > 0 ? (
                                r.isScheduled ? (
                                  <span className="text-slate-400 text-[8px]">{(r.workMin / 60).toFixed(1)}h(予)</span>
                                ) : (
                                  <strong className="font-bold">{(r.workMin / 60).toFixed(1)}h</strong>
                                )
                              ) : '-'}
                            </td>
                            <td className="border border-slate-300 px-1 py-0 text-left text-[9px] text-slate-800 overflow-hidden leading-tight">
                              <AutoFitText 
                                text={r.note} 
                                maxFontSizePt={8.5} 
                                minFontSizePt={6} 
                                className={r.isScheduled ? "text-slate-400 italic" : "text-slate-800"} 
                              />
                            </td>
                            <td className="border border-slate-300 px-0.5 py-0">
                              {r.isActual && r.checkIn ? (
                                <span className="inline-block w-3.5 h-3.5 border border-rose-400 rounded-full text-[8px] text-rose-500 leading-3.5">印</span>
                              ) : (
                                <span className="inline-block w-3 h-3 border border-dashed border-slate-300 rounded-full text-[7px] text-slate-300 leading-3">印</span>
                              )}
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                        );
                      })}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>

                {/* A4下部の余白を埋める：月間内訳・特記事項・本人確認署名枠（実地指導完全準拠） */}
              <div className="statutory-bottom-section shrink-0 border-t-2 border-slate-800 pt-1 space-y-1">
                {/* 1. 月間集計詳細テーブル */}
                <div className="statutory-summary-table grid grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-[9px]">
                  {/* 左: 日数内訳 */}
                  <div className="border border-slate-400 rounded-xs overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-between">
                    <div className="bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 font-bold text-slate-800 border-b border-slate-400 flex justify-between">
                      <span>【月間日数内訳】</span>
                      <span className="font-mono">当月歴日数: {daysInMonth}日</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="p-1.5 grid grid-cols-3 gap-x-2 gap-y-1 font-mono text-[8.5px]">
                      <div>{isTypeB ? '利用予定日' : '所定労働日'}: <strong>{scheduledDays}</strong>日</div>
                      <div>{isTypeB ? '実通所日数' : '実出勤日数'}: <strong>{totalPresentDays}</strong>日</div>
                      <div>施設内就労: <strong>{totalInFacilityDays}</strong>日</div>
                      <div>施設外就労: <strong>{totalOffsiteDays}</strong>日</div>
                      {!isTypeB ? (
                        <div>有給取得日: <strong>{totalPtoDays}</strong>日</div>
                      ) : (
                        <div>在宅就労: <strong>{totalTeleworkDays}</strong>日</div>
                      )}
                      <div>公休日数: <strong>{totalHolidayDays}</strong>日</div>
                      <div>欠勤日数: <strong>{totalAbsentDays}</strong>日</div>
                      {!isTypeB && <div>在宅就労: <strong>{totalTeleworkDays}</strong>日</div>}
                      <div>{isTypeB ? '通所率' : '出勤率'}: <strong>{scheduledDays > 0 ? `${Math.round(((totalPresentDays + (isTypeB ? 0 : totalPtoDays)) / scheduledDays) * 100)}%` : '-'}</strong></div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* 右: 時間数内訳 */}
                  <div className="border border-slate-400 rounded-xs overflow-hidden flex flex-col justify-between">
                    <div className="bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 font-bold text-slate-800 border-b border-slate-400 flex justify-between">
                      <span>{isTypeB ? '【生産活動・利用時間内訳】' : '【労働時間・時間外内訳】'}</span>
                      <span className="font-mono">{isTypeB ? '予定時間' : '所定時間'}: {scheduledHours}h</span>
                    </div>
                    {isTypeB ? (
                      <div className="p-1.5 grid grid-cols-2 gap-x-2 gap-y-1 font-mono text-[8.5px]">
                        <div>総利用・作業時間: <strong>{totalWorkHours}</strong>h</div>
                        <div>総休憩時間: <strong>{(totalBreakMinutes / 60).toFixed(1)}</strong>h</div>
                        <div>1日平均作業時間: <strong>{totalPresentDays > 0 ? (Number(totalWorkHours) / totalPresentDays).toFixed(1) : '0.0'}</strong>h</div>
                        <div>工賃算定対象日数: <strong>{totalPresentDays}</strong>日</div>
                        <div className="col-span-2 text-[8px] text-slate-500 font-sans">※障害者総合支援法・工賃支払規程準拠（非雇用型）</div>
                      </div>
                    ) : (
                      <div className="p-1.5 grid grid-cols-3 gap-x-2 gap-y-1 font-mono text-[8.5px]">
                        <div>総実労働時間: <strong>{totalWorkHours}</strong>h</div>
                        <div>所定内実労働: <strong>{totalWorkHours}</strong>h</div>
                        <div>法定時間外: <strong>0.0</strong>h</div>
                        <div>総休憩時間: <strong>{(totalBreakMinutes / 60).toFixed(1)}</strong>h</div>
                        <div>法定休日労働: <strong>0.0</strong>h</div>
                        <div>深夜労働時間: <strong>0.0</strong>h</div>
                        <div className="col-span-3 text-[8px] text-slate-500 font-sans">※変形労働時間制・36協定・労基法第32条準拠</div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* 2. 特記事項・個別支援連絡欄 ＆ 本人署名捺印枠 */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 pt-0.5">
                  <div className="statutory-remarks-box col-span-2 border border-slate-400 rounded-xs p-2 h-[24.5mm] flex flex-col justify-between">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[8.5px] font-bold text-slate-700 border-b border-slate-200 pb-0.5">
                      <span>【特記事項・作業状況・個別支援連絡欄】</span>
                      <span className="text-[7.5px] text-slate-400 font-normal">（実地指導・定期モニタリング確認用）</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[8.5px] text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">
                      個別支援計画に基づき適正な作業環境および施設外就労支援を提供。月間目標に対する作業態度・体調推移は安定しており、計画に沿った適切な就労支援を継続して実施いたしました。
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="statutory-remarks-box border border-slate-400 rounded-xs p-2 h-[24.5mm] flex flex-col justify-between bg-slate-50/50">
                    <div className="text-[8.5px] font-bold text-slate-800 border-b border-slate-200 pb-0.5">
                      利用者確認署名欄
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[7.5px] text-slate-500 leading-tight">
                      上記{isTypeB ? '通所実績' : '出勤'}および作業内容に相違ないことを確認しました。
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-end justify-between pt-1">
                      <span className="text-[8px] text-slate-400">署名または印:</span>
                      <div className="border-b border-slate-400 w-24 h-6 flex items-center justify-end pr-1 text-[8.5px] text-slate-400">
                        ㊞
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* 3. 最下部フッター */}
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-[7.5px] text-slate-400 pt-0.5">
                  <span>
                    {isTypeB
                      ? '※本書は障害者の日常生活及び社会生活を総合的に支援するための法律に基づくサービス提供実績および工賃支払基礎資料の控えです。'
                      : '※本書は労働基準法第108条に基づく出勤簿および障害者総合支援法に基づくサービス提供実績記録の控えです。'}
                  </span>
                  <span>保存義務期間: 5年間（実地指導対象書類）</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            {!isLast && (
              <div 
                className="page-break hidden print:block" 
                style={{ 
                  pageBreakAfter: 'always', 
                  breakAfter: 'page', 
                  clear: 'both', 
                  height: '0', 
                  lineHeight: '0', 
                  fontSize: '0' 
                }} 
              />
            )}
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}
