'use client';

import { useState } from "react";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { 
  Calendar, 
  AlertCircle, 
  Plus, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  FileText, 
  ChevronRight, 
  Clock, 
  History, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  Printer, 
  Download, 
  Search, 
  FileSpreadsheet, 
  Users, 
  Layers,
  ArrowRight,
  Building2,
  Sparkles,
  UserCheck,
  Briefcase
} from "lucide-react";
import { cn, toLocalISODate } from "@/lib/utils";
import { 
  ClientPtoSummary, 
  StaffPtoSummary, 
  addPtoGrant, 
  updatePtoRecord, 
  processAutomaticPtoGrants,
  addStaffPtoGrant,
  updateStaffPtoRecord
} from "./actions";
import type { MandatoryPtoAlertItem } from "@/lib/compliance/paidLeaveCalculator";

interface Props {
  initialSummaries: ClientPtoSummary[];
  initialStaffSummaries?: StaffPtoSummary[];
  mandatoryAlerts?: MandatoryPtoAlertItem[];
}

export function PtoClient({ 
  initialSummaries, 
  initialStaffSummaries = [], 
  mandatoryAlerts = [] 
}: Props) {
  const [viewCategory, setViewCategory] = useState<'client' | 'staff'>('client');
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'roster' | 'detail'>('roster');
  const [selectedClient, setSelectedClient] = useState<ClientPtoSummary | null>(initialSummaries[0] || null);
  const [selectedStaff, setSelectedStaff] = useState<StaffPtoSummary | null>(initialStaffSummaries[0] || null);
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [filterType, setFilterType] = useState<'all' | 'expiring' | 'hasExpired' | 'needsGrant' | 'needsFiveDays'>('all');
  const [runningAutoGrant, setRunningAutoGrant] = useState(false);
  
  // 新規付与フォームステート
  const [isAdding, setIsAdding] = useState(false);
  const [grantDate, setGrantDate] = useState(() => toLocalISODate(new Date()));
  const [grantedDays, setGrantedDays] = useState(10);
  const [note, setNote] = useState("法定年次付与（6か月経過）");
  const [submitting, setSubmitting] = useState(false);

  // 編集用ステート
  const [editingRecordId, setEditingRecordId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editGranted, setEditGranted] = useState(0);
  const [editUsed, setEditUsed] = useState(0);
  const [editExpired, setEditExpired] = useState(0);
  const [editNote, setEditNote] = useState("");

  // 現在のカテゴリに応じたデータ選択
  const isClientView = viewCategory === 'client';
  
  // サマリー集計（選択中カテゴリに連動）
  const currentSummaries = isClientView ? initialSummaries : initialStaffSummaries;
  const totalGrantedAll = currentSummaries.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.totalGranted, 0);
  const totalUsedAll = currentSummaries.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.totalUsed, 0);
  const totalExpiredAll = currentSummaries.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.totalExpired, 0);
  const totalRemainingAll = currentSummaries.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.totalRemaining, 0);
  const expiringSoonAll = currentSummaries.reduce((sum, s) => sum + s.expiringSoonDays, 0);
  
  // 要付与（利用者）・年5日未達成（職員）カウント
  const clientNeedsGrantCount = initialSummaries.filter(s => s.statutorySuggestion?.isEligibleNow).length;
  const staffNeedsFiveDaysCount = initialStaffSummaries.filter(s => s.mandatoryFiveDaysTarget?.isTarget && (s.mandatoryFiveDaysTarget.remainingToFiveDays > 0)).length;

  // フィルタリング
  const filteredClientSummaries = initialSummaries.filter(item => {
    const matchesSearch = item.clientName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
                          item.recipientNumber.includes(searchTerm);
    if (!matchesSearch) return false;

    if (filterType === 'expiring') return item.expiringSoonDays > 0;
    if (filterType === 'hasExpired') return item.totalExpired > 0;
    if (filterType === 'needsGrant') return item.statutorySuggestion?.isEligibleNow;
    return true;
  });

  const filteredStaffSummaries = initialStaffSummaries.filter(item => {
    const matchesSearch = item.staffName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()) ||
                          (item.role && item.role.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase()));
    if (!matchesSearch) return false;

    if (filterType === 'expiring') return item.expiringSoonDays > 0;
    if (filterType === 'hasExpired') return item.totalExpired > 0;
    if (filterType === 'needsFiveDays') return item.mandatoryFiveDaysTarget?.isTarget && item.mandatoryFiveDaysTarget.remainingToFiveDays > 0;
    return true;
  });

  const handleRunAutoGrant = async () => {
    if (!confirm("基準日（付与月）を迎えた全職員および利用者に対し、法定付与日数を自動計算して付与を実行しますか？")) return;
    setRunningAutoGrant(true);
    try {
      const res = await processAutomaticPtoGrants();
      const msg = `【自動付与処理結果】\n・利用者付与: ${res.clientGrantsCount}件\n・職員付与: ${res.staffGrantsCount}件\n\n${res.details.length > 0 ? res.details.join('\n') : '※現在、新たに付与基準日を迎えた対象者はいません（最新状態です）。'}`;
      alert(msg);
      window.location.reload();
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert("自動付与エラー: " + err.message);
    } finally {
      setRunningAutoGrant(false);
    }
  };

  const handleGrant = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (isClientView) {
      if (!selectedClient) return;
      setSubmitting(true);
      try {
        const res = await addPtoGrant(selectedClient.clientId, grantDate, Number(grantedDays), note);
        if (!res.success) {
          alert("付与エラー: " + (res.error || '不明なエラー'));
          return;
        }
        alert(res.message);
        window.location.reload();
      } catch (err: any) {
        alert("付与エラー: " + err.message);
      } finally {
        setSubmitting(false);
      }
    } else {
      if (!selectedStaff) return;
      setSubmitting(true);
      try {
        const res = await addStaffPtoGrant(selectedStaff.staffId, grantDate, Number(grantedDays), note);
        if (!res.success) {
          alert("付与エラー: " + (res.error || '不明なエラー'));
          return;
        }
        alert(res.message);
        window.location.reload();
      } catch (err: any) {
        alert("付与エラー: " + err.message);
      } finally {
        setSubmitting(false);
      }
    }
  };

  const handleSaveRecord = async (recordId: string) => {
    try {
      if (isClientView) {
        const res = await updatePtoRecord(recordId, Number(editGranted), Number(editUsed), editNote, Number(editExpired));
        if (!res.success) {
          alert("更新エラー: " + (res.error || '不明なエラー'));
          return;
        }
        alert("利用者有給レコードを更新しました。");
      } else {
        const res = await updateStaffPtoRecord(recordId, Number(editGranted), Number(editUsed), editNote, Number(editExpired));
        if (!res.success) {
          alert("更新エラー: " + (res.error || '不明なエラー'));
          return;
        }
        alert("職員有給レコードを更新しました。");
      }
      setEditingRecordId(null);
      window.location.reload();
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert("更新エラー: " + err.message);
    }
  };

  // 全社 有休消化台帳 CSVエクスポート
  const handleExportCsv = () => {
    const safeCell = (val: any) => {
      const str = String(val ?? "");
      // CSV Formula Injection ガード: 数式解釈文字（=, +, -, @, \t, \r）で始まる文字列に ' を付与
      const sanitized = /^[=+\-@\t\r]/.test(str) ? `'${str}` : str;
      return `"${sanitized.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
    };

    if (isClientView) {
      const headers = [
        '利用者氏名', '受給者番号', '雇入れ年月日', '週所定労働時間',
        '前年度繰越日数', '当期付与日数', '累計取得日数', '2年時効消滅日数',
        '現在有効残日数', '3ヶ月以内失効予定', '直近取得日'
      ];

      const rows = initialSummaries.map(item => [
        item.clientName,
        item.recipientNumber,
        item.serviceStartDate || '',
        item.weeklyHours,
        item.carriedOverDays,
        item.currentGrantDays,
        item.totalUsed,
        item.totalExpired,
        item.totalRemaining,
        item.expiringSoonDays,
        item.takenDates && item.takenDates.length > 0 ? item.takenDates[0] : ''
      ]);

      const csvContent = '\uFEFF' + [headers.map(safeCell).join(','), ...rows.map(r => r.map(safeCell).join(','))].join('\r\n');
      const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `年次有給休暇管理簿_利用者_${toLocalISODate(new Date())}.csv`;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } else {
      const headers = [
        '職員氏名', '役職', '雇入れ年月日', '週所定労働時間',
        '前年度繰越日数', '当期付与日数', '累計取得日数', '年5日義務進捗',
        '2年時効消滅日数', '現在有効残日数', '3ヶ月以内失効予定', '直近取得日'
      ];

      const rows = initialStaffSummaries.map(item => {
        const fiveDaysStatus = item.mandatoryFiveDaysTarget?.isTarget
          ? `${item.mandatoryFiveDaysTarget.takenDays}日取得 (残${item.mandatoryFiveDaysTarget.remainingToFiveDays}日)`
          : '対象外(10日未満)';

        return [
          item.staffName,
          item.role || '',
          item.hireDate || '',
          item.weeklyHours,
          item.carriedOverDays,
          item.currentGrantDays,
          item.totalUsed,
          fiveDaysStatus,
          item.totalExpired,
          item.totalRemaining,
          item.expiringSoonDays,
          item.takenDates && item.takenDates.length > 0 ? item.takenDates[0] : ''
        ];
      });

      const csvContent = '\uFEFF' + [headers.map(safeCell).join(','), ...rows.map(r => r.map(safeCell).join(','))].join('\r\n');
      const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `年次有給休暇管理簿_職員_${toLocalISODate(new Date())}.csv`;
      a.click();
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* 印刷用スタイル */}
      <style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{__html: `
        @media print {
          nav, header, .no-print { display: none !important; }
          .print-full { width: 100% !important; max-width: 100% !important; }
          table { font-size: 10px !important; }
          th, td { padding: 4px 6px !important; }
        }
      `}} />

      {/* 労基法第39条第7項 年5日有給休暇取得義務 期限接近アラート（3ヶ月以内） */}
      {mandatoryAlerts.length > 0 && (
        <div className="bg-amber-50/90 border-2 border-amber-300 rounded-xl p-4 text-xs text-amber-950 space-y-2.5 shadow-xs no-print">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <span className="font-bold flex items-center gap-2 text-amber-950 text-sm">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
              【労基法第39条第7項】年5日有給休暇取得義務 期限接近アラート（対象: {mandatoryAlerts.length}名）
            </span>
            <span className="text-[11px] text-amber-800 bg-amber-100/80 px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-medium self-start sm:self-auto">
              期間満了まで3ヶ月（90日）以内で取得5日未満
            </span>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-amber-900 leading-relaxed">
            年10日以上の有給休暇が付与された全ての労働者（正職員・パート・利用者）は、基準日から1年以内に年5日を取得させることが事業者に義務付けられています（違反時は労基法第120条の罰則対象）。以下の対象者について速やかに計画付与や時季指定を行ってください。
          </p>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-2.5 pt-1">
            {mandatoryAlerts.map(item => (
              <div key={item.id} className={cn(
                "p-2.5 rounded-lg border bg-white flex flex-col justify-between space-y-1.5 shadow-2xs",
                item.isCritical ? "border-rose-400 bg-rose-50/70" : "border-amber-200"
              )}>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Badge variant={item.personType === 'staff' ? "outline" : "secondary"} className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0 font-bold">
                      {item.personTypeLabel}
                    </Badge>
                    <span className="font-bold text-sm text-foreground">{item.name}</span>
                  </div>
                  <span className={cn("text-xs font-bold", item.isCritical ? "text-rose-600" : "text-amber-700")}>
                    残り{item.daysUntilDeadline}日
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs pt-1 border-t border-slate-100">
                  <span>取得実績: <strong className="text-foreground">{item.takenDays}日</strong> / 義務5日</span>
                  <Badge variant={item.shortageDays > 0 ? "destructive" : "default"} className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0">
                    不足 {item.shortageDays}日
                  </Badge>
                </div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground flex justify-between">
                  <span>基準日: {item.periodStart}</span>
                  <span>期限: {item.periodEnd}</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 画面上部コントローラー: カテゴリ切替 & 自動付与アクション */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 no-print bg-card p-3 rounded-xl border shadow-2xs">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Button
            variant={viewCategory === 'client' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => { 
              setViewCategory('client'); 
              setActiveTab('roster'); 
              setFilterType('all');
            }}
            className="font-bold gap-1.5 shadow-2xs"
          >
            <Users className="w-4 h-4" />
            利用者（クライアント）有休管理 ({initialSummaries.length}名)
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant={viewCategory === 'staff' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => { 
              setViewCategory('staff'); 
              setActiveTab('roster'); 
              setFilterType('all');
            }}
            className="font-bold gap-1.5 shadow-2xs"
          >
            <Building2 className="w-4 h-4" />
            職員（スタッフ）有休管理 ({initialStaffSummaries.length}名)
          </Button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Button
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            disabled={runningAutoGrant}
            onClick={handleRunAutoGrant}
            className="font-bold gap-1.5 border-emerald-300 text-emerald-800 bg-emerald-50/50 hover:bg-emerald-100/80 shadow-2xs"
          >
            <Sparkles className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
            {runningAutoGrant ? "自動計算・付与中..." : "付与月の法定自動付与を今すぐ実行"}
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* トップサマリーバナー（全社集計） */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-5 gap-3.5 no-print">
        <Card className="border-blue-200 bg-blue-50/40">
          <CardHeader className="p-3.5 pb-1">
            <CardDescription className="text-xs font-semibold text-blue-800">
              {isClientView ? '利用者' : '職員'} 累計付与日数
            </CardDescription>
            <CardTitle className="text-xl font-bold text-blue-900">{totalGrantedAll} 日</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="p-3.5 pt-0 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            全登録付与合計
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="border-emerald-200 bg-emerald-50/40">
          <CardHeader className="p-3.5 pb-1">
            <CardDescription className="text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-800">
              {isClientView ? '利用者' : '職員'} 累計消化日数
            </CardDescription>
            <CardTitle className="text-xl font-bold text-emerald-900">{totalUsedAll} 日</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="p-3.5 pt-0 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            取得実績合計
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="border-primary/30 bg-primary/5">
          <CardHeader className="p-3.5 pb-1">
            <CardDescription className="text-xs font-semibold text-primary">
              {isClientView ? '利用者' : '職員'} 有効残日数
            </CardDescription>
            <CardTitle className="text-xl font-bold text-primary">{totalRemainingAll} 日</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="p-3.5 pt-0 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            利用可能残日数
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="border-slate-300 bg-slate-50">
          <CardHeader className="p-3.5 pb-1">
            <CardDescription className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700">2年時効消滅</CardDescription>
            <CardTitle className="text-xl font-bold text-slate-800">{totalExpiredAll} 日</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="p-3.5 pt-0 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            労基法115条で消滅
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className={`border-rose-200 ${expiringSoonAll > 0 ? 'bg-rose-50/60 animate-pulse' : 'bg-rose-50/30'}`}>
          <CardHeader className="p-3.5 pb-1">
            <CardDescription className="text-xs font-semibold text-rose-800">3ヶ月以内失効予定</CardDescription>
            <CardTitle className="text-xl font-bold text-rose-900">{expiringSoonAll} 日</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="p-3.5 pt-0 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
            計画的取得を促進
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* 法定根拠・アラート通知 */}
      <div className="bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg p-3.5 flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 text-xs no-print">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-slate-700">
          <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600 shrink-0" />
          <span>
            <strong>【労働基準法第39条・第115条 準拠】</strong>
            年次有給休暇は付与日より<strong>2年間で時効消滅</strong>します。当システムはアクセス時に時効消滅を自動確定し、FIFO（有効期限が近いものから優先消化）にて厳密に計算します。
          </span>
        </div>
        {isClientView && clientNeedsGrantCount > 0 && (
          <Badge variant="destructive" className="shrink-0 text-[11px]">
            初回法定付与対象: {clientNeedsGrantCount}名
          </Badge>
        )}
        {!isClientView && staffNeedsFiveDaysCount > 0 && (
          <Badge variant="destructive" className="shrink-0 text-[11px]">
            年5日取得未達: {staffNeedsFiveDaysCount}名
          </Badge>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* タブナビゲーション */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b pb-3 no-print">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Button
            variant={activeTab === 'roster' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('roster')}
            className="gap-1.5"
          >
            <FileSpreadsheet className="w-4 h-4" />
            {isClientView ? '全社 利用者有休消化台帳（法定様式）' : '全社 職員有休消化台帳（法定様式）'}
          </Button>
          <Button
            variant={activeTab === 'detail' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => setActiveTab('detail')}
            className="gap-1.5"
          >
            {isClientView ? <Users className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Building2 className="w-4 h-4" />}
            {isClientView ? '利用者別 詳細台帳・付与履歴' : '職員別 詳細台帳・付与履歴'}
          </Button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={handleExportCsv} className="gap-1 text-xs">
            <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            台帳CSV出力
          </Button>
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => window.print()} className="gap-1 text-xs">
            <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            管理簿を印刷
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 印刷用ヘッダー */}
      <div className="hidden print:block text-center mb-6">
        <h1 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-wider">
          年次有給休暇管理簿（{isClientView ? '利用者' : '職員'} 消化台帳）
        </h1>
        <p className="text-xs text-slate-600 mt-1" suppressHydrationWarning>
          労働基準法第39条および同法施行規則第24条の7に基づく法定管理台帳 ｜ 出力日: {new Date().toLocaleDateString('ja-JP')}
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* タブ1: 全社 有休消化台帳（法定様式・一覧） */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {activeTab === 'roster' && (
        <div className="space-y-4 print-full">
          {/* 検索・絞り込みフィルター（印刷非表示） */}
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 no-print">
            <div className="relative w-full sm:w-72">
              <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-2.5 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
              <Input
                placeholder={isClientView ? "氏名・受給者番号で検索..." : "氏名・役職で検索..."}
                value={searchTerm}
                onChange={e => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
                className="pl-8 h-9 text-xs"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 w-full sm:w-auto overflow-x-auto text-xs">
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant={filterType === 'all' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
                className="h-8 text-xs"
                onClick={() => setFilterType('all')}
              >
                全員 ({isClientView ? initialSummaries.length : initialStaffSummaries.length})
              </Button>
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant={filterType === 'expiring' ? 'destructive' : 'outline'}
                className="h-8 text-xs"
                onClick={() => setFilterType('expiring')}
              >
                失効間近 ({currentSummaries.filter(s => s.expiringSoonDays > 0).length})
              </Button>
              <Button
                size="sm"
                variant={filterType === 'hasExpired' ? 'secondary' : 'outline'}
                className="h-8 text-xs"
                onClick={() => setFilterType('hasExpired')}
              >
                消滅あり ({currentSummaries.filter(s => s.totalExpired > 0).length})
              </Button>
              {isClientView ? (
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant={filterType === 'needsGrant' ? 'outline' : 'outline'}
                  className="h-8 text-xs"
                  onClick={() => setFilterType('needsGrant')}
                >
                  要付与 ({clientNeedsGrantCount})
                </Button>
              ) : (
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant={filterType === 'needsFiveDays' ? 'destructive' : 'outline'}
                  className="h-8 text-xs"
                  onClick={() => setFilterType('needsFiveDays')}
                >
                  年5日未達 ({staffNeedsFiveDaysCount})
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 法定消化台帳テーブル */}
          <Card className="shadow-sm overflow-hidden border">
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-xs text-left border-collapse">
                <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 border-b font-semibold">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3">{isClientView ? '利用者氏名' : '職員氏名 / 役職'}</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2">{isClientView ? '雇入れ日' : '入社日'}</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 text-center">週所定</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 text-right bg-slate-100/60">前年繰越</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 text-right bg-blue-50/50">当期付与</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 text-right bg-emerald-50/50">累計取得</th>
                    {!isClientView && (
                      <th className="py-2.5 px-2 text-center bg-amber-50/50">年5日義務</th>
                    )}
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 text-right bg-rose-50/50">時効消滅(2年)</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right bg-blue-100/60 font-bold text-blue-950">現在有効残</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center">直近取得日</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-2 text-center">3ヶ月失効予定</th>
                    <th className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right no-print">操作</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-slate-100 text-slate-800">
                  {isClientView ? (
                    filteredClientSummaries.length === 0 ? (
                      <tr>
                        <td colSpan={11} className="py-8 text-center text-slate-400">
                          該当する利用者がいません
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ) : (
                      filteredClientSummaries.map(client => (
                        <tr key={client.clientId} className="hover:bg-slate-50/80 transition-colors">
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-3 font-semibold text-slate-900">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                              <span>{client.clientName}</span>
                              {client.statutorySuggestion?.isEligibleNow && (
                                <Badge variant="destructive" className="text-[9px] py-0 px-1">
                                  要付与
                                </Badge>
                              )}
                            </div>
                            <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 block font-normal">
                              受給者: {client.recipientNumber}
                            </span>
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-2 text-slate-600 font-mono text-[11px]">
                            {client.serviceStartDate || '-'}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-2 text-center text-slate-600">
                            {client.weeklyHours}h
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-2 text-right font-medium text-slate-700 bg-slate-50/40">
                            {client.carriedOverDays}日
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-2 text-right font-semibold text-blue-800 bg-blue-50/20">
                            {client.currentGrantDays}日
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-2 text-right font-bold text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50/20">
                            {client.totalUsed}日
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-2 text-right font-medium bg-rose-50/20">
                            {client.totalExpired > 0 ? (
                              <span className="text-rose-700 font-bold">{client.totalExpired}日</span>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-slate-400">0日</span>
                            )}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right font-bold text-blue-900 bg-blue-100/30 text-sm">
                            {client.totalRemaining}日
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center text-slate-600 font-mono text-[11px]">
                            {client.takenDates && client.takenDates.length > 0 ? (
                              <span title={client.takenDates.slice(0, 5).join(', ')}>
                                {client.takenDates[0]}
                              </span>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-slate-400">未取得</span>
                            )}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-2 text-center">
                            {client.expiringSoonDays > 0 ? (
                              <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border-rose-300 text-[10px]">
                                ⚠️ {client.expiringSoonDays}日
                              </Badge>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-slate-400">-</span>
                            )}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right no-print">
                            <Button
                              variant="ghost"
                              size="sm"
                              className="h-7 text-xs text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 gap-1"
                              onClick={() => {
                                setSelectedClient(client);
                                setActiveTab('detail');
                              }}
                            >
                              台帳詳細 <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            </Button>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ))
                    )
                  ) : (
                    filteredStaffSummaries.length === 0 ? (
                      <tr>
                        <td colSpan={12} className="py-8 text-center text-slate-400">
                          該当する職員がいません
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ) : (
                      filteredStaffSummaries.map(staff => (
                        <tr key={staff.staffId} className="hover:bg-slate-50/80 transition-colors">
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-3 font-semibold text-slate-900">
                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                              <span>{staff.staffName}</span>
                              <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[9px] py-0 px-1 font-normal text-muted-foreground">
                                {staff.role || '職員'}
                              </Badge>
                            </div>
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-2 text-slate-600 font-mono text-[11px]">
                            {staff.hireDate || '-'}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-2 text-center text-slate-600">
                            {staff.weeklyHours}h
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-2 text-right font-medium text-slate-700 bg-slate-50/40">
                            {staff.carriedOverDays}日
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-2 text-right font-semibold text-blue-800 bg-blue-50/20">
                            {staff.currentGrantDays}日
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-2 text-right font-bold text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50/20">
                            {staff.totalUsed}日
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-2 text-center bg-amber-50/20">
                            {staff.mandatoryFiveDaysTarget?.isTarget ? (
                              staff.mandatoryFiveDaysTarget.remainingToFiveDays === 0 ? (
                                <Badge variant="secondary" className="bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 text-[10px] py-0 px-1 font-bold">
                                  達成 ({staff.mandatoryFiveDaysTarget.takenDays}日)
                                </Badge>
                              ) : (
                                <Badge 
                                  variant={staff.mandatoryFiveDaysTarget.isCritical ? "destructive" : "outline"} 
                                  className={cn("text-[10px] py-0 px-1", !staff.mandatoryFiveDaysTarget.isCritical && "bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border-amber-300")}
                                >
                                  {staff.mandatoryFiveDaysTarget.takenDays}/5日 (残{staff.mandatoryFiveDaysTarget.remainingToFiveDays}日)
                                </Badge>
                              )
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-slate-400 text-[10px]">対象外</span>
                            )}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-2 text-right font-medium bg-rose-50/20">
                            {staff.totalExpired > 0 ? (
                              <span className="text-rose-700 font-bold">{staff.totalExpired}日</span>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-slate-400">0日</span>
                            )}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right font-bold text-blue-900 bg-blue-100/30 text-sm">
                            {staff.totalRemaining}日
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-center text-slate-600 font-mono text-[11px]">
                            {staff.takenDates && staff.takenDates.length > 0 ? (
                              <span title={staff.takenDates.slice(0, 5).join(', ')}>
                                {staff.takenDates[0]}
                              </span>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-slate-400">未取得</span>
                            )}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-2 text-center">
                            {staff.expiringSoonDays > 0 ? (
                              <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-rose-50 text-rose-700 border-rose-300 text-[10px]">
                                ⚠️ {staff.expiringSoonDays}日
                              </Badge>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-slate-400">-</span>
                            )}
                          </td>
                          <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-right no-print">
                            <Button
                              variant="ghost"
                              size="sm"
                              className="h-7 text-xs text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-800 gap-1"
                              onClick={() => {
                                setSelectedStaff(staff);
                                setActiveTab('detail');
                              }}
                            >
                              台帳詳細 <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            </Button>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ))
                    )
                  )}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </Card>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* タブ2: 個別 詳細台帳・付与履歴 */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {activeTab === 'detail' && (
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
          {/* 左カラム: 一覧リスト */}
          <Card className="lg:col-span-1 no-print">
            <CardHeader className="p-3.5 pb-2 border-b">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm flex items-center justify-between">
                <span>{isClientView ? '対象利用者' : '対象職員'}</span>
                <Badge variant="outline">
                  {isClientView ? initialSummaries.length : initialStaffSummaries.length}名
                </Badge>
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="p-2 space-y-1 max-h-[600px] overflow-y-auto">
              {isClientView ? (
                initialSummaries.map((client) => {
                  const isSelected = selectedClient?.clientId === client.clientId;
                  const hasAlert = client.statutorySuggestion?.isEligibleNow;

                  return (
                    <button
                      key={client.clientId}
                      onClick={() => {
                        setSelectedClient(client);
                        setIsAdding(false);
                        setEditingRecordId(null);
                      }}
                      className={`w-full text-left p-2.5 rounded-lg text-xs transition-colors flex items-center justify-between ${
                        isSelected 
                          ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white font-medium shadow-sm' 
                          : 'hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-700'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="space-y-0.5">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold">
                          <span>{client.clientName}</span>
                          {hasAlert && (
                            <Badge variant="destructive" className="text-[9px] py-0 px-1">
                              要付与
                            </Badge>
                          )}
                        </div>
                        <div className={`text-[10px] ${isSelected ? 'text-blue-100' : 'text-slate-400'}`}>
                          {client.recipientNumber}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-right">
                        <div className="text-sm font-bold">
                          {client.totalRemaining} <span className="text-[10px] font-normal">日残</span>
                        </div>
                        {client.totalExpired > 0 && (
                          <div className={`text-[9px] ${isSelected ? 'text-rose-200' : 'text-slate-400'}`}>
                            失効済: {client.totalExpired}日
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </button>
                  );
                })
              ) : (
                initialStaffSummaries.map((staff) => {
                  const isSelected = selectedStaff?.staffId === staff.staffId;
                  const target = staff.mandatoryFiveDaysTarget;

                  return (
                    <button
                      key={staff.staffId}
                      onClick={() => {
                        setSelectedStaff(staff);
                        setIsAdding(false);
                        setEditingRecordId(null);
                      }}
                      className={`w-full text-left p-2.5 rounded-lg text-xs transition-colors flex items-center justify-between ${
                        isSelected 
                          ? 'bg-blue-600 text-white font-medium shadow-sm' 
                          : 'hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-700'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="space-y-0.5">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold">
                          <span>{staff.staffName}</span>
                          <span className={`text-[10px] font-normal ${isSelected ? 'text-blue-100' : 'text-muted-foreground'}`}>
                            ({staff.role || '職員'})
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        {target?.isTarget && target.remainingToFiveDays > 0 && (
                          <div className={`text-[9px] ${isSelected ? 'text-amber-200' : 'text-amber-700 font-semibold'}`}>
                            ⚠️ 年5日未達: 残{target.remainingToFiveDays}日
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-right">
                        <div className="text-sm font-bold">
                          {staff.totalRemaining} <span className="text-[10px] font-normal">日残</span>
                        </div>
                        {staff.totalExpired > 0 && (
                          <div className={`text-[9px] ${isSelected ? 'text-rose-200' : 'text-slate-400'}`}>
                            失効済: {staff.totalExpired}日
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </button>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          {/* 右カラム: 選択された個別有給管理簿詳細 */}
          <Card className="lg:col-span-2 print-full">
            {isClientView ? (
              selectedClient ? (
                <>
                  <CardHeader className="border-b pb-4">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
                      <div>
                        <CardTitle className="text-lg flex items-center gap-2">
                          <FileText className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600" />
                          {selectedClient.clientName} さんの年次有給休暇管理簿
                        </CardTitle>
                        <CardDescription className="text-xs mt-1">
                          雇入れ日: {selectedClient.serviceStartDate || '未設定'} ｜ 週所定: {selectedClient.weeklyHours}時間 ｜ 受給者番号: {selectedClient.recipientNumber}
                        </CardDescription>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 no-print">
                        <Button 
                          size="sm" 
                          onClick={() => setIsAdding(!isAdding)}
                          className="gap-1 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-xs"
                        >
                          <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          有給を付与する
                        </Button>
                        <Button 
                          size="sm" 
                          variant="outline"
                          onClick={() => window.print()}
                          className="gap-1 text-xs"
                        >
                          <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          台帳印刷
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* 利用者の消化台帳サマリーバナー */}
                    <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-5 gap-2 p-3 bg-slate-50 border rounded-lg text-center text-xs">
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-slate-500 text-[10px] block">前期繰越日数</span>
                        <strong className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">{selectedClient.carriedOverDays}日</strong>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-slate-500 text-[10px] block">当期付与日数</span>
                        <strong className="text-sm font-bold text-blue-800">{selectedClient.currentGrantDays}日</strong>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-slate-500 text-[10px] block">累計取得日数</span>
                        <strong className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-800">{selectedClient.totalUsed}日</strong>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-slate-500 text-[10px] block">2年時効消滅</span>
                        <strong className="text-sm font-bold text-rose-800">{selectedClient.totalExpired}日</strong>
                      </div>
                      <div className="col-span-2 sm:col-span-1 bg-blue-100/60 rounded py-0.5">
                        <span className="text-blue-900 text-[10px] block font-semibold">現在有効残日数</span>
                        <strong className="text-base font-extrabold text-blue-900">{selectedClient.totalRemaining}日</strong>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* 法定サジェストボックス */}
                    {selectedClient.statutorySuggestion && (
                      <div className="mt-3 p-3 bg-blue-50 border border-blue-200 rounded-md flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs text-blue-900 no-print">
                        <div>
                          <span className="font-semibold">法定付与サジェスト:</span> 勤続 {selectedClient.statutorySuggestion.yearsOfService} / 次回基準日: {selectedClient.statutorySuggestion.nextGrantDate}（付与目安: {selectedClient.statutorySuggestion.suggestedDays}日）
                        </div>
                        {selectedClient.statutorySuggestion.isEligibleNow && (
                          <Button
                            size="sm"
                            variant="secondary"
                            className="h-7 text-xs bg-blue-600 text-white hover:bg-blue-700 shrink-0"
                            onClick={() => {
                              setIsAdding(true);
                              setGrantedDays(selectedClient.statutorySuggestion?.suggestedDays || 10);
                              setNote(`初回法定付与（勤続6ヶ月経過）`);
                            }}
                          >
                            サジェスト内容で付与
                          </Button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </CardHeader>

                  <CardContent className="pt-4 space-y-6">
                    {/* 新規付与フォーム */}
                    {isAdding && (
                      <form onSubmit={handleGrant} className="p-4 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg space-y-4 animate-in fade-in no-print">
                        <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2">
                          <Plus className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
                          利用者への新規有給休暇付与登録
                        </h4>
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                          <div className="space-y-1">
                            <Label htmlFor="grantDate" className="text-xs">付与日（基準日）</Label>
                            <Input
                              id="grantDate"
                              type="date"
                              value={grantDate}
                              onChange={(e) => setGrantDate(e.target.value)}
                              required
                              className="h-8 text-xs"
                            />
                          </div>
                          <div className="space-y-1">
                            <Label htmlFor="grantedDays" className="text-xs">付与日数（日）</Label>
                            <Input
                              id="grantedDays"
                              type="number"
                              step="0.5"
                              min="0.5"
                              max="40"
                              value={grantedDays}
                              onChange={(e) => setGrantedDays(Number(e.target.value))}
                              required
                              className="h-8 text-xs"
                            />
                          </div>
                          <div className="space-y-1">
                            <Label htmlFor="note" className="text-xs">付与事由・備考</Label>
                            <Input
                              id="note"
                              value={note}
                              onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)}
                              placeholder="例: 法定年次付与"
                              className="h-8 text-xs"
                            />
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
                          <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setIsAdding(false)}>
                            キャンセル
                          </Button>
                          <Button type="submit" size="sm" disabled={submitting}>
                            {submitting ? '保存中...' : '付与を確定する'}
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </form>
                    )}

                    {/* 有給付与・失効履歴テーブル */}
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800 mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <History className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-600" />
                          付与・消化・失効履歴一覧（有効期限：付与から2年）
                        </span>
                        {selectedClient.expiringSoonDays > 0 && (
                          <span className="text-xs text-rose-700 font-bold">
                            ⚠️ 3ヶ月以内失効予定: {selectedClient.expiringSoonDays}日
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </h4>

                      {selectedClient.records.length === 0 ? (
                        <div className="text-center py-8 text-slate-400 text-xs border border-dashed rounded-lg">
                          有給休暇の付与履歴がありません。「有給を付与する」から登録してください。
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="overflow-x-auto border rounded-lg">
                          <table className="w-full text-xs text-left">
                            <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-slate-600 border-b">
                              <tr>
                                <th className="p-2.5">付与日</th>
                                <th className="p-2.5">付与日数</th>
                                <th className="p-2.5">消化日数</th>
                                <th className="p-2.5 font-bold text-blue-900">残日数</th>
                                <th className="p-2.5 font-bold text-rose-800">時効消滅(失効)</th>
                                <th className="p-2.5">失効日</th>
                                <th className="p-2.5">備考</th>
                                <th className="p-2.5 text-right no-print">操作</th>
                              </tr>
                            </thead>
                            <tbody className="divide-y text-slate-700">
                              {selectedClient.records.map((r) => {
                                const isExpired = new Date(r.expiration_date) < new Date();
                                const isEditing = editingRecordId === r.id;

                                return isEditing ? (
                                  <tr key={r.id} className="bg-blue-50/50">
                                    <td className="p-2">{r.grant_date}</td>
                                    <td className="p-2">
                                      <Input
                                        type="number"
                                        step="0.5"
                                        value={editGranted}
                                        onChange={(e) => setEditGranted(Number(e.target.value))}
                                        className="h-7 w-16 text-xs"
                                      />
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="p-2">
                                      <Input
                                        type="number"
                                        step="0.5"
                                        value={editUsed}
                                        onChange={(e) => setEditUsed(Number(e.target.value))}
                                        className="h-7 w-16 text-xs"
                                      />
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="p-2 font-bold">{Math.max(0, editGranted - editUsed - editExpired)}日</td>
                                    <td className="p-2">
                                      <Input
                                        type="number"
                                        step="0.5"
                                        value={editExpired}
                                        onChange={(e) => setEditExpired(Number(e.target.value))}
                                        className="h-7 w-16 text-xs"
                                      />
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="p-2">{r.expiration_date}</td>
                                    <td className="p-2">
                                      <Input
                                        value={editNote}
                                        onChange={(e) => setEditNote(e.target.value)}
                                        className="h-7 text-xs"
                                      />
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="p-2 text-right space-x-1 no-print">
                                      <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="h-7 text-xs" onClick={() => setEditingRecordId(null)}>
                                        取消
                                      </Button>
                                      <Button size="sm" className="h-7 text-xs" onClick={() => handleSaveRecord(r.id)}>
                                        保存
                                      </Button>
                                    </td>
                                  </tr>
                                ) : (
                                  <tr key={r.id} className={isExpired ? "opacity-60 bg-slate-50" : ""}>
                                    <td className="p-2.5 font-mono">{r.grant_date}</td>
                                    <td className="p-2.5 font-bold">{r.granted_days} 日</td>
                                    <td className="p-2.5 text-emerald-800 font-medium">{r.used_days} 日</td>
                                    <td className="p-2.5 font-bold text-blue-700">{r.remaining_days} 日</td>
                                    <td className="p-2.5 font-medium">
                                      {r.expired_days > 0 ? (
                                        <span className="text-rose-700 font-bold">{r.expired_days} 日</span>
                                      ) : (
                                        <span className="text-slate-400">0 日</span>
                                      )}
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="p-2.5 font-mono">
                                      {r.expiration_date}
                                      {isExpired && (
                                        <Badge variant="outline" className="ml-1 text-[9px] bg-slate-100 text-slate-500">
                                          時効消滅済
                                        </Badge>
                                      )}
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="p-2.5 text-slate-500">{r.note || '-'}</td>
                                    <td className="p-2.5 text-right no-print">
                                      <Button
                                        size="sm"
                                        variant="ghost"
                                        className="h-6 text-xs px-2 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800"
                                        onClick={() => {
                                          setEditingRecordId(r.id);
                                          setEditGranted(r.granted_days);
                                          setEditUsed(r.used_days);
                                          setEditExpired(r.expired_days || 0);
                                          setEditNote(r.note || "");
                                        }}
                                      >
                                        編集
                                      </Button>
                                    </td>
                                  </tr>
                                );
                              })}
                            </tbody>
                          </table>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* 勤怠実績との突合（直近の取得日一覧） */}
                    {selectedClient.takenDates && selectedClient.takenDates.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="border-t pt-4">
                        <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                          出退勤実績から自動集計された取得日一覧（直近{selectedClient.takenDates.length}回）:
                        </h4>
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 max-h-24 overflow-y-auto p-2 bg-slate-50 rounded border text-xs">
                          {selectedClient.takenDates.map((date, idx) => (
                            <span key={idx} className="bg-white border border-slate-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-700">
                              {date}
                            </span>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </CardContent>
                </>
              ) : (
                <CardContent className="py-16 text-center text-slate-400 text-sm">
                  利用者を選択してください
                </CardContent>
              )
            ) : (
              selectedStaff ? (
                <>
                  <CardHeader className="border-b pb-4">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4">
                      <div>
                        <CardTitle className="text-lg flex items-center gap-2">
                          <Briefcase className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-600" />
                          {selectedStaff.staffName} さんの年次有給休暇管理簿
                        </CardTitle>
                        <CardDescription className="text-xs mt-1">
                          入社日: {selectedStaff.hireDate || '未設定'} ｜ 役職: {selectedStaff.role || '職員'} ｜ 週所定: {selectedStaff.weeklyHours}時間
                        </CardDescription>
                      </div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 no-print">
                        <Button 
                          size="sm" 
                          onClick={() => setIsAdding(!isAdding)}
                          className="gap-1 bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-xs"
                        >
                          <Plus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          有給を付与する
                        </Button>
                        <Button 
                          size="sm" 
                          variant="outline"
                          onClick={() => window.print()}
                          className="gap-1 text-xs"
                        >
                          <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          台帳印刷
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* 職員の消化台帳サマリーバナー */}
                    <div className="mt-4 grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-5 gap-2 p-3 bg-slate-50 border rounded-lg text-center text-xs">
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-slate-500 text-[10px] block">前期繰越日数</span>
                        <strong className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">{selectedStaff.carriedOverDays}日</strong>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-slate-500 text-[10px] block">当期付与日数</span>
                        <strong className="text-sm font-bold text-blue-800">{selectedStaff.currentGrantDays}日</strong>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-slate-500 text-[10px] block">累計取得日数</span>
                        <strong className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-800">{selectedStaff.totalUsed}日</strong>
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <span className="text-slate-500 text-[10px] block">2年時効消滅</span>
                        <strong className="text-sm font-bold text-rose-800">{selectedStaff.totalExpired}日</strong>
                      </div>
                      <div className="col-span-2 sm:col-span-1 bg-blue-100/60 rounded py-0.5">
                        <span className="text-blue-900 text-[10px] block font-semibold">現在有効残日数</span>
                        <strong className="text-base font-extrabold text-blue-900">{selectedStaff.totalRemaining}日</strong>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {/* 労基法第39条第7項 年5日取得義務進捗カード */}
                    {selectedStaff.mandatoryFiveDaysTarget?.isTarget && (
                      <div className={cn(
                        "mt-3 p-3 rounded-md border flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-start sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs no-print",
                        selectedStaff.mandatoryFiveDaysTarget.isCritical 
                          ? "bg-rose-50 border-rose-300 text-rose-950" 
                          : selectedStaff.mandatoryFiveDaysTarget.remainingToFiveDays === 0
                            ? "bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-300 text-emerald-950"
                            : "bg-amber-50 border-amber-300 text-amber-950"
                      )}>
                        <div>
                          <span className="font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            {selectedStaff.mandatoryFiveDaysTarget.remainingToFiveDays === 0 ? (
                              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
                            ) : (
                              <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
                            )}
                            【年5日有給休暇取得義務】進捗状況:
                          </span>
                          <span className="mt-0.5 block">
                            取得実績: <strong>{selectedStaff.mandatoryFiveDaysTarget.takenDays}日</strong> / 法定義務: 5日 ｜ 
                            {selectedStaff.mandatoryFiveDaysTarget.remainingToFiveDays === 0 ? (
                              <span className="text-emerald-700 font-bold ml-1">今期の取得義務を達成しています✅</span>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="font-bold ml-1">
                                不足: {selectedStaff.mandatoryFiveDaysTarget.remainingToFiveDays}日（期限 {selectedStaff.mandatoryFiveDaysTarget.periodEnd} まで残り {selectedStaff.mandatoryFiveDaysTarget.daysUntilPeriodEnd}日）
                              </span>
                            )}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                        {selectedStaff.mandatoryFiveDaysTarget.remainingToFiveDays > 0 && (
                          <Badge variant={selectedStaff.mandatoryFiveDaysTarget.isCritical ? "destructive" : "default"} className="shrink-0 text-xs">
                            要取得: 残{selectedStaff.mandatoryFiveDaysTarget.remainingToFiveDays}日
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </CardHeader>

                  <CardContent className="pt-4 space-y-6">
                    {/* 新規付与フォーム */}
                    {isAdding && (
                      <form onSubmit={handleGrant} className="p-4 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-200 rounded-lg space-y-4 animate-in fade-in no-print">
                        <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-2">
                          <Plus className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
                          職員への新規有給休暇付与登録
                        </h4>
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                          <div className="space-y-1">
                            <Label htmlFor="grantDate" className="text-xs">付与日（基準日）</Label>
                            <Input
                              id="grantDate"
                              type="date"
                              value={grantDate}
                              onChange={(e) => setGrantDate(e.target.value)}
                              required
                              className="h-8 text-xs"
                            />
                          </div>
                          <div className="space-y-1">
                            <Label htmlFor="grantedDays" className="text-xs">付与日数（日）</Label>
                            <Input
                              id="grantedDays"
                              type="number"
                              step="0.5"
                              min="0.5"
                              max="40"
                              value={grantedDays}
                              onChange={(e) => setGrantedDays(Number(e.target.value))}
                              required
                              className="h-8 text-xs"
                            />
                          </div>
                          <div className="space-y-1">
                            <Label htmlFor="note" className="text-xs">付与事由・備考</Label>
                            <Input
                              id="note"
                              value={note}
                              onChange={(e) => setNote(e.target.value)}
                              placeholder="例: 法定年次付与"
                              className="h-8 text-xs"
                            />
                          </div>
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
                          <Button type="button" variant="ghost" size="sm" onClick={() => setIsAdding(false)}>
                            キャンセル
                          </Button>
                          <Button type="submit" size="sm" disabled={submitting}>
                            {submitting ? '保存中...' : '付与を確定する'}
                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </form>
                    )}

                    {/* 有給付与・失効履歴テーブル */}
                    <div>
                      <h4 className="text-sm font-semibold text-slate-800 mb-3 flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <History className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-600" />
                          付与・消化・失効履歴一覧（有効期限：付与から2年）
                        </span>
                        {selectedStaff.expiringSoonDays > 0 && (
                          <span className="text-xs text-rose-700 font-bold">
                            ⚠️ 3ヶ月以内失効予定: {selectedStaff.expiringSoonDays}日
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </h4>

                      {selectedStaff.records.length === 0 ? (
                        <div className="text-center py-8 text-slate-400 text-xs border border-dashed rounded-lg">
                          職員の有給休暇付与履歴がありません。「有給を付与する」から登録してください。
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="overflow-x-auto border rounded-lg">
                          <table className="w-full text-xs text-left">
                            <thead className="bg-slate-50 text-slate-600 border-b">
                              <tr>
                                <th className="p-2.5">付与日</th>
                                <th className="p-2.5">付与日数</th>
                                <th className="p-2.5">消化日数</th>
                                <th className="p-2.5 font-bold text-blue-900">残日数</th>
                                <th className="p-2.5 font-bold text-rose-800">時効消滅(失効)</th>
                                <th className="p-2.5">失効日</th>
                                <th className="p-2.5">備考</th>
                                <th className="p-2.5 text-right no-print">操作</th>
                              </tr>
                            </thead>
                            <tbody className="divide-y text-slate-700">
                              {selectedStaff.records.map((r) => {
                                const isExpired = new Date(r.expiration_date) < new Date();
                                const isEditing = editingRecordId === r.id;

                                return isEditing ? (
                                  <tr key={r.id} className="bg-blue-50/50">
                                    <td className="p-2">{r.grant_date}</td>
                                    <td className="p-2">
                                      <Input
                                        type="number"
                                        step="0.5"
                                        value={editGranted}
                                        onChange={(e) => setEditGranted(Number(e.target.value))}
                                        className="h-7 w-16 text-xs"
                                      />
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="p-2">
                                      <Input
                                        type="number"
                                        step="0.5"
                                        value={editUsed}
                                        onChange={(e) => setEditUsed(Number(e.target.value))}
                                        className="h-7 w-16 text-xs"
                                      />
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="p-2 font-bold">{Math.max(0, editGranted - editUsed - editExpired)}日</td>
                                    <td className="p-2">
                                      <Input
                                        type="number"
                                        step="0.5"
                                        value={editExpired}
                                        onChange={(e) => setEditExpired(Number(e.target.value))}
                                        className="h-7 w-16 text-xs"
                                      />
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="p-2">{r.expiration_date}</td>
                                    <td className="p-2">
                                      <Input
                                        value={editNote}
                                        onChange={(e) => setEditNote(e.target.value)}
                                        className="h-7 text-xs"
                                      />
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="p-2 text-right space-x-1 no-print">
                                      <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="h-7 text-xs" onClick={() => setEditingRecordId(null)}>
                                        取消
                                      </Button>
                                      <Button size="sm" className="h-7 text-xs" onClick={() => handleSaveRecord(r.id)}>
                                        保存
                                      </Button>
                                    </td>
                                  </tr>
                                ) : (
                                  <tr key={r.id} className={isExpired ? "opacity-60 bg-slate-50" : ""}>
                                    <td className="p-2.5 font-mono">{r.grant_date}</td>
                                    <td className="p-2.5 font-bold">{r.granted_days} 日</td>
                                    <td className="p-2.5 text-emerald-800 font-medium">{r.used_days} 日</td>
                                    <td className="p-2.5 font-bold text-blue-700">{r.remaining_days} 日</td>
                                    <td className="p-2.5 font-medium">
                                      {r.expired_days > 0 ? (
                                        <span className="text-rose-700 font-bold">{r.expired_days} 日</span>
                                      ) : (
                                        <span className="text-slate-400">0 日</span>
                                      )}
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="p-2.5 font-mono">
                                      {r.expiration_date}
                                      {isExpired && (
                                        <Badge variant="outline" className="ml-1 text-[9px] bg-slate-100 text-slate-500">
                                          時効消滅済
                                        </Badge>
                                      )}
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="p-2.5 text-slate-500">{r.note || '-'}</td>
                                    <td className="p-2.5 text-right no-print">
                                      <Button
                                        size="sm"
                                        variant="ghost"
                                        className="h-6 text-xs px-2 text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-800"
                                        onClick={() => {
                                          setEditingRecordId(r.id);
                                          setEditGranted(r.granted_days);
                                          setEditUsed(r.used_days);
                                          setEditExpired(r.expired_days || 0);
                                          setEditNote(r.note || "");
                                        }}
                                      >
                                        編集
                                      </Button>
                                    </td>
                                  </tr>
                                );
                              })}
                            </tbody>
                          </table>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>

                    {/* シフト実績との突合（直近の取得日一覧） */}
                    {selectedStaff.takenDates && selectedStaff.takenDates.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="border-t pt-4">
                        <h4 className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 mb-2 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                          シフト実績から自動集計された有休取得日一覧（直近{selectedStaff.takenDates.length}回）:
                        </h4>
                        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 max-h-24 overflow-y-auto p-2 bg-slate-50 rounded border text-xs">
                          {selectedStaff.takenDates.map((date, idx) => (
                            <span key={idx} className="bg-white border border-slate-200 px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-mono text-slate-700">
                              {date}
                            </span>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </CardContent>
                </>
              ) : (
                <CardContent className="py-16 text-center text-slate-400 text-sm">
                  職員を選択してください
                </CardContent>
              )
            )}
          </Card>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
