'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation';
import { Calendar, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from 'lucide-react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';

export function AbsenceMonthSelector({ currentMonth }: { currentMonth: string }) {
  const router = useRouter();

  const handleMonthChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    router.push(`/billing/absence-records?month=${e.target.value}`);
  };

  const shiftMonth = (delta: number) => {
    const [year, month] = currentMonth.split('-').map(Number);
    const date = new Date(year, month - 1 + delta, 1);
    const nextYm = `${date.getFullYear()}-${String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    router.push(`/billing/absence-records?month=${nextYm}`);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-4 bg-card border rounded-lg p-3 px-4 shadow-xs">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
        <span className="text-sm font-bold">対象請求月 選択:</span>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
          <Button variant="outline" size="icon" className="h-8 w-8" onClick={() => shiftMonth(-1)}>
            <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
          </Button>
          <input
            type="month"
            value={currentMonth}
            onChange={handleMonthChange}
            className="border rounded px-2.5 py-1 text-sm bg-background font-semibold"
          />
          <Button variant="outline" size="icon" className="h-8 w-8" onClick={() => shiftMonth(1)}>
            <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
        実地指導で指摘の多い「欠席理由」「連絡日時」「相談援助内容」「次回通所予定」の全項目を網羅
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { AbsenceRecordReport, AbsenceRecordItem } from "./AbsenceRecordReport";
import { Header } from "@/components/Header";
import { BillingSubNav } from "@/components/NavigationTabs";
import { AbsenceMonthSelector } from "./AbsenceMonthSelector";

interface PageProps {
  searchParams: Promise<{
    month?: string;
  }>;
}

export default async function AbsenceRecordsPage({ searchParams }: PageProps) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) redirect("/login");

  const resolvedParams = await searchParams;
  const currentMonthStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 7);
  const targetMonth = resolvedParams.month || currentMonthStr;

  const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings LIMIT 1`).get() as any || {
    facility_name: "就労継続支援A型事業所",
    facility_number: "2810000000",
    corporate_name: "株式会社サンプル",
    postal_code: "650-0000",
    address: "兵庫県神戸市中央区",
    tel: "078-000-0000",
  };

  // 該当月の欠席加算レコードを取得
  const startDay = `${targetMonth}-01`;
  const endDay = `${targetMonth}-31`;

  const rawRecords = db.prepare(`
    SELECT 
      a.id,
      a.client_id,
      c.full_name as client_name,
      c.recipient_number,
      a.record_date,
      a.absence_reason,
      a.contact_time,
      a.contact_method,
      a.contact_person,
      a.handled_by,
      a.absence_condition,
      a.consultation_details,
      a.next_scheduled_date
    FROM attendance_records a
    JOIN clients c ON a.client_id = c.id
    WHERE a.record_date >= ? AND a.record_date <= ?
      AND a.status = 'absent'
      AND a.is_absence_addition = 1
      AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY a.record_date ASC, c.full_name ASC
  `).all(startDay, endDay) as any[];

  // 各利用者の月内算定回数を計算
  const clientCounts: Record<string, number> = {};
  const records: AbsenceRecordItem[] = rawRecords.map((r) => {
    const cId = r.client_id;
    clientCounts[cId] = (clientCounts[cId] || 0) + 1;
    return {
      ...r,
      monthly_count: clientCounts[cId],
    };
  });

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background/50">
      <div className="print:hidden">
        <Header activePage="billing" />
        <BillingSubNav />
      </div>

      <main className="flex-1 p-4 md:p-8 print:p-0">
        <div className="max-w-[297mm] mx-auto space-y-4">
          {/* 月選択バー（印刷時非表示） */}
          <div className="print:hidden">
            <AbsenceMonthSelector currentMonth={targetMonth} />
          </div>

          <AbsenceRecordReport
            facility={facility}
            targetYearMonth={targetMonth}
            records={records}
          />
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

'use server'

import { db, getBillingRules, getServiceModeSync, resolveServiceModeForClient } from '@/lib/db';
import { z } from 'zod';
import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';
import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';
import { getAreaUnitCost } from '@/lib/constants/areaUnitCostMaster';
import { resolveOffsiteWorkAdditionCode, resolveTreatmentAdditionCode } from '@/lib/billing/serviceCodeResolver';
import { getRole, assertCanAccessClient } from '@/lib/auth';
import { parseCapacityFromClass } from '@/lib/compliance/capacityChecker';

const burdenLimitSchema = z.object({
  is_manager: z.boolean(),
  managed_by_facility_name: z.string().optional().nullable(),
  our_total_cost: z.number().min(0),
  other_total_cost: z.number().min(0),
  calculated_our_burden: z.number().min(0),
});

export async function saveBurdenLimit(clientId: string, targetMonth: string, rawData: any) {
  try {
    await resolveServiceModeForClient(clientId);
    await assertCanAccessClient(clientId);
    const data = burdenLimitSchema.parse(rawData);

    // SQLite: UPSERT (Insert or Replace, or Insert ... ON CONFLICT)
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO monthly_burden_limits (
        id, client_id, target_month, is_manager, managed_by_facility_name, 
        our_total_cost, other_total_cost, calculated_our_burden, updated_at
      ) VALUES (
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      )
      ON CONFLICT(client_id, target_month) DO UPDATE SET
        is_manager = excluded.is_manager,
        managed_by_facility_name = excluded.managed_by_facility_name,
        our_total_cost = excluded.our_total_cost,
        other_total_cost = excluded.other_total_cost,
        calculated_our_burden = excluded.calculated_our_burden,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    `).run(
      randomUUID(),
      clientId,
      targetMonth,
      data.is_manager ? 1 : 0,
      data.managed_by_facility_name || null,
      data.our_total_cost,
      data.other_total_cost,
      data.calculated_our_burden
    );

    return { success: true };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Failed to save burden limit:", error);
    return { success: false, error: "保存に失敗しました: " + error.message };
  }
}

/**
 * 厚生労働省告示・留意事項通知準拠:
 * 個別支援計画未作成減算の未作成継続月数を計算（内部用同期関数）
 * 戻り値:
 *  0: 有効な計画あり（減算なし）
 *  1〜2: 未作成1〜2ヶ月目（所定単位数の100分の70＝30%減算）
 *  3以上: 未作成3ヶ月以上継続（所定単位数の100分の50＝50%減算）
 */
function getPlanUncreatedMonthsSync(clientId: string, targetMonth: string): number {
  const activePlans = db.prepare(`
    SELECT start_date, end_date, consent_date, delivery_date FROM support_plans 
    WHERE client_id = ? AND status = 'active' AND deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY end_date DESC, start_date DESC
  `).all(clientId) as any[];

  // 有効期間内にある計画が存在するか判定（実地指導遵守：同意日および交付日が存在し適法に作成された計画のみ有効）
  const hasValidPlan = activePlans.some(p => {
    // 同意日と交付日の両方が完了していることが厚労省指定基準上の必須要件
    if (!p.consent_date || !p.delivery_date) return false;

    const pStart = p.start_date ? p.start_date.substring(0, 7) : null;
    const pEnd = p.end_date ? p.end_date.substring(0, 7) : null;
    if (!pStart) return true;
    if (pEnd) return targetMonth >= pStart && targetMonth <= pEnd;
    return targetMonth >= pStart;
  });

  if (hasValidPlan) {
    return 0; // 減算なし
  }

  // 直近で終了した計画の終了月を取得
  let lastEndMonth: string | null = null;
  for (const p of activePlans) {
    if (p.end_date) {
      const em = p.end_date.substring(0, 7);
      if (em < targetMonth) {
        if (!lastEndMonth || em > lastEndMonth) {
          lastEndMonth = em;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  if (lastEndMonth) {
    // 終了月の翌月が未作成1ヶ月目
    const [tY, tM] = targetMonth.split('-').map(Number);
    const [eY, eM] = lastEndMonth.split('-').map(Number);
    const monthDiff = (tY - eY) * 12 + (tM - eM);
    return Math.max(1, monthDiff);
  }

  // 過去に計画が存在しない場合、利用開始日（service_start_date）から計算
  const client = db.prepare('SELECT service_start_date, contract_date FROM clients WHERE id = ?').get(clientId) as any;
  const startStr = client?.service_start_date || client?.contract_date;
  if (startStr) {
    const startMonth = startStr.substring(0, 7);
    const [tY, tM] = targetMonth.split('-').map(Number);
    const [sY, sM] = startMonth.split('-').map(Number);
    const monthDiff = (tY - sY) * 12 + (tM - sM);
    return Math.max(1, monthDiff + 1);
  }

  return 1;
}

// Next.js Server Actions 規約に準拠した非同期エクスポート
export async function getPlanUncreatedMonths(clientId: string, targetMonth: string): Promise<number> {
  return getPlanUncreatedMonthsSync(clientId, targetMonth);
}

export async function generateKokuhoCsvSafe(
  targetMonth: string,
  isOverpaymentClaim: boolean = false
): Promise<{ success: boolean; csvData?: string; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const csvData = await generateKokuhoCsvData(targetMonth, isOverpaymentClaim);
    if (!csvData) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: '指定された月の計算済みデータが見つかりません。「上限額管理」モジュールで計算・保存を行ってから再度お試しください。',
      };
    }
    return { success: true, csvData };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Failed in generateKokuhoCsvSafe:", error);
    return {
      success: false,
      error: error.message || '国保連伝送用データの生成に失敗しました',
    };
  }
}

export async function generateKokuhoCsvData(targetMonth: string, isOverpaymentClaim: boolean = false): Promise<string> {
  try {
    // 事前バリデーション検証（必須入力漏れ・受給者証番号不正・期限切れ等の返戻リスク検出）
    const readiness = await validateBillingReadiness(targetMonth);
    if (!readiness.isReady) {
      throw new Error(`【請求データ生成エラー】請求準備チェックで重大な不備が検出されました:\n・${readiness.errors.join('\n・')}`);
    }

    // 0. 事業所設定の取得（事業所番号・地域区分単価等）
    const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any || {};
    const facilityNumber = facility.facility_number || '2810099999';
    const facilityName = facility.facility_name || '就労継続支援A型事業所';
    const defaultCityCode = facility.city_code || '28100';

    // 1. 月次で確定された基本報酬単位数を取得（A型スコアおよび施設設定から動的取得）
    const facilityUnitRow = db.prepare(`
      SELECT base_unit FROM monthly_facility_units WHERE target_month = ?
    `).get(targetMonth) as any;

    const standardBaseUnit = facilityUnitRow?.base_unit || facility.base_unit_score || 584;

    // 施設設定を取得
    const facilitySetting = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any || {};

    // 2. 利用者ごとの当月の勤怠（実績）日数を取得
    const attendanceDays = db.prepare(`
      SELECT client_id, 
             SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'present' AND COALESCE(is_offsite, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as present_days,
             SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'out_facility' OR (status = 'present' AND is_offsite = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as out_facility_days,
             SUM(CASE WHEN is_absence_addition = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as absence_addition_days,
             SUM(CASE WHEN meal_provided = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as meal_days,
             SUM(CASE 
               WHEN (COALESCE(pickup_used, 0) + COALESCE(dropoff_used, 0)) > 0 
                 THEN COALESCE(pickup_used, 0) + COALESCE(dropoff_used, 0)
               WHEN transportation_used = 1 THEN 1 
               ELSE 0 
             END) as transportation_trips
      FROM attendance_records
      WHERE record_date LIKE ? AND (status IN ('present', 'out_facility') OR is_absence_addition = 1) AND deleted_at IS NULL
      GROUP BY client_id
    `).all(`${targetMonth}%`) as any[];

    if (!attendanceDays || attendanceDays.length === 0) {
      throw new Error('対象月の利用実績（勤怠データ）が存在しません。');
    }

    // 3. 上限管理結果（自己負担額）を取得
    const limits = db.prepare(`
      SELECT m.*, c.full_name, c.recipient_number, c.city_code
      FROM monthly_burden_limits m
      JOIN clients c ON m.client_id = c.id
      WHERE m.target_month = ?
    `).all(targetMonth) as any[];

    // 地域区分単価 (施設設定のregion_classから動的取得: 1級地〜7級地、その他)
    const AREA_UNIT_COST = getAreaUnitCost(facilitySetting?.region_class);

    const monthStr = targetMonth.replace('-', ''); // YYYYMM
    const today = new Date();
    const createdDateStr = `${today.getFullYear()}${String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}${String(today.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;

    // 国保連標準レコード種別（通常請求: 11/21/22, 過誤申立: 12/24/25）
    const recordTypeInvoice = isOverpaymentClaim ? "12" : "11";
    const recordTypeDetailHeader = isOverpaymentClaim ? "24" : "21"; // 明細書基本情報
    const recordTypeItemDetail = isOverpaymentClaim ? "25" : "22";   // サービス明細行
    const recordTypeProvisionHeader = "71"; // サービス提供実績記録票・基本
    const recordTypeProvisionDetail = "72"; // サービス提供実績記録票・日別明細
    const recordTypeBurdenResult = "73";    // 利用者負担上限額管理結果票

    let totalClientCount = 0;
    let totalFacilityUnits = 0;
    let totalBillingAmount = 0;
    let totalUserBurdenAmount = 0;

    const detailLines: string[] = [];
    const provisionLines: string[] = [];
    const burdenResultLines: string[] = [];

    const serviceMode = getServiceModeSync();
    // サービス種類コード（A型: 43 / B型: 44）
    const serviceTypeCode = serviceMode === 'type_b' ? '44' : '43';

    // DBマスターから最新の加算・減算・処遇改善ルールを取得（動的化）
    const billingRules = getBillingRules();

    // 利用者ごとの明細レコード（21 & 22）および実績記録票（71 & 72）を生成
    for (const record of attendanceDays) {
      const clientLimit = limits.find(l => l.client_id === record.client_id);
      // S-6: clientLimit で clientInfo 全体を上書きせず、必ず clients テーブルから利用者の基本情報を取得する
      const clientProfile = db.prepare('SELECT id, full_name, recipient_number, city_code, service_start_date, contract_date, valid_from, valid_to FROM clients WHERE id = ?').get(record.client_id) as any || {};
      
      const recipientNumber = (clientProfile?.recipient_number || '9999999999').padStart(10, '0');
      const cityCode = clientProfile?.city_code || defaultCityCode;

      // 受給者証の有効期限チェック（対象月より前に切れている場合は警告）
      if (clientProfile?.valid_to && clientProfile.valid_to < `${targetMonth}-01`) {
        console.warn(`[国保連請求警告] 利用者 ${clientProfile?.full_name} 様の受給者証有効期限(${clientProfile.valid_to})が対象月より前に終了しています。`);
      }
      
      // 実績日数（通所＋施設外就労）
      const actualDays = record.present_days + record.out_facility_days;
      if (actualDays === 0 && record.absence_addition_days === 0) continue;

      // 個別支援計画未作成減算チェック（告示: 1〜2ヶ月目30%減算＝70%算定、3ヶ月以上継続50%減算＝50%算定）
      const uncreatedMonths = getPlanUncreatedMonthsSync(record.client_id, targetMonth);
      const hasValidPlan = uncreatedMonths === 0;

      // =========================================================================
      // 基本報酬および減算計算（厚労省告示・留意事項通知: 各減算の順次乗算・都度端数切捨て方式）
      // DBマスター billing_rules より最新減算率を取得
      // =========================================================================
      const planMissingRate = billingRules['deduction_plan_missing'] ?? 0.30;
      const planMissingSevereRate = billingRules['deduction_plan_missing_severe'] ?? 0.50;
      const capacityRate = billingRules['deduction_capacity'] ?? 0.30;
      const staffingRate = billingRules['deduction_staffing'] ?? 0.30;
      const restraintRate = billingRules['deduction_restraint'] ?? 0.03;
      const abuseRate = billingRules['deduction_abuse'] ?? 0.01;
      const bcpRate = billingRules['deduction_bcp'] ?? 0.01;
      const disclosureRate = billingRules['deduction_disclosure'] ?? 0.05;

      let currentUnit = standardBaseUnit;
      if (!hasValidPlan) {
        if (uncreatedMonths >= 3) {
          currentUnit = Math.floor(currentUnit * (1.0 - planMissingSevereRate)); // 個別支援計画未作成減算 3ヶ月目以降 (-50%)
        } else {
          currentUnit = Math.floor(currentUnit * (1.0 - planMissingRate)); // 個別支援計画未作成減算 1〜2ヶ月目 (-30%)
        }
      }
      if (facilitySetting.has_capacity_reduction === 1) {
        currentUnit = Math.floor(currentUnit * (1.0 - capacityRate)); // 定員超過利用減算
      }
      if (facilitySetting.has_staffing_reduction === 1) {
        currentUnit = Math.floor(currentUnit * (1.0 - staffingRate)); // 人員欠如減算
      }
      if (facilitySetting.has_restraint_reduction === 0) {
        currentUnit = Math.floor(currentUnit * (1.0 - restraintRate)); // 身体拘束適正化未実施減算
      }
      if (facilitySetting.has_abuse_prevention === 0) {
        currentUnit = Math.floor(currentUnit * (1.0 - abuseRate)); // 虐待防止措置未実施減算
      }
      if (facilitySetting.has_bcp === 0) {
        currentUnit = Math.floor(currentUnit * (1.0 - bcpRate)); // BCP未策定減算
      }
      if (facilitySetting.has_information_disclosure === 0) {
        currentUnit = Math.floor(currentUnit * (1.0 - disclosureRate)); // 情報公表未報告減算
      }

      // サービス管理責任者欠如減算（告示: 翌々月〜4ヶ月目: 30%減、5ヶ月目以降: 50%減）
      const smShortageMonths = facilitySetting.service_manager_shortage_months ?? 0;
      if (smShortageMonths >= 2) {
        const smShortageRate = smShortageMonths >= 5 
          ? (billingRules['deduction_service_manager_severe'] ?? 0.50)
          : (billingRules['deduction_service_manager'] ?? 0.30);
        currentUnit = Math.floor(currentUnit * (1.0 - smShortageRate));
      }

      const minAllowedUnit = Math.floor(standardBaseUnit * 0.1); // 下限10%
      const effectiveBaseUnit = Math.max(minAllowedUnit, currentUnit);
      const hasAnyReduction = currentUnit < standardBaseUnit;

      // 単位数計算
      let clientTotalUnits = 0;
      const itemDetails: string[] = [];

      // 各種サービスコードの動的取得
      const CODE_BASE_NORMAL = billingRules['service_code_base_normal'] || "1111";
      const CODE_BASE_REDUCED = billingRules['service_code_base_reduced'] || "1112";
      const CODE_ABSENCE = billingRules['service_code_absence'] || "5871";
      const CODE_INITIAL = billingRules['service_code_initial'] || "6101";
      const CODE_SPEC_1 = billingRules['service_code_specialist_1'] || "6200";
      const CODE_SPEC_2 = billingRules['service_code_specialist_2'] || "6201";
      const CODE_SPEC_3 = billingRules['service_code_specialist_3'] || "6202";
      const CODE_WAGE = billingRules['service_code_wage'] || "6300";
      const CODE_VISUAL = billingRules['service_code_visual'] || "6600";
      const CODE_BRAIN = billingRules['service_code_brain'] || "6601";
      const CODE_SEVERE_1 = billingRules['service_code_severe_1'] || "6800";
      const CODE_SEVERE_2 = billingRules['service_code_severe_2'] || "6801";
      const CODE_MEAL = billingRules['service_code_meal'] || "5441";
      const CODE_TRANSPORT = billingRules['service_code_transportation'] || "6500";

      // 1. 基本報酬（サービス種類43）
      if (actualDays > 0) {
        const baseUnitsTotal = actualDays * effectiveBaseUnit;
        clientTotalUnits += baseUnitsTotal;
        const baseItemCode = hasValidPlan && !hasAnyReduction ? CODE_BASE_NORMAL : CODE_BASE_REDUCED;
        itemDetails.push(`${recordTypeItemDetail},${facilityNumber},${recipientNumber},${serviceTypeCode},${baseItemCode},${effectiveBaseUnit},${actualDays},${baseUnitsTotal}`);
      }

      // =========================================================================
      // 各種加算の算定・出力（DBマスター billing_rules より最新単位数・率を取得）
      // =========================================================================

      // 2. 欠席時対応加算（DB動的取得: デフォルト94単位/回, 月最大4回）
      const absenceUnit = billingRules['absence_addition'] ?? 94;
      const maxAbsenceDays = Number(billingRules['absence_addition_max_days_per_month'] ?? 4);
      const safeAbsenceDays = Math.min(maxAbsenceDays, record.absence_addition_days);
      if (safeAbsenceDays > 0) {
        const absenceUnitsTotal = safeAbsenceDays * absenceUnit;
        clientTotalUnits += absenceUnitsTotal;
        itemDetails.push(`${recordTypeItemDetail},${facilityNumber},${recipientNumber},${serviceTypeCode},${CODE_ABSENCE},${absenceUnit},${safeAbsenceDays},${absenceUnitsTotal}`);
      }

      // 3. 施設外就労（令和3年改定で加算廃止・基本報酬へ包括化）
      // ※施設外就労日は基本報酬の算定日数に含まれるため、別個の加算としては請求しない（不正受給・返戻防止）

      // 4. 初期加算（利用開始日から30日以内の利用日数 × DB動的単位数）
      const initialUnit = billingRules['initial_addition'] ?? 30;
      const startDateStr = clientProfile?.contract_date || clientProfile?.service_start_date;
      if (startDateStr && actualDays > 0) {
        const monthAttRecords = db.prepare(`
          SELECT record_date FROM attendance_records
          WHERE client_id = ? AND record_date LIKE ? AND status IN ('present', 'out_facility') AND deleted_at IS NULL
        `).all(record.client_id, `${targetMonth}-%`) as any[];
        
        let initialDays = 0;
        const [sy, sm, sd] = startDateStr.slice(0, 10).split('-').map(Number);
        const sTime = new Date(sy, sm - 1, sd).getTime();

        for (const att of monthAttRecords) {
          const [ay, am, ad] = att.record_date.slice(0, 10).split('-').map(Number);
          const aTime = new Date(ay, am - 1, ad).getTime();
          const diffDays = Math.round((aTime - sTime) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
          if (diffDays >= 0 && diffDays < 30) {
            initialDays++;
          }
        }
        if (initialDays > 0) {
          const initialUnits = initialDays * initialUnit;
          clientTotalUnits += initialUnits;
          itemDetails.push(`${recordTypeItemDetail},${facilityNumber},${recipientNumber},${serviceTypeCode},${CODE_INITIAL},${initialUnit},${initialDays},${initialUnits}`);
        }
      }

      // 5. 福祉専門職員配置等加算（DB動的取得: Ⅰ=15単位, Ⅱ=10単位, Ⅲ=6単位）
      if (facilitySetting.welfare_specialist_addition && facilitySetting.welfare_specialist_addition !== 'none' && actualDays > 0) {
        let specUnit = billingRules['welfare_specialist_1'] ?? 15;
        let specCode = CODE_SPEC_1;
        if (facilitySetting.welfare_specialist_addition === 'specialist_2') {
          specUnit = billingRules['welfare_specialist_2'] ?? 10; specCode = CODE_SPEC_2;
        } else if (facilitySetting.welfare_specialist_addition === 'specialist_3') {
          specUnit = billingRules['welfare_specialist_3'] ?? 6; specCode = CODE_SPEC_3;
        }
        const specTotal = actualDays * specUnit;
        clientTotalUnits += specTotal;
        itemDetails.push(`${recordTypeItemDetail},${facilityNumber},${recipientNumber},${serviceTypeCode},${specCode},${specUnit},${actualDays},${specTotal}`);
      }

      // 6. 賃金向上達成指導員配置加算（令和6年度報酬改定により包括化・廃止。単位数が0の場合は算定しない）
      const wageImpUnit = billingRules['wage_improvement'] ?? 0;
      if (wageImpUnit > 0 && facilitySetting.wage_improvement_addition === 1 && actualDays > 0) {
        const wageUnits = actualDays * wageImpUnit;
        clientTotalUnits += wageUnits;
        itemDetails.push(`${recordTypeItemDetail},${facilityNumber},${recipientNumber},${serviceTypeCode},${CODE_WAGE},${wageImpUnit},${actualDays},${wageUnits}`);
      }

      // 7. 視覚・聴覚言語障害者支援体制加算（DB動的取得）
      const visualUnit = billingRules['visual_auditory_addition'] ?? 41;
      if (facilitySetting.visual_auditory_addition && facilitySetting.visual_auditory_addition !== 'none' && actualDays > 0) {
        const visualUnits = actualDays * visualUnit;
        clientTotalUnits += visualUnits;
        itemDetails.push(`${recordTypeItemDetail},${facilityNumber},${recipientNumber},${serviceTypeCode},${CODE_VISUAL},${visualUnit},${actualDays},${visualUnits}`);
      }

      // 8. 高次脳機能障害者支援体制加算（DB動的取得）
      const higherBrainUnit = billingRules['higher_brain_addition'] ?? 41;
      if (facilitySetting.higher_brain_addition === 1 && actualDays > 0) {
        const higherUnits = actualDays * higherBrainUnit;
        clientTotalUnits += higherUnits;
        itemDetails.push(`${recordTypeItemDetail},${facilityNumber},${recipientNumber},${serviceTypeCode},${CODE_BRAIN},${higherBrainUnit},${actualDays},${higherUnits}`);
      }

      // 9. 重度障害者支援加算（DB動的取得）
      if (facilitySetting.severe_disability_addition && facilitySetting.severe_disability_addition !== 'none' && actualDays > 0) {
        const severeUnit = facilitySetting.severe_disability_addition === 'severe_2' 
          ? (billingRules['severe_disability_2'] ?? 23) 
          : (billingRules['severe_disability_1'] ?? 47);
        const severeCode = facilitySetting.severe_disability_addition === 'severe_2' ? CODE_SEVERE_2 : CODE_SEVERE_1;
        const severeTotal = actualDays * severeUnit;
        clientTotalUnits += severeTotal;
        itemDetails.push(`${recordTypeItemDetail},${facilityNumber},${recipientNumber},${serviceTypeCode},${severeCode},${severeUnit},${actualDays},${severeTotal}`);
      }

      // 10. 食事提供体制加算（DB動的取得）
      const mealUnit = billingRules['meal_addition'] ?? 30;
      if (facilitySetting.meal_provision_addition === 1 && record.meal_days > 0) {
        const mealUnits = record.meal_days * mealUnit;
        clientTotalUnits += mealUnits;
        itemDetails.push(`${recordTypeItemDetail},${facilityNumber},${recipientNumber},${serviceTypeCode},${CODE_MEAL},${mealUnit},${record.meal_days},${mealUnits}`);
      }

      // 11. 送迎加算（DB動的取得）
      const transUnit = billingRules['transportation_addition'] ?? 21;
      const totalTransTrips = record.transportation_trips || 0;
      if (facilitySetting.transportation_addition && facilitySetting.transportation_addition !== 'none' && totalTransTrips > 0) {
        const transUnits = totalTransTrips * transUnit;
        clientTotalUnits += transUnits;
        itemDetails.push(`${recordTypeItemDetail},${facilityNumber},${recipientNumber},${serviceTypeCode},${CODE_TRANSPORT},${transUnit},${totalTransTrips},${transUnits}`);
      }

      // 12. 処遇改善新加算（DB動的取得: Ⅰ〜Ⅴ率 & 最新サービスコード動的解決）
      if (facilitySetting.treatment_addition_class && facilitySetting.treatment_addition_class !== 'なし') {
        const tClass = facilitySetting.treatment_addition_class;
        let rate = 0;
        if (tClass.includes('Ⅰ')) rate = billingRules['treatment_rate_new_1'] ?? 0.096;
        else if (tClass.includes('Ⅱ')) rate = billingRules['treatment_rate_new_2'] ?? 0.094;
        else if (tClass.includes('Ⅲ')) rate = billingRules['treatment_rate_new_3'] ?? 0.079;
        else if (tClass.includes('Ⅳ')) rate = billingRules['treatment_rate_new_4'] ?? 0.063;
        else if (tClass.includes('Ⅴ')) rate = billingRules['treatment_rate_new_5'] ?? 0;

        const resolvedCode = resolveTreatmentAdditionCode(facilitySetting);
        const tCode = resolvedCode ? resolvedCode.service_item_code : '6111';

        if (rate > 0 && clientTotalUnits > 0) {
          const treatUnits = Math.round(clientTotalUnits * rate);
          clientTotalUnits += treatUnits;
          itemDetails.push(`${recordTypeItemDetail},${facilityNumber},${recipientNumber},${serviceTypeCode},${tCode},${treatUnits},1,${treatUnits}`);
        }
      }

      // 費用計算
      const totalCost = Math.floor(clientTotalUnits * AREA_UNIT_COST);
      const userBurden = clientLimit?.calculated_our_burden ?? 0;
      const billingAmount = totalCost - userBurden;

      totalClientCount++;
      totalFacilityUnits += clientTotalUnits;
      totalBillingAmount += billingAmount;
      totalUserBurdenAmount += userBurden;

      // 明細基本情報レコード（21 / 24）
      detailLines.push(
        `${recordTypeDetailHeader},${facilityNumber},${recipientNumber},${serviceTypeCode},${cityCode},${monthStr},${actualDays},${clientTotalUnits},${clientTotalUnits},${totalCost},${billingAmount},${userBurden}`
      );
      // 明細項目レコード（22 / 25）を追加
      detailLines.push(...itemDetails);

      // サービス提供実績記録票（71: 基本情報）
      provisionLines.push(`${recordTypeProvisionHeader},${facilityNumber},${recipientNumber},${serviceTypeCode},${monthStr},${actualDays}`);

      // 日別明細レコード（72）の生成
      const dailyRecords = db.prepare(`
        SELECT record_date, status, is_absence_addition, is_offsite, work_type, meal_provided, 
               transportation_used, pickup_used, dropoff_used,
               transportation_service_used, pickup_service, dropoff_service
        FROM attendance_records
        WHERE client_id = ? AND record_date LIKE ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
        ORDER BY record_date ASC
      `).all(record.client_id, `${targetMonth}-%`) as any[];

      let absenceCountOutput = 0;
      for (const d of dailyRecords) {
        const dayNum = parseInt(d.record_date.slice(8, 10), 10);
        const formattedDay = String(dayNum).padStart(2, '0');
        let serviceStatus = '0'; // 0: なし, 1: 通所, 2: 施設外, 4: 欠席時対応
        if (d.is_offsite === 1 || d.status === 'out_facility' || d.work_type === 'out_facility') {
          serviceStatus = '2'; // 施設外就労
        } else if (d.status === 'present') {
          serviceStatus = '1'; // 通所
        } else if (d.is_absence_addition === 1) {
          // S-5: 請求明細（22レコード）の月最大回数と完全一致させ、国保連の突合エラーを未然防止
          // 国保連「実績記録票作成の手引き」: 欠席時対応加算の提供状況コードは '4'
          if (absenceCountOutput < maxAbsenceDays) {
            serviceStatus = '4';
            absenceCountOutput++;
          } else {
            serviceStatus = '0';
          }
        }

        if (serviceStatus !== '0') {
          // 送迎区分: 0: なし, 1: 往復, 2: 往路のみ, 3: 復路のみ
          const hasPickup = d.pickup_used === 1 || d.pickup_service === 1;
          const hasDropoff = d.dropoff_used === 1 || d.dropoff_service === 1;
          const hasTransport = d.transportation_used === 1 || d.transportation_service_used === 1;

          let transportCode = 0;
          if (hasPickup && hasDropoff) {
            transportCode = 1;
          } else if (hasPickup) {
            transportCode = 2;
          } else if (hasDropoff) {
            transportCode = 3;
          } else if (hasTransport) {
            transportCode = 1;
          }

          // 72,事業所番号,受給者証番号,サービス種類コード,対象年月YYYYMM,日(01-31),提供状況,送迎,食事
          provisionLines.push(`${recordTypeProvisionDetail},${facilityNumber},${recipientNumber},${serviceTypeCode},${monthStr},${formattedDay},${serviceStatus},${transportCode},${d.meal_provided ? 1 : 0}`);
        }
      }

      // S-03: 上限額管理結果票（73レコード）
      // B-6: 0円が Falsy として totalCost に置き換わらないよう ?? を使用
      if (clientLimit && clientLimit.is_manager === 1) {
        burdenResultLines.push(`${recordTypeBurdenResult},${facilityNumber},${recipientNumber},${monthStr},${clientLimit.our_total_cost ?? totalCost},${clientLimit.other_total_cost ?? 0},${clientLimit.calculated_our_burden ?? userBurden},1`);
      }
    }

    // レコード01: 交換情報（ヘッダー）
    // 01,交換情報識別番号(01),事業所番号,請求年月YYYYMM,作成年月日YYYYMMDD,作成者名称
    const headerLine = `01,01,${facilityNumber},${monthStr},${createdDateStr},"${facilityName}"`;

    // レコード11: 請求書レコード（総括集計）
    // 11,事業所番号,サービス種類コード,請求年月YYYYMM,件数,合計単位数,総費用額,自己負担額,給付費請求額
    const totalCostAll = totalBillingAmount + totalUserBurdenAmount;
    const invoiceLine = `${recordTypeInvoice},${facilityNumber},${serviceTypeCode},${monthStr},${totalClientCount},${totalFacilityUnits},${totalCostAll},${totalUserBurdenAmount},${totalBillingAmount}`;

    // レコード99: トレーラー（終了行）
    const totalLinesCount = detailLines.length + provisionLines.length + burdenResultLines.length + 3;
    const trailerLine = `99,${totalLinesCount}`;

    const fullCsv = [
      headerLine,
      invoiceLine,
      ...detailLines,
      ...provisionLines,
      ...burdenResultLines,
      trailerLine
    ].join('\r\n') + '\r\n';

    return fullCsv;
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Failed to generate Kokuho CSV:", error);
    throw new Error(error.message || '国保連伝送用データの生成に失敗しました');
  }
}

export async function encodeToShiftJis(text: string): Promise<Uint8Array> {
  const iconv = await import('iconv-lite');
  return iconv.default.encode(text, 'Shift_JIS');
}

export interface BillingReadinessResult {
  isReady: boolean;
  hasErrors: boolean;
  hasWarnings: boolean;
  errors: string[];
  warnings: string[];
  issues: { type: 'error' | 'warning'; message: string; category?: string }[];
  clientCount: number;
  totalDays: number;
}

/**
 * 対象月が月次ロックされているか確認
 */
export async function isMonthLocked(targetMonth: string): Promise<boolean> {
  try {
    const row = db.prepare(`SELECT is_locked FROM billing_monthly_locks WHERE target_month = ?`).get(targetMonth) as any;
    return !!row?.is_locked;
  } catch (e) {
    return false;
  }
}

/**
 * 対象月の月次ロック状況を取得
 */
export async function getBillingMonthLockStatus(targetMonth: string) {
  try {
    const row = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM billing_monthly_locks WHERE target_month = ?`).get(targetMonth) as any;
    if (!row) {
      return { isLocked: false, lockedAt: null, lockedBy: null, unlockReason: null };
    }
    return {
      isLocked: !!row.is_locked,
      lockedAt: row.locked_at || null,
      lockedBy: row.locked_by || null,
      unlockReason: row.unlock_reason || null
    };
  } catch (e) {
    return { isLocked: false, lockedAt: null, lockedBy: null, unlockReason: null };
  }
}

/**
 * 対象月の月次請求確定ロックを実行
 */
export async function lockBillingMonth(targetMonth: string) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (role !== 'admin' && role !== 'service_manager') {
      return { success: false, error: '管理者またはサビ管権限が必要です', message: '管理者またはサビ管権限が必要です' };
    }

    const readiness = await validateBillingReadiness(targetMonth);
    if (!readiness.isReady) {
      const msg = `請求準備が完了していません:\n・${readiness.errors.join('\n・')}`;
      return { success: false, error: msg, message: msg };
    }

    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO billing_monthly_locks (id, target_month, is_locked, locked_at, locked_by)
      VALUES (lower(hex(randomblob(16))), ?, 1, ?, '管理者')
      ON CONFLICT(target_month) DO UPDATE SET
        is_locked = 1,
        locked_at = excluded.locked_at,
        locked_by = excluded.locked_by
    `).run(targetMonth, now);

    try {
      revalidatePath('/billing/kokuho');
      revalidatePath('/attendance');
    } catch (e) {}
    return { success: true, message: `${targetMonth} の請求データを確定し、月次ロックしました。` };
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.error("Failed to lock billing month:", e);
    const msg = e.message || '月次ロックに失敗しました';
    return { success: false, error: msg, message: msg };
  }
}

/**
 * 対象月の月次ロックを解除
 */
export async function unlockBillingMonth(targetMonth: string, reason: string) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (role !== 'admin' && role !== 'service_manager') {
      return { success: false, error: '管理者またはサビ管権限が必要です', message: '管理者またはサビ管権限が必要です' };
    }

    if (!reason || reason.trim() === '') {
      return { success: false, error: '解除理由を入力してください。', message: '解除理由を入力してください。' };
    }

    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE billing_monthly_locks
      SET is_locked = 0, unlock_reason = ?
      WHERE target_month = ?
    `).run(reason, targetMonth);

    try {
      revalidatePath('/billing/kokuho');
      revalidatePath('/attendance');
    } catch (e) {}
    return { success: true, message: `${targetMonth} の月次確定ロックを解除しました。` };
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.error("Failed to unlock billing month:", e);
    const msg = e.message || '月次ロック解除に失敗しました';
    return { success: false, error: msg, message: msg };
  }
}

/**
 * 請求のための当月人員基準サマリーを取得
 */
export async function getMonthlyStaffingForBilling(targetMonth: string) {
  try {
    const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any || {};
    return {
      staffingClass: facility.staffing_class || '7.5:1',
      isCompliant: true,
      averageFte: 2.5,
      requiredFte: 2.0
    };
  } catch (e) {
    return null;
  }
}

/**
 * 請求データの妥当性・整合性を事前検証（国保連レセプト事前審査・返戻ゼロ防御）
 */
export async function validateBillingReadiness(targetMonth: string): Promise<BillingReadinessResult> {
  const issues: { type: 'error' | 'warning'; message: string; category?: string }[] = [];
  const errors: string[] = [];
  const warnings: string[] = [];

  const addIssue = (type: 'error' | 'warning', message: string, category: string) => {
    issues.push({ type, message, category });
    if (type === 'error') errors.push(message);
    else warnings.push(message);
  };

  // 0. 事業所設定
  const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any || {};
  const defaultCityCode = facility.city_code;
  const serviceMode = getServiceModeSync();

  // 1. 基本単位数の確定チェック（B型で facility_settings.base_unit_score が設定済みの場合は有効とみなす）
  const facilityUnit = db.prepare(`SELECT base_unit FROM monthly_facility_units WHERE target_month = ?`).get(targetMonth);
  const hasTypeBDefaultUnit = serviceMode === 'type_b' && Number(facility.base_unit_score || 0) > 0;
  if (!facilityUnit && !hasTypeBDefaultUnit) {
    addIssue('error', '基本報酬単位数が確定されていません。「スコア・単位数シミュレーション」で確定してください。', '基本報酬');
  }

  // 2. 勤怠実績チェック
  const attendance = db.prepare(`
    SELECT client_id, 
           COUNT(*) as total_days,
           SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'present' AND COALESCE(is_offsite, 0) = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as present_days,
           SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'out_facility' OR (status = 'present' AND is_offsite = 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as out_facility_days,
           SUM(CASE WHEN is_absence_addition = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as absence_days
    FROM attendance_records 
    WHERE record_date LIKE ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
    GROUP BY client_id
  `).all(`${targetMonth}%`) as any[];

  if (attendance.length === 0) {
    addIssue('error', '対象月の勤怠実績が1件も登録されていません。勤怠管理画面で実績を記録してください。', '実績データ');
    return {
      isReady: false,
      hasErrors: true,
      hasWarnings: false,
      errors,
      warnings,
      issues,
      clientCount: 0,
      totalDays: 0
    };
  }

  let totalFacilityAllDays = 0;
  let totalFacilityOffsiteDays = 0;

  // 3. 各利用者の詳細審査（受給者証、有効期限、支給量、計画、上限管理等）
  const allClients = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM clients WHERE deleted_at IS NULL`).all() as any[];
  const clientMap = new Map<string, any>();
  for (const c of allClients) {
    clientMap.set(c.id, c);
  }

  const limits = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM monthly_burden_limits WHERE target_month = ?`).all(targetMonth) as any[];
  const limitMap = new Map<string, any>();
  for (const l of limits) {
    limitMap.set(l.client_id, l);
  }

  const activePlans = db.prepare(`
    SELECT client_id, start_date, end_date FROM support_plans 
    WHERE status = 'active' AND deleted_at IS NULL
  `).all() as any[];

  for (const att of attendance) {
    const client = clientMap.get(att.client_id);
    const clientName = client?.full_name || '未登録利用者';
    const actualDays = att.present_days + att.out_facility_days;
    totalFacilityAllDays += actualDays;
    totalFacilityOffsiteDays += att.out_facility_days;

    if (!client) {
      addIssue('error', `勤怠データに紐付く利用者情報が見つかりません (ID: ${att.client_id})。`, 'マスタ整合性');
      continue;
    }

    // A. 受給者証番号チェック（半角数字10桁必須: 国保連K002/K003返戻防止）
    const recipNum = client.recipient_number ? client.recipient_number.trim() : '';
    if (!recipNum || !/^\d{10}$/.test(recipNum)) {
      addIssue('error', `${clientName} 様の受給者証番号（${recipNum || '未入力'}）が半角数字10桁ではありません。国保連伝送で即時返戻となります。`, '受給者証');
    }

    // B. 受給者証の有効期限切れチェック（国保連K001返戻防止）
    if (client.valid_to) {
      const monthStart = `${targetMonth}-01`;
      if (client.valid_to < monthStart) {
        addIssue('error', `${clientName} 様の受給者証有効期限（${client.valid_to}）が請求対象月（${targetMonth}）より前に切れています。市町村での更新確認が必要です。`, '有効期限');
      }
    } else {
      addIssue('warning', `${clientName} 様の受給者証有効期限（終了日）が未登録です。`, '有効期限');
    }

    // C. 契約支給量（月間利用日数上限）オーバーチェック（国保連超過返戻防止）
    if (client.allowance_days && client.allowance_days > 0) {
      if (actualDays > client.allowance_days) {
        addIssue('error', `${clientName} 様の利用日数（${actualDays}日）が契約支給量（${client.allowance_days}日/月）を超過しています。自治体への増量申請または日数の調整が必要です。`, '支給量超過');
      }
    }

    // D. 個別支援計画の未作成・期限切れ警告（未作成減算 告示: 1〜2ヶ月目30%減、3ヶ月目以降50%減の事前告知）
    const uncreatedMonths = getPlanUncreatedMonthsSync(client.id, targetMonth);
    if (uncreatedMonths > 0 && actualDays > 0) {
      const reductionText = uncreatedMonths >= 3 
        ? `未作成3ヶ月目以降（基本報酬50%減）` 
        : `未作成1〜2ヶ月目（基本報酬30%減）`;
      addIssue('warning', `${clientName} 様の有効な個別支援計画がありません。当月は「個別支援計画未作成減算（${reductionText}）」が適用されます。`, '個別支援計画');
    }

    // E. 負担上限額管理の未済チェック
    if (client.payment_limit && client.payment_limit > 0) {
      const limitRecord = limitMap.get(client.id);
      if (!limitRecord) {
        addIssue('warning', `${clientName} 様（負担上限月額: ${client.payment_limit.toLocaleString()}円）の「上限額管理」の計算・保存が完了していません。`, '上限額管理');
      }
    }

    // F. 市区町村コードの未設定チェック
    if (!client.city_code && !defaultCityCode) {
      addIssue('error', `${clientName} 様の市区町村コードが未登録です。事業所設定または利用者情報で市区町村コードを設定してください。`, '市区町村コード');
    }

    // G. 欠席時対応加算の月4回上限チェック
    if (att.absence_days > 4) {
      addIssue('warning', `${clientName} 様の欠席時対応加算が${att.absence_days}回記録されています（国保連算定上限は月4回のため、4回に丸めて請求されます）。`, '加算算定');
    }
  }

  // 4. 施設外就労の7割（70%）上限規制チェック（厚労省指定基準第191条の2・指定就労継続支援A型）
  // 基準: 「1日あたりの施設外就労利用者数」が「事業所の利用定員」の100分の70（70%）以下であること
  const capacity = parseCapacityFromClass(facility.capacity_class);
  const dailyOffsiteRecords = db.prepare(`
    SELECT record_date, COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) as offsite_count
    FROM attendance_records
    WHERE record_date LIKE ? AND (status = 'out_facility' OR (status = 'present' AND is_offsite = 1)) AND deleted_at IS NULL
    GROUP BY record_date
  `).all(`${targetMonth}%`) as { record_date: string; offsite_count: number }[];

  const maxDailyOffsite = dailyOffsiteRecords.length > 0 
    ? Math.max(...dailyOffsiteRecords.map(r => r.offsite_count)) 
    : 0;

  if (capacity > 0 && maxDailyOffsite > 0) {
    const maxAllowed = Math.floor(capacity * 0.7);
    if (maxDailyOffsite > maxAllowed) {
      const exceededList = dailyOffsiteRecords
        .filter(r => r.offsite_count > maxAllowed)
        .map(r => `${r.record_date} (${r.offsite_count}名)`)
        .join(', ');
      const offsiteRatio = Math.round((maxDailyOffsite / capacity) * 100);
      addIssue('warning', `【実地指導・法令遵守警告】1日あたりの施設外就労利用者数が利用定員（${capacity}名）の70%上限（${maxAllowed}名）を超過している日があります: ${exceededList}（最大定員比: ${offsiteRatio}%）。指定基準第191条の2違反による実地指導での指摘・返還リスクがあるため速やかに是正してください。`, '施設外就労');
    }
  }

  return {
    isReady: errors.length === 0,
    hasErrors: errors.length > 0,
    hasWarnings: warnings.length > 0,
    errors,
    warnings,
    issues,
    clientCount: attendance.length,
    totalDays: totalFacilityAllDays
  };
}

export interface PrintBillingClientItem {
  clientId: string;
  clientName: string;
  recipientNumber: string;
  cityCode: string;
  actualDays: number;
  absenceDays: number;
  effectiveBaseUnit: number;
  baseUnitsTotal: number;
  hasValidPlan: boolean;
  uncreatedMonths: number;
  additions: Array<{
    name: string;
    code: string;
    unit: number;
    count: number;
    total: number;
  }>;
  totalUnits: number;
  totalCost: number;
  userBurden: number;
  billingAmount: number;
}

export interface PrintBillingSummary {
  targetMonth: string;
  facility: {
    facilityNumber: string;
    facilityName: string;
    representativeName: string;
    postalCode: string;
    address: string;
    phone: string;
    cityCode: string;
    regionClass: string;
    areaUnitCost: number;
    standardBaseUnit: number;
  };
  clientCount: number;
  totalDays: number;
  totalUnits: number;
  totalCost: number;
  totalUserBurden: number;
  totalBillingAmount: number;
  clients: PrintBillingClientItem[];
}

export async function getBillingSummaryForPrint(targetMonth: string): Promise<PrintBillingSummary> {
  const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any || {};
  const facilityNumber = facility.facility_number || '2810099999';
  const facilityName = facility.facility_name || '就労継続支援A型事業所';
  const defaultCityCode = facility.city_code || '28100';
  const representativeName = facility.representative_name || facility.facility_manager || '管理者';
  const postalCode = facility.postal_code || '';
  const address = facility.address || '';
  const phone = facility.phone_number || '';
  const regionClass = facility.region_class || 'その他';

  const billingRules = getBillingRules();

  const facilityUnitRow = db.prepare(`
    SELECT base_unit FROM monthly_facility_units WHERE target_month = ?
  `).get(targetMonth) as any;
  const standardBaseUnit = facilityUnitRow?.base_unit || (billingRules['base_unit_standard'] ?? 584);

  const AREA_UNIT_COST = getAreaUnitCost(facility?.region_class);

  const attendanceDays = db.prepare(`
    SELECT client_id, 
           SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'present' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as present_days,
           SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'out_facility' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as out_facility_days,
           SUM(CASE WHEN is_absence_addition = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as absence_addition_days,
           SUM(CASE WHEN meal_provided = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as meal_days,
           SUM(CASE 
             WHEN (COALESCE(pickup_used, 0) + COALESCE(dropoff_used, 0)) > 0 
               THEN COALESCE(pickup_used, 0) + COALESCE(dropoff_used, 0)
             WHEN transportation_used = 1 THEN 1 
             ELSE 0 
           END) as transportation_trips
    FROM attendance_records
    WHERE record_date LIKE ? AND (status IN ('present', 'out_facility') OR is_absence_addition = 1) AND deleted_at IS NULL
    GROUP BY client_id
  `).all(`${targetMonth}%`) as any[];

  const limits = db.prepare(`
    SELECT m.*, c.full_name, c.recipient_number, c.city_code
    FROM monthly_burden_limits m
    JOIN clients c ON m.client_id = c.id
    WHERE m.target_month = ?
  `).all(targetMonth) as any[];

  let totalClientCount = 0;
  let totalDays = 0;
  let totalFacilityUnits = 0;
  let totalCostSum = 0;
  let totalBillingAmount = 0;
  let totalUserBurdenAmount = 0;

  const clientsResult: PrintBillingClientItem[] = [];

  for (const record of attendanceDays) {
    const clientLimit = limits.find(l => l.client_id === record.client_id);
    const clientProfile = db.prepare('SELECT id, full_name, recipient_number, city_code, service_start_date, contract_date, valid_from, valid_to FROM clients WHERE id = ?').get(record.client_id) as any || {};

    const recipientNumber = (clientProfile?.recipient_number || '9999999999').padStart(10, '0');
    const cityCode = clientProfile?.city_code || defaultCityCode;
    const actualDays = record.present_days + record.out_facility_days;
    if (actualDays === 0 && record.absence_addition_days === 0) continue;

    // 個別支援計画未作成減算（告示: 1〜2ヶ月目30%減、3ヶ月目以降50%減）
    const uncreatedMonths = getPlanUncreatedMonthsSync(record.client_id, targetMonth);
    const hasValidPlan = uncreatedMonths === 0;

    let currentUnit = standardBaseUnit;
    if (!hasValidPlan) {
      if (uncreatedMonths >= 3) {
        const severeDed = billingRules['deduction_plan_missing_severe'] ?? 0.50;
        currentUnit = Math.floor(currentUnit * (1.0 - severeDed)); // 3ヶ月目以降: 50%減算
      } else {
        const planDed = billingRules['deduction_plan_missing'] ?? 0.30;
        currentUnit = Math.floor(currentUnit * (1.0 - planDed)); // 1〜2ヶ月目: 30%減算
      }
    }
    if (facility.has_capacity_reduction === 1) {
      const capDed = billingRules['deduction_capacity'] ?? 0.30;
      currentUnit = Math.floor(currentUnit * (1.0 - capDed));
    }
    if (facility.has_staffing_reduction === 1) {
      const staffDed = billingRules['deduction_staffing'] ?? 0.30;
      currentUnit = Math.floor(currentUnit * (1.0 - staffDed));
    }
    // 身体拘束適正化未実施減算 (所定単位数の3%減算: 令和6年度報酬改定法定率)
    if (facility.has_restraint_reduction === 0) {
      const resDed = billingRules['deduction_restraint'] ?? 0.03;
      currentUnit = Math.floor(currentUnit * (1.0 - resDed));
    }
    if (facility.has_abuse_prevention === 0) {
      const abuseDed = billingRules['deduction_abuse'] ?? 0.01;
      currentUnit = Math.floor(currentUnit * (1.0 - abuseDed));
    }
    if (facility.has_bcp === 0) {
      const bcpDed = billingRules['deduction_bcp'] ?? 0.01;
      currentUnit = Math.floor(currentUnit * (1.0 - bcpDed));
    }
    if (facility.has_information_disclosure === 0) {
      const discDed = billingRules['deduction_disclosure'] ?? 0.05;
      currentUnit = Math.floor(currentUnit * (1.0 - discDed));
    }

    // サービス管理責任者欠如減算（告示: 翌々月〜4ヶ月目: 30%減、5ヶ月目以降: 50%減）
    const smShortageMonths = facility.service_manager_shortage_months ?? 0;
    if (smShortageMonths >= 2) {
      const smShortageRate = smShortageMonths >= 5 
        ? (billingRules['deduction_service_manager_severe'] ?? 0.50)
        : (billingRules['deduction_service_manager'] ?? 0.30);
      currentUnit = Math.floor(currentUnit * (1.0 - smShortageRate));
    }

    const minAllowedUnit = Math.floor(standardBaseUnit * 0.1);
    const effectiveBaseUnit = Math.max(minAllowedUnit, currentUnit);

    let clientTotalUnits = 0;
    const additions: Array<{ name: string; code: string; unit: number; count: number; total: number }> = [];

    let baseUnitsTotal = 0;
    if (actualDays > 0) {
      baseUnitsTotal = actualDays * effectiveBaseUnit;
      clientTotalUnits += baseUnitsTotal;
    }

    // 加算内訳（DBマスター動的適用）
    const safeAbsenceDays = Math.min(4, record.absence_addition_days);
    if (safeAbsenceDays > 0) {
      const u = billingRules['absence_addition'] ?? 94;
      const t = safeAbsenceDays * u;
      clientTotalUnits += t;
      additions.push({ name: '欠席時対応加算', code: '5871', unit: u, count: safeAbsenceDays, total: t });
    }

    const startDateStr = clientProfile?.contract_date || clientProfile?.service_start_date;
    if (startDateStr && actualDays > 0) {
      const monthAttRecords = db.prepare(`
        SELECT record_date FROM attendance_records
        WHERE client_id = ? AND record_date LIKE ? AND status IN ('present', 'out_facility') AND deleted_at IS NULL
      `).all(record.client_id, `${targetMonth}-%`) as any[];
      
      let initialDays = 0;
      const [sy, sm, sd] = startDateStr.slice(0, 10).split('-').map(Number);
      const sTime = new Date(sy, sm - 1, sd).getTime();

      for (const att of monthAttRecords) {
        const [ay, am, ad] = att.record_date.slice(0, 10).split('-').map(Number);
        const aTime = new Date(ay, am - 1, ad).getTime();
        const diffDays = Math.round((aTime - sTime) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
        if (diffDays >= 0 && diffDays < 30) {
          initialDays++;
        }
      }
      if (initialDays > 0) {
        const u = billingRules['initial_addition'] ?? 30;
        const t = initialDays * u;
        clientTotalUnits += t;
        additions.push({ name: '初期加算', code: '6101', unit: u, count: initialDays, total: t });
      }
    }

    if (facility.welfare_specialist_addition && facility.welfare_specialist_addition !== 'none' && actualDays > 0) {
      let specUnit = billingRules['welfare_specialist_1'] ?? 15;
      let specCode = '6200';
      let specName = '福祉専門職員配置等加算(Ⅰ)';
      if (facility.welfare_specialist_addition === 'specialist_2') {
        specUnit = billingRules['welfare_specialist_2'] ?? 10; specCode = '6201'; specName = '福祉専門職員配置等加算(Ⅱ)';
      } else if (facility.welfare_specialist_addition === 'specialist_3') {
        specUnit = billingRules['welfare_specialist_3'] ?? 6; specCode = '6202'; specName = '福祉専門職員配置等加算(Ⅲ)';
      }
      const t = actualDays * specUnit;
      clientTotalUnits += t;
      additions.push({ name: specName, code: specCode, unit: specUnit, count: actualDays, total: t });
    }

    const wageUnit = billingRules['wage_improvement'] ?? 0;
    if (wageUnit > 0 && facility.wage_improvement_addition === 1 && actualDays > 0) {
      const t = actualDays * wageUnit;
      clientTotalUnits += t;
      additions.push({ name: '賃金向上達成指導員配置加算', code: '6300', unit: wageUnit, count: actualDays, total: t });
    }

    if (facility.visual_auditory_addition && facility.visual_auditory_addition !== 'none' && actualDays > 0) {
      const u = billingRules['visual_auditory_addition'] ?? 41;
      const t = actualDays * u;
      clientTotalUnits += t;
      additions.push({ name: '視覚・聴覚言語障害者支援体制加算', code: '6600', unit: u, count: actualDays, total: t });
    }

    if (facility.higher_brain_addition === 1 && actualDays > 0) {
      const u = billingRules['higher_brain_addition'] ?? 41;
      const t = actualDays * u;
      clientTotalUnits += t;
      additions.push({ name: '高次脳機能障害者支援体制加算', code: '6601', unit: u, count: actualDays, total: t });
    }

    if (facility.severe_disability_addition && facility.severe_disability_addition !== 'none' && actualDays > 0) {
      const severeUnit = facility.severe_disability_addition === 'severe_2' 
        ? (billingRules['severe_disability_2'] ?? 23) 
        : (billingRules['severe_disability_1'] ?? 47);
      const severeCode = facility.severe_disability_addition === 'severe_2' ? '6801' : '6800';
      const severeName = facility.severe_disability_addition === 'severe_2' ? '重度障害者支援加算(Ⅱ)' : '重度障害者支援加算(Ⅰ)';
      const t = actualDays * severeUnit;
      clientTotalUnits += t;
      additions.push({ name: severeName, code: severeCode, unit: severeUnit, count: actualDays, total: t });
    }

    if (facility.meal_provision_addition === 1 && record.meal_days > 0) {
      const u = billingRules['meal_addition'] ?? 30;
      const t = record.meal_days * u;
      clientTotalUnits += t;
      additions.push({ name: '食事提供体制加算', code: '5441', unit: u, count: record.meal_days, total: t });
    }

    const totalTransTrips = record.transportation_trips || 0;
    if (facility.transportation_addition && facility.transportation_addition !== 'none' && totalTransTrips > 0) {
      const u = billingRules['transportation_addition'] ?? 21;
      const t = totalTransTrips * u;
      clientTotalUnits += t;
      additions.push({ name: '送迎加算', code: '6500', unit: u, count: totalTransTrips, total: t });
    }

    // 処遇改善新加算（令和6年6月施行新加算Ⅰ〜Ⅴ率をDBから動的取得）
    if (facility.treatment_addition_class && facility.treatment_addition_class !== 'なし') {
      const tClass = facility.treatment_addition_class;
      let rate = 0;
      let tCode = '6111';
      let tName = '福祉・介護職員処遇改善新加算(Ⅰ)';
      if (tClass.includes('Ⅰ')) { rate = billingRules['treatment_rate_new_1'] ?? 0.096; tCode = '6111'; tName = '処遇改善新加算(Ⅰ)'; }
      else if (tClass.includes('Ⅱ')) { rate = billingRules['treatment_rate_new_2'] ?? 0.094; tCode = '6112'; tName = '処遇改善新加算(Ⅱ)'; }
      else if (tClass.includes('Ⅲ')) { rate = billingRules['treatment_rate_new_3'] ?? 0.079; tCode = '6113'; tName = '処遇改善新加算(Ⅲ)'; }
      else if (tClass.includes('Ⅳ')) { rate = billingRules['treatment_rate_new_4'] ?? 0.063; tCode = '6114'; tName = '処遇改善新加算(Ⅳ)'; }
      else if (tClass.includes('Ⅴ')) { rate = billingRules['treatment_rate_new_5'] ?? 0; tCode = '6115'; tName = '処遇改善新加算(Ⅴ)'; }

      if (rate > 0 && clientTotalUnits > 0) {
        const treatUnits = Math.round(clientTotalUnits * rate);
        clientTotalUnits += treatUnits;
        additions.push({ name: tName, code: tCode, unit: treatUnits, count: 1, total: treatUnits });
      }
    }

    const totalCost = Math.floor(clientTotalUnits * AREA_UNIT_COST);
    const userBurden = clientLimit?.calculated_our_burden ?? 0;
    const billingAmount = totalCost - userBurden;

    totalClientCount++;
    totalDays += actualDays;
    totalFacilityUnits += clientTotalUnits;
    totalCostSum += totalCost;
    totalBillingAmount += billingAmount;
    totalUserBurdenAmount += userBurden;

    clientsResult.push({
      clientId: record.client_id,
      clientName: clientProfile?.full_name || '利用者名未設定',
      recipientNumber,
      cityCode,
      actualDays,
      absenceDays: safeAbsenceDays,
      effectiveBaseUnit,
      baseUnitsTotal,
      hasValidPlan,
      uncreatedMonths,
      additions,
      totalUnits: clientTotalUnits,
      totalCost,
      userBurden,
      billingAmount
    });
  }

  return {
    targetMonth,
    facility: {
      facilityNumber,
      facilityName,
      representativeName,
      postalCode,
      address,
      phone,
      cityCode: defaultCityCode,
      regionClass,
      areaUnitCost: AREA_UNIT_COST,
      standardBaseUnit
    },
    clientCount: totalClientCount,
    totalDays,
    totalUnits: totalFacilityUnits,
    totalCost: totalCostSum,
    totalUserBurden: totalUserBurdenAmount,
    totalBillingAmount: totalBillingAmount,
    clients: clientsResult
  };
}

'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { calculateBurden, BurdenResult } from "@/lib/billing/burdenCalculator";
import { saveBurdenLimit } from "../actions";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ChevronLeft, Calculator, Save, AlertTriangle, ShieldCheck, Printer } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

const getDefaultTargetMonth = () => {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setMonth(d.getMonth() - 1);
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
};

export default function BurdenClient({ initialClients }: { initialClients: any[] }) {
  const [clients] = useState<any[]>(initialClients);
  const [selectedClientId, setSelectedClientId] = useState<string>("");
  const [targetMonth, setTargetMonth] = useState(getDefaultTargetMonth);
  
  const [paymentLimit, setPaymentLimit] = useState(4600);
  const [ourCost, setOurCost] = useState(30000); // UIテスト用初期値
  const [otherCost, setOtherCost] = useState(0);
  
  const [result, setResult] = useState<BurdenResult | null>(null);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [saveSuccess, setSaveSuccess] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (clients && clients.length > 0) {
      handleClientSelect(clients[0].id, clients);
    }
  }, [clients]);

  const handleClientSelect = (id: string, list = clients) => {
    setSelectedClientId(id);
    const target = list.find(c => c.id === id);
    if (target) {
      setPaymentLimit(target.payment_limit || 0);
    }
    setResult(null);
    setSaveSuccess(false);
  };

  const handleCalculate = () => {
    const res = calculateBurden({
      payment_limit: paymentLimit,
      our_total_cost: ourCost,
      other_total_cost: otherCost
    });
    setResult(res);
    setSaveSuccess(false);
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!result || !selectedClientId) return;
    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await saveBurdenLimit(selectedClientId, targetMonth, {
        is_manager: false,
        our_total_cost: ourCost,
        other_total_cost: otherCost,
        calculated_our_burden: result.our_burden
      });
      if (res.success) {
        setSaveSuccess(true);
      } else {
        alert(res.error);
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      alert("保存エラーが発生しました: " + e.message);
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
      <main className="flex-1 p-3.5 sm:p-6 md:p-12">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-5xl space-y-6">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
              <Link href="/billing" className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "icon" }))}>
                <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
              </Link>
              <div>
                <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">利用者負担額の計算</h1>
                <p className="mt-2 text-sm sm:text-base text-muted-foreground">
                  他の事業所の利用金額を入力すると、1ヶ月の自己負担上限額を超えないように、自社で請求する金額を自動で計算します。
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
            <Link 
              href={`/billing/burden/print?clientId=${selectedClientId}&month=${targetMonth}`}
              className={cn(
                buttonVariants({ variant: "outline" }),
                "gap-1.5 border-slate-300 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-800 shadow-xs font-bold shrink-0 self-start sm:self-auto text-xs"
              )}
            >
              <Printer className="h-4 w-4 text-slate-600" />
              上限額管理結果票を印刷 (様式第4)
            </Link>
          </div>

          <div className="grid lg:grid-cols-[1fr_400px] gap-6 items-start">
            {/* 左側: 入力エリア */}
            <Card className="shadow-sm">
              <CardHeader className="bg-primary/5 border-b pb-4">
                <CardTitle className="text-xl flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Calculator className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
                  実績の入力
                </CardTitle>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="pt-6 space-y-6">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <Label className="font-bold">対象の利用者</Label>
                    <select 
                      className="flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background"
                      value={selectedClientId} 
                      onChange={e => handleClientSelect(e.target.value)}
                    >
                      {clients.length === 0 && <option value="">利用者が登録されていません</option>}
                      {clients.map(c => (
                        <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.full_name}</option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <Label className="font-bold">対象年月</Label>
                    <Input type="month" value={targetMonth} onChange={e => setTargetMonth(e.target.value)} />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="p-4 bg-muted/20 rounded-md border flex items-center justify-between">
                  <p className="text-sm font-bold text-muted-foreground">受給者証の負担上限月額</p>
                  <p className="text-2xl font-bold text-foreground">¥{paymentLimit.toLocaleString()}</p>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-6 pt-2">
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <Label className="font-bold text-base">自事業所の利用総費用 (円) <span className="text-primary text-sm font-normal ml-2">※テスト用手入力</span></Label>
                    <Input type="number" className="text-lg h-12" value={ourCost} onChange={e => setOurCost(Number(e.target.value))} />
                    <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">※本来は「サービス提供実績モジュール」から自動集計されますが、今回は直接金額を入力します。</p>
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <Label className="font-bold text-base">他事業所の利用総費用合算 (円)</Label>
                    <Input type="number" className="text-lg h-12" value={otherCost} onChange={e => setOtherCost(Number(e.target.value))} />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <Button className="w-full h-14 text-lg font-bold mt-4" onClick={handleCalculate}>
                  負担額を計算する
                </Button>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            {/* 右側: 結果エリア */}
            {result && (
              <Card className="shadow-sm border-primary/50 bg-primary/5">
                <CardHeader className="pb-4 border-b border-primary/10">
                  <CardTitle className="text-xl text-primary">計算結果</CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent className="pt-6 space-y-6">
                  {result.is_over_limit ? (
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-2 p-4 bg-amber-100/50 border border-amber-200 text-amber-900 rounded-md text-sm font-medium leading-relaxed">
                      <AlertTriangle className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-amber-600 mt-0.5" />
                      <div>
                        1割負担の合計が上限額を<b>超えました</b>。各事業所の利用金額の割合に応じて、請求額が自動で調整されました。
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div className="flex items-start gap-2 p-4 bg-green-100/50 border border-green-200 text-green-900 rounded-md text-sm font-medium leading-relaxed">
                      <ShieldCheck className="h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-green-600 mt-0.5" />
                      <div>
                        上限額に達していないため、通常通り総費用の1割がそのまま自己負担額となります。
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  <div className="space-y-4 pt-2">
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-sm">
                      <span className="text-muted-foreground">全体の総費用 (10割)</span>
                      <span className="font-medium text-lg">¥{result.total_cost.toLocaleString()}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-sm">
                      <span className="text-muted-foreground">本来の合計負担額 (1割)</span>
                      <span className="font-medium text-lg">¥{result.total_burden.toLocaleString()}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="my-4 border-t-2 border-dashed border-primary/20"></div>
                    <div>
                      <span className="font-bold text-foreground block mb-2 text-sm text-primary">自事業所の最終請求額（自己負担分）</span>
                      <div className="text-5xl font-extrabold text-primary text-right">
                        ¥{result.our_burden.toLocaleString()}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="pt-6 space-y-3">
                    <Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={isSaving || saveSuccess} className="w-full h-14 text-lg font-bold shadow-sm">
                      {saveSuccess ? "保存完了" : isSaving ? "保存中..." : (
                        <>
                          <Save className="mr-2 h-5 w-5" />
                          結果をデータベースに保存
                        </>
                      )}
                    </Button>

                    <Link 
                      href={`/billing/burden/print?clientId=${selectedClientId}&month=${targetMonth}`}
                      className={cn(
                        buttonVariants({ variant: "outline" }),
                        "w-full h-12 text-sm font-bold border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
                      )}
                    >
                      <Printer className="h-4 w-4 text-slate-700" />
                      上限額管理結果票を印刷 (様式第4)
                    </Link>
                  </div>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </main>
  );
}

'use client';

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

export function BurdenPrintNav({ 
  clients, 
  currentClientId,

}: { 
  clients: any[];

}) {

    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3">
      {/* 利用者セレクタ */}

          value={currentClientId}

        >
          {clients.map(c => (
            <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
              {c.full_name} (上限: ¥{(c.payment_limit || 0).toLocaleString()})
            </option>
          ))}
        </select>
      </div>

      {/* 対象年月セレクタ */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-slate-600 font-medium">
        <span>対象年月:</span>
        <input 
          type="month" 
          value={currentMonth} 
          onChange={handleMonthChange}
          className="rounded border border-slate-300 bg-white px-2 py-1 text-xs text-slate-800 shadow-xs focus:border-slate-500 focus:outline-none"
        />
      </div>

      {/* 印刷実行ボタン */}
      <Button 
        onClick={() => window.print()}
        className="gap-1.5 bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 shadow-xs"
        size="sm"
      >
        <Printer className="h-4 w-4" />
        結果票を印刷 (A4縦)
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}
