import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Printer, ChevronLeft } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { BurdenPrintNav } from "./BurdenPrintNav";
import { AutoFitText } from "@/components/AutoFitText";

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

export default async function BurdenPrintPage({ 
  searchParams 
}: { 
  searchParams: Promise<{ month?: string; clientId?: string }> 
}) {
  const params = await searchParams;
  const today = new Date();
  const defaultMonth = `${today.getFullYear()}-${String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  const targetMonth = params.month || defaultMonth;
  const selectedClientId = params.clientId || "";

  const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any || {};
  const clients = db.prepare(`
    SELECT * FROM clients 
    WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (status IS NULL OR status = 'active')
    ORDER BY full_name ASC
  `).all() as any[];

  // 選択された利用者または上限管理データが存在する利用者
  const targetClient = selectedClientId 
    ? clients.find(c => c.id === selectedClientId)
    : clients[0];

  let burdenRecord: any = null;
  if (targetClient) {
    burdenRecord = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM monthly_burden_limits
      WHERE client_id = ? AND target_month = ?
    `).get(targetClient.id, targetMonth) as any;
  }

  const [yearStr, monthStr] = targetMonth.split('-');
  const year = parseInt(yearStr, 10);
  const month = parseInt(monthStr, 10);
  const warekiYear = year >= 2019 ? `令和${year - 2018}` : `平成${year - 1988}`;

  // 計算値の整理
  const paymentLimit = targetClient?.payment_limit || 0;
  const ourCost = burdenRecord?.our_total_cost ?? 30000;
  const otherCost = burdenRecord?.other_total_cost ?? 0;
  const totalCost = ourCost + otherCost;
  const ourBurdenPre = Math.floor(ourCost * 0.1);
  const otherBurdenPre = Math.floor(otherCost * 0.1);
  const totalBurdenPre = ourBurdenPre + otherBurdenPre;

  // 上限管理後の負担額
  const ourBurdenPost = burdenRecord?.calculated_our_burden ?? (totalBurdenPre > paymentLimit ? Math.round(paymentLimit * (ourCost / (totalCost || 1))) : ourBurdenPre);
  const otherBurdenPost = totalBurdenPre > paymentLimit ? (paymentLimit - ourBurdenPost) : otherBurdenPre;
  const totalBurdenPost = ourBurdenPost + otherBurdenPost;

  // 管理結果区分判定
  let resultCategory = "2"; // 1: 管理事業所のみで上限到達, 2: 合計が上限額以下, 3: 按分決定
  let resultCategoryLabel = "２．各事業所の負担額の合算が上限月額以下のため、調整なし";
  if (totalBurdenPre > paymentLimit) {
    if (ourBurdenPre >= paymentLimit) {
      resultCategory = "1";
      resultCategoryLabel = "１．管理事業所の負担額のみで上限月額に達したため、他事業所の負担額は０円";
    } else {
      resultCategory = "3";
      resultCategoryLabel = "３．各事業所の費用額の割合に応じて按分計算し、各事業所の負担額を決定した";
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-100 text-slate-900 print:bg-white print:p-0">
      {/* 印刷コントロールバー */}
      <header className="sticky top-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-between border-b bg-white/95 px-6 py-3 shadow-sm backdrop-blur print:hidden">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <Link href="/billing/burden">
            <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="gap-1 text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900">
              <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
              上限額計算へ戻る
            </Button>
          </Link>
          <div className="h-4 w-px bg-slate-200" />
          <h1 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-800">
            利用者負担上限額管理結果票 印刷 ({warekiYear}年{month}月分)
          </h1>
        </div>

        <BurdenPrintNav 
          clients={clients} 
          currentClientId={targetClient?.id || ''} 
          currentMonth={targetMonth} 
        />
      </header>

      {/* 印刷プレビュー領域 */}
      <main className="p-4 md:p-8 print:p-0">
        <style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: `
          @page {
            size: A4 portrait;
            margin: 6mm 10mm;
          }
          @media print {
            body {
              background: white !important;
              color: black !important;
              -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
              print-color-adjust: exact;
            }
            header, nav, .print\\:hidden {
              display: none !important;
            }
            tr {
              page-break-inside: avoid !important;
              break-inside: avoid !important;
            }
          }
        `}} />

        {targetClient ? (
          <div className="mx-auto max-w-[800px] rounded-lg border border-slate-300 bg-white p-6 shadow-sm print:border-none print:p-0 print:shadow-none print:max-h-[270mm] print:overflow-hidden">
            {/* 帳票ヘッダー */}
            <div className="text-center pb-1">
              <div className="text-right text-[10px] font-mono text-slate-500">別紙様式第四（第十七条関係）</div>
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 mt-0.5">
                利用者負担上限額管理結果票
              </h2>
              <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 mt-0.5">
                （対象年月: {warekiYear}年 {month}月分）
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* 市区町村長・利用者殿への案内 & 管理事業所情報 */}
            <div className="mt-3 grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-xs">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div>
                  <div className="font-bold border-b border-slate-400 pb-0.5 inline-block">
                    {targetClient.city_code ? `市区町村長（コード: ${targetClient.city_code}）` : '支給決定市区町村長'} 殿
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-1 font-bold border-b border-slate-400 pb-0.5 block">
                    関係事業所 殿
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-1 flex items-center gap-1">
                    <span className="font-bold shrink-0">利用者:</span>
                    <div className="border-b border-slate-400 pb-0.5 max-w-[200px]">
                      <AutoFitText text={`${targetClient.full_name} 殿`} maxFontSizePt={11} minFontSizePt={8} className="font-bold" />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-600 leading-relaxed">
                  障害者の日常生活及び社会生活を総合的に支援するための法律の規定に基づき、利用者負担上限額管理を行った結果を下記のとおり通知します。
                </p>
              </div>

              {/* 管理事業所情報・印鑑欄 */}
              <div className="border border-slate-400 p-2.5 rounded text-[10.5px] flex justify-between">
                <div className="space-y-0.5 flex-1 mr-2">
                  <div className="font-bold text-slate-700 text-[11px]">【上限額管理事業所】</div>
                  <div>事業所番号: <span className="font-mono font-bold">{facility.facility_number || '2810099999'}</span></div>
                  <div className="max-w-[220px]">
                    <AutoFitText text={facility.facility_name || '就労継続支援A型事業所'} maxFontSizePt={10} minFontSizePt={7} className="font-bold" />
                  </div>
                  <div>代表者: {facility.representative_name || facility.facility_manager || '管理者'}</div>
                  <div className="text-[9.5px] text-slate-600">
                    <AutoFitText text={facility.address || ''} maxFontSizePt={9.5} minFontSizePt={6.5} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[9.5px] text-slate-600">TEL: {facility.phone_number}</div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-center self-center shrink-0 ml-1">
                  <div className="border border-slate-400 bg-slate-50 px-2 py-0 text-[8px] font-bold">管理者印</div>
                  <div className="h-11 w-11 border-b border-l border-r border-slate-400 flex items-center justify-center text-[9px] text-slate-400">印</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* 利用者受給者情報 */}
            <div className="mt-3 border border-slate-400 text-xs">
              <table className="w-full border-collapse">
                <tbody>
                  <tr className="border-b border-slate-400">
                    <td className="bg-slate-100 p-1.5 font-bold w-28 border-r border-slate-400 text-center">受給者証番号</td>
                    <td className="p-1.5 font-mono font-bold text-sm w-44 border-r border-slate-400">{targetClient.recipient_number || '未設定'}</td>
                    <td className="bg-slate-100 p-1.5 font-bold w-28 border-r border-slate-400 text-center">利用者氏名</td>
                    <td className="p-1.5 font-bold text-sm">
                      <AutoFitText text={targetClient.full_name} maxFontSizePt={11} minFontSizePt={8} />
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                  <tr>
                    <td className="bg-slate-100 p-1.5 font-bold border-r border-slate-400 text-center">負担上限月額</td>
                    <td className="p-1.5 font-mono font-black text-sm text-slate-900 border-r border-slate-400">
                      ¥{paymentLimit.toLocaleString()}
                    </td>
                    <td className="bg-slate-100 p-1.5 font-bold border-r border-slate-400 text-center">生年月日</td>
                    <td className="p-1.5 text-slate-700">{targetClient.birth_date || '未登録'}</td>
                  </tr>
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>

            {/* 管理結果区分 */}
            <div className="mt-3 border border-slate-400 p-2 bg-slate-50 text-xs">
              <div className="font-bold text-slate-800 mb-0.5">【上限額管理結果の区分】</div>
              <div className="font-bold text-xs text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="inline-block bg-slate-800 text-white rounded-full w-4 h-4 text-center leading-4 text-[10px] font-mono shrink-0">
                  {resultCategory}
                </span>
                <span>{resultCategoryLabel}</span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* 事業所別内訳表 */}
            <div className="mt-3">
              <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800 mb-1">【事業所別 負担額及び管理結果内訳】</div>
              <table className="w-full border-collapse border border-slate-400 text-xs">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 text-center">
                    <th className="border border-slate-400 p-1.5 font-bold w-20">区分</th>
                    <th className="border border-slate-400 p-1.5 font-bold">事業所名</th>
                    <th className="border border-slate-400 p-1.5 font-bold w-28">事業所番号</th>
                    <th className="border border-slate-400 p-1.5 font-bold w-24">総費用額(10割)</th>
                    <th className="border border-slate-400 p-1.5 font-bold w-24">本来の負担額(1割)</th>
                    <th className="border border-slate-400 p-1.5 font-bold w-28 bg-slate-200">管理結果額(自己負担)</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {/* 管理事業所行 */}
                  <tr>
                    <td className="border border-slate-400 p-1.5 text-center font-bold bg-slate-50">管理事業所</td>
                    <td className="border border-slate-400 p-1.5 font-medium">
                      <AutoFitText text={facility.facility_name || '就労継続支援A型事業所'} maxFontSizePt={9.5} minFontSizePt={7} />
                    </td>
                    <td className="border border-slate-400 p-1.5 text-center font-mono">{facility.facility_number || '2810099999'}</td>
                    <td className="border border-slate-400 p-1.5 text-right font-mono">¥{ourCost.toLocaleString()}</td>
                    <td className="border border-slate-400 p-1.5 text-right font-mono">¥{ourBurdenPre.toLocaleString()}</td>
                    <td className="border border-slate-400 p-1.5 text-right font-mono font-black text-sm bg-slate-100">
                      ¥{ourBurdenPost.toLocaleString()}
                    </td>
                  </tr>

                  {/* 関係事業所行 */}
                  <tr>
                    <td className="border border-slate-400 p-1.5 text-center font-bold bg-slate-50">関係事業所</td>
                    <td className="border border-slate-400 p-1.5 font-medium text-slate-700">他事業所合算</td>
                    <td className="border border-slate-400 p-1.5 text-center font-mono text-slate-500">-</td>
                    <td className="border border-slate-400 p-1.5 text-right font-mono">¥{otherCost.toLocaleString()}</td>
                    <td className="border border-slate-400 p-1.5 text-right font-mono">¥{otherBurdenPre.toLocaleString()}</td>
                    <td className="border border-slate-400 p-1.5 text-right font-mono font-bold text-sm bg-slate-100">
                      ¥{otherBurdenPost.toLocaleString()}
                    </td>
                  </tr>

                  {/* 合計行 */}
                  <tr className="bg-slate-100 font-bold border-t-2 border-slate-500">
                    <td colSpan={3} className="border border-slate-400 p-1.5 text-center">合計</td>
                    <td className="border border-slate-400 p-1.5 text-right font-mono font-bold">¥{totalCost.toLocaleString()}</td>
                    <td className="border border-slate-400 p-1.5 text-right font-mono font-bold">¥{totalBurdenPre.toLocaleString()}</td>
                    <td className="border border-slate-400 p-1.5 text-right font-mono font-black text-sm bg-slate-200">
                      ¥{totalBurdenPost.toLocaleString()}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>

            {/* 備考・注意書き */}
            <div className="mt-4 border-t border-slate-300 pt-2 text-[9.5px] text-slate-500 space-y-0.5">
              <p>※1. 関係事業所は、本結果票に基づき、管理結果額に記載された金額を利用者に請求してください。</p>
              <p>※2. 管理事業所は、本結果票の写しを市区町村に提出する請求明細書に添付してください（国保連電子伝送DATA01.CSVの73レコードとして伝送されます）。</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="text-center p-12 text-slate-500">
            対象の利用者が見つかりません。
          </div>
        )}
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}


================================================================================

'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { 
  CheckCircle2, AlertCircle, Lock, Unlock, ArrowRight, 
  Download, Calendar, ShieldCheck, FileSpreadsheet, Calculator, FileText, Check, AlertTriangle 
} from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { lockBillingMonth, unlockBillingMonth } from "../actions";

interface Props {
  initialMonth: string;
  isLocked: boolean;
  lockedAt?: string | null;
  readiness: {
    isReady: boolean;
    hasErrors: boolean;
    hasWarnings: boolean;
    errors: string[];
    warnings: string[];
    clientCount: number;
    totalDays: number;
  };
  payrollStats: {
    totalClients: number;
    isWageCompliant: boolean;
  };
}

export function MonthlyClosingWizard({
  initialMonth,
  isLocked: initialIsLocked,
  lockedAt,
  readiness,
  payrollStats
}: Props) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [month, setMonth] = useState(initialMonth);
  const [isLocked, setIsLocked] = useState(initialIsLocked);
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setIsLocked(initialIsLocked);
  }, [initialIsLocked]);

  useEffect(() => {
    setMonth(initialMonth);
  }, [initialMonth]);

  const handleMonthChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const newMonth = e.target.value;
    setMonth(newMonth);
    router.push(`/billing?month=${newMonth}`);
  };

  const handleToggleLock = async () => {
    setIsProcessing(true);
    try {
      if (isLocked) {
        const res = await unlockBillingMonth(month, "管理者による月次再確認・修正作業");
        if (res.success) {
          setIsLocked(false);
          toast.success(`${month}月の月次確定ロックを解除しました`);
          router.refresh();
        } else {
          toast.error((res as any).error || (res as any).message || "ロック解除に失敗しました");
        }
      } else {
        const res = await lockBillingMonth(month);
        if (res.success) {
          setIsLocked(true);
          toast.success(`${month}月の請求データを月次確定ロックしました`);
          router.refresh();
        } else {
          toast.error((res as any).error || (res as any).message || "ロックに失敗しました");
        }
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast.error(e.message || "エラーが発生しました");
    }
    setIsProcessing(false);
  };

  // 各ステップのステータス
  const step1Status = !readiness.hasErrors;
  const step2Status = payrollStats.isWageCompliant;
  const step3Status = true; // 上限額管理
  const step4Status = readiness.isReady;
  const step5Status = isLocked;

  return (
    <Card className={`border-2 transition-all shadow-sm ${isLocked ? 'border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50/20' : 'border-primary/30 bg-primary/2'}`}>
      <CardHeader className="pb-4 border-b">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
              <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-primary/10 text-primary border-primary/30 text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5 font-bold">
                月次請求業務 ステップガイド
              </Badge>
              {isLocked ? (
                <Badge className="bg-emerald-600 text-white text-xs gap-1">
                  <Lock className="w-3 h-3" /> 当月データ確定ロック中
                </Badge>
              ) : (
                <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs gap-1">
                  <Unlock className="w-3 h-3 text-amber-600" /> 未ロック（編集中）
                </Badge>
              )}
            </div>
            <CardTitle className="text-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2 text-foreground">
              <span>{month}度 月次請求・決算統合ウィザード</span>
            </CardTitle>
            <CardDescription className="text-xs mt-1">
              勤怠締めから給与確定、上限額管理、国保連請求CSV、月次確定ロックまでを順を追って完了させます。
            </CardDescription>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-card p-1.5 rounded-lg border shadow-2xs self-start sm:self-auto">
            <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground ml-1" />
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground">対象月:</span>
            <Input
              type="month"
              value={month}
              onChange={handleMonthChange}
              className="h-8 w-36 text-xs font-medium"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </CardHeader>

      <CardContent className="pt-6 space-y-6">
        {/* ステップ進捗インジケーター */}
        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-5 gap-3 text-xs">
          
          {/* Step 1: 勤怠診断 */}
          <div className={`p-3 rounded-lg border flex flex-col justify-between space-y-2 transition-all ${
            step1Status ? 'bg-emerald-50/60 border-emerald-200' : 'bg-red-50/60 border-red-200'
          }`}>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-bold">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Step 1</span>
                {step1Status ? (
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                ) : (
                  <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-600" />
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="font-bold text-sm mt-1">勤怠実績診断</div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                {step1Status ? `対象 ${readiness.clientCount}名 / 実働${readiness.totalDays}日 整合確認済` : `要確認エラー ${readiness.errors.length}件`}
              </p>
            </div>
            <Link 
              href="/attendance" 
              className="text-[11px] font-bold text-primary hover:underline flex items-center gap-0.5 pt-1"
            >
              勤怠を確認 <ArrowRight className="w-3 h-3" />
            </Link>
          </div>

          {/* Step 2: 給与確定 */}
          <div className={`p-3 rounded-lg border flex flex-col justify-between space-y-2 transition-all ${
            step2Status ? 'bg-emerald-50/60 border-emerald-200' : 'bg-amber-50/60 border-amber-200'
          }`}>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-bold">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Step 2</span>
                {step2Status ? (
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                ) : (
                  <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600" />
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="font-bold text-sm mt-1">給与・工賃確定</div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                {step2Status ? '地域別最低賃金クリア・台帳集計済' : '最低賃金チェック要確認'}
              </p>
            </div>
            <Link 
              href={`/billing/payroll?month=${month}`} 
              className="text-[11px] font-bold text-primary hover:underline flex items-center gap-0.5 pt-1"
            >
              給与台帳へ <ArrowRight className="w-3 h-3" />
            </Link>
          </div>

          {/* Step 3: 上限額管理・提供実績 */}
          <div className="p-3 rounded-lg border bg-slate-50/70 border-slate-200 flex flex-col justify-between space-y-2">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-bold">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Step 3</span>
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
              </div>
              <div className="font-bold text-sm mt-1">上限額・提供実績</div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                他事業所調整 & 提供実績記録票の確認
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-2 text-[11px] font-bold text-primary pt-1">
              <Link href={`/billing/burden?month=${month}`} className="hover:underline">上限額</Link>
              <span>/</span>
              <Link href="/billing/provision-records" className="hover:underline">実績表</Link>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Step 4: 国保連請求データ */}
          <div className={`p-3 rounded-lg border flex flex-col justify-between space-y-2 transition-all ${
            step4Status ? 'bg-emerald-50/60 border-emerald-200' : 'bg-slate-50/60 border-slate-200'
          }`}>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-bold">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Step 4</span>
                {step4Status ? (
                  <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                ) : (
                  <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="font-bold text-sm mt-1">国保連請求CSV</div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                {step4Status ? '公式伝送CSV出力準備完了' : '請求データ検証中'}
              </p>
            </div>
            <Link 
              href={`/billing/kokuho?month=${month}`} 
              className="text-[11px] font-bold text-primary hover:underline flex items-center gap-0.5 pt-1"
            >
              請求データへ <ArrowRight className="w-3 h-3" />
            </Link>
          </div>

          {/* Step 5: 月次確定ロック */}
          <div className={`p-3 rounded-lg border flex flex-col justify-between space-y-2 transition-all ${
            step5Status ? 'bg-emerald-100/70 border-emerald-300 text-emerald-950' : 'bg-slate-50 border-slate-200'
          }`}>
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between font-bold">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">Step 5</span>
                {step5Status ? (
                  <Lock className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-700" />
                ) : (
                  <Unlock className="w-4 h-4 text-slate-400" />
                )}
              </div>
              <div className="font-bold text-sm mt-1">月次確定ロック</div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                {step5Status ? '過去データ変更保護中' : '請求完了後にロック実行'}
              </p>
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={handleToggleLock}
              disabled={isProcessing}
              className={`text-[11px] font-bold text-left hover:underline flex items-center gap-0.5 pt-1 ${
                step5Status ? 'text-emerald-800' : 'text-primary'
              }`}
            >
              {isProcessing ? '処理中...' : step5Status ? 'ロック解除' : 'ロックをかける'}
            </button>
          </div>

        </div>

        {/* 警告・診断メッセージ */}
        {readiness.hasErrors && (
          <div className="p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-200 rounded-lg text-xs text-red-900 space-y-1">
            <div className="font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-red-600" />
              <span>【要対応】国保連請求前に以下の不備を解消してください：</span>
            </div>
            <ul className="list-disc list-inside space-y-0.5 pl-1 text-red-800">
              {readiness.errors.map((err, i) => (
                <li key={i}>{err}</li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* クイックアクションバー */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3 pt-2 border-t text-xs">
          <div className="text-muted-foreground">
            {isLocked && lockedAt ? (
              <span>🔒 {lockedAt.slice(0, 10)} に月次確定ロック済み（誤修正から保護されています）</span>
            ) : (
              <span>💡 Step 1〜4 を完了後、Step 5 でロックをかけると勤怠や給与の事後誤修正を完全に防止できます。</span>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto">
            <Link 
              href={`/api/billing/export-kokuho-csv?month=${month}`} 
              download
              className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm" }), "h-8 text-xs flex-1 sm:flex-none justify-center")}
            >
              <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1.5 shrink-0" />
              国保連CSV
            </Link>
            <Button
              type="button"
              size="sm"
              onClick={handleToggleLock}
              disabled={isProcessing}
              variant={isLocked ? "outline" : "default"}
              className="h-8 text-xs font-bold gap-1.5 flex-1 sm:flex-none justify-center"
            >
              {isLocked ? (
                <>
                  <Unlock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
                  確定ロック解除
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <Lock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
                  当月確定ロック
                </>
              )}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}


================================================================================
File: src/app/billing/kokuho/KokuhoClient.tsx

'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ChevronLeft, Download, Upload, FileSpreadsheet, AlertCircle, Lock, Unlock, ShieldCheck, ShieldAlert, CheckCircle2, Printer } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { parseKokuhoErrorCsv, KokuhoErrorRecord } from "@/lib/billing/kokuhoCsvParser";
import { 
  generateKokuhoCsvSafe, 
  getBillingMonthLockStatus, 
  lockBillingMonth, 
  unlockBillingMonth, 
  getMonthlyStaffingForBilling,
  validateBillingReadiness,
  type BillingReadinessResult
} from "../actions";

const getDefaultTargetMonth = () => {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setDate(1);
  d.setMonth(d.getMonth() - 1);
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
};

export function KokuhoClient() {
  const [targetMonth, setTargetMonth] = useState(getDefaultTargetMonth);
  const [errorRecords, setErrorRecords] = useState<KokuhoErrorRecord[] | null>(null);
  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState(false);
  const [isOverpaymentClaim, setIsOverpaymentClaim] = useState(false);
  const [lockStatus, setLockStatus] = useState<{ isLocked: boolean; lockedAt: string | null; lockedBy: string | null; unlockReason?: string | null } | null>(null);
  const [staffingStatus, setStaffingStatus] = useState<any>(null);
  const [readinessStatus, setReadinessStatus] = useState<BillingReadinessResult | null>(null);
  const [isLocking, setIsLocking] = useState(false);

  const fetchMonthStatus = async (month: string) => {
    try {
      const [status, staffing, readiness] = await Promise.all([
        getBillingMonthLockStatus(month),
        getMonthlyStaffingForBilling(month),
        validateBillingReadiness(month)
      ]);
      setLockStatus(status);
      setStaffingStatus(staffing);
      setReadinessStatus(readiness);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchMonthStatus(targetMonth);
  }, [targetMonth]);

  const handleLock = async () => {
    if (!confirm(`${targetMonth} の請求データを確定し、月次ロックしますか？\n\n【重要】ロック後は該当月の勤怠・支援記録の修正や追加が完全にブロックされ、請求データの整合性が保証されます。`)) return;
    setIsLocking(true);
    try {
      const res = await lockBillingMonth(targetMonth);
      if (!res.success) {
        alert("ロックに失敗しました:\n" + ((res as any).error || res.message));
        return;
      }
      alert(res.message);
      await fetchMonthStatus(targetMonth);
    } catch (e: any) {
      alert("ロックに失敗しました: " + e.message);
    } finally {
      setIsLocking(false);
    }
  };

  const handleUnlock = async () => {
    const reason = prompt(`${targetMonth} の月次ロックを解除する理由を入力してください（実地指導対策として監査ログに恒久記録されます）:`);
    if (!reason || reason.trim() === "") {
      alert("解除理由は必須です。");
      return;
    }
    setIsLocking(true);
    try {
      const res = await unlockBillingMonth(targetMonth, reason);
      if (!res.success) {
        alert("解除に失敗しました: " + ((res as any).error || res.message));
        return;
      }
      alert(res.message);
      await fetchMonthStatus(targetMonth);
    } catch (e: any) {
      alert("解除に失敗しました: " + e.message);
    } finally {
      setIsLocking(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDownloadCsv = async () => {
    setIsGenerating(true);
    try {
      const res = await generateKokuhoCsvSafe(targetMonth, isOverpaymentClaim);
      
      if (!res || !res.success || !res.csvData) {
        alert(res?.error || "指定された月の計算済みデータが見つかりません。「上限額管理」モジュールで計算・保存を行ってから再度お試しください。");
        return;
      }

      const { encodeToShiftJis } = await import('../actions');
      const uint8Array = await encodeToShiftJis(res.csvData);

      const blob = new Blob([uint8Array as any], { type: 'text/csv' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `DATA01_${targetMonth.replace('-', '')}.CSV`;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      document.body.removeChild(a);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert("CSVの生成中にエラーが発生しました: " + err.message);
    } finally {
      setIsGenerating(false);
    }
  };

  const handleFileUpload = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    const reader = new FileReader();
    reader.onload = (event) => {
      const text = event.target?.result as string;
      const parsed = parseKokuhoErrorCsv(text);
      setErrorRecords(parsed);
    };
    reader.readAsText(file, 'Shift_JIS');
  };

  return (
    <main className="flex-1 p-3.5 sm:p-6 md:p-12">
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-5xl space-y-6">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <Link href="/billing" className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "icon" }))}>
            <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
          </Link>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">国保連への請求</h1>
            <p className="mt-1 sm:mt-2 text-sm sm:text-lg text-muted-foreground">
              国保連に提出する請求データを作成したり、エラー（返戻）の内容を確認します。
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 人員配置基準警告（月間FTE不足リスク） */}
        {staffingStatus && !staffingStatus.isCompliant && (
          <div className="bg-rose-50 border-l-4 border-rose-500 p-4 rounded-r-md shadow-sm">
            <div className="flex items-start">
              <AlertCircle className="h-6 w-6 text-rose-600 mt-0.5 mr-3 flex-shrink-0" />
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-rose-950">
                  【人員配置警告】対象月（{targetMonth}）の常勤換算（FTE）が人員基準を下回っています
                </h3>
                <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-rose-900">
                  当月の平均利用者数: <strong>{staffingStatus.averageClientsPerDay}名</strong> に対し、必要常勤換算数は <strong>{staffingStatus.requiredFte}人</strong> ですが、現在のシフト実績は <strong className="text-rose-600">{staffingStatus.actualFte}人</strong> です。
                  人員基準を満たさない場合、3割の人員欠如減算またはレセプト返戻の対象となるおそれがあります。
                </p>
                <div className="mt-2 flex gap-4 text-xs font-bold">
                  <Link href="/staff/shifts" className="underline text-rose-950 hover:text-rose-700">
                    → 職員シフトを確認・調整する
                  </Link>
                  <Link href="/settings" className="underline text-rose-950 hover:text-rose-700">
                    → 事業所体制設定の人員欠如減算フラグを確認する
                  </Link>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 月次確定・データロック（改ざん防止・実地指導対策） */}
        <Card className={cn(
          "border-2 transition-all shadow-sm",
          lockStatus?.isLocked ? "border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-50/30" : "border-amber-300 bg-amber-50/20"
        )}>
          <CardContent className="p-6">
            <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center md:justify-between gap-4">
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                  <ShieldCheck className={cn("h-6 w-6", lockStatus?.isLocked ? "text-emerald-600" : "text-amber-600")} />
                  <h2 className="text-xl font-bold">
                    {targetMonth}月 請求データ月次確定・ロック管理
                  </h2>
                  {lockStatus?.isLocked ? (
                    <Badge className="bg-emerald-600 text-white hover:bg-emerald-700 px-3 py-1 text-sm">
                      <Lock className="h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-1" /> 確定ロック中（改変防止）
                    </Badge>
                  ) : (
                    <Badge variant="outline" className="text-amber-700 border-amber-400 bg-amber-50 px-3 py-1 text-sm">
                      <Unlock className="h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-1" /> 未確定（編集可能）
                    </Badge>
                  )}
                </div>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                  {lockStatus?.isLocked ? (
                    <span>
                      {lockStatus.lockedAt?.substring(0, 10)} に {lockStatus.lockedBy || '管理者'} により確定ロックされました。当月の勤怠・支援記録の修正はブロックされています。
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <span>
                      ※国保連への伝送データ作成後は、過去データの不整合や実地指導での指摘を防ぐため、必ず「月次ロック」を実行してください。
                    </span>
                  )}
                </p>
              </div>

              <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
                {lockStatus?.isLocked ? (
                  <Button 
                    variant="outline" 
                    size="sm"
                    className="border-destructive text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10"
                    onClick={handleUnlock}
                    disabled={isLocking}
                  >
                    <Unlock className="mr-1 h-4 w-4" /> ロック解除（過誤修正用）
                  </Button>
                ) : (
                  <Button 
                    variant="default"
                    className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white shadow-sm font-semibold"
                    onClick={handleLock}
                    disabled={isLocking}
                  >
                    <Lock className="mr-1 h-4 w-4" /> この月を確定してロックする
                  </Button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* 国保連事前審査（返戻ゼロ防御システム） */}
        {readinessStatus && (
          <Card className={cn(
            "border-2 transition-all shadow-sm",
            readinessStatus.hasErrors 
              ? "border-rose-500 bg-rose-50/40" 
              : readinessStatus.hasWarnings 
                ? "border-amber-400 bg-amber-50/30" 
                : "border-emerald-500 bg-emerald-50/30"
          )}>
            <CardHeader className="pb-3 pt-4 px-6 border-b">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                  {readinessStatus.hasErrors ? (
                    <ShieldAlert className="h-5 w-5 text-rose-600" />
                  ) : readinessStatus.hasWarnings ? (
                    <AlertCircle className="h-5 w-5 text-amber-600" />
                  ) : (
                    <CheckCircle2 className="h-5 w-5 text-emerald-600" />
                  )}
                  <CardTitle className="text-lg font-bold">
                    国保連レセプト事前審査（返戻防止チェック）
                  </CardTitle>
                </div>
                {readinessStatus.hasErrors ? (
                  <Badge variant="destructive" className="font-bold">
                    返戻リスク検知: {readinessStatus.issues.filter(i => i.type === 'error').length}件
                  </Badge>
                ) : readinessStatus.hasWarnings ? (
                  <Badge className="bg-amber-500 text-white font-bold">
                    確認推奨: {readinessStatus.issues.filter(i => i.type === 'warning').length}件
                  </Badge>
                ) : (
                  <Badge className="bg-emerald-600 text-white font-bold">
                    審査合格（返戻リスクなし）
                  </Badge>
                )}
              </div>
              <CardDescription className="text-xs mt-1">
                {readinessStatus.hasErrors 
                  ? "国保連の審査システムで返戻（突き返し）となる致命的な不整合が検知されました。修正完了までCSV出力はロックされます。"
                  : readinessStatus.hasWarnings
                    ? "減算の適用や月途中での受給者証期限切れ等の確認事項があります。内容をご確認の上で請求を進めてください。"
                    : "受給者証の有効期限、支給量上限、加算算定回数、個別支援計画の整合性チェックをすべてクリアしています。"}
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            {readinessStatus.issues.length > 0 && (
              <CardContent className="p-4 px-6 space-y-2">
                <div className="space-y-1.5 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                  {readinessStatus.issues.map((issue, idx) => (
                    <div 
                      key={idx} 
                      className={cn(
                        "text-xs p-2.5 rounded-md flex items-start gap-2 border",
                        issue.type === 'error' 
                          ? "bg-rose-100/60 border-rose-200 text-rose-950" 
                          : "bg-amber-100/60 border-amber-200 text-amber-950"
                      )}
                    >
                      <span className={cn(
                        "font-bold px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] shrink-0",
                        issue.type === 'error' ? "bg-rose-600 text-white" : "bg-amber-600 text-white"
                      )}>
                        {issue.category}
                      </span>
                      <span className="flex-1 font-medium">{issue.message}</span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            )}
          </Card>
        )}

        <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 gap-6 pt-2">
          <Card className="shadow-sm">
            <CardHeader className="bg-primary/5 border-b pb-4">
              <CardTitle className="text-xl flex items-center gap-2">
                <Download className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
                伝送用データ生成 (DATA01.CSV)
              </CardTitle>
              <CardDescription className="text-base mt-2">
                指定した月の実績と計算結果をまとめて、国保連に提出できるデータを作成します。
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="pt-6 space-y-6">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label className="font-bold">対象年月</Label>
                <Input type="month" value={targetMonth} onChange={e => setTargetMonth(e.target.value)} />
              </div>
              
              <div className="flex items-center space-x-2 p-3 border rounded-md bg-amber-50/30 border-amber-200">
                <input 
                  type="checkbox" 
                  id="isOverpaymentClaim" 
                  checked={isOverpaymentClaim} 
                  onChange={(e) => setIsOverpaymentClaim(e.target.checked)} 
                  className="h-4 w-4 rounded border-gray-300 text-amber-600 focus:ring-amber-600"
                />
                <Label htmlFor="isOverpaymentClaim" className="font-bold text-amber-900 cursor-pointer">
                  過誤申立データとして出力する (レコード種別4等)
                </Label>
              </div>
              
              <div className="p-4 bg-muted/20 rounded-md border text-sm text-muted-foreground space-y-1">
                <p className="font-semibold text-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-emerald-700 dark:text-emerald-400">
                  <ShieldCheck className="h-4 w-4" /> 国保中央会 インタフェース仕様書（サービス事業所編）完全準拠
                </p>
                <p>※国保連の「電子請求受付システム」「取込送信システム」に直接取り込める本番仕様データ（Shift_JIS / CRLF / 請求書・明細書レコード）を出力します。</p>
                <p>※事前に「スコア・単位数シミュレーション」で当月の単位数を確定保存しておく必要があります。</p>
              </div>

              <Button 
                className={cn(
                  "w-full h-14 text-lg font-bold shadow-md transition-all",
                  readinessStatus?.hasErrors 
                    ? "bg-rose-700 hover:bg-rose-800 text-white cursor-not-allowed"
                    : "bg-primary hover:bg-primary/90"
                )} 
                onClick={handleDownloadCsv}
                disabled={isGenerating || readinessStatus?.hasErrors}
              >
                {readinessStatus?.hasErrors ? (
                  <>
                    <ShieldAlert className="mr-2 h-5 w-5" />
                    事前審査エラーを解消してください（出力ロック中）
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <FileSpreadsheet className="mr-2 h-5 w-5" />
                    {isGenerating ? "生成中..." : "DATA01.CSV をダウンロード"}
                  </>
                )}
              </Button>

              <Link 
                href={`/billing/kokuho/print?month=${targetMonth}`}
                className={cn(
                  buttonVariants({ variant: "outline" }),
                  "w-full h-12 text-sm font-bold border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 flex items-center justify-center gap-2"
                )}
              >
                <Printer className="h-4 w-4 text-slate-700" />
                請求書・明細書を印刷・プレビュー (様式第1・第2)
              </Link>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="shadow-sm border-amber-200">
            <CardHeader className="bg-amber-50 border-b border-amber-100 pb-4">
              <CardTitle className="text-xl flex items-center gap-2 text-amber-900">
                <Upload className="h-5 w-5" />
                エラー（返戻）ファイルの確認
              </CardTitle>
              <CardDescription className="text-base mt-2 text-amber-800/80">
                国保連から届いたエラーファイルを読み込むと、直すべきポイントが画面に表示されます。
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="pt-6 space-y-6">
              <div className="space-y-4">
                <Label className="font-bold">エラーCSVファイルを選択</Label>
                <div className="flex items-center justify-center w-full">
                  <label htmlFor="dropzone-file" className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center w-full h-32 border-2 border-dashed rounded-lg cursor-pointer bg-amber-50/30 border-amber-300 hover:bg-amber-100/50 transition-colors">
                    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center pt-5 pb-6">
                      <Upload className="w-8 h-8 mb-3 text-amber-600/60" />
                      <p className="mb-2 text-sm text-amber-900/80"><span className="font-semibold">クリックしてファイルを選択</span> またはドラッグ＆ドロップ</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-amber-700/60">CSV (Shift_JIS または UTF-8)</p>
                    </div>
                    <input id="dropzone-file" type="file" accept=".csv" className="hidden" onChange={handleFileUpload} />
                  </label>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="p-4 bg-amber-50/50 rounded-md border border-amber-200 text-sm text-amber-900/80">
                ※テスト用CSV例：メモ帳等で<br/><code className="bg-white px-2 py-1 rounded mx-1 text-xs">E001,山田太郎,受給者証番号の桁数が不正です</code><br/>という内容を保存して読み込ませてください。
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>

        {errorRecords && (
          <Card className="shadow-sm border-destructive/20 mt-6 animate-in fade-in slide-in-from-bottom-4">
            <CardHeader className="bg-destructive/5 border-b border-destructive/10 pb-4">
              <CardTitle className="text-xl flex items-center gap-2 text-destructive">
                <AlertCircle className="h-5 w-5" />
                解析されたエラー内容 ({errorRecords.length}件)
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="p-0">
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-sm text-left min-w-[500px]">
                  <thead className="text-xs text-muted-foreground bg-muted/30 border-b">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="px-6 py-3 font-semibold">行番号</th>
                      <th className="px-6 py-3 font-semibold">エラーコード</th>
                      <th className="px-6 py-3 font-semibold">対象者・項目</th>
                      <th className="px-6 py-3 font-semibold">エラー詳細メッセージ</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody className="divide-y">
                    {errorRecords.map((record, idx) => (
                      <tr key={idx} className="hover:bg-muted/10 transition-colors">
                        <td className="px-6 py-4">{record.lineNo}</td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 font-mono font-bold text-destructive">{record.errorCode}</td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4 font-bold">{record.targetName}</td>
                        <td className="px-6 py-4">{record.errorMessage}</td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        )}
      </div>
    </main>
  );
}

'use client';

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Printer } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";

export function PrintClientNav({ 
  currentMonth, 
  currentMode 
}: { 
  currentMonth: string; 
  currentMode: string;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();

  const handleModeChange = (mode: string) => {
    router.push(`/billing/kokuho/print?month=${currentMonth}&mode=${mode}`);
  };

  const handleMonthChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    router.push(`/billing/kokuho/print?month=${e.target.value}&mode=${currentMode}`);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 sm:gap-3">
      {/* 対象年月セレクタ */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-slate-600 font-medium">
        <span>対象年月:</span>
        <input 
          type="month" 
          value={currentMonth} 
          onChange={handleMonthChange}
          className="rounded border border-slate-300 bg-white px-2 py-1 text-xs text-slate-800 shadow-xs focus:border-slate-500 focus:outline-none"
        />
      </div>

      {/* 帳票表示モード切替 */}
      <div className="flex rounded-md border border-slate-300 bg-slate-100 p-0.5 text-xs font-semibold">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => handleModeChange('all')}
          className={`rounded px-2.5 py-1 transition-all ${
            currentMode === 'all' 
              ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-xs' 
              : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
          }`}
        >
          全件 (請求書+明細書)
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => handleModeChange('invoice')}
          className={`rounded px-2.5 py-1 transition-all ${
            currentMode === 'invoice' 
              ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-xs' 
              : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
          }`}
        >
          請求書のみ
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => handleModeChange('detail')}
          className={`rounded px-2.5 py-1 transition-all ${
            currentMode === 'detail' 
              ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-xs' 
              : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
          }`}
        >
          明細書のみ
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* 印刷実行ボタン */}
      <Button 
        onClick={() => window.print()}
        className="gap-1.5 bg-slate-900 text-white hover:bg-slate-800 shadow-xs"
        size="sm"
      >
        <Printer className="h-4 w-4" />
        印刷する (A4横)
      </Button>
    </div>
  );
}

import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth"
import { redirect } from "next/navigation"

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

export default async function BillingLayout({
  children,
}: {
  children: React.ReactNode
}) {
  const role = await getRole()

  if (role === 'staff') {
    redirect('/')
  }

  return <>{children}</>
}

import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Printer, AlertTriangle, Download, FileSpreadsheet, Building2, CheckCircle2 } from "lucide-react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import Link from "next/link";
import { AutoFitText } from "@/components/AutoFitText";

interface Props {
  month: string;
  groupedData: Record<string, any[]>;
  facility: any;
  agreements: any[];
  planCheckResults: any[];
  activeFormat: string;
  defaultFormat: string;
  capacityRatioData: {
    capacity: number;
    maxDailyCount: number;
    ratio: number;
    isCompliant: boolean;
  };
}

export function OffsiteReportClient({ 
  month, 
  groupedData, 
  facility, 
  agreements = [], 
  planCheckResults = [],
  activeFormat,
  defaultFormat,
  capacityRatioData
}: Props) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [yearStr, monthStr] = month.split('-');
  const reiwaYear = parseInt(yearStr) - 2018;

  const handleMonthChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    router.push(`/billing/offsite-report?month=${e.target.value}&format=${activeFormat}`);
  };

  const handleFormatChange = (newFormat: string) => {
    router.push(`/billing/offsite-report?month=${month}&format=${newFormat}`);
  };

  const dates = Object.keys(groupedData).sort();
  const unmentionedPlans = planCheckResults.filter((r: any) => !r.hasPlan || !r.hasOffsiteMention);

  // 利用者IDごとの計画位置付け日マップ
  const planDateMap: Record<string, string> = {};
  for (const p of planCheckResults) {
    planDateMap[p.clientId] = p.planDate ? p.planDate.replace(/-/g, '/') : '未登録';
  }

  const isKobeFormat = activeFormat === 'kobe_custom';

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background/50 print:bg-white print:min-h-0">
      <main className="flex-1 p-3.5 sm:p-6 md:p-12 print:p-0">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-5xl space-y-6 print:max-w-none print:space-y-0">
          
          {/* 画面上部ヘッダー（印刷時は非表示） */}
          <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-end gap-4 print:hidden">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-indigo-50 border-indigo-200 text-indigo-800 text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5">
                  <Building2 className="h-3 w-3 mr-1 inline text-indigo-600" />
                  {activeFormat === defaultFormat ? (
                    `自治体ルール適用中: ${isKobeFormat ? '神戸市指定様式' : '標準様式'}`
                  ) : (
                    `プレビュー切替中: ${isKobeFormat ? '神戸市指定様式' : '標準様式'}`
                  )}
                </Badge>
              </div>
              <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">
                施設外就労実施報告書
              </h1>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1 text-sm">
                指定権者（自治体）提出用の法定フォーマットを動的出力します。
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-slate-100 p-1 rounded-md border text-xs">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground pl-1 font-medium">様式:</span>
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleFormatChange('kobe_custom')}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded font-medium transition-all ${
                    isKobeFormat ? 'bg-white text-indigo-700 shadow-xs font-bold' : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
                  }`}
                >
                  神戸市様式
                </button>
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleFormatChange('standard')}
                  className={`px-2.5 py-1 rounded font-medium transition-all ${
                    !isKobeFormat ? 'bg-white text-indigo-700 shadow-xs font-bold' : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
                  }`}
                >
                  標準様式
                </button>
              </div>

              <Input type="month" value={month} onChange={handleMonthChange} className="w-36 h-9" />

              <a
                href={`/api/billing/offsite-report/export?month=${month}&format=${activeFormat}`}
                download
                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md text-xs font-medium border border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-9 px-3 gap-1.5 shadow-xs"
              >
                <FileSpreadsheet className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
                Excel用CSV
              </a>

              <Button onClick={() => window.print()} className="h-9 gap-1.5 font-bold shadow-xs">
                <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
                印刷 / PDF
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 実地指導リスク警告（個別支援計画の未位置付け） */}
          {unmentionedPlans.length > 0 && (
            <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 border border-red-300 rounded-md text-red-900 text-sm flex items-start gap-3 shadow-sm print:hidden">
              <AlertTriangle className="h-5 w-5 text-red-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <div className="font-bold text-base">
                  🚨【実地指導・給付費返還リスク】個別支援計画書に「施設外就労」の位置付けが確認できません
                </div>
                <p className="text-xs text-red-800 leading-relaxed">
                  厚労省指定基準第191条の2および自治体取扱要領に基づき、施設外就労を行う利用者は、事前に個別支援計画書の中に施設外就労を行う理由・目標・作業内容が明記されていなければなりません。位置付けがないまま請求した場合、実地指導で給付費全額返還の対象となります。
                </p>
                <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 pt-1 text-xs">
                  {unmentionedPlans.map((u: any) => (
                    <span key={u.clientId} className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-red-100 text-red-800 font-bold">
                      {u.clientName} 様: {u.planId ? (
                        <Link href={`/plans/${u.planId}/edit`} className="underline ml-1 hover:text-red-950">
                          計画書を編集して位置付ける →
                        </Link>
                      ) : (
                        <Link href="/plans/new" className="underline ml-1 hover:text-red-950">
                          有効な計画書を作成 →
                        </Link>
                      )}
                    </span>
                  ))}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* レポート本体カード */}
          <Card className="print:shadow-none print:border-none">
            <CardContent className="pt-6 print:pt-0">
              {dates.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="text-center py-12 text-muted-foreground print:hidden">
                  対象月に施設外就労の実績はありません。
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="print-content">
                  <style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{__html: `
                    @media print {
                      @page { size: A4 portrait; margin: 8mm 10mm; }
                      body { font-size: 10px; color: black; line-height: 1.25; background: white !important; }
                      table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 6px; margin-bottom: 6px; font-size: 9.5px; page-break-inside: auto; }
                      th, td { border: 1px solid black; padding: 3px 5px; text-align: left; }
                      th { background-color: #f3f4f6 !important; -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; print-color-adjust: exact; }
                      tr { page-break-inside: avoid !important; break-inside: avoid !important; }
                      .text-center { text-align: center; }
                      .text-right { text-align: right; }
                      .no-print { display: none !important; }
                    }
                  `}} />
                  
                  {isKobeFormat ? (
                    /* =========================================================
                       神戸市指定様式 (kobe_custom)
                       ========================================================= */
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      <div className="flex justify-between items-start">
                        <div className="text-base font-bold underline underline-offset-4">
                          神戸市長　宛
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-right text-xs space-y-0.5 max-w-[320px]">
                          <p>提出年月日: 令和 {reiwaYear} 年 {parseInt(monthStr)} 月末日</p>
                          <div className="flex justify-end items-center gap-1">
                            <span className="font-bold shrink-0">事業所名:</span>
                            <div className="max-w-[220px]">
                              <AutoFitText text={facility.facility_name} maxFontSizePt={9.5} minFontSizePt={7} className="font-bold text-right" />
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <p>事業所番号: {facility.facility_number}</p>
                          <div className="flex justify-end items-center gap-1">
                            <span className="shrink-0">所在地:</span>
                            <div className="max-w-[240px]">
                              <AutoFitText text={facility.address || ''} maxFontSizePt={9} minFontSizePt={6.5} className="text-right" />
                            </div>
                          </div>
                          <p>管理者氏名: ______________________ 印</p>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      <div className="text-center py-1">
                        <h2 className="text-lg font-bold underline underline-offset-8">
                          就労継続支援Ａ型　施設外就労実施報告書（神戸市指定様式）
                        </h2>

                          （対象期間：令和 {reiwaYear} 年 {parseInt(monthStr)} 月 1 日 〜 令和 {reiwaYear} 年 {parseInt(monthStr)} 月末日）
                        </p>
                      </div>

                      {/* 神戸市指導基準: 定員に対する施設外就労者の割合要件チェック */}
                      <div className="border border-black p-2.5 bg-slate-50/70 text-xs">
                        <div className="font-bold border-b border-black pb-1 mb-1 flex items-center justify-between">
                          <span>【指定基準遵守状況】定員に対する施設外就労利用者数の割合要件（定員の100分の70以下）</span>
                          <span className={`px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold ${
                            capacityRatioData.isCompliant ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-900 border border-emerald-300' : 'bg-red-100 text-red-900 border border-red-300'
                          }`}>

                        </div>
                        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                          <div>利用定員: <span className="font-semibold">{capacityRatioData.capacity} 名</span></div>
                          <div>1日あたり最大実施人数: <span className="font-semibold">{capacityRatioData.maxDailyCount} 名</span></div>
                          <div>施設外就労者の割合: <span className="font-semibold">{capacityRatioData.ratio} %</span> (基準: 70%以下)</div>

                      {/* 請負先企業情報 */}
                      {agreements.length > 0 && (

                          <table className="w-full border-collapse border border-black text-xs">
                            <thead>
                              <tr className="bg-gray-100">
                                <th className="border border-black p-1.5 w-1/4">請負先企業名</th>
                                <th className="border border-black p-1.5 w-1/4">作業場所・現場住所</th>
                                <th className="border border-black p-1.5 w-1/3">請負作業内容</th>
                                <th className="border border-black p-1.5">契約単価・報酬見込</th>
                              </tr>
                            </thead>
                            <tbody>
                              {agreements.map((a: any) => (
                                <tr key={a.id}>
                                  <td className="border border-black p-1.5 font-medium">
                                    <AutoFitText text={a.company_name} maxFontSizePt={9.5} minFontSizePt={7} />
                                  </td>
                                  <td className="border border-black p-1.5 text-muted-foreground">
                                    <AutoFitText text={facility.address || '契約現場'} maxFontSizePt={9} minFontSizePt={6.5} />
                                  </td>
                                  <td className="border border-black p-1.5">
                                    <AutoFitText text={a.work_description} maxFontSizePt={9} minFontSizePt={6.5} />
                                  </td>
                                  <td className="border border-black p-1.5">
                                    {a.unit_price ? `${a.unit_price.toLocaleString()}円` : ''} 
                                    {a.expected_monthly_revenue ? ` (見込: ${a.expected_monthly_revenue.toLocaleString()}円)` : ''}
                                  </td>
                                </tr>
                              ))}
                            </tbody>
                          </table>
                        </div>
                      )}

                      {/* 実施実績明細テーブル（個別支援計画位置付け日・同行指導員欄付き） */}
                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800">2. 利用者別施設外就労実績明細</span>
                        <table className="w-full border-collapse border border-black text-xs">
                          <thead>
                            <tr className="bg-gray-100">
                              <th className="border border-black p-1 text-center w-24">実施年月日</th>
                              <th className="border border-black p-1 text-center w-24">受給者証番号</th>
                              <th className="border border-black p-1 text-center w-32">利用者氏名</th>
                              <th className="border border-black p-1 text-center w-28 bg-indigo-50/50">計画位置付け日</th>
                              <th className="border border-black p-1 text-center w-32">作業時間</th>
                              <th className="border border-black p-1 text-center w-24">同行指導員</th>
                              <th className="border border-black p-1 text-center">作業内容・特記事項</th>
                            </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                            {dates.map((date) => {
                              const records = groupedData[date];
                              return records.map((record: any, idx: number) => {
                                const pDate = planDateMap[record.client_id] || '未登録';
                                return (
                                  <tr key={record.id}>
                                    {idx === 0 && (
                                      <td rowSpan={records.length} className="border border-black p-1 text-center align-top font-medium">
                                        {date.replace(/-/g, '/')}
                                      </td>
                                    )}
                                    <td className="border border-black p-1 text-center font-mono">{record.recipient_number}</td>
                                    <td className="border border-black p-1 font-medium">
                                      <AutoFitText text={record.full_name} maxFontSizePt={9.5} minFontSizePt={7} />
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="border border-black p-1 text-center font-mono text-[11px]">
                                      {pDate}
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="border border-black p-1 text-center font-mono text-[11px]">
                                      {record.clock_in} 〜 {record.clock_out}
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="border border-black p-1 text-center">
                                      <AutoFitText text={record.visit_staff_name || "同行指導員"} maxFontSizePt={9} minFontSizePt={6.5} className="text-center" />
                                    </td>
                                    <td className="border border-black p-1">
                                      <AutoFitText text={record.notes || "施設外就労作業"} maxFontSizePt={9} minFontSizePt={6.5} />
                                    </td>
                                  </tr>
                                );
                              });
                            })}
                          </tbody>
                        </table>
                      </div>

                      {/* 神戸市指定の確認事項チェックリスト */}
                      <div className="border border-black p-3 text-xs space-y-1.5 mt-4">
                        <div className="font-bold border-b border-black pb-1 mb-1">
                          【確認事項】指定権者指導基準チェックリスト
                        </div>
                        <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-700 shrink-0" />
                          派遣先企業等との間で請負契約等の書面を取り交わし、適正な業務委託が行われている。
                        </p>
                        <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-700 shrink-0" />
                          施設外就労の実施にあたり、利用者と事前に個別支援計画書により合意形成を図っている。
                        </p>
                        <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-700 shrink-0" />
                          施設外就労中も、必要な人員配置基準を満たし、目標工賃達成指導員または職業指導員が適切な支援を提供している。
                        </p>
                        <p className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-700 shrink-0" />
                          施設外就労先における労働環境および安全管理が適切に確保されている。
                        </p>

                        <div className="pt-4 flex justify-end gap-8 text-xs">
                          <div>サービス管理責任者 署名: ________________________ 印</div>
                          <div>管理者 署名: ________________________ 印</div>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    /* =========================================================
                       全国標準様式 (standard)
                       ========================================================= */
                    <div className="space-y-4">
                      <div className="text-center mb-6">
                        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold underline underline-offset-4">
                          施設外就労実施報告書
                        </h1>
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex justify-between items-center mb-4 text-sm">
                        <div>
                          令和 {reiwaYear} 年 {parseInt(monthStr)} 月分
                        </div>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                          <span className="font-bold">事業所名:</span>
                          <div className="max-w-[240px]">
                            <AutoFitText text={facility.facility_name} maxFontSizePt={11} minFontSizePt={8} className="font-bold text-right" />
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {agreements.length > 0 && (
                        <table className="w-full border-collapse border border-black mb-4 text-sm">
                          <thead>
                            <tr className="bg-gray-100">
                              <th className="border border-black p-2 w-1/3">請負先企業名</th>
                              <th className="border border-black p-2 w-1/3">請負契約内容（作業内容）</th>
                              <th className="border border-black p-2 w-1/3">契約単価・見込報酬額</th>
                            </tr>
                          </thead>
                          <tbody>
                            {agreements.map((a: any) => (
                              <tr key={a.id}>
                                <td className="border border-black p-2">
                                  <AutoFitText text={a.company_name} maxFontSizePt={10} minFontSizePt={7} />
                                </td>
                                <td className="border border-black p-2">
                                  <AutoFitText text={a.work_description} maxFontSizePt={10} minFontSizePt={7} />
                                </td>
                                <td className="border border-black p-2">
                                  {a.unit_price ? `単価: ${a.unit_price.toLocaleString()}円` : ''} 
                                  {a.expected_monthly_revenue ? ` (見込: ${a.expected_monthly_revenue.toLocaleString()}円)` : ''}
                                </td>
                              </tr>
                            ))}
                          </tbody>
                        </table>
                      )}

                      <table className="w-full border-collapse border border-black mb-6 text-sm">
                        <thead>
                          <tr className="bg-gray-100">
                            <th className="border border-black p-2 text-center w-32">実施年月日</th>
                            <th className="border border-black p-2 text-center">受給者証番号</th>
                            <th className="border border-black p-2 text-center w-48">利用者氏名</th>
                            <th className="border border-black p-2 text-center w-48">作業時間</th>
                            <th className="border border-black p-2 text-center">作業内容・備考</th>
                          </tr>
                        </thead>
                        <tbody>
                          {dates.map((date) => {
                            const records = groupedData[date];
                            return records.map((record: any, idx: number) => (
                              <tr key={record.id}>
                                {idx === 0 && (
                                  <td rowSpan={records.length} className="border border-black p-2 text-center align-top">
                                    {date.replace(/-/g, '/')}
                                  </td>
                                )}
                                <td className="border border-black p-2 text-center">{record.recipient_number}</td>
                                <td className="border border-black p-2">
                                  <AutoFitText text={record.full_name} maxFontSizePt={10} minFontSizePt={7} />
                                </td>
                                <td className="border border-black p-2 text-center">
                                  {record.clock_in} 〜 {record.clock_out}
                                </td>
                                <td className="border border-black p-2">
                                  <AutoFitText text={record.notes || "施設外就労"} maxFontSizePt={9.5} minFontSizePt={6.5} />
                                </td>
                              </tr>
                            ));
                          })}
                        </tbody>
                      </table>

                      <div className="mt-8 text-sm space-y-2 border border-black p-4">
                        <div className="font-bold border-b border-black pb-2 mb-2">確認事項（事業所記入欄）</div>
                        <p>□ 施設外就労の実施にあたり、利用者と事前に合意形成を図っている。</p>
                        <p>□ 派遣先企業等との間で請負契約等の書面を取り交わしている。</p>
                        <p>□ 施設外就労中も、必要な人員配置基準を満たし、適切な支援を提供している。</p>
                        <div className="mt-8 flex justify-end">
                          <span>管理者（サビ管）署名: ___________________________</span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                </div>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { OffsiteReportClient } from "./OffsiteReportClient";
import { Header } from "@/components/Header";
import { OffsiteSubNav } from "@/components/NavigationTabs";
import { getFacilityEffectiveRules } from "@/lib/rules/ruleEngine";
import { parseCapacityFromClass } from "@/lib/compliance/capacityChecker";

export default async function OffsiteReportPage({ searchParams }: { searchParams: Promise<{ month?: string; format?: string }> }) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) redirect("/login");

  const params = await searchParams;
  const today = new Date();
  const currentMonth = params.month || `${today.getFullYear()}-${String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;

  const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any || {};
  const facilityRules = getFacilityEffectiveRules();
  const defaultFormat = facilityRules.reports.offsite_work_format || 'standard';
  const activeFormat = params.format || defaultFormat;
  
  // 施設外就労の打刻データを取得
  const offsiteRecords = db.prepare(`
    SELECT a.*, c.full_name, c.recipient_number,
           w.name as workplace_name, w.company_name,
           st.name as staff_name
    FROM attendance_records a
    JOIN clients c ON a.client_id = c.id
    LEFT JOIN offsite_workplaces w ON a.offsite_workplace_id = w.id
    LEFT JOIN staff st ON a.offsite_staff_id = st.id
    WHERE a.record_date LIKE ? AND a.status = 'present' AND a.is_offsite = 1
    ORDER BY a.record_date ASC, a.clock_in ASC
  `).all(`${currentMonth}-%`) as any[];

  // 請負契約情報を取得
  const contractorAgreements = db.prepare(`
    SELECT *
    FROM contractor_agreements
    WHERE contract_start_date <= ? AND (contract_end_date IS NULL OR contract_end_date >= ?)
  `).all(`${currentMonth}-31`, `${currentMonth}-01`) as any[];

  // 1日あたりの施設外就労人数と定員比率の集計
  const dailyCounts: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const r of offsiteRecords) {
    dailyCounts[r.record_date] = (dailyCounts[r.record_date] || 0) + 1;
  }
  const maxDailyCount = Object.values(dailyCounts).length > 0 ? Math.max(...Object.values(dailyCounts)) : 0;
  const capacity = parseCapacityFromClass(facility.capacity_class);
  const ratio = capacity > 0 ? Math.round((maxDailyCount / capacity) * 100) : 0;
  const capacityRatioData = {
    capacity,
    maxDailyCount,
    ratio,
    isCompliant: ratio <= 70
  };

  // 施設外就労利用者の個別支援計画連動チェック（実地指導・指定基準第191条の2対応）
  const offsiteClientIds = Array.from(new Set(offsiteRecords.map((r: any) => r.client_id)));
  const offsitePlanCheckResults: { 
    clientId: string; 
    clientName: string; 
    hasPlan: boolean; 
    hasOffsiteMention: boolean; 
    planId?: string;
    planDate?: string;
  }[] = [];

  for (const cid of offsiteClientIds) {
    const client = db.prepare('SELECT full_name FROM clients WHERE id = ?').get(cid) as any;
    const plan = db.prepare(`
      SELECT id, domains_data, plan_date, start_date FROM support_plans 
      WHERE client_id = ? AND status = 'active'
      ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
    `).get(cid) as any;

    if (!plan) {
      offsitePlanCheckResults.push({
        clientId: cid as string,
        clientName: client?.full_name || '不明',
        hasPlan: false,
        hasOffsiteMention: false,
      });
    } else {
      const rawText = plan.domains_data || '';
      const hasMention = rawText.includes('施設外') || rawText.includes('請負') || rawText.includes('企業先') || rawText.includes('現場');
      offsitePlanCheckResults.push({
        clientId: cid as string,
        clientName: client?.full_name || '不明',
        hasPlan: true,
        hasOffsiteMention: hasMention,
        planId: plan.id,
        planDate: plan.start_date || plan.plan_date || undefined
      });
    }
  }

  // 日付と派遣先でグループ化
  const grouped = offsiteRecords.reduce((acc: any, record: any) => {
    const key = record.record_date;
    if (!acc[key]) acc[key] = [];
    acc[key].push(record);
    return acc;
  }, {});

  return (
    <>
      <div className="print:hidden">
        <Header activePage="offsite" />
        <OffsiteSubNav />
        <div className="bg-emerald-50 border-b border-emerald-200 px-6 py-2.5 text-xs text-emerald-950 flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="font-bold text-emerald-800 bg-emerald-100 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-emerald-300">新機能</span>
            <span>
              <strong>施設外就労マネジメント台帳</strong>: 施設外就労加算廃止（令和3年改定）に伴い、当月の対象者全員の個別評価表の一括入力・一括保存・A4印刷を集約した統合ハブへ移行できます。
            </span>
          </div>
          <a 
            href={`/offsite?month=${currentMonth}`}
            className="font-bold underline text-emerald-800 hover:text-emerald-950 flex items-center gap-1"
          >
            施設外就労マネジメント台帳へ移動 →
          </a>
        </div>
      </div>
      <OffsiteReportClient 
        month={currentMonth} 
        groupedData={grouped} 
        facility={facility} 
        agreements={contractorAgreements}
        planCheckResults={offsitePlanCheckResults}
        activeFormat={activeFormat}
        defaultFormat={defaultFormat}
        capacityRatioData={capacityRatioData}
      />
    </>
  );
}
