import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import Link from "next/link";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { Calculator, FileSpreadsheet, TrendingUp } from "lucide-react";
import { Header } from "@/components/Header";
import { BillingSubNav } from "@/components/NavigationTabs";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

import { validateBillingReadiness, getBillingMonthLockStatus } from "./actions";
import { MonthlyClosingWizard } from "./components/MonthlyClosingWizard";

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

export default async function BillingPage({
  searchParams
}: {
  searchParams?: Promise<{ month?: string }>
}) {
  const params = await searchParams;
  const today = new Date();
  const defaultMonth = `${today.getFullYear()}-${String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  const targetMonth = params?.month || defaultMonth;

  const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any || {};
  const clients = db.prepare('SELECT disability_class FROM clients WHERE deleted_at IS NULL').all() as any[];
  const totalClients = clients.length;
  let class3Plus = 0;
  let class4Plus = 0;
  for (const c of clients) {
    const dc = c.disability_class || '';
    if (dc.includes('3') || dc.includes('4') || dc.includes('5') || dc.includes('6')) class3Plus++;
    if (dc.includes('4') || dc.includes('5') || dc.includes('6')) class4Plus++;
  }
  const ratio3 = totalClients > 0 ? Math.round((class3Plus / totalClients) * 100) : 0;
  const ratio4 = totalClients > 0 ? Math.round((class4Plus / totalClients) * 100) : 0;
  const severeSetting = facility.severe_disability_addition || 'none';
  const isSevereWarning = (severeSetting === 'I' && ratio4 < 50) || (severeSetting === 'II' && ratio3 < 50);

  // 月次ロック状況と請求レディネス診断
  const lockStatus = await getBillingMonthLockStatus(targetMonth);
  let readiness = {
    isReady: true,
    hasErrors: false,
    hasWarnings: false,
    errors: [] as string[],
    warnings: [] as string[],
    clientCount: 0,
    totalDays: 0
  };
  try {
    const r = await validateBillingReadiness(targetMonth);
    readiness = {
      isReady: r.isReady,
      hasErrors: r.hasErrors,
      hasWarnings: r.hasWarnings,
      errors: r.errors || [],
      warnings: r.warnings || [],
      clientCount: r.clientCount || 0,
      totalDays: r.totalDays || 0
    };
  } catch (e) {}

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background/50">
      <Header activePage="billing" />
      <BillingSubNav />

      <main className="flex-1 p-3.5 sm:p-6 md:p-12">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-4xl space-y-6">
          {isSevereWarning && (
            <div className="p-4 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-300 rounded-lg text-amber-900 text-sm">
              <div className="font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 mb-1">
                <span>⚠【重度障害者支援加算・要件未達アラート】</span>
              </div>
              <p>
                現在「重度障害者支援{severeSetting === 'I' ? '加算I（区分4以上50%）' : '加算II（区分3以上50%）'}」が設定されていますが、
                現在の在籍利用者の重度者割合は <strong>{severeSetting === 'I' ? `区分4以上: ${ratio4}%` : `区分3以上: ${ratio3}%`}</strong> です。
                前年度の平均実績が要件を満たしていない場合、国保連請求で返戻・過誤調整の対象となります。
              </p>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* 月次請求業務統合ステップウィザード */}
          <MonthlyClosingWizard
            initialMonth={targetMonth}
            isLocked={lockStatus.isLocked}
            lockedAt={lockStatus.lockedAt}
            readiness={readiness}
            payrollStats={{
              totalClients,
              isWageCompliant: true
            }}
          />

          <div>
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">各業務機能メニュー</h2>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              スコア算出、自己負担額計算、給与台帳、提供実績表などの個別機能はこちらから利用できます。
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="grid md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-6 pt-4">
            <Card className="shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow border-primary/20">
              <CardHeader className="pb-4 bg-primary/5">
                <CardTitle className="text-xl flex items-center gap-2">
                  <TrendingUp className="h-6 w-6 text-primary" />
                  スコア・単位数算出
                </CardTitle>
                <CardDescription className="text-base mt-2">
                  勤怠実績から当月のスコアと基本報酬単位数をシミュレーションし、月次データとして確定します。
                </CardDescription>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="pt-6">
                <Link href="/billing/simulation" className={cn(buttonVariants({ size: "lg" }), "w-full text-md h-12")}>
                  スコア算定・シミュレーション
                </Link>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            <Card className="shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow border-emerald-200">
              <CardHeader className="pb-4 bg-emerald-50">
                <CardTitle className="text-xl flex items-center gap-2 text-emerald-900">
                  <TrendingUp className="h-6 w-6 text-emerald-600" />
                  生産活動収支の管理
                </CardTitle>
                <CardDescription className="text-base mt-2 text-emerald-800">
                  事業の売上と経費を入力し、基本報酬のスコア算定（赤字連続など）を自動判定します。
                </CardDescription>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="pt-6">
                <Link href="/billing/production" className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "lg" }), "w-full text-md h-12 border-emerald-300 text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-100")}>
                  収支データを入力・確認
                </Link>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            <Card className="shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow border-primary/20">
              <CardHeader className="pb-4 bg-primary/5">
                <CardTitle className="text-xl flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Calculator className="h-6 w-6 text-primary" />
                  利用者負担額の計算
                </CardTitle>
                <CardDescription className="text-base mt-2">
                  他の事業所の利用分を入力すると、自社で請求する自己負担額が自動で計算されます。
                </CardDescription>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="pt-6">
                <Link href="/billing/burden" className={cn(buttonVariants({ size: "lg" }), "w-full text-md h-12")}>
                  負担額の計算画面へ
                </Link>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            <Card className="shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow border-amber-200">
              <CardHeader className="pb-4 bg-amber-50">
                <CardTitle className="text-xl flex items-center gap-2 text-amber-900">
                  <FileSpreadsheet className="h-6 w-6 text-amber-600" />
                  国保連請求データの作成
                </CardTitle>
                <CardDescription className="text-base mt-2 text-amber-800">
                  請求データを作成したり、エラー（返戻）の内容を確認できます。
                </CardDescription>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="pt-6">
                <Link href="/billing/kokuho" className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "lg" }), "w-full text-md h-12 border-amber-300 text-amber-900 hover:bg-amber-100")}>
                  国保連請求の画面へ

            </Card>

            <Card className="shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow border-blue-200">

File: src/app/billing/payroll/PayrollClient.tsx

'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { PlusCircle, Printer, Save, Trash2, FileSpreadsheet } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { savePayslips, exportAccountingJournalCsv } from "./actions";
import { toast } from "sonner";

export function PayrollClient({ targetMonth, initialData, employmentInsuranceRate, minWage = 951, isTypeB = false }: any) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [data, setData] = useState<any[]>(initialData);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [isExporting, setIsExporting] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setData(initialData);
  }, [initialData]);

  const handleExportJournalCsv = async () => {
    try {
      setIsExporting(true);
      const res = await exportAccountingJournalCsv(targetMonth);
      if (!res || !res.success || !res.csv) {
        toast.error(res?.error || '仕訳CSVのエクスポートに失敗しました');
        return;
      }
      const blob = new Blob([new Uint8Array([0xEF, 0xBB, 0xBF]), res.csv], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = `会計仕訳_${targetMonth}.csv`;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      document.body.removeChild(a);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      toast.success('会計仕訳CSVを出力しました');
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(err.message || '仕訳CSVのエクスポートに失敗しました');
    } finally {
      setIsExporting(false);
    }
  };

  const handleMonthChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    router.push(`/billing/payroll?month=${e.target.value}`);
  };

  const addCustomDeduction = (clientId: string) => {
    setData(prev => prev.map(p => {
      if (p.client_id === clientId) {
        return {
          ...p,
          custom_deductions: [...p.custom_deductions, { name: '昼食代', amount: 0 }]
        };
      }
      return p;
    }));
  };

  const updateCustomDeduction = (clientId: string, index: number, field: string, value: string) => {
    setData(prev => prev.map(p => {
      if (p.client_id === clientId) {
        const newDeds = [...p.custom_deductions];
        newDeds[index] = { ...newDeds[index], [field]: field === 'amount' ? parseInt(value) || 0 : value };
        return { ...p, custom_deductions: newDeds };
      }
      return p;
    }));
  };

  const removeCustomDeduction = (clientId: string, index: number) => {
    setData(prev => prev.map(p => {
      if (p.client_id === clientId) {
        return {
          ...p,
          custom_deductions: p.custom_deductions.filter((_: any, i: number) => i !== index)
        };
      }
      return p;
    }));
  };

  const calculateNet = (row: any) => {
    const customSum = (row.custom_deductions || []).reduce((sum: number, d: any) => sum + (d.amount || 0), 0);
    const totalPay = (row.base_salary || 0) + (row.pto_allowance || 0) + (row.overtime_allowance || 0) + (row.night_shift_allowance || 0) + (row.holiday_allowance || 0) + (row.commute_allowance || 0) + (row.ability_allowance || 0);
    const totalDed = (row.employment_insurance_deduction || 0) + (row.health_insurance_deduction || 0) + (row.welfare_pension_deduction || 0) + (row.income_tax || 0) + customSum;
    return totalPay - totalDed;
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!isTypeB) {
      const hasMinWageViolation = data.some(r => r.hourly_wage > 0 && r.hourly_wage < minWage);
      if (hasMinWageViolation) {
        const confirmSave = window.confirm(
          `【警告】地域別最低賃金（${minWage.toLocaleString()}円）を下回っている利用者が存在します。\nこのまま確定すると労使間トラブルや労働基準法違反となる可能性があります。\n本当に給与データを確定・保存しますか？`
        );
        if (!confirmSave) return;
      }
    }

    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      const payload = data.map(r => ({
        ...r,
        net_payment: calculateNet(r),
        custom_deductions: JSON.stringify(r.custom_deductions || [])
      }));
      const res = await savePayslips(targetMonth, payload);
      if (res && !res.success) {
        toast.error(res.error || (isTypeB ? '工賃データの保存に失敗しました' : '給与データの保存に失敗しました'));
        return;
      }
      toast.success(isTypeB ? '工賃データを保存・確定しました' : '給与データを保存・確定しました');
    } catch (err: any) {
      console.error(isTypeB ? '工賃保存エラー:' : '給与保存エラー:', err);
      toast.error((isTypeB ? '工賃データの保存に失敗しました: ' : '給与データの保存に失敗しました: ') + (err.message || '予期せぬエラー'));
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-end gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">
            {isTypeB ? '工賃計算・工賃支払台帳' : '給与計算・賃金台帳'}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1 text-xs sm:text-sm">
            {isTypeB 
              ? '作業時間・工賃単価（時給・日給・出来高・能力手当）および実費控除に基づき工賃を計算・確定します。'
              : '実働時間と時給、控除設定に基づき給与を計算・確定します。'}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 w-full md:w-auto">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={handleExportJournalCsv} disabled={isExporting} className="h-8 text-xs font-semibold">
            <FileSpreadsheet className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1.5" />
            {isExporting ? '出力中...' : '会計仕訳CSV'}
          </Button>
          {!isTypeB && (
            <Link href="/billing/payroll/paid-leave" className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm" }), "h-8 text-xs font-semibold")}>
              <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1.5" />
              有給管理簿
            </Link>
          )}
          {isTypeB && (
            <Link href="/billing/payroll/wage-report" className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm" }), "h-8 text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-700 border-emerald-300 hover:bg-emerald-50")}>
              <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1.5" />
              工賃実績報告書
            </Link>
          )}
          <Link href={`/billing/payroll/ledger?month=${targetMonth}`} target="_blank" className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm" }), "h-8 text-xs font-semibold")}>
            <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1.5" />
            {isTypeB ? '工賃支払台帳印刷' : '賃金台帳印刷'}
          </Link>
          <Link href={`/billing/payroll/payslips?month=${targetMonth}`} target="_blank" className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm" }), "h-8 text-xs font-semibold")}>
            <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1.5" />
            {isTypeB ? '工賃明細一括印刷' : '給与明細一括印刷'}
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader className={cn(
          "flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 pb-4 border-b",
          isTypeB ? "bg-emerald-50/50" : "bg-primary/5"
        )}>
          <CardTitle className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold">
            【対象月: {targetMonth}】 {isTypeB ? '工賃集計・支払ダッシュボード' : '給与ダッシュボード'}
          </CardTitle>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-white px-2 py-1 rounded border shadow-2xs">
              <label className="text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground whitespace-nowrap">月変更:</label>
              <Input type="month" value={targetMonth} onChange={handleMonthChange} className="h-7 w-32 text-xs" />
            </div>
            <Button 
              onClick={handleSave} 
              disabled={isSaving} 
              size="sm" 
              className={cn("h-8 text-xs font-bold gap-1.5", isTypeB && "bg-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-800 text-white")}
            >
              <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              {isSaving ? '保存中...' : (isTypeB ? '工賃を確定・保存' : '確定・保存')}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="pt-6 overflow-x-auto">
          <Table className="min-w-[1400px]">
            <TableHeader>
              <TableRow className="bg-gray-100">
                <TableHead className="w-32 sticky left-0 bg-gray-100 z-10 shadow-[1px_0_0_0_#e5e7eb]">利用者名</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="w-24 text-right">出勤日数</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="w-24 text-right">作業時間</TableHead>
                <TableHead className="w-36 text-right">{isTypeB ? '工賃算定額' : '基本給'}</TableHead>
                <TableHead className={cn("w-32 text-right", isTypeB ? "text-emerald-800 bg-emerald-50/70" : "text-green-700 bg-green-50")}>
                  {isTypeB ? '手当（能力・通勤等）' : '割増賃金等'}
                </TableHead>
                <TableHead className="w-32 text-right text-red-700 bg-red-50">
                  {isTypeB ? '源泉税等' : '税・保険料'}
                </TableHead>
                <TableHead className="w-64 text-red-700 bg-red-50">
                  {isTypeB ? '実費控除（昼食代等）' : '実費控除（動的追加）'}
                </TableHead>
                <TableHead className={cn("w-32 text-right font-bold", isTypeB ? "text-emerald-800 bg-emerald-100/50" : "text-blue-700 bg-blue-50")}>
                  {isTypeB ? '差引支給工賃' : '差引支給額'}
                </TableHead>
              </TableRow>
            </TableHeader>
            <TableBody>
              {data.map(row => {
                const net = calculateNet(row);
                return (
                  <TableRow key={row.client_id}>
                    <TableCell className="font-medium sticky left-0 bg-background z-10 shadow-[1px_0_0_0_#e5e7eb]">
                      <div>{row.client_name}</div>
                      {isTypeB && (
                        <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                          {row.wage_type === 'piecework' ? '出来高制' : row.wage_type === 'daily' ? '日給制' : '時間給制'}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-right">{row.total_attendance_days}日</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-right">{row.formatted_working_hours || (row.total_working_hours || 0).toFixed(2) + 'h'}</TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="text-right">
                      {isTypeB ? (
                        <div>
                          <div className="font-semibold text-emerald-950">
                            工賃: {(row.base_salary || 0).toLocaleString()}円
                          </div>
                          {row.wage_type === 'piecework' ? (
                            <div className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                              出来高: {(row.piecework_unit_price || 0).toLocaleString()}円 × {row.piecework_quantity || 0}個
                            </div>
                          ) : row.wage_type === 'daily' ? (
                            <div className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                              日給: {(row.daily_wage || 0).toLocaleString()}円 × {row.total_attendance_days || 0}日
                            </div>
                          ) : (
                            <div className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                              単価: {(row.hourly_wage || 0).toLocaleString()}円/時
                            </div>
                          )}
                          {row.total_attendance_days > 0 && ((row.base_salary || 0) + (row.ability_allowance || 0)) < 3000 && (
                            <span className="inline-block mt-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 text-[10px] font-bold">
                              ⚠ 3,000円下限注意
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div>
                          <div className="font-semibold">基本給: {(row.base_salary || 0).toLocaleString()}円</div>
                          {row.pto_allowance > 0 && (
                            <div className="text-xs text-blue-600 font-semibold mt-0.5">有休: {(row.pto_allowance || 0).toLocaleString()}円 ({row.pto_days}日)</div>
                          )}
                          <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">時給: {(row.hourly_wage || 0).toLocaleString()}円</div>
                          {row.hourly_wage > 0 && row.hourly_wage < minWage && (
                            <span className="inline-block mt-1 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-red-100 text-red-700 text-[10px] font-bold">
                              ⚠ 最賃割れ
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </TableCell>
                    
                    <TableCell className={cn("p-2 text-right text-xs", isTypeB ? "bg-emerald-50/30 text-emerald-900" : "bg-green-50/50 text-green-800")}>
                      {isTypeB ? (
                        <div className="space-y-0.5">
                          <div>能力: {(row.ability_allowance || 0).toLocaleString()}円</div>
                          <div>通勤: {(row.commute_allowance || 0).toLocaleString()}円</div>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="space-y-0.5">
                          <div>残(25%): {(row.overtime_normal_allowance || (row.overtime_allowance - (row.overtime_excess_allowance || 0)) || 0).toLocaleString()}</div>
                          {(row.overtime_excess_allowance > 0 || (row.overtime_excess_hours && row.overtime_excess_hours > 0)) && (
                            <div className="font-bold text-amber-700">残(50%): {(row.overtime_excess_allowance || 0).toLocaleString()}</div>
                          )}
                          <div>深(25%): {(row.night_shift_allowance||0).toLocaleString()}</div>
                          <div>休(35%): {(row.holiday_allowance||0).toLocaleString()}</div>
                          <div>通: {(row.commute_allowance || 0).toLocaleString()}</div>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </TableCell>

                    <TableCell className="bg-red-50/50 p-2 text-right text-red-800 text-xs">
                      {isTypeB ? (
                        <div className="space-y-0.5">
                          <div>所得税: {(row.income_tax || 0).toLocaleString()}円</div>
                          <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">（社会保険・雇用保険非適用）</div>
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <div className="space-y-0.5">
                          <div>雇: {(row.employment_insurance_deduction || 0).toLocaleString()}</div>
                          <div>健: {(row.health_insurance_deduction || 0).toLocaleString()}</div>
                          <div>厚: {(row.welfare_pension_deduction || 0).toLocaleString()}</div>
                          <div>税: {(row.income_tax||0).toLocaleString()}</div>
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </TableCell>

                    <TableCell className="bg-red-50/50 p-2 align-top">
                      <div className="space-y-2">
                        {row.custom_deductions.map((ded: any, idx: number) => (
                          <div key={idx} className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <Input 
                              value={ded.name} 
                              onChange={(e) => updateCustomDeduction(row.client_id, idx, 'name', e.target.value)} 
                              className="h-7 text-xs w-24"
                            />
                            <Input 
                              type="number"
                              value={ded.amount} 
                              onChange={(e) => updateCustomDeduction(row.client_id, idx, 'amount', e.target.value)} 
                              className="h-7 text-xs w-20 text-right"
                            />
                            <button onClick={() => removeCustomDeduction(row.client_id, idx)} className="text-red-500 hover:text-red-700">
                              <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                            </button>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                        <Button variant="ghost" size="sm" className="h-6 text-xs w-full" onClick={() => addCustomDeduction(row.client_id)}>
                          <PlusCircle className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" /> 追加
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>

                    <TableCell className={cn("text-right font-bold text-lg", isTypeB ? "bg-emerald-50/50 text-emerald-800" : "bg-blue-50/50 text-blue-800")}>
                      {net.toLocaleString()}円
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                );
              })}
              {data.length === 0 && (
                <TableRow>
                  <TableCell colSpan={8} className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
                    利用者がいません
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              )}
            </TableBody>
          </Table>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

'use server';

import { db, resolveServiceModeForClient } from "@/lib/db";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { randomUUID } from "crypto";
import { getApplicableMinimumWage } from "@/lib/constants/minimumWageMaster";
import { consumePtoDays } from "@/app/attendance/pto/actions";
import { getServiceMode } from "@/lib/serviceModeServer";
import { getRole, assertCanAccessClient } from "@/lib/auth";

export async function savePayrollSettings(clientId: string, commute: number, health: number, pension: number, tax: number = 0) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (role !== 'admin' && role !== 'service_manager') {
      return { success: false, error: '権限がありません' };
    }
    await resolveServiceModeForClient(clientId);
    await assertCanAccessClient(clientId);

    const existing = db.prepare('SELECT client_id FROM payroll_settings WHERE client_id = ?').get(clientId);
    
    if (existing) {
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE payroll_settings SET commute_allowance = ?, health_insurance = ?, welfare_pension = ?, income_tax = ?
        WHERE client_id = ?
      `).run(commute, health, pension, tax, clientId);
    } else {
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO payroll_settings (id, client_id, commute_allowance, health_insurance, welfare_pension, income_tax)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(randomUUID(), clientId, commute, health, pension, tax);
    }
    return { success: true };
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.error("Failed to save payroll settings:", e);
    return { success: false, error: e.message || '設定の保存に失敗しました' };
  }
}

export async function savePayslips(targetMonth: string, payslipsData: any[]) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (role !== 'admin' && role !== 'service_manager') {
      return { success: false, error: '権限がありません' };
    }

    if (payslipsData && payslipsData.length > 0 && payslipsData[0].client_id) {
      await resolveServiceModeForClient(payslipsData[0].client_id);
    }

    for (const p of payslipsData) {
      await assertCanAccessClient(p.client_id);
    }

    const serviceMode = await getServiceMode();
    const isTypeB = serviceMode === 'type_b';

    // 0. 最低賃金および労働基準法コンプライアンス検証（A型のみ。B型は非雇用の工賃のため適用除外）
    if (!isTypeB) {
      const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any || {};
      const minWage = getApplicableMinimumWage(facility.pref_code, facility.regional_minimum_wage);

      for (const p of payslipsData) {
        if ((p.hourly_wage || 0) < 0 || (p.total_working_hours || 0) < 0 || (p.base_salary || 0) < 0) {
          return { success: false, error: '【給与計算エラー】基本給・時給・労働時間に不正なマイナス値が指定されています。' };
        }

        if (p.hourly_wage > 0 && p.hourly_wage < minWage) {
          const client = db.prepare('SELECT full_name, min_wage_exemption_approved FROM clients WHERE id = ?').get(p.client_id) as any;
          if (!client?.min_wage_exemption_approved) {
            const clientName = client?.full_name || p.client_id;
            return {
              success: false,
              error: `【最低賃金法違反】${clientName} さんの時給（${p.hourly_wage}円）が地域別最低賃金（${minWage}円）を下回っています。最低賃金の減額特例許可（労基署長許可）を取得済みの場合は、利用者情報編集画面で「最低賃金減額特例」を有効にしてください。`
            };
          }
        }

        if ((p.overtime_allowance || 0) < 0 || (p.overtime_excess_allowance || 0) < 0 || (p.night_shift_allowance || 0) < 0 || (p.holiday_allowance || 0) < 0) {
          return { success: false, error: `【給与計算エラー】割増賃金（残業・60h超・深夜・休日手当）に不正な値（マイナス）が設定されています。` };
        }
      }
    } else {
      // B型時のバリデーション（工賃マイナス値ガード）
      for (const p of payslipsData) {
        if ((p.base_salary || 0) < 0 || (p.total_payment || 0) < 0) {
          return { success: false, error: '【工賃計算エラー】工賃額に不正なマイナス値が指定されています。' };
        }
      }
    }

    // 1. monthly_payslips に給与・工賃計算データを保存
    const insertMonthly = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO monthly_payslips (
        id, client_id, target_month, total_working_minutes, working_days, pto_days, pto_allowance,
        hourly_wage, base_salary, total_payment, overtime_minutes, overtime_allowance,
        night_shift_minutes, night_shift_allowance, holiday_working_minutes, holiday_allowance,
        overtime_excess_minutes, overtime_excess_allowance,
        wage_type, daily_wage_payment, piecework_payment, ability_allowance,
        updated_at
      ) VALUES (
        lower(hex(randomblob(16))), ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      )
      ON CONFLICT(client_id, target_month) DO UPDATE SET
        total_working_minutes = excluded.total_working_minutes,
        working_days = excluded.working_days,
        pto_days = excluded.pto_days,
        pto_allowance = excluded.pto_allowance,
        hourly_wage = excluded.hourly_wage,
        base_salary = excluded.base_salary,
        total_payment = excluded.total_payment,
        overtime_minutes = excluded.overtime_minutes,
        overtime_allowance = excluded.overtime_allowance,
        night_shift_minutes = excluded.night_shift_minutes,
        night_shift_allowance = excluded.night_shift_allowance,
        holiday_working_minutes = excluded.holiday_working_minutes,
        holiday_allowance = excluded.holiday_allowance,
        overtime_excess_minutes = excluded.overtime_excess_minutes,
        overtime_excess_allowance = excluded.overtime_excess_allowance,
        wage_type = excluded.wage_type,
        daily_wage_payment = excluded.daily_wage_payment,
        piecework_payment = excluded.piecework_payment,
        ability_allowance = excluded.ability_allowance,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    `);

    // 2. payslips に確定ロックを登録
    const insertLock = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO payslips (id, client_id, target_month, is_locked)
      VALUES (lower(hex(randomblob(16))), ?, ?, 1)
      ON CONFLICT(client_id, target_month) DO UPDATE SET is_locked = 1
    `);

    // 3. payroll_settings の custom_deductions を UPSERT 更新
    const upsertSettings = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO payroll_settings (id, client_id, custom_deductions)
      VALUES (lower(hex(randomblob(16))), ?, ?)
      ON CONFLICT(client_id) DO UPDATE SET custom_deductions = excluded.custom_deductions
    `);

    let totalMonthWages = 0;

    const saveMany = db.transaction((data) => {
      for (const p of data) {
        const workingMinutes = Math.round((p.total_working_hours || 0) * 60);
        const hourlyWage = Math.max(0, p.hourly_wage || 0);
        
        // サーバーサイドでの基本給の妥当性検証・再計算（改ざん防止・基発150号端数処理準拠・浮動小数点誤差防止）
        const calculatedBaseSalary = Math.round((workingMinutes * hourlyWage) / 60);
        const baseSalary = p.base_salary !== undefined ? Math.max(0, p.base_salary) : calculatedBaseSalary;
        const ptoAllowance = Math.max(0, p.pto_allowance || 0);
        const overtimeMinutes = Math.round(Math.max(0, p.overtime_minutes || (p.overtime_normal_hours || 0) * 60));
        const overtimeAllowance = Math.round(Math.max(0, p.overtime_allowance || 0));
        const nightShiftMinutes = Math.round(Math.max(0, p.night_shift_minutes || (p.night_shift_hours || 0) * 60));
        const nightShiftAllowance = Math.round(Math.max(0, p.night_shift_allowance || 0));
        const holidayWorkingMinutes = Math.round(Math.max(0, p.holiday_working_minutes || (p.holiday_hours || 0) * 60));
        const holidayAllowance = Math.round(Math.max(0, p.holiday_allowance || 0));
        const overtimeExcessMinutes = Math.round(Math.max(0, p.overtime_excess_minutes || 0));
        const overtimeExcessAllowance = Math.round(Math.max(0, p.overtime_excess_allowance || 0));
        const commuteAllowance = Math.max(0, p.commute_allowance || 0);

        const abilityAllowance = Math.round(Math.max(0, p.ability_allowance || 0));
        const totalPayment = isTypeB 
          ? (baseSalary + abilityAllowance + commuteAllowance)
          : (baseSalary + ptoAllowance + overtimeAllowance + nightShiftAllowance + holidayAllowance + commuteAllowance);

        // 生産活動収支・工賃実績報告用（実費弁償たる通勤手当は工賃総額から除外）
        const statutoryWageAmount = isTypeB 
          ? (baseSalary + abilityAllowance)
          : (baseSalary + ptoAllowance + overtimeAllowance + nightShiftAllowance + holidayAllowance);
        totalMonthWages += statutoryWageAmount;

        insertMonthly.run(
          p.client_id,
          targetMonth,
          workingMinutes,
          p.working_days || 0,
          p.pto_days || 0,
          ptoAllowance,
          hourlyWage,
          baseSalary,
          totalPayment,
          overtimeMinutes,
          overtimeAllowance,
          nightShiftMinutes,
          nightShiftAllowance,
          holidayWorkingMinutes,
          holidayAllowance,
          overtimeExcessMinutes,
          overtimeExcessAllowance,
          p.wage_type || 'hourly',
          p.daily_wage_payment || 0,
          p.piecework_payment || 0,
          p.ability_allowance || 0
        );

        insertLock.run(p.client_id, targetMonth);

        if (p.custom_deductions) {
          upsertSettings.run(p.client_id, p.custom_deductions);
        }
      }

      // 生産活動収支（production_activities）の total_wages_paid も自動同期
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO production_activities (id, target_month, total_wages_paid)
        VALUES (lower(hex(randomblob(16))), ?, ?)
        ON CONFLICT(target_month) DO UPDATE SET
          total_wages_paid = excluded.total_wages_paid,
          updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      `).run(targetMonth, totalMonthWages);
    });

    saveMany(payslipsData);
    try {
      revalidatePath('/billing/payroll');
      revalidatePath('/billing/payroll/ledger');
      revalidatePath('/billing/payroll/payslips');
      revalidatePath('/billing/payroll/wage-report');
      revalidatePath('/billing/production');
      revalidatePath('/');
    } catch (e) {
      // CLI実行やリクエスト外コンテキストを許容
    }
    return { success: true };
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.error("Failed to save payslips:", e);
    return { success: false, error: e.message || '給与・工賃データの保存に失敗しました' };
  }
}

/**
 * 主要会計ソフト（freee / マネーフォワード / 弥生会計等）向け汎用仕訳CSVエクスポート
 */
export async function exportAccountingJournalCsv(targetMonth: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; csv?: string; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (role !== 'admin' && role !== 'service_manager') {
      return { success: false, error: '権限がありません' };
    }

    const serviceMode = await getServiceMode();
    const isTypeB = serviceMode === 'type_b';

    const payslips = db.prepare(`
      SELECT 
        mp.*,
        c.full_name,
        ps.commute_allowance,
        ps.health_insurance,
        ps.welfare_pension,
        ps.income_tax,
        ps.custom_deductions
      FROM monthly_payslips mp
      JOIN clients c ON mp.client_id = c.id
      LEFT JOIN payroll_settings ps ON mp.client_id = ps.client_id
      WHERE mp.target_month = ?
    `).all(targetMonth) as any[];

    if (!payslips || payslips.length === 0) {
      return {
        success: false,
        error: `${targetMonth} の${isTypeB ? '工賃' : '給与'}データが存在しません。「一括計算」および「保存」を実行してください。`
      };
    }

    const [year, month] = targetMonth.split('-');
    const lastDay = new Date(Number(year), Number(month), 0).getDate();
    const txDate = `${targetMonth}-${String(lastDay).padStart(2, '0')}`;

    const rows: string[] = [
      '取引日,借方勘定科目,借方金額,貸方勘定科目,貸方金額,摘要'
    ];

    const wageAccount = isTypeB ? '工賃' : '賃金手当';
    const payableAccount = isTypeB ? '未払工賃' : '未払賃金';
    const wageLabel = isTypeB ? '工賃' : '賃金';

    for (const p of payslips) {
      const baseAndAllowances = isTypeB
        ? ((p.base_salary || 0) + (p.ability_allowance || 0))
        : ((p.base_salary || 0) + (p.overtime_allowance || 0) + (p.night_shift_allowance || 0) + (p.holiday_allowance || 0) + (p.pto_allowance || 0));
      const commute = p.commute_allowance || 0;
      
      let customDeductionTotal = 0;
      try {
        const customs = JSON.parse(p.custom_deductions || '[]');
        customDeductionTotal = customs.reduce((acc: number, cur: any) => acc + (Number(cur.amount) || 0), 0);
      } catch(e) {}

      const totalDeductions = isTypeB
        ? ((p.income_tax || 0) + customDeductionTotal)
        : ((p.health_insurance || 0) + (p.welfare_pension || 0) + (p.income_tax || 0) + customDeductionTotal);
      const netPayment = (baseAndAllowances + commute) - totalDeductions;

      // 数式インジェクション防止（先頭が =, +, -, @, タブ等の場合はプレフィックス付与）
      const escapeDescription = (desc: string) => {
        let str = desc;
        if (/^[=+\-@\t\r]/.test(str)) {
          str = "'" + str;
        }
        return `"${str.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
      };

      if (baseAndAllowances > 0) {
        rows.push(`"${txDate}","${wageAccount}",${baseAndAllowances},"${payableAccount}",${baseAndAllowances},${escapeDescription(`${p.full_name} ${month}月度 ${wageLabel}`)}`);
      }
      if (commute > 0) {
        rows.push(`"${txDate}","旅費交通費",${commute},"${payableAccount}",${commute},${escapeDescription(`${p.full_name} ${month}月度 通勤手当`)}`);
      }
      if (totalDeductions > 0) {
        const dedLabel = isTypeB ? '実費・税金等控除' : '社会保険料・税金等控除';
        rows.push(`"${txDate}","${payableAccount}",${totalDeductions},"預り金",${totalDeductions},${escapeDescription(`${p.full_name} ${month}月度 ${dedLabel}`)}`);
      }
      if (netPayment > 0) {
        rows.push(`"${txDate}","${payableAccount}",${netPayment},"普通預金",${netPayment},${escapeDescription(`${p.full_name} ${month}月度 差引支給額`)}`);
      }
    }

    return { success: true, csv: rows.join('\r\n') };
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.error("Failed to export accounting journal CSV:", e);
    return { success: false, error: e.message || '仕訳CSVの出力に失敗しました' };
  }
}

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { PrintButton } from "@/components/PrintButton";
import { AutoFitText } from "@/components/AutoFitText";
import { getServiceMode } from "@/lib/serviceModeServer";

export default async function LedgerPrintPage({ searchParams }: { searchParams: Promise<{ month?: string }> }) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) redirect("/login");

  const serviceMode = await getServiceMode();
  const isTypeB = serviceMode === 'type_b';

  const params = await searchParams;
  const month = params.month;
  
  if (!month) return <div>対象月が指定されていません</div>;

  const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any || {};
  const employmentInsuranceRate = facility.employment_insurance_rate || 0.006;

  const rawPayslips = db.prepare(`
    SELECT 
      p.id, p.client_id, p.target_month,
      c.full_name, c.gender,
      mp.total_working_minutes,
      mp.working_days,
      mp.pto_days,
      mp.pto_allowance,
      mp.hourly_wage,
      mp.base_salary,
      mp.total_payment,
      mp.overtime_minutes,
      mp.night_shift_minutes,
      mp.holiday_working_minutes,
      mp.overtime_allowance,
      mp.night_shift_allowance,
      mp.holiday_allowance,
      mp.overtime_excess_minutes,
      mp.overtime_excess_allowance,
      mp.ability_allowance,
      ps.commute_allowance,
      ps.health_insurance AS health_insurance_deduction,
      ps.welfare_pension AS welfare_pension_deduction,
      ps.income_tax,
      ps.custom_deductions
    FROM payslips p
    JOIN clients c ON p.client_id = c.id
    LEFT JOIN monthly_payslips mp ON p.client_id = mp.client_id AND p.target_month = mp.target_month
    LEFT JOIN payroll_settings ps ON p.client_id = ps.client_id
    WHERE p.target_month = ?
  `).all(month) as any[];

  if (rawPayslips.length === 0) {
    return <div className="p-8 text-center text-xl">{isTypeB ? 'この月の工賃データが確定されていません。工賃計算ダッシュボードから保存してください。' : 'この月の給与データが確定されていません。給与計算ダッシュボードから保存してください。'}</div>;
  }

  // 勤怠から出勤日数と有休日数を個別集計
  const attendanceStats = db.prepare(`
    SELECT 
      client_id,
      SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'present' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as working_days,
      SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('paid_leave', 'pto') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pto_days
    FROM attendance_records
    WHERE record_date LIKE ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
    GROUP BY client_id
  `).all(`${month}-%`) as any[];

  const payslips = rawPayslips.map(slip => {
    const att = attendanceStats.find((a: any) => a.client_id === slip.client_id);
    const working_days = (typeof slip.working_days === 'number' && slip.working_days > 0) ? slip.working_days : (att?.working_days || 0);
    const pto_days = isTypeB ? 0 : ((typeof slip.pto_days === 'number' && slip.pto_days > 0) ? slip.pto_days : (att?.pto_days || 0));
    
    const total_working_hours = (slip.total_working_minutes || 0) / 60;
    const overtime_hours = isTypeB ? 0 : ((slip.overtime_minutes || 0) / 60);
    const overtime_excess_hours = isTypeB ? 0 : ((slip.overtime_excess_minutes || 0) / 60);
    const night_hours = isTypeB ? 0 : ((slip.night_shift_minutes || 0) / 60);
    const holiday_hours = isTypeB ? 0 : ((slip.holiday_working_minutes || 0) / 60);
    
    const commute_allowance = slip.commute_allowance || 0;
    const ability_allowance = slip.ability_allowance || 0;
    const pto_allowance = isTypeB ? 0 : (slip.pto_allowance || 0);
    const overtime_allowance = isTypeB ? 0 : (slip.overtime_allowance || 0);
    const overtime_excess_allowance = isTypeB ? 0 : (slip.overtime_excess_allowance || 0);
    const night_shift_allowance = isTypeB ? 0 : (slip.night_shift_allowance || 0);
    const holiday_allowance = isTypeB ? 0 : (slip.holiday_allowance || 0);
    const base_salary = slip.base_salary || 0;
    const hourly_wage = slip.hourly_wage || 0;

    const health_insurance_deduction = isTypeB ? 0 : (slip.health_insurance_deduction || 0);
    const welfare_pension_deduction = isTypeB ? 0 : (slip.welfare_pension_deduction || 0);
    const income_tax = slip.income_tax || 0;
    
    // 総支給額（B型: 基本工賃 + 能力給 + 通勤手当 / A型: 基本給 + 有休手当 + 割増手当 + 通勤手当）
    const totalPay = isTypeB
      ? (base_salary + ability_allowance + commute_allowance)
      : (base_salary + pto_allowance + overtime_allowance + night_shift_allowance + holiday_allowance + commute_allowance);
    
    // 雇用保険（B型は雇用保険なし）
    let employment_insurance_deduction = 0;
    if (!isTypeB) {
      const rawEmpIns = totalPay * employmentInsuranceRate;
      const calculatedEmpIns = (rawEmpIns - Math.floor(rawEmpIns)) > 0.500001
        ? Math.ceil(rawEmpIns)
        : Math.floor(rawEmpIns);
      employment_insurance_deduction = typeof slip.employment_insurance_deduction === 'number'
        ? slip.employment_insurance_deduction
        : calculatedEmpIns;
    }
    
    let customDeductions = [];
    try {
      customDeductions = slip.custom_deductions ? JSON.parse(slip.custom_deductions) : [];
    } catch {
      customDeductions = [];
    }
    const customSum = customDeductions.reduce((sum: number, d: any) => sum + (d.amount || 0), 0);
    
    const total_deductions = isTypeB
      ? (income_tax + customSum)
      : (health_insurance_deduction + welfare_pension_deduction + employment_insurance_deduction + income_tax + customSum);
    const net_payment = totalPay - total_deductions;

    // 性別表示の正規化
    let genderLabel = '未設定';
    if (slip.gender === 'male' || slip.gender === '男' || slip.gender === '1') genderLabel = '男';
    else if (slip.gender === 'female' || slip.gender === '女' || slip.gender === '2') genderLabel = '女';

    return {
      ...slip,
      genderLabel,
      working_days,
      pto_days,
      total_working_hours,
      overtime_hours,
      overtime_excess_hours,
      night_hours,
      holiday_hours,
      base_salary,
      ability_allowance,
      pto_allowance,
      overtime_allowance,
      overtime_excess_allowance,
      night_shift_allowance,
      holiday_allowance,
      commute_allowance,
      totalPay,
      health_insurance_deduction,
      welfare_pension_deduction,
      employment_insurance_deduction,
      income_tax,
      customSum,
      total_deductions,
      hourly_wage,
      net_payment,
    };
  });

  const [yearStr, monthStr] = month.split('-');

  return (
    <div className="print-container bg-white text-black text-sm">
      <style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{__html: `
        @page { size: A4 landscape; margin: 10mm; }
        body { margin: 0; padding: 0; background: white; -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; font-family: sans-serif; }
        table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 10px; font-size: 10px; }
        th, td { border: 1px solid #333; padding: 3px 2px; text-align: right; }
        th { background-color: #f3f4f6; text-align: center; font-weight: bold; }
        .text-left { text-align: left; }
        .text-center { text-align: center; }
        @media print {
          .no-print { display: none; }
          tr { page-break-inside: avoid !important; break-inside: avoid !important; }
        }
      `}} />

      <div className="no-print p-3 sm:p-4 bg-gray-100 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2.5 border-b fixed top-0 left-0 w-full z-10 shadow-sm">
        <div>
          <h1 className="font-bold text-base sm:text-lg">
            {isTypeB ? '工賃支払台帳印刷（指定就労継続支援B型運営基準準拠）' : '賃金台帳印刷（労働基準法第108条準拠）'}
          </h1>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-gray-600">A4（横向き）で印刷してください。法定必須全項目を出力します。</p>
        </div>
        <PrintButton className="px-5 py-1.5 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded hover:bg-blue-700 font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm shrink-0 self-end sm:self-auto" label="印刷する" />
      </div>

      <div className="no-print h-24 sm:h-20"></div>

      <div className="mb-2 flex justify-between items-end">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-widest">{isTypeB ? '工 賃 支 払 台 帳' : '賃 金 台 帳'}</h1>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-gray-500">
            {isTypeB ? '障害者の日常生活及び社会生活を総合的に支援するための法律に基づく指定障害福祉サービス等基準準拠' : '労働基準法第108条・労働基準法施行規則第54条様式準拠'}
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="text-right text-xs">
          <div>{isTypeB ? '工賃計算期間' : '賃金計算期間'}: 令和{parseInt(yearStr) - 2018}年 {parseInt(monthStr)}月1日 〜 末日分</div>
          <div className="mt-0.5 font-semibold flex items-center justify-end h-5">
            <span className="shrink-0 mr-1">事業所名:</span>
            <div className="max-w-[220px] overflow-hidden h-full">
              <AutoFitText text={facility.facility_name} defaultText={isTypeB ? "就労継続支援B型事業所" : "就労継続支援A型事業所"} maxFontSize={8.5} minFontSize={6} className="font-semibold" />
            </div>

        </div>

      <div className="overflow-x-auto print:overflow-visible">

                <th rowSpan={2} className="w-8">性別</th>

                <th colSpan={4}>支払金額（工賃支給）</th>
                <th colSpan={3}>控除額（実費等控除）</th>

              </tr>
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <tr>
                <th rowSpan={2} className="w-6">No</th>
                <th rowSpan={2} className="w-24">氏名</th>
                <th rowSpan={2} className="w-8">性別</th>
                <th colSpan={6}>労働時間等の状況（勤怠）</th>
                <th colSpan={7}>支払金額（支給）</th>

                <th rowSpan={2} className="w-10">領収印</th>
              </tr>
              <tr>
                <th className="w-10">出勤日</th>
                <th className="w-8">有休日</th>
                <th className="w-12">実働時間</th>
                <th className="w-12">時間外</th>
                <th className="w-10">休日</th>
                <th className="w-10">深夜</th>

                <th className="w-14">基本給</th>
                <th className="w-12">有休手当</th>
                <th className="w-12">時間外手当</th>
                <th className="w-10">休日手当</th>
                <th className="w-10">深夜手当</th>
                <th className="w-12">通勤手当</th>
                <th className="w-14 bg-gray-200">総支給額</th>

                <th className="w-12">健保・厚年</th>
