                <th className="w-12">その他控除</th>
                <th className="w-14 bg-gray-200">控除計</th>
              </tr>
            </>
          )}
        </thead>
        <tbody>
          {payslips.map((slip, i) => {
            const healthWelfare = slip.health_insurance_deduction + slip.welfare_pension_deduction;

            if (isTypeB) {
              return (
                <tr key={slip.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50">
                  <td className="text-center">{i + 1}</td>
                  <td className="text-left font-medium p-1">
                    <div className="w-full h-5 overflow-hidden">
                      <AutoFitText text={slip.full_name} maxFontSize={8} minFontSize={5.5} className="font-medium" />
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  <td className="text-center">{slip.genderLabel}</td>

                  {/* 作業状況 */}
                  <td>{slip.working_days}日</td>
                  <td>{slip.total_working_hours.toFixed(1)}h</td>

                  {/* 工賃支給 */}
                  <td>{slip.base_salary.toLocaleString()}</td>
                  <td>{slip.ability_allowance > 0 ? slip.ability_allowance.toLocaleString() : '-'}</td>
                  <td>{slip.commute_allowance > 0 ? slip.commute_allowance.toLocaleString() : '-'}</td>
                  <td className="bg-gray-50 font-bold">{slip.totalPay.toLocaleString()}</td>

                  {/* 控除 */}
                  <td>{slip.income_tax > 0 ? slip.income_tax.toLocaleString() : '-'}</td>
                  <td>{slip.customSum > 0 ? slip.customSum.toLocaleString() : '-'}</td>
                  <td className="bg-gray-50 font-bold">{slip.total_deductions.toLocaleString()}</td>

                  {/* 差引支払額・印 */}
                  <td className="font-bold text-xs bg-blue-50/50">{slip.net_payment.toLocaleString()}</td>
                  <td></td>
                </tr>
              );
            }

            return (
              <tr key={slip.id} className="hover:bg-slate-50">
                <td className="text-center">{i + 1}</td>
                <td className="text-left font-medium p-1">
                  <div className="w-full h-5 overflow-hidden">
                    <AutoFitText text={slip.full_name} maxFontSize={8} minFontSize={5.5} className="font-medium" />
                  </div>
                </td>
                <td className="text-center">{slip.genderLabel}</td>
                
                {/* 勤怠 */}
                <td>{slip.working_days}日</td>
                <td>{slip.pto_days}日</td>
                <td>{slip.total_working_hours.toFixed(1)}h</td>
                <td>
                  {slip.overtime_hours > 0 ? (
                    <div>
                      <div>{slip.overtime_hours.toFixed(1)}h</div>
                      {slip.overtime_excess_hours > 0 && (
                        <div className="text-[8px] text-amber-700 leading-tight">内50%:{slip.overtime_excess_hours.toFixed(1)}h</div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ) : '-'}
                </td>
                <td>{slip.holiday_hours > 0 ? `${slip.holiday_hours.toFixed(1)}h` : '-'}</td>
                <td>{slip.night_hours > 0 ? `${slip.night_hours.toFixed(1)}h` : '-'}</td>
                
                {/* 支給 */}
                <td>{slip.base_salary.toLocaleString()}</td>
                <td>{slip.pto_allowance > 0 ? slip.pto_allowance.toLocaleString() : '-'}</td>
                <td>
                  {slip.overtime_allowance > 0 ? (
                    <div>
                      <div>{slip.overtime_allowance.toLocaleString()}</div>
                      {slip.overtime_excess_allowance > 0 && (
                        <div className="text-[8px] text-amber-700 leading-tight">内50%:{slip.overtime_excess_allowance.toLocaleString()}</div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ) : '-'}
                </td>
                <td>{slip.holiday_allowance > 0 ? slip.holiday_allowance.toLocaleString() : '-'}</td>
                <td>{slip.night_shift_allowance > 0 ? slip.night_shift_allowance.toLocaleString() : '-'}</td>
                <td>{slip.commute_allowance > 0 ? slip.commute_allowance.toLocaleString() : '-'}</td>
                <td className="bg-gray-50 font-bold">{slip.totalPay.toLocaleString()}</td>
                
                {/* 控除 */}
                <td>{healthWelfare > 0 ? healthWelfare.toLocaleString() : '-'}</td>
                <td>{slip.employment_insurance_deduction.toLocaleString()}</td>
                <td>{slip.income_tax > 0 ? slip.income_tax.toLocaleString() : '-'}</td>
                <td>{slip.customSum > 0 ? slip.customSum.toLocaleString() : '-'}</td>
                <td className="bg-gray-50 font-bold">{slip.total_deductions.toLocaleString()}</td>
                
                {/* 差引支給額・印 */}
                <td className="font-bold text-xs bg-blue-50/50">{slip.net_payment.toLocaleString()}</td>
                <td></td>
              </tr>
            );
          })}
        </tbody>
      </table>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


================================================================================
File: src/app/billing/payroll/page.tsx
================================================================================

import { Header } from "@/components/Header";
import { BillingSubNav } from "@/components/NavigationTabs";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { PayrollClient } from "./PayrollClient";
import { getApplicableMinimumWage } from "@/lib/constants/minimumWageMaster";
import { getAllClientsPaidLeaveStatus } from "@/lib/compliance/paidLeaveCalculator";
import { getServiceMode } from "@/lib/serviceModeServer";
import { calculateTypeBAverageWage, determineTypeBServiceFee } from "@/lib/compliance/officialTypeBBillingMaster";
import { TypeBWageStatPanel } from "./TypeBWageStatPanel";
import Link from "next/link";

function formatHoursMinutes(decimalHours: number): string {
  const hours = Math.floor(decimalHours);
  const minutes = Math.round((decimalHours - hours) * 60);
  return `${hours}時間${minutes.toString().padStart(2, '0')}分`;
}

export default async function PayrollPage({ searchParams }: { searchParams: Promise<{ month?: string }> }) {
  const serviceMode = await getServiceMode();
  const isTypeB = serviceMode === 'type_b';

  const params = await searchParams;
  
  const today = new Date();
  const currentMonth = params.month || `${today.getFullYear()}-${String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;

  const clients = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM clients WHERE deleted_at IS NULL').all() as any[];
  const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any || {};
  const employmentInsuranceRate = facility.employment_insurance_rate || 0.006;
  const overtimeRate = typeof facility.overtime_rate === 'number' ? facility.overtime_rate : 0.25;
  const overtimeOver60Rate = typeof facility.overtime_over60_rate === 'number' ? facility.overtime_over60_rate : 0.50;
  const nightRate = typeof facility.night_rate === 'number' ? facility.night_rate : 0.25;
  const holidayRate = typeof facility.holiday_rate === 'number' ? facility.holiday_rate : 0.35;
  const healthInsuranceRate = typeof facility.health_insurance_rate === 'number' ? facility.health_insurance_rate : 0.0499;
  const welfarePensionRate = typeof facility.welfare_pension_rate === 'number' ? facility.welfare_pension_rate : 0.0915;
  const legalHolidayDay = parseInt(facility.legal_holiday ?? '0', 10);
  const minWage = getApplicableMinimumWage(facility.pref_code, facility.regional_minimum_wage);

  // 先月の最後の6日間も含めて取得する（月をまたぐ週の週40時間超過を正しく計算するため）
  const [year, month] = currentMonth.split('-').map(Number);
  const prevMonthDate = new Date(year, month - 2, 25);
  const prevMonthStr = `${prevMonthDate.getFullYear()}-${String(prevMonthDate.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  
  const attendanceRecords = db.prepare(`
    SELECT client_id, record_date, status, clock_in, clock_out, break_time_minutes FROM attendance_records 
    WHERE (record_date LIKE ? OR record_date >= ?) AND deleted_at IS NULL AND status IN ('present', 'paid_leave', 'pto')
    ORDER BY record_date ASC
  `).all(`${currentMonth}-%`, `${prevMonthStr}-25`) as any[];

  const clientShifts = db.prepare(`
    SELECT client_id, target_date, scheduled_in, scheduled_out FROM client_shifts
    WHERE target_date LIKE ?
  `).all(`${currentMonth}-%`) as any[];

  const contracts = db.prepare('SELECT client_id, hourly_wage, standard_remuneration FROM employment_contracts').all() as any[];
  const payrollSettings = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM payroll_settings').all() as any[];
  const savedPayslips = db.prepare(`
    SELECT 
      p.id as lock_id,
      p.client_id,
      p.target_month,
      p.is_locked,
      mp.total_working_minutes,
      mp.hourly_wage,
      mp.base_salary,
      mp.total_payment,
      mp.pto_allowance,
      mp.overtime_allowance,
      mp.overtime_excess_allowance,
      mp.night_shift_allowance,
      mp.holiday_allowance,
      mp.employment_insurance_deduction,
      ps.commute_allowance,
      ps.health_insurance AS health_insurance_deduction,
      ps.welfare_pension AS welfare_pension_deduction,
      ps.income_tax,
      ps.custom_deductions
    FROM payslips p
    LEFT JOIN monthly_payslips mp ON p.client_id = mp.client_id AND p.target_month = mp.target_month
    LEFT JOIN payroll_settings ps ON p.client_id = ps.client_id
    WHERE p.target_month = ?
  `).all(currentMonth) as any[];

  const facilityHolidays = db.prepare('SELECT target_date FROM facility_holidays').all() as any[];
  const isVariableWorkingHours = facility.use_variable_working_hours === 1;

  // 当月の暦日数と変形労働時間制の法定総枠（分）
  const [curYearStr, curMonthStr] = currentMonth.split('-');
  const daysInCurrentMonth = new Date(parseInt(curYearStr, 10), parseInt(curMonthStr, 10), 0).getDate();
  const variableStatutoryLimitMins = Math.floor((40 * daysInCurrentMonth / 7) * 60);

  // 過去1年間の開始月（36協定年360時間チェック用）
  const pastOneYearStartMonth = (() => {
    const d = new Date(parseInt(curYearStr, 10), parseInt(curMonthStr, 10) - 1, 1);
    d.setFullYear(d.getFullYear() - 1);
    return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  })();

  let laborLawWarnings: string[] = [];

  const getWeekKey = (dateStr: string) => {
    const d = new Date(dateStr);
    const day = d.getDay(); 
    const diff = d.getDate() - day + (day === 0 ? -6 : 1);
    const monday = new Date(d.setDate(diff));
    return `${monday.getFullYear()}-${String(monday.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(monday.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  };

  // Compute calculated values
  const payrollData = clients.map(client => {
    // 1. Get saved data if exists
    const saved = savedPayslips.find(p => p.client_id === client.id);

    // 2. Compute attendance dynamically
    const clientAttendance = attendanceRecords.filter(a => a.client_id === client.id);
    let totalDays = 0;
    let workingDaysCount = 0;
    let ptoDaysCount = 0;
    let totalHours = 0;
    let actualWorkingMinutes = 0;
    let ptoMinutesTotal = 0;
    
    let overtimeMinutes = 0;
    let nightShiftMinutes = 0;
    let holidayWorkingMinutes = 0; // 法定休日（35%割増）
    let totalNormalWorkingMinutes = 0; // 変形労働制用：法定休日以外の総実労働分数

    const weeklyStats = new Map<string, { regularWorkingMins: number, dailyOvertimeMins: number, holidayWorkDays: number }>();
    let clientHolidays = [];
    try {
      clientHolidays = client.regular_holidays ? JSON.parse(client.regular_holidays) : [];
    } catch {
      clientHolidays = [];
    }

    for (const record of clientAttendance) {
      const isCurrentMonth = record.record_date.startsWith(currentMonth);

      if (record.status === 'present' && (!record.clock_in || !record.clock_out)) {
        if (isCurrentMonth) {
          laborLawWarnings.push(`${record.record_date} (${client.full_name}): 打刻漏れ（出勤または退勤打刻なし）`);
        }
      }

      if (record.status === 'present' && record.clock_in && record.clock_out) {
        const [sh, sm] = record.clock_in.split(':').map(Number);
        const [eh, em] = record.clock_out.split(':').map(Number);
        let outM = eh * 60 + em;
        const inM = sh * 60 + sm;
        if (outM < inM) outM += 24 * 60; // night shift crossover

        const shiftDurationForBreak = outM - inM;
        let breakM = typeof record.break_time_minutes === 'number' ? record.break_time_minutes : 0;
        if (facility.auto_deduct_break_time === 1 && typeof record.break_time_minutes !== 'number') {
          if (shiftDurationForBreak > 480) breakM = 60;
          else if (shiftDurationForBreak > 360) breakM = 45;
        }
        let minutes = shiftDurationForBreak - breakM;
        if (minutes < 0) minutes = 0;
        
        const workHours = minutes / 60;
        if (isCurrentMonth) {
          if (workHours > 8 && breakM < 60) {
            laborLawWarnings.push(`${record.record_date} (${client.full_name}): 労働${formatHoursMinutes(workHours)} 休憩${breakM}分`);
          } else if (workHours > 6 && breakM < 45) {
            laborLawWarnings.push(`${record.record_date} (${client.full_name}): 労働${formatHoursMinutes(workHours)} 休憩${breakM}分`);
          }
        }

        // 休日判定（利用者個人の公休 または 事業所休日）
        const recordDateObj = new Date(record.record_date);
        const dayOfWeek = recordDateObj.getDay();
        const dayOfWeekStr = dayOfWeek.toString();
        const isFacilityHoliday = facilityHolidays.some(h => h.target_date === record.record_date);
        const isHolidayWork = clientHolidays.includes(dayOfWeek) || clientHolidays.includes(dayOfWeekStr) || isFacilityHoliday;

        const weekKey = getWeekKey(record.record_date);
        const currentWeek = weeklyStats.get(weekKey) || { regularWorkingMins: 0, dailyOvertimeMins: 0, holidayWorkDays: 0 };

        // B-13: 法定休日（労基法35条: 週1回）と法定外休日の区別
        let isStatutoryHoliday = false;
        if (isHolidayWork) {
          if (currentWeek.holidayWorkDays === 0 || dayOfWeek === legalHolidayDay) {
            // 週の最初の休日出勤、または就業規則指定の曜日（例: 日曜日）を「法定休日」とする
            isStatutoryHoliday = true;
            currentWeek.holidayWorkDays++;
            if (isCurrentMonth) holidayWorkingMinutes += minutes;
          } else {
            // 同一週内の2日目以降の休日出勤は「法定外休日（所定休日）労働」として通常枠に含める
            isStatutoryHoliday = false;
          }
        }

        if (!isStatutoryHoliday) {
          if (isCurrentMonth) totalNormalWorkingMinutes += minutes;

          if (!isVariableWorkingHours) {
            // 固定時間制：1日8時間超を時間外とする
            if (minutes > 480) {
              const dailyOver = minutes - 480;
              if (isCurrentMonth) overtimeMinutes += dailyOver;
              currentWeek.regularWorkingMins += 480;
              currentWeek.dailyOvertimeMins += dailyOver;
            } else {
              currentWeek.regularWorkingMins += minutes;
            }

            // 週40時間超過の判定（日単位で超過した分をその日の時間外とする）
            if (currentWeek.regularWorkingMins > 2400) {
              const weeklyOver = currentWeek.regularWorkingMins - 2400;
              if (isCurrentMonth) overtimeMinutes += weeklyOver;
              currentWeek.regularWorkingMins = 2400; // 超過分を精算
            }
          }
        }

        weeklyStats.set(weekKey, currentWeek);

        // 深夜業判定 (22:00〜翌5:00)
        const calcNightMinutes = (startM: number, endM: number) => {
          let nightM = 0;
          if (startM < 300) {
            nightM += Math.min(300, endM) - startM;
          }
          if (endM > 1320) {
            nightM += Math.min(1740, endM) - Math.max(1320, startM);
          }
          return nightM > 0 ? nightM : 0;
        };
        
        if (isCurrentMonth) {
          const rawNight = calcNightMinutes(inM, outM);
          const daySpan = shiftDurationForBreak - rawNight;
          const remainingBreakToDeductFromNight = Math.max(0, breakM - daySpan);
          const netNight = Math.max(0, rawNight - remainingBreakToDeductFromNight);
          nightShiftMinutes += netNight;
          workingDaysCount++;
          totalDays++;
          actualWorkingMinutes += minutes;
          totalHours += (minutes / 60);
        }
      } else if (record.status === 'paid_leave' || record.status === 'pto') {
        const shift = clientShifts.find(s => s.client_id === client.id && s.target_date === record.record_date);
        let ptoMinutes = 0;
        if (shift && shift.scheduled_in && shift.scheduled_out) {
          const [sh, sm] = shift.scheduled_in.split(':').map(Number);
          const [eh, em] = shift.scheduled_out.split(':').map(Number);
          let outM = eh * 60 + em;
          const inM = sh * 60 + sm;
          if (outM < inM) outM += 24 * 60;
          const shiftDuration = outM - inM;
          const breakM = typeof record.break_time_minutes === 'number' && record.break_time_minutes >= 0
            ? record.break_time_minutes
            : (facility.auto_deduct_break_time === 1 ? (shiftDuration > 480 ? 60 : (shiftDuration > 360 ? 45 : 0)) : 0);
          ptoMinutes = Math.max(0, shiftDuration - breakM);
        } else if (client.weekly_scheduled_hours && client.weekly_scheduled_hours > 0) {
          const holidaysCount = clientHolidays.length > 0 ? clientHolidays.length : 2;
          const scheduledDaysPerWeek = Math.max(1, Math.min(6, 7 - holidaysCount));
          ptoMinutes = Math.round((client.weekly_scheduled_hours / scheduledDaysPerWeek) * 60);
        } else {
          ptoMinutes = 240;
        }

        if (ptoMinutes > 0 && isCurrentMonth) {
          ptoDaysCount++;
          totalDays++;
          ptoMinutesTotal += ptoMinutes;
          totalHours += (ptoMinutes / 60);
          totalNormalWorkingMinutes += ptoMinutes;
        }
      }
    }

    // B-18: 変形労働時間制 vs 固定時間制の時間外集計
    if (isVariableWorkingHours) {
      // 1ヶ月単位の変形労働時間制：月間総実労働時間（法定休日を除く）が法定総枠を超えた分を時間外とする
      if (totalNormalWorkingMinutes > variableStatutoryLimitMins) {
        overtimeMinutes = totalNormalWorkingMinutes - variableStatutoryLimitMins;
      } else {
        overtimeMinutes = 0;
      }
    }

    const contract = contracts.find(c => c.client_id === client.id) as any;
    const setting = payrollSettings.find(s => s.client_id === client.id) || {};
    const hourlyWage = (saved && saved.hourly_wage) ? saved.hourly_wage : (contract?.hourly_wage || 0);
    
    // B型対応: 賃金・工賃体系（時間給・日給・出来高制）
    const wageType = setting.wage_type || client.wage_type || 'hourly';
    const dailyWage = (saved && typeof (saved as any).daily_wage_payment === 'number' && (saved as any).daily_wage_payment > 0)
      ? (saved as any).daily_wage_payment
      : (setting.daily_wage || contract?.daily_wage || 0);
    const pieceworkUnitPrice = setting.piecework_unit_price || contract?.piecework_unit_price || 0;
    const pieceworkQuantity = setting.piecework_quantity || 0;
    const abilityAllowance = (saved && typeof (saved as any).ability_allowance === 'number')
      ? (saved as any).ability_allowance
      : (setting.ability_allowance || 0);

    let calculatedBaseSalary = 0;
    let pieceworkPayment = 0;
    let dailyWagePayment = 0;

    if (isTypeB) {
      if (wageType === 'daily') {
        dailyWagePayment = Math.round(workingDaysCount * dailyWage);
        calculatedBaseSalary = dailyWagePayment;
      } else if (wageType === 'piecework') {
        pieceworkPayment = Math.round(pieceworkUnitPrice * pieceworkQuantity);
        calculatedBaseSalary = pieceworkPayment;
      } else {
        // 時間給制（デフォルト・実働時間 × 工賃単価）
        calculatedBaseSalary = Math.round((actualWorkingMinutes * hourlyWage) / 60);
      }
    } else {
      // 労基法第108条準拠: 基本給（実働分）と有休手当（有休分）の明確な分離計算
      calculatedBaseSalary = Math.round((actualWorkingMinutes * hourlyWage) / 60);
    }

    const calculatedPtoAllowance = isTypeB ? 0 : Math.round((ptoMinutesTotal * hourlyWage) / 60);
    const actualHours = actualWorkingMinutes / 60;
    const ptoHours = isTypeB ? 0 : (ptoMinutesTotal / 60);

    const baseSalary = (saved && typeof saved.base_salary === 'number' && saved.base_salary > 0)
      ? saved.base_salary
      : calculatedBaseSalary;

    const ptoAllowance = isTypeB ? 0 : ((saved && typeof saved.pto_allowance === 'number')
      ? saved.pto_allowance
      : calculatedPtoAllowance);
    
    // B-16: 通達（昭和63年基発150号）準拠の端数処理（30分未満切り捨て、30分以上切り上げ）
    const roundStatutoryHours = (totalMins: number) => {
      const h = Math.floor(totalMins / 60);
      const m = totalMins % 60;
      return m >= 30 ? h + 1 : h;
    };

    const roundedOvertimeHours = roundStatutoryHours(overtimeMinutes);
    const roundedNightShiftHours = roundStatutoryHours(nightShiftMinutes);
    const roundedHolidayHours = roundStatutoryHours(holidayWorkingMinutes);

    // 割増賃金（B型は非雇用のため割増賃金なし、A型は就業規則・設定動的適用）
    const normalOvertimeHours = Math.min(roundedOvertimeHours, 60);
    const excessOvertimeHours = Math.max(0, roundedOvertimeHours - 60);
    const calculatedNormalOvertime = isTypeB ? 0 : Math.round(normalOvertimeHours * hourlyWage * overtimeRate);
    const calculatedExcessOvertime = isTypeB ? 0 : Math.round(excessOvertimeHours * hourlyWage * overtimeOver60Rate);
    const calculatedOvertime = calculatedNormalOvertime + calculatedExcessOvertime;

    const calculatedNight = isTypeB ? 0 : Math.round(roundedNightShiftHours * hourlyWage * nightRate);
    const calculatedHoliday = isTypeB ? 0 : Math.round(roundedHolidayHours * hourlyWage * holidayRate);

    const overtimeAllowance = isTypeB ? 0 : ((saved && typeof saved.overtime_allowance === 'number') ? saved.overtime_allowance : calculatedOvertime);
    const overtimeExcessAllowance = isTypeB ? 0 : ((saved && typeof saved.overtime_excess_allowance === 'number') ? saved.overtime_excess_allowance : calculatedExcessOvertime);
    const overtimeNormalAllowance = isTypeB ? 0 : (overtimeAllowance - overtimeExcessAllowance);
    const nightShiftAllowance = isTypeB ? 0 : ((saved && typeof saved.night_shift_allowance === 'number') ? saved.night_shift_allowance : calculatedNight);
    const holidayAllowance = isTypeB ? 0 : ((saved && typeof saved.holiday_allowance === 'number') ? saved.holiday_allowance : calculatedHoliday);

    // Deductions
    const commute = (saved && typeof saved.commute_allowance === 'number') ? saved.commute_allowance : (setting.commute_allowance || 0);
    const totalPayment = isTypeB 
      ? (baseSalary + abilityAllowance + commute)
      : (baseSalary + ptoAllowance + overtimeAllowance + nightShiftAllowance + holidayAllowance + commute);
    
    // 社会保険・雇用保険（B型は非雇用契約のため0円）
    const standardRemuneration = contract?.standard_remuneration || 0;
    const autoHealthInsurance = standardRemuneration > 0 ? Math.round(standardRemuneration * healthInsuranceRate) : 0;
    const autoWelfarePension = standardRemuneration > 0 ? Math.round(standardRemuneration * welfarePensionRate) : 0;

    const rawEmpIns = totalPayment * employmentInsuranceRate;
    const calculatedEmpIns = (rawEmpIns - Math.floor(rawEmpIns)) > 0.500001
      ? Math.ceil(rawEmpIns)
      : Math.floor(rawEmpIns);
    const employmentInsurance = isTypeB ? 0 : ((saved && typeof saved.employment_insurance_deduction === 'number') 
      ? saved.employment_insurance_deduction 
      : calculatedEmpIns);
    const healthInsurance = isTypeB ? 0 : ((saved && typeof saved.health_insurance_deduction === 'number') ? saved.health_insurance_deduction : (setting.health_insurance || autoHealthInsurance || 0));
    const welfarePension = isTypeB ? 0 : ((saved && typeof saved.welfare_pension_deduction === 'number') ? saved.welfare_pension_deduction : (setting.welfare_pension || autoWelfarePension || 0));
    const incomeTax = (saved && typeof saved.income_tax === 'number') ? saved.income_tax : (setting.income_tax || 0);
    
    let customDeductions = [];
    try {
      customDeductions = saved && saved.custom_deductions ? JSON.parse(saved.custom_deductions) : [];
    } catch {
      customDeductions = [];
    }

    // 最低賃金減額特例許可の考慮（A型のみ）
    const isExempted = !isTypeB && hourlyWage > 0 && hourlyWage < minWage && !!client.min_wage_exemption_approved;
    const isBelowMinWage = !isTypeB && hourlyWage > 0 && hourlyWage < minWage && !client.min_wage_exemption_approved;
    const customDeductionSum = customDeductions.reduce((sum: number, d: any) => sum + (d.amount || 0), 0);
    const isExcessiveDeduction = baseSalary > 0 && customDeductionSum > (baseSalary * 0.5);

    // B-15: 36協定アラート（A型のみ）
    const monthlyOvertimeHours = overtimeMinutes / 60;
    if (!isTypeB && monthlyOvertimeHours > 45) {
      laborLawWarnings.push(`${client.full_name} さんの当月時間外労働が ${monthlyOvertimeHours.toFixed(1)} 時間となり、36協定の上限基準（月45時間）を超過しています。`);
    }

    if (!isTypeB) {
      try {
        const pastOtRow = db.prepare(`
          SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(overtime_allowance / NULLIF(hourly_wage * ?, 0))), 0) as past_ot_hours
          FROM monthly_payslips
          WHERE client_id = ? AND target_month >= ? AND target_month < ?
        `).get(overtimeRate, client.id, pastOneYearStartMonth, currentMonth) as any;
        const annualEstimatedOt = (pastOtRow?.past_ot_hours || 0) + monthlyOvertimeHours;
        if (annualEstimatedOt > 360) {
          laborLawWarnings.push(`${client.full_name} さんの過去1年間の累積時間外労働（推計${annualEstimatedOt.toFixed(1)}時間）が36協定の年間限度（年360時間）を超過しています。`);
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    return {
      client_id: client.id,
      client_name: client.full_name,
      total_attendance_days: totalDays,
      working_days: workingDaysCount,
      pto_days: ptoDaysCount,
      total_working_hours: totalHours,
      formatted_working_hours: formatHoursMinutes(totalHours),
      hourly_wage: hourlyWage,
      base_salary: baseSalary,
      wage_type: wageType,
      daily_wage: dailyWage,
      piecework_unit_price: pieceworkUnitPrice,
      piecework_quantity: pieceworkQuantity,
      piecework_payment: pieceworkPayment,
      daily_wage_payment: dailyWagePayment,
      ability_allowance: abilityAllowance,
      pto_allowance: ptoAllowance,
      overtime_allowance: overtimeAllowance,
      overtime_normal_allowance: overtimeNormalAllowance,
      overtime_excess_allowance: overtimeExcessAllowance,
      overtime_normal_hours: normalOvertimeHours,
      overtime_excess_hours: excessOvertimeHours,
      overtime_excess_minutes: Math.round(excessOvertimeHours * 60),
      overtime_minutes: overtimeMinutes,
      night_shift_allowance: nightShiftAllowance,
      night_shift_hours: roundedNightShiftHours,
      night_shift_minutes: nightShiftMinutes,
      holiday_allowance: holidayAllowance,
      holiday_hours: roundedHolidayHours,
      holiday_working_minutes: holidayWorkingMinutes,
      commute_allowance: commute,
      employment_insurance_deduction: employmentInsurance,
      health_insurance_deduction: healthInsurance,
      welfare_pension_deduction: welfarePension,
      income_tax: incomeTax,
      custom_deductions: customDeductions,
      is_below_min_wage: isBelowMinWage,
      is_excessive_deduction: isExcessiveDeduction,
      saved: !!saved,
      gender: client.gender
    };
  });

  const belowMinWageClients = payrollData.filter(p => p.is_below_min_wage);
  const excessiveDeductionClients = payrollData.filter(p => p.is_excessive_deduction);

  // 年5日有給取得義務の要注意・警告者を集計
  const paidLeaveStatuses = getAllClientsPaidLeaveStatus();
  const criticalPaidLeave = paidLeaveStatuses.filter(s => s.complianceStatus === 'critical');
  const warningPaidLeave = paidLeaveStatuses.filter(s => s.complianceStatus === 'warning');

  // 労基法第24条協定（賃金控除協定）の有効性および項目照合
  const todayDateStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const activeArticle24Agreements = db.prepare(`
    SELECT * FROM labor_agreements 
    WHERE agreement_type = 'article24_deduction' 
      AND valid_from <= ? AND valid_to >= ?
  `).all(todayDateStr, todayDateStr) as any[];

  const allowedDeductionSet = new Set<string>();
  for (const agr of activeArticle24Agreements) {
    try {
      const items = JSON.parse(agr.deduction_items || '[]');
      items.forEach((it: string) => allowedDeductionSet.add(it.trim()));
    } catch(e) {}
  }

  const hasAnyCustomDeductions = payrollData.some(p => p.custom_deductions && p.custom_deductions.some((d: any) => d.amount > 0));
  const isArticle24Missing = activeArticle24Agreements.length === 0 && hasAnyCustomDeductions;

  const unagreedDeductionIssues: { clientName: string, items: string[] }[] = [];
  if (activeArticle24Agreements.length > 0) {
    for (const p of payrollData) {
      if (p.custom_deductions && p.custom_deductions.length > 0) {
        const unagreed = p.custom_deductions
          .filter((d: any) => d.amount > 0 && !allowedDeductionSet.has(d.name?.trim()))
          .map((d: any) => d.name);
        if (unagreed.length > 0) {
          unagreedDeductionIssues.push({ clientName: p.client_name, items: unagreed });
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // 社会保険・雇用保険の加入義務コンプライアンス検証（労務監査対策）
  const insuranceComplianceIssues: {
    clientId: string;
    clientName: string;
    avgWeeklyHours: number;
    issueType: 'employment_insurance' | 'social_insurance' | 'both';
    reason: string;
  }[] = [];

  for (const client of clients) {
    const pData = payrollData.find(p => p.client_id === client.id);
    if (!pData) continue;

    // 月間労働時間を4.33週（30日÷7）で割って週平均実働時間を算出（所定労働時間も加味）
    const calculatedWeeklyHours = Math.round((pData.total_working_hours / 4.33) * 10) / 10;
    const scheduledWeeklyHours = client.weekly_scheduled_hours || 0;
    const effectiveWeeklyHours = Math.max(calculatedWeeklyHours, scheduledWeeklyHours);

    const setting = payrollSettings.find(s => s.client_id === client.id) || {};
    const hasEmploymentInsurance = !!client.employment_insurance_number || pData.employment_insurance_deduction > 0;
    const hasHealthInsurance = (setting.health_insurance || 0) > 0 || pData.health_insurance_deduction > 0;
    const hasWelfarePension = (setting.welfare_pension || 0) > 0 || pData.welfare_pension_deduction > 0;

    // 週20時間以上は雇用保険の加入義務（雇用保険法第6条）
    const needsEmployment = effectiveWeeklyHours >= 20;
    // 週30時間以上は健康保険・厚生年金の当然適用（健康保険法第3条・厚生年金保険法第12条）
    const needsSocial = effectiveWeeklyHours >= 30;

    const empIssue = needsEmployment && !hasEmploymentInsurance;
    const socIssue = needsSocial && (!hasHealthInsurance || !hasWelfarePension);

    if (empIssue || socIssue) {
      insuranceComplianceIssues.push({
        clientId: client.id,
        clientName: client.full_name,
        avgWeeklyHours: effectiveWeeklyHours,
        issueType: empIssue && socIssue ? 'both' : empIssue ? 'employment_insurance' : 'social_insurance',
        reason: empIssue && socIssue
          ? `週${effectiveWeeklyHours}時間労働（雇用保険・社会保険の両方で加入要件該当、未加入疑い）`
          : empIssue
            ? `週${effectiveWeeklyHours}時間労働（週20h以上: 雇用保険加入義務該当、被保険者番号未登録または控除0円）`
            : `週${effectiveWeeklyHours}時間労働（週30h以上: 社会保険加入義務該当、健康保険・年金控除0円）`
      });
    }
  }

  // B型専用: 厚労省最新算定式による平均工賃月額・基本報酬判定
  let bTypeStats = {
    monthlyTotalWage: 0,
    monthlyTotalClients: 0,
    monthlyOpenDays: 0,
    monthlyAverageWage: 0,
    annualTotalWage: 0,
    annualTotalClients: 0,
    annualOpenDays: 0,
    officialAverageWage: 0,
    predictedServiceFeeName: '',
    predictedUnitScore: 0,
    staffingClass: facility.staffing_class || '6:1'
  };

  if (isTypeB) {
    // 厚労省工賃基準: 実費弁償（通勤手当）を除外し、純作業工賃＋能力給で算定
    const monthlyTotalWage = payrollData.reduce((sum, p) => sum + (p.base_salary || 0) + (p.ability_allowance || 0), 0);
    const monthlyTotalClients = payrollData.reduce((sum, p) => sum + (p.working_days || 0), 0);
    const monthlyOpenDaysRow = db.prepare(`
      SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT record_date) as open_days
      FROM attendance_records
      WHERE record_date LIKE ? AND status = 'present' AND deleted_at IS NULL
    `).get(`${currentMonth}-%`) as any;
    const monthlyOpenDays = Math.max(1, monthlyOpenDaysRow?.open_days || 20);
    const monthlyAverageWage = clients.length > 0 ? Math.round(monthlyTotalWage / clients.length) : 0;

    let annualTotalWage = 0;
    let annualTotalClients = 0;
    let annualOpenDays = 0;

    try {
      const pastAnnualRow = db.prepare(`
        SELECT 
          COALESCE(SUM(base_salary + COALESCE(ability_allowance, 0)), 0) as total_wages,
          COALESCE(SUM(working_days), 0) as total_clients
        FROM monthly_payslips
        WHERE target_month >= ? AND target_month <= ?
      `).get(pastOneYearStartMonth, currentMonth) as any;

      annualTotalWage = pastAnnualRow?.total_wages || (monthlyTotalWage * 12);
      annualTotalClients = pastAnnualRow?.total_clients || (monthlyTotalClients * 12);

      const pastOpenDaysRow = db.prepare(`
        SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT record_date) as annual_days
        FROM attendance_records
        WHERE record_date >= ? AND record_date <= ? AND status = 'present' AND deleted_at IS NULL
      `).get(`${pastOneYearStartMonth}-01`, `${currentMonth}-31`) as any;

      annualOpenDays = Math.max(1, pastOpenDaysRow?.annual_days || (monthlyOpenDays * 12));
    } catch(e) {
      annualTotalWage = monthlyTotalWage * 12;
      annualTotalClients = monthlyTotalClients * 12;
      annualOpenDays = monthlyOpenDays * 12;
    }

    const { averageWageMonthly } = calculateTypeBAverageWage(annualTotalWage, annualTotalClients, annualOpenDays);
    const feeInfo = determineTypeBServiceFee(facility.staffing_class || '6:1', averageWageMonthly || monthlyAverageWage);

    bTypeStats = {
      monthlyTotalWage,
      monthlyTotalClients,
      monthlyOpenDays,
      monthlyAverageWage,
      annualTotalWage,
      annualTotalClients,
      annualOpenDays,
      officialAverageWage: averageWageMonthly || monthlyAverageWage,
      predictedServiceFeeName: feeInfo.serviceName,
      predictedUnitScore: feeInfo.unitScore,
      staffingClass: facility.staffing_class || '6:1'
    };
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background/50">
      <Header activePage="payroll" />
      <BillingSubNav />
      <main className="flex-1 p-3.5 sm:p-6 md:p-12">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl space-y-6">
          {/* B型モード時: 厚労省最新算定式・工賃月額集計パネルおよび平均工賃月額基準管理（3,000円以上） */}
          {isTypeB && (
            <TypeBWageStatPanel 
              currentMonth={currentMonth}
              monthlyTotalWage={bTypeStats.monthlyTotalWage}
              monthlyTotalClients={bTypeStats.monthlyTotalClients}
              monthlyOpenDays={bTypeStats.monthlyOpenDays}
              monthlyAverageWage={bTypeStats.monthlyAverageWage}
              annualTotalWage={bTypeStats.annualTotalWage}
              annualTotalClients={bTypeStats.annualTotalClients}
              annualOpenDays={bTypeStats.annualOpenDays}
              officialAverageWage={bTypeStats.officialAverageWage}
              predictedServiceFeeName={bTypeStats.predictedServiceFeeName}
              predictedUnitScore={bTypeStats.predictedUnitScore}
              staffingClass={bTypeStats.staffingClass}
            />
          )}

          {/* A型モード時のみ: 労基法関連アラート（年5日有給、社保雇用保険、最低賃金、24条協定） */}
          {!isTypeB && (
            <>
              {(criticalPaidLeave.length > 0 || warningPaidLeave.length > 0) && (
                <div className="p-4 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-300 rounded-md text-amber-900 text-sm flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <div className="font-bold text-base mb-1">
                      ⚠【労基法第39条】有給休暇の「年5日取得義務」期限が迫っている利用者がいます（計 {criticalPaidLeave.length + warningPaidLeave.length} 名）
                    </div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-amber-800 mb-2">
                      法定付与10日以上の労働者には、基準日から1年以内に5日以上の有給を取得させる義務があります。
                    </p>
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 text-xs">
                      {criticalPaidLeave.map(c => (
                        <span key={c.clientId} className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-red-100 text-red-800 font-bold">
                          {c.clientName} (残{c.daysUntilPeriodEnd}日 / 不足{c.remainingDaysToTarget}日)
                        </span>
                      ))}
                      {warningPaidLeave.map(c => (
                        <span key={c.clientId} className="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 font-medium">
                          {c.clientName} (残{c.daysUntilPeriodEnd}日 / 不足{c.remainingDaysToTarget}日)
                        </span>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <Link href="/attendance/pto" className="self-start sm:self-auto shrink-0 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold bg-amber-600 text-white rounded hover:bg-amber-700">
                    有給管理簿を確認 →
                  </Link>
                </div>
              )}

              {insuranceComplianceIssues.length > 0 && (
                <div className="p-4 bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-200 rounded-md text-indigo-900 text-sm">
                  <div className="font-bold text-base mb-1 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span>🛡【社労士監査対策】社会保険・雇用保険の加入要件該当アラート（計 {insuranceComplianceIssues.length} 名）</span>
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-xs text-indigo-700 mb-2">
                    労働時間基準（週20時間以上で雇用保険、週30時間以上で社会保険）を満たしているにもかかわらず、被保険者番号未登録または保険料控除が0円の利用者がいます。実地調査・年金事務所調査で遡及加入・追徴金が発生するリスクを防止するため、加入状況を確認してください。
                  </p>
                  <div className="space-y-1 text-xs">
                    {insuranceComplianceIssues.map(issue => (
                      <div key={issue.clientId} className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-1 bg-white/80 p-2 rounded border border-indigo-100">
                        <span className="font-medium text-slate-800">{issue.clientName}</span>
                        <span className="text-indigo-900 font-semibold">{issue.reason}</span>
                        <Link href={`/clients/${issue.clientId}/edit`} className="text-blue-600 underline hover:text-blue-800 text-[11px] self-start sm:self-auto">
                          利用者・給与設定を修正 →
                        </Link>
                      </div>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {belowMinWageClients.length > 0 && (
                <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 border border-red-300 rounded-md text-red-800 text-sm">
                  <div className="font-bold text-base mb-1">🚨【労働基準法違反リスク】地域別最低賃金を下回っている利用者がいます</div>
                  <p className="mb-2">現在の適用最低賃金基準: <strong>{minWage.toLocaleString()}円/時</strong></p>
                  <ul className="list-disc list-inside space-y-1">
                    {belowMinWageClients.map(c => (
                      <li key={c.client_id}>
                        {c.client_name}: 現在の時給 <strong>{c.hourly_wage.toLocaleString()}円</strong> （{minWage - c.hourly_wage}円不足）
                      </li>
                    ))}
                  </ul>
                  <p className="mt-2 text-xs text-red-600">※A型事業所では最低賃金の適用除外許可を得ていない限り、最低賃金以上の支払いが義務付けられています。</p>
                </div>
              )}

              {isArticle24Missing && (
                <div className="p-4 bg-red-50 border border-red-300 rounded-md text-red-900 text-sm flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <div className="font-bold text-base mb-1">🚨【労働基準法第24条違反リスク】有効な賃金控除協定（24条協定）が未登録です</div>
                    <p className="text-xs text-red-800 leading-relaxed">
                      賃金から昼食代や送迎費実費などを控除（天引き）するには、労働者の過半数代表者との「書面による労使協定（24条協定）」の締結が法令上義務付けられています。協定のない天引きは労基法第24条違反（全額払いの原則違反: 30万円以下の罰金）の対象となります。
                    </p>
                  </div>
                  <Link href="/settings/agreements" className="self-start sm:self-auto shrink-0 px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold bg-red-700 text-white rounded hover:bg-red-800">
                    24条協定を登録 →
                  </Link>
                </div>
              )}

              {unagreedDeductionIssues.length > 0 && (
                <div className="p-3 bg-amber-50 border border-amber-300 rounded-md text-amber-900 text-sm flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <div className="font-bold mb-1">⚠【労基法第24条注意】締結中の協定に含まれていない天引き項目が設定されています</div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-amber-800 space-y-0.5">
                      {unagreedDeductionIssues.map(u => (
                        <div key={u.clientName}>
                          ・{u.clientName}: 未協定項目「{u.items.join('」「')}」が控除されています。協定書に項目を追加するか控除設定をご確認ください。
                        </div>
                      ))}
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <Link href="/settings/agreements" className="self-start sm:self-auto shrink-0 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-bold border border-amber-600 text-amber-800 rounded hover:bg-amber-100">
                    協定項目を確認 →
                  </Link>
                </div>
              )}

              {laborLawWarnings.length > 0 && (
                <div className="p-3 bg-yellow-50 border border-yellow-200 rounded-md text-yellow-800 text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap">
                  ⚠ 以下の日付で労基法に基づく休憩時間が不足しています:
                  {laborLawWarnings.map(w => `\n・${w}`)}
                </div>
              )}
            </>
          )}

          <PayrollClient 
            key={currentMonth}
            targetMonth={currentMonth} 
            initialData={payrollData} 
            employmentInsuranceRate={employmentInsuranceRate}
            minWage={minWage}
            isTypeB={isTypeB}
          />
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import Link from 'next/link';
import { 
  ChevronLeft, 
  Printer, 
  Download, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  Clock, 
  Calendar, 
  ShieldAlert, 
  Search,
  FileSpreadsheet
} from "lucide-react";
import { cn, toLocalISODate } from "@/lib/utils";
import { ClientPaidLeaveStatus } from "@/lib/compliance/paidLeaveCalculator";

export function PaidLeaveClient({ initialData }: { initialData: ClientPaidLeaveStatus[] }) {
  const [searchTerm, setSearchTerm] = useState('');
  const [filterStatus, setFilterStatus] = useState<string>('all');

  const filteredData = initialData.filter(item => {
    const matchesSearch = item.clientName.toLowerCase().includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase());
    if (!matchesSearch) return false;
    if (filterStatus === 'all') return true;
    if (filterStatus === 'mandatory') return item.isMandatoryTarget;
    if (filterStatus === 'warning') return item.complianceStatus === 'warning' || item.complianceStatus === 'critical';
    if (filterStatus === 'achieved') return item.complianceStatus === 'achieved';
    return true;
  });

  // サマリー集計
  const mandatoryCount = initialData.filter(i => i.isMandatoryTarget).length;
  const achievedCount = initialData.filter(i => i.complianceStatus === 'achieved').length;
  const warningCount = initialData.filter(i => i.complianceStatus === 'warning').length;
  const criticalCount = initialData.filter(i => i.complianceStatus === 'critical').length;
  const achievedRate = mandatoryCount > 0 ? Math.round((achievedCount / mandatoryCount) * 100) : 100;

  // CSVエクスポート
  const handleExportCsv = () => {
    const safeCell = (val: any) => {
      const str = String(val ?? "");
      // CSV Formula Injection ガード: 数式解釈文字（=, +, -, @, \t, \r）で始まる文字列に ' を付与
      const sanitized = /^[=+\-@\t\r]/.test(str) ? `'${str}` : str;
      return `"${sanitized.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
    };

    const headers = [
      '利用者氏名', '雇入れ年月日', '当期基準日', '当期満了日', '週所定労働時間',
      '週所定労働日数', '付与日数', '年5日義務対象', '取得日数', '取得日一覧',
      '義務残日数', '期日残日数', '判定'
    ];

    const rows = initialData.map(item => [
      item.clientName,
      item.hireDate,
      item.currentPeriodStart,
      item.currentPeriodEnd,
      item.weeklyHours,
      item.weeklyDays,
      item.grantedDays,
      item.isMandatoryTarget ? '対象' : '対象外',
      item.takenDays,
      item.takenDates.join('; '),
      item.remainingDaysToTarget,
      item.daysUntilPeriodEnd,
      item.statusLabel
    ]);

    const csvContent = '\uFEFF' + [headers.map(safeCell).join(','), ...rows.map(r => r.map(safeCell).join(','))].join('\r\n');
    const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = url;
    a.download = `年次有給休暇管理簿_${toLocalISODate(new Date())}.csv`;
    a.click();
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  };

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-7xl space-y-6">
      {/* 上部ヘッダー（印刷非表示） */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 print:hidden">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <Link href="/billing/payroll" className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "icon" }))}>
            <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
          </Link>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
              <Calendar className="h-7 w-7 text-primary" />
              年次有給休暇管理簿（年5日取得義務）
            </h1>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              労働基準法第39条第7項に基づき、年10日以上の有給休暇が付与される労働者に対する「年5日確実取得」の進捗を管理します。
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Link href="/attendance/pto" className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline" }), "gap-1.5 border-blue-200 text-blue-800 hover:bg-blue-50")}>
            <FileSpreadsheet className="h-4 w-4" />
            有休消化・時効管理台帳へ
          </Link>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={handleExportCsv} className="gap-1.5">
            <Download className="h-4 w-4" />
            CSV出力
          </Button>
          <Button variant="default" onClick={() => window.print()} className="gap-1.5">
            <Printer className="h-4 w-4" />
            管理簿を印刷
          </Button>
        </div>

      </div>

      {/* 印刷用ヘッダー */}
      <div className="hidden print:block text-center mb-6">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">年次有給休暇管理簿（労働基準法第39条第7項準拠）</h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-gray-600 mt-1">出力日: {new Date().toLocaleDateString('ja-JP')}</p>
      </div>

      {/* サマリーカード（印刷非表示） */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 print:hidden">
        <Card className="shadow-sm border-blue-200 bg-blue-50/40">
          <CardHeader className="p-4 pb-2">
            <CardDescription className="text-xs font-semibold text-blue-800">年5日取得義務 対象者</CardDescription>
            <CardTitle className="text-2xl font-bold text-blue-900">{mandatoryCount} 名</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="p-4 pt-0 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            法定付与10日以上の利用者
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="shadow-sm border-green-200 bg-green-50/40">
          <CardHeader className="p-4 pb-2">
            <CardDescription className="text-xs font-semibold text-green-800">5日取得 達成率</CardDescription>
            <CardTitle className="text-2xl font-bold text-green-900">{achievedRate}%</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="p-4 pt-0 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            {achievedCount} / {mandatoryCount} 名 達成
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="shadow-sm border-amber-200 bg-amber-50/40">
          <CardHeader className="p-4 pb-2">
            <CardDescription className="text-xs font-semibold text-amber-800">期日接近（残り90日以内）</CardDescription>
            <CardTitle className="text-2xl font-bold text-amber-900">{warningCount} 名</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="p-4 pt-0 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            未達・取得促進が必要
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="shadow-sm border-red-200 bg-red-50/40">
          <CardHeader className="p-4 pb-2">
            <CardDescription className="text-xs font-semibold text-red-800">違反リスク（残り30日以内）</CardDescription>
            <CardTitle className="text-2xl font-bold text-red-900">{criticalCount} 名</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="p-4 pt-0 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            労基署是正勧告リスク
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* 警告バナー（違反リスクまたは注意者がいる場合） */}
      {(criticalCount > 0 || warningCount > 0) && (
        <div className="p-4 rounded-lg border border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 text-amber-900 flex items-start gap-3 shadow-sm print:hidden">
          <AlertTriangle className="h-5 w-5 text-amber-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <div className="text-sm space-y-1">
            <p className="font-bold">年5日取得義務の期限が迫っている利用者がいます</p>
            <p className="text-xs text-amber-800">
              労働基準法第39条第7項に基づき、年10日以上付与される労働者には付与日から1年以内に5日の有給休暇を取得させなければなりません（未達時は1人につき30万円以下の罰金対象）。早めの計画的付与・取得を促してください。
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 検索・フィルタ（印刷非表示） */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between gap-3 print:hidden">
        <div className="relative w-full sm:w-72">
          <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-2.5 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
          <Input 
            placeholder="利用者氏名で検索..." 
            value={searchTerm}
            onChange={e => setSearchTerm(e.target.value)}
            className="pl-8"
          />
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto overflow-x-auto">
          <Button 
            size="sm" 
            variant={filterStatus === 'all' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            onClick={() => setFilterStatus('all')}
          >
            全員 ({initialData.length})
          </Button>
          <Button 
            size="sm" 
            variant={filterStatus === 'mandatory' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            onClick={() => setFilterStatus('mandatory')}
          >
            義務対象のみ ({mandatoryCount})
          </Button>
          <Button 
            size="sm" 
            variant={filterStatus === 'warning' ? 'destructive' : 'outline'}
            onClick={() => setFilterStatus('warning')}
          >
            要注意・警告 ({warningCount + criticalCount})
          </Button>
          <Button 
            size="sm" 
            variant={filterStatus === 'achieved' ? 'secondary' : 'outline'}
            onClick={() => setFilterStatus('achieved')}
          >
            達成済 ({achievedCount})
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 有給管理簿テーブル */}
      <Card className="shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-sm border-collapse">
            <thead>
              <tr className="bg-muted/60 text-muted-foreground border-b text-xs font-semibold">
                <th className="py-3 px-4 text-left">利用者氏名</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-3 text-left">雇入れ年月日</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-3 text-left">当期基準期間</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-2 text-center">勤続</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-2 text-center">付与日数</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-3 text-center">年5日義務</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-4 text-left">取得進捗 (年5日)</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-3 text-center">取得実績</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-3 text-center">期日残日数</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-3 text-center">ステータス</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y">
              {filteredData.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={10} className="py-8 text-center text-muted-foreground">
                    該当する利用者がいません
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                filteredData.map(item => {
                  const progressVal = Math.min(100, Math.round((item.takenDays / 5) * 100));

                  return (
                    <tr key={item.clientId} className="hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors">
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 font-bold text-foreground">
                        {item.clientName}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {item.hireDate}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-3 text-xs">
                        <span className="font-mono">{item.currentPeriodStart}</span>
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground mx-1">〜</span>
                        <span className="font-mono">{item.currentPeriodEnd}</span>
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-2 text-center text-xs">
                        {item.serviceYears}年
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-2 text-center font-bold">
                        {item.grantedDays}日
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center">
                        {item.isMandatoryTarget ? (
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-blue-50 text-blue-800 border-blue-200 text-[11px]">
                            対象 (10日以上)
                          </Badge>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">対象外</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 min-w-[180px]">
                        {item.isMandatoryTarget ? (
                          <div className="space-y-1">
                            <div className="flex justify-between text-xs">
                              <span className="font-semibold">{item.takenDays} / 5日</span>
                              <span className="text-muted-foreground">{progressVal}%</span>
                            </div>
                            <div className="w-full bg-slate-200 dark:bg-slate-700 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden">
                              <div 
                                className={cn(
                                  "h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-300",
                                  item.takenDays >= 5 ? "bg-green-600" :
                                  item.complianceStatus === 'critical' ? "bg-red-600" :
                                  item.complianceStatus === 'warning' ? "bg-amber-500" :
                                  "bg-blue-600"
                                )}
                                style={{ width: `${progressVal}%` }}
                              />
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">-</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center">
                        <span className="font-bold text-sm text-primary">{item.takenDays}日</span>
                        {item.takenDates.length > 0 && (
                          <span className="block text-[10px] text-muted-foreground truncate max-w-[120px]" title={item.takenDates.join(', ')}>
                            直近: {item.takenDates[item.takenDates.length - 1]}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center text-xs font-mono">
                        {item.isMandatoryTarget ? (
                          item.takenDays >= 5 ? (
                            <span className="text-muted-foreground">-</span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className={cn(
                              "font-bold",
                              item.daysUntilPeriodEnd <= 30 ? "text-red-600" :
                              item.daysUntilPeriodEnd <= 90 ? "text-amber-600" : "text-foreground"
                            )}>
                              残り {item.daysUntilPeriodEnd} 日
                            </span>
                          )
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-muted-foreground">-</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center">
                        {item.complianceStatus === 'achieved' && (
                          <Badge className="bg-green-100 text-green-800 border-green-300 gap-1 hover:bg-green-100">
                            <CheckCircle2 className="h-3 w-3 text-green-600" />
                            達成
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                        {item.complianceStatus === 'in_progress' && (
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-blue-50 text-blue-800 border-blue-200 hover:bg-blue-50">
                            進行中
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                        {item.complianceStatus === 'warning' && (
                          <Badge className="bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border-amber-300 gap-1 hover:bg-amber-100">
                            <Clock className="h-3 w-3 text-amber-600" />
                            注意
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                        {item.complianceStatus === 'critical' && (
                          <Badge className="bg-red-100 text-red-800 border-red-300 gap-1 hover:bg-red-100 animate-pulse">
                            <ShieldAlert className="h-3 w-3 text-red-600" />
                            警告
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                        {item.complianceStatus === 'exempt' && (
                          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">対象外</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

import { Header } from "@/components/Header";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { getServiceMode } from "@/lib/serviceModeServer";
import { getAllClientsPaidLeaveStatus } from "@/lib/compliance/paidLeaveCalculator";
import { PaidLeaveClient } from "./PaidLeaveClient";

export default async function PaidLeavePage() {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) redirect("/login");
  const serviceMode = await getServiceMode();
  if (serviceMode === 'type_b') redirect("/billing/payroll");

  const clientsPaidLeave = getAllClientsPaidLeaveStatus();

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background/50">
      <div className="print:hidden">
        <Header activePage="billing" />
      </div>

      <main className="flex-1 p-4 md:p-8">
        <PaidLeaveClient initialData={clientsPaidLeave} />
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}


================================================================================
File: src/app/billing/payroll/payslips/page.tsx

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { PrintButton } from "@/components/PrintButton";
import { AutoFitText } from "@/components/AutoFitText";
import { getServiceMode } from "@/lib/serviceModeServer";

export default async function PayslipsPrintPage({ searchParams }: { searchParams: Promise<{ month?: string, clientId?: string }> }) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) redirect("/login");

  const serviceMode = await getServiceMode();
  const isTypeB = serviceMode === 'type_b';

  const params = await searchParams;
  const month = params.month;
  const targetClientId = params.clientId;
  
  if (!month) return <div>対象月が指定されていません</div>;

  const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any || {};
  let payslipsQuery = `
    SELECT 
      p.id, p.client_id, p.target_month,
      c.full_name,
      mp.total_working_minutes,
      mp.working_days,
      mp.pto_days,
      mp.hourly_wage,
      mp.base_salary,
      mp.pto_allowance,
      mp.overtime_minutes,
      mp.overtime_allowance,
      mp.overtime_excess_minutes,
      mp.overtime_excess_allowance,
      mp.night_shift_minutes,
      mp.night_shift_allowance,
      mp.holiday_working_minutes,
      mp.holiday_allowance,
      mp.ability_allowance,
      ps.commute_allowance,
      ps.health_insurance AS health_insurance_deduction,
      ps.welfare_pension AS welfare_pension_deduction,
      ps.income_tax,
      ps.custom_deductions
    FROM payslips p
    JOIN clients c ON p.client_id = c.id
    LEFT JOIN monthly_payslips mp ON p.client_id = mp.client_id AND p.target_month = mp.target_month
    LEFT JOIN payroll_settings ps ON p.client_id = ps.client_id
    WHERE p.target_month = ?
  `;
  const queryParams: any[] = [month];

  if (targetClientId) {
    payslipsQuery += ` AND p.client_id = ?`;
    queryParams.push(targetClientId);
  }

  const rawPayslips = db.prepare(payslipsQuery).all(...queryParams) as any[];

  if (rawPayslips.length === 0) {
    return <div className="p-8 text-center text-xl">{isTypeB ? 'この月の工賃データが確定されていません。工賃計算ダッシュボードから保存してください。' : 'この月の給与データが確定されていません。給与計算ダッシュボードから保存してください。'}</div>;
  }

  const attendances = db.prepare(`
    SELECT client_id, 
           SUM(CASE WHEN status = 'present' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as working_days,
           SUM(CASE WHEN status IN ('paid_leave', 'pto') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pto_days
    FROM attendance_records
    WHERE record_date LIKE ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
    GROUP BY client_id
  `).all(`${month}-%`) as any[];

  const payslips = rawPayslips.map(slip => {
    const attendance = attendances.find((a: any) => a.client_id === slip.client_id);
    const working_days = (typeof slip.working_days === 'number' && slip.working_days > 0) 
      ? slip.working_days 
      : (attendance ? attendance.working_days : 0);
    const pto_days = (typeof slip.pto_days === 'number' && slip.pto_days > 0) 
      ? slip.pto_days 
      : (attendance ? attendance.pto_days : 0);
    const total_attendance_days = isTypeB ? working_days : (working_days + pto_days);
    const total_working_hours = (slip.total_working_minutes || 0) / 60;
    const overtime_hours = (slip.overtime_minutes || 0) / 60;
    const excess_overtime_hours = (slip.overtime_excess_minutes || 0) / 60;
    
    const commute_allowance = slip.commute_allowance || 0;
    const ability_allowance = slip.ability_allowance || 0;
    const pto_allowance = isTypeB ? 0 : (slip.pto_allowance || 0);
    const overtime_allowance = isTypeB ? 0 : (slip.overtime_allowance || 0);
    const overtime_excess_allowance = isTypeB ? 0 : (slip.overtime_excess_allowance || 0);
    const overtime_normal_allowance = overtime_allowance - overtime_excess_allowance;
    const night_shift_allowance = isTypeB ? 0 : (slip.night_shift_allowance || 0);
    const holiday_allowance = isTypeB ? 0 : (slip.holiday_allowance || 0);

    const health_insurance_deduction = isTypeB ? 0 : (slip.health_insurance_deduction || 0);
    const welfare_pension_deduction = isTypeB ? 0 : (slip.welfare_pension_deduction || 0);
    const income_tax = slip.income_tax || 0;
    const base_salary = slip.base_salary || 0;
    const hourly_wage = slip.hourly_wage || 0;
    
    const employmentInsuranceRate = facility.employment_insurance_rate || 0.006;
    // 総支給額（B型: 基本工賃 + 能力給 + 通勤手当 / A型: 基本給 + 有休 + 割増 + 通勤）
    const totalPayment = isTypeB 
      ? (base_salary + ability_allowance + commute_allowance)
      : (base_salary + pto_allowance + overtime_allowance + night_shift_allowance + holiday_allowance + commute_allowance);

    const rawEmpIns = totalPayment * employmentInsuranceRate;
    const employment_insurance_deduction = isTypeB ? 0 : ((rawEmpIns - Math.floor(rawEmpIns)) > 0.500001 ? Math.ceil(rawEmpIns) : Math.floor(rawEmpIns));
    
    let customDeductions = [];
    try {
      customDeductions = slip.custom_deductions ? JSON.parse(slip.custom_deductions) : [];
    } catch {
      customDeductions = [];
    }
    const customSum = customDeductions.reduce((sum: number, d: any) => sum + (d.amount || 0), 0);
    
    // B型は社会保険・雇用保険が存在しないため控除合計から除外
    const total_deductions = isTypeB
      ? (income_tax + customSum)
      : (health_insurance_deduction + welfare_pension_deduction + employment_insurance_deduction + income_tax + customSum);
    const net_payment = totalPayment - total_deductions;

    return {
      ...slip,
      working_days,
      pto_days,
      total_attendance_days,
      total_working_hours,
      overtime_hours,
      excess_overtime_hours,
      commute_allowance,
      ability_allowance,
      pto_allowance,
      overtime_allowance,
      overtime_excess_allowance,
      overtime_normal_allowance,
      night_shift_allowance,
      holiday_allowance,
      totalPayment,
      health_insurance_deduction,
      welfare_pension_deduction,
      employment_insurance_deduction,
      income_tax,
      total_deductions,
      base_salary,
      hourly_wage,
      net_payment,
      custom_deductions: slip.custom_deductions
    };
  });

  // Split month for display
  const [yearStr, monthStr] = month.split('-');

  return (
    <div className="print-container bg-white text-black text-sm">
      <style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{__html: `
        @page { size: A4; margin: 0; }
        body { margin: 0; padding: 0; background: white; -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact; }
        .page-break { page-break-after: always; height: 100vh; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
        .half-page { flex: 1; padding: 30px 40px; box-sizing: border-box; }
        .cut-line { border-top: 1px dashed #666; margin: 0; height: 0; position: relative; }
        .cut-line::after { content: '✂ 切り取り線'; position: absolute; top: -10px; right: 20px; font-size: 10px; color: #666; background: white; padding: 0 5px; }
        table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; margin-top: 15px; }
        th, td { border: 1px solid #333; padding: 6px 8px; text-align: left; }
        th { background-color: #f3f4f6; text-align: center; font-weight: normal; }
        .amount-td { text-align: right; }
        .title-row { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; margin-bottom: 20px; border-bottom: 2px solid #333; padding-bottom: 10px; }
        .section-title { font-weight: bold; margin-bottom: 5px; margin-top: 15px; border-left: 3px solid #333; padding-left: 5px; }
        @media print {
          .no-print { display: none; }
        }
      `}} />

      <div className="no-print p-3 sm:p-4 bg-gray-100 flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2.5 border-b fixed top-0 left-0 w-full z-10 shadow-sm">
        <div>
          <h1 className="font-bold text-base sm:text-lg">{isTypeB ? '工賃明細一括印刷' : '給与明細一括印刷'}</h1>
          <p className="text-xs sm:text-sm text-gray-600">A4用紙で印刷してください。</p>
        </div>
        <PrintButton className="px-5 py-1.5 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded hover:bg-blue-700 font-bold text-xs sm:text-sm shrink-0 self-end sm:self-auto" label="印刷する" />
      </div>

      <div className="no-print h-24 sm:h-20"></div>

      {payslips.map(slip => {
        let customDeductions = [];
        try {
          customDeductions = slip.custom_deductions ? JSON.parse(slip.custom_deductions) : [];
        } catch {
          customDeductions = [];
        }
        const customSum = customDeductions.reduce((sum: number, d: any) => sum + (d.amount || 0), 0);
        
        const PaySlipContent = ({ titleSuffix }: { titleSuffix: string }) => (
          <div className="half-page flex flex-col justify-between">
            <div>
              <div className="title-row">
                <div>
                  <h1 className="text-xl tracking-widest font-bold">
                    {isTypeB ? `工 賃 明 細 書 ${titleSuffix}` : `給 与 明 細 書 ${titleSuffix}`}
                  </h1>
                  <div className="mt-1 text-sm font-medium">令和{parseInt(yearStr) - 2018}年 {parseInt(monthStr)}月分</div>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right">
                  <div className="border-b border-black pb-0.5 mb-1 px-3 min-w-[180px] max-w-[260px] inline-flex justify-end items-baseline">
                    <AutoFitText text={slip.full_name} maxFontSizePt={14} minFontSizePt={9} className="font-bold text-right" />
                    <span className="text-xs ml-1 shrink-0 font-normal">様</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-xs mt-1 text-gray-700 max-w-[220px] ml-auto">
                    <AutoFitText text={facility.facility_name || (isTypeB ? '就労継続支援B型事業所' : '就労継続支援A型事業所')} maxFontSizePt={9.5} minFontSizePt={7} className="text-right" />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

            <div className="flex gap-4">
              <div className="flex-1">
                <div className="section-title">勤怠</div>
                <table>
                  <tbody>
                    <tr>
                      <th className="w-1/2">出勤日数</th>
                      <td className="amount-td">{slip.working_days} 日</td>
                    </tr>
                    {!isTypeB && (
                      <tr>
                        <th>有休日数</th>
                        <td className="amount-td font-semibold text-blue-700">{slip.pto_days} 日</td>
                      </tr>
                    )}
                    <tr>
                      <th>{isTypeB ? '作業時間' : '実働時間'}</th>
                      <td className="amount-td">{slip.total_working_hours.toFixed(2)} 時間</td>
                    </tr>
                    {!isTypeB && (
                      <tr>
                        <th>時間外労働</th>
                        <td className="amount-td">
                          {slip.overtime_hours.toFixed(2)} 時間
                          {slip.excess_overtime_hours > 0 && (
                            <div className="text-[10px] text-amber-700 font-bold">(うち60h超: {slip.excess_overtime_hours.toFixed(2)}h)</div>
                          )}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    )}
                    <tr>
                      <th>{isTypeB ? '工賃単価' : '時給'}</th>
                      <td className="amount-td">{slip.hourly_wage.toLocaleString()} 円</td>
                    </tr>
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>

              <div className="flex-1">
                <div className="section-title">支給</div>
                <table>
                  <tbody>
                    <tr>
                      <th className="w-1/2">{isTypeB ? '基本工賃 (作業分)' : '基本給 (実働分)'}</th>
                      <td className="amount-td">{slip.base_salary.toLocaleString()} 円</td>
                    </tr>
                    {isTypeB ? (
                      <>
                        {slip.ability_allowance > 0 && (
                          <tr>
                            <th>能力給・評価手当</th>
                            <td className="amount-td font-medium text-emerald-800">{slip.ability_allowance.toLocaleString()} 円</td>
                          </tr>
                        )}
                        <tr>
                          <th>通勤手当 (実費弁償)</th>
                          <td className="amount-td">{slip.commute_allowance.toLocaleString()} 円</td>
                        </tr>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      <>
                        <tr className={slip.pto_allowance > 0 ? "bg-blue-50/50" : ""}>
                          <th>有休手当 (有休分)</th>
                          <td className="amount-td font-medium text-blue-800">{slip.pto_allowance.toLocaleString()} 円</td>
                        </tr>
                        <tr>
                          <th>時間外手当 (通常25%)</th>
                          <td className="amount-td">{slip.overtime_normal_allowance.toLocaleString()} 円</td>
                        </tr>
                        {slip.overtime_excess_allowance > 0 && (
                          <tr className="bg-amber-50/50">
                            <th className="text-amber-900 font-bold">時間外手当 (60h超50%)</th>
                            <td className="amount-td font-bold text-amber-900">{slip.overtime_excess_allowance.toLocaleString()} 円</td>
                          </tr>
                        )}
                        {slip.night_shift_allowance > 0 && (
                          <tr>
                            <th>深夜手当 (25%)</th>
                            <td className="amount-td">{slip.night_shift_allowance.toLocaleString()} 円</td>
                          </tr>
                        )}
                        {slip.holiday_allowance > 0 && (
                          <tr>
                            <th>休日手当 (35%)</th>
                            <td className="amount-td">{slip.holiday_allowance.toLocaleString()} 円</td>
                          </tr>
                        )}
                        <tr>
                          <th>通勤手当</th>
                          <td className="amount-td">{slip.commute_allowance.toLocaleString()} 円</td>
                        </tr>
                      </>
                    )}
                    <tr>
                      <th className="bg-gray-200 font-bold">支給合計 (A)</th>
                      <td className="amount-td font-bold text-base">{slip.totalPayment.toLocaleString()} 円</td>
                    </tr>
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-4">
              <div className="section-title">{isTypeB ? '控除（実費等）' : '控除'}</div>
              <table style={{ fontSize: '0.9em' }}>
                <thead>
                  <tr>
                    {!isTypeB && <th>健康保険</th>}
                    {!isTypeB && <th>厚生年金</th>}
                    {!isTypeB && <th>雇用保険</th>}
                    <th>所得税</th>
                    {customDeductions.map((d: any, i: number) => <th key={i}>{d.name}</th>)}
                    <th className="bg-gray-200 font-bold w-32">控除合計 (B)</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  <tr>
                    {!isTypeB && <td className="amount-td">{slip.health_insurance_deduction.toLocaleString()}</td>}
                    {!isTypeB && <td className="amount-td">{slip.welfare_pension_deduction.toLocaleString()}</td>}
                    {!isTypeB && <td className="amount-td">{slip.employment_insurance_deduction.toLocaleString()}</td>}
                    <td className="amount-td">{slip.income_tax.toLocaleString()}</td>
                    {customDeductions.map((d: any, i: number) => <td key={i} className="amount-td">{d.amount.toLocaleString()}</td>)}
                    <td className="amount-td font-bold">
                      {slip.total_deductions.toLocaleString()}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
            </div>

            <div className="mt-8 flex justify-end">
              <table style={{ width: '300px' }}>
                <tbody>
                  <tr>
                    <th className="text-lg bg-gray-200">差引支給額 (A - B)</th>
                    <td className="amount-td text-xl font-bold">{slip.net_payment.toLocaleString()} 円</td>
                  </tr>
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
            
            <div className="mt-8 text-xs text-gray-600 text-center">
              内容に相違がある場合は、速やかに管理者までお申し出ください。
            </div>
          </div>
        );

        return (
          <div key={slip.id} className="page-break">
            <PaySlipContent titleSuffix="（本人用）" />
            <div className="cut-line"></div>
            <PaySlipContent titleSuffix="（事業所控）" />
          </div>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

interface MonthRow {
  month: string;
  monthLabel: string;
  openDays: number;
  totalAttendances: number;
  uniqueUsers: number;
  avgUsersPerDay: number;
  totalWage: number;
  avgWagePerUser: number;
}

interface AnnualSummary {
  totalOpenDays: number;
  totalAttendances: number;
  annualAvgUsersPerDay: number;
  annualTotalWage: number;
  statutoryMonthlyAverageWage: number;
  isBelow3000: boolean;
  targetWage: number;
}

interface WageReportProps {
  facility: any;
  fiscalYear: number;
  monthlyData: MonthRow[];
  annualSummary: AnnualSummary;
}

export function WageReportClient({ facility, fiscalYear, monthlyData, annualSummary }: WageReportProps) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [selectedFy, setSelectedFy] = useState(fiscalYear);

  const handleYearChange = (newYear: number) => {
    setSelectedFy(newYear);
    router.push(`/billing/payroll/wage-report?year=${newYear}`);
  };

  const handlePrint = () => {
    window.print();
  };

  const handleExportCsv = () => {
    try {
      const safeCell = (val: any) => {
        const str = String(val ?? "");
        // CSV Formula Injection ガード: 数式解釈文字（=, +, -, @）で始まる文字列に ' を付与
        const sanitized = /^[=+\-@\t\r]/.test(str) ? `'${str}` : str;
        return `"${sanitized.replace(/"/g, '""')}"`;
      };

      const header = [
        "対象月",
        "開所日数(日)",
        "延べ利用人数(人日)",
        "実利用人数(人)",
        "1日平均利用人数(人)",
        "工賃支払総額(円)",
        "1人当たり平均工賃(円)"
      ];

      const rows: any[][] = monthlyData.map(m => [
        m.monthLabel,
        m.openDays,
        m.totalAttendances,
        m.uniqueUsers,
        m.avgUsersPerDay.toFixed(2),
        m.totalWage,
        Math.round(m.avgWagePerUser)
      ]);

      // 合計行
      rows.push([
        "年度合計・平均",
        annualSummary.totalOpenDays,
        annualSummary.totalAttendances,
        "-",
        annualSummary.annualAvgUsersPerDay.toFixed(2),
        annualSummary.annualTotalWage,
        Math.round(annualSummary.statutoryMonthlyAverageWage)
      ]);

      const csvContent = [
        safeCell(`就労継続支援B型 工賃実績報告書 (${selectedFy}年度)`),
        safeCell(`事業所名: ${facility.facility_name || '就労継続支援B型事業所'}`),
        safeCell(`事業所番号: ${facility.facility_code || '2810000000'}`),
        safeCell(`法定平均工賃月額: ${Math.round(annualSummary.statutoryMonthlyAverageWage).toLocaleString()}円`),
        "",
        header.map(safeCell).join(","),
        ...rows.map(r => r.map(safeCell).join(","))
      ].join("\r\n");

      const blob = new Blob([new Uint8Array([0xEF, 0xBB, 0xBF]), csvContent], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
      const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      const safeFileName = (facility.facility_name || 'B型').replace(/[\\/:*?"<>|]/g, '_');
      a.download = `工賃実績報告書_${selectedFy}年度_${safeFileName}.csv`;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      document.body.removeChild(a);
      URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
      toast.success('工賃実績報告書CSVを出力しました');

      toast.error('CSV出力に失敗しました: ' + e.message);

              <span>対象年度:</span>

                value={selectedFy}
