        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-xs text-slate-700 border p-3 rounded-md bg-slate-50">
          <div>
            <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900 mb-1">【厚生労働省告示に基づく算定根拠】</h4>
            <div className="p-2 bg-white rounded border border-slate-200 font-mono text-[11px] leading-relaxed">
              平均工賃月額 ＝ 年間工賃支払総額 ÷ (年間延べ利用人数 ÷ 年間開所日数) ÷ 12ヶ月<br />
              ＝ {annualSummary.annualTotalWage.toLocaleString()} ÷ ({annualSummary.totalAttendances} ÷ {annualSummary.totalOpenDays}) ÷ 12<br />
              ＝ <strong>{Math.round(annualSummary.statutoryMonthlyAverageWage).toLocaleString()} 円</strong>
            </div>
            <p className="text-[10px] text-slate-500 mt-1">
              ※年度途中に利用開始または終了した利用者の日数・工賃も全て算定対象に正しく含まれています。
            </p>
          </div>

          <div>
            <h4 className="font-bold text-slate-900 mb-1">【事業所確認・署名欄】</h4>
            <div className="border border-slate-300 bg-white p-2 rounded h-20 flex flex-col justify-between">

              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between items-end text-xs">
                <div>事業所代表者 / 管理者 署名:</div>
                <div className="w-28 border-b border-dashed border-slate-500 text-right pr-2">印</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { getServiceMode } from "@/lib/serviceModeServer";
import { calculateTypeBAverageWage } from "@/lib/compliance/officialTypeBBillingMaster";
import { WageReportClient } from "./WageReportClient";

export default async function WageReportPage({ searchParams }: { searchParams: Promise<{ year?: string }> }) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) redirect("/login");

  const params = await searchParams;
  const today = new Date();
  const currentMonthNum = today.getMonth() + 1;
  const currentYearNum = today.getFullYear();
  // 4月以降なら今年度、1〜3月なら前年度が直近年度
  const defaultFiscalYear = currentMonthNum >= 4 ? currentYearNum : currentYearNum - 1;
  const fiscalYear = params.year ? parseInt(params.year, 10) : defaultFiscalYear;

  const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any || {};

  // 4月から翌年3月までの12ヶ月のリストを生成
  const months: string[] = [];
  for (let m = 4; m <= 12; m++) {
    months.push(`${fiscalYear}-${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}`);
  }
  for (let m = 1; m <= 3; m++) {
    months.push(`${fiscalYear + 1}-${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}`);
  }

  // 月別実績の集計
  let annualTotalOpenDays = 0;
  let annualTotalAttendances = 0;
  let annualTotalWage = 0;

  const monthlyData = months.map(monthStr => {
    const [y, m] = monthStr.split('-');
    const monthLabel = `${parseInt(m, 10)}月`;

    // 開所日数と延べ利用人数・実利用人数
    const attendanceStats = db.prepare(`
      SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT record_date) as open_days,
        COUNT(*) as total_attendances,
        COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) as unique_users
      FROM attendance_records
      WHERE record_date LIKE ? AND status = 'present' AND deleted_at IS NULL
    `).get(`${monthStr}-%`) as any;

    const openDays = attendanceStats?.open_days || 0;
    const totalAttendances = attendanceStats?.total_attendances || 0;
    const uniqueUsers = attendanceStats?.unique_users || 0;
    const avgUsersPerDay = openDays > 0 ? (totalAttendances / openDays) : 0;

    // 当月の工賃支払総額（厚労省指定基準: 実費弁償の通勤手当等を除外した純工賃を集計）
    const wageStats = db.prepare(`
      SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mp.base_salary + COALESCE(mp.ability_allowance, 0)), 0) as total_wage
      FROM payslips p
      JOIN monthly_payslips mp ON p.client_id = mp.client_id AND p.target_month = mp.target_month
      WHERE p.target_month = ?
    `).get(monthStr) as any;

    const totalWage = wageStats?.total_wage || 0;
    const avgWagePerUser = uniqueUsers > 0 ? (totalWage / uniqueUsers) : 0;

    annualTotalOpenDays += openDays;
    annualTotalAttendances += totalAttendances;
    annualTotalWage += totalWage;

    return {
      month: monthStr,
      monthLabel,
      openDays,
      totalAttendances,
      uniqueUsers,
      avgUsersPerDay,
      totalWage,
      avgWagePerUser
    };
  });

  // 厚労省算定式による確定平均工賃月額
  const avgWageResult = calculateTypeBAverageWage({
    totalWagePaid: annualTotalWage,
    totalClientAttendances: annualTotalAttendances,
    facilityOpenDays: Math.max(1, annualTotalOpenDays),
    operatingMonths: 12
  });

  const annualSummary = {
    totalOpenDays: annualTotalOpenDays,
    totalAttendances: annualTotalAttendances,
    annualAvgUsersPerDay: avgWageResult.averageUsersPerDay,
    annualTotalWage: annualTotalWage,
    statutoryMonthlyAverageWage: avgWageResult.averageMonthlyWage,
    isBelow3000: avgWageResult.isBelowMinimum3000,
    targetWage: facility.target_wage || 20000
  };

  return (
    <WageReportClient 
      facility={facility}
      fiscalYear={fiscalYear}
      monthlyData={monthlyData}
      annualSummary={annualSummary}
    />
  );
}

'use server';

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { randomUUID } from "crypto";

export async function getCalculatedWagesForMonth(targetMonth: string): Promise<number | null> {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (role !== 'admin') return null;

  try {
    const row = db.prepare(`
      SELECT SUM(
        base_salary 
        + overtime_allowance 
        + night_shift_allowance 
        + holiday_allowance 
        + COALESCE(overtime_excess_allowance, 0) 
        + COALESCE(pto_allowance, 0)
        + COALESCE(ability_allowance, 0)
      ) as total_wages
      FROM monthly_payslips
      WHERE target_month = ?
    `).get(targetMonth) as any;

    return row && row.total_wages !== null ? Number(row.total_wages) : null;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Failed to fetch calculated wages for month:", error);
    return null;
  }
}

export async function getProductionActivities() {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (role !== 'admin') return [];

  const rows = db.prepare(`
    SELECT * FROM production_activities 
    ORDER BY target_month DESC 
    LIMIT 12
  `).all() as any[];

  // 各月の確定給与・工賃総額を取得して付与
  return rows.map(r => {
    const payslipRow = db.prepare(`
      SELECT SUM(
        base_salary 
        + overtime_allowance 
        + night_shift_allowance 
        + holiday_allowance 
        + COALESCE(overtime_excess_allowance, 0) 
        + COALESCE(pto_allowance, 0)
        + COALESCE(ability_allowance, 0)
      ) as total_wages
      FROM monthly_payslips
      WHERE target_month = ?
    `).get(r.target_month) as any;
    return {
      ...r,
      payslip_total_wages: payslipRow && payslipRow.total_wages !== null ? Number(payslipRow.total_wages) : null
    };
  });
}

export async function saveProductionActivity(formData: FormData) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (role !== 'admin') return;

    const target_month = formData.get("targetMonth") as string;
    if (!target_month) return;
    const total_revenue = parseInt(formData.get("totalRevenue") as string, 10) || 0;
    const total_expenses = parseInt(formData.get("totalExpenses") as string, 10) || 0;
    const total_wages_paid = parseInt(formData.get("totalWagesPaid") as string, 10) || 0;

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO production_activities (
        id, target_month, total_revenue, total_expenses, total_wages_paid, updated_at
      ) VALUES (
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      ) ON CONFLICT(target_month) DO UPDATE SET
        total_revenue = excluded.total_revenue,
        total_expenses = excluded.total_expenses,
        total_wages_paid = excluded.total_wages_paid,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    `).run(randomUUID(), target_month, total_revenue, total_expenses, total_wages_paid);

    revalidatePath('/billing/production');
    revalidatePath('/billing/simulation');
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.error("Failed to save production activity:", e);
  }
}

export async function getProductionDeficitStatus() {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) return { consecutiveDeficitMonths: 0, hasDeficitRisk: false, recentActivities: [] };

  const rows = db.prepare(`
    SELECT target_month, total_revenue, total_expenses, total_wages_paid
    FROM production_activities
    ORDER BY target_month DESC
    LIMIT 6
  `).all() as any[];

  let consecutiveDeficitMonths = 0;
  for (const r of rows) {
    const profit = r.total_revenue - r.total_expenses;
    if (profit < r.total_wages_paid) {
      consecutiveDeficitMonths++;
    } else {
      break; // 連続が途切れたら終了
    }
  }

  return {
    consecutiveDeficitMonths,
    hasDeficitRisk: consecutiveDeficitMonths >= 3,
    recentActivities: rows,
  };
}

'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from 'react';
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Printer, Lock, Unlock } from "lucide-react";
import { getAttendanceForMonth, getProvisionRecordStatus, toggleLockProvisionRecord, getClientDetails } from "./actions";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { AutoFitText } from "@/components/AutoFitText";

export function ProvisionRecordClient({ initialClients, targetYearMonth, isAdmin }: any) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [selectedClient, setSelectedClient] = useState<any | null>(initialClients[0] || null);
  const [clientDetails, setClientDetails] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [attendance, setAttendance] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [recordStatus, setRecordStatus] = useState<any | null>(null);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);

  const [y, m] = targetYearMonth.split('-');
  const year = parseInt(y);
  const month = parseInt(m);

  const daysInMonth = new Date(year, month, 0).getDate();
  const daysArray = Array.from({ length: daysInMonth }, (_, i) => {
    const d = i + 1;
    const dateObj = new Date(year, month - 1, d);
    return {
      day: d,
      dateStr: `${year}-${month.toString().padStart(2, '0')}-${d.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`,
      dayOfWeek: dateObj.getDay()
    };
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    async function loadData() {
      if (!selectedClient) return;
      setIsLoading(true);
      
      const att = await getAttendanceForMonth(selectedClient.id, targetYearMonth);
      const stat = await getProvisionRecordStatus(selectedClient.id, targetYearMonth);
      const details = await getClientDetails(selectedClient.id);
      
      setAttendance(att || []);
      setRecordStatus(stat);
      setClientDetails(details);
      
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
    loadData();
  }, [selectedClient, targetYearMonth]);

  const handlePrevMonth = () => {
    const prev = new Date(year, month - 2, 1);
    const newYm = `${prev.getFullYear()}-${(prev.getMonth() + 1).toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
    window.location.href = `/billing/provision-records?month=${newYm}`;
  };

  const handleNextMonth = () => {
    const next = new Date(year, month, 1);
    const newYm = `${next.getFullYear()}-${(next.getMonth() + 1).toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
    window.location.href = `/billing/provision-records?month=${newYm}`;
  };

  const handleToggleLock = async () => {
    if (!selectedClient) return;
    const newStatus = !recordStatus?.is_locked;
    
    if (newStatus) {
      if (!confirm("この月の実績を確定（ロック）しますか？ロック後は編集できなくなります。")) return;
    }

    const res = await toggleLockProvisionRecord(selectedClient.id, targetYearMonth, newStatus);
    if (res.success) {
      toast.success(newStatus ? "実績を確定（ロック）しました" : "ロックを解除しました");
      setRecordStatus({ ...recordStatus, is_locked: newStatus ? 1 : 0 });
    } else {
      toast.error(res.error || "操作に失敗しました");
    }
  };

  const handlePrint = () => {
    window.print();
  };

  // Helper for rendering table cells
  const getAttendanceForDay = (dateStr: string) => {
    return attendance.find(a => a.record_date === dateStr);
  };

  const isLocked = recordStatus?.is_locked === 1;

  let totalDays = 0;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row h-auto md:h-[calc(100vh-64px)] overflow-x-hidden md:overflow-hidden print:h-auto print:overflow-visible bg-gray-50">
      
      {/* Sidebar - Hidden when printing */}
      <div className="w-full md:w-64 bg-white border-r flex flex-col print:hidden shadow-sm z-10 shrink-0">
        <div className="p-3 sm:p-4 border-b bg-gray-50/50">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between mb-2 sm:mb-4">
            <Button variant="outline" size="icon" onClick={handlePrevMonth} className="h-8 w-8">
              <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
            </Button>
            <h2 className="font-bold text-base sm:text-lg">{year}年{month}月</h2>
            <Button variant="outline" size="icon" onClick={handleNextMonth} className="h-8 w-8">
              <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
            </Button>
          </div>
          
          <div className="text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium text-gray-500">対象者を選択</div>
        </div>
        
        <div className="overflow-y-auto max-h-40 md:max-h-none flex-1">
          {initialClients.map((client: any) => (
            <button
              key={client.id}
              onClick={() => setSelectedClient(client)}
              className={`w-full text-left px-4 py-2.5 sm:py-3 border-b text-xs sm:text-sm transition-colors ${
                selectedClient?.id === client.id 
                  ? 'bg-primary/10 border-l-4 border-l-primary font-bold' 
                  : 'hover:bg-gray-50 border-l-4 border-l-transparent'
              }`}
            >
              {client.name}
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Content Area */}
      <div className="flex-1 overflow-x-auto overflow-y-auto p-3 sm:p-4 md:p-8 print:p-0 print:overflow-visible relative">
        {selectedClient && !isLoading ? (
          <div className="max-w-[800px] mx-auto space-y-4 print:space-y-0 print:max-w-none">
            
            {/* Toolbar - Hidden when printing */}
            <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 print:hidden sticky top-0 bg-gray-50 pb-4 z-10">
              {isAdmin && (
                <Button 
                  variant={isLocked ? "destructive" : "outline"}
                  className="gap-2 shadow-sm"
                  onClick={handleToggleLock}
                >
                  {isLocked ? <Lock className="h-4 w-4" /> : <Unlock className="h-4 w-4" />}
                  {isLocked ? "ロック解除" : "実績を確定 (ロック)"}
                </Button>
              )}
              <Button onClick={handlePrint} className="gap-2 shadow-sm">
                <Printer className="h-4 w-4" />
                印刷 / PDF
              </Button>
            </div>

            {/* A4 Paper Container */}
            <div className="provision-sheet-container bg-white p-6 shadow-md rounded-sm mx-auto print:shadow-none print:p-0 print:m-0" style={{ width: '210mm', minHeight: '280mm', maxHeight: '285mm' }}>
              
              {/* Header */}
              <div className="text-center mb-4">
                <h1 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-widest border-b-2 border-black inline-block pb-1 px-8">
                  就労継続支援A型 サービス提供実績記録票
                </h1>
              </div>

              <div className="flex justify-between items-end mb-2 text-xs">
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <div><strong>対象年月:</strong> {year}年 {month}月分</div>
                  <div><strong>受給者証番号:</strong> {clientDetails?.recipient_number || '未設定'}</div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 mt-1">
                    <strong className="shrink-0 text-sm">氏名:</strong>
                    <div className="border-b border-black pb-0.5 px-3 min-w-[180px] max-w-[260px]">
                      <AutoFitText text={selectedClient.name} maxFontSizePt={13} minFontSizePt={8.5} className="font-bold" />
                    </div>
                    <span className="text-xs shrink-0">様</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                
                <div className="space-y-0.5 text-right border border-black p-2 rounded w-64 text-[10px]">
                  <div><strong>事業所番号:</strong> {clientDetails?.facility_number || '2810099999'}</div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                    <strong className="shrink-0">事業所名:</strong>
                    <div className="max-w-[180px]">
                      <AutoFitText text={clientDetails?.facility_name || '就労継続支援A型事業所'} maxFontSizePt={9.5} minFontSizePt={6.5} className="font-bold text-right" />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* Status Ribbon */}
              {isLocked && (
                <div className="print:hidden bg-red-100 text-red-800 text-center py-1 mb-2 font-bold border border-red-200 text-xs">
                  この月の実績は確定（ロック）されています
                </div>
              )}

              {/* Table */}
              <table className="w-full text-[10px] border-collapse border border-black">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-gray-100 text-center font-bold">
                    <th className="border border-black py-0.5 w-7">日付</th>
                    <th className="border border-black py-0.5 w-7">曜日</th>
                    <th className="border border-black py-0.5 w-14">開始時間</th>
                    <th className="border border-black py-0.5 w-14">終了時間</th>
                    <th className="border border-black py-0.5 w-12">実働</th>
                    <th className="border border-black py-0.5">提供内容・備考</th>
                    <th className="border border-black py-0.5 w-16">確認印</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {daysArray.map(d => {
                    const att = getAttendanceForDay(d.dateStr);
                    const isWeekend = d.dayOfWeek === 0 || d.dayOfWeek === 6;
                    
                    let remarks = "";
                    let workingHoursStr = "";

                    if (att) {
                      if (att.is_absence_addition || att.status === 'absent') {
                        remarks = "欠席";
                        if (att.is_absence_addition) {
                          totalDays++; // usually counted for billing if absence addition is claimed
                        }
                      } else if (att.status === 'present') {
                        totalDays++;
                        if (att.work_type === 'out_facility') {
                          remarks = "施設外就労";
                        }
                      }

                      if (att.clock_in && att.clock_out) {
                        const [inH, inM] = att.clock_in.split(':').map(Number);
                        const [outH, outM] = att.clock_out.split(':').map(Number);
                        
                        const inMinutes = inH * 60 + inM;
                        const outMinutes = outH * 60 + outM;
                        const breakMinutes = parseInt(att.break_time_minutes) || 0;
                        
                        const actualMinutes = outMinutes - inMinutes - breakMinutes;
                        if (actualMinutes > 0) {
                          workingHoursStr = (actualMinutes / 60).toFixed(1);
                        }
                      }
                    }

                    return (
                      <tr key={d.day} className={`h-[5.8mm] ${isWeekend ? "bg-gray-50/50" : ""}`}>
                        <td className="border border-black py-0 text-center font-mono">{d.day}</td>
                        <td className={`border border-black py-0 text-center font-bold ${d.dayOfWeek === 0 ? 'text-red-600' : d.dayOfWeek === 6 ? 'text-blue-600' : ''}`}>
                          {['日','月','火','水','木','金','土'][d.dayOfWeek]}
                        </td>
                        <td className="border border-black py-0 text-center font-mono">{att?.clock_in || ""}</td>
                        <td className="border border-black py-0 text-center font-mono">{att?.clock_out || ""}</td>
                        <td className="border border-black py-0 text-center font-mono font-medium">{workingHoursStr ? `${workingHoursStr}h` : ''}</td>
                        <td className="border border-black py-0 px-1 text-[9.5px] leading-tight text-left">
                          <AutoFitText text={remarks} maxFontSizePt={9} minFontSizePt={6.5} />
                        </td>
                        <td className="border border-black py-0 text-center">
                          {att?.clock_in ? <span className="inline-block w-3.5 h-3.5 border border-gray-400 rounded-full text-[7px] text-gray-400 leading-3.5">印</span> : null}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    )
                  })}
                </tbody>
              </table>

              <div className="mt-2 flex justify-between items-center text-xs">
                <div className="text-[9px] text-gray-500">
                  ※厚生労働省告示に基づく障害福祉サービス提供実績記録原本（保存期間5年間）
                </div>
                <div className="font-bold border-2 border-black py-1 px-4 flex items-center gap-3">
                  <span>合計提供日数:</span>
                  <span className="text-base font-mono">{totalDays} 日</span>
                </div>
              </div>

            </div>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="h-full flex items-center justify-center text-muted-foreground">
            {isLoading ? "読み込み中..." : "左側のリストから対象者を選択してください"}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <style jsx global>{`
        @media print {
          @page {
            size: A4 portrait;
            margin: 6mm 8mm;
          }
          body {
            background: white !important;
            color: black !important;
            -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
            print-color-adjust: exact;
          }
          body * {
            visibility: hidden;
          }
          .print\\:hidden {
            display: none !important;
          }
          .provision-sheet-container, .provision-sheet-container * {
            visibility: visible;
          }
          .provision-sheet-container {
            position: absolute;
            left: 0;
            top: 0;
            margin: 0 !important;
            padding: 0 !important;
            width: 100% !important;
            max-height: 280mm !important;
            overflow: hidden !important;
            box-shadow: none !important;
            border: none !important;
          }
          tr {
            page-break-inside: avoid !important;
            break-inside: avoid !important;
          }
        }
      `}</style>
    </div>
  );
}

'use server';

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { randomUUID } from "crypto";

export async function getClientList() {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) throw new Error("認証されていません");

  try {
    return db.prepare("SELECT id, full_name as name, recipient_number FROM clients WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (status IS NULL OR status = 'active') ORDER BY created_at ASC").all() as any[];
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Failed to fetch clients:", error);
    return [];
  }
}

export async function getClientDetails(clientId: string) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) throw new Error("認証されていません");

  try {
    return db.prepare('SELECT * FROM clients WHERE id = ?').get(clientId) as any;
  } catch (error) {
    return null;
  }
}

export async function getAttendanceForMonth(clientId: string, yearMonth: string) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) throw new Error("認証されていません");

  try {
    return db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM attendance_records 
      WHERE client_id = ? AND record_date LIKE ?
      ORDER BY record_date ASC
    `).all(clientId, `${yearMonth}-%`) as any[];
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Failed to fetch attendance:", error);
    return [];
  }
}

export async function getProvisionRecordStatus(clientId: string, targetMonth: string) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) throw new Error("認証されていません");

  try {
    let record = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM monthly_provision_records 
      WHERE client_id = ? AND target_month = ?
    `).get(clientId, targetMonth) as any;

    if (!record) {
      // Create initial status
      const id = randomUUID();
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO monthly_provision_records (id, client_id, target_month, is_locked)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, 0)
      `).run(id, clientId, targetMonth);
      
      record = { id, client_id: clientId, target_month: targetMonth, is_locked: 0, signature_data: null };
    }
    
    return record;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Failed to get provision record status:", error);
    return null;
  }
}

import { getIntegrityErrors } from "@/lib/compliance/recordIntegrityChecker";

export async function toggleLockProvisionRecord(clientId: string, targetMonth: string, lockStatus: boolean) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) throw new Error("認証されていません");
  if (role !== 'admin' && role !== 'service_manager') {
    throw new Error("管理者またはサビ管のみロック操作が可能です");
  }

  // 実績確定（ロック）時のみ整合性チェックを行う
  if (lockStatus) {
    const errors = getIntegrityErrors(targetMonth, clientId);
    if (errors && errors.length > 0) {
      // 最初の1件のエラー内容を返す
      const firstError = errors[0];
      return { 
        success: false, 
        error: `勤怠と支援記録の不整合があるため確定できません。\n[${firstError.recordDate}] ${firstError.message}\nダッシュボードから詳細を確認・修正してください。` 
      };
    }
  }

  try {
    const isLocked = lockStatus ? 1 : 0;
    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE monthly_provision_records 
      SET is_locked = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      WHERE client_id = ? AND target_month = ?
    `).run(isLocked, clientId, targetMonth);
    
    return { success: true };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Failed to toggle lock:", error);
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
}

import { Header } from "@/components/Header";
import { BillingSubNav } from "@/components/NavigationTabs";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { PrintButton } from "@/app/plans/[id]/PrintButton";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ArrowLeft, SlidersHorizontal } from "lucide-react";
import { getClientDayHolidayInfo } from "@/lib/compliance/holidayUtils";
import { getServiceMode } from "@/lib/serviceModeServer";

export default async function ProvisionRecordsPage({ 
  searchParams 
}: { 
  searchParams: Promise<{ month?: string; clientId?: string; stampStyle?: string; columnMode?: string }> 
}) {
  const serviceMode = await getServiceMode();
  const isTypeB = serviceMode === 'type_b';
  const params = await searchParams;
  
  const today = new Date();
  const currentMonthStr = `${today.getFullYear()}-${String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;

  // 実績データが存在する最新月を取得
  const latestRecordRow = db.prepare(`
    SELECT substr(record_date, 1, 7) as latest_month 
    FROM attendance_records 
    WHERE deleted_at IS NULL 
    ORDER BY record_date DESC 
    LIMIT 1
  `).get() as any;
  const latestDataMonth: string = latestRecordRow?.latest_month || currentMonthStr;

  const currentMonthCount = db.prepare(`
    SELECT count(*) as count 
    FROM attendance_records 
    WHERE record_date LIKE ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
  `).get(`${currentMonthStr}-%`) as any;

  const currentMonth: string = params.month || ((currentMonthCount?.count > 0) ? currentMonthStr : latestDataMonth);

  const selectedClientId = params.clientId || "";
  const stampStyle = params.stampStyle || "stamp"; // 'stamp' | 'box' | 'text'
  const columnMode = params.columnMode || "auto";   // 'auto' | 'show' | 'hide'

  const clients = db.prepare(
    "SELECT * FROM clients WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (status IS NULL OR status = 'active') ORDER BY created_at DESC"
  ).all() as any[];
  
  let records: any[] = [];
  let shifts: any[] = [];
  let clientInfo: any = null;
  let facilityInfo: any = null;

  facilityInfo = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any;
  const facilityHasMeal = facilityInfo?.meal_provision_addition === 1;
  const facilityHasTransportation = facilityInfo?.transportation_addition && facilityInfo.transportation_addition !== 'none';
  
  // 送迎・食事列を表示するかどうかの判定
  const showTransAndMeal = columnMode === 'show' 
    ? true 
    : (columnMode === 'hide' ? false : (facilityHasMeal || facilityHasTransportation));

  // 当月の事業所開所日数および実利用者数（様式第4 法定記載事項）
  const monthlyFacilityStats = db.prepare(`
    SELECT 
      COUNT(DISTINCT record_date) as monthly_open_days,
      COUNT(DISTINCT client_id) as monthly_active_users
    FROM attendance_records
    WHERE record_date LIKE ? AND status = 'present' AND deleted_at IS NULL
  `).get(`${currentMonth}-%`) as any;
  const facilityOpenDays = monthlyFacilityStats?.monthly_open_days || 0;
  const facilityActiveUsers = monthlyFacilityStats?.monthly_active_users || 0;

  if (selectedClientId && currentMonth) {
    clientInfo = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM clients WHERE id = ?').get(selectedClientId);
    
    // 施設外就労先（請負企業マスタ）とLEFT JOINして企業名を取得
    records = db.prepare(`
      SELECT 
        ar.*,
        ow.name as offsite_name,
        ow.company_name as offsite_company_name
      FROM attendance_records ar
      LEFT JOIN offsite_workplaces ow ON ar.offsite_workplace_id = ow.id
      WHERE ar.client_id = ? AND ar.record_date LIKE ? AND ar.deleted_at IS NULL
      ORDER BY ar.record_date ASC
    `).all(selectedClientId, `${currentMonth}-%`) as any[];

    // シフト情報を取得（公休日判定用）
    shifts = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM client_shifts
      WHERE client_id = ? AND target_date LIKE ?
    `).all(selectedClientId, `${currentMonth}-%`) as any[];
  }

  // Parse YYYY-MM
  const [yearStr, monthStr] = currentMonth.split('-');
  const year = parseInt(yearStr);
  const month = parseInt(monthStr);

  // Generate days in month
  const daysInMonth = new Date(year, month, 0).getDate();
  const calendarRows = [];
  
  let totalAttendanceDays = 0;
  let totalActualHours = 0;

  for (let i = 1; i <= daysInMonth; i++) {
    const dStr = String(i).padStart(2, '0');
    const dateStr = `${currentMonth}-${dStr}`;
    const dateObj = new Date(year, month - 1, i);
    const dayOfWeek = ["日", "月", "火", "水", "木", "金", "土"][dateObj.getDay()];

    const record = records.find(r => r.record_date === dateStr);
    const shift = shifts.find(s => s.target_date === dateStr);
    
    let startTime = "";
    let endTime = "";
    let actualHours: any = "";
    let remarks = "";
    let offsiteInfo: { name: string; style: string } | null = null;

    let serviceStatus = "";
    let pickup = "";
    let dropoff = "";
    let offsite = "";
    let meal = "";

    if (record) {
      if (record.status === 'present') {
        if (record.is_offsite === 1) {
          serviceStatus = "2"; // 2: 施設外就労
          offsite = "〇";
          const companyName = record.offsite_company_name || record.offsite_name || "請負先企業";
          remarks = "施設外就労";
          offsiteInfo = {
            name: companyName,
            style: stampStyle
          };
        } else if (record.is_telework === 1) {
          serviceStatus = "3"; // 3: 施設外支援（在宅等）
          remarks = "在宅就労";
        } else {
          serviceStatus = "1"; // 1: 通所
        }

        startTime = record.clock_in || "";
        endTime = record.clock_out || "";
        
        if (record.pickup_used === 1 || record.pickup_service === 1) pickup = "〇";
        if (record.dropoff_used === 1 || record.dropoff_service === 1) dropoff = "〇";
        if ((record.transportation_used === 1 || record.transportation_service_used === 1) && !record.pickup_used && !record.dropoff_used && !record.pickup_service && !record.dropoff_service) {
          pickup = "〇";
        }

        if (record.meal_provided === 1) {
          meal = "〇";
        }

        if (startTime && endTime) {
          const start = new Date(`${dateStr}T${startTime}`);
          const end = new Date(`${dateStr}T${endTime}`);
          let diffMs = end.getTime() - start.getTime();
          if (diffMs < 0) diffMs = 0;

          let minutes = Math.floor(diffMs / (1000 * 60));
          const breakTime = record.break_time_minutes || 0;
          minutes -= breakTime;
          if (minutes < 0) minutes = 0;

          const decimalHours = minutes / 60;
          actualHours = decimalHours.toFixed(2).replace(/\.00$/, ''); 
          
          totalAttendanceDays++;
          totalActualHours += decimalHours;
        }

      } else if (record.status === 'absent') {
        if (record.is_absence_addition === 1) {
          serviceStatus = "4"; // 厚労省告示コード 4: 欠席時対応加算
          remarks = "欠席時対応加算";
        } else {
          remarks = "欠勤";
        }
      } else if (record.status === 'holiday') {
        remarks = "公休";
      } else if (record.status === 'paid_leave' || record.status === 'pto') {
        remarks = "有給休暇";
      }
    } else if (clientInfo) {
      // 勤怠レコードがない日: シフト表および利用者台帳（定休日・定例パターン）から公休判定
      const holidayInfo = getClientDayHolidayInfo(dateStr, clientInfo, shift);
      if (holidayInfo.isHoliday) {
        remarks = holidayInfo.holidayLabel || "公休";
      }
    }

    calendarRows.push({
      day: i,
      dayOfWeek,
      serviceStatus,
      startTime,
      endTime,
      actualHours,
      pickup,
      dropoff,
      offsite,
      meal,
      remarks,
      offsiteInfo,
    });
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background/50">
      {/* 
        A4縦（210mm × 297mm）印刷専用CSS
        上下マージン10mm、左右12mm、印刷領域 186mm × 277mm をフル活用し、
        下の巨大な空白を排除し、美しく端正な比率に整える
      */}
      <style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: `
        @media print {
          @page {
            size: A4 portrait;
            margin: 0;
          }
          html, body {
            width: 210mm !important;
            height: 297mm !important;
            margin: 0 !important;
            padding: 0 !important;
            background: white !important;
            color: black !important;
            font-size: 11px !important;
            -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact !important;
            print-color-adjust: exact !important;
          }
          .print-a4-sheet {
            width: 210mm !important;
            height: 297mm !important;
            max-width: 210mm !important;
            max-height: 297mm !important;
            min-height: 297mm !important;
            margin: 0 auto !important;
            padding: 9mm 10mm 9mm 10mm !important;
            box-sizing: border-box !important;
            border: none !important;
            box-shadow: none !important;
            page-break-inside: avoid !important;
            page-break-after: always !important;
            break-after: page !important;
            overflow: hidden !important;
            display: flex !important;
            flex-direction: column !important;
            justify-content: space-between !important;
          }
          table {
            border-collapse: collapse !important;
            width: 100% !important;
            table-layout: fixed !important;
            page-break-inside: avoid !important;
          }
          thead tr {
            height: 7mm !important;
          }
          tbody tr {
            page-break-inside: avoid !important;
            height: 5.9mm !important;
          }
          tfoot tr {
            height: 7.5mm !important;
          }
          th, td {
            padding: 2px 2px !important;
            line-height: 1.2 !important;
            overflow: hidden !important;
            vertical-align: middle !important;
          }
        }
      `}} />

      <div className="print:hidden">
        <Header activePage="billing" />
        <BillingSubNav />
      </div>

      <main className="flex-1 p-4 md:p-8 print:p-0">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-4xl space-y-6 print:space-y-0 print:max-w-none">
          
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center print:hidden">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Link 
                href="/billing" 
                className="text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground flex items-center gap-1 font-medium"
              >
                <ArrowLeft className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                請求管理へ戻る
              </Link>
              <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">サービス提供実績記録表</h1>
            </div>
            {clientInfo && <PrintButton />}
          </div>

          {/* 操作・様式カスタマイズツールバー（印刷時は非表示） */}
          <Card className="print:hidden border-blue-200 bg-blue-50/20 shadow-xs">
            <CardContent className="pt-4 pb-4">
              <form className="flex flex-wrap gap-4 items-end" method="GET">
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-700">対象月</label>
                    {latestDataMonth !== currentMonthStr && (
                      <Link 
                        href={`/billing/provision-records?month=${latestDataMonth}&clientId=${selectedClientId || clients[0]?.id || ''}`}
                        className="text-[10px] text-blue-600 hover:underline font-semibold"
                      >
                        実績確定月({latestDataMonth.replace('-', '年')}月)
                      </Link>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <input 
                    type="month" 
                    name="month" 
                    defaultValue={currentMonth} 
                    className="flex h-9 rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-xs focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1 min-w-[180px]">
                  <label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-700">利用者</label>
                  <select 
                    name="clientId" 
                    defaultValue={selectedClientId}
                    className="flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-xs focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring"
                  >
                    <option value="">選択してください</option>
                    {clients.map(c => (
                      <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.full_name}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1 min-w-[200px]">
                  <label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 flex items-center gap-1">
                    <SlidersHorizontal className="h-3 w-3 text-primary" />
                    送迎・食事列の表示
                  </label>
                  <select 
                    name="columnMode" 
                    defaultValue={columnMode}
                    className="flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-xs focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring"
                  >
                    <option value="auto">自動判定 ({facilityHasMeal || facilityHasTransportation ? '加算あり・全列表示' : '加算なし・シンプル様式'})</option>
                    <option value="hide">シンプル様式（送迎・食事なし / 備考欄ワイド）</option>
                    <option value="show">厚労省標準様式（全列表示）</option>
                  </select>

              {/* 帳票ヘッダー */}

import { Header } from "@/components/Header";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { ArrowLeft } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { PrintButton } from "@/components/PrintButton";
import { getBillingSummaryForPrint } from "@/app/billing/actions";
import { AutoFitText } from "@/components/AutoFitText";

export default async function ProxyReceiptPage({ searchParams }: { searchParams?: Promise<{ month?: string }> }) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) {
    redirect("/login");
  }

  const params = searchParams ? await searchParams : {};
  const today = new Date();
  // 先月をデフォルトにする（通常、前月分を当月に通知するため）
  const lastMonthDate = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth() - 1, 1);
  const targetMonth = params.month || `${lastMonthDate.getFullYear()}-${String(lastMonthDate.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;

  const facilityRaw = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any || {};
  const summary = await getBillingSummaryForPrint(targetMonth);
  const facility = { ...facilityRaw, ...summary.facility };

  // 各利用者の確定請求・負担額データ
  const receipts = summary.clients.map((c) => {
    const details = [
      {
        name: `基本報酬${!c.hasValidPlan ? (c.uncreatedMonths >= 2 ? '（未作成減算50%適用）' : '（未作成減算70%適用）') : ''}`,
        days: c.actualDays,
        amount: Math.floor(c.baseUnitsTotal * summary.facility.areaUnitCost)
      },
      ...c.additions.map(a => ({
        name: a.name,
        days: a.count,
        amount: Math.floor(a.total * summary.facility.areaUnitCost)
      }))
    ];

    return {
      clientId: c.clientId,
      clientName: c.clientName,
      recipientNumber: c.recipientNumber,
      attendanceDays: c.actualDays,
      totalCost: c.totalCost,
      proxyReceiptAmount: c.billingAmount,
      userBurden: c.userBurden,
      details
    };
  });

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background/50">
      <style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{__html: `
        @media print {
          @page {
            size: A4 portrait;
            margin: 10mm 12mm 10mm 12mm;
          }
          html, body {
            margin: 0 !important;
            padding: 0 !important;
            height: 100% !important;
            background: white !important;
            color: black !important;
            -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
            print-color-adjust: exact;
          }
          .receipt-page-print {
            height: 275mm !important;
            max-height: 275mm !important;
            display: flex !important;
            flex-direction: column !important;
            justify-content: space-between !important;
            page-break-after: always !important;
            break-after: page !important;
            page-break-inside: avoid !important;
            break-inside: avoid !important;
            padding: 0 !important;
            margin: 0 !important;
            border: none !important;
            box-shadow: none !important;
          }
          .receipt-page-print:last-child {
            page-break-after: avoid !important;
            break-after: avoid !important;
          }
        }
      `}} />

      <div className="print:hidden">
        <Header activePage="billing" />
      </div>

      <main className="flex-1 p-3.5 sm:p-6 md:p-12 print:p-0">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-4xl space-y-6 print:max-w-none print:space-y-0">
          {/* コントロールヘッダー（印刷時は非表示） */}
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4 print:hidden">
            <div>
              <Link href="/billing" className="inline-flex items-center text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground mb-2">
                <ArrowLeft className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                請求管理へ戻る
              </Link>
              <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">
                法定代理受領通知書の発行
              </h1>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs sm:text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                障害者総合支援法に基づき、事業所が利用者に代わって受領した訓練等給付費を各利用者に通知します。
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5 w-full sm:w-auto">
              <form method="GET" className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <input 
                  type="month" 
                  name="month" 
                  defaultValue={targetMonth} 
                  className="h-9 px-2.5 rounded-md border text-xs"
                />
                <Button type="submit" variant="secondary" size="sm" className="h-9 text-xs">変更</Button>
              </form>
              <PrintButton size="sm" label="一括印刷" />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 通知書一覧（印刷プレビュー） */}
          {receipts.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-12 text-center text-muted-foreground border rounded-lg bg-white print:hidden">
              {targetMonth} に通所実績のある利用者がいません。
            </div>
          ) : (

                    </div>

                      <div className="max-w-[55%]">
                        <div className="h-7 border-b border-black pb-0.5 inline-flex items-center w-full max-w-[280px]">
                          <div className="flex-1 overflow-hidden h-full">
                            <AutoFitText text={`${r.clientName} 様`} maxFontSize={13} minFontSize={9} className="font-bold tracking-wide" />

                        </div>
                        <div className="h-4 overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-end">
                          <AutoFitText text={`${facility.facility_name || '事業所名'}（事業者No. ${facility.facility_number || '未登録'}）`} maxFontSize={8.5} minFontSize={6} />
                        </div>
                        <p>管理者: {facility.manager_name || '管理者'} 印</p>
                        <div className="h-3.5 overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-end text-[10px] text-gray-600">

                        貴殿に支給される介護給付費・訓練等給付費について、当事業所が貴殿に代わり下記のとおり受領いたしましたので通知いたします。
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  {/* 受領額テーブル */}

export interface ScoreSheetReportProps {
  facility: any;
  fiscalYear: number; // 例: 2026
  workingHoursAverage: number; // 例: 5.8
  workingHoursScore: number;
  productionActivityScore: number;
  productionSummary?: {
    revenue: number;
    wages: number;
    balance: number;
  };
  diversityScore: number;
  supportImprovementScore: number;
  regionalCooperationScore: number;
  managementImprovementScore: number;
  knowledgeSkillScore: number;
  totalScore: number;
  baseUnit: number;
  publishedUrl?: string;
  publishedDate?: string;
}

export function ScoreSheetReport({
  facility,
  fiscalYear,
  workingHoursAverage,
  workingHoursScore,
  productionActivityScore,
  productionSummary,
  diversityScore,
  supportImprovementScore,
  regionalCooperationScore,
  managementImprovementScore,
  knowledgeSkillScore,
  totalScore,
  baseUnit,
  publishedUrl,
  publishedDate,
}: ScoreSheetReportProps) {
  // 和暦年度
  const reiwaYear = fiscalYear >= 2019 ? fiscalYear - 2018 : fiscalYear;
  const reiwaYearStr = `令和${reiwaYear}年度`;

  // 労働時間の文字列表現
  const hours = Math.floor(workingHoursAverage || 0);
  const minutes = Math.round(((workingHoursAverage || 0) - hours) * 60);
  const avgHoursStr = `${hours}時間${minutes.toString().padStart(2, '0')}分`;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 max-w-[210mm] mx-auto p-4 sm:p-6 print:p-0 print:max-w-none bg-background text-foreground">
      {/* ツールバー（画面表示時のみ） */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-between items-center gap-2 bg-muted/40 p-3 rounded-lg border print:hidden">
        <Link href="/billing/simulation">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="text-xs gap-1 font-bold">
            <ArrowLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>シミュレーションに戻る</span>
          </Button>
        </Link>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-semibold hidden md:inline">
            厚生労働省告示・神戸市4月公表義務書式
          </span>
          <Button size="sm" onClick={() => window.print()} className="text-xs gap-1 font-bold bg-primary text-primary-foreground">
            <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>A4印刷 / PDF保存</span>
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 印刷用CSS */}
      <style jsx global>{`
        @media print {
          @page {
            size: A4 portrait;
            margin: 10mm 10mm 10mm 10mm;
          }
          body {
            background: white !important;
            color: black !important;
            -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
            print-color-adjust: exact;
          }
          .score-sheet-print {
            border: none !important;
            box-shadow: none !important;
            padding: 0 !important;
          }
        }
      `}</style>

      {/* 公式帳票本体（A4縦） */}
      <div className="score-sheet-print bg-white text-black font-sans text-xs leading-tight border border-black p-6 space-y-3 shadow-sm print:shadow-none">
        
        {/* ヘッダー・表題 */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap sm:flex-nowrap justify-between items-start gap-4 border-b-2 border-black pb-2">
          <div className="flex-1 min-w-[200px]">
            <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-600 font-semibold mb-0.5">
              別紙様式２（就労継続支援Ａ型事業所におけるスコア表）
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold tracking-wider">
              就労継続支援Ａ型事業所におけるスコア表（公表用）
            </h1>
            <div className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-800 mt-1">
              対象年度： {reiwaYearStr}（{fiscalYear}年度算定分）
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="text-right text-[10px] space-y-1 shrink-0">
            <div className="border border-black p-1 text-center min-w-[120px]">
              <div className="border-b border-black pb-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold bg-gray-50">管理者承認印</div>
              <div className="h-10 flex items-center justify-center text-gray-400">印</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 1. 事業所基本情報 */}
        <div className="border border-black">
          <div className="bg-gray-100 font-bold px-2 py-1 border-b border-black text-[11px]">
            1. 事業所基本情報
          </div>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 text-[10.5px]">
            <div className="border-r border-black p-1.5 space-y-1 overflow-hidden">
              <div className="h-4 flex items-center overflow-hidden">
                <span className="font-semibold text-gray-600 shrink-0 mr-1">法人名：</span>
                <div className="flex-1 overflow-hidden h-full">
                  <AutoFitText text={facility?.corporation_name || '特定非営利活動法人○○'} maxFontSize={9} minFontSize={6} />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="h-5 flex items-center overflow-hidden">
                <span className="font-semibold text-gray-600 shrink-0 mr-1">事業所名：</span>
                <div className="flex-1 overflow-hidden h-full">
                  <AutoFitText text={facility?.facility_name || '就労継続支援A型事業所'} maxFontSize={10.5} minFontSize={7} className="font-bold" />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="h-4 flex items-center overflow-hidden">
                <span className="font-semibold text-gray-600 shrink-0 mr-1">所在地：</span>
                <div className="flex-1 overflow-hidden h-full">
                  <AutoFitText text={`〒${facility?.postal_code || ''} ${facility?.address || ''}`} maxFontSize={9} minFontSize={6} />
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="p-1.5 space-y-1">
              <div><span className="font-semibold text-gray-600">事業所番号：</span> <span className="font-mono font-bold tracking-wider">{facility?.facility_number || '2810099999'}</span></div>
              <div><span className="font-semibold text-gray-600">定員規模：</span> {facility?.capacity_class || '20人以下'}</div>
              <div><span className="font-semibold text-gray-600">指定権者：</span> 兵庫県 神戸市福祉局</div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 2. スコア算定項目・配点明細 */}
        <div className="border border-black">
          <div className="bg-gray-100 font-bold px-2 py-1 border-b border-black text-[11px] flex justify-between items-center">
            <span>2. スコア算定項目の実績および配点（厚生労働大臣が定める評価基準）</span>
            <span className="text-[10px] font-normal text-gray-600">令和6年報酬改定対応</span>
          </div>

          <table className="w-full border-collapse text-[10.5px]">
            <thead>
              <tr className="border-b border-black bg-gray-50 text-center font-bold">
                <th className="border-r border-black py-1 px-2 text-left w-36">評価項目</th>
                <th className="border-r border-black py-1 px-2 text-left">本事業所における実績・取り組み状況</th>
                <th className="border-r border-black py-1 px-2 w-20">配点基準</th>
                <th className="py-1 px-2 w-20">獲得点数</th>

                  前年度利用者の1日あたり平均実労働時間： <span className="font-bold text-sm text-primary">{avgHoursStr}</span>
                  <div className="text-[9.5px] text-gray-600 mt-0.5">
                    ※有給休暇取得日の契約所定労働時間を含め適正に算定（令和6年度改定厚労省解釈通知準拠）

                </td>
              </tr>

              {/* Ⅱ. 生産活動 */}

                <td className="border-r border-black p-2 font-bold bg-gray-50/50">

                </td>

                  {productionActivityScore > 0 ? (
                    <div>
                      <span className="font-semibold text-emerald-800">生産活動収支が利用者の支払賃金総額を上回っている（要件達成）</span>
                      {productionSummary && (
                        <div className="text-[9.5px] text-gray-600 mt-0.5 font-mono">
                          売上収益: ¥{productionSummary.revenue.toLocaleString()} / 支払賃金: ¥{productionSummary.wages.toLocaleString()} (差引: +¥{productionSummary.balance.toLocaleString()})
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  ) : (
                    <div>
                      <span className="font-semibold text-rose-800">生産活動収支が賃金総額を下回っている</span>
                      <div className="text-[9.5px] text-rose-700 mt-0.5">
                        ※経営改善計画に基づき収支改善を実施中

                </td>
              </tr>

              {/* Ⅲ. 多様な働き方 */}

                </td>
                <td className="border-r border-black p-2 text-center text-gray-600">
                  最大15点
                </td>

                </td>
              </tr>

              {/* Ⅳ. 支援力向上 */}
              <tr>
                <td className="border-r border-black p-2 font-bold bg-gray-50/50">
                  Ⅳ. 支援力向上
                </td>
                <td className="border-r border-black p-2 leading-relaxed">
                  職員の外部専門研修受講、ピアサポーター等の配置、作業手順書およびマニュアルの体系的整備。
                </td>
                <td className="border-r border-black p-2 text-center text-gray-600">
                  最大15点
                </td>
                <td className="p-2 text-center font-bold text-sm">
                  {supportImprovementScore} 点
                </td>
              </tr>

              {/* Ⅴ. 地域連携活動 */}
              <tr>

                  Ⅴ. 地域連携活動
                </td>
                <td className="border-r border-black p-2 leading-relaxed">
                  地域社会における生産活動の受注、近隣住民や自治会・企業との連携行事、および事業所情報の積極的公開。
                </td>
                <td className="border-r border-black p-2 text-center text-gray-600">
                  最大10点
                </td>
                <td className="p-2 text-center font-bold text-sm">
                  {regionalCooperationScore} 点
                </td>
              </tr>

              {/* Ⅵ. 利用者の知識・能力向上（令和6年度新設） */}

              </span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <p className="text-[9.5px] text-gray-600 pt-1 border-t border-gray-300">
            ※就労継続支援A型事業所は、厚生労働省告示および神戸市指定基準に基づき、毎年度4月中に前年度の実績スコアを算定の上、事業所ホームページ等に公表し、神戸市長へ届け出る義務があります。
          </p>

'use client';

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import Link from "next/link";
import { 
  ChevronLeft, Calculator, Save, AlertTriangle, TrendingUp, 
  BarChart3, Sparkles, CheckCircle2, Clock, DollarSign, 
  Target, ArrowUpRight, RefreshCw, Calendar, Users, Briefcase,
  Printer, FileText
} from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { runSimulation, saveFacilityUnits, FiscalYearScoreProgress } from "./actions";

const getDefaultTargetMonth = () => {
  const d = new Date();
  d.setDate(1);
  d.setMonth(d.getMonth() - 1);
  return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
};

export default function SimulationClient({ 
  initialAverageHours, 
  initialProdActivity, 
  initialProgress,
  isAdmin 
}: { 
  initialAverageHours: number; 
  initialProdActivity: string; 
  initialProgress: FiscalYearScoreProgress | null;
  isAdmin: boolean; 
}) {
  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'dashboard' | 'simulator'>('dashboard');
  const [targetMonth, setTargetMonth] = useState(getDefaultTargetMonth);
  const [version, setVersion] = useState("2024");
  
  const [inputs, setInputs] = useState({
    averageHours: initialAverageHours,
    productionActivity: initialProdActivity,
    diversity: "not_achieved",
    supportImprovement: "not_achieved",
    regionalCooperation: "not_achieved",
    managementImprovement: "submitted_or_not_applicable",
    knowledgeSkill: "not_achieved"
  });

  const [result, setResult] = useState<any>(null);
  const [isSimulating, setIsSimulating] = useState(false);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);

  const performSimulation = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsSimulating(true);
    const res = await runSimulation({ version, ...inputs });
    if (res.success) {
      setResult(res);
    } else {
      alert(res.error);
    }
    setIsSimulating(false);
  }, [inputs, version]);

  // Run initial simulation
  useEffect(() => {
    performSimulation();
  }, [performSimulation]);

  const handleInputChange = (field: string, value: string | number) => {
    setInputs(prev => ({ ...prev, [field]: value }));
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!isAdmin) {
      alert("管理者権限が必要です。");
      return;
    }
    setIsSaving(true);
    const res = await saveFacilityUnits(targetMonth, result, version);
    if (res.success) {
      alert("月次確定データとして保存しました。国保連請求データ作成時に使用されます。");
    } else {
      alert(res.error);
    }
    setIsSaving(false);
  };

  const progress = initialProgress;

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
          <Link href="/billing" className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "icon" }))}>
            <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
          </Link>
          <div>
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <h1 className="text-xl sm:text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">
                スコア方式 基本報酬ダッシュボード
              </h1>
              <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-primary/10 text-primary border-primary/20 text-[10px] sm:text-xs">
                令和6年度改定
              </Badge>
            </div>
            <p className="mt-1 text-xs sm:text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              当年度の実績進捗をリアルタイム追跡し、次年度の基本報酬単位数・売上影響を試算します。
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* タブ切り替え & 公表帳票印刷ボタン */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 w-full md:w-auto">
          <div className="flex items-center bg-muted p-1 rounded-lg border text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium w-full sm:w-auto">
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('dashboard')}
              className={cn(
                "flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 sm:px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md transition-all flex-1 sm:flex-none",
                activeTab === 'dashboard' 
                  ? "bg-white text-foreground shadow-xs font-bold" 
                  : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
              )}
            >
              <BarChart3 className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-primary shrink-0" />
              <span>当年度リアルタイム進捗</span>
            </button>
            <button
              onClick={() => setActiveTab('simulator')}
              className={cn(
                "flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 sm:px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md transition-all flex-1 sm:flex-none",
                activeTab === 'simulator' 
                  ? "bg-white text-foreground shadow-xs font-bold" 
                  : "text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
              )}
            >
              <Calculator className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-primary shrink-0" />
              <span>手動試算・確定</span>
            </button>
          </div>

          <Link href="/billing/simulation/score-sheet" target="_blank" className="w-full sm:w-auto">
            <Button variant="default" size="sm" className="gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold bg-primary hover:bg-primary/90 text-primary-foreground shadow-xs w-full sm:w-auto justify-center">
              <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
              <span>スコア公表票（様式２）印刷</span>
            </Button>
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {/* 1. 当年度リアルタイム進捗ダッシュボード タブ */}
      {/* ========================================================================= */}
      {activeTab === 'dashboard' && progress && (
        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* トップサマリーカード */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            {/* 1. 暫定合計スコア */}
            <Card className="border-indigo-200 bg-gradient-to-br from-indigo-50/50 to-white shadow-xs">
              <CardHeader className="pb-2">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="text-xs font-bold text-indigo-900 flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Target className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600" />
                    当年度 暫定合計スコア
                  </span>
                  <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-[10px]">

                      "font-bold text-sm",

                    </span>
                  </div>

                  <div className="py-2 flex items-center justify-between">
                    <div>
                      <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 block">知識・能力の向上</span>
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">一般就労への移行実績等</span>

                    <span className="font-bold text-primary text-sm">{progress.otherCategories.knowledgeSkillScore} 点</span>

            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="pt-6 space-y-6">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label className="font-bold">対象年月 (確定用)</Label>

                  <Label className="font-bold">適用マスター年度</Label>

                </div>
              </div>

                <div className="space-y-2 border p-4 rounded-md bg-muted/10">

                      <option value="not_achieved">満たさない (0点)</option>

                    <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mb-2 text-center">※定員20名以下・配置基準7.5:1を想定</p>
                    <div className="text-5xl font-extrabold text-primary text-center">
                      {result.baseUnit} <span className="text-xl font-bold">単位</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="pt-6">
                    <Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={isSaving || isSimulating || !isAdmin} className="w-full h-14 text-lg font-bold shadow-sm">
                      {isSaving ? "保存中..." : (
                        <>
                          <Save className="mr-2 h-5 w-5" />
                          この月次単位数を確定して保存
                        </>
                      )}
                    </Button>
                    {!isAdmin && <p className="text-xs text-center text-muted-foreground mt-2">確定保存には管理者権限が必要です</p>}
                  </div>
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState } from "react";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { 
  Calculator, TrendingUp, AlertTriangle, CheckCircle2, 
  HelpCircle, ShieldCheck, DollarSign, Award, ChevronRight, 
  RefreshCw, FileText, ArrowUpRight
} from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import Link from "next/link";
import { determineTypeBServiceFee } from "@/lib/compliance/officialTypeBBillingMaster";

interface TypeBSimulationProps {
  initialData: {
    fiscalYearPeriod: string;
    totalWagePaid: number;
    facilityOpenDays: number;
    totalClientAttendances: number;
    averageUsersPerDay: number;
    averageMonthlyWage: number;
    isBelowMinimum3000: boolean;
    staffRatio: '6:1' | '7.5:1' | '10:1';
    currentServiceFee: any;
    unitPrice: number;
    activeClientsCount: number;
    brackets: any[];
    additions: any[];
    fixedFees: any;
  };
  isAdmin: boolean;
}

export function TypeBSimulationClient({ initialData, isAdmin }: TypeBSimulationProps) {
  // シミュレーション用ステート
  const [simStaffRatio, setSimStaffRatio] = useState<'6:1' | '7.5:1' | '10:1'>(initialData.staffRatio || '6:1');
  const [useFixedFee, setUseFixedFee] = useState<boolean>(false);
  const [simMonthlyWage, setSimMonthlyWage] = useState<number>(initialData.averageMonthlyWage || 18500);
  const [simActiveUsers, setSimActiveUsers] = useState<number>(initialData.activeClientsCount || 15);
  const [simMonthlyDays, setSimMonthlyDays] = useState<number>(20);

  // 加算選択状態
  const [selectedAdditions, setSelectedAdditions] = useState<{ [key: string]: boolean }>({
    target_wage_instructor: true, // 目標工賃達成指導員配置加算 (89単位)
    target_wage_achievement: false, // 目標工賃達成加算 (10単位)
    regional_cooperation: true, // 地域協働加算 (30単位)
    treatment_improvement_1: true // 処遇改善新加算Ⅰ
  });

  const toggleAddition = (key: string) => {
    setSelectedAdditions(prev => ({ ...prev, [key]: !prev[key] }));
  };

  // シミュレーション結果の計算
  const calculatedServiceFee = determineTypeBServiceFee({
    averageMonthlyWage: simMonthlyWage,
    staffRatio: simStaffRatio,
    capacity: 20,
    useGeneralScale: useFixedFee
  });

  const baseUnitsPerDay = calculatedServiceFee.units;

  // 加算合計単位数/日
  let additionUnitsPerDay = 0;
  if (selectedAdditions.target_wage_instructor) additionUnitsPerDay += 89;
  if (selectedAdditions.target_wage_achievement) additionUnitsPerDay += 10;
  if (selectedAdditions.regional_cooperation) additionUnitsPerDay += 30;

  // 1日・月間・年間報酬の試算
  const totalDailyUnitsPerUser = baseUnitsPerDay + additionUnitsPerDay;
  const monthlyTotalUnits = totalDailyUnitsPerUser * simActiveUsers * simMonthlyDays;
  
  // 処遇改善加算率（B型新加算Ⅰ: 11.2%）
  let treatmentRate = 0;
  if (selectedAdditions.treatment_improvement_1) treatmentRate = 0.112;

  const monthlyTreatmentUnits = Math.round(monthlyTotalUnits * treatmentRate);
  const grandTotalMonthlyUnits = monthlyTotalUnits + monthlyTreatmentUnits;

  const unitPrice = initialData.unitPrice || 10.36;
  const monthlyRevenue = Math.round(grandTotalMonthlyUnits * unitPrice);
  const annualRevenue = monthlyRevenue * 12;

  // 次のランクまでの必要工賃試算
  const currentBracketIndex = initialData.brackets.findIndex(
    b => simMonthlyWage >= b.minWage && (b.maxWage === null || simMonthlyWage < b.maxWage)
  );

  const nextBracket = currentBracketIndex > 0 ? initialData.brackets[currentBracketIndex - 1] : null;
  const wageNeededForNextRank = nextBracket ? Math.max(0, nextBracket.minWage - simMonthlyWage) : 0;
  const annualTotalWageNeeded = wageNeededForNextRank * (simActiveUsers || 1) * 12;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* ページタイトルと概要 */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-end gap-4">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <span className="px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-bold rounded-full bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-300">
              就労継続支援B型
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">令和6年度報酬改定・令和8年6月改定準拠</span>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground mt-1">
            工賃・基本報酬シミュレーション
          </h1>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1 text-xs sm:text-sm">
            厚労省告示に基づき、平均工賃月額と人員配置基準（6:1 / 7.5:1 / 10:1）から次期基本報酬区分と事業所給付費を試算します。
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Link 
            href="/billing/payroll/wage-report" 
            className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-semibold rounded-md border border-emerald-600 text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 hover:bg-emerald-100 flex items-center gap-1.5"
          >
            <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            工賃実績報告書を見る
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 現在の実績サマリーカード */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <Card className="bg-white border-emerald-200 shadow-2xs">
          <CardHeader className="p-4 pb-2">
            <CardDescription className="text-xs font-medium text-emerald-700">実績集計期間</CardDescription>
            <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold text-gray-800">{initialData.fiscalYearPeriod}</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="p-4 pt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground space-y-1">
            <div>年間工賃支払総額: <strong className="text-foreground">{initialData.totalWagePaid.toLocaleString()}円</strong></div>
            <div>年間開所日数: <strong className="text-foreground">{initialData.facilityOpenDays}日</strong></div>
            <div>延べ利用人員: <strong className="text-foreground">{initialData.totalClientAttendances}名</strong></div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className={cn(
          "bg-white shadow-2xs border",
          initialData.isBelowMinimum3000 ? "border-red-400 bg-red-50/30" : "border-emerald-300"
        )}>
          <CardHeader className="p-4 pb-2">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <CardDescription className="text-xs font-medium text-emerald-700">法定平均工賃月額</CardDescription>
              {initialData.isBelowMinimum3000 ? (
                <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-red-100 text-red-800">3,000円未満</span>
              ) : (
                <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-bold bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800">下限達成</span>
              )}
            </div>
            <CardTitle className="text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-950">
              {Math.round(initialData.averageMonthlyWage).toLocaleString()}<span className="text-sm font-normal text-gray-500"> 円/月</span>
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="p-4 pt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
            <div>1日平均利用者数: <strong>{initialData.averageUsersPerDay.toFixed(1)}名</strong></div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-500 mt-1">※支払総額÷(延べ利用人数÷開所日数)÷12ヶ月</div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="bg-white border-emerald-200 shadow-2xs">
          <CardHeader className="p-4 pb-2">
            <CardDescription className="text-xs font-medium text-emerald-700">現在の人員配置</CardDescription>
            <CardTitle className="text-xl font-bold text-gray-800">
              {initialData.staffRatio} 配置
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="p-4 pt-1 text-xs text-muted-foreground space-y-1">
            <div>現行基本報酬: <strong className="text-emerald-700 text-sm">{initialData.currentServiceFee.units}単位/日</strong></div>
            <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-600 truncate">{initialData.currentServiceFee.bracketLabel}</div>
            <div className="text-[10px] text-gray-500">コード: {initialData.currentServiceFee.serviceCode}</div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="bg-emerald-900 text-white shadow-md">
          <CardHeader className="p-4 pb-2">
            <CardDescription className="text-xs font-medium text-emerald-200">現行基準での月間推定給付費</CardDescription>
            <CardTitle className="text-2xl font-bold text-white">
              {Math.round(initialData.currentServiceFee.units * (initialData.activeClientsCount || 15) * 20 * unitPrice).toLocaleString()}
              <span className="text-xs font-normal text-emerald-200"> 円/月</span>
            </CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="p-4 pt-1 text-xs text-emerald-100 space-y-0.5">
            <div>地域区分単価: {unitPrice}円/単位</div>
            <div>年間推計: 約{(Math.round(initialData.currentServiceFee.units * (initialData.activeClientsCount || 15) * 20 * unitPrice) * 12 / 10000).toFixed(0)}万円</div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* 3,000円未満警告アラート */}
      {initialData.isBelowMinimum3000 && (
        <div className="p-4 rounded-lg bg-red-50 border-2 border-red-300 text-red-900 flex items-start gap-3">
          <AlertTriangle className="w-5 h-5 text-red-600 shrink-0 mt-0.5" />
          <div className="text-xs sm:text-sm">
            <strong className="font-bold text-base block mb-1">【指定基準第171条違反リスク】平均工賃月額が3,000円を下回っています</strong>
            障害者総合支援法指定基準第171条により、就労継続支援B型事業所は利用者に支払う平均工賃月額を3,000円以上とすることが義務付けられています。3,000円未満の状況が継続する場合、行政による勧告・指定取消を含む指導対象となります。
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 対話型シミュレーション操作パネル */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6">
        {/* 左側: 条件設定入力 */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-5 space-y-6">
          <Card className="border-emerald-300 shadow-2xs">
            <CardHeader className="bg-emerald-50/60 pb-3 border-b">
              <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold flex items-center gap-2 text-emerald-950">
                <Calculator className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-700" />
                シミュレーション条件設定
              </CardTitle>
              <CardDescription className="text-xs">
                人員配置や目標平均工賃を変更して報酬区分の変化を試算します
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="pt-4 space-y-5">
              {/* 人員配置基準選択 */}
              <div>
                <Label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 mb-2 block">① 人員配置基準の選択</Label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                  {(['6:1', '7.5:1', '10:1'] as const).map(ratio => (

                      className={cn(
                        "p-2.5 rounded-lg border text-center transition-all text-xs font-bold",
                        simStaffRatio === ratio
                          ? "border-emerald-600 bg-emerald-100/70 text-emerald-900 ring-2 ring-emerald-500/30"
                          : "border-gray-200 bg-white text-gray-600 hover:bg-gray-50"

                      </div>

                  ))}

              </div>

              {/* 報酬体系モード切り替え */}

              {/* 平均工賃月額スライダー＆直接入力 */}
              {!useFixedFee && (
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <Label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-700">② 目標・想定 平均工賃月額</Label>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                      <Input
                        type="number"
                        value={simMonthlyWage}
                        onChange={(e) => setSimMonthlyWage(Math.max(0, parseInt(e.target.value) || 0))}
                        className="w-28 h-7 text-xs font-bold text-right"
                      />
                      <span className="text-xs font-semibold">円</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <input
                    type="range"
                    min="3000"
                    max="50000"
                    step="500"
                    value={simMonthlyWage}
                    onChange={(e) => setSimMonthlyWage(parseInt(e.target.value))}
                    className="w-full accent-emerald-600"
                  />
                  <div className="flex justify-between text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                    <span>3,000円(下限)</span>
                    <span>1.5万円</span>
                    <span>2.5万円</span>
                    <span>3.5万円</span>
                    <span>4.5万円以上</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}

              {/* 事業規模前提 */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3 pt-2 border-t">
                <div>
                  <Label className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-600 mb-1 block">想定利用者数</Label>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Input
                      type="number"
                      value={simActiveUsers}
                      onChange={(e) => setSimActiveUsers(Math.max(1, parseInt(e.target.value) || 1))}
                      className="h-8 text-xs text-right"
                    />
                    <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">名</span>
