                <div>
                  <Label className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-600 mb-1 block">月間開所日数</Label>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                    <Input
                      type="number"
                      value={simMonthlyDays}
                      onChange={(e) => setSimMonthlyDays(Math.max(1, parseInt(e.target.value) || 1))}
                      className="h-8 text-xs text-right"
                    />
                    <span className="text-xs text-gray-500">日</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* 加算選択オプション */}
              <div className="space-y-2 pt-2 border-t">
                <Label className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-700 block">③ B型専用 加算の選択</Label>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <label className="flex items-start gap-2.5 p-2 rounded border hover:bg-gray-50 text-xs cursor-pointer">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={selectedAdditions.target_wage_instructor}
                      onChange={() => toggleAddition('target_wage_instructor')}
                      className="mt-0.5 text-emerald-600 rounded focus:ring-emerald-500"
                    />
                    <div>
                      <div className="font-semibold text-gray-800">目標工賃達成指導員配置加算 (+89単位/日)</div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">常勤換算5:1以上配置・目標工賃達成指導員の専任配置</div>
                    </div>
                  </label>

                  <label className="flex items-start gap-2.5 p-2 rounded border hover:bg-gray-50 text-xs cursor-pointer">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={selectedAdditions.target_wage_achievement}
                      onChange={() => toggleAddition('target_wage_achievement')}
                      className="mt-0.5 text-emerald-600 rounded focus:ring-emerald-500"
                    />
                    <div>
                      <div className="font-semibold text-gray-800">目標工賃達成加算 (+10単位/日)</div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">工賃向上計画に基づく目標工賃の達成</div>
                    </div>
                  </label>

                  <label className="flex items-start gap-2.5 p-2 rounded border hover:bg-gray-50 text-xs cursor-pointer">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={selectedAdditions.regional_cooperation}
                      onChange={() => toggleAddition('regional_cooperation')}
                      className="mt-0.5 text-emerald-600 rounded focus:ring-emerald-500"
                    />
                    <div>
                      <div className="font-semibold text-gray-800">地域協働加算 (+30単位/日)</div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">地域資源を活用した協働作業や販路開拓の実施</div>
                    </div>
                  </label>

                  <label className="flex items-start gap-2.5 p-2 rounded border hover:bg-gray-50 text-xs cursor-pointer">
                    <input
                      type="checkbox"
                      checked={selectedAdditions.treatment_improvement_1}
                      onChange={() => toggleAddition('treatment_improvement_1')}
                      className="mt-0.5 text-emerald-600 rounded focus:ring-emerald-500"
                    />
                    <div>
                      <div className="font-semibold text-gray-800">福祉・介護職員等処遇改善加算Ⅰ (+11.2%)</div>
                      <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">令和6年6月一本化新加算最高区分（B型法定率: 11.2%）</div>
                    </div>
                  </label>
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>

        {/* 右側: シミュレーション結果表示 */}
        <div className="lg:col-span-7 space-y-6">
          <Card className="border-emerald-300 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
            <CardHeader className="bg-emerald-800 text-white pb-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-xs text-emerald-200 font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase">Simulation Outcome</span>
                  <CardTitle className="text-xl font-bold mt-0.5 text-white">
                    算定される基本報酬区分と推定収益
                  </CardTitle>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right">
                  <div className="text-2xl font-bold">{baseUnitsPerDay} <span className="text-sm font-normal">単位/日</span></div>
                  <div className="text-[11px] text-emerald-200">基本報酬 (定員20名以下)</div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="pt-6 space-y-6">
              {/* 区分詳細バナー */}
              <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-3">
                <div>
                  <div className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-800">適用報酬区分</div>
                  <div className="text-lg font-bold text-emerald-950 mt-0.5">
                    {calculatedServiceFee.serviceName}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-emerald-700 mt-0.5">
                    判定工賃基準: {calculatedServiceFee.bracketLabel}
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="bg-white px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg border border-emerald-300 text-center shrink-0">
                  <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">サービスコード</div>
                  <div className="font-mono text-sm font-bold text-emerald-900">{calculatedServiceFee.serviceCode}</div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* 単位・給付費内訳テーブル */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
                <div className="p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg border text-center">
                  <div className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">基本単位/日</div>
                  <div className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-800">{baseUnitsPerDay} 単位</div>
                </div>
                <div className="p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg border text-center">
                  <div className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">加算単位/日</div>
                  <div className="text-lg font-bold text-emerald-700">+{additionUnitsPerDay} 単位</div>
                </div>
                <div className="p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg border text-center">
                  <div className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">1人1日合計</div>
                  <div className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900">{totalDailyUnitsPerUser} 単位</div>
                </div>
                <div className="p-3 bg-gray-50 rounded-lg border text-center">
                  <div className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">月間総単位数</div>
                  <div className="text-lg font-bold text-emerald-900">{grandTotalMonthlyUnits.toLocaleString()}</div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* 収益インパクトカード */}
              <div className="p-5 bg-linear-to-br from-emerald-900 to-teal-950 rounded-xl text-white shadow-md">
                <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-emerald-300 uppercase tracking-wider">Estimated Revenue</span>
                    <div className="text-3xl font-extrabold mt-1">
                      {monthlyRevenue.toLocaleString()} <span className="text-sm font-normal text-emerald-200">円 / 月</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-xs text-emerald-200 mt-1">
                      年間想定給付費: <strong className="text-white text-sm">{(annualRevenue / 10000).toFixed(1)} 万円</strong> (地域単価: {unitPrice}円)
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-emerald-100 bg-emerald-800/60 p-3 rounded-lg border border-emerald-700/50 space-y-1 sm:max-w-[220px]">
                    <div>基本報酬分: {Math.round(baseUnitsPerDay * simActiveUsers * simMonthlyDays * unitPrice).toLocaleString()}円</div>
                    <div>加算・処遇分: {Math.round((grandTotalMonthlyUnits - baseUnitsPerDay * simActiveUsers * simMonthlyDays) * unitPrice).toLocaleString()}円</div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* 上位区分ステップアップアドバイザー */}
              {nextBracket && !useFixedFee && (
                <div className="p-4 rounded-xl bg-amber-50/70 border border-amber-300 text-amber-950">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-sm text-amber-900">
                    <TrendingUp className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-700" />
                    <span>上位区分（{nextBracket.label}）へのステップアップ試算</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="mt-2 text-xs text-amber-900 space-y-1">
                    <div>
                      次の区分（{simStaffRatio === '6:1' ? nextBracket.units6to1 : simStaffRatio === '7.5:1' ? nextBracket.units75to1 : nextBracket.units10to1}単位）に上がるには、平均工賃月額をあと <strong>+{wageNeededForNextRank.toLocaleString()}円</strong> 引き上げる必要があります。
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      事業所全体の年間追加工賃原資の目安: <strong>約 {annualTotalWageNeeded.toLocaleString()}円</strong>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          {/* 厚生労働省 報酬告示テーブル一覧 */}
          <Card className="border-gray-200 shadow-2xs">
            <CardHeader className="p-4 pb-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-800 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                令和6年度改定 就労継続支援B型 基本報酬一覧（定員20名以下）
              </CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="p-4 pt-1">
              <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                <table className="w-full text-xs text-left">
                  <thead>
                    <tr className="border-b bg-gray-50 text-gray-600">
                      <th className="p-2">平均工賃月額区分</th>
                      <th className="p-2 text-right">6:1配置(Ⅰ)</th>
                      <th className="p-2 text-right">7.5:1配置(Ⅱ)</th>
                      <th className="p-2 text-right">10:1配置(Ⅲ)</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {initialData.brackets.map((b) => {
                      const isCurrent = simMonthlyWage >= b.minWage && (b.maxWage === null || simMonthlyWage < b.maxWage);
                      return (
                        <tr key={b.rangeId} className={cn("border-b", isCurrent && "bg-emerald-100/60 font-bold")}>
                          <td className="p-2">{b.label}</td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-right">{b.units6to1}単位</td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-right">{b.units75to1}単位</td>
                          <td className="p-2 text-right">{b.units10to1}単位</td>
                        </tr>
                      );
                    })}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
              <div className="mt-2 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground space-y-0.5">
                <div>※令和8年6月臨時報酬改定では、中間細分化区分および所定の1000分の984調整が適用されます。</div>
                <div>※定員21名以上の事業所の場合は、規模に応じた告示逓減率が適用されます。</div>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

// JSONマスター読み込みヘルパー
function loadMasterData(version: string, type: 'score_rules' | 'unit_values') {
  const filePath = path.join(process.cwd(), `src/config/billing-master/${version}_${type}.json`);
  const fileContent = fs.readFileSync(filePath, 'utf-8');
  return JSON.parse(fileContent);
}

export async function calculatePreviousYearAverageHours() {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role) return 0;

    const today = new Date();
    const currentMonth = today.getMonth() + 1;
    const currentYear = today.getFullYear();
    
    // 今年度の起算年は、4月以降なら今年、1～3月なら前年
    // 前年度はそのさらに1年前
    const previousFyStartYear = currentMonth >= 4 ? currentYear - 1 : currentYear - 2;
    
    const previousFyStartDate = `${previousFyStartYear}-04-01`;
    const previousFyEndDate = `${previousFyStartYear + 1}-04-01`; // exclusive

    const attendances = db.prepare(`
      SELECT a.status, a.clock_in, a.clock_out, a.break_time_minutes, c.weekly_scheduled_hours, c.regular_holidays
      FROM attendance_records a
      JOIN clients c ON a.client_id = c.id
      WHERE a.record_date >= ? AND a.record_date < ?
        AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND (
          c.service_start_date IS NULL 
          OR c.service_start_date < strftime('%Y-%m-01', a.record_date) 
          OR c.service_start_date > date(strftime('%Y-%m-01', a.record_date), '+1 month', '-1 day')
        )
        AND (
          c.contract_end_date IS NULL 
          OR c.contract_end_date < strftime('%Y-%m-01', a.record_date) 
          OR c.contract_end_date > date(strftime('%Y-%m-01', a.record_date), '+1 month', '-1 day')
        )
    `).all(previousFyStartDate, previousFyEndDate) as any[];

    let totalMinutes = 0;
    let totalWorkDays = 0;

    if (attendances) {
      for (const record of attendances) {
        if (record.status === 'pto') {
          // 厚労省ルール: 年次有給休暇取得日は契約上の所定労働時間をみなし労働時間として合算
          let scheduledDays = 5;
          try {
            const holidays = record.regular_holidays ? JSON.parse(record.regular_holidays) : [];
            if (Array.isArray(holidays)) {
              scheduledDays = Math.max(1, 7 - holidays.length);
            }
          } catch {
            scheduledDays = 5;
          }
          const dailyHours = record.weekly_scheduled_hours && record.weekly_scheduled_hours > 0 
            ? (record.weekly_scheduled_hours / scheduledDays) 
            : 4.0; // デフォルト4時間
          totalMinutes += Math.round(dailyHours * 60);
          totalWorkDays++;
        } else if (record.clock_in && record.clock_out) {
          const [inH, inM] = record.clock_in.split(':').map(Number);
          const [outH, outM] = record.clock_out.split(':').map(Number);
          
          let outTotalM = outH * 60 + outM;
          const inTotalM = inH * 60 + inM;
          if (outTotalM < inTotalM) {
            outTotalM += 24 * 60;
          }
          
          const mins = outTotalM - inTotalM - (record.break_time_minutes || 0);
          if (mins > 0) {
            totalMinutes += mins;
            totalWorkDays++;
          }
        }
      }
    }

    const totalHours = totalMinutes / 60;
    // 厚労省告示基準: 1日当たり平均労働時間 = 前年度延べ労働時間 ÷ 前年度延べ就労日数
    const averageHours = totalWorkDays > 0 ? (totalHours / totalWorkDays) : 0;
    return Number(averageHours.toFixed(1));
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Failed to calculate previous year average hours:", e);
    return 0;
  }
}

// 生産活動収支の自動判定ロジック
export async function evaluateProductionActivity(targetMonth: string) {
  const [targetY, targetM] = targetMonth.split('-').map(Number);

  // カレンダー年月ベースで直近3年度（各12ヶ月）の月キーセットを生成
  // 年1: 直近12ヶ月 (0〜11ヶ月前)
  // 年2: 12〜23ヶ月前
  // 年3: 24〜35ヶ月前
  const getMonthsForPeriod = (startOffsetMonths: number, count: number): Set<string> => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    for (let i = startOffsetMonths; i < startOffsetMonths + count; i++) {
      const d = new Date(targetY, targetM - 1 - i, 1);
      const ym = `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
      set.add(ym);
    }
    return set;
  };

  const period1Months = getMonthsForPeriod(0, 12);
  const period2Months = getMonthsForPeriod(12, 12);
  const period3Months = getMonthsForPeriod(24, 12);

  // targetMonth以前のデータを取得（最大60件）
  const activities = db.prepare(`
    SELECT * FROM production_activities
    WHERE target_month <= ?
    ORDER BY target_month DESC
    LIMIT 60
  `).all(targetMonth) as any[];

  if (activities.length === 0) {
    return "profit_exceeds_wages"; // データがない場合はデフォルト
  }

  // カレンダー基準で各年度にデータを振り分け（欠損月があっても過去年と混ざらない）
  const period1 = activities.filter(a => period1Months.has(a.target_month));
  const period2 = activities.filter(a => period2Months.has(a.target_month));
  const period3 = activities.filter(a => period3Months.has(a.target_month));

  const periods = [period1, period2, period3];

  let consecutiveDeficitYears = 0;

  for (const period of periods) {
    if (period.length === 0) break; // その年のデータが全くない場合はループ終了

    let sumProfit = 0;
    let sumWages = 0;
    for (const act of period) {
      sumProfit += (act.total_revenue - act.total_expenses);
      sumWages += act.total_wages_paid;
    }

    if (sumProfit < sumWages) {
      consecutiveDeficitYears++;
    } else {
      break; // 赤字が途切れたら連続赤字カウント終了
    }
  }

  if (consecutiveDeficitYears >= 3) return "deficit_3_years";
  if (consecutiveDeficitYears === 2) return "deficit_2_years";
  if (consecutiveDeficitYears === 1) return "deficit_1_year";
  return "profit_exceeds_wages";
}

export type SimulationInput = {
  version: string;
  averageHours: number;
  productionActivity: string;
  diversity: string;
  supportImprovement: string;
  regionalCooperation: string;
  managementImprovement: string;
  knowledgeSkill: string;
};

export async function runSimulation(input: SimulationInput) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role) return { success: false, error: '認証されていません' };

    const rules = loadMasterData(input.version, 'score_rules');
    const unitVals = loadMasterData(input.version, 'unit_values');

    let totalScore = 0;
    const details = {
      working_hours: 0,
      production_activity: 0,
      diversity: 0,
      support_improvement: 0,
      regional_cooperation: 0,
      management_improvement: 0,
      knowledge_skill: 0
    };

    // 1. 労働時間のスコア判定
    const whRules = rules.categories.working_hours;
    for (const rule of whRules) {
      if ((rule.min === null || input.averageHours >= rule.min) && 
          (rule.max === null || input.averageHours < rule.max)) {
        details.working_hours = rule.score;
        break;
      }
    }

    // 2. その他の項目
    const calcCategory = (catKey: keyof typeof details, inputVal: string) => {
      const catRules = rules.categories[catKey];
      const match = catRules.find((r: any) => r.condition === inputVal);
      if (match) {
        details[catKey] = match.score;
      }
    };

    calcCategory('production_activity', input.productionActivity);
    calcCategory('diversity', input.diversity);
    calcCategory('support_improvement', input.supportImprovement);
    calcCategory('regional_cooperation', input.regionalCooperation);
    calcCategory('management_improvement', input.managementImprovement);
    calcCategory('knowledge_skill', input.knowledgeSkill);

    totalScore = Object.values(details).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);

    // 3. 単位数の判定
    const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any || {};
    
    // Convert capacity_class and staffing_class to JSON keys
    let capacityKey = 'capacity_20_under';
    if (facility.capacity_class === '21人以上40人以下') capacityKey = 'capacity_21_40';
    else if (facility.capacity_class === '41人以上60人以下') capacityKey = 'capacity_41_60';
    else if (facility.capacity_class === '61人以上80人以下') capacityKey = 'capacity_61_80';
    else if (facility.capacity_class === '81人以上') capacityKey = 'capacity_81_over';

    let staffingKey = 'staff_ratio_7_5';
    if (facility.staffing_class === '10:1') staffingKey = 'staff_ratio_10';

    let baseUnit = 0;
    let unitMatrix = unitVals.unit_matrices?.[capacityKey]?.[staffingKey];
    
    // Fallback if the JSON master is incomplete
    if (!unitMatrix) {
      unitMatrix = unitVals.unit_matrices?.['capacity_20_under']?.['staff_ratio_7_5'] || [];
    }

    for (const row of unitMatrix) {
      if ((row.min_score === null || totalScore >= row.min_score) && 
          (row.max_score === null || totalScore < row.max_score)) {
        baseUnit = row.unit;
        break;
      }
    }

    return {
      success: true,
      totalScore,
      details,
      baseUnit,
      alerts: {
        deficitWarning: details.production_activity < 0,
        managementWarning: details.management_improvement === -50
      }
    };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Simulation failed:", error);
    return { success: false, error: "シミュレーションに失敗しました。マスターデータを確認してください。" };
  }
}

export async function saveFacilityUnits(targetMonth: string, simulationResult: any, version: string) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role) return { success: false, error: '認証されていません' };
    if (role !== 'admin') return { success: false, error: '管理者権限が必要です' };

    const { totalScore, details, baseUnit } = simulationResult;
    
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO monthly_facility_units (
        target_month, revision_version, working_hours_score, production_activity_score,
        diversity_score, support_improvement_score, regional_cooperation_score,
        management_improvement_score, knowledge_skill_score, total_score, base_unit, updated_at
      ) VALUES (
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      ) ON CONFLICT(target_month) DO UPDATE SET
        revision_version = excluded.revision_version,
        working_hours_score = excluded.working_hours_score,
        production_activity_score = excluded.production_activity_score,
        diversity_score = excluded.diversity_score,
        support_improvement_score = excluded.support_improvement_score,
        regional_cooperation_score = excluded.regional_cooperation_score,
        management_improvement_score = excluded.management_improvement_score,
        knowledge_skill_score = excluded.knowledge_skill_score,
        total_score = excluded.total_score,
        base_unit = excluded.base_unit,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    `).run(
      targetMonth, version, details.working_hours, details.production_activity,
      details.diversity, details.support_improvement, details.regional_cooperation,
      details.management_improvement, details.knowledge_skill, totalScore, baseUnit
    );

    return { success: true };
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error(err);
    return { success: false, error: err.message };
  }
}

  remainingMonths: number;

    supportImprovementScore: number;
    regionalCooperationScore: number;
    managementImprovementScore: number;
    knowledgeSkillScore: number;
  };
  currentTotalScore: number;
  currentBaseUnit: number;
  capacityClass: string;
  staffingClass: string;
  nextRankInfo: {
    targetUnit: number;
    targetScore: number;
    scoreNeeded: number;
    adviceMessage: string;
  } | null;
  revenueImpact: {
    activeClientCount: number;
    monthlyOperatingDays: number;
    unitPrice: number;
    currentMonthlyRevenue: number;
    nextRankMonthlyRevenue: number;
    monthlyDifference: number;
    annualDifference: number;
  };
}

export async function getCurrentFiscalYearScoreProgress(): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  data?: FiscalYearScoreProgress;
  error?: string;
}> {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role) return { success: false, error: '認証されていません' };
    const today = new Date();
    const currentMonth = today.getMonth() + 1; // 1-12
    const currentYear = today.getFullYear();

    // 今年度の起算年は、4月以降なら今年、1～3月なら前年
    const currentFyStartYear = currentMonth >= 4 ? currentYear : currentYear - 1;
    const startMonthStr = `${currentFyStartYear}-04`;
    const currentMonthStr = `${today.getFullYear()}-${String(currentMonth).padStart(2, '0')}`;

    // 4月から当月までの月リストを作成
    const monthsList: { year: number; month: number; ym: string; label: string }[] = [];
    const elapsedMonthsCount = currentMonth >= 4 ? (currentMonth - 4 + 1) : (currentMonth + 9);

    for (let m = 0; m < elapsedMonthsCount; m++) {
      const targetYear = currentFyStartYear + (m < 9 ? 0 : 1);
      const targetMonth = (m + 3) % 12 + 1;
      const ym = `${targetYear}-${String(targetMonth).padStart(2, '0')}`;
      monthsList.push({
        year: targetYear,
        month: targetMonth,
        ym,
        label: `${targetMonth}月`
      });
    }

    const allClients = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM clients WHERE deleted_at IS NULL`).all() as any[];

    // 各月の労働時間と月末在籍者・延べ就労日数を計算
    const monthlyProgress: MonthlyHoursProgress[] = [];
    let cumulativeMinutes = 0;
    let cumulativeWorkDays = 0;
    let cumulativeSumEndOfMonthClients = 0;

    for (const mInfo of monthsList) {
      const startOfMonth = `${mInfo.ym}-01`;
      const endOfMonthObj = new Date(mInfo.year, mInfo.month, 0);
      const endOfMonth = `${endOfMonthObj.getFullYear()}-${String(endOfMonthObj.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(endOfMonthObj.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}`;
      const nextMonthStartDate = new Date(mInfo.year, mInfo.month, 1);
      const nextMonthStartStr = `${nextMonthStartDate.getFullYear()}-${String(nextMonthStartDate.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-01`;

      const attendances = db.prepare(`
        SELECT a.status, a.clock_in, a.clock_out, a.break_time_minutes, c.weekly_scheduled_hours, c.regular_holidays
        FROM attendance_records a
        JOIN clients c ON a.client_id = c.id
        WHERE a.record_date >= ? AND a.record_date < ?
          AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
      `).all(startOfMonth, nextMonthStartStr) as any[];

      let mMinutes = 0;
      let mWorkDays = 0;
      if (attendances) {
        for (const rec of attendances) {
          if (rec.status === 'pto') {
            let scheduledDays = 5;
            try {
              const holidays = rec.regular_holidays ? JSON.parse(rec.regular_holidays) : [];
              if (Array.isArray(holidays)) scheduledDays = Math.max(1, 7 - holidays.length);
            } catch {
              scheduledDays = 5;
            }
            const dailyHours = rec.weekly_scheduled_hours && rec.weekly_scheduled_hours > 0 
              ? (rec.weekly_scheduled_hours / scheduledDays) 
              : 4.0;
            mMinutes += Math.round(dailyHours * 60);
            mWorkDays++;
          } else if (rec.clock_in && rec.clock_out) {
            const [inH, inM] = rec.clock_in.split(':').map(Number);
            const [outH, outM] = rec.clock_out.split(':').map(Number);
            let outTotalM = outH * 60 + outM;
            const inTotalM = inH * 60 + inM;
            if (outTotalM < inTotalM) outTotalM += 24 * 60;
            const mins = outTotalM - inTotalM - (rec.break_time_minutes || 0);
            if (mins > 0) {
              mMinutes += mins;
              mWorkDays++;
            }
          }
        }
      }

      // 当月末時点での有効在籍者数（除外要件考慮）
      const activeClients = allClients.filter(c => {
        if (!c.service_start_date) return false;
        if (c.service_start_date > endOfMonth) return false;
        if (c.contract_end_date && c.contract_end_date < endOfMonth) return false;
        // 当月中開始・退所除外
        if (c.service_start_date >= startOfMonth && c.service_start_date <= endOfMonth) return false;
        if (c.contract_end_date && c.contract_end_date >= startOfMonth && c.contract_end_date <= endOfMonth) return false;
        return true;
      });

      const mActiveCount = activeClients.length;
      // 厚労省告示基準: 1日当たりの平均労働時間 = 総労働時間 ÷ 延べ就労日数
      const mAvgHours = mWorkDays > 0 ? (mMinutes / 60) / mWorkDays : 0;

      monthlyProgress.push({
        month: mInfo.ym,
        monthLabel: mInfo.label,
        totalMinutes: mMinutes,
        totalHours: Number((mMinutes / 60).toFixed(1)),
        activeClientCount: mActiveCount,
        averageHours: Number(mAvgHours.toFixed(1))
      });

      cumulativeMinutes += mMinutes;
      cumulativeWorkDays += mWorkDays;
      cumulativeSumEndOfMonthClients += mActiveCount;
    }

    const averageHoursToDate = cumulativeWorkDays > 0
      ? Number(((cumulativeMinutes / 60) / cumulativeWorkDays).toFixed(1))
      : 0;

    // ルールマスターの読み込み
    const rules = loadMasterData('2024', 'score_rules');
    const unitVals = loadMasterData('2024', 'unit_values');

    // 1. 労働時間スコア
    let workingHoursScore = 0;
    for (const rule of rules.categories.working_hours) {
      if ((rule.min === null || averageHoursToDate >= rule.min) && 
          (rule.max === null || averageHoursToDate < rule.max)) {
        workingHoursScore = rule.score;
        break;
      }
    }

    // 2. 生産活動収支
    const prodActivities = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM production_activities
      WHERE target_month >= ? AND target_month <= ?
    `).all(startMonthStr, currentMonthStr) as any[];

    let totalRevenue = 0;
    let totalExpenses = 0;
    let totalWages = 0;
    for (const pa of prodActivities) {
      totalRevenue += (pa.total_revenue || 0);
      totalExpenses += (pa.total_expenses || 0);
      totalWages += (pa.total_wages_paid || 0);
    }
    const netProfit = totalRevenue - totalExpenses;
    const wageCoverageDiff = netProfit - totalWages;

    let prodStatus = "profit_exceeds_wages";
    let prodScore = 60;
    let prodLabel = "収支が賃金総額を上回る（要件達成）";

    if (prodActivities.length > 0 && wageCoverageDiff < 0) {
      // 過去3年判定
      const pastEval = await evaluateProductionActivity(currentMonthStr);
      if (pastEval === 'deficit_3_years') {
        prodStatus = 'deficit_3_years';
        prodScore = -20;
        prodLabel = '3年以上連続で下回る';
      } else if (pastEval === 'deficit_2_years') {
        prodStatus = 'deficit_2_years';
        prodScore = -10;
        prodLabel = '2年連続で下回る';
      } else {
        prodStatus = 'deficit_1_year';
        prodScore = -5;
        prodLabel = '1年連続で下回る';
      }
    }

    // 3. その他評価項目（直近確定値またはデフォルト基準値）
    const latestFacilityUnit = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM monthly_facility_units
      ORDER BY target_month DESC
      LIMIT 1
    `).get() as any;

    const otherCategories = {
      diversityScore: latestFacilityUnit?.diversity_score ?? 10,
      supportImprovementScore: latestFacilityUnit?.support_improvement_score ?? 15,
      regionalCooperationScore: latestFacilityUnit?.regional_cooperation_score ?? 10,
      managementImprovementScore: latestFacilityUnit?.management_improvement_score ?? 0,
      knowledgeSkillScore: latestFacilityUnit?.knowledge_skill_score ?? 0
    };

    const currentTotalScore = workingHoursScore + prodScore +
      otherCategories.diversityScore +
      otherCategories.supportImprovementScore +
      otherCategories.regionalCooperationScore +
      otherCategories.managementImprovementScore +
      otherCategories.knowledgeSkillScore;

    // 4. 単位数の判定
    const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any || {};
    let capacityKey = 'capacity_20_under';
    if (facility.capacity_class === '21人以上40人以下') capacityKey = 'capacity_21_40';
    else if (facility.capacity_class === '41人以上60人以下') capacityKey = 'capacity_41_60';
    else if (facility.capacity_class === '61人以上80人以下') capacityKey = 'capacity_61_80';
    else if (facility.capacity_class === '81人以上') capacityKey = 'capacity_81_over';

    let staffingKey = 'staff_ratio_7_5';
    if (facility.staffing_class === '10:1') staffingKey = 'staff_ratio_10';

    let unitMatrix = unitVals.unit_matrices?.[capacityKey]?.[staffingKey] || 
                     unitVals.unit_matrices?.['capacity_20_under']?.['staff_ratio_7_5'] || [];

    let currentBaseUnit = unitMatrix[unitMatrix.length - 1]?.unit ?? 325;
    let currentMatrixIndex = -1;

    for (let i = 0; i < unitMatrix.length; i++) {
      const row = unitMatrix[i];
      if ((row.min_score === null || currentTotalScore >= row.min_score) && 
          (row.max_score === null || currentTotalScore < row.max_score)) {
        currentBaseUnit = row.unit;
        currentMatrixIndex = i;
        break;
      }
    }

    // 5. 上位ランク情報の算出
    let nextRankInfo = null;
    if (currentMatrixIndex > 0) {
      const higherRow = unitMatrix[currentMatrixIndex - 1];
      const targetScore = higherRow.min_score || 0;
      const scoreNeeded = targetScore - currentTotalScore;

      // 労働時間であと何時間伸ばせば届くか
      let adviceMessage = `あと ${scoreNeeded} 点で上位報酬区分（${higherRow.unit}単位/日）へランクアップします。`;
      if (scoreNeeded <= 10) {
        adviceMessage += " 多様な働き方（資格取得支援やテレワーク対応）の追加認定や、平均労働時間のわずかな延長（10〜15分程度）で達成可能です。";
      } else if (scoreNeeded <= 25) {
        adviceMessage += " 平均労働時間を1段階引き上げる（例: 5時間台→6時間台）ことで一気に達成できます。";
      } else {
        adviceMessage += " 生産活動収支の黒字化（+60点）および平均労働時間の延伸を組み合わせることで大幅な増収が見込めます。";
      }

      nextRankInfo = {
        targetUnit: higherRow.unit,
        targetScore,
        scoreNeeded,
        adviceMessage
      };
    }

    // 6. 経営インパクト試算
    // 在籍利用者数（または定員20名想定）
    const activeClientCount = Math.max(1, allClients.filter(c => !c.contract_end_date || c.contract_end_date >= currentMonthStr).length);
    const monthlyOperatingDays = 22; // 標準稼働日数
    const unitPrice = getAreaUnitCost(facility?.area_cost_grade || 'other'); // 事業所の地域区分単価（動的取得）

    const currentMonthlyRevenue = Math.round(currentBaseUnit * unitPrice * activeClientCount * monthlyOperatingDays);
    const nextRankUnit = nextRankInfo?.targetUnit || currentBaseUnit;
    const nextRankMonthlyRevenue = Math.round(nextRankUnit * unitPrice * activeClientCount * monthlyOperatingDays);
    const monthlyDifference = nextRankMonthlyRevenue - currentMonthlyRevenue;
    const annualDifference = monthlyDifference * 12;

    return {
      success: true,
      data: {
        fiscalYear: currentFyStartYear,
        startMonth: startMonthStr,
        currentMonth: currentMonthStr,
        elapsedMonths: elapsedMonthsCount,
        remainingMonths: 12 - elapsedMonthsCount,
        averageHoursToDate,
        workingHoursScore,
        monthlyProgress,
        productionSummary: {
          totalRevenue,
          totalExpenses,
          totalWages,
          netProfit,
          wageCoverageDiff,
          status: prodStatus,
          score: prodScore,
          label: prodLabel
        },
        otherCategories,
        currentTotalScore,
        currentBaseUnit,
        capacityClass: facility.capacity_class || '20人以下',
        staffingClass: facility.staffing_class || '7.5:1',
        nextRankInfo,
        revenueImpact: {
          activeClientCount,
          monthlyOperatingDays,
          unitPrice,
          currentMonthlyRevenue,
          nextRankMonthlyRevenue,
          monthlyDifference,
          annualDifference
        }
      }
    };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('Failed to get current fiscal year score progress:', error);
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
}

export async function getTypeBWageSimulationData() {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role) throw new Error('認証されていません');

    const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any || {};
    const unitPrice = getAreaUnitCost(facility.region_class || '2級地');

    // 前年度の期間算出（4月〜翌3月）
    const today = new Date();
    const curYear = today.getFullYear();
    const curMonth = today.getMonth() + 1;
    const startYear = curMonth >= 4 ? curYear - 1 : curYear - 2;
    const startMonthStr = `${startYear}-04`;
    const endMonthStr = `${startYear + 1}-03`;

    // 1. payslips / monthly_payslips から前年度の工賃支払総額を集計（厚労省指定基準: 実費弁償の通勤手当等を除外した純工賃を集計）
    let wageStats = db.prepare(`
      SELECT 
        COALESCE(SUM(mp.base_salary + COALESCE(mp.ability_allowance, 0)), 0) as total_wage,
        COUNT(DISTINCT p.client_id) as unique_clients
      FROM payslips p
      JOIN monthly_payslips mp ON p.client_id = mp.client_id AND p.target_month = mp.target_month
      WHERE p.target_month >= ? AND p.target_month <= ?
    `).get(startMonthStr, endMonthStr) as any;

    let totalWagePaid = wageStats?.total_wage || 0;
    if (totalWagePaid === 0) {
      // 直近登録された全月データからフォールバック集計
      const fallbackStats = db.prepare(`
        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mp.base_salary + COALESCE(mp.ability_allowance, 0)), 0) as total_wage 
        FROM payslips p
        JOIN monthly_payslips mp ON p.client_id = mp.client_id AND p.target_month = mp.target_month
      `).get() as any;
      totalWagePaid = fallbackStats?.total_wage || 0;
    }

    // 2. 開所日数と延べ利用人数を集計
    let attendanceStats = db.prepare(`
      SELECT 
        COUNT(DISTINCT record_date) as facility_open_days,
        COUNT(*) as total_client_attendances
      FROM attendance_records
      WHERE record_date >= ? AND record_date < ?
        AND status = 'present' AND deleted_at IS NULL
    `).get(`${startYear}-04-01`, `${startYear + 1}-04-01`) as any;

    let facilityOpenDays = attendanceStats?.facility_open_days || 0;
    let totalClientAttendances = attendanceStats?.total_client_attendances || 0;

    if (facilityOpenDays === 0) {
      const allAttendance = db.prepare(`
        SELECT 
          COUNT(DISTINCT record_date) as open_days,
          COUNT(*) as attendances
        FROM attendance_records
        WHERE status = 'present' AND deleted_at IS NULL
      `).get() as any;
      facilityOpenDays = allAttendance?.open_days || 240;
      totalClientAttendances = allAttendance?.attendances || 3600;
    }

    // 利用者数
    const activeClientsCount = (db.prepare(`SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM clients WHERE deleted_at IS NULL`).get() as any)?.count || 15;

    // 厚労省最新算定式による平均工賃月額算出
    const avgWageResult = calculateTypeBAverageWage({
      totalWagePaid,
      totalClientAttendances,
      facilityOpenDays: Math.max(1, facilityOpenDays),
      operatingMonths: 12
    });

    const staffRatio = (facility.staff_ratio || '6:1') as '6:1' | '7.5:1' | '10:1';
    const currentServiceFee = determineTypeBServiceFee({
      averageMonthlyWage: avgWageResult.averageMonthlyWage,
      staffRatio,
      capacity: 20
    });

    return {
      success: true,
      data: {
        fiscalYearPeriod: `${startYear}年度 (${startMonthStr}〜${endMonthStr})`,
        totalWagePaid,
        facilityOpenDays,
        totalClientAttendances,
        averageUsersPerDay: avgWageResult.averageUsersPerDay,
        averageMonthlyWage: avgWageResult.averageMonthlyWage,
        isBelowMinimum3000: avgWageResult.isBelowMinimum3000,
        staffRatio,
        currentServiceFee,
        unitPrice,
        activeClientsCount,
        brackets: TYPE_B_WAGE_BRACKETS,
        additions: TYPE_B_ADDITIONS,
        fixedFees: TYPE_B_FIXED_FEES
      }
    };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('Failed to get type B wage simulation data:', error);
    return { success: false, error: error.message };
  }
}

import { Header } from "@/components/Header";

  calculatePreviousYearAverageHours, 
  evaluateProductionActivity, 
  getCurrentFiscalYearScoreProgress,
  getTypeBWageSimulationData
} from "./actions";
import { toLocalISODate } from "@/lib/utils";
import { getServiceMode } from "@/lib/serviceModeServer";

export default async function SimulationPage() {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) redirect("/login");

  const serviceMode = await getServiceMode();
  const isTypeB = serviceMode === 'type_b';

  if (isTypeB) {
    const typeBDataResult = await getTypeBWageSimulationData();
    const typeBData = typeBDataResult.success && typeBDataResult.data ? typeBDataResult.data : {
      fiscalYearPeriod: '前年度',
      totalWagePaid: 0,
      facilityOpenDays: 240,
      totalClientAttendances: 3600,
      averageUsersPerDay: 15,
      averageMonthlyWage: 18500,
      isBelowMinimum3000: false,
      staffRatio: '6:1' as const,
      currentServiceFee: { units: 534, serviceCode: '1116', serviceName: 'サービス費Ⅰ(6:1)', bracketLabel: '1.5万円以上 2.0万円未満' },
      unitPrice: 10.36,
      activeClientsCount: 15,
      brackets: [],
      additions: [],
      fixedFees: {}
    };

    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background/50">
        <Header activePage="billing" />
        <BillingSubNav />
        <main className="flex-1 p-3.5 sm:p-6 md:p-12">
          <TypeBSimulationClient 
            initialData={typeBData}
            isAdmin={role === 'admin'}
          />
        </main>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const averageHours = await calculatePreviousYearAverageHours();
  const todayStr = toLocalISODate(new Date()).slice(0, 7); // YYYY-MM
  const autoProdActivity = await evaluateProductionActivity(todayStr);
  const currentProgressResult = await getCurrentFiscalYearScoreProgress();

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background/50">
      <Header activePage="billing" />
      <BillingSubNav />

        <SimulationClient 
          initialAverageHours={averageHours} 
          initialProdActivity={autoProdActivity}
          initialProgress={currentProgressResult.data || null}
          isAdmin={role === 'admin'} 
        />
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

export interface TransRecordItem {
  id: string;
  client_id: string;
  client_name: string;
  recipient_number?: string;
  record_date: string;
  clock_in?: string;
  clock_out?: string;
  pickup_used: number;
  dropoff_used: number;
  pickup_driver?: string;
  dropoff_driver?: string;
  route_pickup?: string;
  route_dropoff?: string;
}

export interface TransportationRecordReportProps {
  facility: {
    facility_name: string;
    facility_number?: string;
    address?: string;
    tel?: string;
    manager_name?: string;
  };
  targetYearMonth: string; // "YYYY-MM"
  records: TransRecordItem[];
}

export function TransportationRecordReport({
  facility,
  targetYearMonth,
  records,
}: TransportationRecordReportProps) {
  const [yearStr, monthStr] = targetYearMonth.split('-');
  const year = parseInt(yearStr, 10);
  const month = parseInt(monthStr, 10);
  const eraMonthStr = `令和${year >= 2019 ? year - 2018 : year}年 ${month}月分`;

  // 合計算定回数と単位数
  let totalPickupTrips = 0;
  let totalDropoffTrips = 0;
  records.forEach(r => {
    if (r.pickup_used === 1) totalPickupTrips++;
    if (r.dropoff_used === 1) totalDropoffTrips++;
  });
  const totalTrips = totalPickupTrips + totalDropoffTrips;
  const totalUnits = totalTrips * 21; // 送迎加算: 片道21単位

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 max-w-[297mm] mx-auto p-4 sm:p-6 print:p-0 print:max-w-none bg-background text-foreground">
      {/* 画面ツールバー */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-between items-center gap-2 bg-muted/40 p-3 rounded-lg border print:hidden">
        <Link href="/billing">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="text-xs gap-1 font-bold">
            <ArrowLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>請求管理に戻る</span>
          </Button>
        </Link>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-semibold hidden md:inline">
            厚生労働省告示・神戸市実地指導必携帳票（片道21単位算定根拠原本）
          </span>
          <Button size="sm" onClick={() => window.print()} className="text-xs gap-1 font-bold bg-primary text-primary-foreground">
            <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>A4横印刷 / PDF保存</span>
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 印刷CSS（A4横向き） */}
      <style jsx global>{`
        @media print {
          @page {
            size: A4 landscape;
            margin: 8mm 8mm 8mm 8mm;
          }
          body {
            background: white !important;
            color: black !important;
            -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
            print-color-adjust: exact;
          }
          .trans-report-print {
            border: none !important;
            box-shadow: none !important;
            padding: 0 !important;
          }
        }
      `}</style>

      {/* 帳票本体 */}
      <div className="trans-report-print bg-white text-black font-sans text-xs leading-normal border border-black p-6 space-y-3 shadow-sm print:shadow-none min-h-[195mm]">
        {/* 表題部 */}
        <div className="flex justify-between items-start border-b-2 border-black pb-2">
          <div>
            <div className="inline-block border border-black px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold">
              指定就労継続支援A型 送迎加算（Ⅰ・Ⅱ） 算定根拠原本帳票
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-wider mt-1">
              【送 迎 運 行 管 理 簿】
            </h1>
            <p className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-gray-800 mt-0.5">
              対象年月： <span className="font-bold underline text-sm">{eraMonthStr}</span>
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="text-right text-[10.5px] space-y-0.5">
            <div className="font-bold">{facility.facility_name}</div>
            <div>事業所番号: <span className="font-mono font-bold">{facility.facility_number || '0000000000'}</span></div>
            <div>所在地: {facility.address || '未設定'}</div>
            <div>管理者確認印: ［　　　　　　］印</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 算定サマリー */}
        <div className="flex gap-6 p-2 bg-gray-50 border border-black text-[11px]">
          <div>総対象日数・回数: <span className="font-bold font-mono text-sm">{records.length}</span> 日</div>
          <div>迎え（往路）: <span className="font-bold font-mono">{totalPickupTrips}</span> 回</div>
          <div>送り（復路）: <span className="font-bold font-mono">{totalDropoffTrips}</span> 回</div>
          <div>合計送迎回数: <span className="font-bold font-mono text-sm">{totalTrips}</span> 回</div>
          <div>算定加算単位数（片道21単位）: <span className="font-bold font-mono text-sm text-blue-900">{totalUnits.toLocaleString()}</span> 単位</div>
        </div>

        {/* 運行詳細テーブル */}
        <div className="border border-black overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-[10px] border-collapse min-w-[700px]">
            <thead>
              <tr className="bg-gray-100 text-center font-bold border-b border-black">
                <th className="border-r border-black p-1 w-16">日付</th>
                <th className="border-r border-black p-1 w-28">利用者氏名</th>
                <th className="border-r border-black p-1 w-20">受給者番号</th>
                <th className="border-r border-black p-1 w-28">迎え（往路）</th>
                <th className="border-r border-black p-1 w-24">迎え運転者</th>
                <th className="border-r border-black p-1 w-28">送り（復路）</th>
                <th className="border-r border-black p-1 w-24">送り運転者</th>
                <th className="border-r border-black p-1 w-16">算定回数</th>
                <th className="p-1">備考・特記事項</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {records.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={9} className="p-4 text-center text-gray-500">
                    当月の送迎実績（送迎加算対象）はありません。
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                records.map((r, idx) => {
                  const trips = (r.pickup_used ? 1 : 0) + (r.dropoff_used ? 1 : 0);
                  const dEra = toJapaneseEra(r.record_date);

                  return (
                    <tr key={idx} className="border-b border-black hover:bg-gray-50/50">
                      <td className="border-r border-black p-1 text-center font-mono">
                        {r.record_date.slice(5)}
                      </td>
                      <td className="border-r border-black p-1 font-bold">
                        {r.client_name}
                      </td>
                      <td className="border-r border-black p-1 text-center font-mono text-[9px]">
                        {r.recipient_number || '-'}
                      </td>
                      <td className="border-r border-black p-1 text-center">
                        {r.pickup_used === 1 ? (
                          <span className="font-bold text-blue-700">利用（{r.clock_in || '着'}）</span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-gray-400">なし</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="border-r border-black p-1 text-center font-medium">
                        {r.pickup_used === 1 ? (r.pickup_driver || '事業所送迎員') : '-'}
                      </td>
                      <td className="border-r border-black p-1 text-center">
                        {r.dropoff_used === 1 ? (
                          <span className="font-bold text-emerald-700">利用（{r.clock_out || '発'}）</span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-gray-400">なし</span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="border-r border-black p-1 text-center font-medium">
                        {r.dropoff_used === 1 ? (r.dropoff_driver || '事業所送迎員') : '-'}
                      </td>
                      <td className="border-r border-black p-1 text-center font-bold font-mono">
                        {trips}回（{trips * 21}単位）
                      </td>
                      <td className="p-1 text-[9px] text-gray-600">
                        安全運転実施・乗車前点呼済
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </div>

        {/* 補足注記 */}
        <div className="text-[9px] text-gray-600 pt-1">
          ※本運行管理簿は厚生労働省告示および自治体（神戸市等）の指定基準に基づき、送迎加算の算定根拠として5年間の原本保存が義務付けられています。
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

File: src/app/billing/transportation-records/page.tsx

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { TransportationRecordReport, TransRecordItem } from "./TransportationRecordReport";

export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic';

export default async function TransportationRecordsPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ month?: string }>;
}) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) {
    redirect("/login");
  }

  const resolvedParams = await searchParams;
  const today = new Date();
  const defaultMonth = `${today.getFullYear()}-${String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  const targetMonth = resolvedParams.month || defaultMonth;

  const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any || {
    facility_name: '就労継続支援A型事業所',
    manager_name: '管理者',
  };

  // 送迎利用実績を取得 (transportation_used = 1 または pickup/dropoff 使用)
  const rows = db.prepare(`
    SELECT 
      ar.id,
      ar.client_id,
      c.full_name as client_name,
      c.recipient_number,
      ar.record_date,
      ar.clock_in,
      ar.clock_out,
      ar.transportation_used,
      ar.pickup_used,
      ar.dropoff_used,
      ar.transportation_service_used,
      ar.pickup_service,
      ar.dropoff_service,
      ar.pickup_driver,
      ar.dropoff_driver
    FROM attendance_records ar
    JOIN clients c ON ar.client_id = c.id
    WHERE ar.record_date LIKE ? 
      AND ar.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND (ar.transportation_used = 1 OR ar.pickup_used = 1 OR ar.dropoff_used = 1 OR ar.pickup_service = 1 OR ar.dropoff_service = 1 OR ar.transportation_service_used = 1)
    ORDER BY ar.record_date ASC, c.full_name ASC
  `).all(`${targetMonth}-%`) as any[];

  const records: TransRecordItem[] = rows.map(r => ({
    id: r.id,
    client_id: r.client_id,
    client_name: r.client_name,
    recipient_number: r.recipient_number,
    record_date: r.record_date,
    clock_in: r.clock_in,
    clock_out: r.clock_out,
    pickup_used: (r.pickup_used === 1 || r.pickup_service === 1) ? 1 : ((r.transportation_used === 1 || r.transportation_service_used === 1) ? 1 : 0),
    dropoff_used: (r.dropoff_used === 1 || r.dropoff_service === 1) ? 1 : ((r.transportation_used === 1 || r.transportation_service_used === 1) ? 1 : 0),
    pickup_driver: r.pickup_driver,
    dropoff_driver: r.dropoff_driver,
  }));

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-slate-50 py-6 print:py-0 print:bg-white">
      <TransportationRecordReport
        facility={facility}
        targetYearMonth={targetMonth}
        records={records}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from '@/components/ui/table';
import { Badge } from '@/components/ui/badge';
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input';
import { Button, buttonVariants } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Search, AlertCircle, CheckCircle2, Edit, FileText, UserCheck, Clock, ArrowUpDown, Calendar } from 'lucide-react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { cn, parseDisabilityTypes } from '@/lib/utils';
import { DeleteClientButton } from './DeleteClientButton';

export function ClientListTable({ 
  initialClients, 
  departments = [],
  todayStr,
  initialFilter = 'active',
  alertDaysCertificate = 60
}: { 
  initialClients: any[], 
  departments?: any[],
  todayStr: string,
  initialFilter?: 'all' | 'active' | 'terminated' | 'transitioned' | 'suspended' | 'expired',
  alertDaysCertificate?: number
}) {
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [filterType, setFilterType] = useState<'all' | 'active' | 'terminated' | 'transitioned' | 'suspended' | 'expired'>(initialFilter);
  const [selectedDepartment, setSelectedDepartment] = useState<string>('all');
  const [sortOrder, setSortOrder] = useState<'hire_asc' | 'hire_desc' | 'name_asc' | 'created_desc'>('hire_asc');
  const todayDate = useMemo(() => new Date(todayStr), [todayStr]);

  const filteredClients = useMemo(() => {
    return initialClients.filter(client => {
      const nameMatch = client.full_name?.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
      const numberMatch = client.recipient_number?.toLowerCase().includes(searchQuery.toLowerCase());
      const matchesSearch = !searchQuery || nameMatch || numberMatch;

      if (!matchesSearch) return false;

      // 部署フィルター
      if (selectedDepartment !== 'all') {
        if (selectedDepartment === 'unassigned') {
          if (client.department_id) return false;
        } else {
          if (client.department_id !== selectedDepartment) return false;
        }
      }

      const validToDate = client.valid_to ? new Date(client.valid_to) : null;
      const isExpired = validToDate ? validToDate < todayDate : false;
      const daysUntilExpiry = validToDate ? Math.ceil((validToDate.getTime() - todayDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) : null;
      const isExpiringSoon = !isExpired && daysUntilExpiry !== null && daysUntilExpiry <= alertDaysCertificate;
      const status = client.status || (client.transition_date ? 'transitioned' : (client.contract_end_date && new Date(client.contract_end_date) <= todayDate ? 'terminated' : 'active'));

      if (filterType === 'expired') return isExpired || isExpiringSoon;
      if (filterType === 'active') return status === 'active';
      if (filterType === 'terminated') return status === 'terminated';
      if (filterType === 'transitioned') return status === 'transitioned';
      if (filterType === 'suspended') return status === 'suspended';

      return true;
    });
  }, [initialClients, searchQuery, filterType, selectedDepartment, todayStr, alertDaysCertificate]);

  const displayedClients = useMemo(() => {
    return [...filteredClients].sort((a, b) => {
      if (sortOrder === 'hire_asc' || sortOrder === 'hire_desc') {
        const dateA = a.contract_date || a.service_start_date || '';
        const dateB = b.contract_date || b.service_start_date || '';
        if (!dateA && !dateB) return (a.full_name || '').localeCompare(b.full_name || '', 'ja');
        if (!dateA) return 1;
        if (!dateB) return -1;
        const cmp = dateA.localeCompare(dateB);
        return sortOrder === 'hire_asc' ? cmp : -cmp;
      }
      if (sortOrder === 'name_asc') {
        return (a.full_name || '').localeCompare(b.full_name || '', 'ja');
      }
      return (b.created_at || '').localeCompare(a.created_at || '');
    });
  }, [filteredClients, sortOrder]);

  const activeCount = initialClients.filter(c => (c.status === 'active' || (!c.status && !c.termination_date && !c.transition_date))).length;
  const terminatedCount = initialClients.filter(c => c.status === 'terminated' || (!c.status && c.contract_end_date && new Date(c.contract_end_date) <= new Date(todayStr))).length;
  const transitionedCount = initialClients.filter(c => c.status === 'transitioned' || !!c.transition_date).length;
  const expiredOrSoonCount = initialClients.filter(c => {
    const isInactive = c.status === 'terminated' || c.status === 'transitioned' || (c.contract_end_date && new Date(c.contract_end_date) <= new Date(todayStr));
    if (isInactive) return false;
    if (!c.valid_to) return false;
    const vDate = new Date(c.valid_to);
    const tDate = new Date(todayStr);
    const days = Math.ceil((vDate.getTime() - tDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
    return days <= alertDaysCertificate;
  }).length;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="p-4 bg-muted/20 border-b flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-3 items-stretch md:items-center justify-between">
        <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center gap-2.5 flex-1">
          <div className="relative w-full sm:w-72">
            <Search className="absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
            <Input
              placeholder="氏名・受給者証番号で検索..."
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={e => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              className="pl-9 bg-background"
            />
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0 bg-background border rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 shadow-2xs">
            <ArrowUpDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground whitespace-nowrap">並び順:</span>
            <select
              value={sortOrder}
              onChange={e => setSortOrder(e.target.value as any)}
              className="bg-transparent text-xs font-semibold focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
            >
              <option value="hire_asc">入社日・利用開始日順 (古い順)</option>
              <option value="hire_desc">入社日・利用開始日順 (新しい順)</option>
              <option value="name_asc">五十音順 (氏名)</option>
              <option value="created_desc">システム登録順 (新しい順)</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 w-full md:w-auto overflow-x-auto pb-1.5 md:pb-0">
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant={filterType === 'active' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            onClick={() => setFilterType('active')}
            className="h-9 px-3 text-xs gap-1"
          >
            <UserCheck className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            利用中 ({activeCount})
          </Button>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant={filterType === 'terminated' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            onClick={() => setFilterType('terminated')}
            className="h-9 px-3 text-xs gap-1 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
          >
            退職・契約終了 ({terminatedCount})
          </Button>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant={filterType === 'transitioned' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            onClick={() => setFilterType('transitioned')}
            className="h-9 px-3 text-xs gap-1 text-blue-700 hover:text-blue-800"
          >
            就職移行 ({transitionedCount})
          </Button>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant={filterType === 'expired' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            onClick={() => setFilterType('expired')}
            className={`h-9 px-3 text-xs gap-1 ${expiredOrSoonCount > 0 ? 'text-destructive font-bold hover:text-destructive' : 'text-muted-foreground'}`}
          >
            <AlertCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            受給者証期限切れ・切迫 ({expiredOrSoonCount})
          </Button>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant={filterType === 'all' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            onClick={() => setFilterType('all')}
            className="h-9 px-3 text-xs"
          >
            全員 ({initialClients.length})
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {departments.length > 0 && (
        <div className="px-4 py-2.5 bg-muted/10 border-b flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto text-xs">
          <span className="font-bold text-muted-foreground shrink-0 mr-1">拠点・部署別:</span>
          <Button
            size="sm"
            variant={selectedDepartment === 'all' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            onClick={() => setSelectedDepartment('all')}
            className="h-7 px-2.5 text-xs font-semibold"
          >
            全拠点 ({initialClients.length})
          </Button>
          {departments.map((dep: any) => {
            const count = initialClients.filter(c => c.department_id === dep.id).length;
            return (
              <Button
                key={dep.id}
                size="sm"
                variant={selectedDepartment === dep.id ? 'default' : 'outline'}
                onClick={() => setSelectedDepartment(dep.id)}
                className="h-7 px-2.5 text-xs font-semibold"
              >
                {dep.name} ({count})
              </Button>
            );
          })}
          {initialClients.some(c => !c.department_id) && (
            <Button
              size="sm"
              variant={selectedDepartment === 'unassigned' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
              onClick={() => setSelectedDepartment('unassigned')}
              className={`h-7 px-2.5 text-xs font-semibold ${selectedDepartment === 'unassigned' ? 'bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white' : 'text-amber-700 border-amber-300 hover:bg-amber-50'}`}
            >
              未所属 ({initialClients.filter(c => !c.department_id).length})
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {displayedClients.length > 0 ? (
        <div className="overflow-x-auto">
          <Table className="min-w-[800px]">
          <TableHeader className="bg-muted/50">
            <TableRow>
              <TableHead className="py-4 text-base">氏名</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="py-4 text-base">在籍状況</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="py-4 text-base">所定勤務 / 休憩</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="py-4 text-base">受給者証番号</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="py-4 text-base">受給者証有効期限</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="py-4 text-base">上限額</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="py-4 text-base">支給量</TableHead>
              <TableHead className="py-4 text-base w-[160px] text-right">操作</TableHead>
            </TableRow>
          </TableHeader>
          <TableBody>
            {displayedClients.map((client) => {
              const validToDate = client.valid_to ? new Date(client.valid_to) : null;
              const status = client.status || (client.transition_date ? 'transitioned' : (client.contract_end_date && new Date(client.contract_end_date) <= todayDate ? 'terminated' : 'active'));
              const isInactive = status === 'terminated' || status === 'transitioned';
              const isExpired = !isInactive && validToDate ? validToDate < todayDate : false;
              const daysUntilExpiry = validToDate ? Math.ceil((validToDate.getTime() - todayDate.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24)) : null;
              const isExpiringSoon = !isInactive && !isExpired && daysUntilExpiry !== null && daysUntilExpiry <= alertDaysCertificate;

              let statusBadge;
              if (status === 'terminated') {
                statusBadge = (
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-gray-100 text-gray-800 border-gray-400 font-bold px-2.5 py-1 text-xs">
                    退職済 ({client.termination_date || client.contract_end_date || '契約終了'})
                  </Badge>
                );
              } else if (status === 'transitioned') {
                statusBadge = (
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-blue-100 text-blue-900 border-blue-300 font-bold px-2.5 py-1 text-xs">
                    就職移行 ({client.transition_company || client.transition_date})
                  </Badge>
                );
              } else if (status === 'suspended') {
                statusBadge = (
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 border-amber-300 font-bold px-2.5 py-1 text-xs">
                    休職中
                  </Badge>
                );
              } else {

                  <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-900 border-emerald-300 font-bold px-2.5 py-1 text-xs">
                    <CheckCircle2 className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5 text-emerald-600 inline" /> 利用中
                  </Badge>
                );
              }

              return (
                <TableRow key={client.id} className={cn("hover:bg-muted/30", status === 'terminated' && "opacity-75 bg-muted/10")}>

                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">

                        {client.department_name ? (
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-sky-50 text-sky-800 border-sky-200 text-[11px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0">
                            {client.department_name}
                          </Badge>
                        ) : (
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-muted text-muted-foreground border-muted-foreground/30 text-[11px] font-bold px-1.5 py-0">
                            未所属
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                        {client.client_type === 'trial' && (
                          <Badge variant="secondary" className="bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border-amber-300 font-semibold text-xs">
                            体験利用
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                        {(client.contract_date || client.service_start_date) && (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded border border-emerald-200" title="雇用契約日 / 利用開始日">
                            <Calendar className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-600" />
                            入社: {client.contract_date || client.service_start_date}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                      {/* 障害種別・区分バッジ */}
                      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1">
                        {client.disability_class && (

                            区分{client.disability_class}
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {parseDisabilityTypes(client.disability_type).map((dt: string) => (
                          <span 
                            key={dt}
                            className="text-[11px] font-medium bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-700 dark:bg-indigo-950/60 dark:text-indigo-300 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded border border-indigo-200/60"
                          >
                            {dt}
                          </span>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="py-4">
                    {statusBadge}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="py-3 text-sm">
                    <span className="font-mono bg-blue-50 text-blue-800 dark:bg-blue-950/60 dark:text-blue-300 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-blue-200/60 font-semibold inline-block">
                      {client.work_start_time || '09:00'}〜{client.work_end_time || '16:00'}
                    </span>
                    <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground ml-1.5 inline-block">
                      (休{client.break_time_minutes ?? 60}分)
                    </span>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="py-4 text-base font-mono text-muted-foreground">
                    {client.recipient_number || <span className="italic text-muted-foreground/70">未登録</span>}
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="py-4 text-base">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      {isExpired ? (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center text-destructive font-bold bg-destructive/10 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-destructive/30 text-xs sm:text-sm">
                          <AlertCircle className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0" />
                          {client.valid_to} (期限切れ)
                        </span>
                      ) : isExpiringSoon ? (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center text-amber-800 dark:text-amber-300 font-bold bg-amber-100/80 dark:bg-amber-950/60 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-amber-300 text-xs sm:text-sm">
                          <AlertCircle className="mr-1 h-3.5 w-3.5 shrink-0 text-amber-600" />
                          {client.valid_to} (残{daysUntilExpiry}日)
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span>{client.valid_to}</span>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  </TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="py-4 text-base">¥{client.payment_limit?.toLocaleString()}</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="py-4 text-base">{client.allowance_days}日 / 月</TableCell>
                  <TableCell className="py-4 text-right">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-2">
                      <Link 
                        href={`/clients/${client.id}/documents`} 
                        className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "default", size: "sm" }), "h-9 px-3 gap-1 bg-primary text-white hover:bg-primary/90")}
                      >
                        <FileText className="h-4 w-4" />
                        <span>書類カルテ</span>
                      </Link>
                      <Link 
                        href={`/clients/${client.id}/edit`} 
                        className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm" }), "h-9 px-3 gap-1")}
                      >
                        <Edit className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                        <span>編集</span>
                      </Link>
                      <DeleteClientButton id={client.id} name={client.full_name} />
                    </div>
                  </TableCell>
                </TableRow>
              );
            })}
          </TableBody>
        </Table>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="p-12 text-center text-muted-foreground">
          {searchQuery || filterType !== 'all' ? '該当する利用者が条件に見つかりませんでした。' : '利用者が登録されていません。'}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
