'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { 
  Dialog, 
  DialogContent, 
  DialogHeader, 
  DialogTitle, 
  DialogTrigger,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { Upload, Download, FileSpreadsheet, AlertCircle, CheckCircle2, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import { importClientsFromCsv, CsvClientImportItem } from "./actions";
import { toast } from "sonner";

export function CsvImportModal() {
  const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [parsedData, setParsedData] = useState<CsvClientImportItem[]>([]);
  const [fileName, setFileName] = useState<string>('');
  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);
  const [parseErrors, setParseErrors] = useState<string[]>([]);

  // 雛形CSVのダウンロード（Excelで文字化けしないようBOM付与）
  const handleDownloadTemplate = () => {
    const headers = [
      "氏名", "フリガナ", "受給者証番号(10桁)", "負担上限月額", "有効期限開始(YYYY-MM-DD)", "有効期限終了(YYYY-MM-DD)",
      "支給量日数", "障害区分", "障害種別", "時給", "週所定労働時間",
      "所定始業(HH:MM)", "所定終業(HH:MM)", "休憩分", "生年月日(YYYY-MM-DD)", "性別",
      "電話番号", "住所", "サービス開始日(YYYY-MM-DD)"
    ];
    
    const sampleRows = [
      [
        "神戸 太郎", "コウベ タロウ", "1234567890", "0", "2026-04-01", "2027-03-31",
        "23", "区分3", "精神障害", "1052", "20",
        "09:00", "16:00", "60", "1995-05-15", "男性",
        "090-1234-5678", "兵庫県神戸市中央区...", "2026-04-01"
      ],
      [
        "三宮 花子", "サンノミヤ ハナコ", "2345678901", "9300", "2026-04-01", "2027-03-31",
        "22", "区分2", "知的障害", "1052", "20",
        "09:30", "15:30", "60", "2000-11-20", "女性",
        "080-9876-5432", "兵庫県神戸市灘区...", "2026-04-01"
      ]
    ];

    const csvContent = "\uFEFF" + [
      headers.join(","),
      ...sampleRows.map(r => r.map(c => `"${c}"`).join(","))
    ].join("\r\n");

    const blob = new Blob([csvContent], { type: "text/csv;charset=utf-8;" });
    const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = url;
    link.setAttribute("download", "利用者一括登録テンプレート.csv");
    document.body.appendChild(link);
    link.click();
    document.body.removeChild(link);
  };

  // CSVファイルの読み込みと簡易パース
  const handleFileChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    setFileName(file.name);
    const reader = new FileReader();

    reader.onload = (event) => {
      const text = event.target?.result as string;
      if (!text) return;

      const lines = text.split(/\r?\n/).map(l => l.trim()).filter(Boolean);
      if (lines.length < 2) {
        setParseErrors(["有効なデータ行がありません（ヘッダー行＋1件以上のデータが必要です）"]);
        setParsedData([]);
        return;
      }

      // 堅牢なCSV行パーサー（空フィールド対応・ダブルクォートエスケープ対応）
      const parseCsvLine = (line: string): string[] => {
        const result: string[] = [];
        let current = '';
        let inQuotes = false;
        for (let j = 0; j < line.length; j++) {
          const char = line[j];
          if (char === '"') {
            if (inQuotes && line[j + 1] === '"') {
              current += '"';
              j++;
            } else {
              inQuotes = !inQuotes;
            }
          } else if (char === ',' && !inQuotes) {
            result.push(current.trim());
            current = '';
          } else {
            current += char;
          }
        }
        result.push(current.trim());
        return result;
      };

      const headerRow = parseCsvLine(lines[0]);
      const hasFuriganaHeader = headerRow.some(h => h.includes('フリガナ') || h.includes('ふりがな'));

      // ヘッダー行を無視してパース
      const items: CsvClientImportItem[] = [];
      const errors: string[] = [];

      for (let i = 1; i < lines.length; i++) {
        const cleaned = parseCsvLine(lines[i]);
        const fullName = cleaned[0];
        if (!fullName) {
          errors.push(`${i + 1}行目: 氏名が未入力です`);
          continue;
        }

        if (hasFuriganaHeader) {
          items.push({
            fullName,
            furigana: cleaned[1] || undefined,
            recipientNumber: cleaned[2] || undefined,
            paymentLimit: cleaned[3] ? parseInt(cleaned[3], 10) : 0,
            validFrom: cleaned[4] || undefined,
            validTo: cleaned[5] || undefined,
            allowanceDays: cleaned[6] ? parseInt(cleaned[6], 10) : 23,
            disabilityClass: cleaned[7] || undefined,
            disabilityType: cleaned[8] || undefined,
            hourlyWage: cleaned[9] ? parseInt(cleaned[9], 10) : undefined,
            weeklyScheduledHours: cleaned[10] ? parseFloat(cleaned[10]) : undefined,
            workStartTime: cleaned[11] || undefined,
            workEndTime: cleaned[12] || undefined,
            breakTimeMinutes: cleaned[13] ? parseInt(cleaned[13], 10) : undefined,
            birthdate: cleaned[14] || undefined,
            gender: cleaned[15] || undefined,
            phoneNumber: cleaned[16] || undefined,
            address: cleaned[17] || undefined,
            serviceStartDate: cleaned[18] || undefined,
          });
        } else {
          // 旧フォーマット（フリガナなし18列）後方互換
          items.push({
            fullName,
            recipientNumber: cleaned[1] || undefined,
            paymentLimit: cleaned[2] ? parseInt(cleaned[2], 10) : 0,
            validFrom: cleaned[3] || undefined,
            validTo: cleaned[4] || undefined,
            allowanceDays: cleaned[5] ? parseInt(cleaned[5], 10) : 23,
            disabilityClass: cleaned[6] || undefined,
            disabilityType: cleaned[7] || undefined,
            hourlyWage: cleaned[8] ? parseInt(cleaned[8], 10) : undefined,
            weeklyScheduledHours: cleaned[9] ? parseFloat(cleaned[9]) : undefined,
            workStartTime: cleaned[10] || undefined,
            workEndTime: cleaned[11] || undefined,
            breakTimeMinutes: cleaned[12] ? parseInt(cleaned[12], 10) : undefined,
            birthdate: cleaned[13] || undefined,
            gender: cleaned[14] || undefined,
            phoneNumber: cleaned[15] || undefined,
            address: cleaned[16] || undefined,
            serviceStartDate: cleaned[17] || undefined,
          });
        }
      }

      setParseErrors(errors);
      setParsedData(items);
    };

    reader.readAsText(file);
  };

  // インポート実行
  const handleExecuteImport = async () => {
    if (parsedData.length === 0) return;
    setIsProcessing(true);

    try {
      const res = await importClientsFromCsv(parsedData);
      if (res.success) {
        toast.success(res.message);
        setIsOpen(false);
        setParsedData([]);
        setFileName('');
        window.location.reload();
      } else {
        toast.error(res.error || "インポートに失敗しました");
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast.error(e.message || "予期せぬエラーが発生しました");
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Dialog open={isOpen} onOpenChange={setIsOpen}>
      <DialogTrigger asChild>
        <Button variant="outline" className="h-10 px-3.5 gap-2 border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/50 hover:bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-900 font-semibold shadow-xs">
          <Upload className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600" />
          <span>CSV一括登録</span>
        </Button>
      </DialogTrigger>
      
      <DialogContent className="max-w-3xl max-h-[85vh] flex flex-col">
        <DialogHeader>
          <DialogTitle className="text-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2 text-indigo-950">
            <FileSpreadsheet className="h-5 w-5 text-indigo-600" />
            利用者データ一括CSVインポート
          </DialogTitle>
          <DialogDescription className="text-sm">
            他社ソフト（カイポケ、ワイズマン等）やExcelで管理している利用者一覧をまとめて登録できます。
          </DialogDescription>
        </DialogHeader>

        <div className="space-y-4 my-2 overflow-y-auto pr-1 flex-1">
          {/* テンプレート案内カード */}
          <div className="p-3.5 bg-muted/40 rounded-lg border flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div className="space-y-0.5">
              <div className="text-sm font-bold">1. CSVテンプレートを準備</div>
              <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                所定フォーマットの雛形CSVをダウンロードし、氏名や受給者証情報を入力してください。
              </div>
            </div>
            <Button 
              size="sm" 
              variant="outline" 
              onClick={handleDownloadTemplate}
              className="gap-1.5 shrink-0 bg-white font-medium text-xs"
            >
              <Download className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              テンプレートDL
            </Button>
          </div>

          {/* アップロードエリア */}
          <div className="space-y-2">
            <div className="text-sm font-bold">2. 入力済みのCSVファイルを選択</div>
            <label className="border-2 border-dashed border-input hover:border-primary/60 bg-card p-6 rounded-xl flex flex-col items-center justify-center cursor-pointer transition-colors text-center group">
              <Upload className="h-8 w-8 text-muted-foreground group-hover:text-primary mb-2 transition-colors" />
              <span className="text-sm font-semibold">
                {fileName ? fileName : "クリックしてCSVファイルを選択（またはドラッグ＆ドロップ）"}
              </span>
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">.csv ファイル対応（UTF-8またはShift-JIS）</span>
              <input 
                type="file" 
                accept=".csv" 
                className="hidden" 
                onChange={handleFileChange}
              />
            </label>
          </div>

          {/* エラー表示 */}
          {parseErrors.length > 0 && (
            <div className="p-3 bg-rose-50 border border-rose-200 rounded-lg text-rose-800 text-xs space-y-1">
              <div className="font-bold flex items-center gap-1">
                <AlertCircle className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-rose-600" />
                以下の行で問題が検出されました（スキップされます）:
              </div>
              <ul className="list-disc list-inside space-y-0.5 max-h-24 overflow-y-auto">
                {parseErrors.map((err, i) => (
                  <li key={i}>{err}</li>
                ))}
              </ul>
            </div>
          )}

          {/* プレビューテーブル */}
          {parsedData.length > 0 && (
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                <span className="font-bold text-gray-700">
                  インポート対象プレビュー（全 {parsedData.length} 件）
                </span>
                <span className="text-emerald-600 font-semibold flex items-center gap-1">
                  <CheckCircle2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> 正常に解析されました
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="border rounded-md overflow-x-auto max-h-56 text-xs">
                <table className="w-full text-left border-collapse">
                  <thead className="bg-muted/80 sticky top-0 font-semibold">
                    <tr>
                      <th className="p-2 border-b">No</th>
                      <th className="p-2 border-b">氏名</th>
                      <th className="p-2 border-b">受給者証番号</th>
                      <th className="p-2 border-b">区分</th>
                      <th className="p-2 border-b">上限額</th>
                      <th className="p-2 border-b">支給量</th>
                      <th className="p-2 border-b">所定勤務/休憩</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {parsedData.map((d, i) => (
                      <tr key={i} className="hover:bg-muted/30 border-b last:border-b-0">
                        <td className="p-2 text-muted-foreground">{i + 1}</td>
                        <td className="p-2 font-bold">{d.fullName}</td>
                        <td className="p-2 font-mono">{d.recipientNumber || '未入力'}</td>
                        <td className="p-2">{d.disabilityClass || '区分3'}</td>
                        <td className="p-2">¥{(d.paymentLimit ?? 0).toLocaleString()}</td>
                        <td className="p-2">{d.allowanceDays || 23}日</td>
                        <td className="p-2 font-mono">
                          {d.workStartTime || '09:00'}〜{d.workEndTime || '16:00'} (休{d.breakTimeMinutes ?? 60}分)
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

        <DialogFooter className="border-t pt-3 flex sm:justify-between items-center gap-2">
          <Button 
            variant="ghost" 
            size="sm" 
            onClick={() => setIsOpen(false)}
            disabled={isProcessing}
          >
            キャンセル
          </Button>
          <Button 
            onClick={handleExecuteImport} 
            disabled={parsedData.length === 0 || isProcessing}
            className="bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-bold gap-2 px-6"
          >
            {isProcessing ? (
              <>
                <Loader2 className="h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
                登録中...
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <Upload className="h-4 w-4" />
                {parsedData.length} 件を一括登録する
              </>
            )}
          </Button>
        </DialogFooter>
      </DialogContent>
    </Dialog>
  );
}

'use client'

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Trash2 } from "lucide-react"
import { deleteClientRecord } from "./actions"
import { toast } from "sonner"
import { useState } from "react"

export function DeleteClientButton({ id, name }: { id: string, name: string }) {
  const [isDeleting, setIsDeleting] = useState(false);

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (confirm(`利用者「${name}」を本当に削除しますか？\n\n※この操作は取り消せません。関連する個別支援計画や請求・上限額管理のデータもすべて完全に削除されます。`)) {
      setIsDeleting(true);
      try {
        const res = await deleteClientRecord(id);
        if (res && !res.success) {
          toast.error(res.error || '削除に失敗しました');
          setIsDeleting(false);
          return;
        }
        toast.success(`利用者「${name}」を削除しました`);
      } catch (err: any) {
        toast.error(err.message || '削除に失敗しました');
        setIsDeleting(false); // 失敗時のみ元に戻す
      }
    }
  }

  return (
    <Button 
      variant="destructive" 
      size="sm" 
      onClick={handleDelete}
      disabled={isDeleting}
      className="h-8 px-2"
    >
      <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
    </Button>
  )
}

              >

                {interviewRecords?.length > 0 && (

                    {offsiteEvaluations.length}
                  </span>
                )}
              </TabsTrigger>
            </div>
          </TabsList>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-6">
        <TabsContent value="facesheet" className="m-0">
          <FacesheetTab clientId={clientId} initialData={facesheet} contractData={contract} clientName={clientName} isTypeB={isTypeB} />
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="files" className="m-0">
          <FilesTab clientId={clientId} />
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="self-plan" className="m-0">
          <SelfPlanTab clientId={clientId} selfPlans={selfPlans} clientName={clientName} />
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="assessment" className="m-0">
          <AssessmentTab clientId={clientId} assessments={assessments} clientName={clientName} isTypeB={isTypeB} />
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="plan" className="m-0">
          <SupportPlanTab clientId={clientId} plans={plans} clientName={clientName} />
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="monitoring" className="m-0">
          <MonitoringTab 
            clientId={clientId} 
            monitorings={monitorings} 
            plans={plans} 
            clientName={clientName} 
            interviewRecords={interviewRecords}
            supportRecords={supportRecords}
          />
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="daily" className="m-0">
          <DailyRecordsTab clientId={clientId} dailyRecords={dailyRecords} supportRecords={supportRecords} clientName={clientName} />
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="interview" className="m-0">
          <InterviewTab clientId={clientId} interviewRecords={interviewRecords} clientName={clientName} />
        </TabsContent>
        <TabsContent value="offsite-eval" className="m-0">
          <OffsiteEvaluationTab clientId={clientId} evaluations={offsiteEvaluations} clientName={clientName} />
        </TabsContent>
      </div>
    </Tabs>
  );
}

'use server';

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { assertCanAccessClient } from "@/lib/auth";

export async function getDefaultServiceManagerName(): Promise<string> {
  try {
    const sm = db.prepare(`
      SELECT name FROM staff 
      WHERE (role IN ('service_manager', 'admin_and_service_manager') 
         OR job_category LIKE '%サービス管理責任者%' 
         OR job_category LIKE '%サビ管%')
        AND deleted_at IS NULL
      ORDER BY created_at ASC
      LIMIT 1
    `).get() as any;
    return sm?.name || '担当サービス管理責任者';
  } catch (e) {
    return '担当サービス管理責任者';
  }
}

export async function saveFacesheet(clientId: string, data: any) {
  try {
    await assertCanAccessClient(clientId);
    const existing = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM client_facesheets WHERE client_id = ?').get(clientId);
    
    if (existing) {
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE client_facesheets SET
          family_structure = ?,
          medical_history = ?,
          disability_details = ?,
          emergency_contact = ?,
          updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE client_id = ?
      `).run(
        data.family_structure || null,
        data.medical_history || null,
        data.disability_details || null,
        data.emergency_contact || null,
        clientId
      );
    } else {
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO client_facesheets (id, client_id, family_structure, medical_history, disability_details, emergency_contact)
        VALUES (lower(hex(randomblob(16))), ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(
        clientId,
        data.family_structure || null,
        data.medical_history || null,
        data.disability_details || null,
        data.emergency_contact || null
      );

export async function saveMonitoring(clientId: string, data: any): Promise<{ success: boolean; id?: string; error?: string }> {
  try {
    await assertCanAccessClient(clientId);
    const mDate = data.monitoring_date || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const isNew = !data.id || data.id === "new";
    const mId = isNew ? (await import("crypto")).randomUUID() : data.id;
    const validPlanId = data.plan_id && db.prepare('SELECT id FROM support_plans WHERE id = ?').get(data.plan_id) ? data.plan_id : null;

    const existing = !isNew ? db.prepare('SELECT id FROM monitorings WHERE id = ? AND client_id = ?').get(mId, clientId) : null;

    if (!existing) {
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO monitorings (id, client_id, plan_id, monitoring_date, evaluation, next_steps, consent_date)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(
        mId,
        clientId,
        validPlanId,
        mDate,
        data.evaluation || null,
        data.next_steps || null,
        data.consent_date || null
      );
    } else {
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE monitorings SET
          plan_id = ?,
          monitoring_date = ?,
          evaluation = ?,
          next_steps = ?,
          consent_date = ?,
          updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE id = ? AND client_id = ?
      `).run(
        validPlanId,
        mDate,
        data.evaluation || null,
        data.next_steps || null,
        data.consent_date || null,
        mId,
        clientId
      );
    }

    try {
      const defaultSm = await getDefaultServiceManagerName();
      const planId = validPlanId || (db.prepare('SELECT id FROM support_plans WHERE client_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY start_date DESC LIMIT 1').get(clientId) as any)?.id;
      if (planId) {
        db.prepare(`
          INSERT OR REPLACE INTO plan_monitorings (
            id, client_id, support_plan_id, monitoring_date, monitoring_period_month,
            progress_status, goal_achievement, staff_evaluation, next_action_plan, evaluator_name
          ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, '6', 'smooth', ?, ?, ?, ?)
        `).run(mId, clientId, planId, mDate, data.evaluation || '', data.evaluation || '', data.next_steps || '', defaultSm);
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    try {
      revalidatePath(`/clients/${clientId}/documents`);
    } catch (e) {}
    return { success: true, id: mId };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('saveMonitoring error:', error);
    return { success: false, error: error?.message || 'モニタリングの保存に失敗しました' };
  }
}

export async function saveInterview(clientId: string, data: any): Promise<{ success: boolean; id?: string; error?: string }> {
  try {
    await assertCanAccessClient(clientId);
    const isNew = !data.id || data.id === 'new';
    const interviewId = isNew ? (await import('crypto')).randomUUID() : data.id;
    const now = new Date().toISOString();
    const interviewDate = data.interview_date || now.slice(0, 10);

    const existing = !isNew ? db.prepare('SELECT id FROM interview_records WHERE id = ? AND client_id = ?').get(interviewId, clientId) : null;

    if (existing) {
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE interview_records SET
          interview_date = ?,
          topic = ?,
          notes = ?,
          interview_type = ?,
          interviewer_name = ?,
          location = ?,
          client_statement = ?,
          staff_response = ?,
          next_action_plan = ?,
          next_interview_date = ?,
          attendees = ?,
          status = ?,
          updated_at = ?
        WHERE id = ? AND client_id = ?
      `).run(
        interviewDate,
        data.topic || null,
        data.notes || null,
        data.interview_type || 'regular',
        data.interviewer_name || (await getDefaultServiceManagerName()),
        data.location || '相談室',
        data.client_statement || null,
        data.staff_response || null,
        data.next_action_plan || null,
        data.next_interview_date || null,
        data.attendees || null,
        data.status || 'completed',
        now,
        interviewId,
        clientId
      );
    } else {
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO interview_records (
          id, client_id, interview_date, topic, notes,
          interview_type, interviewer_name, location,
          client_statement, staff_response, next_action_plan,
          next_interview_date, attendees, status, created_at, updated_at
        )
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(
        interviewId,
        clientId,
        interviewDate,
        data.topic || null,
        data.notes || null,
        data.interview_type || 'regular',
        data.interviewer_name || (await getDefaultServiceManagerName()),
        data.location || '相談室',
        data.client_statement || null,
        data.staff_response || null,
        data.next_action_plan || null,
        data.next_interview_date || null,
        data.attendees || null,
        data.status || 'completed',
        now,
        now
      );
    }
    try {
      revalidatePath(`/clients/${clientId}/documents`);
    } catch (e) {}
    return { success: true, id: interviewId };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('saveInterview error:', error);
    return { success: false, error: error?.message || '面談記録の保存に失敗しました' };
  }
}

export default async function ContractPdfPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const resolvedParams = await params;
  const clientId = resolvedParams.id;

  const serviceMode = resolveServiceModeForClient(clientId);
  if (serviceMode === 'type_b') {
    redirect(`/clients/${clientId}/documents/wage-regulation-agreement`);
  }

  const client = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM clients WHERE id = ?').get(clientId) as any;
  if (!client) notFound();

  const contract = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM employment_contracts WHERE client_id = ?').get(clientId) as any || {};
  const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any || {};

  const today = new Date();
  const dateStr = `${today.getFullYear()}年${today.getMonth() + 1}月${today.getDate()}日`;

  const startDate = contract.contract_start_date ? new Date(contract.contract_start_date) : null;
  const startDateStr = startDate ? `${startDate.getFullYear()}年${startDate.getMonth() + 1}月${startDate.getDate()}日` : "　　年　　月　　日";

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-4 sm:p-8 print:p-0 print:bg-white flex flex-col items-center text-[12px] leading-snug">
      <style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{__html: `
        @media print {
          @page {
            size: A4 portrait;
            margin: 10mm 12mm 10mm 12mm;
          }
          html, body {
            margin: 0 !important;
            padding: 0 !important;
            height: 100% !important;
            background: white !important;
            color: black !important;
            -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
            print-color-adjust: exact;
          }

            width: 100% !important;

            justify-content: space-between !important;
            border: none !important;
            box-shadow: none !important;
            padding: 0 !important;
            margin: 0 !important;
            overflow: hidden !important;
            page-break-after: avoid !important;
            break-after: avoid !important;
            page-break-inside: avoid !important;
            break-inside: avoid !important;
          }
        }
      `}} />

      <div className="contract-sheet-print w-full max-w-4xl bg-white shadow-lg p-10 print:shadow-none print:p-0">
        
        <div className="flex justify-end mb-2 print:hidden shrink-0">

  params,

}) {

  if (!client) notFound();

  const interview = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM interview_records WHERE id = ? AND client_id = ?').get(interviewId, clientId) as any;
  if (!interview) notFound();

  const getTypeName = (type: string) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'regular': return '定期個別面談（月次・定期）';
      case 'work': return '就労・作業相談（作業・施設外）';
      case 'life': return '生活・健康相談（睡眠・服薬）';
      case 'relationship': return '人間関係相談（職場対人）';

              <Link
                href={`/clients/${clientId}/documents/interviews/${interviewId}/edit`}
                className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline" }), "gap-1 font-bold")}

import { Header } from "@/components/Header";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ChevronLeft, Save, MessageSquare, ShieldCheck, User, Calendar } from "lucide-react";
import { saveInterview } from "../actions";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { db, resolveServiceModeForClient } from "@/lib/db";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export default async function NewInterviewPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const resolvedParams = await params;
  const clientId = resolvedParams.id;
  resolveServiceModeForClient(clientId);

  const client = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM clients WHERE id = ?').get(clientId) as any;
  if (!client) notFound();

  // 実地指導連動: 現在有効な個別支援計画の目標を取得
  const activePlan = db.prepare(`
    SELECT * FROM support_plans 
    WHERE client_id = ? AND status = 'active' AND deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY start_date DESC LIMIT 1
  `).get(clientId) as any;

  let planShortGoal = '';
  let planLongGoal = '';
  if (activePlan?.domains_data) {
    try {
      const parsed = JSON.parse(activePlan.domains_data);
      planShortGoal = parsed.short_term_goal || parsed.shortTermGoal || '';
      planLongGoal = parsed.long_term_goal || parsed.longTermGoal || '';
    } catch {}
  }

  const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0];

  const serviceManager = db.prepare(`
    SELECT name, job_category, role 
    FROM staff 
    WHERE role IN ('service_manager', 'admin_and_service_manager') 
       OR job_category LIKE '%サービス管理責任者%' 
       OR job_category LIKE '%サビ管%'
    ORDER BY created_at ASC
    LIMIT 1
  `).get() as any;
  const defaultInterviewer = serviceManager ? `${serviceManager.name}（${serviceManager.job_category || 'サビ管'}）` : '担当職員';

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background/50">
      <Header activePage="clients" />
      <main className="flex-1 p-6 md:p-12">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-4xl space-y-6">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <Link href={`/clients/${clientId}/documents?tab=interview`} className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "icon" })}>
              <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
            </Link>
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
                <MessageSquare className="w-7 h-7 text-primary" />
                個別面談・相談援助記録の作成
              </h1>
              <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">
                対象者: <span className="font-bold text-foreground">{client.full_name}</span> 様 （受給者番号: {client.recipient_number || '未登録'}）
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          {activePlan && (
            <div className="p-4 bg-indigo-50/80 border border-indigo-200 rounded-xl text-xs space-y-2">
              <div className="font-bold text-indigo-950 flex items-center justify-between">
                <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm">
                  🎯 個別支援計画策定目標（実地指導: 計画目標に即した相談援助）
                </span>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-indigo-700 bg-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-indigo-200">
                  計画期間: {activePlan.start_date || '未定'} 〜 {activePlan.end_date || '未定'}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2 pt-1 text-indigo-900">
                <div className="bg-white p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-indigo-100">
                  <span className="font-bold text-indigo-700 block mb-0.5">【短期目標】</span>
                  {planShortGoal || '（未設定）'}
                </div>
                <div className="bg-white p-2.5 rounded-lg border border-indigo-100">
                  <span className="font-bold text-indigo-700 block mb-0.5">【長期目標】</span>
                  {planLongGoal || '（未設定）'}
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <form action={async (formData) => {
            'use server';
            const data = Object.fromEntries(formData);
            await saveInterview(clientId, data);
            redirect(`/clients/${clientId}/documents?tab=interview`);
          }}>
            <Card className="shadow-sm border-primary/20">
              <CardHeader className="bg-primary/5 border-b pb-4">
                <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                  <div>
                    <CardTitle className="text-lg text-primary">基本情報・面談属性（実地指導 指定基準第197条準用第53条の2 準拠）</CardTitle>
                    <CardDescription>
                      面談実施者、面談場所、および面談種別を正確に記録してください。
                    </CardDescription>
                  </div>
                  <ShieldCheck className="h-6 w-6 text-primary shrink-0" />
                </div>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="space-y-6 pt-6">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <Label className="font-bold text-xs text-muted-foreground">面談実施日 <span className="text-red-500">*</span></Label>
                    <Input name="interview_date" type="date" defaultValue={todayStr} required />
                  </div>

                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <Label className="font-bold text-xs text-muted-foreground">面談種別 <span className="text-red-500">*</span></Label>
                    <select
                      name="interview_type"
                      defaultValue="regular"
                      className="flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring"
                      required
                    >
                      <option value="regular">定期個別面談（月次・定期）</option>
                      <option value="work">就労・作業相談（作業・施設外）</option>
                      <option value="life">生活・健康相談（睡眠・服薬）</option>
                      <option value="relationship">人間関係相談（職場対人）</option>
                      <option value="family">ご家族相談（保護者面談）</option>
                      <option value="transition">一般就労移行相談（求職・実習）</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>

                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <Label className="font-bold text-xs text-muted-foreground">面談担当者 <span className="text-red-500">*</span></Label>
                    <Input name="interviewer_name" defaultValue={defaultInterviewer} required />
                  </div>

                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <Label className="font-bold text-xs text-muted-foreground">面談場所</Label>
                    <Input name="location" defaultValue="相談室（事業所内）" />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label className="font-bold text-xs text-muted-foreground">同席者（任意）</Label>
                  <Input name="attendees" placeholder="例：ご家族（母）、相談支援専門員（〇〇相談支援事業所）" />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label className="font-bold text-xs text-muted-foreground">相談件名・主訴トピック <span className="text-red-500">*</span></Label>
                  <Input name="topic" placeholder="例：日々の作業ペースに関する相談、施設外就労への参加希望" required />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label className="font-bold text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    【相談内容・本人の訴え（主訴）】 <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </Label>
                  <Textarea 
                    name="client_statement" 
                    rows={4}
                    placeholder="本人の発言や表情、訴えている悩みや不安、要望をできる限り本人の言葉を交えて具体的に記録してください..." 
                    required 
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label className="font-bold text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    【支援員の助言・指導・具体的対応】 <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
                  </Label>
                  <Textarea 
                    name="staff_response" 
                    rows={4}
                    placeholder="本人の訴えに対してどのような助言や指導を行ったか、事業所としてどのような配慮や環境調整を決定したかを具体的に記録してください..." 
                    required 
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <Label className="font-bold text-xs text-muted-foreground">次回フォロー方針・決定事項</Label>
                    <Textarea 
                      name="next_action_plan" 
                      rows={2}
                      placeholder="例：作業指導員へ工程見直しを共有、1週間後に体調の経過確認を実施" 
                    />
                  </div>

                  <div className="space-y-2">
                    <Label className="font-bold text-xs text-muted-foreground">次回面談予定日（任意）</Label>
                    <Input name="next_interview_date" type="date" />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="pt-4 border-t flex justify-end gap-3">
                  <Link 
                    href={`/clients/${clientId}/documents?tab=interview`}
                    className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline" }))}
                  >
                    キャンセル
                  </Link>
                  <Button type="submit" className="gap-2 font-bold">
                    <Save className="w-4 h-4" />

import { notFound, redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { db, resolveServiceModeForClient } from "@/lib/db";
import { getServiceMode } from "@/lib/serviceModeServer";
import { PrintButton } from "@/app/plans/[id]/PrintButton";
import { AutoFitText } from "@/components/AutoFitText";

export default async function OfferLetterPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const resolvedParams = await params;
  const clientId = resolvedParams.id;

  const serviceMode = resolveServiceModeForClient(clientId);
  if (serviceMode === 'type_b') {
    redirect(`/clients/${clientId}/documents/wage-regulation-agreement`);
  }

  const client = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM clients WHERE id = ?').get(clientId) as any;
  if (!client) notFound();

  const contract = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM employment_contracts WHERE client_id = ?').get(clientId) as any || {};
  const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any || {};

  const today = new Date();
  const dateStr = `${today.getFullYear()}年${today.getMonth() + 1}月${today.getDate()}日`;

  const hireDate = contract.hire_date ? new Date(contract.hire_date) : null;
  const hireDateStr = hireDate ? `${hireDate.getFullYear()}年${hireDate.getMonth() + 1}月${hireDate.getDate()}日` : "　　年　　月　　日";

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-gray-100 p-4 sm:p-8 print:p-0 print:bg-white flex flex-col items-center text-[12px] leading-snug">
      <style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{__html: `
        @media print {
          @page {
            size: A4 portrait;
            margin: 15mm 18mm 15mm 18mm;
          }
          html, body {
            margin: 0 !important;
            padding: 0 !important;
            height: 100% !important;
            background: white !important;

import { db, resolveServiceModeForClient } from "@/lib/db";
import { notFound, redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { Header } from "@/components/Header";
import { PrintButton } from "@/components/PrintButton";
import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ChevronLeft, Briefcase, FileCheck2, User, Building, Calendar, Star, Edit } from "lucide-react";
import { cn, formatDisabilityTypes } from "@/lib/utils";

export default async function OffsiteEvaluationDetailPage(props: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string; evalId: string }>;
}) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) redirect("/login");

  const params = await props.params;
  const clientId = params.id;
  const evalId = params.evalId;
  resolveServiceModeForClient(clientId);

  const evaluation = db.prepare(`
    SELECT e.*, 
           c.full_name as client_name, c.recipient_number, c.disability_class, c.disability_type,
           w.name as workplace_name, w.company_name, w.address as workplace_address,
           con.work_description as contract_work_desc, con.contract_start_date, con.contract_end_date
    FROM offsite_evaluations e
    JOIN clients c ON e.client_id = c.id
    LEFT JOIN offsite_workplaces w ON e.workplace_id = w.id
    LEFT JOIN contractor_agreements con ON e.contractor_id = con.id
    WHERE e.id = ? AND e.client_id = ?
  `).get(evalId, clientId) as any;

  if (!evaluation) {
    notFound();
  }

  const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any || {};

  const scoreLabels = [
    { key: 'basic_habits_score', label: '1. 基本的労働習慣', desc: '勤怠の安定性、身だしなみ、体調管理、挨拶、報告・連絡・相談の適切さ' },
    { key: 'work_performance_score', label: '2. 作業遂行能力', desc: '作業手順の理解・遵守、正確性・品質、作業スピード、集中力と持続力' },
    { key: 'interpersonal_score', label: '3. 対人関係・協調性', desc: '企業先担当者や同僚とのコミュニケーション、指示の受容と柔軟な対応' },
    { key: 'safety_score', label: '4. 安全衛生・危機管理', desc: '作業安全ルールの遵守、保護具着用、道具の適正な取り扱い、危険回避' },
    { key: 'readiness_score', label: '5. 一般就労への適性・移行意欲', desc: '企業での就労に対する意欲・熱意、自立した行動力、就職へのレディネス' },
  ];

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background">
      <div className="print:hidden">
        <Header activePage="clients" />
      </div>

      <main className="flex-1 p-6 md:p-12 print:p-0">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-4xl space-y-6">
          {/* 操作バー（画面表示時のみ） */}
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between print:hidden">
            <Link
              href={`/clients/${clientId}/documents?tab=offsite-eval`}
              className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm" }), "gap-1")}
            >
              <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
              書類ハブ（評価表台帳）へ戻る
            </Link>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Link
                href={`/clients/${clientId}/documents/offsite-evaluations/${evalId}/edit`}
                className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm" }), "gap-1 font-bold")}
              >
                <Edit className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
                評価表を編集
              </Link>
              <PrintButton label="A4評価シートを印刷" />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 施設外就労評価表（A4帳票レイアウト） */}
          <div className="bg-card text-card-foreground p-8 md:p-12 border rounded-lg shadow-sm print:border-none print:shadow-none print:p-0 print:m-0 space-y-6 text-foreground">
            
            {/* 帳票ヘッダー */}
            <div className="border-b-2 border-foreground pb-4">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-start">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-xs font-mono text-muted-foreground">厚生労働省指定基準 第191条の2準拠様式</span>
                  <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight mt-1">
                    就労継続支援A型 施設外就労評価表（総括評価シート）
                  </h1>
                </div>
                <div className="text-right text-xs space-y-0.5">
                  <div>事業所番号: {facility.facility_number || '2810700001'}</div>
                  <div className="font-semibold">{facility.facility_name || '就労継続支援A型事業所 須磨ワークス'}</div>
                  <div>作成日: <span className="font-mono font-bold">{evaluation.evaluation_date}</span></div>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* 対象者・就労先企業 基本情報 */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 border rounded-md p-4 bg-muted/10 text-sm">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <span className="font-semibold w-24 text-muted-foreground">利用者氏名:</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-base">{evaluation.client_name} 様</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <span className="font-semibold w-24 text-muted-foreground">受給者証番号:</span>
                  <span className="font-mono">{evaluation.recipient_number}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <span className="font-semibold w-24 text-muted-foreground">障害区分/種別:</span>
                  <span>{evaluation.disability_class ? `区分${evaluation.disability_class}` : '区分未設定'} / {formatDisabilityTypes(evaluation.disability_type) || '障害種別未設定'}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <span className="font-semibold w-24 text-muted-foreground">評価対象期間:</span>
                  <span className="font-mono font-semibold">{evaluation.period_start} 〜 {evaluation.period_end}</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2 border-l pl-4">
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <span className="font-semibold w-24 text-muted-foreground">就労先企業:</span>
                  <span className="font-bold">{evaluation.company_name || evaluation.workplace_name || '請負先企業'}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <span className="font-semibold w-24 text-muted-foreground">就労先所在地:</span>
                  <span className="text-xs">{evaluation.workplace_address || '神戸市内'}</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <span className="font-semibold w-24 text-muted-foreground">担当作業内容:</span>

                </div>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <span className="font-semibold w-24 text-muted-foreground">同行指導員:</span>
                  <span className="font-semibold">{evaluation.evaluator_name || '配置指導員'}</span>

            </div>

            {/* 5大評価項目テーブル */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <h2 className="text-base font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 border-b pb-1">
                <FileCheck2 className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
                職業レディネス・作業遂行状況 評価（5段階客観評価）
              </h2>
              <table className="w-full border-collapse border border-foreground/30 text-sm">
                <thead>
                  <tr className="bg-muted/40 text-center text-xs">
                    <th className="border border-foreground/30 p-2 w-[220px] text-left">評価項目</th>
                    <th className="border border-foreground/30 p-2 text-left">評価着眼点・評価基準</th>
                    <th className="border border-foreground/30 p-2 w-[120px]">評定スコア</th>
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody>
                  {scoreLabels.map((item) => {
                    const score = evaluation[item.key] || 3;
                    return (

'use server';

import { db, sanitizeForeignKeyId } from "@/lib/db";
import { getRole, assertCanAccessClient } from "@/lib/auth";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

export async function saveOffsiteEvaluation(clientId: string, formData: FormData) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) {
    redirect("/login");
  }

  let id = '';
  try {
    await assertCanAccessClient(clientId);

    const existingId = formData.get("id") as string;
    const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    const evaluationDate = (formData.get("evaluationDate") as string) || todayStr;
    const periodStart = (formData.get("periodStart") as string) || todayStr;
    const periodEnd = (formData.get("periodEnd") as string) || todayStr;
    const workplaceId = sanitizeForeignKeyId('offsite_workplaces', formData.get("workplaceId") as string);
    const contractorId = sanitizeForeignKeyId('contractor_agreements', formData.get("contractorId") as string);
    const workTasks = formData.get("workTasks") as string;
    const basicHabitsScore = Number(formData.get("basicHabitsScore")) || 3;
    const workPerformanceScore = Number(formData.get("workPerformanceScore")) || 3;
    const interpersonalScore = Number(formData.get("interpersonalScore")) || 3;
    const safetyScore = Number(formData.get("safetyScore")) || 4;
    const readinessScore = Number(formData.get("readinessScore")) || 3;
    const detailedEvaluation = formData.get("detailedEvaluation") as string;
    const strengthsAndGrowth = formData.get("strengthsAndGrowth") as string;
    const challengesAndSupport = formData.get("challengesAndSupport") as string;
    const planReflection = formData.get("planReflection") as string;
    const evaluatorId = sanitizeForeignKeyId('staff', formData.get("evaluatorId") as string);
    const evaluatorName = formData.get("evaluatorName") as string;
    const supervisorId = sanitizeForeignKeyId('staff', formData.get("supervisorId") as string);
    const supervisorName = formData.get("supervisorName") as string;
    const feedbackDate = formData.get("feedbackDate") as string;
    const clientSignature = formData.get("clientSignature") as string;

    id = existingId && existingId !== 'new' ? existingId : `eval_${clientId}_${Date.now()}`;
    const existing = existingId && existingId !== 'new'
      ? db.prepare('SELECT id FROM offsite_evaluations WHERE id = ? AND client_id = ?').get(id, clientId)
      : null;

    if (existing) {
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE offsite_evaluations SET
          workplace_id = ?, contractor_id = ?, evaluation_date = ?, period_start = ?, period_end = ?,
          work_tasks = ?, basic_habits_score = ?, work_performance_score = ?, interpersonal_score = ?, safety_score = ?, readiness_score = ?,
          detailed_evaluation = ?, strengths_and_growth = ?, challenges_and_support = ?, plan_reflection = ?,
          evaluator_id = ?, evaluator_name = ?, supervisor_id = ?, supervisor_name = ?, feedback_date = ?, client_signature = ?,
          updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE id = ? AND client_id = ?
      `).run(
        workplaceId, contractorId, evaluationDate, periodStart, periodEnd,
        workTasks, basicHabitsScore, workPerformanceScore, interpersonalScore, safetyScore, readinessScore,
        detailedEvaluation, strengthsAndGrowth, challengesAndSupport, planReflection,
        evaluatorId, evaluatorName, supervisorId, supervisorName, feedbackDate || null, clientSignature || '本人確認済',
        id, clientId
      );
    } else {
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO offsite_evaluations (
          id, client_id, workplace_id, contractor_id, evaluation_date, period_start, period_end,
          work_tasks, basic_habits_score, work_performance_score, interpersonal_score, safety_score, readiness_score,
          detailed_evaluation, strengths_and_growth, challenges_and_support, plan_reflection,
          evaluator_id, evaluator_name, supervisor_id, supervisor_name, feedback_date, client_signature
        ) VALUES (
          ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
          ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
          ?, ?, ?, ?,
          ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?
        )
      `).run(
        id, clientId, workplaceId, contractorId, evaluationDate, periodStart, periodEnd,
        workTasks, basicHabitsScore, workPerformanceScore, interpersonalScore, safetyScore, readinessScore,
        detailedEvaluation, strengthsAndGrowth, challengesAndSupport, planReflection,
        evaluatorId, evaluatorName, supervisorId, supervisorName, feedbackDate || null, clientSignature || '本人確認済'
      );
    }

    revalidatePath(`/clients/${clientId}/documents`);
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('saveOffsiteEvaluation error:', error);
    redirect(`/clients/${clientId}/documents?tab=offsite-eval`);
  }

  redirect(`/clients/${clientId}/documents/offsite-evaluations/${id}`);
}

export async function deleteOffsiteEvaluation(clientId: string, evalId: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    await assertCanAccessClient(clientId);
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role) return { success: false, error: '認証されていません' };

    db.prepare('UPDATE offsite_evaluations SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ? AND client_id = ?').run(evalId, clientId);
    revalidatePath(`/clients/${clientId}/documents`);
    return { success: true };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('deleteOffsiteEvaluation error:', error);
    return { success: false, error: error?.message || '施設外評価票の削除に失敗しました' };
  }
}

File: src/app/clients/[id]/documents/page.tsx

import { Header } from "@/components/Header";
import { db, resolveServiceModeForClient } from "@/lib/db";
import { getServiceMode } from "@/lib/serviceModeServer";
import { notFound } from "next/navigation";
import Link from "next/link";
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { ChevronLeft } from "lucide-react";
import { cn, formatDisabilityTypes } from "@/lib/utils";
import { DocumentsTabs } from "./DocumentsTabs";

export default async function DocumentsHubPage({
  params,
  searchParams,
}: {
  params: Promise<{ id: string }>;
  searchParams: Promise<{ tab?: string }>;
}) {
  const resolvedParams = await params;
  const resolvedSearchParams = await searchParams;
  const clientId = resolvedParams.id;
  const currentTab = resolvedSearchParams.tab || "facesheet";

  const serviceMode = resolveServiceModeForClient(clientId);
  await getServiceMode();
  const isTypeB = serviceMode === 'type_b';

  const client = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM clients WHERE id = ?').get(clientId) as any;
  if (!client) {
    notFound();
  }

  // 各種ドキュメントの最新データを取得
  const facesheet = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM client_facesheets WHERE client_id = ?').get(clientId) as any;
  const assessments = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM assessments WHERE client_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY assessment_date DESC').all(clientId) as any[];
  const plans = db.prepare(`
    SELECT p.*,
           (SELECT MAX(monitoring_date) FROM plan_monitorings WHERE support_plan_id = p.id) as latest_monitoring_date,
           (SELECT staff_evaluation FROM plan_monitorings WHERE support_plan_id = p.id ORDER BY monitoring_date DESC LIMIT 1) as latest_evaluation
    FROM support_plans p 
    WHERE p.client_id = ? AND p.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY p.plan_date DESC
  `).all(clientId) as any[];

  // サービス管理責任者（担当サビ管）の実在職員を取得
  let serviceManager: any = null;
  try {
    serviceManager = db.prepare(`
      SELECT name, job_category, role 
      FROM staff 
      WHERE (role IN ('service_manager', 'admin_and_service_manager') 
         OR job_category LIKE '%サービス管理責任者%' 
         OR job_category LIKE '%サビ管%')
        AND deleted_at IS NULL
      ORDER BY created_at ASC
      LIMIT 1
    `).get() as any;
  } catch (e) {}

  let supportRecords: any[] = [];
  try {
    supportRecords = db.prepare(`
      SELECT s.*, st.name as staff_full_name
      FROM support_records s
      LEFT JOIN staff st ON s.staff_id = st.id
      WHERE s.client_id = ? AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
      ORDER BY s.record_date DESC
    `).all(clientId) as any[];
  } catch (e) {}

  let monitorings: any[] = [];
  try {
    const rawMonitorings = db.prepare(`
      SELECT 
        id, client_id, plan_id, monitoring_date, 
        evaluation, next_steps, consent_date,
        created_at, updated_at
      FROM monitorings 
      WHERE client_id = ? 
      ORDER BY monitoring_date DESC, created_at DESC
    `).all(clientId) as any[];

    const rawPlanMonitorings = db.prepare(`
      SELECT 
        id, client_id, support_plan_id as plan_id, monitoring_date, 
        staff_evaluation as evaluation, next_action_plan as next_steps, 
        created_at, updated_at
      FROM plan_monitorings 
      WHERE client_id = ? 
      ORDER BY monitoring_date DESC, created_at DESC
    `).all(clientId) as any[];

    const map = new Map<string, any>();
    rawMonitorings.forEach(m => map.set(m.id, m));
    rawPlanMonitorings.forEach(m => {
      if (!map.has(m.id)) {
        map.set(m.id, m);
      }
    });

    monitorings = Array.from(map.values()).sort((a, b) => 
      (b.monitoring_date || '').localeCompare(a.monitoring_date || '') || 
      (b.created_at || '').localeCompare(a.created_at || '')
    );
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Failed to fetch monitorings:', e);
  }

  const contract = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM employment_contracts WHERE client_id = ?').get(clientId) as any;

  let incidents: any[] = [];
  try {
    incidents = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM incident_reports WHERE client_id = ?').all(clientId).map((r: any) => ({
      ...r, 
      type: 'incident', 
      date: r.occurred_at ? r.occurred_at.slice(0, 10) : (r.incident_date || '')
    }));
  } catch {}

  let absences: any[] = [];
  try {
    absences = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM absence_logs WHERE client_id = ?').all(clientId).map((r: any) => ({
      ...r, 
      type: 'absence', 
      date: r.absence_date || ''
    }));
  } catch {}

  let rawInterviews: any[] = [];
  let interviews: any[] = [];
  try {
    rawInterviews = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM interview_records WHERE client_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY interview_date DESC').all(clientId) as any[];
    interviews = rawInterviews.map((r: any) => ({
      ...r, 
      type: 'interview', 
      date: r.interview_date || ''
    }));
  } catch {}

  const dailyRecords = [...incidents, ...absences, ...interviews].sort((a, b) => (b.date || '').localeCompare(a.date || ''));
  const selfPlans = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM self_plans WHERE client_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY creation_date DESC').all(clientId) as any[];

  let offsiteEvaluations: any[] = [];
  try {
    offsiteEvaluations = db.prepare(`
      SELECT e.*, w.name as workplace_name, w.company_name
      FROM offsite_evaluations e
      LEFT JOIN offsite_workplaces w ON e.workplace_id = w.id
      WHERE e.client_id = ? AND e.deleted_at IS NULL
      ORDER BY e.evaluation_date DESC
    `).all(clientId) as any[];
  } catch (e) {}

  const isRetired = !!client.contract_end_date && client.contract_end_date <= new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background/50">
      <div className="print:hidden">
        <Header activePage="clients" />
      </div>

      <main className="flex-1 p-4 md:p-8 print:p-0">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl space-y-6">
          {/* パンくず & ヘッダー */}
          <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-4 print:hidden">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
              <Link href="/clients" className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "icon" }))}>
                <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
              </Link>
              <div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                  <h1 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">
                    PDCA・書類管理台帳
                  </h1>
                  {isRetired ? (
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-zinc-200 text-zinc-800 dark:bg-zinc-800 dark:text-zinc-300">
                      退職済 ({client.contract_end_date} 退職)
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 dark:bg-emerald-950/60 dark:text-emerald-400">
                      在籍中（稼働）
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                  利用者氏名: <span className="font-bold text-foreground text-base">{client.full_name}</span> 様 （受給者番号: <span className="font-mono font-semibold">{client.recipient_number || '未登録'}</span>）
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 利用者プロフェッショナル・ステータスカード */}
          <div className="bg-card border rounded-xl p-4 md:p-5 shadow-sm print:hidden">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-6 gap-4 text-xs">
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground block font-medium">受給者証番号</span>
                <span className="font-mono font-bold text-sm text-foreground">{client.recipient_number || "未登録"}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground block font-medium">障害種別・区分</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-sm text-foreground">
                  {formatDisabilityTypes(client.disability_type) || client.disability_certificate || "一般"} 
                  {client.disability_class ? ` (区分${client.disability_class})` : ""}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground block font-medium">支給決定期間</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-sm text-foreground">
                  {client.valid_from ? `${client.valid_from} 〜` : "未定"}
                  <br />
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground text-[11px]">{client.valid_to || "無期限"}</span>
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground block font-medium">{isTypeB ? '工賃単価・設定' : '雇用契約'}</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-sm text-foreground">
                  {isTypeB ? '工賃 ' : '時給 '}
                  {client.hourly_wage ? `${Number(client.hourly_wage).toLocaleString()}円` : (isTypeB ? "規程工賃" : "最低賃金")}
                  <br />
                  <span className="text-muted-foreground text-[11px]">週 {client.weekly_scheduled_hours || 20}時間</span>
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground block font-medium">{isTypeB ? '利用開始日' : '契約開始日'}</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-sm text-foreground">{client.contract_date || client.service_start_date || "未登録"}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground block font-medium">担当サビ管</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-sm text-foreground">
                  {serviceManager ? `${serviceManager.name}（${serviceManager.job_category || '専従'}）` : "未指定"}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <DocumentsTabs 
            clientId={clientId}
            currentTab={currentTab}
            facesheet={facesheet}
            assessments={assessments}
            plans={plans}
            monitorings={monitorings}
            contract={contract}
            dailyRecords={dailyRecords}
            supportRecords={supportRecords}
            clientName={client.full_name}
            selfPlans={selfPlans}
            offsiteEvaluations={offsiteEvaluations}
            interviewRecords={rawInterviews}
            isTypeB={isTypeB}
          />
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

import { db, resolveServiceModeForClient } from "@/lib/db";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { getServiceMode } from "@/lib/serviceModeServer";
import { notFound, redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { PrintButton } from "@/components/PrintButton";
import { AutoFitText } from "@/components/AutoFitText";

export default async function ServiceAgreementPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) redirect("/login");

  const resolvedParams = await params;
  const clientId = resolvedParams.id;
  const serviceMode = resolveServiceModeForClient(clientId);
  const isTypeB = serviceMode === 'type_b';
  const serviceTypeName = isTypeB ? "就労継続支援B型" : "就労継続支援A型";
  
  const client = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM clients WHERE id = ?').get(clientId) as any;
  if (!client) notFound();

  const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any || {};
  const today = new Date();
  const dateStr = `${today.getFullYear()}年${today.getMonth() + 1}月${today.getDate()}日`;

  return (
    <div className="bg-white text-black min-h-screen p-4 sm:p-8 text-sm" style={{ fontFamily: 'serif' }}>
      <style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{__html: `
        @media print {
          @page {
            size: A4 portrait;
            margin: 15mm 15mm 15mm 15mm;
          }
          html, body {
            margin: 0 !important;
            padding: 0 !important;
            height: 100% !important;
            background: white !important;
            color: black !important;
            -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
            print-color-adjust: exact;
          }
          .service-agreement-print {
            height: 265mm !important;
            max-height: 265mm !important;
            display: flex !important;
            flex-direction: column !important;
            justify-content: space-between !important;
            border: none !important;
            box-shadow: none !important;
            padding: 0 !important;
            margin: 0 !important;
            overflow: hidden !important;
            page-break-after: avoid !important;
            break-after: avoid !important;
            page-break-inside: avoid !important;
            break-inside: avoid !important;
          }
        }
      `}} />

      <div className="service-agreement-print max-w-[210mm] mx-auto bg-white flex flex-col justify-between min-h-[260mm] print:min-h-0">
        
        <div className="shrink-0">
          <div className="flex justify-end mb-4 print:hidden">
            <PrintButton className="px-4 py-2 bg-blue-600 text-white rounded font-bold" label="印刷する" />
          </div>

          <div className="text-center mb-8">
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold border-b border-black inline-block pb-1 tracking-widest">
              {serviceTypeName} 利用契約書
            </h1>
          </div>

          <div className="text-right mb-6 text-xs">
            契約日：　令和　　年　　月　　日
          </div>

          <div className="mb-6 space-y-4 text-xs leading-relaxed">
            <p>
              事業者（以下「甲」という。）と、利用者（以下「乙」という。）は、指定{serviceTypeName}の利用に関する契約を、以下のとおり締結します。
            </p>
            <p>
              本契約の成立を証するため、本書を2通作成し、甲、乙（及び代理人・立会人）署名押印の上、各1通を保有するものとします。
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="my-8 space-y-8 shrink-0 text-xs">
          <div className="flex gap-4 border p-4 rounded">
            <div className="w-24 font-bold shrink-0">【甲】事業者</div>
            <div className="flex-1 space-y-2">
              <div className="h-5 flex items-center overflow-hidden">
                <span className="shrink-0 mr-1">法人名：</span>
                <div className="flex-1 overflow-hidden h-full">
                  <AutoFitText text={facility.corporation_name} defaultText="法人名" maxFontSize={10} minFontSize={7} className="font-bold" />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="h-5 flex items-center overflow-hidden">
                <span className="shrink-0 mr-1">事業所名：</span>
                <div className="flex-1 overflow-hidden h-full">
                  <AutoFitText text={facility.facility_name} defaultText={`${serviceTypeName}事業所`} maxFontSize={10} minFontSize={7} className="font-bold" />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="h-5 flex items-center overflow-hidden">
                <span className="shrink-0 mr-1">所在地：</span>
                <div className="flex-1 overflow-hidden h-full">
                  <AutoFitText text={`〒${facility.postal_code || ''} ${facility.address || ''}`} maxFontSize={9} minFontSize={6} />
                </div>
              </div>
              <p className="mt-2">代表者氏名： {facility.manager_name || '管理者'} 　　印</p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex gap-4 border p-4 rounded">
            <div className="w-24 font-bold shrink-0">【乙】利用者</div>
            <div className="flex-1 space-y-3">
              <div className="h-5 flex items-center overflow-hidden">
                <span className="shrink-0 mr-1">住所：</span>
                <div className="flex-1 overflow-hidden h-full">
                  <AutoFitText text={client.address || '_____________________________________________________'} maxFontSize={9} minFontSize={6} />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="h-6 flex items-center overflow-hidden">

        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
