'use client';

import { useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Printer, Plus, Save, Sparkles, CheckCircle2, UserCheck, ShieldCheck, HelpCircle, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { saveAssessment, deleteAssessment } from "../actions";
import { toast } from "sonner";

// ユーザー指定の法令・実地指導基準に準拠した【記入例】
export const ASSESSMENT_EXAMPLES = {
  user_wishes: "本人は将来的に一般企業（事務職の補助業務）へのステップアップを強く希望している。まずはA型事業所での規則正しい勤務を通じて生活リズムを安定させ、週20時間の勤務とPCスキル（Excel・Word）の正確性を高めたい意図がある。",
  health_and_life: "うつ病による睡眠障害があり、朝方に倦怠感が残ることがあるが、服薬コントロールにより週5日（1日4時間）の通所は可能である。自己管理による通院は月1回で安定している。",
  working_capabilities: "指示書を見ながらの手作業や、手順の決まったデータ入力は正確かつ迅速に対応できる。一方で、複数の作業を同時に並行して行うことや、急な予定変更には混乱が生じやすいため、単一業務の割り当てが望ましい。",
  communication_skills: "挨拶や業務上の報告・連絡・相談は丁寧に行うことができる。ただし、分からないことを自分から質問することに遠慮が見られるため、支援員側から定期的な声かけが必要である。",
  current_challenges: "疲労の蓄積に自覚が遅れやすいため、無理をせず適宜休息を取るセルフモニタリングの習慣化が今後の課題である。",
  support_policy_instructions: "口頭のみの指示ではなく、チェックリストや手順書などの視覚的ツールを併用する。",
  support_policy_consultation: "週1回の定期面談をサビ管または担当支援員が実施し、業務の進捗や体調の不安をヒアリングする。",
  support_policy_environment: "集中が切れたり疲労を感じた際は、静かな休憩スペースで10分間の休息を取ることを認める。",
  operational_notes: "体調悪化の予兆（欠勤や遅刻の増加、表情の暗さ）が見られた場合は速やかに医療機関や相談支援機関と連携する。"
};

export function AssessmentTab({ clientId, assessments, clientName, isTypeB = false }: any) {
  // If no assessments, start with an empty draft. Otherwise pick the first one.
  const [activeAssessment, setActiveAssessment] = useState<any>(
    assessments?.[0] || {
      id: "new",
      client_id: clientId,
      assessment_date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      assessor_name: "",
      user_wishes: "",
      client_hopes: "",
      health_and_life: "",
      working_capabilities: "",
      communication_skills: "",
      current_challenges: "",
      support_policy_instructions: "",
      support_policy_consultation: "",
      support_policy_environment: "",
      operational_notes: "",
      consent_date: "",
      notes: ""
    }
  );
  const router = useRouter();
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);

  const handleCreateNew = () => {
    setActiveAssessment({
      id: "new",
      client_id: clientId,
      assessment_date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      assessor_name: "",
      user_wishes: "",
      client_hopes: "",
      health_and_life: "",
      working_capabilities: "",
      communication_skills: "",
      current_challenges: "",
      support_policy_instructions: "",
      support_policy_consultation: "",
      support_policy_environment: "",
      operational_notes: "",
      consent_date: "",
      notes: ""
    });
  };

  const handleSetFieldExample = (field: keyof typeof ASSESSMENT_EXAMPLES) => {
    const example = ASSESSMENT_EXAMPLES[field];
    if (field === 'user_wishes') {
      setActiveAssessment((prev: any) => ({
        ...prev,
        user_wishes: example,
        client_hopes: example
      }));
    } else {
      setActiveAssessment((prev: any) => ({
        ...prev,
        [field]: example
      }));
    }
  };

  const handleApplyAllExamples = () => {
    if (window.confirm("すべての項目に標準的な【記入例】をセットしますか？（すでに入力されている内容は上書きされます）")) {
      setActiveAssessment((prev: any) => ({
        ...prev,
        user_wishes: ASSESSMENT_EXAMPLES.user_wishes,
        client_hopes: ASSESSMENT_EXAMPLES.user_wishes,
        health_and_life: ASSESSMENT_EXAMPLES.health_and_life,
        working_capabilities: ASSESSMENT_EXAMPLES.working_capabilities,
        communication_skills: ASSESSMENT_EXAMPLES.communication_skills,
        current_challenges: ASSESSMENT_EXAMPLES.current_challenges,
        support_policy_instructions: ASSESSMENT_EXAMPLES.support_policy_instructions,
        support_policy_consultation: ASSESSMENT_EXAMPLES.support_policy_consultation,
        support_policy_environment: ASSESSMENT_EXAMPLES.support_policy_environment,
        operational_notes: ASSESSMENT_EXAMPLES.operational_notes,
      }));
    }
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await saveAssessment(clientId, activeAssessment);
      if (res && !res.success) {
        toast.error("保存中にエラーが発生しました: " + (res.error || "不明なエラー"));
        setIsSaving(false);
        return;
      }
      if (res?.id) {
        setActiveAssessment((prev: any) => ({ ...prev, id: res.id }));
      }
      toast.success("アセスメントシートを保存しました");
      router.refresh();
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast.error("保存中にエラーが発生しました: " + (e?.message || e));
    }
    setIsSaving(false);
  };

  const handleDelete = async (assessmentId: string) => {
    if (!confirm("このアセスメントシートを削除しますか？\n※削除すると元に戻せません。")) return;
    try {
      await deleteAssessment(clientId, assessmentId);
      toast.success("アセスメントシートを削除しました");
      const remaining = assessments?.filter((a: any) => a.id !== assessmentId) || [];
      if (remaining.length > 0) {
        setActiveAssessment(remaining[0]);
      } else {
        handleCreateNew();
      }
      router.refresh();
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast.error(e?.message || "削除に失敗しました");
    }
  };

  // 表示用の値ヘルパー
  const userWishesVal = activeAssessment.user_wishes || activeAssessment.client_hopes || "";

  return (
    <div className="flex gap-6">
      {/* Sidebar for history (hidden when printing) */}
      <div className="w-64 shrink-0 print:hidden space-y-4 border-r pr-6">
        <Button className="w-full" onClick={handleCreateNew}>
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
          新規アセスメント作成
        </Button>
        
        <div className="space-y-2 mt-4">
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm text-muted-foreground flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>過去のアセスメント履歴</span>
            <span className="text-xs bg-muted px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-normal">{assessments?.length || 0}件</span>
          </h3>
          {(!assessments || assessments.length === 0) && (
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground p-2">履歴なし（新規作成中）</p>
          )}
          {assessments?.map((a: any) => (
            <div 
              key={a.id}
              onClick={() => setActiveAssessment(a)}
              className={`p-3 rounded-md cursor-pointer border transition-colors group relative ${
                activeAssessment.id === a.id ? 'bg-primary/10 border-primary font-medium shadow-sm' : 'hover:bg-muted'
              }`}
            >
              <div className="text-sm font-semibold flex items-center justify-between">
                <span>{a.assessment_date}</span>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                  {a.consent_date && <span className="text-[10px] bg-green-100 text-green-700 px-1 rounded">同意済</span>}
                  <Button
                    variant="ghost"
                    size="sm"
                    className="h-6 w-6 p-0 text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10"
                    onClick={(e) => {
                      e.stopPropagation();
                      handleDelete(a.id);
                    }}
                    title="削除"
                  >
                    <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1 truncate">
                担当: {a.assessor_name || "未指定"}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Form & Printable Document */}
      <div className="flex-1 space-y-6">
        {/* 操作バー */}
        <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-between items-center gap-3 print:hidden bg-card p-4 rounded-lg border shadow-sm">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold tracking-tight">アセスメントシート（{isTypeB ? "就労継続支援B型" : "就労継続支援A型"}）</h2>
              <span className="text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 font-semibold border border-blue-200">
                実地指導・法令準拠
              </span>
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
              就労意向、心身の特性（生活・作業・対人）、支援方針を詳細に評価・記録します。
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={handleApplyAllExamples} className="text-blue-700 border-blue-300 hover:bg-blue-50">
              <Sparkles className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1 text-blue-600" />
              一括で記入例を反映
            </Button>
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => window.print()}>
              <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />
              印刷 / PDF出力
            </Button>
            {activeAssessment.id !== "new" && (
              <Button 
                variant="outline" 
                size="sm" 
                onClick={() => handleDelete(activeAssessment.id)} 
                className="text-destructive border-destructive/30 hover:bg-destructive/10"
              >
                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />
                削除
              </Button>
            )}
            <Button size="sm" onClick={handleSave} disabled={isSaving} className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white">
              <Save className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />
              {isSaving ? "保存中..." : "保存する"}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 印刷・画面表示コンテナ */}
        <div className="print-area space-y-6 bg-white print:p-0">
          {/* 印刷用ヘッダー（A4帳票） */}
          <div className="hidden print:block text-center border-b pb-4 mb-6">
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-wider">アセスメントシート（課題分析票）</h1>
            <div className="flex justify-between items-center text-sm mt-3 px-2">
              <span>{isTypeB ? "就労継続支援B型事業所" : "就労継続支援A型事業所"}</span>
              <span className="text-base font-semibold">利用者氏名: {clientName} 様</span>
              <span>作成日: {activeAssessment.assessment_date || "令和　年　月　日"}</span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 基本ヘッダー情報（実施日・担当者・同意日） */}
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 p-4 rounded-lg bg-slate-50 border print:bg-transparent print:border-black print:p-2 print:grid-cols-3 text-sm">
            <div>
              <Label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 print:text-black">アセスメント実施日</Label>
              <Input 
                type="date" 
                className="mt-1 h-9 bg-white print:border-none print:p-0 print:h-auto"
                value={activeAssessment.assessment_date || ""} 
                onChange={(e) => setActiveAssessment({...activeAssessment, assessment_date: e.target.value})} 
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <Label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-700 print:text-black">作成者 / 担当者氏名</Label>
              <Input 
                type="text" 
                placeholder="例: 山田 太郎（サービス管理責任者）"
                className="mt-1 h-9 bg-white print:border-none print:p-0 print:h-auto"
                value={activeAssessment.assessor_name || ""} 
                onChange={(e) => setActiveAssessment({...activeAssessment, assessor_name: e.target.value})} 
              />
            </div>
            <div>
              <Label className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-800 print:text-black flex items-center gap-1">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 print:hidden text-emerald-600" />
                本人・代理人 同意日
              </Label>
              <Input 
                type="date" 
                className="mt-1 h-9 bg-white border-emerald-300 print:border-none print:p-0 print:h-auto"
                value={activeAssessment.consent_date || ""} 
                onChange={(e) => setActiveAssessment({...activeAssessment, consent_date: e.target.value})} 
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 1. 本人の希望・就労に対する意向 */}
          <Card className="print:border-black print:shadow-none">
            <CardHeader className="py-3 px-4 bg-slate-100/70 border-b print:bg-transparent print:py-2">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                <div>
                  <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold text-slate-800 print:text-black">
                    1. 本人の希望・就労に対する意向
                  </CardTitle>
                  <CardDescription className="text-xs print:hidden">
                    将来のステップアップ、希望する職種・勤務時間、身につけたいスキル等
                  </CardDescription>
                </div>
                <Button 
                  type="button" 
                  variant="ghost" 
                  size="sm" 
                  className="text-xs text-blue-600 h-7 print:hidden hover:bg-blue-50"
                  onClick={() => handleSetFieldExample('user_wishes')}
                >
                  <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
                  記入例をセット
                </Button>
              </div>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="p-4 print:p-2">
              <Textarea 
                className="min-h-[90px] text-sm print:border-none print:p-0 print:resize-none"
                value={userWishesVal} 
                onChange={(e) => setActiveAssessment({
                  ...activeAssessment, 
                  user_wishes: e.target.value,
                  client_hopes: e.target.value
                })} 
                placeholder={`【記入例】\n${ASSESSMENT_EXAMPLES.user_wishes}`}
              />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          {/* 2. 現在の状況・心身の特性（アセスメントの核心） */}
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="border-l-4 border-blue-600 pl-3">
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 print:text-black">
                2. 現在の状況・心身の特性（アセスメントの核心）
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground print:hidden">
                生活リズム、作業遂行力、対人関係など、就労継続および支援計画の基盤となる客観的状況
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* 基本的生活・体調面 */}
            <Card className="print:border-black print:shadow-none">
              <CardHeader className="py-2.5 px-4 bg-slate-50 border-b print:bg-transparent print:py-1">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <div className="font-semibold text-sm text-slate-800 print:text-black flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-blue-500 print:hidden" />
                    基本的生活・体調面
                  </div>
                  <Button 
                    type="button" 
                    variant="ghost" 
                    size="sm" 
                    className="text-xs text-blue-600 h-6 print:hidden hover:bg-blue-50"
                    onClick={() => handleSetFieldExample('health_and_life')}
                  >
                    <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
                    記入例をセット
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="p-4 print:p-2">
                <Textarea 
                  className="min-h-[80px] text-sm print:border-none print:p-0 print:resize-none"
                  value={activeAssessment.health_and_life || ""} 
                  onChange={(e) => setActiveAssessment({...activeAssessment, health_and_life: e.target.value})} 
                  placeholder={`【記入例】\n${ASSESSMENT_EXAMPLES.health_and_life}`}
                />
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            {/* 作業遂行能力 */}
            <Card className="print:border-black print:shadow-none">
              <CardHeader className="py-2.5 px-4 bg-slate-50 border-b print:bg-transparent print:py-1">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <div className="font-semibold text-sm text-slate-800 print:text-black flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-blue-500 print:hidden" />
                    作業遂行能力
                  </div>
                  <Button 
                    type="button" 
                    variant="ghost" 
                    size="sm" 
                    className="text-xs text-blue-600 h-6 print:hidden hover:bg-blue-50"
                    onClick={() => handleSetFieldExample('working_capabilities')}
                  >
                    <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
                    記入例をセット
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="p-4 print:p-2">
                <Textarea 
                  className="min-h-[80px] text-sm print:border-none print:p-0 print:resize-none"
                  value={activeAssessment.working_capabilities || ""} 
                  onChange={(e) => setActiveAssessment({...activeAssessment, working_capabilities: e.target.value})} 
                  placeholder={`【記入例】\n${ASSESSMENT_EXAMPLES.working_capabilities}`}
                />
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            {/* 対人関係・コミュニケーション */}
            <Card className="print:border-black print:shadow-none">
              <CardHeader className="py-2.5 px-4 bg-slate-50 border-b print:bg-transparent print:py-1">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <div className="font-semibold text-sm text-slate-800 print:text-black flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-blue-500 print:hidden" />
                    対人関係・コミュニケーション
                  </div>
                  <Button 
                    type="button" 
                    variant="ghost" 
                    size="sm" 
                    className="text-xs text-blue-600 h-6 print:hidden hover:bg-blue-50"
                    onClick={() => handleSetFieldExample('communication_skills')}
                  >
                    <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
                    記入例をセット
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="p-4 print:p-2">
                <Textarea 
                  className="min-h-[80px] text-sm print:border-none print:p-0 print:resize-none"
                  value={activeAssessment.communication_skills || ""} 
                  onChange={(e) => setActiveAssessment({...activeAssessment, communication_skills: e.target.value})} 
                  placeholder={`【記入例】\n${ASSESSMENT_EXAMPLES.communication_skills}`}
                />
              </CardContent>
            </Card>

            {/* 現在の課題・生活上の留意点 */}
            <Card className="print:border-black print:shadow-none">
              <CardHeader className="py-2.5 px-4 bg-slate-50 border-b print:bg-transparent print:py-1">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <div className="font-semibold text-sm text-slate-800 print:text-black flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full bg-amber-500 print:hidden" />
                    現在の課題・留意点
                  </div>
                  <Button 
                    type="button" 
                    variant="ghost" 
                    size="sm" 
                    className="text-xs text-blue-600 h-6 print:hidden hover:bg-blue-50"
                    onClick={() => handleSetFieldExample('current_challenges')}
                  >
                    <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
                    記入例をセット
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="p-4 print:p-2">
                <Textarea 
                  className="min-h-[70px] text-sm print:border-none print:p-0 print:resize-none"
                  value={activeAssessment.current_challenges || ""} 
                  onChange={(e) => setActiveAssessment({...activeAssessment, current_challenges: e.target.value})} 
                  placeholder={`【記入例】\n${ASSESSMENT_EXAMPLES.current_challenges}`}
                />
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </div>

          {/* 3. 就労継続に向けた支援方針・配慮事項 */}
          <div className="space-y-4">
            <div className="border-l-4 border-emerald-600 pl-3">
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 print:text-black">
                3. 就労継続に向けた支援方針・配慮事項
              </h3>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground print:hidden">
                個別支援計画書の原案作成に直結する、具体的かつ実効性のある合理的配慮と支援体制
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4 print:grid-cols-3">
              {/* 作業指示の工夫 */}
              <Card className="print:border-black print:shadow-none">
                <CardHeader className="py-2 px-3 bg-slate-50 border-b print:bg-transparent print:py-1">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-xs text-slate-800 print:text-black">作業指示の工夫</span>
                    <Button 
                      type="button" 
                      variant="ghost" 
                      size="sm" 
                      className="text-[11px] text-blue-600 h-5 px-1 print:hidden hover:bg-blue-50"
                      onClick={() => handleSetFieldExample('support_policy_instructions')}
                    >
                      記入例
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent className="p-3 print:p-1.5">
                  <Textarea 
                    className="min-h-[80px] text-xs print:border-none print:p-0 print:resize-none"
                    value={activeAssessment.support_policy_instructions || ""} 
                    onChange={(e) => setActiveAssessment({...activeAssessment, support_policy_instructions: e.target.value})} 
                    placeholder={`【記入例】\n${ASSESSMENT_EXAMPLES.support_policy_instructions}`}
                  />
                </CardContent>
              </Card>

              {/* 相談体制 */}
              <Card className="print:border-black print:shadow-none">
                <CardHeader className="py-2 px-3 bg-slate-50 border-b print:bg-transparent print:py-1">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-xs text-slate-800 print:text-black">相談体制</span>
                    <Button 
                      type="button" 
                      variant="ghost" 
                      size="sm" 
                      className="text-[11px] text-blue-600 h-5 px-1 print:hidden hover:bg-blue-50"
                      onClick={() => handleSetFieldExample('support_policy_consultation')}
                    >
                      記入例
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent className="p-3 print:p-1.5">
                  <Textarea 
                    className="min-h-[80px] text-xs print:border-none print:p-0 print:resize-none"
                    value={activeAssessment.support_policy_consultation || ""} 
                    onChange={(e) => setActiveAssessment({...activeAssessment, support_policy_consultation: e.target.value})} 
                    placeholder={`【記入例】\n${ASSESSMENT_EXAMPLES.support_policy_consultation}`}
                  />
                </CardContent>
              </Card>

              {/* 環境の配慮 */}
              <Card className="print:border-black print:shadow-none">
                <CardHeader className="py-2 px-3 bg-slate-50 border-b print:bg-transparent print:py-1">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-xs text-slate-800 print:text-black">環境の配慮</span>
                    <Button 
                      type="button" 
                      variant="ghost" 
                      size="sm" 
                      className="text-[11px] text-blue-600 h-5 px-1 print:hidden hover:bg-blue-50"
                      onClick={() => handleSetFieldExample('support_policy_environment')}
                    >
                      記入例
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent className="p-3 print:p-1.5">
                  <Textarea 
                    className="min-h-[80px] text-xs print:border-none print:p-0 print:resize-none"
                    value={activeAssessment.support_policy_environment || ""} 
                    onChange={(e) => setActiveAssessment({...activeAssessment, support_policy_environment: e.target.value})} 
                    placeholder={`【記入例】\n${ASSESSMENT_EXAMPLES.support_policy_environment}`}
                  />
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            </div>

            {/* 運用上の留意点 */}
            <Card className="print:border-black print:shadow-none">
              <CardHeader className="py-2 px-4 bg-slate-50 border-b print:bg-transparent print:py-1">
                <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-xs text-slate-800 print:text-black">運用上の留意点・特記事項</span>
                  <Button 
                    type="button" 
                    variant="ghost" 
                    size="sm" 
                    className="text-xs text-blue-600 h-6 print:hidden hover:bg-blue-50"
                    onClick={() => handleSetFieldExample('operational_notes')}
                  >
                    <Sparkles className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" />
                    記入例をセット
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="p-4 print:p-2">
                <Textarea 
                  className="min-h-[70px] text-sm print:border-none print:p-0 print:resize-none"
                  value={activeAssessment.operational_notes || ""} 
                  onChange={(e) => setActiveAssessment({...activeAssessment, operational_notes: e.target.value})} 
                  placeholder={`【記入例】\n${ASSESSMENT_EXAMPLES.operational_notes}`}
                />
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          </div>

          {/* 印刷用の公式署名・押印欄（実地指導・法令要件準拠） */}
          <div className="hidden print:block mt-8 pt-4 border-t-2 border-black space-y-4">
            <div className="text-xs leading-relaxed text-slate-700">
              上記のアセスメント内容に基づき、利用者の意向及び心身の状況を踏まえた就労継続支援A型の支援方針について説明を行いました。
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-8 text-sm">
              <div className="border border-black p-3 space-y-3">
                <div className="text-xs font-bold border-b border-black pb-1">事業所側（説明・作成者）</div>
                <div>説明日：　　　　年　　月　　日</div>
                <div className="flex justify-between items-end pt-2">
                  <span>管理者氏名：　　　　　　　　</span>
                  <span className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full border border-black flex items-center justify-center text-[10px]">印</span>
                </div>
                <div className="flex justify-between items-end pt-2">
                  <span>サービス管理責任者：　　　　</span>
                  <span className="w-8 h-8 rounded-full border border-black flex items-center justify-center text-[10px]">印</span>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="border border-black p-3 space-y-3">
                <div className="text-xs font-bold border-b border-black pb-1">利用者確認（同意・署名）</div>
                <div>同意日：　　　　年　　月　　日</div>
                <div className="pt-6">
                  署名（本人または代理人）：
                </div>
                <div className="text-[10px] text-slate-600 pt-2">
                  ※上記内容に相違がないことを確認し、支援方針に同意します。
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


================================================================================

'use client';

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { 
  FileWarning, CalendarX, MessageSquare, Printer, FileText, Search, 
  Clock, HeartPulse, User, MapPin, CheckCircle2 
} from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export function DailyRecordsTab({ clientId, dailyRecords = [], supportRecords = [], clientName }: any) {
  const [activeSubTab, setActiveSubTab] = useState<'support' | 'incidents'>('support');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState('');
  const [selectedMonth, setSelectedMonth] = useState<string>('all');

  // 利用可能な年月リストを抽出（ユニーク降順）
  const availableMonths = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    for (const r of supportRecords) {
      if (r.record_date) set.add(r.record_date.slice(0, 7));
    }
    for (const r of dailyRecords) {
      if (r.date) set.add(r.date.slice(0, 7));
    }
    return Array.from(set).sort().reverse();
  }, [supportRecords, dailyRecords]);

  // フィルタリングされた日次支援記録
  const filteredSupportRecords = useMemo(() => {
    return supportRecords.filter((r: any) => {
      const matchesMonth = selectedMonth === 'all' || (r.record_date && r.record_date.startsWith(selectedMonth));
      const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      const matchesSearch = !query || 
        (r.task_content && r.task_content.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
        (r.staff_comment && r.staff_comment.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
        (r.staff_full_name && r.staff_full_name.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
        (r.record_date && r.record_date.includes(query));
      return matchesMonth && matchesSearch;
    });
  }, [supportRecords, selectedMonth, searchQuery]);

  // フィルタリングされた日常突発記録（ヒヤリハット、欠席、面談）
  const filteredDailyRecords = useMemo(() => {
    return dailyRecords.filter((r: any) => {
      const matchesMonth = selectedMonth === 'all' || (r.date && r.date.startsWith(selectedMonth));
      const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      const matchesSearch = !query ||
        (r.situation && r.situation.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
        (r.response_details && r.response_details.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
        (r.notes && r.notes.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
        (r.topic && r.topic.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
        (r.date && r.date.includes(query));
      return matchesMonth && matchesSearch;
    });
  }, [dailyRecords, selectedMonth, searchQuery]);

  const getIcon = (type: string) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'incident': return <FileWarning className="w-5 h-5 text-red-500" />;
      case 'absence': return <CalendarX className="w-5 h-5 text-amber-500" />;
      case 'interview': return <MessageSquare className="w-5 h-5 text-blue-500" />;
      default: return <FileText className="w-5 h-5 text-gray-500" />;
    }
  };

  const getTypeName = (type: string) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'incident': return "ヒヤリハット・事故報告";
      case 'absence': return "欠席時対応加算 記録";
      case 'interview': return "面談記録";
      default: return "記録";
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* 上部ヘッダー */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4 bg-muted/20 p-4 rounded-lg border print:hidden">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
            <FileText className="w-6 h-6 text-primary" />
            日次支援記録・日常記録カルテ
          </h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">
            {clientName} 様の日々の作業支援記録（全 {supportRecords.length} 件）および事故・面談・欠席対応履歴です。実地指導時の日常支援提供エビデンスとしてご活用いただけます。
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => window.print()} className="gap-1 font-bold">
            <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
            表示中の記録を印刷
          </Button>
          <Link href={`/support-records?clientId=${clientId}`} className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline" }), "font-bold text-primary")}>
            支援記録を追加 →
          </Link>
          <Link href={`/clients/${clientId}/documents/new-incident`} className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "destructive", size: "sm" }))}>
            <FileWarning className="w-4 h-4 mr-1" />
            ヒヤリハット
          </Link>
          <Link href={`/clients/${clientId}/documents/new-interview`} className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm" }))}>
            <MessageSquare className="w-4 h-4 mr-1 text-blue-600" />
            面談記録
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 絞り込み & サブタブ切り替え */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-4 items-center justify-between bg-card p-4 rounded-lg border shadow-sm print:hidden">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto">
          <Button 
            variant={activeSubTab === 'support' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            onClick={() => setActiveSubTab('support')}
            className="gap-2 font-bold"
          >
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4" />
            日次支援記録 ({filteredSupportRecords.length}/{supportRecords.length}件)
          </Button>
          <Button 
            variant={activeSubTab === 'incidents' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            onClick={() => setActiveSubTab('incidents')}
            className="gap-2 font-bold"
          >
            <FileWarning className="w-4 h-4" />
            事故・欠席・面談 ({filteredDailyRecords.length}/{dailyRecords.length}件)
          </Button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 w-full sm:w-auto">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
            <label htmlFor="monthSelect" className="text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground">年月:</label>
            <select
              id="monthSelect"
              value={selectedMonth}
              onChange={e => setSelectedMonth(e.target.value)}
              className="h-9 rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring"
            >
              <option value="all">全期間 ({availableMonths.length}ヶ月分)</option>
              {availableMonths.map(m => (
                <option key={m} value={m}>{m.replace('-', '年')}月</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="relative flex-1 sm:w-64">
            <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
            <Input
              placeholder="作業内容・コメント等で検索..."
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={e => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              className="h-9 pl-8 text-xs bg-background"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* サブタブ1: 日次支援記録一覧（作業内容・バイタル・支援員コメント） */}
      {activeSubTab === 'support' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center px-1">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">
              {selectedMonth === 'all' ? '全期間の支援記録一覧' : `${selectedMonth.replace('-', '年')}月の支援記録一覧`}
            </h3>
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">該当件数: {filteredSupportRecords.length} 件</span>
          </div>

          {filteredSupportRecords.length === 0 ? (
            <Card className="p-12 text-center text-muted-foreground">
              指定された条件に該当する日次支援記録はありません。
            </Card>
          ) : (
            <div className="grid gap-3">
              {filteredSupportRecords.map((record: any) => (
                <Card key={record.id} className="hover:shadow-md transition-shadow border-l-4 border-l-primary/70">
                  <CardContent className="p-5 space-y-3">
                    <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between sm:items-center gap-2 border-b pb-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                        <span className="text-base font-bold bg-primary/10 text-primary px-2.5 py-1 rounded">
                          {record.record_date}
                        </span>
                        {(record.service_start_time || record.service_end_time) && (
                          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1 font-medium">
                            <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            {record.service_start_time || '??:??'} 〜 {record.service_end_time || '??:??'}
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {record.service_location && (
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[11px] gap-1 bg-muted/40">
                            <MapPin className="w-3 h-3 text-muted-foreground" />
                            {record.service_location}
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground">
                        <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-primary" />
                        <span>担当支援員: {record.staff_full_name || record.staff_name || '指導員'}</span>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 text-sm">
                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground block">作業内容・訓練支援:</span>
                        <p className="bg-muted/30 p-2.5 rounded text-foreground whitespace-pre-wrap font-medium">
                          {record.task_content || '作業記録なし'}
                        </p>
                      </div>

                      <div className="space-y-1">
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">
                          <HeartPulse className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-rose-500" />
                          バイタル・健康状態:
                        </span>
                        <p className="bg-muted/30 p-2.5 rounded text-foreground whitespace-pre-wrap font-medium">
                          {record.vitals || '特変なし'}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>

                    {record.staff_comment && (
                      <div className="space-y-1 pt-1">
                        <span className="text-xs font-bold text-primary block">指導員・支援員コメント（実地指導評価対象）:</span>
                        <p className="bg-primary/5 border border-primary/15 p-3 rounded text-sm text-foreground whitespace-pre-wrap">
                          {record.staff_comment}
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* サブタブ2: 事故・ヒヤリハット・欠席対応・面談記録 */}
      {activeSubTab === 'incidents' && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center px-1">
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">
              {selectedMonth === 'all' ? '全期間の事故・欠席・面談記録一覧' : `${selectedMonth.replace('-', '年')}月の記録一覧`}
            </h3>
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">該当件数: {filteredDailyRecords.length} 件</span>
          </div>

          {filteredDailyRecords.length === 0 ? (
            <Card className="p-12 text-center text-muted-foreground">
              指定された条件に該当する事故・欠席・面談記録はありません。
            </Card>
          ) : (
            <div className="grid gap-3">
              {filteredDailyRecords.map((record: any) => (
                <Card key={`${record.type}-${record.id}`} className="hover:shadow-md transition-shadow relative overflow-hidden">
                  <div className={cn(
                    "absolute left-0 top-0 bottom-0 w-1.5",
                    record.type === 'incident' ? "bg-red-500" :
                    record.type === 'absence' ? "bg-amber-500" : "bg-blue-500"
                  )} />
                  <CardContent className="p-6 flex items-start gap-4">
                    <div className="mt-1 bg-gray-100 p-3 rounded-full shrink-0">
                      {getIcon(record.type)}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex-1 space-y-2">
                      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between sm:items-center gap-2">
                        <h4 className="text-lg font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
                          <span>{getTypeName(record.type)}</span>
                          {record.type === 'incident' && record.location && (
                            <span className="text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">発生場所: {record.location}</span>
                          )}
                          {record.type === 'absence' && record.contact_person && (
                            <span className="text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">連絡者: {record.contact_person}</span>
                          )}
                        </h4>
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-4 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                          <span className="font-bold bg-muted px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-xs">
                            {record.date} {record.incident_time && ` ${record.incident_time}`}
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </div>
                      
                      <div className="bg-muted/30 p-4 rounded-md text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap mt-2">
                        {record.type === 'incident' && (
                          <div className="space-y-1">
                            <p><strong>状況:</strong> {record.situation}</p>
                            {record.cause && <p><strong>原因:</strong> {record.cause}</p>}
                            {record.preventive_action && <p><strong>再発防止策:</strong> {record.preventive_action}</p>}
                          </div>
                        )}
                        {record.type === 'absence' && (
                          <div className="space-y-1">
                            <p><strong>理由:</strong> {record.reason || '体調不良等'}</p>
                            <p><strong>対応内容:</strong> {record.response_details}</p>
                          </div>
                        )}
                        {record.type === 'interview' && (
                          <div>
                            <p className="font-bold border-b pb-1 mb-2">{record.topic}</p>
                            <p>{record.notes}</p>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Upload, File, Image as ImageIcon, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { format } from "date-fns";
import { ja } from "date-fns/locale";

export function FilesTab({ clientId }: { clientId: string }) {
  const [documents, setDocuments] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [uploading, setUploading] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchDocuments();
  }, [clientId]);

  const fetchDocuments = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/clients/${clientId}/documents`);
      const data = await res.json();
      if (data.success) {
        setDocuments(data.documents);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error("ファイルの取得に失敗しました");
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleFileUpload = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    const file = e.target.files?.[0];
    if (!file) return;

    // Check file size (e.g., limit to 10MB)
    if (file.size > 10 * 1024 * 1024) {
      toast.error("10MB以下のファイルを選択してください");
      return;
    }

    setUploading(true);
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append("file", file);

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/clients/${clientId}/documents`, {
        method: "POST",
        body: formData,
      });

      if (res.ok) {
        toast.success("ファイルをアップロードしました");
        fetchDocuments();
      } else {
        toast.error("アップロードに失敗しました");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error("アップロード中にエラーが発生しました");
    } finally {
      setUploading(false);
      e.target.value = ''; // Reset input
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (docId: string) => {
    if (!confirm("本当にこのファイルを削除しますか？")) return;

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/documents/${docId}`, {
        method: "DELETE",
      });

      if (res.ok) {
        toast.success("ファイルを削除しました");
        fetchDocuments();
      } else {
        toast.error("削除に失敗しました");
      }
    } catch (err) {
      toast.error("削除中にエラーが発生しました");
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between">
        <CardTitle>添付書類管理</CardTitle>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Input 
            type="file" 
            id="file-upload" 
            className="hidden" 
            onChange={handleFileUpload}
            accept=".pdf,.png,.jpg,.jpeg"
            disabled={uploading}
          />
            <Button variant="outline" className="cursor-pointer" disabled={uploading} type="button" onClick={() => document.getElementById('file-upload')?.click()}>
              <Upload className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
              {uploading ? "送信中..." : "アップロード"}
            </Button>
        </div>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        {loading ? (
          <div className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">読み込み中...</div>
        ) : documents.length === 0 ? (
          <div className="text-center py-12 text-muted-foreground border-2 border-dashed rounded-md">
            ファイルがありません。<br />
            障害福祉サービス受給者証のコピーや履歴書などをアップロードしてください。
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            {documents.map((doc) => {
              const isImage = doc.file_type.startsWith("image/");
              return (
                <div key={doc.id} className="border rounded-md p-4 flex flex-col justify-between group hover:border-primary/50 transition-colors bg-muted/20">
                  <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                    <div className="p-2 bg-background rounded shadow-sm">
                      {isImage ? <ImageIcon className="w-8 h-8 text-blue-500" /> : <File className="w-8 h-8 text-red-500" />}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                      <p className="text-sm font-medium truncate" title={doc.file_name}>{doc.file_name}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                        {format(new Date(doc.uploaded_at), "yyyy年MM月dd日 HH:mm")}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex gap-2 mt-4 pt-4 border-t">
                    <Button 
                      variant="default" 
                      size="sm" 
                      className="flex-1"
                      onClick={() => window.open(`/api/documents/${doc.id}`, '_blank')}
                    >
                      プレビュー
                    </Button>
                    <Button 
                      variant="destructive" 
                      size="icon" 
                      className="shrink-0"
                      onClick={() => handleDelete(doc.id)}
                    >
                      <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        )}
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { 
  MessageSquare, Plus, Printer, Calendar, User, MapPin, 
  Search, CheckCircle2, Clock, FileText, ArrowRight, ShieldCheck,
  Edit, Trash2
} from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { deleteInterview } from "../actions";
import { toast } from "sonner";

export function InterviewTab({ clientId, interviewRecords = [], clientName }: any) {
  const [selectedType, setSelectedType] = useState<string>('all');
  const [selectedMonth, setSelectedMonth] = useState<string>('all');
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState<string>('');

  // 利用可能な年月リスト
  const availableMonths = useMemo(() => {
    const set = new Set<string>();
    for (const r of interviewRecords) {
      if (r.interview_date) set.add(r.interview_date.slice(0, 7));
    }
    return Array.from(set).sort().reverse();
  }, [interviewRecords]);

  // 面談種別ラベル & バッジ色
  const getTypeInfo = (type: string) => {
    switch (type) {
      case 'regular':
        return { label: '定期個別面談', color: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border-blue-200' };
      case 'work':
        return { label: '就労・作業相談', color: 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-200' };
      case 'life':
        return { label: '生活・健康相談', color: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border-amber-200' };
      case 'relationship':
        return { label: '人間関係相談', color: 'bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 border-purple-200' };
      case 'family':
        return { label: 'ご家族相談', color: 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border-rose-200' };
      case 'transition':
        return { label: '一般就労移行相談', color: 'bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800 border-indigo-200' };
      default:
        return { label: '個別面談', color: 'bg-zinc-100 text-zinc-800 border-zinc-200' };
    }
  };

  // フィルタリング
  const filteredInterviews = useMemo(() => {
    return interviewRecords.filter((item: any) => {
      const matchesType = selectedType === 'all' || item.interview_type === selectedType;
      const matchesMonth = selectedMonth === 'all' || (item.interview_date && item.interview_date.startsWith(selectedMonth));
      const query = searchQuery.toLowerCase();
      const matchesQuery = !query ||
        (item.topic && item.topic.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
        (item.client_statement && item.client_statement.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
        (item.staff_response && item.staff_response.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
        (item.interviewer_name && item.interviewer_name.toLowerCase().includes(query)) ||
        (item.interview_date && item.interview_date.includes(query));
      return matchesType && matchesMonth && matchesQuery;
    });
  }, [interviewRecords, selectedType, selectedMonth, searchQuery]);

  // 統計集計
  const stats = useMemo(() => {
    const regular = interviewRecords.filter((r: any) => r.interview_type === 'regular').length;
    const work = interviewRecords.filter((r: any) => r.interview_type === 'work').length;
    const life = interviewRecords.filter((r: any) => r.interview_type === 'life').length;
    const transition = interviewRecords.filter((r: any) => r.interview_type === 'transition').length;
    const latest = interviewRecords[0]?.interview_date || '未実施';
    return { regular, work, life, transition, latest };
  }, [interviewRecords]);

  const handleDelete = async (interviewId: string) => {
    if (!confirm('この面談記録を削除しますか？')) return;
    try {
      await deleteInterview(clientId, interviewId);
      toast.success('面談記録を削除しました');
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast.error(e.message || '削除に失敗しました');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* 上部ヘッダーバー */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4 bg-muted/20 p-4 rounded-lg border print:hidden">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
            <MessageSquare className="w-6 h-6 text-primary" />
            個別面談・相談援助記録台帳
          </h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">
            {clientName} 様の個別面談および相談援助履歴（全 {interviewRecords.length} 件）です。実地指導（指定基準第197条準用第53条の2）における相談援助実施エビデンスとしてご活用いただけます。
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => window.print()} className="gap-1 font-bold">
            <Printer className="w-4 h-4" />
            台帳を印刷
          </Button>
          <Link 
            href={`/clients/${clientId}/documents/new-interview`} 
            className={cn(buttonVariants({ className: "shadow-sm gap-1 font-bold" }))}
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            面談を記録する
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* サマリーカード */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-4 print:hidden">
        <Card className="bg-blue-50/50 border-blue-200">
          <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-bold">定期個別面談</p>
              <p className="text-xl font-black text-blue-950 mt-1">{stats.regular} 回</p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-blue-700 mt-0.5">月次・定期フォロー</p>
            </div>
            <Clock className="h-7 w-7 text-blue-500 shrink-0" />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="bg-emerald-50/50 border-emerald-200">
          <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-bold">就労・作業相談</p>
              <p className="text-xl font-black text-emerald-950 mt-1">{stats.work} 回</p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-emerald-700 mt-0.5">作業向上・施設外</p>
            </div>
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-7 w-7 text-emerald-500 shrink-0" />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="bg-amber-50/50 border-amber-200">
          <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-bold">生活・健康相談</p>
              <p className="text-xl font-black text-amber-950 mt-1">{stats.life} 回</p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-amber-700 mt-0.5">体調・睡眠・服薬</p>
            </div>
            <ShieldCheck className="h-7 w-7 text-amber-500 shrink-0" />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="bg-purple-50/50 border-purple-200">
          <CardContent className="p-4 flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-bold">一般就労移行相談</p>
              <p className="text-xl font-black text-purple-950 mt-1">{stats.transition} 回</p>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-purple-700 mt-0.5">直近面談: {stats.latest}</p>
            </div>
            <ArrowRight className="h-7 w-7 text-purple-500 shrink-0" />
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* 絞り込みバー */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-4 items-center justify-between bg-card p-4 rounded-lg border shadow-sm print:hidden">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
          {['all', 'regular', 'work', 'life', 'transition'].map((t) => (
            <Button
              key={t}
              size="sm"
              variant={selectedType === t ? 'default' : 'outline'}
              onClick={() => setSelectedType(t)}
              className="text-xs font-bold"
            >
              {t === 'all' ? `すべて (${interviewRecords.length})` :
               t === 'regular' ? `定期面談 (${stats.regular})` :
               t === 'work' ? `就労相談 (${stats.work})` :
               t === 'life' ? `生活相談 (${stats.life})` :
               `移行相談 (${stats.transition})`}
            </Button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 w-full sm:w-auto">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
            <label htmlFor="interviewMonth" className="text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground">年月:</label>
            <select
              id="interviewMonth"
              value={selectedMonth}
              onChange={e => setSelectedMonth(e.target.value)}
              className="h-9 rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-1 text-xs shadow-sm focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring"
            >
              <option value="all">全期間 ({availableMonths.length}ヶ月分)</option>
              {availableMonths.map(m => (
                <option key={m} value={m}>{m.replace('-', '年')}月</option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="relative flex-1 sm:w-60">
            <Search className="absolute left-2.5 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
            <Input
              placeholder="相談内容・発言等で検索..."
              value={searchQuery}
              onChange={e => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
              className="h-9 pl-8 text-xs bg-background"
            >
            </Input>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 面談記録一覧 */}
      {filteredInterviews.length === 0 ? (
        <div className="text-center py-16 border-2 border-dashed rounded-xl bg-card">
          <MessageSquare className="w-12 h-12 mx-auto text-muted-foreground/50 mb-3" />
          <p className="font-bold text-base text-foreground">条件に合致する面談記録がありません</p>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">「面談を記録する」ボタンから新しい相談援助記録を作成してください。</p>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          {filteredInterviews.map((item: any) => {
            const typeInfo = getTypeInfo(item.interview_type);
            return (
              <Card key={item.id} className="hover:shadow-md transition-all border-l-4 border-l-primary/70">
                <CardHeader className="pb-3">
                  <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                      <span className="font-bold font-mono text-base flex items-center gap-1">
                        <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                        {item.interview_date}
                      </span>
                      <span className={cn("px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-xs font-bold border", typeInfo.color)}>
                        {typeInfo.label}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">
                        <User className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        担当: {item.interviewer_name || '担当職員'}
                      </span>
                      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1">
                        <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        {item.location || '相談室'}
                      </span>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 print:hidden">
                      <Link
                        href={`/clients/${clientId}/documents/interviews/${item.id}`}
                        className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm" }), "text-xs font-bold gap-1 h-8")}
                      >
                        <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-primary" />
                        A4プレビュー
                      </Link>
                      <Link
                        href={`/clients/${clientId}/documents/interviews/${item.id}/edit`}
                        className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm" }), "text-xs font-bold gap-1 h-8 text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-700")}
                        title="面談記録を編集"
                      >
                        <Edit className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        編集
                      </Link>
                      <Button
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="sm"
                        className="h-8 px-2 text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive"
                        onClick={() => handleDelete(item.id)}
                        title="削除"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <CardTitle className="text-lg mt-2 text-foreground">
                    {item.topic || '個別相談・支援面談'}
                  </CardTitle>
                </CardHeader>

                <CardContent className="space-y-3 pt-0 text-sm">
                  {/* 本人の発言・主訴 */}
                  <div className="bg-muted/30 p-3 rounded-lg border">
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground block mb-1">
                      【相談内容・本人の訴え（主訴）】
                    </span>
                    <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed text-foreground">
                      {item.client_statement || item.notes || '記録なし'}
                    </p>
                  </div>

                  {/* 支援員の助言・指導・対応 */}
                  {item.staff_response && (
                    <div className="bg-blue-50/40 dark:bg-blue-950/20 p-3 rounded-lg border border-blue-100 dark:border-blue-900/50">
                      <span className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-900 dark:text-blue-300 block mb-1">
                        【支援員の助言・指導・具体的対応】
                      </span>
                      <p className="whitespace-pre-wrap leading-relaxed text-blue-950 dark:text-blue-100">
                        {item.staff_response}
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {/* 次回方針・予定 */}
                  {(item.next_action_plan || item.next_interview_date) && (
                    <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 text-xs bg-muted/20 p-2.5 rounded-md text-muted-foreground">
                      {item.next_action_plan && (
                        <div>
                          <span className="font-bold text-foreground mr-1">次回フォロー方針:</span>
                          <span>{item.next_action_plan}</span>
                        </div>
                      )}
                      {item.next_interview_date && (
                        <div className="shrink-0 font-bold text-primary">
                          次回面談予定日: {item.next_interview_date}
                        </div>
                      )}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


================================================================================
File: src/app/clients/[id]/documents/tabs/MonitoringTab.tsx

'use client';

import { useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Printer, Plus, Save, Sparkles, Target, MessageSquare, CheckCircle2, Trash2, BookOpen, ShieldCheck, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { saveMonitoring, deleteMonitoring } from "../actions";
import { generateGroundedMonitoringDraft } from "@/app/plans/actions";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { toast } from "sonner";

export function MonitoringTab({ 
  clientId, 
  monitorings, 
  plans, 
  clientName,
  interviewRecords = [],
  supportRecords = []
}: any) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [activeMonitoring, setActiveMonitoring] = useState(
    monitorings?.[0] || { 
      id: "new", 
      client_id: clientId, 
      monitoring_date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      plan_id: plans?.[0]?.id || "" 
    }
  );
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [isGeneratingGrounded, setIsGeneratingGrounded] = useState(false);
  const [groundedMeta, setGroundedMeta] = useState<{
    period_start: string;
    period_end: string;
    attendance_count: number;
    support_record_count: number;
    cited_record_dates: string[];
    masked_source_preview: string;
  } | null>(null);
  const [showMaskedSource, setShowMaskedSource] = useState(false);

  const handleCreateNew = () => {
    setActiveMonitoring({
      id: "new",
      client_id: clientId,
      monitoring_date: new Date().toISOString().split('T')[0],
      plan_id: plans?.[0]?.id || "",
      evaluation: "",
      next_steps: "",
      consent_date: ""
    });
  };

  const selectedPlan = plans?.find((p: any) => p.id === activeMonitoring.plan_id) || plans?.[0];

  // 過去記録ノート（直近6ヶ月間の支援記録 support_records ＆ 勤怠実績 attendance_records）のみを根拠とした厳格グラウンディング要約
  const handleAutoGenerateSummary = async () => {
    setIsGeneratingGrounded(true);
    try {
      const res = await generateGroundedMonitoringDraft(
        clientId,
        activeMonitoring.plan_id || selectedPlan?.id,
        activeMonitoring.monitoring_date
      );
      if (!res.success || !res.data) {
        toast.error(res.error || "過去記録ノートからの要約生成に失敗しました");
        return;
      }

      const d = res.data;
      const evaluationText = `${d.goal_achievement}\n\n■ 記録された様子・本人の意向（支援記録抜粋）:\n${d.client_feedback}`;
      const nextStepsText = `【次期計画および支援方針（直近6ヶ月実績に基づく見直し事項）】\n${d.next_action_plan}`;

      setActiveMonitoring((prev: any) => ({
        ...prev,
        evaluation: evaluationText,
        next_steps: nextStepsText,
      }));

      setGroundedMeta({
        period_start: d.period_start,
        period_end: d.period_end,
        attendance_count: d.attendance_count,
        support_record_count: d.support_record_count,
        cited_record_dates: d.cited_record_dates || [],
        masked_source_preview: d.masked_source_preview || "",
      });

      toast.success(
        `直近6ヶ月間の勤怠実績（${d.attendance_count}件）・支援記録（${d.support_record_count}件）のみを根拠に要約を生成しました（PIIマスク済）`
      );
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(err?.message || "要約生成中にエラーが発生しました");
    } finally {
      setIsGeneratingGrounded(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await saveMonitoring(clientId, activeMonitoring);
      if (res && !res.success) {
        toast.error(res.error || "保存に失敗しました");
        setIsSaving(false);
        return;
      }
      if (res?.id) {
        setActiveMonitoring((prev: any) => ({ ...prev, id: res.id }));
      }
      toast.success("モニタリングを保存しました");
      router.refresh();
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast.error(e.message || "エラーが発生しました");
    }
    setIsSaving(false);
  };

  const handleDelete = async (monitoringId: string) => {
    if (!confirm("このモニタリング報告書を削除しますか？\n※削除すると元に戻せません。")) return;
    try {
      await deleteMonitoring(clientId, monitoringId);
      toast.success("モニタリング報告書を削除しました");
      const remaining = monitorings?.filter((m: any) => m.id !== monitoringId) || [];
      if (remaining.length > 0) {
        setActiveMonitoring(remaining[0]);
      } else {
        handleCreateNew();
      }
      router.refresh();
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast.error(e?.message || "削除に失敗しました");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex gap-6">
      {/* Sidebar for history */}
      <div className="w-64 shrink-0 print:hidden space-y-4 border-r pr-6">
        <Button className="w-full" onClick={handleCreateNew}>
          <Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
          新規作成
        </Button>
        
        <div className="space-y-2 mt-4">
          <h3 className="font-semibold text-sm text-muted-foreground flex items-center justify-between">
            <span>過去の履歴</span>
            <span className="text-xs bg-muted px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-normal">{monitorings?.length || 0}件</span>
          </h3>
          {(!monitorings || monitorings.length === 0) && (
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground py-2">履歴なし</p>
          )}
          <div className="space-y-1.5 max-h-[500px] overflow-y-auto pr-1">
            {monitorings?.map((m: any) => {
              const isSelected = activeMonitoring.id === m.id;
              const snippet = (m.evaluation || m.next_steps || '').replace(/\n/g, ' ').slice(0, 30);
              return (
                <div 
                  key={m.id}
                  onClick={() => setActiveMonitoring(m)}
                  className={`p-2.5 rounded-md cursor-pointer border text-left transition-colors group relative ${
                    isSelected 
                      ? 'bg-primary/10 border-primary/60 shadow-2xs font-semibold' 
                      : 'hover:bg-muted/70 bg-card'
                  }`}
                >
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                    <span className="font-bold text-foreground">{m.monitoring_date}</span>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                      {isSelected && <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[9px] px-1 py-0 h-4 border-primary text-primary">選択中</Badge>}
                      <Button
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="sm"
                        className="h-5 w-5 p-0 text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10"
                        onClick={(e) => {
                          e.stopPropagation();
                          handleDelete(m.id);
                        }}
                        title="削除"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="w-3 h-3" />
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  {snippet && (
                    <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground truncate mt-1">
                      {snippet}...
                    </p>
                  )}
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Main Form */}
      <div className="flex-1 space-y-6">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-center print:hidden">
          <div>
            <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">モニタリング報告書</h2>
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
              個別支援計画の目標に対する達成状況を評価し、次期計画へ反映します（実地指導 指定基準準拠）。
            </p>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
            <Button 
              type="button" 
              variant="outline" 
              size="sm" 
              disabled={isGeneratingGrounded}
              onClick={handleAutoGenerateSummary}
              className="text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-800 border-indigo-300 bg-indigo-50/80 hover:bg-indigo-100 flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-2xs"
            >
              {isGeneratingGrounded ? (
                <>
                  <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600 animate-spin" />
                  過去6ヶ月記録を照合・要約中...
                </>
              ) : (
                <>
                  <BookOpen className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600" />
                  過去6ヶ月記録ノートから事実限定要約（NotebookLM方式）
                </>
              )}
            </Button>
            <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => window.print()}>
              <Printer className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
              印刷・PDF化
            </Button>
            {activeMonitoring.id !== "new" && (
              <Button 
                variant="outline" 
                size="sm" 
                onClick={() => handleDelete(activeMonitoring.id)}
                className="text-destructive border-destructive/30 hover:bg-destructive/10"
              >
                <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1" />
                削除
              </Button>
            )}
            <Button size="sm" onClick={handleSave} disabled={isSaving} className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white">
              <Save className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
              保存する
            </Button>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 過去記録ノート（Strict Grounding ＆ PIIマスキング検証パネル） */}
        {groundedMeta && (
          <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50/80 border border-emerald-200 rounded-lg text-xs space-y-2 print:hidden">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2">
              <div className="font-bold text-emerald-950 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                過去記録ノート（Strict Grounding）参照結果 — 期間: {groundedMeta.period_start} 〜 {groundedMeta.period_end}
              </div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-white text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300 text-[10px]">
                  勤怠実績: {groundedMeta.attendance_count}件
                </Badge>
                <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-white text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300 text-[10px]">
                  日次支援記録: {groundedMeta.support_record_count}件
                </Badge>
                <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-white text-indigo-800 border-indigo-300 text-[10px]">
                  PIIマスキング済（[利用者A]置換）
                </Badge>
                <Button
                  type="button"
                  variant="ghost"
                  size="sm"
                  className="h-6 px-2 text-[11px] text-emerald-800 hover:bg-emerald-100"
                  onClick={() => setShowMaskedSource(!showMaskedSource)}
                >
                  {showMaskedSource ? "ソース記録を閉じる" : "AIへ渡したPIIマスク済ソースを確認"}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
            {groundedMeta.cited_record_dates.length > 0 && (
              <div className="text-[11px] text-emerald-900">
                <span className="font-semibold">引用・根拠とした記録日: </span>
                {groundedMeta.cited_record_dates.join(" / ")}
              </div>
            )}
            {showMaskedSource && (
              <pre className="p-2.5 bg-slate-900 text-slate-100 rounded text-[11px] max-h-48 overflow-y-auto whitespace-pre-wrap font-mono leading-relaxed">
                {groundedMeta.masked_source_preview}
              </pre>
            )}
          </div>
        )}

        {/* 評価対象計画の目標参照カード（実地指導 目標連動） */}
        {selectedPlan && (
          <div className="p-3 bg-indigo-50/70 border border-indigo-200 rounded-lg text-xs space-y-1.5 print:hidden">
            <div className="font-bold text-indigo-950 flex items-center justify-between">
              <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <Target className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600" />
                評価対象の個別支援計画（{selectedPlan.plan_date || '作成日未登録'}）の策定目標
              </span>
              <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-white text-indigo-800 text-[10px]">
                期間: {selectedPlan.start_date || '未定'} 〜 {selectedPlan.end_date || '未定'}
              </Badge>
            </div>
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-indigo-900 pt-0.5">
              <div className="bg-white/80 p-2 rounded border border-indigo-100">
                <span className="font-semibold text-indigo-700 block mb-0.5">【短期目標】</span>
                {selectedPlan.short_term_goal || '（未設定）'}
              </div>
              <div className="bg-white/80 p-2 rounded border border-indigo-100">
                <span className="font-semibold text-indigo-700 block mb-0.5">【長期目標】</span>
                {selectedPlan.long_term_goal || '（未設定）'}
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="print-area space-y-8">
          <div className="hidden print:block text-center mb-8">
            <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold">モニタリング報告書</h1>
            <p className="text-xl mt-4">氏名: {clientName} 様</p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <Label className="w-32 font-bold text-lg">モニタリング日</Label>
            <Input 
              type="date" 
              className="w-48"
              value={activeMonitoring.monitoring_date || ""} 
              onChange={(e) => setActiveMonitoring({...activeMonitoring, monitoring_date: e.target.value})} 
            />
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
            <Label className="w-32 font-bold text-lg">評価対象の計画</Label>
            <select 
              className="flex h-10 w-full md:w-96 rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2"
              value={activeMonitoring.plan_id || ""}
              onChange={(e) => setActiveMonitoring({...activeMonitoring, plan_id: e.target.value})}
            >
              <option value="">選択してください</option>
              {plans?.map((p: any) => (
                <option key={p.id} value={p.id}>
                  {p.plan_date} 作成の計画
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </div>

          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>1. 支援目標の達成状況・評価</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <Textarea 
                className="min-h-[160px] font-sans text-sm leading-relaxed"
                value={activeMonitoring.evaluation || ""} 
                onChange={(e) => setActiveMonitoring({...activeMonitoring, evaluation: e.target.value})} 
                placeholder="計画で定めた目標に対して、この期間にどのような成果があったか、または課題が残ったかを記載します。"
              />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card>
            <CardHeader>
              <CardTitle>2. 今後の方針・次回計画への反映事項</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent>
              <Textarea 
                className="min-h-[160px] font-sans text-sm leading-relaxed"
                value={activeMonitoring.next_steps || ""} 
                onChange={(e) => setActiveMonitoring({...activeMonitoring, next_steps: e.target.value})}

            <Input

          {/* 印刷用の署名欄 */}
          <div className="hidden print:block mt-16 space-y-8 border-t pt-8">
