'use client';

import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { Award, Briefcase, Calendar, CheckCircle2, FileText, Plus, Printer, Star, Edit, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { deleteOffsiteEvaluation } from "../offsite-evaluations/actions";
import { toast } from "sonner";

interface OffsiteEvaluation {
  id: string;
  client_id: string;
  workplace_id?: string;
  workplace_name?: string;
  company_name?: string;
  contractor_id?: string;
  evaluation_date: string;
  period_start: string;
  period_end: string;
  work_tasks?: string;
  basic_habits_score: number;
  work_performance_score: number;
  interpersonal_score: number;
  safety_score: number;
  readiness_score: number;
  detailed_evaluation?: string;
  strengths_and_growth?: string;
  challenges_and_support?: string;
  plan_reflection?: string;
  evaluator_name?: string;
  supervisor_name?: string;
  feedback_date?: string;
  client_signature?: string;
}

export function OffsiteEvaluationTab({
  clientId,
  evaluations = [],
  clientName
}: {
  clientId: string;
  evaluations: OffsiteEvaluation[];
  clientName: string;
}) {
  const renderScoreStars = (score: number) => {
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center gap-0.5 text-amber-500">
        {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map((star) => (
          <span key={star} className={star <= score ? "text-amber-500 font-bold" : "text-gray-300"}>
            ★
          </span>
        ))}
        <span className="ml-1 text-xs font-mono text-muted-foreground">({score}/5)</span>
      </div>
    );
  };

  const handleDelete = async (evalId: string) => {
    if (!confirm('この施設外就労評価表を削除しますか？')) return;
    try {
      await deleteOffsiteEvaluation(clientId, evalId);
      toast.success('施設外就労評価表を削除しました');
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast.error(e.message || '削除に失敗しました');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4 bg-muted/20 p-4 rounded-lg border print:hidden">
        <div>
          <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
            <Briefcase className="w-6 h-6 text-primary" />
            施設外就労評価表 台帳（厚労省指定基準第191条の2）
          </h2>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-sm mt-1">
            {clientName} 様の企業先施設外就労における作業遂行力、労働習慣、一般就労移行適性の定期評価記録です。実地指導（運営指導）の必須提出台帳です。
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Link
            href={`/clients/${clientId}/documents/offsite-evaluations/new`}
            className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "default" }), "font-bold gap-1")}
          >
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4" />
            新規評価表を作成
          </Link>
        </div>
      </div>

      <Card className="shadow-sm">
        <CardHeader className="bg-primary/5 border-b pb-4">
          <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
            <div>
              <CardTitle className="text-xl">施設外就労評価シート 交付・保管台帳</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription className="mt-1">
                登録件数: {evaluations.length} 件（過去全期間の評価シートが保存されています）
              </CardDescription>
            </div>
            <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              ※ 個別支援計画（Plan）と連動し、評価結果は次期モニタリングおよび計画見直しに反映されます。
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="p-0">
          {evaluations && evaluations.length > 0 ? (
            <Table>
              <TableHeader className="bg-muted/50">
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead className="py-3 w-[110px]">評価作成日</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="py-3 w-[180px]">対象期間</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="py-3">就労先企業 / 作業内容</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="py-3 w-[140px]">作業遂行力</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="py-3 w-[140px]">一般就労適性</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="py-3 w-[130px]">評価者 / サビ管</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="py-3 w-[100px]">本人確認</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="py-3 w-[180px] text-right">操作</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {evaluations.map((ev) => (
                  <TableRow key={ev.id} className="hover:bg-muted/20">
                    <TableCell className="py-3 font-mono font-medium text-sm whitespace-nowrap">
                      {ev.evaluation_date}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="py-3 text-xs font-mono">
                      {ev.period_start} 〜 {ev.period_end}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="py-3">
                      <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-foreground">
                        {ev.company_name || ev.workplace_name || '請負先企業'}
                      </div>
                      <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-1 mt-0.5">
                        {ev.work_tasks}
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="py-3">
                      {renderScoreStars(ev.work_performance_score)}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="py-3">
                      {renderScoreStars(ev.readiness_score)}
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="py-3 text-xs">
                      <div>担: {ev.evaluator_name || '指導員'}</div>
                      <div className="text-muted-foreground">監: {ev.supervisor_name || 'サビ管'}</div>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="py-3">
                      <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border-emerald-300 text-[11px] gap-1">
                        <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-600" />
                        合意済
                      </Badge>
                    </TableCell>
                    <TableCell className="py-3 text-right">
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">

                          className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm" }), "text-xs font-bold gap-1 h-8 px-2")}
                          title="確認・印刷"
                        >
                          <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          <span>印刷</span>
                        </Link>
                        <Link
                          href={`/clients/${clientId}/documents/offsite-evaluations/${ev.id}/edit`}
                          className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm" }), "text-xs font-bold gap-1 h-8 px-2 text-blue-600 hover:text-blue-700")}
                          title="評価表を編集"
                        >
                          <Edit className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                          <span>編集</span>
                        </Link>
                        <Button
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="sm"
                          className="h-8 px-2 text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive"
                          onClick={() => handleDelete(ev.id)}
                          title="削除"
                        >
                          <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                        </Button>
                      </div>
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                ))}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          ) : (
            <div className="p-12 text-center text-muted-foreground space-y-3">
              <Briefcase className="w-10 h-10 text-muted-foreground/50 mx-auto" />
              <p>施設外就労評価表の登録がありません。</p>
              <p className="text-xs">
                施設外就労（企業先請負作業等）に従事された利用者は、定期的に評価表を作成・保管してください。

                評価表を新規作成する

'use client';

import { useState } from "react";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Printer, Save, Plus, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import { saveSelfPlan, deleteSelfPlan } from "../actions";

export function SelfPlanTab({ clientId, selfPlans = [], clientName }: any) {
  const [activePlan, setActivePlan] = useState<any>(selfPlans[0] || null);
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState<any>(activePlan || {
    id: "new",
    creation_date: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
    hopes_and_dreams: "",
    current_challenges: "",
    weekly_schedule: ""
  });
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);

  const handleNew = () => {
    const newPlan = {
      id: "new",
      creation_date: new Date().toISOString().split("T")[0],
      hopes_and_dreams: "",
      current_challenges: "",
      weekly_schedule: ""
    };
    setActivePlan(newPlan);
    setFormData(newPlan);
  };

  const handleChange = (e: any) => {
    setFormData({ ...formData, [e.target.name]: e.target.value });
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await saveSelfPlan(clientId, formData);
      if (res && !res.success) {
        toast.error(res.error || "保存に失敗しました");
        return;
      }
      const wasNew = formData.id === "new";
      if (res?.id) {
        setFormData((prev: any) => ({ ...prev, id: res.id }));
        setActivePlan((prev: any) => prev ? { ...prev, id: res.id } : { ...formData, id: res.id });
      }
      toast.success("セルフプランを保存しました");
      if (wasNew) {
        setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 1000);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(err?.message || "保存に失敗しました");
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!activePlan || activePlan.id === "new") return;
    if (!confirm("このセルフプランを削除しますか？\n※削除すると元に戻せません。")) return;
    try {
      const res = await deleteSelfPlan(clientId, activePlan.id);
      if (res && !res.success) {
        toast.error(res.error || "削除に失敗しました");
        return;
      }
      toast.success("セルフプランを削除しました");
      setTimeout(() => window.location.reload(), 500);
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(err?.message || "削除に失敗しました");
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card>
      <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between">
        <div>
          <CardTitle>セルフプラン（サービス等利用計画案）</CardTitle>
          <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground mt-1">
            利用者が自ら作成する計画案です。AIアセスメントや個別支援計画のベースになります。
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex gap-2 print:hidden">
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={handleNew}>
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
            新規作成
          </Button>
          <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => window.print()} disabled={!activePlan || activePlan.id === "new"}>
            <Printer className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
            印刷
          </Button>
          {activePlan && activePlan.id !== "new" && (
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={handleDelete} className="text-destructive border-destructive/30 hover:bg-destructive/10">
              <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
              削除
            </Button>
          )}
          <Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={isSaving} className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white">
            <Save className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
            保存
          </Button>
        </div>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent>
        
        {selfPlans.length > 0 && (
          <div className="mb-6 flex gap-2 overflow-x-auto pb-2 print:hidden">
            {selfPlans.map((plan: any) => (
              <Button
                key={plan.id}
                variant={activePlan?.id === plan.id ? "default" : "outline"}
                onClick={() => { setActivePlan(plan); setFormData(plan); }}
              >
                {plan.creation_date}
              </Button>
            ))}
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="space-y-6 print-content">
          <style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{__html: `
            @media print {
              @page { size: A4; margin: 15mm; }
              body { font-size: 12px; color: black; }
              .print-border { border: 1px solid black; padding: 12px; margin-bottom: 12px; }
              textarea { resize: none; overflow: hidden; height: auto !important; border: none !important; }
              input { border: none !important; }
            }
          `}} />

          <div className="text-center hidden print:block mb-8">
            <h1 className="text-xl font-bold underline mb-4">サービス等利用計画案（セルフプラン）</h1>
            <div className="flex justify-between">
              <div>氏名：{clientName}</div>
              <div>作成日：{formData.creation_date}</div>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid gap-2 print:hidden">
            <Label>作成日</Label>
            <Input 
              type="date" 
              name="creation_date"
              value={formData.creation_date} 
              onChange={handleChange} 
              className="max-w-[200px]"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2 print-border">
            <Label className="font-bold">本人の希望する生活・将来の夢</Label>
            <Textarea
              name="hopes_and_dreams"
              value={formData.hopes_and_dreams || ""}
              onChange={handleChange}
              rows={4}
              placeholder="将来どのように暮らしたいか、どのような仕事をしたいかを記入してください。"
              className="print:p-0 print:shadow-none"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2 print-border">
            <Label className="font-bold">現在困っていること・解決すべき課題</Label>
            <Textarea
              name="current_challenges"
              value={formData.current_challenges || ""}
              onChange={handleChange}
              rows={4}
              placeholder="現在、生活や仕事で困っていること、サポートが必要なことを記入してください。"
              className="print:p-0 print:shadow-none"
            />
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-2 print-border">
            <Label className="font-bold">1週間のスケジュール（希望）</Label>
            <Textarea
              name="weekly_schedule"
              value={formData.weekly_schedule || ""}
              onChange={handleChange}
              rows={4}
              placeholder="月: 〇〇火: 〇〇..."
              className="print:p-0 print:shadow-none"
            />
          </div>
          
          <div className="hidden print:block mt-12 border border-black p-4">
            <p className="mb-2">上記の内容を私の「サービス等利用計画案」として提出します。</p>
            <div className="flex justify-end mt-8">
              <span>本人署名：___________________________________</span>
            </div>
          </div>

        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

                  <TableHead>モニタリング状況</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>ステータス</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right w-[210px]">操作</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {plans.map((plan: any, index: number) => {
                  const planNumber = plans.length - index;
                  const isActive = plan.status === 'active';
                  const isDraft = plan.status === 'draft';

                  return (
                    <TableRow key={plan.id} className={cn("hover:bg-muted/20", isActive && "bg-emerald-50/20 font-medium")}>
                      <TableCell className="text-center font-bold text-muted-foreground">
                        第{planNumber}期
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        <div className="font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <FileText className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                          <span>{plan.plan_date}</span>
                        </div>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-sm">
                        {plan.start_date && plan.end_date ? (
                          <span>{plan.start_date} 〜 {plan.end_date}</span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-muted-foreground italic">未設定</span>
                        )}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-sm">
                        {plan.consent_date ? (
                          <span className="text-emerald-800 font-semibold">✓ {plan.consent_date}</span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-rose-600 text-xs font-bold">⚠ 未同意</span>
                        )}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-sm">
                        {plan.delivery_date ? (
                          <span className="text-blue-800 font-medium">✓ {plan.delivery_date}</span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-muted-foreground text-xs italic">未交付</span>
                        )}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-sm">
                        {plan.creator_name || '専任サビ管'}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-xs">
                        {plan.latest_monitoring_date ? (
                          <div>
                            <span className="font-bold text-purple-900">{plan.latest_monitoring_date}</span>
                            {plan.latest_evaluation && (
                              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground line-clamp-1">{plan.latest_evaluation}</p>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-muted-foreground italic">実施なし</span>
                        )}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        {isActive ? (
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-900 border-emerald-300 font-bold text-xs">
                            現行・運用中
                          </Badge>
                        ) : isDraft ? (
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 border-amber-300 font-bold text-xs">
                            下書き
                          </Badge>
                        ) : (
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-gray-100 text-gray-700 border-gray-300 text-xs">
                            過去計画
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1.5">
                          <Link 
                            href={`/plans/${plan.id}`}
                            className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "default", size: "sm" }), "h-8 px-2.5 text-xs bg-primary text-white gap-1")}
                          >
                            <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            <span>確認・印刷</span>
                          </Link>
                          <Link 
                            href={`/plans/${plan.id}/edit`}
                            className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm" }), "h-8 px-2.5 text-xs text-blue-700 border-blue-200 hover:bg-blue-50 font-bold gap-1")}
                            title="計画書を編集する"
                          >
                            <Edit className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600" />
                            <span>編集</span>
                          </Link>
                          {isDraft && (
                            <PlanActionButtons 
                              planId={plan.id} 
                              clientId={clientId} 
                              status={plan.status} 
                              compact={true}
                              redirectTo={`/clients/${clientId}/documents?tab=plan`}
                            />
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  );
                })}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

File: src/app/clients/[id]/edit/DocumentsSection.tsx
================================================================================

'use client';

import { useState, useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { FileIcon, FileTextIcon, ImageIcon, Trash2Icon, DownloadIcon, Loader2Icon, UploadCloudIcon } from "lucide-react";

interface DocumentData {
  id: string;
  file_name: string;
  file_type: string;
  uploaded_at: string;
}

export function DocumentsSection({ clientId }: { clientId: string }) {
  const [documents, setDocuments] = useState<DocumentData[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(true);
  const [isUploading, setIsUploading] = useState(false);
  const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    fetchDocuments();
  }, [clientId]);

  const fetchDocuments = async () => {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/clients/${clientId}/documents`);
      if (res.ok) {
        const data = await res.json();
        setDocuments(data.documents || []);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Failed to fetch documents", error);
    } finally {
      setIsLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleFileChange = async (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (!e.target.files || e.target.files.length === 0) return;
    
    const file = e.target.files[0];
    await uploadFile(file);
    
    // Reset input
    if (fileInputRef.current) {
      fileInputRef.current.value = "";
    }
  };

  const handleDrop = async (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (e.dataTransfer.files && e.dataTransfer.files.length > 0) {
      const file = e.dataTransfer.files[0];
      await uploadFile(file);
    }
  };

  const handleDragOver = (e: React.DragEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
  };

  const uploadFile = async (file: File) => {
    const allowedTypes = ['application/pdf', 'image/jpeg', 'image/png', 'image/gif', 'image/webp'];
    if (!allowedTypes.includes(file.type)) {
      alert("アップロードできるのはPDFまたは画像（JPG, PNG等）のみです。");
      return;
    }

    setIsUploading(true);
    const formData = new FormData();
    formData.append("file", file);

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/clients/${clientId}/documents`, {
        method: "POST",
        body: formData,
      });

      if (res.ok) {
        await fetchDocuments();
      } else {
        const data = await res.json();
        alert(`アップロード失敗: ${data.error}`);
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Upload error", error);
      alert("アップロード中にエラーが発生しました。");
    } finally {
      setIsUploading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (docId: string) => {
    if (!confirm("本当にこの書類を削除しますか？この操作は元に戻せません。")) return;

    try {
      const res = await fetch(`/api/documents/${docId}`, {
        method: "DELETE",
      });

      if (res.ok) {
        setDocuments(docs => docs.filter(d => d.id !== docId));
      } else {
        alert("削除に失敗しました。");
      }
    } catch (error) {
      console.error("Delete error", error);
      alert("削除中にエラーが発生しました。");
    }
  };

  const getFileIcon = (fileType: string) => {
    if (fileType.includes('pdf')) return <FileTextIcon className="h-8 w-8 text-red-500" />;
    if (fileType.includes('image')) return <ImageIcon className="h-8 w-8 text-blue-500" />;
    return <FileIcon className="h-8 w-8 text-gray-500" />;
  };

  return (
    <Card className="shadow-sm mt-6 border-muted bg-white/50">
      <CardHeader className="bg-primary/5 border-b pb-4">
        <CardTitle className="text-xl">添付書類（履歴書・受給者証コピーなど）</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription className="text-base">
          PDFや画像ファイルをアップロードして保存できます。
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="pt-6 space-y-6">
        
        {/* アップロードエリア */}
        <div 
          className="border-2 border-dashed border-muted-foreground/25 rounded-lg p-8 text-center hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors cursor-pointer"
          onDrop={handleDrop}
          onDragOver={handleDragOver}
          onClick={() => fileInputRef.current?.click()}
        >
          <input 
            type="file" 
            ref={fileInputRef} 
            onChange={handleFileChange} 
            className="hidden" 
            accept="application/pdf,image/jpeg,image/png,image/gif,image/webp"
          />
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center space-y-3">
            {isUploading ? (
              <>
                <Loader2Icon className="h-10 w-10 text-primary animate-spin" />
                <p className="text-lg font-medium text-muted-foreground">アップロード中...</p>
              </>
            ) : (
              <>
                <div className="p-3 bg-primary/10 rounded-full">
                  <UploadCloudIcon className="h-8 w-8 text-primary" />
                </div>
                <p className="text-lg font-medium">クリックまたはファイルをドロップしてアップロード</p>
                <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">対応フォーマット: PDF, JPG, PNG (最大10MB推奨)</p>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* ファイルリスト */}
        <div className="space-y-3">
          <h4 className="font-medium text-foreground">アップロード済みファイル</h4>
          
          {isLoading ? (
            <div className="py-8 text-center text-muted-foreground">読み込み中...</div>
          ) : documents.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="py-8 text-center border rounded-md bg-muted/10 text-muted-foreground">
              添付されている書類はありません。
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div className="grid gap-3">
              {documents.map(doc => (
                <div key={doc.id} className="flex items-center justify-between p-4 border rounded-md bg-background hover:bg-muted/10 transition-colors">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-4 overflow-hidden">
                    {getFileIcon(doc.file_type)}
                    <div className="truncate">
                      <p className="font-medium truncate" title={doc.file_name}>{doc.file_name}</p>
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {new Date(doc.uploaded_at).toLocaleString('ja-JP')} 追加
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pl-4">
                    <a 
                      href={`/api/documents/${doc.id}`} 
                      target="_blank" 
                      rel="noopener noreferrer"
                    >
                      <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="h-9">
                        <DownloadIcon className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" /> 確認
                      </Button>
                    </a>
                    <Button 
                      variant="ghost" 
                      size="icon" 
                      className="h-9 w-9 text-destructive hover:text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10"
                      onClick={() => handleDelete(doc.id)}
                    >
                      <Trash2Icon className="h-4 w-4" />
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>

      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

File: src/app/clients/[id]/edit/PayrollSettings.tsx
================================================================================

'use client';

import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { savePayrollSettings } from "@/app/billing/payroll/actions";
import { useState } from "react";

export function PayrollSettings({ clientId, settings, isTypeB = false }: { clientId: string, settings: any, isTypeB?: boolean }) {
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      const formData = new FormData(e.currentTarget);
      const commute = parseInt(formData.get('commute_allowance') as string) || 0;
      const health = isTypeB ? 0 : (parseInt(formData.get('health_insurance') as string) || 0);
      const pension = isTypeB ? 0 : (parseInt(formData.get('welfare_pension') as string) || 0);
      const res: any = await savePayrollSettings(clientId, commute, health, pension);
      if (res && res.success === false) {
        alert(res.error || '設定の保存に失敗しました');
        setIsSaving(false);
        return;
      }
      alert(isTypeB ? '工賃・実費弁償（通勤手当）設定を保存しました。' : '給与・控除設定を保存しました。');
    } catch (err: any) {
      alert(err?.message || '設定の保存に失敗しました');
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Card className="shadow-sm mt-6">
      <CardHeader className="bg-primary/5 border-b pb-4">
        <CardTitle className="text-xl">{isTypeB ? '工賃・実費弁償（通勤手当）設定' : '給与・控除設定'}</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription className="text-base">
          {isTypeB
            ? '工賃計算時に別途支給される通勤手当（実費弁償・工賃実績および生産活動収支の対象外）を設定します。'
            : '給与計算時に使用される各種手当・社会保険料（固定額）を設定します。'}
        </CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="pt-6">
        <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <Label className="text-base">通勤手当（実費弁償） (円/月)</Label>
              <Input name="commute_allowance" type="number" defaultValue={settings?.commute_allowance || 0} className="h-14 text-base" />
            </div>
            {!isTypeB && (
              <>
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <Label className="text-base">健康保険料 (円/月)</Label>
                  <Input name="health_insurance" type="number" defaultValue={settings?.health_insurance || 0} className="h-14 text-base" />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-3">
                  <Label className="text-base">厚生年金保険料 (円/月)</Label>
                  <Input name="welfare_pension" type="number" defaultValue={settings?.welfare_pension || 0} className="h-14 text-base" />
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </div>
          <div className="pt-4 flex justify-end">
            <Button type="submit" className="h-14 px-8 text-lg" disabled={isSaving}>
              {isSaving ? '保存中...' : (isTypeB ? '設定を保存する' : '控除設定を保存する')}
            </Button>
          </div>
        </form>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

export default async function EditClientPage({ params, searchParams }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }>, searchParams: Promise<{ error?: string }> }) {
  const resolvedParams = await params;
  const resolvedSearchParams = await searchParams;
  resolveServiceModeForClient(resolvedParams.id);
  const serviceMode = await getServiceMode();
  const isTypeB = serviceMode === 'type_b';
  
  const client = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM clients WHERE id = ?').get(resolvedParams.id) as any;
  const payrollSettings = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM payroll_settings WHERE client_id = ?').get(resolvedParams.id) as any;
  const departments = db.prepare('SELECT id, name FROM departments WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at ASC').all() as any[];
  const contractors = db.prepare(`
    SELECT id, name as company_name FROM offsite_workplaces WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
    UNION
    SELECT id, company_name FROM contractor_agreements WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY company_name ASC
  `).all() as any[];

  if (!client) {
    notFound()
  }

  // Wrap the action with the ID
  const updateWithId = updateClientRecord.bind(null, resolvedParams.id);

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background/50">
      <Header activePage="clients" />

      <main className="flex-1 p-3.5 sm:p-6 md:p-12">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-4xl space-y-6">
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">利用者編集</h1>
            <p className="mt-1 sm:mt-2 text-sm sm:text-base text-muted-foreground">
              登録済みの利用者情報を編集します。
            </p>
          </div>

          <Card className="shadow-sm">
            <CardHeader className="bg-primary/5 border-b pb-4">
              <CardTitle className="text-xl">基本情報</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription className="text-base">
                受給者証に記載されている内容を正確に入力してください。
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="pt-6">
              <form action={updateWithId} className="space-y-6">
                
                {resolvedSearchParams?.error && (
                  <div className="p-4 bg-destructive/10 text-destructive rounded-md font-medium">
                    {resolvedSearchParams.error === 'true' ? '更新に失敗しました。入力内容をご確認ください。' : decodeURIComponent(resolvedSearchParams.error)}
                  </div>
                )}

                <div className="space-y-3 pt-4 border-t">
                  <h3 className="text-xl font-semibold text-primary border-b pb-2">基本情報</h3>
                  <div className="space-y-3">
                    <Label htmlFor="departmentId" className="text-lg font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
                      <span>所属拠点</span>
                      <span className="text-xs bg-primary/10 text-primary px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-semibold">必須</span>
                    </Label>
                    <select
                      id="departmentId"
                      name="departmentId"
                      required
                      defaultValue={client.department_id || ''}
                      className="flex h-14 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-lg ring-offset-background focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2"
                    >
                      <option value="">選択してください</option>
                      {departments.map((dep: any) => (
                        <option key={dep.id} value={dep.id}>{dep.name} {dep.facility_type === 'main' ? '(本所)' : '(サテライト)'}</option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  </div>

                    <Label htmlFor="fullName" className="text-lg">氏名</Label>

                        <input
                          type="checkbox"
                          name="usesTransportation"
                          defaultChecked={client.uses_transportation === 1}
                          className="w-5 h-5 accent-primary"
                        />
                        <span className="text-base">日常的に送迎を利用する</span>
                      </label>
                    </div>

                    <div className="space-y-3 md:col-span-2 pt-2">
                      <WeeklyScheduleEditor 
                        initialPatternJson={client.weekly_schedule_pattern}
                        initialRegularHolidaysJson={client.regular_holidays}
                        defaultStartTime={client.work_start_time || "10:00"}
                        defaultEndTime={client.work_end_time || "15:00"}
                        contractors={contractors}
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-3 pt-4 border-t">
                  <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-primary">緊急連絡先・医療情報</h3>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6 pt-2">
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      <Label htmlFor="emergencyContactName" className="text-base">緊急連絡先 氏名</Label>
                      <Input id="emergencyContactName" name="emergencyContactName" type="text" className="h-14 text-base" defaultValue={client.emergency_contact_name || ""} placeholder="例: 山田 花子" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      <Label htmlFor="emergencyContactRelation" className="text-base">緊急連絡先 続柄</Label>
                      <Input id="emergencyContactRelation" name="emergencyContactRelation" type="text" className="h-14 text-base" defaultValue={client.emergency_contact_relation || ""} placeholder="例: 母" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      <Label htmlFor="emergencyContactPhone" className="text-base">緊急連絡先 電話番号</Label>
                      <Input id="emergencyContactPhone" name="emergencyContactPhone" type="text" className="h-14 text-base" defaultValue={client.emergency_contact_phone || ""} placeholder="例: 090-XXXX-XXXX" />
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      <Label htmlFor="primaryDoctor" className="text-base">主治医・医療機関名</Label>
                      <Input id="primaryDoctor" name="primaryDoctor" type="text" className="h-14 text-base" defaultValue={client.primary_doctor || ""} placeholder="例: 〇〇クリニック" />
                    </div>
                    {!isTypeB && (
                      <div className="space-y-3 md:col-span-2">
                        <Label htmlFor="employmentInsuranceNumber" className="text-base">雇用保険被保険者番号</Label>
                        <Input id="employmentInsuranceNumber" name="employmentInsuranceNumber" type="text" className="h-14 text-base" defaultValue={client.employment_insurance_number || ""} placeholder="例: 1234-567890-1" />
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-3 pt-4 border-t">
                  <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-primary">
                    {isTypeB ? '一般就労移行情報' : '有給休暇・就労移行情報'}
                  </h3>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6 pt-2">
                    {!isTypeB && (
                      <div className="space-y-3">
                        <Label htmlFor="ptoGranted" className="text-base">有給休暇 付与日数 (今年度)</Label>
                        <Input id="ptoGranted" name="ptoGranted" type="number" min="0" className="h-14 text-base" defaultValue={client.pto_granted?.toString() || "0"} placeholder="例: 10" />
                      </div>
                    )}
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      <Label htmlFor="transitionDate" className="text-base">一般就労 移行日</Label>
                      <Input id="transitionDate" name="transitionDate" type="date" className="h-14 text-base" defaultValue={client.transition_date || ""} />
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-3 md:col-span-2">
                      <Label htmlFor="transitionCompany" className="text-base">一般就労 移行先企業名</Label>
                      <Input id="transitionCompany" name="transitionCompany" type="text" className="h-14 text-base" defaultValue={client.transition_company || ""} placeholder="例: 株式会社〇〇" />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-3 pt-4 border-t">
                  <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-primary flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span>{isTypeB ? '在籍・契約終了（退所）管理' : '在籍・契約終了（退職）管理'}</span>
                    <span className="text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">※実地指導での在籍・退所台帳に反映されます</span>
                  </h3>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6 pt-2">
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      <Label htmlFor="status" className="text-base">在籍ステータス</Label>
                      <select 
                        id="status" 
                        name="status" 
                        defaultValue={client.status || (client.transition_date ? 'transitioned' : (client.contract_end_date && new Date(client.contract_end_date) <= new Date() ? 'terminated' : 'active'))}
                        className="flex h-14 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-base ring-offset-background focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2"
                      >
                        <option value="active">利用中（在籍中）</option>
                        <option value="suspended">{isTypeB ? '利用休止中' : '休職中'}</option>
                        <option value="terminated">{isTypeB ? '退所・契約終了' : '退職・契約終了'}</option>
                        <option value="transitioned">一般就労移行</option>
                      </select>
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-3">
                      <Label htmlFor="terminationDate" className="text-base">{isTypeB ? '退所日・契約終了日' : '退職日・契約終了日'}</Label>
                      <Input id="terminationDate" name="terminationDate" type="date" className="h-14 text-base" defaultValue={client.termination_date || client.contract_end_date || ""} />
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-3 md:col-span-2">
                      <Label htmlFor="terminationReason" className="text-base">{isTypeB ? '退所・終了理由' : '退職・終了理由'}</Label>
                      <select 
                        id="terminationReason" 
                        name="terminationReason" 
                        defaultValue={client.termination_reason || ""}
                        className="flex h-14 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-base ring-offset-background focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2"
                      >
                        <option value="">-- 選択してください --</option>
                        <option value="一般就労への移行">一般就労への移行（企業就職）</option>
                        <option value="契約期間満了">契約期間満了</option>
                        <option value="自己都合">{isTypeB ? '自己都合退所' : '自己都合退職'}</option>
                        <option value="体調不良・療養">体調不良・入院・療養のため</option>
                        <option value="他事業所・施設への転出">他事業所・施設への転出</option>
                        <option value="支給決定終了">自治体による支給決定の終了</option>
                        <option value="その他">その他</option>
                      </select>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>




                <div className="pt-4 flex justify-end gap-4">
                  <Link href="/clients" className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", className: "h-14 px-8 text-lg" }))}>
                    キャンセル
                  </Link>
                  <SubmitButton className="h-14 px-8 text-lg">
                    保存する
                  </SubmitButton>
                </div>
              </form>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
          
          <PayrollSettings clientId={resolvedParams.id} settings={payrollSettings} isTypeB={isTypeB} />
          
          <DocumentsSection clientId={resolvedParams.id} />
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  )
}

'use server'

import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache'
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'
import { getApplicableMinimumWage } from "@/lib/constants/minimumWageMaster";
import { db } from '@/lib/db'
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid'
import { getRole, assertCanAccessClient, assertCanAccessDepartment } from '@/lib/auth'
import { logAudit } from '@/lib/audit'
import { createClientSchema, getFirstZodErrorMessage } from '@/lib/validations'
import { toLocalISODate } from '@/lib/utils'

export async function createClientRecord(formData: FormData) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) return redirect('/login');

  const parseResult = createClientSchema.safeParse({
    fullName: formData.get('fullName'),
    furigana: formData.get('furigana') || null,
    clientType: formData.get('clientType') || 'regular',
    recipientNumber: (formData.get('recipientNumber') as string) || '',
    paymentLimit: parseInt(formData.get('paymentLimit') as string) || 0,
    burdenLimitFacilityName: (formData.get('burdenLimitFacilityName') as string) || null,
    isBurdenLimitManaged: formData.get('isBurdenLimitManaged') === 'on' || formData.get('isBurdenLimitManaged') === '1',
    burdenManagerType: (formData.get('burdenManagerType') as string) || 'none',
    grantDecisionDate: formData.get('grantDecisionDate') || null,
    grantDecisionMunicipality: (formData.get('grantDecisionMunicipality') as string) || null,
    validFrom: formData.get('validFrom'),
    validTo: formData.get('validTo'),
    allowanceDays: parseInt(formData.get('allowanceDays') as string) || 0,
    disabilityClass: formData.get('disabilityClass') as string || '',
    disabilityClassValidFrom: formData.get('disabilityClassValidFrom') || null,
    disabilityClassValidTo: formData.get('disabilityClassValidTo') || null,
    disabilityCertificate: formData.get('disabilityCertificate') as string || '未所持',
    hourlyWage: parseInt(formData.get('hourlyWage') as string) || 0,
    weeklyScheduledHours: parseFloat(formData.get('weeklyScheduledHours') as string) || 0,
    serviceStartDate: formData.get('serviceStartDate') || null,
    contractDate: formData.get('contractDate') || null,
    contractEndDate: formData.get('contractEndDate') || null,
    usesMealProvision: formData.get('usesMealProvision') === 'on',
    usesTransportation: formData.get('usesTransportation') === 'on',
    ptoGranted: parseInt(formData.get('ptoGranted') as string) || 0,
    transitionDate: formData.get('transitionDate') || null,
    transitionCompany: formData.get('transitionCompany') || null,
    emergencyContactName: formData.get('emergencyContactName') || null,
    emergencyContactPhone: formData.get('emergencyContactPhone') || null,
    emergencyContactRelation: formData.get('emergencyContactRelation') || null,
    primaryDoctor: formData.get('primaryDoctor') || null,
    cityCode: formData.get('cityCode') || null,
    employmentInsuranceNumber: formData.get('employmentInsuranceNumber') || null,
    workStartTime: formData.get('workStartTime') || '09:00',
    workEndTime: formData.get('workEndTime') || '16:00',
    breakTimeMinutes: parseInt(formData.get('breakTimeMinutes') as string) || 60,
    wageType: (formData.get('wageType') as 'hourly' | 'daily' | 'piecework') || 'hourly',
  });

  if (!parseResult.success) {
    const errorMsg = getFirstZodErrorMessage(parseResult.error);
    redirect(`/clients/new?error=${encodeURIComponent(errorMsg)}`);
  }
  const parsedData = parseResult.data;

  const birthdate = formData.get('birthdate') || null;
  const gender = formData.get('gender') || null;
  const address = formData.get('address') || null;
  const phoneNumber = formData.get('phoneNumber') || null;
  const disabilityTypesRaw = formData.getAll('disabilityType').filter(Boolean) as string[];
  const disabilityType = disabilityTypesRaw.length > 0 ? JSON.stringify(disabilityTypesRaw) : (formData.get('disabilityType') as string || null);
  const departmentId = (formData.get('departmentId') as string) || null;
  if (departmentId) {
    try {
      await assertCanAccessDepartment(departmentId);
    } catch (err: any) {
      redirect(`/clients/new?error=${encodeURIComponent(err?.message || '拠点へのアクセス権限がありません')}`);
    }
  }
  const minWageExemptionApproved = formData.get('minWageExemptionApproved') === 'on' ? 1 : 0;
  const importanceExplanationDate = (formData.get('importanceExplanationDate') as string) || null;
  const privacyConsentDate = (formData.get('privacyConsentDate') as string) || null;

  const settings = db.prepare(`SELECT service_type, regional_minimum_wage, pref_code FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any;
  const isTypeB = settings?.service_type === 'type_b' || settings?.service_type === 'B';
  if (isTypeB) {
    parsedData.ptoGranted = 0;
    parsedData.employmentInsuranceNumber = null;
  } else {
    const minWage = getApplicableMinimumWage(settings?.pref_code, settings?.regional_minimum_wage);
    if (parsedData.hourlyWage! > 0 && parsedData.hourlyWage! < minWage && !minWageExemptionApproved) {
      redirect(`/clients/new?error=${encodeURIComponent(`時給（${parsedData.hourlyWage}円）が地域別最低賃金（${minWage}円）を下回っています。労基署長による減額特例許可を取得している場合は「最低賃金減額特例」にチェックを入れてください。`)}`);
    }
  }

  const status = (formData.get('status') as string) || 'active';
  const terminationDate = (formData.get('terminationDate') as string) || null;
  const terminationReason = (formData.get('terminationReason') as string) || null;

  const regularHolidays = JSON.stringify(formData.getAll('regularHolidays'));
  const weeklySchedulePattern = (formData.get('weeklySchedulePattern') as string) || null;

  const stmt = db.prepare(`
    INSERT INTO clients (
      id, full_name, furigana, client_type, recipient_number, payment_limit,
      burden_limit_facility_name, is_burden_limit_managed, burden_manager_type,
      valid_from, valid_to,
      grant_decision_date, grant_decision_municipality,
      allowance_days, disability_class, disability_class_valid_from, disability_class_valid_to, disability_certificate, hourly_wage, weekly_scheduled_hours, regular_holidays,
      service_start_date, contract_date, contract_end_date, uses_meal_provision, uses_transportation,
      pto_granted, transition_date, transition_company, emergency_contact_name, emergency_contact_phone,
      emergency_contact_relation, primary_doctor, city_code, employment_insurance_number,
      birthdate, gender, address, phone_number, disability_type, department_id,
      min_wage_exemption_approved, importance_explanation_date, privacy_consent_date,
      status, termination_date, termination_reason,
      work_start_time, work_end_time, break_time_minutes,
      weekly_schedule_pattern, location, wage_type
    ) VALUES (
      ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?
    )
  `);

  try {
    stmt.run(
      uuidv4(),
      parsedData.fullName,
      parsedData.furigana || null,
      parsedData.clientType,
      parsedData.recipientNumber,
      parsedData.paymentLimit,
      parsedData.burdenLimitFacilityName || null,
      parsedData.isBurdenLimitManaged ? 1 : 0,
      parsedData.burdenManagerType || 'none',
      parsedData.validFrom,
      parsedData.validTo,
      parsedData.grantDecisionDate || null,
      parsedData.grantDecisionMunicipality || null,
      parsedData.allowanceDays,
      parsedData.disabilityClass,
      parsedData.disabilityClassValidFrom || null,
      parsedData.disabilityClassValidTo || null,
      parsedData.disabilityCertificate,
      parsedData.hourlyWage,
      parsedData.weeklyScheduledHours,
      regularHolidays,
      parsedData.serviceStartDate,
      parsedData.contractDate,
      parsedData.contractEndDate,
      parsedData.usesMealProvision ? 1 : 0,
      parsedData.usesTransportation ? 1 : 0,
      parsedData.ptoGranted,
      parsedData.transitionDate,
      parsedData.transitionCompany,
      parsedData.emergencyContactName,
      parsedData.emergencyContactPhone,
      parsedData.emergencyContactRelation,
      parsedData.primaryDoctor,
      parsedData.cityCode,
      parsedData.employmentInsuranceNumber,
      birthdate,
      gender,
      address,
      phoneNumber,
      disabilityType,
      departmentId,
      minWageExemptionApproved,
      importanceExplanationDate,
      privacyConsentDate,
      status,
      terminationDate,
      terminationReason,
      parsedData.workStartTime || '09:00',
      parsedData.workEndTime || '16:00',
      parsedData.breakTimeMinutes !== undefined ? parsedData.breakTimeMinutes : 60,
      weeklySchedulePattern,
      (departmentId ? (db.prepare('SELECT facility_type FROM departments WHERE id = ?').get(departmentId) as any)?.facility_type || 'main' : 'main'),
      parsedData.wageType || 'hourly'
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('利用者登録エラー:', error)
    redirect('/clients/new?error=true')
  }

  revalidatePath('/clients')
  revalidatePath('/attendance/shifts')
  revalidatePath('/attendance')
  revalidatePath('/billing/payroll')
  revalidatePath('/')
  redirect('/clients?success=true&msg=' + encodeURIComponent('利用者情報を保存しました'))
}

export async function deleteClientRecord(id: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    await assertCanAccessClient(id);
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role) return { success: false, error: '認証されていません' };
    if (role !== 'admin') return { success: false, error: '管理者権限が必要です' };

    const stmt = db.prepare("UPDATE clients SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, status = 'inactive' WHERE id = ?");
    stmt.run(id);

    await logAudit({
      action: 'delete',
      targetTable: 'clients',
      targetId: id,
      details: { action: 'soft_delete', clientId: id }
    });

    revalidatePath('/clients');
    revalidatePath('/attendance/shifts');
    revalidatePath('/attendance');
    revalidatePath('/billing/payroll');
    revalidatePath('/');
    return { success: true };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('利用者削除エラー:', error);
    return { success: false, error: error?.message || '削除に失敗しました' };
  }
}

      uses_meal_provision = ?,
      uses_transportation = ?,
      pto_granted = ?,
      transition_date = ?,
      transition_company = ?,
      emergency_contact_name = ?,
      emergency_contact_phone = ?,
      emergency_contact_relation = ?,
      primary_doctor = ?,
      city_code = ?,
      employment_insurance_number = ?,
      birthdate = ?,
      gender = ?,
      address = ?,
      phone_number = ?,
      disability_type = ?,
      department_id = ?,
      min_wage_exemption_approved = ?,
      importance_explanation_date = ?,
      privacy_consent_date = ?,
      status = ?,
      termination_date = ?,
      termination_reason = ?,
      work_start_time = ?,
      work_end_time = ?,
      break_time_minutes = ?,
      weekly_schedule_pattern = ?,
      location = ?,
      wage_type = ?
    WHERE id = ?
  `);

  try {
    stmt.run(
      parsedData.fullName,
      parsedData.furigana || null,
      parsedData.clientType,
      parsedData.recipientNumber,
      parsedData.paymentLimit,
      parsedData.burdenLimitFacilityName || null,
      parsedData.isBurdenLimitManaged ? 1 : 0,
      parsedData.burdenManagerType || 'none',
      parsedData.validFrom,
      parsedData.validTo,
      parsedData.grantDecisionDate || null,
      parsedData.grantDecisionMunicipality || null,
      parsedData.allowanceDays,
      parsedData.disabilityClass,
      parsedData.disabilityClassValidFrom || null,
      parsedData.disabilityClassValidTo || null,
      parsedData.disabilityCertificate,
      parsedData.hourlyWage,
      parsedData.weeklyScheduledHours,
      regularHolidays,
      parsedData.serviceStartDate,
      parsedData.contractDate,
      parsedData.contractEndDate,
      parsedData.usesMealProvision ? 1 : 0,
      parsedData.usesTransportation ? 1 : 0,
      parsedData.ptoGranted,
      parsedData.transitionDate,
      parsedData.transitionCompany,
      parsedData.emergencyContactName,
      parsedData.emergencyContactPhone,
      parsedData.emergencyContactRelation,
      parsedData.primaryDoctor,
      parsedData.cityCode,
      parsedData.employmentInsuranceNumber,
      birthdate,
      gender,
      address,
      phoneNumber,
      disabilityType,
      departmentId,
      minWageExemptionApproved,
      importanceExplanationDate,
      privacyConsentDate,
      status,
      terminationDate,
      terminationReason,
      parsedData.workStartTime || '09:00',
      parsedData.workEndTime || '16:00',
      parsedData.breakTimeMinutes !== undefined ? parsedData.breakTimeMinutes : 60,
      weeklySchedulePattern,
      (departmentId ? (db.prepare('SELECT facility_type FROM departments WHERE id = ?').get(departmentId) as any)?.facility_type || 'main' : 'main'),
      parsedData.wageType || 'hourly',
      id
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('利用者更新エラー:', error);
    redirect(`/clients/${id}/edit?error=true`);
  }

  revalidatePath('/clients')
  revalidatePath(`/clients/${id}/edit`)
  revalidatePath('/attendance/shifts')
  revalidatePath('/attendance')
  revalidatePath('/billing/payroll')
  revalidatePath('/')
  redirect('/clients?success=true&msg=' + encodeURIComponent('利用者情報を保存しました'))
}

export interface CsvClientImportItem {
  fullName: string;
  furigana?: string;
  recipientNumber?: string;
  paymentLimit?: number;
  validFrom?: string;
  validTo?: string;
  allowanceDays?: number;
  disabilityClass?: string;
  disabilityType?: string;
  hourlyWage?: number;
  weeklyScheduledHours?: number;
  workStartTime?: string;
  workEndTime?: string;
  breakTimeMinutes?: number;
  birthdate?: string;
  gender?: string;
  phoneNumber?: string;
  address?: string;
  serviceStartDate?: string;
}

/**
 * 他社ソフトやExcelからのCSV一括インポートアクション
 */
export async function importClientsFromCsv(records: CsvClientImportItem[]) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (role !== 'admin') {
    return { success: false, error: '管理者権限が必要です' };
  }

  if (!records || !Array.isArray(records) || records.length === 0) {
    return { success: false, error: '有効なデータがありません' };
  }

  const facility = db.prepare('SELECT service_type, regional_minimum_wage FROM facility_settings WHERE id = \'default\'').get() as any;
  const isTypeB = facility?.service_type === 'type_b' || facility?.service_type === 'B';
  const defaultWage = isTypeB ? 300 : (facility?.regional_minimum_wage || 1000);
  const defaultPtoGranted = isTypeB ? 0 : 10;
  const todayStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
  const oneYearLater = new Date();
  oneYearLater.setFullYear(oneYearLater.getFullYear() + 1);
  const oneYearLaterStr = toLocalISODate(oneYearLater);

  let insertedCount = 0;
  const errors: string[] = [];

  try {
    const insertStmt = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO clients (
        id, full_name, furigana, client_type, recipient_number, payment_limit,
        valid_from, valid_to, grant_decision_date, grant_decision_municipality, 
        allowance_days, disability_class, disability_class_valid_from, disability_class_valid_to, disability_certificate,
        hourly_wage, weekly_scheduled_hours, regular_holidays, service_start_date, contract_date,
        uses_meal_provision, uses_transportation, pto_granted,
        birthdate, gender, address, phone_number, disability_type,
        work_start_time, work_end_time, break_time_minutes,
        status, created_at
      ) VALUES (
        ?, ?, ?, 'regular', ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?, '["0","6"]', ?, ?,
        0, 0, ?,
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?,
        'active', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      )
    `);

    db.transaction(() => {
      for (let i = 0; i < records.length; i++) {
        const item = records[i];
        if (!item.fullName || !item.fullName.trim()) {
          errors.push(`${i + 1}行目: 氏名が未入力です`);
          continue;
        }

        const id = uuidv4();
        const fullName = item.fullName.trim();
        const furigana = item.furigana && item.furigana.trim() ? item.furigana.trim() : null;
        const recipientNumber = item.recipientNumber && item.recipientNumber.trim() ? item.recipientNumber.trim() : '未採番';
        const paymentLimit = item.paymentLimit !== undefined && !isNaN(Number(item.paymentLimit)) ? Number(item.paymentLimit) : 0;
        const validFrom = item.validFrom && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(item.validFrom) ? item.validFrom : todayStr;
        const validTo = item.validTo && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(item.validTo) ? item.validTo : oneYearLaterStr;
        const allowanceDays = item.allowanceDays !== undefined && !isNaN(Number(item.allowanceDays)) ? Number(item.allowanceDays) : 23;
        const disabilityClass = item.disabilityClass ? item.disabilityClass.trim() : '区分3';
        const disabilityCertificate = item.disabilityClass ? `障害福祉サービス受給者証 (${disabilityClass})` : '受給者証あり';
        const hourlyWage = item.hourlyWage !== undefined && !isNaN(Number(item.hourlyWage)) && Number(item.hourlyWage) > 0 ? Number(item.hourlyWage) : defaultWage;
        const weeklyHours = item.weeklyScheduledHours !== undefined && !isNaN(Number(item.weeklyScheduledHours)) && Number(item.weeklyScheduledHours) > 0 ? Number(item.weeklyScheduledHours) : 20;
        const serviceStart = item.serviceStartDate && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(item.serviceStartDate) ? item.serviceStartDate : todayStr;
        const birthdate = item.birthdate && /^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(item.birthdate) ? item.birthdate : null;
        const gender = item.gender ? item.gender.trim() : null;
        const address = item.address ? item.address.trim() : null;
        const phone = item.phoneNumber ? item.phoneNumber.trim() : null;
        const disabilityType = item.disabilityType ? JSON.stringify([item.disabilityType.trim()]) : null;
        const startTime = item.workStartTime && /^\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(item.workStartTime) ? item.workStartTime : '09:00';
        const endTime = item.workEndTime && /^\d{2}:\d{2}$/.test(item.workEndTime) ? item.workEndTime : '16:00';
        const breakM = item.breakTimeMinutes !== undefined && !isNaN(Number(item.breakTimeMinutes)) ? Number(item.breakTimeMinutes) : 60;

        insertStmt.run(
          id, fullName, furigana, recipientNumber, paymentLimit,
          validFrom, validTo, null, null, allowanceDays, disabilityClass, null, null, disabilityCertificate,
          hourlyWage, weeklyHours, serviceStart, serviceStart,
          defaultPtoGranted,
          birthdate, gender, address, phone, disabilityType,
          startTime, endTime, breakM
        );

        insertedCount++;
      }
    })();

    revalidatePath('/clients');
    return {
      success: true,
      insertedCount,
      errors: errors.length > 0 ? errors : undefined,
      message: `${insertedCount}件の利用者を一括登録しました。${errors.length > 0 ? ` (エラー: ${errors.length}件)` : ''}`
    };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('CSV一括インポートエラー:', error);
    return { success: false, error: `インポートに失敗しました: ${error.message}` };
  }
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Building2, Car, Moon, Clock } from "lucide-react";

export interface DaySchedulePattern {
  is_holiday: boolean;
  holiday_type?: string;
  work_type: 'in_facility' | 'out_facility' | 'both';
  start_time: string;
  end_time: string;
  offsite_workplace_id?: string;
  offsite_workplace_name?: string;
}

export type WeeklySchedulePattern = Record<string, DaySchedulePattern>;

const DAYS = [
  { value: "1", label: "月曜日", short: "月", isWeekend: false },
  { value: "2", label: "火曜日", short: "火", isWeekend: false },
  { value: "3", label: "水曜日", short: "水", isWeekend: false },
  { value: "4", label: "木曜日", short: "木", isWeekend: false },
  { value: "5", label: "金曜日", short: "金", isWeekend: false },
  { value: "6", label: "土曜日", short: "土", isWeekend: true },
  { value: "0", label: "日曜日", short: "日", isWeekend: true },
];

const DEFAULT_WEEKLY_PATTERN: WeeklySchedulePattern = {
  "1": { is_holiday: false, work_type: "in_facility", start_time: "10:00", end_time: "15:00" },
  "2": { is_holiday: false, work_type: "in_facility", start_time: "10:00", end_time: "15:00" },
  "3": { is_holiday: false, work_type: "in_facility", start_time: "10:00", end_time: "15:00" },
  "4": { is_holiday: false, work_type: "in_facility", start_time: "10:00", end_time: "15:00" },
  "5": { is_holiday: false, work_type: "in_facility", start_time: "10:00", end_time: "15:00" },
  "6": { is_holiday: true, holiday_type: "公休", work_type: "in_facility", start_time: "10:00", end_time: "15:00" },
  "0": { is_holiday: true, holiday_type: "公休", work_type: "in_facility", start_time: "10:00", end_time: "15:00" },
};

interface WeeklyScheduleEditorProps {
  initialPatternJson?: string | null;
  initialRegularHolidaysJson?: string | null;
  defaultStartTime?: string | null;
  defaultEndTime?: string | null;
  contractors?: { id: string; company_name: string }[];
}

export function WeeklyScheduleEditor({
  initialPatternJson,
  initialRegularHolidaysJson,
  defaultStartTime = "10:00",
  defaultEndTime = "15:00",
  contractors = []
}: WeeklyScheduleEditorProps) {
  const [schedule, setSchedule] = useState<WeeklySchedulePattern>(() => {
    if (initialPatternJson) {
      try {
        const parsed = JSON.parse(initialPatternJson);
        if (typeof parsed === 'object' && parsed !== null) {
          return { ...DEFAULT_WEEKLY_PATTERN, ...parsed };
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    // 従来の regular_holidays とデフォルト時間から初期値を生成
    const base = { ...DEFAULT_WEEKLY_PATTERN };
    let holidays: string[] = ["0", "6"];
    try {
      if (initialRegularHolidaysJson) {
        holidays = JSON.parse(initialRegularHolidaysJson);
      }
    } catch (e) {}

    const sTime = defaultStartTime || "10:00";
    const eTime = defaultEndTime || "15:00";

    DAYS.forEach(d => {
      const isHol = holidays.includes(d.value);
      base[d.value] = {
        is_holiday: isHol,
        holiday_type: isHol ? "公休" : undefined,
        work_type: "in_facility",
        start_time: sTime,
        end_time: eTime,
      };
    });

    return base;
  });

  const updateDay = (dayVal: string, updates: Partial<DaySchedulePattern>) => {
    setSchedule(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [dayVal]: {
        ...prev[dayVal],
        ...updates
      }
    }));
  };

  // クイックプリセット適用
  const applyPreset = (type: 'weekday_10_15' | 'weekday_10_16') => {
    setSchedule(prev => {
      const next = { ...prev };
      DAYS.forEach(d => {
        if (type === 'weekday_10_15') {
          const isHol = d.isWeekend;
          next[d.value] = {
            is_holiday: isHol,
            holiday_type: isHol ? "公休" : undefined,
            work_type: "in_facility",
            start_time: "10:00",
            end_time: "15:00",
          };
        } else if (type === 'weekday_10_16') {
          const isHol = d.isWeekend;
          next[d.value] = {
            is_holiday: isHol,
            holiday_type: isHol ? "公休" : undefined,
            work_type: "in_facility",
            start_time: "10:00",
            end_time: "16:00",
          };
        }
      });
      return next;
    });
  };

  // 公休日の配列（従来のregularHolidaysとの連動用）
  const holidayDays = Object.entries(schedule)
    .filter(([_, v]) => v.is_holiday)
    .map(([k]) => k);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 bg-slate-50 p-3 rounded-lg border">
        <div>
          <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Clock className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
            曜日別 定例通所・勤務パターン設定（シフト自動反映）
          </h4>
          <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
            曜日ごとの通所時間（基本10-15時、16時/17時までなど）や施設外就労の曜日固定を設定します。シフト表に初期値として自動展開されます。
          </p>
        </div>
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 shrink-0">
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => applyPreset('weekday_10_15')}
            className="text-xs h-7 px-2 bg-white"
          >
            平日 10-15時 (土日休)
          </Button>
          <Button
            type="button"
            variant="outline"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => applyPreset('weekday_10_16')}
            className="text-xs h-7 px-2 bg-white"
          >
            平日 10-16時 (土日休)
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 曜日ごとの行リスト */}
      <div className="divide-y border rounded-lg overflow-hidden bg-white shadow-xs">
        {DAYS.map(day => {
          const item = schedule[day.value] || {
            is_holiday: day.isWeekend,
            work_type: "in_facility",
            start_time: "10:00",
            end_time: "15:00"
          };

          return (
            <div 
              key={day.value}
              className={`p-3 sm:px-4 flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-3 transition-colors ${
                item.is_holiday 
                  ? 'bg-slate-50/70 text-slate-500' 
                  : item.work_type === 'out_facility'
                    ? 'bg-cyan-50/40'
                    : 'bg-white'
              }`}
            >
              {/* 曜日ラベル & 区分セレクタ */}
              <div className="flex items-center gap-3 w-full md:w-56 shrink-0">
                <div className={`w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center font-black text-sm shrink-0 shadow-2xs ${
                  day.value === "0" 
                    ? "bg-rose-100 text-rose-700" 
                    : day.value === "6" 
                      ? "bg-blue-100 text-blue-700" 
                      : "bg-slate-100 text-slate-800"
                }`}>
                  {day.short}
                </div>
                <div className="flex flex-col">
                  <span className="font-bold text-sm text-foreground">{day.label}</span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                    {item.is_holiday ? "定例公休" : item.work_type === 'out_facility' ? "施設外就労" : "事業所内勤務"}
                  </span>
                </div>
                
                {/* 区分切替バッジ */}
                <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-1 bg-slate-100 p-0.5 rounded-md border border-slate-200">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => updateDay(day.value, { 
                      is_holiday: false, 
                      work_type: 'in_facility',
                      start_time: item.start_time || '10:00',
                      end_time: item.end_time || '15:00'
                    })}
                    className={`text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1 ${
                      !item.is_holiday && item.work_type === 'in_facility'
                        ? 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-2xs'
                        : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <Building2 className="w-3 h-3 text-slate-600" />
                    内勤
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => updateDay(day.value, { 
                      is_holiday: false, 
                      work_type: 'out_facility',
                      start_time: item.start_time || '10:00',
                      end_time: item.end_time === '15:00' ? '16:00' : (item.end_time || '16:00')
                    })}
                    className={`text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1 ${
                      !item.is_holiday && item.work_type === 'out_facility'
                        ? 'bg-cyan-600 text-white shadow-2xs'
                        : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
                    }`}
                    title="施設外就労（10-16時など）"
                  >
                    <Car className="w-3 h-3" />
                    施設外
                  </button>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => updateDay(day.value, { 
                      is_holiday: true, 
                      holiday_type: '公休' 
                    })}
                    className={`text-xs px-2 py-1 rounded font-bold transition-all flex items-center gap-1 ${
                      item.is_holiday
                        ? 'bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border border-rose-200 shadow-2xs'
                        : 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900'
                    }`}
                  >
                    <Moon className="w-3 h-3 text-rose-600" />
                    公休
                  </button>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* 時間入力 & 就労先指定（稼働日のみ） */}
              <div className="flex-1 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                {!item.is_holiday ? (
                  <>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <Input
                        type="time"
                        value={item.start_time || "10:00"}
                        onChange={(e) => updateDay(day.value, { start_time: e.target.value })}
                        className="h-8 w-24 text-xs font-mono bg-white"
                      />
                      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">〜</span>
                      <Input
                        type="time"
                        value={item.end_time || "15:00"}
                        onChange={(e) => updateDay(day.value, { end_time: e.target.value })}
                        className="h-8 w-24 text-xs font-mono bg-white"
                      />
                    </div>

                    {/* クイック時間選択ボタン */}
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => updateDay(day.value, { start_time: "10:00", end_time: "15:00" })}
                        className={`text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border transition-colors ${
                          item.start_time === "10:00" && item.end_time === "15:00"
                            ? "bg-slate-800 text-white border-slate-800 font-bold"
                            : "bg-slate-50 text-slate-600 border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100"
                        }`}
                      >
                        10-15
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => updateDay(day.value, { start_time: "10:00", end_time: "16:00" })}
                        className={`text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border transition-colors ${
                          item.start_time === "10:00" && item.end_time === "16:00"
                            ? "bg-slate-800 text-white border-slate-800 font-bold"
                            : "bg-slate-50 text-slate-600 border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100"
                        }`}
                      >
                        10-16
                      </button>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => updateDay(day.value, { start_time: "10:00", end_time: "17:00" })}
                        className={`text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border transition-colors ${
                          item.start_time === "10:00" && item.end_time === "17:00"
                            ? "bg-slate-800 text-white border-slate-800 font-bold"
                            : "bg-slate-50 text-slate-600 border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100"
                        }`}
                      >
                        10-17
                      </button>
                    </div>

                    {/* 施設外就労先選択（施設外の場合のみ） */}
                    {item.work_type === 'out_facility' && contractors.length > 0 && (
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 ml-auto">
                        <span className="text-[11px] font-semibold text-cyan-900 shrink-0">就労先:</span>
                        <select
                          value={item.offsite_workplace_id || ""}
                          onChange={(e) => {
                            const found = contractors.find(c => c.id === e.target.value);
                            updateDay(day.value, {
                              offsite_workplace_id: e.target.value || undefined,
                              offsite_workplace_name: found ? found.company_name : undefined
                            });
                          }}
                          className="h-8 text-xs rounded border border-cyan-300 bg-white px-2 py-1 text-slate-900 focus:outline-hidden"
                        >
                          <option value="">指定なし（汎用施設外）</option>
                          {contractors.map(c => (
                            <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.company_name}</option>
                          ))}
                        </select>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <div className="text-xs text-slate-400 font-medium italic">
                    定例公休（通所予定なし）
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* フォーム送信用の Hidden Inputs */}
      <input 
        type="hidden" 
        name="weeklySchedulePattern" 
        value={JSON.stringify(schedule)} 
      />
      {/* 従来の regularHolidays との完全連動（後方互換性） */}
      {holidayDays.map(val => (
        <input 
          key={val} 
          type="hidden" 
          name="regularHolidays" 
          value={val} 
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

import { Header } from "@/components/Header";
import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { SubmitButton } from "@/components/SubmitButton";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { createClientRecord } from "../actions";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ChevronLeft } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { getServiceMode } from "@/lib/serviceModeServer";
import { WeeklyScheduleEditor } from "../components/WeeklyScheduleEditor";

const DAYS = [
  { value: "1", label: "月" },
  { value: "2", label: "火" },
  { value: "3", label: "水" },
  { value: "4", label: "木" },
  { value: "5", label: "金" },
  { value: "6", label: "土" },
  { value: "0", label: "日" }
];

  `).all() as any[];
