"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { AlertTriangle, CheckCircle2, ChevronRight, Users, MapPin, UserX } from "lucide-react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import type { DailyStaffingStatus } from "@/lib/compliance/staffingCalculator";

interface DailyStaffingAlertProps {
  dailyStaffing: DailyStaffingStatus;
  todayStr: string;
  role: "admin" | "service_manager" | "staff";
}

export function DailyStaffingAlert({ dailyStaffing, todayStr, role }: DailyStaffingAlertProps) {
  const isStaff = role === "staff";

  // 基準充足時
  if (dailyStaffing.isCompliant) {
    if (isStaff) {
      // 一般スタッフには問題ない場合は非表示にしてノイズをゼロに
      return null;
    }
    return (
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-emerald-50/90 border border-emerald-200 rounded-lg text-emerald-900 text-xs shadow-2xs">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
          <span className="font-bold">
            【本日 {todayStr}】人員配置基準・施設外引率体制: 充足しています
          </span>
          <span className="text-emerald-700 hidden sm:inline">
            （利用者: {dailyStaffing.clientPresentCount}名 / 実績FTE: {dailyStaffing.actualFte}人 / 基準: {dailyStaffing.staffingClass}）
          </span>
        </div>
        <Link href={`/attendance?date=${todayStr}`} className="font-semibold text-emerald-700 hover:underline shrink-0 ml-2">
          出欠状況 →
        </Link>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // 利用者ゼロの場合は表示不要
  if (dailyStaffing.clientPresentCount === 0) {
    return null;
  }

  // 一般スタッフ向けのシンプルで直感的な警告表示
  if (isStaff) {
    return (
      <div className="bg-rose-50 border-l-4 border-rose-600 p-4 rounded-r-md shadow-sm">
        <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
          <AlertTriangle className="h-6 w-6 text-rose-600 mt-0.5 shrink-0 animate-pulse" />
          <div className="flex-1 space-y-2">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
              <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-rose-950">
                {!dailyStaffing.isOffsiteCompliant 
                  ? `【本日 ${todayStr}】施設外就労の引率職員が未登録です` 
                  : `【本日 ${todayStr}】本日の人員配置が未充足です`}
              </h3>
              <Badge variant="destructive" className="text-xs">
                要確認
              </Badge>
            </div>

            {!dailyStaffing.isOffsiteCompliant && (
              <div className="bg-white/90 p-3 rounded border border-rose-200 text-xs text-rose-950 space-y-1.5">
                <p className="font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 text-rose-900">
                  <MapPin className="w-4 h-4 text-rose-600 shrink-0" />
                  以下の施設外就労利用者に同行する専任引率職員がまだ選択・保存されていません：
                </p>
                {dailyStaffing.unassignedOffsiteClients && dailyStaffing.unassignedOffsiteClients.length > 0 ? (
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5 pt-1">
                    {dailyStaffing.unassignedOffsiteClients.map((c, i) => (
                      <span key={i} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-rose-100 text-rose-900 px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-medium text-xs border border-rose-200">
                        <UserX className="w-3 h-3 text-rose-600" />
                        {c.clientName} ({c.workplaceName || '現場未指定'})
                      </span>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                ) : (
                  <p className="text-muted-foreground">
                    施設外就労に出勤予定の利用者（{dailyStaffing.offsiteClientCount}名）の引率担当を指定してください。
                  </p>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="pt-1">
              <Link href={`/attendance?date=${todayStr}`}>
                <Button size="sm" className="bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white font-bold text-xs h-8">
                  本日の出欠管理で引率職員を登録する →
                </Button>
              </Link>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // 管理者・サビ管向けのフル詳細警告表示
  return (
    <div className="bg-rose-50 border-l-4 border-rose-600 p-4 rounded-r-md shadow-sm">
      <div className="flex items-start">
        <AlertTriangle className="h-6 w-6 text-rose-600 mt-0.5 mr-3 shrink-0 animate-pulse" />
        <div className="w-full space-y-2">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <h3 className="text-base sm:text-lg font-bold text-rose-950">
              {dailyStaffing.shortageMinutes > 0
                ? `【本日 ${todayStr}】職員勤務時間が不足しています（至急対応が必要です）`
                : !dailyStaffing.isOffsiteCompliant
                ? `【本日 ${todayStr}】施設外就労の引率職員が不足・未登録です（配置基準違反リスク）`
                : `【本日 ${todayStr}】人員配置基準が未充足です（要確認）`}
            </h3>
            <span className="text-xs bg-rose-200 text-rose-900 font-bold px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
              配置基準: {dailyStaffing.staffingClass}
            </span>
          </div>

          {dailyStaffing.complianceReason && (
            <div className="inline-block bg-rose-200/80 border border-rose-300 text-rose-950 font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded text-xs">
              ⚠️ 警告の具体要因: {dailyStaffing.complianceReason}
            </div>
          )}

          <p className="text-rose-900 font-medium text-xs sm:text-sm">
            {dailyStaffing.isEstimated ? '本日の通所予定人数' : '本日の出勤利用者数'}: <strong>{dailyStaffing.clientPresentCount}名</strong>（内勤 {dailyStaffing.inFacilityClientCount}名、施設外就労 {dailyStaffing.offsiteClientCount}名）
            {dailyStaffing.shortageMinutes === 0 ? (
              <span className="text-emerald-800 ml-2 font-bold">※総勤務時間は法定基準を満たしています。</span>
            ) : (
              <span className="text-rose-700 ml-2 font-bold">※直接処遇職員の勤務時間が不足しています。</span>
            )}
          </p>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2 bg-white/80 p-2.5 rounded border border-rose-200 text-xs">
            <div>
              <span className="text-muted-foreground block">必要常勤換算:</span>
              <strong className="text-rose-950 text-sm">{dailyStaffing.requiredFte}人</strong>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-muted-foreground block">法定必要勤務時間:</span>
              <strong className="text-rose-950 text-sm">
                {Math.floor(dailyStaffing.requiredMinutes / 60)}時間{(dailyStaffing.requiredMinutes % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0')}分
              </strong>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-muted-foreground block">本日職員勤務シフト:</span>
              <strong className="text-rose-950 text-sm">
                {Math.floor(dailyStaffing.actualStaffMinutes / 60)}時間{(dailyStaffing.actualStaffMinutes % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0')}分
              </strong> ({dailyStaffing.actualFte}人分)
            </div>
            <div>
              <span className="text-muted-foreground block font-bold">不足勤務時間:</span>
              {dailyStaffing.shortageMinutes > 0 ? (
                <strong className="text-rose-600 text-sm font-black">
                  -{Math.floor(dailyStaffing.shortageMinutes / 60)}時間{(dailyStaffing.shortageMinutes % 60).toString().padStart(2, '0')}分
                </strong>
              ) : (
                <strong className="text-emerald-700 text-sm font-black">
                  0時間00分（時間充足）
                </strong>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          {!dailyStaffing.isOffsiteCompliant && (
            <div className="bg-white/90 p-3 rounded border border-rose-200 text-xs text-rose-950 space-y-2">
              <p>
                📌 <strong>施設外就労引率職員の設定が必要です:</strong> 本日、施設外就労の利用者が <strong>{dailyStaffing.offsiteClientCount}名</strong> 出勤していますが、同行する専任引率職員が未登録です。実地指導基準に適合させるため、出欠管理で引率職員を指定するか、職員シフトで引率担当職員を登録してください。
              </p>
              {dailyStaffing.unassignedOffsiteClients && dailyStaffing.unassignedOffsiteClients.length > 0 && (
                <div className="pt-1">
                  <span className="font-bold text-rose-900 block mb-1">【引率未配置の対象利用者】</span>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                    {dailyStaffing.unassignedOffsiteClients.map((c, i) => (
                      <span key={i} className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 bg-rose-100 text-rose-900 px-2 py-0.5 rounded font-medium text-xs border border-rose-200">
                        <UserX className="w-3 h-3 text-rose-600" />
                        {c.clientName} ({c.workplaceName || '現場未指定'})
                      </span>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          <div className="pt-1 flex flex-wrap gap-4 text-xs font-semibold">
            <Link href={`/attendance?date=${todayStr}`} className="underline text-rose-900 hover:text-rose-700">
              → 本日の出欠管理で引率職員・状況を確認する
            </Link>
            <Link href="/staff/shifts" className="underline text-rose-900 hover:text-rose-700">
              → 職員シフトを調整する
            </Link>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import { useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { 
  Users, 
  FileText, 
  Clock, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  ClipboardList, 
  CreditCard, 
  ShieldAlert, 
  Building2, 
  ChevronRight, 
  ChevronDown, 
  ChevronUp, 
  Sparkles, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  CalendarDays, 
  UserCheck, 
  Settings, 
  DollarSign, 
  Award, 
  BookOpen, 
  HelpCircle,
  ExternalLink
} from "lucide-react";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Tabs, TabsContent, TabsList, TabsTrigger } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

import { DailyStaffingAlert } from "./DailyStaffingAlert";
import { CapacityAlertBanner } from "./CapacityAlertBanner";
import { ComplianceNotificationCenter } from "./ComplianceNotificationCenter";
import { IntegrityAlertBanner } from "./IntegrityAlertBanner";
import type { DailyStaffingStatus } from "@/lib/compliance/staffingCalculator";

interface DashboardClientProps {
  role: "admin" | "service_manager" | "staff";
  todayStr: string;
  currentMonth: string;
  dailyStaffing: DailyStaffingStatus;
  attendanceCounts: {
    present: number;
    absent: number;
    total: number;
  };
  integrityErrors: any[];
  // サビ管・管理者用
  facilitySettings?: any;
  complianceIssues?: string[];
  complianceItems?: any[];
  urgentComplianceCount?: number;
  monthlyStaffing?: any;
  staffCount?: number;
  clientCount?: number;
  expiringClients?: any[];
  expiringSupportPlans?: any[];
  uninterviewedClients?: any[];
  unevaluatedOffsiteClients?: any[];
  monitoringAlerts?: any[];
  upcomingCapacityAlerts?: any[];
  expiringContractors?: any[];
  expiringClientContracts?: any[];
  expiringPtoRecords?: any[];
  mandatoryPtoAlerts?: any[];
  displayScore?: string;
  totalHours?: number;
  totalDays?: number;
  deficitAlert?: string | null;
  offsiteAlert?: string | null;
  tunnelUrl?: string | null;
}

export function DashboardClient({
  role,
  todayStr,
  currentMonth,
  dailyStaffing,
  attendanceCounts,
  integrityErrors,
  facilitySettings,
  complianceIssues = [],
  complianceItems = [],
  urgentComplianceCount = 0,
  monthlyStaffing,
  staffCount = 0,
  clientCount = 0,
  expiringClients = [],
  expiringSupportPlans = [],
  uninterviewedClients = [],
  unevaluatedOffsiteClients = [],
  monitoringAlerts = [],
  upcomingCapacityAlerts = [],
  expiringContractors = [],
  expiringClientContracts = [],
  expiringPtoRecords = [],
  mandatoryPtoAlerts = [],
  displayScore = "0.0",
  totalHours = 0,
  totalDays = 0,
  deficitAlert = null,
  offsiteAlert = null,
  tunnelUrl = null,
}: DashboardClientProps) {
  const isAdmin = role === "admin";
  const isServiceManager = role === "service_manager";
  const isStaff = role === "staff";

  // アラート開閉アコーディオン（重大なエラーがある場合はデフォルトで開く）
  const hasCriticalAlerts = 
    integrityErrors.length > 0 || 
    !dailyStaffing.isCompliant || 
    (!dailyStaffing.isOffsiteCompliant && dailyStaffing.offsiteClientCount > 0) ||
    urgentComplianceCount > 0 ||
    monitoringAlerts.some(m => m.isOverdue) ||
    mandatoryPtoAlerts.some((m: any) => m.isCritical);

  const [showAlertDetails, setShowAlertDetails] = useState(hasCriticalAlerts);

  // 総アラート件数の集計
  const totalAlertCount = 
    integrityErrors.length + 
    (!dailyStaffing.isCompliant ? 1 : 0) +
    (!dailyStaffing.isOffsiteCompliant && dailyStaffing.offsiteClientCount > 0 ? 1 : 0) +
    upcomingCapacityAlerts.length +
    urgentComplianceCount +
    complianceIssues.length +
    monitoringAlerts.filter(m => m.isOverdue).length +
    mandatoryPtoAlerts.length;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {tunnelUrl && (
        <div className="bg-emerald-50/90 border border-emerald-200/80 px-3 py-2 sm:px-4 sm:py-2.5 rounded-lg sm:rounded-xl shadow-xs">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
              <span className="relative flex h-2 w-2 shrink-0">
                <span className="animate-ping absolute inline-flex h-full w-full rounded-full bg-emerald-400 opacity-75"></span>
                <span className="relative inline-flex rounded-full h-2 w-2 bg-emerald-500"></span>
              </span>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 sm:gap-2 min-w-0">
                <span className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-900 whitespace-nowrap">
                  リモート公開中
                </span>
                <code className="text-[11px] text-emerald-700 bg-white/90 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-emerald-200/70 truncate max-w-[130px] sm:max-w-xs font-mono font-medium">
                  {tunnelUrl}
                </code>
              </div>
            </div>

            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => {
                navigator.clipboard.writeText(tunnelUrl);
                alert("リモートURLをコピーしました！");
              }}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs font-medium bg-white hover:bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-300 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md transition-colors shadow-2xs shrink-0 active:scale-95"
            >
              <ClipboardList className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
              <span>URLコピー</span>
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ======================================================== */}
      {/* 1. 最上部: クイックアクション & 本日のステータスバー     */}
      {/* ======================================================== */}
      <div className="bg-card border rounded-xl shadow-xs p-4 sm:p-5">
        <div className="flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-4">
          
          {/* 左側: 日付と本日の利用人数サマリー */}
          <div className="space-y-1.5">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground bg-muted px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <CalendarDays className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-primary" />
                {todayStr}
              </span>
              <Badge variant="outline" className="font-bold text-xs">
                {isAdmin ? "管理者権限" : isServiceManager ? "サービス管理責任者" : "現場スタッフ"}
              </Badge>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-baseline gap-4 pt-1">
              <div>
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block font-medium">利用実績</span>
                <span className="text-2xl font-black text-primary">{dailyStaffing.clientPresentCount}</span>
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground ml-1">名利用</span>
              </div>
              <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground border-l pl-3 space-y-0.5">
                <div>内勤: <span className="font-bold text-foreground">{dailyStaffing.inFacilityClientCount}</span> 名</div>
                <div>施設外: <span className="font-bold text-emerald-600">{dailyStaffing.offsiteClientCount}</span> 名</div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground border-l pl-3 space-y-0.5">
                <div>欠席: <span className="font-bold text-rose-600">{attendanceCounts.absent}</span> 名</div>
                <div>未打刻: <span className="font-bold text-amber-600">{attendanceCounts.total - (dailyStaffing.clientPresentCount + attendanceCounts.absent)}</span> 名</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 右側: 毎日必ず使う「クイック直通ボタン」 */}
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 pt-2 lg:pt-0">
            <Link href="/attendance" className={cn(buttonVariants({ size: "sm" }), "font-bold shadow-xs bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white gap-1.5 h-9")}>
              <Clock className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>出欠・打刻</span>
            </Link>
            <Link href="/support-records" className={cn(buttonVariants({ size: "sm" }), "font-bold shadow-xs bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white gap-1.5 h-9")}>
              <FileText className="w-4 h-4" />
              <span>本日の支援記録</span>
            </Link>
            <Link href="/daily-logs" className={cn(buttonVariants({ size: "sm", variant: "outline" }), "font-bold gap-1.5 h-9")}>
              <BookOpen className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
              <span>業務日誌</span>
            </Link>
            {!isStaff && (
              <Link href="/plans" className={cn(buttonVariants({ size: "sm", variant: "outline" }), "font-bold gap-1.5 h-9 border-indigo-200 text-indigo-900 bg-indigo-50/50 hover:bg-indigo-100")}>
                <ClipboardList className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600" />
                <span>支援計画</span>
              </Link>
            )}
            {isAdmin && (
              <Link href="/billing" className={cn(buttonVariants({ size: "sm", variant: "secondary" }), "font-bold gap-1.5 h-9")}>
                <CreditCard className="w-4 h-4" />
                <span>国保連請求</span>
              </Link>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* ======================================================== */}
      {/* 2. 運営指導・日常確認事項（問題がある時だけ開閉して確認） */}
      {/* ======================================================== */}
      <div className="space-y-3">
        <div 
          onClick={() => setShowAlertDetails(!showAlertDetails)}
          className={cn(
            "flex items-center justify-between p-3 sm:px-4 rounded-lg border cursor-pointer transition-all shadow-2xs select-none",
            totalAlertCount > 0 
              ? hasCriticalAlerts 
                ? "bg-rose-50/90 border-rose-200 text-rose-950 hover:bg-rose-100/80" 
                : "bg-amber-50/90 border-amber-200 text-amber-950 hover:bg-amber-100/80"
              : "bg-emerald-50/70 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-950 hover:bg-emerald-100/60"
          )}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
            {totalAlertCount > 0 ? (
              <AlertTriangle className={cn("w-5 h-5 shrink-0", hasCriticalAlerts ? "text-rose-600" : "text-amber-600")} />
            ) : (
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
            )}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
              <span className="font-bold text-sm">
                {totalAlertCount > 0 
                  ? `【アラート】現在確認が必要な項目が ${totalAlertCount} 件あります`
                  : "【正常】人員配置・支援計画・コンプライアンス状況はすべて適正です"
                }
              </span>
              {integrityErrors.length > 0 && (
                <Badge variant="destructive" className="text-[11px] px-2 py-0">
                  不整合 {integrityErrors.length}件
                </Badge>
              )}
              {!dailyStaffing.isCompliant && (
                <Badge variant="destructive" className="text-[11px] px-2 py-0">
                  人員配置要対応
                </Badge>
              )}
              {!dailyStaffing.isOffsiteCompliant && dailyStaffing.offsiteClientCount > 0 && (
                <Badge className="bg-rose-600 text-[11px] px-2 py-0">
                  引率未登録
                </Badge>
              )}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs font-semibold shrink-0">
            <span>{showAlertDetails ? "詳細を折りたたむ" : "詳細を展開して確認"}</span>
            {showAlertDetails ? <ChevronUp className="w-4 h-4" /> : <ChevronDown className="w-4 h-4" />}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* アラート詳細（展開時） */}
        {showAlertDetails && (
          <div className="space-y-4 pt-1 animate-in fade-in-50 duration-200">
            {/* 勤怠と支援記録の不整合エラー */}
            <IntegrityAlertBanner errors={integrityErrors} />

            {/* 本日の人員配置基準チェック */}
            <DailyStaffingAlert 
              dailyStaffing={dailyStaffing} 
              todayStr={todayStr} 
              role={role} 
            />

            {/* 内勤受入上限超過アラート */}
            <CapacityAlertBanner alerts={upcomingCapacityAlerts} />

            {/* 実地指導・コンプライアンス通知センター（サビ管・管理者のみ） */}
            {!isStaff && (
              <ComplianceNotificationCenter 
                role={role}
                expiringSupportPlans={expiringSupportPlans}
                monitoringAlerts={monitoringAlerts}
                expiringClients={expiringClients}
                uninterviewedClients={uninterviewedClients}
                unevaluatedOffsiteClients={unevaluatedOffsiteClients}
                complianceIssues={complianceIssues}
                complianceItems={complianceItems}
                urgentComplianceCount={urgentComplianceCount}
                monthlyStaffing={monthlyStaffing}
                deficitAlert={deficitAlert}
                offsiteAlert={offsiteAlert}
                expiringContractors={expiringContractors}
                expiringClientContracts={expiringClientContracts}
                expiringPtoRecords={expiringPtoRecords}
                mandatoryPtoAlerts={mandatoryPtoAlerts}
              />
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* ======================================================== */}
      {/* 3. 管理者向け経営サマリー（平均労働時間・利用集計）     */}
      {/* ======================================================== */}
      {isAdmin && (
        <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
          <Card className="border-l-4 border-l-primary shadow-2xs">
            <CardHeader className="py-3 px-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <CardTitle className="text-sm font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Clock className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                  今月の平均労働時間（スコア計算用）
                </CardTitle>
                <Link
                  href="/billing/simulation"
                  className="text-xs text-primary font-bold hover:underline flex items-center gap-0.5"
                >
                  次年度試算へ <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </Link>
              </div>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="px-4 pb-3 pt-0">
              <div className="flex items-baseline gap-2">
                <span className="text-3xl font-black text-foreground">{displayScore}</span>
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">時間 / 日</span>
                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground ml-auto">
                  総 {totalHours.toFixed(1)}h ÷ {totalDays}日稼働
                </span>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="border-l-4 border-l-emerald-600 shadow-2xs">
            <CardHeader className="py-3 px-4">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <CardTitle className="text-sm font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Award className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600" />
                  令和6年度 スコア・報酬シミュレーション
                </CardTitle>
                <Link
                  href="/billing/simulation"
                  className="text-xs text-emerald-700 font-bold hover:underline flex items-center gap-0.5"
                >
                  シミュレーションへ <ChevronRight className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                </Link>
              </div>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="px-4 pb-3 pt-0">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs">
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">生産活動収支・多様な働き方・支援力向上</span>
                <Link 
                  href="/billing/simulation" 
                  className="font-bold text-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50 hover:bg-indigo-100 px-2.5 py-1 rounded border border-indigo-200 flex items-center gap-1"
                >
                  <span>スコア表を確認</span>
                  <ChevronRight className="w-3 h-3" />
                </Link>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* ======================================================== */}

import { AlertTriangle } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export function IntegrityAlertBanner({ errors }: { errors: any[] }) {
  if (!errors || errors.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className="rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50 p-4 w-full shadow-sm">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-2">
        <AlertTriangle className="h-5 w-5 text-red-600" />
        <h5 className="text-red-800 font-bold">
          勤怠実績と支援記録の不整合エラー ({errors.length}件)
        </h5>
      </div>
      <div className="text-red-700 text-sm mb-3">
        実地指導や労働基準監査において重大な指摘事項となる可能性があります。至急、以下の記録を確認・修正してください。
      </div>
      <div className="max-h-60 overflow-y-auto bg-white rounded-md border border-red-100 p-2 shadow-inner">
        <ul className="space-y-2 text-sm">
          {errors.map((error, idx) => (
            <li key={idx} className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 p-2 border-b border-red-50 last:border-0 hover:bg-red-50/50 transition-colors">
              <div className="flex-1">
                <span className="font-semibold px-2 py-0.5 bg-red-100 text-red-800 rounded mr-2 text-xs">
                  {error.recordDate}
                </span>
                <span className="font-medium mr-2 text-foreground">{error.clientName}</span>
                <span className="text-muted-foreground">{error.message}</span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex gap-2 shrink-0">
                <Link 
                  href={`/attendance?date=${error.recordDate}`}
                  className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm" }), "h-7 text-xs")}
                >
                  勤怠確認
                </Link>
                <Link 
                  href={`/support-records?date=${error.recordDate}`}
                  className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm" }), "h-7 text-xs")}
                >
                  支援記録確認
                </Link>
              </div>
            </li>
          ))}
        </ul>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

  };

'use client';

import { useState } from "react";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { saveContractor, deleteContractor } from "./actions";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { ChevronLeft, Trash2 } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";

export function ContractorForm({ initialData, isEdit = false }: { initialData: any, isEdit?: boolean }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [formData, setFormData] = useState(initialData);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);

  const handleChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement | HTMLTextAreaElement>) => {
    setFormData({ ...formData, [e.target.name]: e.target.value });
  };

  const handleSave = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsSaving(true);
    try {
      const res = await saveContractor(formData);
      if (res && !res.success) {
        toast.error(res.error);
        setIsSaving(false);
        return;
      }
      toast.success("請負契約を保存しました");
      router.push("/contractors");
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(err.message || "保存に失敗しました");
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!confirm("本当にこの請負契約を削除しますか？")) return;
    try {
      const res = await deleteContractor(formData.id);
      if (res && !res.success) {
        toast.error(res.error);
        return;
      }
      toast.success("削除しました");
      router.push("/contractors");
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(err.message || "削除に失敗しました（権限がありません）");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
        <Button variant="outline" size="icon" onClick={() => router.push('/contractors')} type="button">
          <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
        </Button>
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">{isEdit ? "請負契約の編集" : "請負契約の新規登録"}</h1>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <CardHeader>
          <CardTitle>契約情報</CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>派遣先企業との請負契約内容を入力します。</CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <form onSubmit={handleSave} className="space-y-4">
            
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>企業名 <span className="text-red-500">*</span></Label>
              <Input 
                name="company_name" 
                value={formData.company_name || ""} 
                onChange={handleChange} 
                required 
                placeholder="株式会社サンプル"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>業務内容</Label>
              <Textarea 
                name="work_description" 
                value={formData.work_description || ""} 
                onChange={handleChange}
                placeholder="箱詰め作業、清掃業務など"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>契約開始日 <span className="text-red-500">*</span></Label>
                <Input 
                  type="date" 
                  name="contract_start_date" 
                  value={formData.contract_start_date || ""} 
                  onChange={handleChange} 
                  required 
                />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>契約終了日 <span className="text-red-500">*</span></Label>
                <Input 
                  type="date" 
                  name="contract_end_date" 
                  value={formData.contract_end_date || ""} 
                  onChange={handleChange} 
                  required 
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>契約全体金額（円）</Label>
                <Input 
                  type="number" 
                  name="contract_amount" 
                  value={formData.contract_amount || ""} 
                  onChange={handleChange} 
                  placeholder="50000"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>単価（円）</Label>
                <Input 
                  type="number" 
                  name="unit_price" 
                  value={formData.unit_price || ""} 
                  onChange={handleChange} 
                  placeholder="1000"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>月間想定売上（円）</Label>
                <Input 
                  type="number" 
                  name="expected_monthly_revenue" 
                  value={formData.expected_monthly_revenue || ""} 
                  onChange={handleChange} 
                  placeholder="150000"
                />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label>配置想定人数</Label>
                <Input 
                  type="number" 
                  name="assigned_clients_count" 
                  value={formData.assigned_clients_count || ""} 
                  onChange={handleChange} 
                  placeholder="5"
                />
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>備考</Label>
              <Textarea 
                name="notes" 
                value={formData.notes || ""} 
                onChange={handleChange} 
                rows={3}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="pt-6 flex gap-4">
              <Button type="submit" disabled={isSaving} className="flex-1">
                {isSaving ? "保存中..." : "保存する"}
              </Button>
              {isEdit && (
                <Button type="button" variant="destructive" size="icon" onClick={handleDelete}>
                  <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>

          </form>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState } from "react";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { Plus, Edit, AlertTriangle } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";

export function ContractorsClient({ initialContractors, isAdmin }: any) {
  const [contractors] = useState<any[]>(initialContractors);
  
  const today = new Date();
  const nextMonth = new Date();
  nextMonth.setMonth(today.getMonth() + 1);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight">請負契約管理</h1>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1">施設外就労等の派遣先企業との請負契約を管理します。</p>
        </div>
        <Button asChild>
          <Link href="/contractors/new">
            <Plus className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
            新規登録
          </Link>
        </Button>
      </div>

      <Card>
        <CardContent className="p-0">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <Table>
              <TableHeader>
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead>ステータス</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>企業名</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>業務内容</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>契約期間</TableHead>
                  <TableHead>請負金額</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right">操作</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {contractors.map((c) => {
                  const endDate = new Date(c.contract_end_date);
                  let status = "有効";
                  let badgeVariant: "default" | "destructive" | "secondary" = "default";
                  
                  if (endDate < today) {
                    status = "期限切れ";
                    badgeVariant = "destructive";
                  } else if (endDate <= nextMonth) {
                    status = "更新間近";
                    badgeVariant = "secondary";
                  }

                  return (
                    <TableRow key={c.id}>
                      <TableCell>
                        <Badge variant={badgeVariant}>
                          {status === "期限切れ" || status === "更新間近" ? <AlertTriangle className="w-3 h-3 mr-1" /> : null}
                          {status}
                        </Badge>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="font-medium">{c.company_name}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{c.work_description}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>{c.contract_start_date} 〜 {c.contract_end_date}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell>¥{c.contract_amount?.toLocaleString()}</TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right">
                        <Button asChild variant="ghost" size="icon">
                          <Link href={`/contractors/${c.id}/edit`}>
                            <Edit className="w-4 h-4" />
                          </Link>
                        </Button>
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  );
                })}
                {contractors.length === 0 && (
                  <TableRow>
                    <TableCell colSpan={6} className="text-center py-8 text-muted-foreground">
                      登録されている請負契約はありません。
                    </TableCell>
                  </TableRow>
                )}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

import { Header } from "@/components/Header";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";

import { notFound, redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { ContractorForm } from "../../ContractorForm";
import { getContractor } from "../../actions";

export default async function EditContractorPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ id: string }> }) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) redirect("/login");

  const resolvedParams = await params;
  await resolveServiceModeForContractor(resolvedParams.id);
  const contractor = await getContractor(resolvedParams.id);
  
  if (!contractor) notFound();

  return (

        <ContractorForm initialData={contractor} isEdit />
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}


================================================================================
File: src/app/contractors/actions.ts
================================================================================

'use server';

import { db, resolveServiceModeForContractor } from "@/lib/db";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from "uuid";
import { contractorSchema, getFirstZodErrorMessage } from "@/lib/validations";

export async function getContractors() {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role) return [];
    return db.prepare('SELECT * FROM contractor_agreements WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY contract_end_date ASC').all();
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Failed to get contractors:", error);
    return [];
  }
}

export async function getContractor(id: string) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role) return null;
    await resolveServiceModeForContractor(id);
    return db.prepare('SELECT * FROM contractor_agreements WHERE id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL').get(id);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Failed to get contractor:", error);
    return null;
  }
}

export async function saveContractor(data: any) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role) return { success: false, error: '認証されていません。ログインしてください。' };

    const parseResult = contractorSchema.safeParse(data);
    if (!parseResult.success) {
      return { success: false, error: getFirstZodErrorMessage(parseResult.error) };
    }
    const parsedData = parseResult.data;

    const id = parsedData.id && parsedData.id !== "new" ? parsedData.id : uuidv4();
    
    if (parsedData.id && parsedData.id !== "new") {
      await resolveServiceModeForContractor(id);
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE contractor_agreements SET
          company_name = ?, work_description = ?, contract_start_date = ?, contract_end_date = ?, contract_amount = ?, 
          unit_price = ?, expected_monthly_revenue = ?, assigned_clients_count = ?, notes = ?
        WHERE id = ?
      `).run(
        parsedData.company_name, parsedData.work_description, parsedData.contract_start_date, parsedData.contract_end_date, parsedData.contract_amount,
        parsedData.unit_price, parsedData.expected_monthly_revenue, parsedData.assigned_clients_count, parsedData.notes, id
      );
    } else {
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO contractor_agreements (id, company_name, work_description, contract_start_date, contract_end_date, contract_amount, unit_price, expected_monthly_revenue, assigned_clients_count, notes)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(
        id, parsedData.company_name, parsedData.work_description, parsedData.contract_start_date, parsedData.contract_end_date, parsedData.contract_amount,
        parsedData.unit_price, parsedData.expected_monthly_revenue, parsedData.assigned_clients_count, parsedData.notes
      );
    }

    try {
      revalidatePath('/contractors');
      revalidatePath('/');
    } catch (e) {}
    return { success: true, id };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Failed to save contractor:", error);
    return { success: false, error: error.message || '受託先の保存に失敗しました' };
  }
}

export async function deleteContractor(id: string) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (role !== 'admin') return { success: false, error: '管理者権限が必要です' };

    await resolveServiceModeForContractor(id);
    db.prepare('UPDATE contractor_agreements SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?').run(id);
    try {
      revalidatePath('/contractors');
      revalidatePath('/');
    } catch (e) {}
    return { success: true };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Failed to delete contractor:", error);
    return { success: false, error: error.message || '受託先の削除に失敗しました' };
  }
}

import { Header } from "@/components/Header";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";

'use client'

import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { Input } from '@/components/ui/input'

export function DailyLogDateInput({ defaultValue, departmentId }: { defaultValue: string; departmentId?: string }) {
  const router = useRouter()

  return (
    <Input 
      type="date" 
      name="date" 
      defaultValue={defaultValue} 
      className="w-[160px]"
      onChange={(e) => {
        if (e.target.value) {
          const url = departmentId 
            ? `/daily-logs?date=${e.target.value}&departmentId=${encodeURIComponent(departmentId)}`
            : `/daily-logs?date=${e.target.value}`
          router.push(url)
        }
      }}
    />
  )
}

import { saveDailyLog } from "./actions"
import { toast } from "sonner"
import { Sparkles, Users, Building, Car, UtensilsCrossed, PhoneCall } from "lucide-react"

export function DailyLogForm({ 
  targetDate,
  departmentId,
  departmentName = '拠点',
  initialData,
  stats = {
    totalPresent: 0,
    inFacility: 0,
    offsite: 0,
    remote: 0,
    absent: 0,
    absenceAddition: 0,
    transport: 0,
    meal: 0,
    offsiteNames: []
  }
}: { 
  targetDate: string,
  departmentId?: string,
  departmentName?: string,
  initialData?: any,
  stats?: {
    totalPresent: number;
    inFacility: number;
    offsite: number;
    remote: number;
    absent: number;
    absenceAddition: number;
    transport: number;
    meal: number;
    offsiteNames: string[];
  }
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [activitiesSummary, setActivitiesSummary] = useState(initialData?.activities_summary || "");

  const locLabel = departmentName;

  const handleAutoGenerateSummary = () => {
    const offsiteStr = stats.offsiteNames.length > 0 ? `（${stats.offsiteNames.join('、')}）` : '';
    const generated = `【本日の稼働概況（${locLabel}・勤怠自動集計）】
・利用者出勤: 計 ${stats.totalPresent}名（施設内: ${stats.inFacility}名、施設外就労: ${stats.offsite}名${offsiteStr}${stats.remote > 0 ? `、在宅: ${stats.remote}名` : ''}）
・欠席: ${stats.absent}名${stats.absenceAddition > 0 ? `（うち欠席時対応加算算定: ${stats.absenceAddition}名、電話連絡・相談済）` : ''}
・支援提供: 送迎利用 ${stats.transport}名、昼食提供 ${stats.meal}食

【作業・支援の状況】
・各担当作業（施設内軽作業および施設外就労作業）ともに作業手順・安全基準を順守して円滑に実施。
・支援員による適時の声かけと作業進捗確認を行い、集中して作業に取り組めた。特段の体調異変や事故等の発生なし。`;

    setActivitiesSummary(generated);
    toast.success(`${locLabel}の勤怠集計データから活動サマリーを自動生成しました`);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (formData: FormData) => {
    try {
      const res = await saveDailyLog(formData);
      if (res && !res.success) {
        toast.error(res.error);
        return;
      }
      toast.success(`${locLabel}の業務日誌を保存しました`);
      if (res?.recordDate) {
        router.push(`/daily-logs?date=${res.recordDate}&departmentId=${res.departmentId || departmentId}`);
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast.error(e.message || "エラーが発生しました");
    }
  };

  return (
    <form action={handleSubmit} className="space-y-6">
      <input type="hidden" name="recordDate" value={targetDate} />
      <input type="hidden" name="departmentId" value={departmentId} />
      
      {/* 勤怠リアルタイム連動インフォメーション */}
      <div className="bg-slate-50 border rounded-lg p-4 space-y-3">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
          <div className="text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1.5">
            <Users className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
            <span>本日の勤怠実績集計（勤怠打刻とリアルタイム連動）</span>
          </div>
          <Button 
            type="button" 
            variant="outline" 
            size="sm" 
            onClick={handleAutoGenerateSummary}
            className="h-8 text-xs font-medium text-indigo-700 border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/50 hover:bg-indigo-100 flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow-2xs"
          >
            <Sparkles className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-indigo-600" />
            勤怠から活動サマリーを自動生成
          </Button>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 md:grid-cols-6 gap-2 pt-1 text-xs">
          <div className="bg-white p-2.5 rounded border">
            <div className="text-muted-foreground font-medium">出勤総数</div>
            <div className="text-lg font-bold text-primary">{stats.totalPresent} 名</div>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-white p-2.5 rounded border">
            <div className="text-muted-foreground font-medium">施設内作業</div>
            <div className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-800">{stats.inFacility} 名</div>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-white p-2.5 rounded border">
            <div className="text-muted-foreground font-medium flex items-center gap-1">
              <Building className="h-3 w-3 text-indigo-500" /> 施設外就労
            </div>
            <div className="text-lg font-bold text-indigo-700">{stats.offsite} 名</div>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-white p-2.5 rounded border">
            <div className="text-muted-foreground font-medium flex items-center gap-1">
              <Car className="h-3 w-3 text-emerald-500" /> 送迎利用
            </div>
            <div className="text-lg font-bold text-emerald-700">{stats.transport} 名</div>
          </div>
          <div className="bg-white p-2.5 rounded border">
            <div className="text-muted-foreground font-medium flex items-center gap-1">

        {stats.offsiteNames.length > 0 && (
          <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1 pt-1">

            ))}
          </div>

      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
        <div className="space-y-2">
          <Label htmlFor="weather">天気</Label>
          <select 
            id="weather" 
            name="weather" 
            defaultValue={initialData?.weather || "晴れ"}

          >
            <option value="晴れ">晴れ</option>

            <option value="雪">雪</option>
          </select>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">

        <Textarea

File: src/app/daily-logs/actions.ts

'use server'

import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache'
import { db, sanitizeForeignKeyId } from '@/lib/db'
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid'
import { getRole } from '@/lib/auth'
import { dailyLogSchema, getFirstZodErrorMessage } from '@/lib/validations'
import { getActiveDepartments } from '@/lib/location'

export async function saveDailyLog(formData: FormData) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole()
    if (!role) return { success: false, error: '認証されていません。ログインしてください。' }

    const parseResult = dailyLogSchema.safeParse({
      recordDate: formData.get('recordDate'),
      departmentId: formData.get('departmentId') as string || undefined,
      weather: formData.get('weather') as string || '',
      staffOnDuty: formData.get('staffOnDuty') as string || '',
      activitiesSummary: formData.get('activitiesSummary') as string || '',
      notes: formData.get('notes') as string || '',
    })

    if (!parseResult.success) {
      return { success: false, error: getFirstZodErrorMessage(parseResult.error) }
    }
    const parsedData = parseResult.data

    const activeDepartments = getActiveDepartments();
    const rawDepartmentId = parsedData.departmentId || activeDepartments[0]?.id || null;
    const departmentId = sanitizeForeignKeyId('departments', rawDepartmentId) || activeDepartments[0]?.id || null;

    // Calculate total present clients for this department automatically
    const presentCountRow = db.prepare(`
      SELECT COUNT(*) as cnt 
      FROM attendance_records a
      JOIN clients c ON a.client_id = c.id
      WHERE a.record_date = ? AND a.status = 'present' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND (c.department_id = ? OR (? IS NULL AND c.department_id IS NULL))
    `).get(parsedData.recordDate, departmentId, departmentId) as any;

    const totalPresent = presentCountRow ? presentCountRow.cnt : 0;

    const stmt = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO daily_logs (
        id, record_date, department_id, weather, total_present, staff_on_duty, activities_summary, notes
      ) VALUES (
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?
      )
      ON CONFLICT(record_date, department_id) DO UPDATE SET
        weather = excluded.weather,
        total_present = excluded.total_present,
        staff_on_duty = excluded.staff_on_duty,
        activities_summary = excluded.activities_summary,
        notes = excluded.notes,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    `);

    stmt.run(
      uuidv4(),
      parsedData.recordDate,
      departmentId,
      parsedData.weather,
      totalPresent,
      parsedData.staffOnDuty,
      parsedData.activitiesSummary,
      parsedData.notes
    );

    try {
      revalidatePath('/daily-logs')
    } catch (e) {}
    return { success: true, recordDate: parsedData.recordDate, departmentId }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('業務日誌保存エラー:', error)
    return { success: false, error: '業務日誌の保存に失敗しました' }
  }
}

File: src/app/daily-logs/page.tsx

import { Header } from "@/components/Header"
import { SupportSubNav } from "@/components/NavigationTabs"
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card"
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
import { Printer, ChevronLeft, ChevronRight } from "lucide-react"
import { toLocalISODate } from "@/lib/utils"
import { db } from "@/lib/db"
import Link from "next/link"
import { DailyLogForm } from "./DailyLogForm"
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth"
import { redirect } from "next/navigation"
import { PrintButton } from "@/app/plans/[id]/PrintButton"
import { DailyLogDateInput } from "./DailyLogDateInput"
import { getActiveDepartments } from "@/lib/location"

export default async function DailyLogsPage({
  searchParams,
}: {
  searchParams: Promise<{ date?: string; departmentId?: string }>
}) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) {
    redirect("/login");
  }

  const activeDepartments = getActiveDepartments();
  const resolvedParams = await searchParams;
  const rawDepartmentId = resolvedParams.departmentId;
  const activeDepartmentId = (rawDepartmentId && activeDepartments.some(d => d.id === rawDepartmentId)
    ? rawDepartmentId
    : activeDepartments[0]?.id) || null;

  const now = new Date()
  const todayStr = toLocalISODate(now)
  const targetDate = resolvedParams.date || todayStr

  const targetDateObj = new Date(targetDate)
  
  const prevDateObj = new Date(targetDateObj)
  prevDateObj.setDate(prevDateObj.getDate() - 1)
  const prevDateStr = toLocalISODate(prevDateObj)
  
  const nextDateObj = new Date(targetDateObj)
  nextDateObj.setDate(nextDateObj.getDate() + 1)
  const nextDateStr = toLocalISODate(nextDateObj)

  // 既存の業務日誌を取得（拠点別）
  const log = db.prepare(`
    SELECT * FROM daily_logs 
    WHERE record_date = ? 
      AND (department_id = ? OR (? IS NULL AND department_id IS NULL))
  `).get(targetDate, activeDepartmentId, activeDepartmentId) as any;

  // 勤怠のリアルタイム詳細集計（選択拠点の所属利用者のみを集計）
  const statsRow = db.prepare(`
    SELECT 
      COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 'present' THEN 1 END) as present_cnt,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 'present' AND (a.work_type = 'in_facility' OR a.work_type IS NULL) THEN 1 END) as in_facility_cnt,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 'present' AND a.work_type = 'out_facility' THEN 1 END) as offsite_cnt,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 'present' AND a.work_type = 'remote' THEN 1 END) as remote_cnt,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 'absent' THEN 1 END) as absent_cnt,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 'absent' AND a.is_absence_addition = 1 THEN 1 END) as absence_addition_cnt,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 'present' AND (a.transportation_used = 1 OR a.pickup_used = 1 OR a.dropoff_used = 1) THEN 1 END) as transport_cnt,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN a.status = 'present' AND a.meal_provided = 1 THEN 1 END) as meal_cnt
    FROM attendance_records a
    JOIN clients c ON a.client_id = c.id
    WHERE a.record_date = ? AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND (c.department_id = ? OR (? IS NULL AND c.department_id IS NULL))
  `).get(targetDate, activeDepartmentId, activeDepartmentId) as any || {};

  // 当日利用された施設外就労先企業名（選択拠点のみ）
  const offsiteCompanies = db.prepare(`
    SELECT DISTINCT w.name 
    FROM attendance_records a
    JOIN clients c ON a.client_id = c.id
    JOIN offsite_workplaces w ON a.offsite_workplace_id = w.id
    WHERE a.record_date = ? AND a.status = 'present' AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND (c.department_id = ? OR (? IS NULL AND c.department_id IS NULL))
  `).all(targetDate, activeDepartmentId, activeDepartmentId) as any[];
  const offsiteNames = offsiteCompanies.map((c: any) => c.name);

  const stats = {
    totalPresent: statsRow.present_cnt || 0,
    inFacility: statsRow.in_facility_cnt || 0,
    offsite: statsRow.offsite_cnt || 0,
    remote: statsRow.remote_cnt || 0,
    absent: statsRow.absent_cnt || 0,
    absenceAddition: statsRow.absence_addition_cnt || 0,
    transport: statsRow.transport_cnt || 0,
    meal: statsRow.meal_cnt || 0,
    offsiteNames
  };

  // 表示用に曜日をフォーマット
  const dateStrJp = targetDateObj.toLocaleDateString('ja-JP', { year: 'numeric', month: 'long', day: 'numeric', weekday: 'short' });

  const staffShifts = db.prepare(`
    SELECT ss.*, s.name, s.job_category, s.employment_type
    FROM staff_shifts ss
    JOIN staff s ON ss.staff_id = s.id AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
    WHERE ss.target_date = ? AND (ss.is_holiday = 0 OR ss.is_other_facility = 1 OR ss.is_offsite = 1)
    ORDER BY ss.scheduled_in
  `).all(targetDate) as any[];

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background/50">
      <div className="print:hidden">
        <Header activePage="daily-logs" />
        <SupportSubNav />
      </div>

      <main className="flex-1 p-3.5 sm:p-6 md:p-12 print:p-0">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-4xl space-y-6 print:max-w-none print:space-y-0">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4 print:hidden">
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">業務日誌</h1>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm sm:text-lg text-muted-foreground">
                事業所の一日の動きを記録・出力します。
              </p>
            </div>
            
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 w-full sm:w-auto">
              <PrintButton />
              <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                <Link href={`/daily-logs?date=${prevDateStr}&departmentId=${activeDepartmentId}`} className="p-2 border rounded hover:bg-muted">
                  <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4" />
                </Link>
                <DailyLogDateInput defaultValue={targetDate} departmentId={activeDepartmentId || undefined} />
                <Link href={`/daily-logs?date=${nextDateStr}&departmentId=${activeDepartmentId}`} className="p-2 border rounded hover:bg-muted">
                  <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4" />
                </Link>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 🏢 業務日誌 拠点切り替えタブ */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2 bg-muted/30 border rounded-xl shadow-2xs print:hidden overflow-x-auto whitespace-nowrap">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground px-2 shrink-0">日誌対象拠点:</span>
            {activeDepartments.map(dep => (
              <Link
                key={dep.id}
                href={`/daily-logs?date=${targetDate}&departmentId=${dep.id}`}
                className={buttonVariants({
                  variant: activeDepartmentId === dep.id ? 'default' : 'outline',
                  size: 'sm',
                  className: `h-8 px-4 text-xs font-bold shrink-0 ${
                    activeDepartmentId === dep.id
                      ? 'bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-700 text-white shadow-xs'
                      : 'border-sky-200 text-sky-800 hover:bg-sky-50'
                  }`
                })}
              >
                {dep.facility_type === 'satellite' ? '🛰️' : '🏢'} {dep.name}の日誌
              </Link>
            ))}
            <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground ml-auto hidden sm:inline shrink-0">
              現在: <strong className="text-foreground">{activeDepartments.find(d => d.id === activeDepartmentId)?.name || ''}</strong> の日誌を表示・編集中
            </span>
          </div>

          <Card className="shadow-sm">
            <CardHeader className="bg-primary/5 border-b pb-4 flex flex-row items-center justify-between">
              <div>
                <CardTitle className="text-xl">
                  {dateStrJp} の業務日誌（{activeDepartments.find(d => d.id === activeDepartmentId)?.name || ''}）
                </CardTitle>
              </div>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="pt-6">
              <DailyLogForm 
                targetDate={targetDate} 
                departmentId={activeDepartmentId || undefined}
                departmentName={activeDepartments.find(d => d.id === activeDepartmentId)?.name || ''}
                initialData={log} 
                stats={stats}
              />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="shadow-sm">
            <CardHeader className="bg-primary/5 border-b pb-4">
              <CardTitle className="text-xl">本日の職員シフト</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="p-0">
              {staffShifts && staffShifts.length > 0 ? (
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="w-full text-sm text-left">
                    <thead className="bg-muted/50 text-muted-foreground">
                      <tr>
                        <th className="px-6 py-3 font-medium">職員名</th>
                        <th className="px-6 py-3 font-medium">職種</th>
                        <th className="px-6 py-3 font-medium">出勤予定</th>
                        <th className="px-6 py-3 font-medium">退勤予定</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y border-b">
                      {staffShifts.map((shift: any) => {
                        const isOther = shift.is_other_facility === 1;
                        const isOffsite = shift.is_offsite === 1 || ['施設外', '施設外引率', '引率'].includes(shift.holiday_type);

                        return (
                          <tr key={shift.id} className="hover:bg-muted/30">
                            <td className="px-6 py-4 font-medium">
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 flex-wrap">
                                <span>{shift.name}</span>
                                {isOther && (
                                  <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-semibold bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 border border-purple-200">
                                    {shift.other_facility_name || 'GH勤務'} (A型配置対象外)
                                  </span>
                                )}
                                {isOffsite && (
                                  <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-semibold bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 border border-amber-300">
                                    施設外引率 (専任引率 / 内勤配置除外)
                                  </span>
                                )}
                              </div>
                            </td>
                            <td className="px-6 py-4">{shift.job_category || '未設定'}</td>
                            <td className="px-6 py-4">{shift.scheduled_in || (isOther ? '他事業所' : isOffsite ? '09:00' : '--:--')}</td>
                            <td className="px-6 py-4">{shift.scheduled_out || (isOther ? '勤務' : isOffsite ? '18:00' : '--:--')}</td>
                          </tr>
                        );
                      })}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="p-8 text-center text-muted-foreground">
                  本日のシフトが設定されている職員はいません。
                </div>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  )
}

'use client';
import { useEffect } from 'react';

export default function Error({ error, reset }: { error: Error & { digest?: string }; reset: () => void }) {
  useEffect(() => { console.error(error); }, [error]);
  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center justify-center min-h-screen p-8">
      <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold text-red-600 mb-4">エラーが発生しました</h2>
      <p className="text-gray-600 mb-6">申し訳ございません。予期せぬエラーが発生しました。</p>
      <button onClick={reset} className="px-6 py-3 bg-primary text-white rounded-md hover:bg-primary/90">もう一度試す</button>
    </div>
  );
}

export function LoginFormClient({ initialServiceMode }: LoginFormClientProps) {

  const isCorporate = selectedMode === 'corporate';

  return (

              {config.category}
            </span>
          </div>
          <CardTitle className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-tight">
            {config.fullName}

            {config.lawBasis}

              <span>▼ 起動する事業所・サービスを選択</span>

          <div className={`inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium border ${config.activeBadgeBg}`}>
            <CheckCircle2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" style={{ color: config.themeColor }} />
            <span>データベース: {config.dbName}</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </CardHeader>

      <CardContent className="space-y-3.5 pt-0 pb-7 px-6">
        <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 mb-1 flex items-center justify-between">
          <span>ログインする権限を選択してください:</span>
          <span className="text-[11px] font-normal text-slate-400">ワンクリック認証</span>
        </div>

        {/* 1. 管理者 */}
        <form action={loginAsAdmin}>
          <input type="hidden" name="serviceMode" value={selectedMode} />
          <button 
            type="submit"
            className="w-full h-13 py-3 px-4 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm sm:text-base transition-all shadow-md flex items-center justify-between text-white active:scale-[0.99] group"
            style={{ backgroundColor: config.themeColor }}
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <ShieldCheck className="w-5 h-5 flex-shrink-0" />
              <span>
                {isCorporate 
                  ? '法人統括代表（管理者）としてログイン' 
                  : '管理者としてログイン'}
              </span>
            </div>
            <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 opacity-70 group-hover:translate-x-0.5 transition-transform" />
          </button>
        </form>

        {/* 2. サービス管理責任者 / 児発管 */}
        <form action={loginAsServiceManager}>
          <input type="hidden" name="serviceMode" value={selectedMode} />
          <button 
            type="submit"
            className="w-full h-13 py-3 px-4 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm sm:text-base transition-all shadow-sm flex items-center justify-between bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-900 text-white active:scale-[0.99] group"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <UserCheck className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-400 flex-shrink-0" />
              <span className="truncate">{config.roleManagerTitle}</span>
            </div>
            <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 opacity-70 group-hover:translate-x-0.5 transition-transform" />
          </button>
        </form>

        {/* 3. 支援員 / 指導員 / 世話人 */}
        <form action={loginAsStaff}>
          <input type="hidden" name="serviceMode" value={selectedMode} />
          <button 
            type="submit"
            className="w-full h-13 py-3 px-4 rounded-xl font-bold text-sm sm:text-base transition-all shadow-sm flex items-center justify-between bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-800 border-2 border-slate-200 active:scale-[0.99] group"
          >
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <Users className="w-5 h-5 text-slate-600 flex-shrink-0" />
              <span className="truncate">{config.roleStaffTitle}</span>
            </div>
            <ArrowRight className="w-4 h-4 opacity-70 group-hover:translate-x-0.5 transition-transform" />
          </button>
        </form>

        <div className="pt-2 text-center text-[11px] text-slate-400">
          ※ 選択した事業所の専用ダッシュボード・専用データベースに直接接続します
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}

'use server'

import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'
import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache'
import { setRole, logout as clearCookie } from '@/lib/auth'
import { setServiceMode, getServiceMode, ServiceMode } from '@/lib/serviceModeServer'

function parseServiceMode(formData?: FormData): ServiceMode | undefined {
  if (!formData) return undefined;
  const mode = formData.get('serviceMode') as string;
  if (mode === 'type_a' || mode === 'type_b' || mode === 'gh' || mode === 'houday' || mode === 'corporate') {
    return mode;
  }
  return undefined;
}

function getRedirectUrl(mode?: ServiceMode): string {
  switch (mode) {
    case 'type_a':
      return '/';
    case 'type_b':
      return '/';
    case 'gh':
      return '/gh/dashboard';
    case 'houday':
      return '/houday/dashboard';
    case 'corporate':
      return '/corporate/dashboard';
    default:
      return '/';
  }
}

export async function loginAsAdmin(formData?: FormData) {
  const mode = parseServiceMode(formData) || 'type_a';
  await setServiceMode(mode);
  await setRole('admin');
  revalidatePath('/', 'layout');
  redirect(getRedirectUrl(mode));
}

export async function loginAsAdminToSettings(formData?: FormData) {
  const mode = parseServiceMode(formData) || 'type_a';
  await setServiceMode(mode);
  await setRole('admin');
  revalidatePath('/', 'layout');
  redirect('/settings');
}

export async function loginAsServiceManager(formData?: FormData) {
  const mode = parseServiceMode(formData) || 'type_a';
  await setServiceMode(mode);
  await setRole('service_manager');
  revalidatePath('/', 'layout');
  redirect(getRedirectUrl(mode));
}

export async function loginAsStaff(formData?: FormData) {
  const mode = parseServiceMode(formData) || 'type_a';
  await setServiceMode(mode);
  await setRole('staff');
  revalidatePath('/', 'layout');
  redirect(getRedirectUrl(mode));
}

export async function switchServiceMode(targetMode: ServiceMode, returnUrl?: string) {
  await setServiceMode(targetMode);
  revalidatePath('/', 'layout');
  const target = returnUrl || getRedirectUrl(targetMode);
  redirect(target);
}

export async function logout() {
  await clearCookie();
  revalidatePath('/', 'layout');
  redirect('/login');
}

'use client';

import { useState } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { Tabs, TabsList, TabsTrigger, TabsContent } from "@/components/ui/tabs";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { 
  Building2, Printer, Download, Save, Sparkles, CheckCircle2, 
  AlertTriangle, FileSpreadsheet, ExternalLink, Calendar, Users, ShieldAlert, FileText 
} from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { saveBulkOffsiteEvaluations, OffsiteBulkItem } from "./actions";

interface ClientRow {
  clientId: string;
  clientName: string;
  recipientNumber?: string;
  daysCount: number;
  totalHours: number;
  workplaceId?: string;
  workplaceName: string;
  contractorId?: string;
  hasPlan: boolean;
  hasOffsiteMention: boolean;
  evaluationId?: string;
  detailedEvaluation: string;
  strengthsAndGrowth?: string;
  challengesAndSupport?: string;
  planReflection?: string;
  evaluatorName?: string;
  supervisorName?: string;
  isCompleted: boolean;
}

interface Props {
  month: string;
  clientRows: ClientRow[];
  facility: any;
  agreements: any[];
  groupedData: Record<string, any[]>;
  availableMonths: string[];
  activeFormat: string;
  capacityRatioData: {
    capacity: number;
    maxDailyCount: number;
    ratio: number;
    isCompliant: boolean;
  };
}

export function OffsiteManagerClient({
  month,
  clientRows: initialRows,
  facility,
  agreements,
  groupedData,
  availableMonths,
  activeFormat,
  capacityRatioData
}: Props) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [rows, setRows] = useState<ClientRow[]>(initialRows);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [currentTab, setCurrentTab] = useState("evaluations");

  const [yearStr, monthStr] = month.split('-');
  const lastDay = new Date(parseInt(yearStr), parseInt(monthStr), 0).getDate();
  const periodStart = `${month}-01`;
  const periodEnd = `${month}-${String(lastDay).padStart(2, '0')}`;

  const completedCount = rows.filter(r => r.isCompleted || (r.detailedEvaluation && r.detailedEvaluation.trim().length > 0)).length;
  const uncompletedCount = rows.length - completedCount;

  const handleMonthChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    router.push(`/offsite?month=${e.target.value}`);
  };

  const handleCommentChange = (clientId: string, val: string) => {
    setRows(prev => prev.map(r => r.clientId === clientId ? { ...r, detailedEvaluation: val } : r));
  };

  // 定型下書きの一括挿入
  const handleAutoFillDrafts = () => {
    setRows(prev => prev.map(r => {
      if (r.detailedEvaluation && r.detailedEvaluation.trim().length > 10) return r;
      const defaultComment = `${r.workplaceName}での施設外就労において、月${r.daysCount}日間安定して従事。作業手順および安全ルールを順守し、責任感を持って業務を完遂できた。周囲の職員との連携も良好。`;
      return { ...r, detailedEvaluation: defaultComment };
    }));
    toast.success("未記入の対象者に定型評価コメントの下書きを一括挿入しました");
  };

  // 一括保存
  const handleSaveAll = async () => {
    setIsSaving(true);
    const itemsToSave: OffsiteBulkItem[] = rows.map(r => ({
      clientId: r.clientId,
      workplaceId: r.workplaceId,
      contractorId: r.contractorId,
      evaluationDate: periodEnd,
      periodStart: periodStart,
      periodEnd: periodEnd,
      workTasks: `${r.workplaceName}での施設外作業`,
      detailedEvaluation: r.detailedEvaluation || `${r.workplaceName}にて月${r.daysCount}日就労に従事。作業手順を守り良好に作業を遂行した。`,
      strengthsAndGrowth: r.strengthsAndGrowth || '指示をよく理解し、作業ペースを維持して責任を持って遂行できた。',
      challengesAndSupport: r.challengesAndSupport || '作業工程の自己確認チェックを習慣づけ、より自立した就労を支援する。',
      planReflection: r.planReflection || '個別支援計画の短期目標に沿い、次期計画で自主点検項目の充実を図る。',
      evaluatorName: r.evaluatorName || '担当職業指導員',
      supervisorName: r.supervisorName || '担当サービス管理責任者',
      basicHabitsScore: 4,
      workPerformanceScore: 4,
      interpersonalScore: 4,
      safetyScore: 4,
      readinessScore: 4
    }));

    try {
      const res = await saveBulkOffsiteEvaluations(itemsToSave);
      if (res.success) {
        toast.success(`施設外就労評価（${res.count}名分）を一括保存しました`);
        setRows(prev => prev.map(r => ({ ...r, isCompleted: true })));
      } else {
        toast.error(res.error || "保存に失敗しました");
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast.error(e.message || "エラーが発生しました");
    }
    setIsSaving(false);
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* 画面ヘッダー */}
      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-end gap-4 print:hidden">
        <div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
            <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800 text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5">
              <Building2 className="h-3 w-3 mr-1 inline text-emerald-600" />
              実地指導（運営指導）完全対応・保存ハブ
            </Badge>
            <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs">
              厚労省基準第191条の2準拠
            </Badge>
          </div>
          <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground flex items-center gap-3">
            施設外就労マネジメント台帳
          </h1>
          <p className="text-muted-foreground mt-1 text-xs sm:text-sm">
            施設外就労加算廃止（令和3年改定）後の「基本報酬算定要件」である、月次個別評価の作成・保存・実地指導対策を一元集約します。
          </p>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto">
          <Link
            href="/settings/offsite"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 h-8 px-2.5 rounded-md text-xs font-semibold border border-emerald-300 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 hover:bg-emerald-100 transition-colors shadow-2xs"
          >
            <Building2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-emerald-600" />
            就労先企業マスタ →
          </Link>
          <Link
            href="/contractors"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 h-8 px-2.5 rounded-md text-xs font-semibold border border-slate-300 bg-white text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors shadow-2xs"
          >
            <FileText className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-500" />
            請負契約管理 →
          </Link>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-card p-1 rounded-lg border shadow-2xs">
            <Calendar className="w-4 h-4 text-muted-foreground ml-1" />
            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground">対象月:</span>
            <Input
              type="month"
              value={month}
              onChange={handleMonthChange}
              className="h-7 w-32 text-xs font-medium"
            />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* サマリーカード */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 print:hidden">
        <Card className="shadow-2xs">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Users className="w-4 h-4 text-primary" />
              当月 施設外従事者
            </div>
            <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-primary mt-1">
              {rows.length} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">名</span>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="shadow-2xs">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
              月次評価 完了状況
            </div>
            <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-emerald-700 mt-1">
              {completedCount} / {rows.length} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">名完了</span>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="shadow-2xs">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <Building2 className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600" />
              連携請負企業数
            </div>
            <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-indigo-700 mt-1">
              {agreements.length} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">社</span>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        <Card className="shadow-2xs">
          <CardContent className="p-4">
            <div className="text-xs font-medium text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <ShieldAlert className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600" />
              定員比率（基準70%未満）
            </div>
            <div className="text-2xl font-bold text-slate-800 mt-1">
              {capacityRatioData.ratio}% 
              <span className={`text-xs ml-2 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-bold ${capacityRatioData.isCompliant ? 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800' : 'bg-red-100 text-red-800'}`}>
                {capacityRatioData.isCompliant ? '適合' : '要件超過'}
              </span>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* タブUI */}
      <Tabs value={currentTab} onValueChange={setCurrentTab} className="space-y-4">
        <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row md:items-center justify-between gap-3 print:hidden border-b pb-2">
          <TabsList className="bg-muted/60 p-1 w-full md:w-auto h-auto flex flex-wrap sm:flex-nowrap gap-1">
            <TabsTrigger value="evaluations" className="text-xs md:text-sm font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 py-1.5 px-2.5 flex-1 sm:flex-none justify-center">
              <FileSpreadsheet className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />

              {uncompletedCount > 0 && (
                <span className="ml-1 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded-full text-[10px] bg-amber-200 text-amber-900 font-bold">
                  未完 {uncompletedCount}
                </span>
              )}
            </TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="print-all" className="text-xs md:text-sm font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 py-1.5 px-2.5 flex-1 sm:flex-none justify-center">
              <Printer className="w-4 h-4 text-primary shrink-0" />
              <span>A4評価表一括印刷</span>
            </TabsTrigger>
            <TabsTrigger value="reports" className="text-xs md:text-sm font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5 py-1.5 px-2.5 flex-1 sm:flex-none justify-center">
              <Download className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600 shrink-0" />
              <span>指定報告書・CSV</span>

          </TabsList>

          {currentTab === 'evaluations' && (
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2 w-full md:w-auto justify-start sm:justify-end">
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={handleAutoFillDrafts}
                className="h-8 text-xs text-indigo-700 border-indigo-200 bg-indigo-50/50 hover:bg-indigo-100 flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-1 sm:flex-none justify-center"
