          )}

          {currentTab === 'print-all' && (
            <Button
              type="button"
              size="sm"
              onClick={() => window.print()}
              className="h-8 text-xs font-bold gap-1.5 w-full sm:w-auto justify-center"
            >
              <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
              全対象者のA4評価表を印刷・PDF出力
            </Button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* タブ 1: 月次評価一括入力スプレッドシート */}
        <TabsContent value="evaluations" className="space-y-4 print:hidden">
          <Card className="shadow-sm">
            <CardHeader className="bg-slate-50 border-b pb-3">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                <div>
                  <CardTitle className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                    <span>{month}度 施設外就労従事者 月次個別評価入力</span>
                  </CardTitle>
                  <CardDescription className="text-xs">
                    勤怠データと連動して対象者を自動抽出しています。サビ管評価を直接入力し、右上の「一括保存」で保存できます。
                  </CardDescription>
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="p-0">
              {rows.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="p-12 text-center text-muted-foreground">
                  当月（{month}）は施設外就労に従事した利用者の勤怠実績がありません。

              ) : (
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">

                      <tr>
                        <th className="p-3 w-40">利用者名</th>

                        <th className="p-3 w-28 text-center">稼働実績</th>
                        <th className="p-3 w-32 text-center">個別支援計画</th>
                        <th className="p-3">当月サビ管評価・指導内容（実地指導保存項目）</th>
                        <th className="p-3 w-28 text-center">個別帳票</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y">
                      {rows.map((r) => (
                        <tr key={r.clientId} className="hover:bg-slate-50/70 transition-colors">
                          <td className="p-3 font-medium align-top">
                            <div className="text-foreground text-sm font-bold">{r.clientName}</div>
                            <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-mono">
                              受給者証: {r.recipientNumber || '未登録'}
                            </div>
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-3 align-top">
                            <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-white text-indigo-800 border-indigo-200 text-xs">
                              {r.workplaceName}
                            </Badge>
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-3 text-center align-top">
                            <div className="font-bold text-slate-800 text-sm">{r.daysCount} <span className="text-[10px] font-normal">日</span></div>
                            <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">{r.totalHours} 時間</div>
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-3 text-center align-top">
                            {r.hasPlan && r.hasOffsiteMention ? (
                              <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300 text-[10px]">
                                計画記載済
                              </Badge>
                            ) : (
                              <Badge variant="destructive" className="text-[10px] flex items-center justify-center gap-1">
                                <AlertTriangle className="w-2.5 h-2.5" />
                                計画未記載
                              </Badge>
                            )}
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-3 align-top space-y-1">
                            <Textarea
                              value={r.detailedEvaluation}
                              onChange={(e) => handleCommentChange(r.clientId, e.target.value)}
                              placeholder="作業態度、手順順守、体調・安全管理に関する評価コメントを入力してください..."
                              rows={3}
                              className="text-xs bg-white resize-y font-sans leading-relaxed"
                            />
                          </td>
                          <td className="p-3 text-center align-top">
                            <Link
                              href={`/clients/${r.clientId}/documents?tab=offsite-eval`}
                              target="_blank"
                              className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-xs text-primary hover:underline font-medium p-1.5 border rounded hover:bg-muted"
                            >
                              <ExternalLink className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                              評価詳細
                            </Link>
                          </td>
                        </tr>
                      ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </TabsContent>

        {/* タブ 2: 実地指導提示用 A4評価表 一括連続印刷プレビュー */}
        <TabsContent value="print-all" className="space-y-6">
          <div className="bg-indigo-50/70 border border-indigo-200 rounded-lg p-3 text-xs text-indigo-900 flex items-center gap-2 print:hidden">
            <Printer className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600 shrink-0" />
            <span>
              当月（{month}）に施設外就労に従事した全利用者の<strong>「施設外就労評価表」</strong>がA4サイズで1人1枚ずつ改ページ印刷されます。実地指導時の提示資料や保管用としてそのままご利用いただけます。
            </span>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-12 print:space-y-0">
            {rows.map((r, index) => (
              <div 
                key={r.clientId} 
                className="bg-white border p-8 rounded-lg shadow-sm print:shadow-none print:border-none print:p-0 print:m-0 print:break-after-page"
                style={{ pageBreakAfter: index === rows.length - 1 ? 'auto' : 'always' }}
              >
                {/* A4単票印刷ヘッダー */}
                <div className="text-center border-b-2 border-black pb-3 mb-6">
                  <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold tracking-wider">施設外就労個別評価表（実地指導保管用）</h2>
                  <p className="text-xs text-gray-600 mt-1">
                    （障害者の日常生活及び社会生活を総合的に支援するための法律に基づく指定基準等準拠）
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 border border-black p-3 text-xs mb-6">
                  <div>
                    <span className="font-bold">対象年月:</span> {month} （{periodStart} 〜 {periodEnd}）
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="font-bold">利用者氏名:</span> <strong className="text-sm">{r.clientName}</strong> 様 （受給者番号: {r.recipientNumber || '未登録'}）
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="font-bold">事業所名:</span> {facility?.facility_name || '就労継続支援A型事業所'} （事業所番号: {facility?.facility_number || '2812345678'}）
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="font-bold">施設外就労先:</span> <strong>{r.workplaceName}</strong>
                  </div>

                    <span className="font-bold">当月稼働日数:</span> {r.daysCount} 日 （実働合計: {r.totalHours} 時間）

                    <span className="font-bold">評価実施者:</span> 担当職業指導員 / 担当サビ管
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* 5大項目評価レーティング */}
                <div className="border border-black mb-6">
                  <div className="bg-gray-100 font-bold p-2 text-xs border-b border-black">
                    就労能力・適応状況の評価（5段階評価: 5=優良, 4=良好, 3=標準, 2=要支援, 1=要配慮）
                  </div>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-5 text-center text-xs divide-x border-black p-2">

                    </div>

                    施設外就労実施報告書（神戸市指定様式 CSV）
                  </div>

                    神戸市障害福祉部局の指定様式に準拠した詳細CSV（個別支援計画位置付け日、担当職員情報付き）を出力します。
                  </p>
                  <a 
                    href={`/api/billing/offsite-report/export?month=${month}&format=kobe_custom`} 
                    download
                    className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm" }), "w-full border-indigo-200 text-indigo-800 hover:bg-indigo-50")}
                  >
                    <Download className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-2" />
                    神戸市指定様式 CSVダウンロード
                  </a>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="border-t pt-4 flex justify-between items-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                <span>関連マスター・台帳管理:</span>
                <div className="flex gap-2">
                  <Link 
                    href="/contractors"
                    className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "ghost", size: "sm" }), "h-7 text-xs")}

      </Tabs>
    </div>
  );
}

'use server';

import { db, sanitizeForeignKeyId, resolveServiceModeForClient } from "@/lib/db";
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from "uuid";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { getRole, assertCanAccessClient } from "@/lib/auth";
import { logAudit } from "@/lib/audit";

export interface OffsiteBulkItem {
  clientId: string;
  workplaceId?: string;
  contractorId?: string;
  evaluationDate: string;
  periodStart: string;
  periodEnd: string;
  workTasks: string;
  detailedEvaluation: string;
  strengthsAndGrowth?: string;
  challengesAndSupport?: string;
  planReflection?: string;
  evaluatorName?: string;
  supervisorName?: string;
  basicHabitsScore?: number;
  workPerformanceScore?: number;
  interpersonalScore?: number;
  safetyScore?: number;
  readinessScore?: number;
}

export async function saveBulkOffsiteEvaluations(items: OffsiteBulkItem[]) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role || role === 'staff') {
      return { success: false, error: '権限がありません（サービス管理責任者または管理者のみ保存可能です）' };
    }

    if (!items || items.length === 0) {
      return { success: true, count: 0 };
    }

    if (items[0].clientId) {
      await resolveServiceModeForClient(items[0].clientId);
      await assertCanAccessClient(items[0].clientId);
    }

    const insertStmt = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO offsite_evaluations (
        id, client_id, workplace_id, contractor_id,
        evaluation_date, period_start, period_end, work_tasks,
        basic_habits_score, work_performance_score, interpersonal_score,
        safety_score, readiness_score, detailed_evaluation,
        strengths_and_growth, challenges_and_support, plan_reflection,
        evaluator_name, supervisor_name, feedback_date, client_signature,
        created_at, updated_at
      ) VALUES (
        ?, ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?, ?,
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      )
    `);

    const updateStmt = db.prepare(`
      UPDATE offsite_evaluations SET
        workplace_id = ?,
        contractor_id = ?,
        work_tasks = ?,
        basic_habits_score = ?,
        work_performance_score = ?,
        interpersonal_score = ?,
        safety_score = ?,
        readiness_score = ?,
        detailed_evaluation = ?,
        strengths_and_growth = ?,
        challenges_and_support = ?,
        plan_reflection = ?,
        evaluator_name = ?,
        supervisor_name = ?,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
        deleted_at = NULL
      WHERE id = ?
    `);

    const checkStmt = db.prepare(`
      SELECT id FROM offsite_evaluations
      WHERE client_id = ? AND evaluation_date = ?
    `);

    const smRow = db.prepare(`SELECT name, job_category FROM staff WHERE (role IN ('service_manager', 'admin_and_service_manager') OR job_category LIKE '%サービス管理責任者%' OR job_category LIKE '%サビ管%') AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 1`).get() as any;
    const defaultSmName = smRow ? `${smRow.name}（${smRow.job_category || 'サビ管'}）` : '担当サビ管';
    const viRow = db.prepare(`SELECT name, job_category FROM staff WHERE (role = 'vocational_instructor' OR job_category LIKE '%職業指導員%') AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at ASC LIMIT 1`).get() as any;
    const defaultViName = viRow ? `${viRow.name}（${viRow.job_category || '職業指導員'}）` : '担当指導員';

    db.transaction(() => {
      for (const item of items) {
        const safeClientId = sanitizeForeignKeyId('clients', item.clientId);
        if (!safeClientId) continue;
        const safeWorkplaceId = sanitizeForeignKeyId('offsite_workplaces', item.workplaceId);
        const safeContractorId = sanitizeForeignKeyId('contractor_agreements', item.contractorId);
        const existing = checkStmt.get(safeClientId, item.evaluationDate) as any;
        if (existing) {
          updateStmt.run(
            safeWorkplaceId,
            safeContractorId,
            item.workTasks || '施設外就労作業',
            item.basicHabitsScore ?? 4,
            item.workPerformanceScore ?? 4,
            item.interpersonalScore ?? 4,
            item.safetyScore ?? 4,
            item.readinessScore ?? 4,
            item.detailedEvaluation || '',
            item.strengthsAndGrowth || '指示をよく理解し、作業ペースを維持して責任を持って遂行できた。',
            item.challengesAndSupport || '作業工程の自己確認チェックを習慣づけ、より自立した就労を支援する。',
            item.planReflection || '個別支援計画の短期目標に沿い、次期計画で自主点検項目の充実を図る。',
            item.evaluatorName || defaultViName,
            item.supervisorName || defaultSmName,
            existing.id
          );
        } else {
          insertStmt.run(
            uuidv4(),
            safeClientId,
            safeWorkplaceId,
            safeContractorId,
            item.evaluationDate,
            item.periodStart,
            item.periodEnd,
            item.workTasks || '施設外就労作業',
            item.basicHabitsScore ?? 4,
            item.workPerformanceScore ?? 4,
            item.interpersonalScore ?? 4,
            item.safetyScore ?? 4,
            item.readinessScore ?? 4,
            item.detailedEvaluation || '',
            item.strengthsAndGrowth || '指示をよく理解し、作業ペースを維持して責任を持って遂行できた。',
            item.challengesAndSupport || '作業工程の自己確認チェックを習慣づけ、より自立した就労を支援する。',
            item.planReflection || '個別支援計画の短期目標に沿い、次期計画で自主点検項目の充実を図る。',
            item.evaluatorName || defaultViName,
            item.supervisorName || defaultSmName,
            item.evaluationDate,
            '済'
          );
        }
      }
    })();

    await logAudit({
      action: 'update',
      targetTable: 'offsite_evaluations',
      targetId: `bulk:${items.length}`,
      details: { count: items.length, month: items[0]?.periodStart?.slice(0, 7) }
    });

    revalidatePath('/offsite');
    revalidatePath('/billing/offsite-report');
    return { success: true, count: items.length };
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.error('施設外就労評価一括保存エラー:', e);
    return { success: false, error: e.message || '一括保存に失敗しました' };
  }
}


================================================================================
File: src/app/offsite/page.tsx

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { Header } from "@/components/Header";
import { OffsiteSubNav } from "@/components/NavigationTabs";
import { OffsiteManagerClient } from "./OffsiteManagerClient";
import { getFacilityEffectiveRules } from "@/lib/rules/ruleEngine";
import { parseCapacityFromClass } from "@/lib/compliance/capacityChecker";

export default async function OffsitePage({ 
  searchParams 
}: { 
  searchParams: Promise<{ month?: string; format?: string }> 
}) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) redirect("/login");

  const params = await searchParams;
  const today = new Date();
  const currentMonth = params.month || `${today.getFullYear()}-${String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;

  const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any || {};
  const facilityRules = getFacilityEffectiveRules();
  const defaultFormat = facilityRules.reports.offsite_work_format || 'standard';
  const activeFormat = params.format || defaultFormat;

  // 施設外就労の打刻データを取得
  const offsiteRecords = db.prepare(`
    SELECT a.*, c.full_name, c.recipient_number,
           w.id as workplace_id, w.name as workplace_name, w.company_name,
           st.name as staff_name
    FROM attendance_records a
    JOIN clients c ON a.client_id = c.id
    LEFT JOIN offsite_workplaces w ON a.offsite_workplace_id = w.id
    LEFT JOIN staff st ON a.offsite_staff_id = st.id
    WHERE a.record_date LIKE ? AND a.status = 'present' AND a.is_offsite = 1 AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY a.record_date ASC, a.clock_in ASC
  `).all(`${currentMonth}-%`) as any[];

  // 請負契約情報を取得
  const contractorAgreements = db.prepare(`
    SELECT *
    FROM contractor_agreements
    WHERE contract_start_date <= ? AND (contract_end_date IS NULL OR contract_end_date >= ?)
  `).all(`${currentMonth}-31`, `${currentMonth}-01`) as any[];

  // 定員比率集計
  const dailyCounts: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const r of offsiteRecords) {
    dailyCounts[r.record_date] = (dailyCounts[r.record_date] || 0) + 1;
  }
  const maxDailyCount = Object.values(dailyCounts).length > 0 ? Math.max(...Object.values(dailyCounts)) : 0;
  const capacity = parseCapacityFromClass(facility.capacity_class);
  const ratio = capacity > 0 ? Math.round((maxDailyCount / capacity) * 100) : 0;
  const capacityRatioData = {
    capacity,
    maxDailyCount,
    ratio,
    isCompliant: ratio <= 70
  };

  // 利用者ごとの集計
  const clientMap: Record<string, {
    clientId: string;
    clientName: string;
    recipientNumber?: string;
    daysCount: number;
    totalMinutes: number;
    workplaces: Record<string, { id: string; name: string; count: number }>;
  }> = {};

  for (const r of offsiteRecords) {
    if (!clientMap[r.client_id]) {
      clientMap[r.client_id] = {
        clientId: r.client_id,
        clientName: r.full_name,
        recipientNumber: r.recipient_number,
        daysCount: 0,
        totalMinutes: 0,
        workplaces: {}
      };
    }
    clientMap[r.client_id].daysCount++;

    // 時間計算
    if (r.clock_in && r.clock_out) {
      const [inH, inM] = r.clock_in.split(':').map(Number);
      const [outH, outM] = r.clock_out.split(':').map(Number);
      const diffMin = Math.max(0, (outH * 60 + outM) - (inH * 60 + inM) - (r.break_time_minutes || 0));
      clientMap[r.client_id].totalMinutes += diffMin;
    } else {
      clientMap[r.client_id].totalMinutes += 240; // デフォルト4時間
    }

    const wpName = r.workplace_name || '施設外企業先';
    const wpId = r.workplace_id || '';
    if (!clientMap[r.client_id].workplaces[wpName]) {
      clientMap[r.client_id].workplaces[wpName] = { id: wpId, name: wpName, count: 0 };
    }
    clientMap[r.client_id].workplaces[wpName].count++;
  }

  // 既存の月次評価レコード（offsite_evaluations）を取得
  const existingEvaluations = db.prepare(`
    SELECT * FROM offsite_evaluations
    WHERE evaluation_date LIKE ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
  `).all(`${currentMonth}-%`) as any[];
  const evalMap: Record<string, any> = {};
  for (const ev of existingEvaluations) {
    evalMap[ev.client_id] = ev;
  }

  // 個別支援計画チェック
  const clientRows = Object.values(clientMap).map(c => {
    // 最も多く従事した就労先
    const topWp = Object.values(c.workplaces).sort((a, b) => b.count - a.count)[0];
    const plan = db.prepare(`
      SELECT id, domains_data, plan_date, start_date FROM support_plans 
      WHERE client_id = ? AND status = 'active'
      ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1
    `).get(c.clientId) as any;

    const hasPlan = !!plan;
    const rawText = plan ? (plan.domains_data || '') : '';
    const hasOffsiteMention = rawText.includes('施設外') || rawText.includes('請負') || rawText.includes('企業先') || rawText.includes('現場');

    const existingEval = evalMap[c.clientId];
    const contractor = contractorAgreements[0];

    return {
      clientId: c.clientId,
      clientName: c.clientName,
      recipientNumber: c.recipientNumber,
      daysCount: c.daysCount,
      totalHours: Math.round((c.totalMinutes / 60) * 10) / 10,
      workplaceId: topWp?.id || undefined,
      workplaceName: topWp?.name || '施設外企業先',
      contractorId: contractor?.id || undefined,
      hasPlan,
      hasOffsiteMention,
      evaluationId: existingEval?.id,
      detailedEvaluation: existingEval?.detailed_evaluation || '',
      strengthsAndGrowth: existingEval?.strengths_and_growth || '',
      challengesAndSupport: existingEval?.challenges_and_support || '',
      planReflection: existingEval?.plan_reflection || '',
      isCompleted: !!existingEval && !!existingEval.detailed_evaluation
    };
  });

  // 日付ごとのグループ化データ（報告書CSV用）
  const groupedData = offsiteRecords.reduce((acc: any, record: any) => {
    const key = record.record_date;
    if (!acc[key]) acc[key] = [];
    acc[key].push(record);
    return acc;
  }, {});

  // 過去年月リスト
  const availableMonths = db.prepare(`
    SELECT DISTINCT substr(record_date, 1, 7) as ym 
    FROM attendance_records 
    WHERE is_offsite = 1 AND deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY ym DESC LIMIT 36
  `).all().map((r: any) => r.ym);
  if (!availableMonths.includes(currentMonth)) {
    availableMonths.unshift(currentMonth);
  }

  // 拠点別内勤上限超過チェック（直近30日間）
  let upcomingCapacityAlerts: any[] = [];
  try {
    const { getUpcomingCapacityAlerts } = await import('@/lib/compliance/capacityChecker');
    const { toLocalISODate } = await import('@/lib/utils');
    upcomingCapacityAlerts = getUpcomingCapacityAlerts(toLocalISODate(new Date()), 30);
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('内勤上限超過チェックエラー:', e);
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background/50">
      <div className="print:hidden">
        <Header activePage="offsite" />
        <OffsiteSubNav />
      </div>

      <main className="flex-1 p-3.5 sm:p-6 md:p-12 print:p-0">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl space-y-6 print:max-w-none print:space-y-0">
          {/* 内勤上限超過・施設外就労振替リクエストバナー */}
          {upcomingCapacityAlerts.length > 0 && (
            <div className="p-4 rounded-lg border-2 border-rose-300 bg-rose-50/90 shadow-sm print:hidden">
              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
                <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
                  <div className="p-1.5 rounded-full bg-rose-600 text-white shrink-0 mt-0.5">
                    <span className="text-sm font-black">⚠️</span>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <h4 className="font-black text-rose-950 text-sm sm:text-base flex items-center gap-2">
                      内勤上限超過に伴う施設外就労の振替リクエスト（本所10名・サテライト10名）
                    </h4>
                    <p className="text-xs text-rose-800 mt-1">
                      直近30日間で内勤上限（各拠点10名）を超える日が <strong>{upcomingCapacityAlerts.length}日</strong> あります。内勤が定員を超える日は、<strong>超過人数分の利用者を施設外就労へ配置</strong>してください。
                    </p>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <a 
                  href="/attendance/shifts" 
                  className="inline-flex items-center justify-center px-4 py-2 rounded-md bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white font-bold text-xs shadow-xs whitespace-nowrap gap-1.5 self-start sm:self-auto"
                >
                  <span>シフト表で施設外へ振替</span>
                  <span>→</span>
                </a>
              </div>
            </div>
          )}

          <OffsiteManagerClient
            month={currentMonth}
            clientRows={clientRows}
            facility={facility}
            agreements={contractorAgreements}
            groupedData={groupedData}
            availableMonths={availableMonths}
            activeFormat={activeFormat}
            capacityRatioData={capacityRatioData}
          />
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}


================================================================================

import { Header } from "@/components/Header";
import { toLocalISODate } from "@/lib/utils";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { AlertTriangle } from "lucide-react";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { QuickSetupGuide } from "@/components/QuickSetupGuide";
import { checkMandatoryComplianceStatus } from "./records/actions";
import { calculateMonthlyStaffingStatus, calculateDailyStaffingStatus } from "@/lib/compliance/staffingCalculator";
import { getIntegrityErrors } from "@/lib/compliance/recordIntegrityChecker";
import { DashboardClient } from "./components/DashboardClient";
import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { getServiceMode } from "@/lib/serviceModeServer";

export default async function Home() {
  const currentMode = await getServiceMode();
  if (currentMode === 'gh') {
    redirect('/gh/dashboard');
  }
  if (currentMode === 'houday') {
    redirect('/houday/dashboard');
  }
  if (currentMode === 'corporate') {
    redirect('/corporate/dashboard');
  }

  const role = (await getRole()) || 'staff';
  const isAdmin = role === 'admin';
  const isServiceManager = role === 'service_manager';
  const isStaff = role === 'staff';

  // Read tunnel URL if it exists
  let tunnelUrl = null;
  try {
    const urlFilePath = path.join(process.cwd(), '.tunnel_url');
    if (fs.existsSync(urlFilePath)) {
      tunnelUrl = fs.readFileSync(urlFilePath, 'utf8').trim();
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Failed to read tunnel url", e);
  }

  const todayStr = toLocalISODate(new Date());
  const today = new Date();
  const currentMonth = `${today.getFullYear()}-${String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  
  // 勤怠と支援記録の不整合チェック（当月分）
  const integrityErrors = getIntegrityErrors(currentMonth);

  // 日次・本日の人員配置基準チェック（全ロール共通で把握）
  const dailyStaffing = calculateDailyStaffingStatus(todayStr);

  // 本日の出欠集計カウント
  const attendanceCountsResult = db.prepare(`
    SELECT 
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'present' THEN 1 END) as present,
      COUNT(CASE WHEN status = 'absent' THEN 1 END) as absent,
      COUNT(*) as total
    FROM attendance_records
    WHERE record_date = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
  `).get(todayStr) as any;

  const attendanceCounts = {
    present: attendanceCountsResult?.present || 0,
    absent: attendanceCountsResult?.absent || 0,
    total: attendanceCountsResult?.total || 0,
  };

  // ----------------------------------------------------
  // 管理者・サビ管向けデータ取得（一般スタッフログイン時はクエリをスキップ）
  // ----------------------------------------------------
  let facilitySettings: any = null;
  let complianceIssues: string[] = [];
  let complianceItems: any[] = [];
  let urgentComplianceCount = 0;
  let monthlyStaffing: any = null;
  let staffCount = 0;
  let clientCount = 0;
  let expiringContractors: any[] = [];
  let expiringClients: any[] = [];
  let expiringClientContracts: any[] = [];
  let expiringSupportPlans: any[] = [];
  let uninterviewedClients: any[] = [];
  let unevaluatedOffsiteClients: any[] = [];
  let expiringPtoRecords: any[] = [];
  let mandatoryPtoAlerts: any[] = [];
  let monitoringAlerts: any[] = [];
  let upcomingCapacityAlerts: any[] = [];
  let deficitAlert: string | null = null;
  let offsiteAlert: string | null = null;
  let displayScore = "0.0";
  let totalHours = 0;
  let totalDays = 0;
  let dataFetchErrors: string[] = [];

  if (!isStaff) {
    facilitySettings = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any;
    const certAlertDays = facilitySettings?.alert_days_certificate || 60;
    const certAlertDate = new Date();
    certAlertDate.setDate(today.getDate() + certAlertDays);

    const thirtyDaysFromNow = new Date();
    thirtyDaysFromNow.setDate(today.getDate() + 30);

    const sixtyDaysFromNow = new Date();
    sixtyDaysFromNow.setDate(today.getDate() + 60);

    // 1. サビ管＆管理者共通: 実地指導・支援計画・モニタリング・受給者証期限
    expiringClients = db.prepare(`
      SELECT id, full_name, valid_to
      FROM clients
      WHERE valid_to IS NOT NULL AND valid_to != ''
        AND valid_to <= ?
        AND deleted_at IS NULL
        AND (status IS NULL OR status = 'active')
      ORDER BY valid_to ASC
    `).all(toLocalISODate(certAlertDate)) as any[];

    expiringSupportPlans = db.prepare(`
      SELECT p.id, p.client_id, p.end_date, c.full_name as client_full_name
      FROM support_plans p
      JOIN clients c ON p.client_id = c.id
      WHERE p.end_date IS NOT NULL 
        AND p.end_date != ''
        AND p.end_date <= ?
        AND p.status = 'active'
        AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND (c.status IS NULL OR c.status = 'active')
      ORDER BY p.end_date ASC
    `).all(toLocalISODate(thirtyDaysFromNow)) as any[];

    try {
      uninterviewedClients = db.prepare(`
        SELECT c.id, c.full_name
        FROM clients c
        WHERE (c.status IS NULL OR c.status = 'active') AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM interview_records i
            WHERE i.client_id = c.id AND i.interview_date LIKE ? AND i.deleted_at IS NULL
          )
        ORDER BY c.full_name
        LIMIT 6
      `).all(`${currentMonth}-%`) as any[];

      unevaluatedOffsiteClients = db.prepare(`
        SELECT DISTINCT c.id, c.full_name
        FROM attendance_records a
        JOIN clients c ON a.client_id = c.id
        WHERE c.deleted_at IS NULL AND (c.status IS NULL OR c.status = 'active')
          AND a.record_date LIKE ? AND (a.status = 'out_facility' OR (a.status = 'present' AND a.is_offsite = 1)) AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND NOT EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 FROM offsite_evaluations e
            WHERE e.client_id = a.client_id AND e.evaluation_date LIKE ? AND e.deleted_at IS NULL
          )
        ORDER BY c.full_name
        LIMIT 6
      `).all(`${currentMonth}-%`, `${currentMonth}-%`) as any[];
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }

    // モニタリング期日アラート
    try {
      const activePlansForMonitoring = db.prepare(`
        SELECT p.id, p.client_id, p.plan_date, p.start_date,
               COALESCE(p.monitoring_period, '6') as monitoring_period,
               c.full_name as client_full_name,
               (SELECT MAX(monitoring_date) FROM plan_monitorings WHERE support_plan_id = p.id) as latest_monitoring_date
        FROM support_plans p
        JOIN clients c ON p.client_id = c.id
        WHERE p.status = 'active'
          AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
          AND (c.status IS NULL OR c.status != 'terminated')
      `).all() as any[];

      monitoringAlerts = activePlansForMonitoring.map(p => {
        const baseDateStr = p.latest_monitoring_date || p.start_date || p.plan_date;
        const baseDate = new Date(baseDateStr);
        const months = parseInt(p.monitoring_period) || 6;
        const dueDate = new Date(baseDate);
        dueDate.setMonth(dueDate.getMonth() + months);
        const dueDateStr = toLocalISODate(dueDate);
        const diffDays = Math.ceil((dueDate.getTime() - today.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
        
        return {
          ...p,
          lastActivityDate: baseDateStr,
          hasMonitoringRecord: !!p.latest_monitoring_date,
          dueDate: dueDateStr,
          diffDays,
          isOverdue: diffDays < 0,
          isWarning: diffDays >= 0 && diffDays <= 30
        };
      }).filter(p => p.isOverdue || p.isWarning);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }

    // 内勤受入上限超過チェック
    try {
      const { getUpcomingCapacityAlerts } = await import('@/lib/compliance/capacityChecker');
      upcomingCapacityAlerts = getUpcomingCapacityAlerts(todayStr, 30);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error('内勤上限超過チェックエラー:', e);
    }

    // 2. 管理者専用データ
    if (isAdmin) {
      const complianceStatus = await checkMandatoryComplianceStatus();
      complianceItems = complianceStatus.items || [];
      urgentComplianceCount = complianceStatus.urgentCount || 0;

      monthlyStaffing = calculateMonthlyStaffingStatus(currentMonth);

      const staffCountResult = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM staff WHERE deleted_at IS NULL").get() as any;
      staffCount = staffCountResult?.count || 0;
      const clientCountResult = db.prepare("SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM clients WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (status = 'active' OR status IS NULL)").get() as any;
      clientCount = clientCountResult?.count || 0;

      facilitySettings = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any;
      if (facilitySettings) {
        if (facilitySettings.has_bcp === 0) complianceIssues.push("業務継続計画(BCP)の策定 (1%減算対象)");
        if (facilitySettings.has_abuse_prevention === 0) complianceIssues.push("虐待防止措置の実施 (1%減算対象)");
        if (facilitySettings.has_restraint_reduction === 0) complianceIssues.push("身体拘束廃止の措置 (1%減算対象)");
        if (facilitySettings.has_information_disclosure === 0) complianceIssues.push("情報公表システムへの報告 (5%減算対象)");
      }

      expiringContractors = db.prepare(`
        SELECT id, company_name, contract_end_date
        FROM contractor_agreements
        WHERE contract_end_date <= ?
        ORDER BY contract_end_date ASC
      `).all(toLocalISODate(thirtyDaysFromNow)) as any[];

      expiringClientContracts = db.prepare(`
        SELECT id, full_name, contract_end_date
        FROM clients
        WHERE contract_end_date IS NOT NULL 
          AND contract_end_date != ''
          AND contract_end_date <= ?
          AND deleted_at IS NULL
          AND (status IS NULL OR status = 'active')
        ORDER BY contract_end_date ASC
      `).all(toLocalISODate(thirtyDaysFromNow)) as any[];

      try {
        expiringPtoRecords = db.prepare(`
          SELECT p.id, p.client_id, p.remaining_days, p.expiration_date, c.full_name as client_name
          FROM client_pto_records p
          JOIN clients c ON p.client_id = c.id
          WHERE p.remaining_days > 0 
            AND p.expiration_date <= ?
            AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
            AND (c.status IS NULL OR c.status != 'terminated')
          ORDER BY p.expiration_date ASC
        `).all(toLocalISODate(sixtyDaysFromNow)) as any[];
      } catch (e) {}

      // 労基法第39条第7項: 年5日有給休暇取得義務アラート（3ヶ月前から警告）
      try {
        const { getMandatoryPtoAlerts } = await import('@/lib/compliance/paidLeaveCalculator');
        const { processAutomaticPtoGrants } = await import('@/app/attendance/pto/actions');
        await processAutomaticPtoGrants();
        mandatoryPtoAlerts = getMandatoryPtoAlerts();
      } catch (e) {
        console.error('年5日有給義務アラート集計エラー:', e);
      }

      // スコア計算（当月平均労働時間）
      const currentMonthStart = `${today.getFullYear()}-${String(today.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-01`;
      const nextMonthStartDate = new Date(today.getFullYear(), today.getMonth() + 1, 1);
      const nextMonthStart = toLocalISODate(nextMonthStartDate);

      const attendances = db.prepare(`
        SELECT clock_in, clock_out, break_time_minutes
        FROM attendance_records
        WHERE record_date >= ? AND record_date < ?
      `).all(currentMonthStart, nextMonthStart) as any[];

      let totalMinutes = 0;
      if (attendances) {
        for (const record of attendances) {
          if (record.clock_in && record.clock_out) {
            const [inH, inM] = record.clock_in.split(':').map(Number);
            const [outH, outM] = record.clock_out.split(':').map(Number);
            let outTotalM = outH * 60 + outM;
            const inTotalM = inH * 60 + inM;
            if (outTotalM < inTotalM) {
              outTotalM += 24 * 60;
            }
            const mins = outTotalM - inTotalM - (record.break_time_minutes || 0);
            if (mins > 0) {
              totalMinutes += mins;
              totalDays++;
            }
          }
        }
      }
      totalHours = totalMinutes / 60;
      const score = totalDays > 0 ? (totalHours / totalDays) : 0;
      displayScore = score.toFixed(1);

      // 生産活動収支アラート
      try {
        const { evaluateProductionActivity } = await import('@/app/billing/simulation/actions');
        const prodActivityStatus = await evaluateProductionActivity(currentMonth);
        if (prodActivityStatus === 'deficit_3_years') {
          deficitAlert = "【警告】生産活動収支が3期連続で赤字（賃金総額を下回る）判定となっています。大幅なスコア減算の対象です。";
        } else if (prodActivityStatus === 'deficit_2_years') {
          deficitAlert = "【注意】生産活動収支が2期連続で赤字判定です。次期も赤字の場合、大幅減算となります。";
        }
      } catch (e) {}

      // 施設外就労比率
      try {
        const offsiteStats = db.prepare(`
          SELECT 
            COUNT(*) as total_days,
            SUM(CASE WHEN is_offsite = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as offsite_days
          FROM attendance_records
          WHERE record_date >= ? AND record_date < ? AND status = 'present'
        `).get(currentMonthStart, nextMonthStart) as any;
        
        if (offsiteStats && offsiteStats.total_days > 0) {
          const offsiteRatio = offsiteStats.offsite_days / offsiteStats.total_days;
          if (offsiteRatio > 0.7) {
            offsiteAlert = `【警告】当月の施設外就労率が ${(offsiteRatio * 100).toFixed(1)}% です。原則7割以内（${offsiteStats.offsite_days}/${offsiteStats.total_days}日）を超過しています。`;
          } else if (offsiteRatio > 0.6) {
            offsiteAlert = `【注意】当月の施設外就労率が ${(offsiteRatio * 100).toFixed(1)}% です。7割上限に近づいています。（${offsiteStats.offsite_days}/${offsiteStats.total_days}日）`;
          }
        }
      } catch (e) {}
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background/50">
      <Header activePage="home" />
      <main className="flex-1 p-3.5 sm:p-6 md:p-8 space-y-6">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl space-y-6">

          {dataFetchErrors.length > 0 && (
            <Card className="border-destructive bg-destructive/10">
              <CardHeader className="py-3 px-4">
                <CardTitle className="text-sm font-bold text-destructive flex items-center gap-2">
                  <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4" />
                  システム内部エラー（データ不整合またはスキーマ破損の可能性があります）
                </CardTitle>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="px-4 pb-4">
                <ul className="list-disc list-inside text-xs text-destructive/90 space-y-1">
                  {dataFetchErrors.map((err, i) => (
                    <li key={i}>{err}</li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
                <p className="text-xs mt-2 text-destructive/80">
                  機能の一部が正常に動作していません。データベースのマイグレーションが正しく完了していない可能性があります。
                </p>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          )}

          {/* 初期設定ウィザード（管理者のみ、初期設定未完了時） */}
          {isAdmin && (
            <QuickSetupGuide 
              facilitySettings={facilitySettings}
              staffCount={staffCount}
              clientCount={clientCount}
            />
          )}

          {/* 統合ダッシュボード（最上部クイックアクション・スマート開閉アラート・4タブ業務メニュー） */}
          <DashboardClient 
            role={role}
            todayStr={todayStr}
            currentMonth={currentMonth}
            dailyStaffing={dailyStaffing}
            attendanceCounts={attendanceCounts}
            integrityErrors={integrityErrors}
            facilitySettings={facilitySettings}
            complianceIssues={complianceIssues}
            complianceItems={complianceItems}
            urgentComplianceCount={urgentComplianceCount}
            monthlyStaffing={monthlyStaffing}
            staffCount={staffCount}
            clientCount={clientCount}
            expiringClients={expiringClients}
            expiringSupportPlans={expiringSupportPlans}
            uninterviewedClients={uninterviewedClients}
            unevaluatedOffsiteClients={unevaluatedOffsiteClients}
            monitoringAlerts={monitoringAlerts}
            upcomingCapacityAlerts={upcomingCapacityAlerts}
            expiringContractors={expiringContractors}
            expiringClientContracts={expiringClientContracts}
            expiringPtoRecords={expiringPtoRecords}
            mandatoryPtoAlerts={mandatoryPtoAlerts}
            displayScore={displayScore}
            totalHours={totalHours}
            totalDays={totalDays}
            deficitAlert={deficitAlert}
            offsiteAlert={offsiteAlert}
            tunnelUrl={tunnelUrl}
          />
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Calculator, Printer, FileText } from "lucide-react";
import { calculatePayrollForMonth, getPayslipsForMonth } from "./actions";
import Link from "next/link";

export default function PayrollClient({ initialMonth }: { initialMonth: string }) {
  const [targetMonth, setTargetMonth] = useState(initialMonth);
  const [payslips, setPayslips] = useState<any[]>([]);
  const [isLoading, setIsLoading] = useState(false);
  const [isCalculating, setIsCalculating] = useState(false);

  const loadPayslips = useCallback(async () => {
    setIsLoading(true);
    const data = await getPayslipsForMonth(targetMonth);
    setPayslips(data);
    setIsLoading(false);
  }, [targetMonth]);

  useEffect(() => {
    loadPayslips();
  }, [loadPayslips]);

  const handleCalculate = async () => {
    if (!confirm(`${targetMonth} の給与（工賃）計算を実行します。勤怠データに基づき全利用者の明細が更新されますがよろしいですか？`)) return;
    
    setIsCalculating(true);
    try {
      const result = await calculatePayrollForMonth(targetMonth);
      if (result.success) {
        alert(`計算が完了しました。${result.totalWagesPaid.toLocaleString()}円 が生産活動の支払賃金総額に反映されました。`);
        await loadPayslips();
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      alert(`エラーが発生しました: ${e.message}`);
    }
    setIsCalculating(false);
  };

  const totalPaymentAll = payslips.reduce((sum, p) => sum + p.total_payment, 0);

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl space-y-8">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">給与・工賃管理</h1>
          <p className="mt-2 text-lg text-muted-foreground">
            勤怠データと連動して利用者の給与を計算し、明細書を発行します。
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-6">
        
        {/* コントロールパネル */}
        <div className="md:col-span-1 space-y-6">
          <Card className="shadow-sm border-muted">
            <CardHeader className="bg-primary/5 border-b pb-4">
              <CardTitle className="text-xl">操作</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="pt-6 space-y-4">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <label className="text-sm font-semibold">対象月</label>
                <Input 
                  type="month" 
                  value={targetMonth} 
                  onChange={(e) => setTargetMonth(e.target.value)} 
                  className="h-12 text-lg"
                />
              </div>
              
              <Button 
                onClick={handleCalculate} 
                disabled={isCalculating}
                className="w-full h-12 text-lg mt-4 flex items-center gap-2"
              >
                <Calculator className="h-5 w-5" />
                給与計算を実行
              </Button>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                ※実行するとこの月の生産活動収支データへも自動反映されます。
              </p>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
          
          <Card className="shadow-sm border-muted">
            <CardContent className="pt-6">
              <div className="text-center">
                <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-muted-foreground mb-1">今月の支払賃金総額</p>
                <p className="text-3xl font-bold text-primary">{totalPaymentAll.toLocaleString()}円</p>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>

        {/* 明細リスト */}
        <div className="md:col-span-3">
          <Card className="shadow-sm border-muted">
            <CardHeader className="bg-muted/30 border-b pb-4 flex flex-row items-center justify-between">
              <CardTitle className="text-xl">給与明細一覧 ({targetMonth})</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="pt-0 p-0">
              {isLoading ? (
                <div className="p-8 text-center text-muted-foreground">読み込み中...</div>
              ) : payslips.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="p-12 text-center text-muted-foreground flex flex-col items-center">
                  <FileText className="h-12 w-12 text-muted-foreground/30 mb-4" />
                  <p>この月の給与データがありません。</p>
                  <p className="text-sm mt-2">左の「給与計算を実行」ボタンを押して勤怠データから計算してください。</p>
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="overflow-x-auto">
                  <table className="w-full text-sm text-left min-w-[760px]">
                    <thead className="text-xs text-muted-foreground uppercase bg-muted/50 border-b">
                      <tr>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">氏名</th>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-right">総労働時間</th>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-right">適用時給</th>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-right">基本給</th>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-right">時間外手当<br/><span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-normal">(1.25倍)</span></th>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-right">休日手当<br/><span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-normal">(1.35倍)</span></th>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-right">深夜手当<br/><span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-normal">(0.25倍)</span></th>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-right">総支給額</th>
                        <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-center">明細書</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody className="divide-y">
                      {payslips.map((p) => {
                        const hours = Math.floor(p.total_working_minutes / 60);
                        const mins = p.total_working_minutes % 60;
                        return (
                          <tr key={p.id} className="hover:bg-muted/30">
                            <td className="px-4 py-3 font-bold">{p.full_name}</td>
                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">{hours}時間{mins}分</td>
                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">{p.hourly_wage.toLocaleString()}円</td>
                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">{p.base_salary?.toLocaleString() || 0}円</td>
                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-muted-foreground">{p.overtime_allowance?.toLocaleString() || 0}円</td>
                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-muted-foreground">{p.holiday_allowance?.toLocaleString() || 0}円</td>
                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-muted-foreground">{p.night_shift_allowance?.toLocaleString() || 0}円</td>
                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right text-primary font-bold">{p.total_payment.toLocaleString()}円</td>
                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
                              <Link 
                                href={`/payroll/print?month=${targetMonth}&clientId=${p.client_id}`}
                                target="_blank"
                                className="inline-flex items-center justify-center whitespace-nowrap rounded-md text-sm font-medium border border-input bg-background hover:bg-accent hover:text-accent-foreground h-8 px-3 gap-1"
                              >
                                <Printer className="h-3 w-3" />
                                印刷
                              </Link>
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                        );
                      })}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                </div>
              )}
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

File: src/app/payroll/actions.ts

'use server';

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { randomUUID } from "crypto";

export async function calculatePayrollForMonth(targetMonth: string) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (role !== 'admin') return { success: false, error: "権限がありません", count: 0, totalWagesPaid: 0 };

    // 対象月の月初から翌月初までの日付を計算 (targetMonth は 'YYYY-MM' 形式)
    const startDate = `${targetMonth}-01`;
    const nextMonth = new Date(`${targetMonth}-01`);
    nextMonth.setMonth(nextMonth.getMonth() + 1);
    const endDate = nextMonth.toISOString().slice(0, 10);

    // 1. 全クライアントを取得
    const clients = db.prepare(`SELECT id, full_name, hourly_wage, regular_holidays, weekly_scheduled_hours FROM clients WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (status IS NULL OR status = 'active')`).all() as any[];

    // 2. 期間内のすべての勤怠データを取得（有給・出勤の両方、論理削除除外）
    const attendances = db.prepare(`
      SELECT client_id, record_date, status, clock_in, clock_out, break_time_minutes 
      FROM attendance_records 
      WHERE record_date >= ? AND record_date < ? 
        AND status IN ('present', 'paid_leave', 'pto')
        AND deleted_at IS NULL
    `).all(startDate, endDate) as any[];

    // 3. シフト予定データを取得（有給休暇の所定時間算出用）
    const clientShifts = db.prepare(`
      SELECT client_id, target_date, scheduled_in, scheduled_out
      FROM client_shifts
      WHERE target_date >= ? AND target_date < ?
    `).all(startDate, endDate) as any[];

    const runInsert = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO monthly_payslips (
        id, client_id, target_month, total_working_minutes, working_days, pto_days, pto_allowance,
        hourly_wage, base_salary, total_payment,
        overtime_minutes, night_shift_minutes, holiday_working_minutes,
        overtime_allowance, night_shift_allowance, holiday_allowance,
        overtime_excess_minutes, overtime_excess_allowance
      ) VALUES (
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?
      ) ON CONFLICT(client_id, target_month) DO UPDATE SET
        total_working_minutes = excluded.total_working_minutes,
        working_days = excluded.working_days,
        pto_days = excluded.pto_days,
        pto_allowance = excluded.pto_allowance,
        hourly_wage = excluded.hourly_wage,
        base_salary = excluded.base_salary,
        total_payment = excluded.total_payment,
        overtime_minutes = excluded.overtime_minutes,
        night_shift_minutes = excluded.night_shift_minutes,
        holiday_working_minutes = excluded.holiday_working_minutes,
        overtime_allowance = excluded.overtime_allowance,
        night_shift_allowance = excluded.night_shift_allowance,
        holiday_allowance = excluded.holiday_allowance,
        overtime_excess_minutes = excluded.overtime_excess_minutes,
        overtime_excess_allowance = excluded.overtime_excess_allowance,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    `);

    const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any || {};
    const overtimeRate = typeof facility.overtime_rate === 'number' ? facility.overtime_rate : 0.25;
    const overtimeOver60Rate = typeof facility.overtime_over60_rate === 'number' ? facility.overtime_over60_rate : 0.50;
    const nightRate = typeof facility.night_rate === 'number' ? facility.night_rate : 0.25;
    const holidayRate = typeof facility.holiday_rate === 'number' ? facility.holiday_rate : 0.35;
    const legalHoliday = typeof facility.legal_holiday === 'string' ? facility.legal_holiday : '0'; // デフォルト0: 日曜日

    let totalWagesPaid = 0;

    // 週の月曜日を取得するヘルパー関数
    const getWeekStart = (dateStr: string): string => {
      const d = new Date(dateStr);
      const day = d.getDay();
      const diff = d.getDate() - day + (day === 0 ? -6 : 1);
      const monday = new Date(d.setDate(diff));
      return monday.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
    };

    // 法定端数処理（通達昭63.3.14基発150号: 30分未満切り捨て・30分以上切り上げ）
    const roundStatutoryHours = (minutes: number): number => {
      const hours = Math.floor(minutes / 60);
      const remainingMinutes = minutes % 60;
      return remainingMinutes >= 30 ? hours + 1 : hours;
    };

    db.transaction(() => {
      for (const client of clients) {
        const clientRecords = attendances.filter(a => a.client_id === client.id);
        
        let workingDays = 0;
        let ptoDays = 0;
        let totalMinutes = 0;
        let ptoMinutes = 0;
        let dailyOvertimeMinutes = 0;
        let nightShiftMinutes = 0;
        let holidayWorkingMinutes = 0;
        
        let regularHolidays: string[] = [];
        try {
          regularHolidays = JSON.parse(client.regular_holidays || '[]');
        } catch(e) {}

        // 週ごとの法定内労働時間集計（週40時間超過判定用）
        const weeklyRegularMinutes = new Map<string, number>();

        for (const record of clientRecords) {
          const isPto = record.status === 'pto' || record.status === 'paid_leave';

          if (isPto) {
            // 労働基準法第39条: 有給休暇取得日の賃金計算（所定労働時間を労働した場合に支払われる賃金）
            ptoDays++;
            const shift = clientShifts.find(s => s.client_id === client.id && s.target_date === record.record_date);
            let dayPtoMinutes = 0;
            if (shift && shift.scheduled_in && shift.scheduled_out) {
              const [sh, sm] = shift.scheduled_in.split(':').map(Number);
              const [eh, em] = shift.scheduled_out.split(':').map(Number);
              let outM = eh * 60 + em;
              const inM = sh * 60 + sm;
              if (outM < inM) outM += 24 * 60;
              dayPtoMinutes = outM - inM;
              // 休憩時間の控除（労基法第34条: 6時間超45分、8時間超60分）
              if (dayPtoMinutes > 480) {
                dayPtoMinutes -= 60;
              } else if (dayPtoMinutes > 360) {
                dayPtoMinutes -= 45;
              }
            } else if (client.weekly_scheduled_hours && client.weekly_scheduled_hours > 0) {
              const holidaysCount = regularHolidays.length > 0 ? regularHolidays.length : 2;
              const scheduledDaysPerWeek = Math.max(1, Math.min(6, 7 - holidaysCount));
              dayPtoMinutes = Math.round((client.weekly_scheduled_hours / scheduledDaysPerWeek) * 60);
            } else {
              dayPtoMinutes = 240; // デフォルト4時間
            }
            ptoMinutes += dayPtoMinutes;
          } else if (record.status === 'present') {
            workingDays++;
            if (record.clock_in && record.clock_out) {
              const [inH, inM] = record.clock_in.split(':').map(Number);
              const [outH, outM] = record.clock_out.split(':').map(Number);
              
              let outTotalM = outH * 60 + outM;
              const inTotalM = inH * 60 + inM;
              if (outTotalM < inTotalM) {
                outTotalM += 24 * 60; // 日またぎ
              }
              
              let breakM = record.break_time_minutes || 0;
              let rawMins = outTotalM - inTotalM;
              // 休憩時間の控除（労基法第24条・全額払いの原則の遵守）
              // 実績打刻を優先。事業所で自動控除が明示的に設定されている場合のみ自動控除、未設定時は実打刻に従う
              if (breakM === 0 && facility.auto_deduct_break_time === 1) {
                if (rawMins > 480) breakM = 60;
                else if (rawMins > 360) breakM = 45;
              }
              const mins = Math.max(0, rawMins - breakM);
              if (mins > 0) {
                totalMinutes += mins;
                
                const dObj = new Date(record.record_date);
                const dayOfWeekStr = dObj.getDay().toString();
                const isLegalHoliday = dayOfWeekStr === legalHoliday;

                if (isLegalHoliday) {
                  // 労基法第35条・第37条: 法定休日労働（35%割増、週40時間枠外）
                  holidayWorkingMinutes += mins;
                } else {
                  // 平日または法定外休日労働: 1日8時間超の時間外労働および週40時間枠への積算
                  if (mins > 480) {
                    dailyOvertimeMinutes += (mins - 480);
                    const regularPart = 480;
                    const weekKey = getWeekStart(record.record_date);
                    weeklyRegularMinutes.set(weekKey, (weeklyRegularMinutes.get(weekKey) || 0) + regularPart);
                  } else {
                    const weekKey = getWeekStart(record.record_date);
                    weeklyRegularMinutes.set(weekKey, (weeklyRegularMinutes.get(weekKey) || 0) + mins);
                  }
                }

                // 深夜労働計算 (22:00 - 05:00)
                let rawNightMins = 0;
                for (let m = inTotalM; m < outTotalM; m++) {
                   const hourOfDay = Math.floor(m / 60) % 24;
                   if (hourOfDay >= 22 || hourOfDay < 5) {
                     rawNightMins++;
                   }
                }
                // 深夜帯の休憩控除考慮: 日中拘束時間で休憩が消化されたとみなし、日中帯で不足する場合のみ深夜から控除
                const totalSpan = outTotalM - inTotalM;
                const daySpan = totalSpan - rawNightMins;
                const remainingBreakToDeductFromNight = Math.max(0, breakM - daySpan);
                const netNightMins = Math.max(0, rawNightMins - remainingBreakToDeductFromNight);
                nightShiftMinutes += netNightMins;
              }
            }
          }
        }

        // 週40時間を超える法定時間外労働の集計
        let weeklyOvertimeMinutes = 0;
        for (const mins of weeklyRegularMinutes.values()) {
          if (mins > 2400) { // 40時間 * 60分
            weeklyOvertimeMinutes += (mins - 2400);
          }
        }
        const totalOvertimeMinutes = dailyOvertimeMinutes + weeklyOvertimeMinutes;

        const hourlyWage = client.hourly_wage || 0;
        // 労基法第24条・通達昭63.3.14基発150号準拠: 50銭未満切捨、50銭以上切上（四捨五入）
        // 浮動小数点誤差防止のため、分×時給を先に計算してから60で割る
        const baseSalary = Math.round((totalMinutes * hourlyWage) / 60);
        const ptoAllowance = Math.round((ptoMinutes * hourlyWage) / 60);

        // 法定端数処理（通達昭63.3.14基発150号準拠: 1ヶ月の総時間外合計に対して30分未満切捨、30分以上切上）
        // 合計を丸めた上で、60時間以内と60時間超に按分する（二重切捨てによる未払い防止）
        const totalOvertimeHours = roundStatutoryHours(totalOvertimeMinutes);
        const normalOvertimeHours = Math.min(totalOvertimeHours, 60);
        const excessOvertimeHours = Math.max(0, totalOvertimeHours - 60);
        const normalOvertimeAllowance = Math.round(normalOvertimeHours * hourlyWage * overtimeRate);
        const excessOvertimeAllowance = Math.round(excessOvertimeHours * hourlyWage * overtimeOver60Rate);
        const overtimeAllowance = normalOvertimeAllowance + excessOvertimeAllowance;
        const overtimeExcessMinutes = Math.max(0, totalOvertimeMinutes - 3600);

        const roundedNightHours = roundStatutoryHours(nightShiftMinutes);
        const nightShiftAllowance = Math.round(roundedNightHours * hourlyWage * nightRate);

        const roundedHolidayHours = roundStatutoryHours(holidayWorkingMinutes);
        const holidayAllowance = Math.round(roundedHolidayHours * hourlyWage * holidayRate);
        
        const totalPayment = baseSalary + ptoAllowance + overtimeAllowance + nightShiftAllowance + holidayAllowance;

        if (totalMinutes > 0 || ptoMinutes > 0 || totalPayment > 0) {
          runInsert.run(
            randomUUID(),
            client.id,
            targetMonth,
            totalMinutes,
            workingDays,
            ptoDays,
            ptoAllowance,
            hourlyWage,
            baseSalary,
            totalPayment,
            totalOvertimeMinutes,
            nightShiftMinutes,
            holidayWorkingMinutes,
            overtimeAllowance,
            nightShiftAllowance,
            holidayAllowance,
            overtimeExcessMinutes,
            excessOvertimeAllowance
          );
          totalWagesPaid += totalPayment;
        }
      }

      // 連動して production_activities の total_wages_paid も更新する
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO production_activities (
          id, target_month, total_wages_paid
        ) VALUES (
          ?, ?, ?
        ) ON CONFLICT(target_month) DO UPDATE SET
          total_wages_paid = excluded.total_wages_paid,
          updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      `).run(randomUUID(), targetMonth, totalWagesPaid);

    })();

    try {
      revalidatePath('/payroll');
      revalidatePath('/billing/production'); // 収支データも更新されるため
    } catch (e) {}
    
    return { success: true, count: clients.length, totalWagesPaid };
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.error("Failed to calculate payroll for month:", e);
    return { success: false, error: e.message || "給与一括計算に失敗しました", count: 0, totalWagesPaid: 0 };
  }
}

export async function getPayslipsForMonth(targetMonth: string) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role) return [];

    return db.prepare(`
      SELECT p.*, c.full_name 
      FROM monthly_payslips p
      JOIN clients c ON p.client_id = c.id
      WHERE p.target_month = ?
      ORDER BY c.full_name ASC
    `).all(targetMonth) as any[];
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Failed to get payslips for month:", e);
    return [];
  }
}

import { redirect } from "next/navigation";

export default async function PrintPayslipPage({ 
  searchParams 
}: { 
  searchParams: Promise<{ month?: string; clientId?: string }> 
}) {
  const resolvedParams = await searchParams;
  const { month, clientId } = resolvedParams;

  if (!month) {
    redirect("/billing/payroll");
  }

  // 法定必須全項目（基本給・有休手当・割増・各種社保控除・税額等）が完全に揃った正式な給与明細ページへリダイレクト
  const redirectUrl = clientId 
    ? `/billing/payroll/payslips?month=${month}&clientId=${clientId}`
    : `/billing/payroll/payslips?month=${month}`;

  redirect(redirectUrl);
}
