'use client';

import { useState, useMemo } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { buttonVariants, Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import {
  FileText,
  User,
  PlusCircle,
  Calendar,
  AlertTriangle,
  CheckCircle2,
  Clock,
  ChevronDown,
  ChevronUp,
  History,
  LayoutGrid,
  List,
  Search,
  Filter,
  ArrowRight,
  ExternalLink,
  Users,
  AlertCircle
} from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { PlanActionButtons } from "./components/PlanActionButtons";

export interface PlanRecord {
  id: string;
  client_id: string;
  client_full_name?: string;
  plan_date: string;
  start_date?: string | null;
  end_date?: string | null;
  status: string;
  monitoring_period?: string | number | null;
  latest_monitoring_date?: string | null;
  consent_date?: string | null;
  delivery_date?: string | null;
  domains_data?: string | null;
  created_at?: string;
}

export interface ClientRecord {
  id: string;
  full_name: string;
  recipient_number?: string | null;
  status?: string | null;
}

interface PlansClientProps {
  clients: ClientRecord[];
  plans: PlanRecord[];
  initialClientId?: string;
  initialStatus?: string;
}

type FilterStatus = 'all' | 'overdue' | 'warning' | 'active' | 'draft' | 'no_plan';
type ViewMode = 'cards' | 'table';

export function PlansClient({
  clients,
  plans,
  initialClientId = '',
  initialStatus = 'all'
}: PlansClientProps) {
  const [selectedFilter, setSelectedFilter] = useState<FilterStatus>(
    initialStatus === 'active' ? 'active' : initialStatus === 'draft' ? 'draft' : 'all'
  );
  const [searchQuery, setSearchQuery] = useState(initialClientId ? '' : '');
  const [selectedClientFilter, setSelectedClientFilter] = useState(initialClientId);
  const [viewMode, setViewMode] = useState<ViewMode>('cards');
  const [expandedClients, setExpandedClients] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});

  const today = useMemo(() => new Date(), []);

  // 利用者ごとに計画書をグルーピング＆ステータス判定
  const groupedData = useMemo(() => {
    return clients.map(client => {
      // 当該利用者の全計画書（作成日降順）
      const clientPlans = plans.filter(p => p.client_id === client.id);

      // 有効な現行計画書（status === 'active' の中で最新）
      const activePlan = clientPlans.find(p => p.status === 'active') || null;

      // 最新の下書き計画書（status === 'draft'）
      const draftPlan = clientPlans.find(p => p.status === 'draft') || null;

      // 過去履歴（activePlan 以外のもの、または過去ステータス）
      const historyPlans = clientPlans.filter(p => p.id !== activePlan?.id && p.status !== 'draft');

      // メインで前面表示する計画書（現行優先、なければ下書き、それもなければ最新の過去計画）
      const primaryPlan = activePlan || draftPlan || (clientPlans.length > 0 ? clientPlans[0] : null);

      // モニタリング期日計算
      let dueDate: Date | null = null;
      let dueDateStr = '';
      let diffDays: number | null = null;
      let isOverdue = false;
      let isWarning = false;

      if (primaryPlan && primaryPlan.status === 'active') {
        const baseDateStr = primaryPlan.latest_monitoring_date || primaryPlan.start_date || primaryPlan.plan_date;
        const baseDate = new Date(baseDateStr);
        const months = parseInt(String(primaryPlan.monitoring_period)) || 6;
        dueDate = new Date(baseDate);
        const targetMonth = dueDate.getMonth() + months;
        dueDate.setMonth(targetMonth);
        if (dueDate.getMonth() !== (targetMonth % 12)) {
          dueDate.setDate(0);
        }
        dueDateStr = dueDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10);
        diffDays = Math.ceil((dueDate.getTime() - today.getTime()) / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));
        isOverdue = diffDays < 0;
        isWarning = diffDays >= 0 && diffDays <= 30;
      }

      // カテゴリ分類
      let category: FilterStatus = 'no_plan';
      if (!primaryPlan) {
        category = 'no_plan';
      } else if (isOverdue) {
        category = 'overdue';
      } else if (isWarning) {
        category = 'warning';
      } else if (primaryPlan.status === 'draft') {
        category = 'draft';
      } else if (primaryPlan.status === 'active') {
        category = 'active';
      }

      return {
        client,
        allPlans: clientPlans,
        activePlan,
        draftPlan,
        historyPlans,
        primaryPlan,
        dueDateStr,
        diffDays,
        isOverdue,
        isWarning,
        category,
        totalPlansCount: clientPlans.length
      };
    });
  }, [clients, plans, today]);

  // サマリー集計
  const counts = useMemo(() => {
    let overdue = 0;
    let warning = 0;
    let active = 0;
    let draft = 0;
    let noPlan = 0;

    groupedData.forEach(item => {
      if (item.category === 'overdue') overdue++;
      else if (item.category === 'warning') warning++;
      else if (item.category === 'draft') draft++;
      else if (item.category === 'active') active++;
      else if (item.category === 'no_plan') noPlan++;
    });

    return {
      all: groupedData.length,
      overdue,
      warning,
      active,
      draft,
      noPlan,
      needsAttention: overdue + warning + noPlan
    };
  }, [groupedData]);

  // フィルタリング処理
  const filteredData = useMemo(() => {
    return groupedData.filter(item => {
      // 利用者セレクトボックスでの絞り込み
      if (selectedClientFilter && item.client.id !== selectedClientFilter) {
        return false;
      }

      // テキスト検索（氏名）
      if (searchQuery.trim()) {
        const q = searchQuery.trim().toLowerCase();
        if (!item.client.full_name.toLowerCase().includes(q)) {
          return false;
        }
      }

      // ステータスフィルター
      if (selectedFilter === 'all') return true;
      if (selectedFilter === 'overdue') return item.isOverdue;
      if (selectedFilter === 'warning') return item.isWarning;
      if (selectedFilter === 'active') return item.primaryPlan?.status === 'active';
      if (selectedFilter === 'draft') return item.primaryPlan?.status === 'draft';
      if (selectedFilter === 'no_plan') return item.category === 'no_plan';

      return true;
    }).sort((a, b) => {
      // 要対応（期限超過・期日接近）を優先して上位に表示
      const order = { overdue: 1, warning: 2, no_plan: 3, draft: 4, active: 5 };
      const scoreA = order[a.category] || 99;
      const scoreB = order[b.category] || 99;
      if (scoreA !== scoreB) return scoreA - scoreB;
      return a.client.full_name.localeCompare(b.client.full_name, 'ja');
    });
  }, [groupedData, selectedFilter, searchQuery, selectedClientFilter]);

  // アコーディオン開閉トグル
  const toggleExpand = (clientId: string) => {
    setExpandedClients(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      [clientId]: !prev[clientId]
    }));
  };

  const expandAll = () => {
    const next: Record<string, boolean> = {};
    groupedData.forEach(item => {
      if (item.historyPlans.length > 0) {
        next[item.client.id] = true;
      }
    });
    setExpandedClients(next);
  };

  const collapseAll = () => {
    setExpandedClients({});
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* 1. 上部KPIサマリーカード（ワンタップで絞り込み可能） */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-6 gap-3">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setSelectedFilter('all')}
          className={cn(
            "p-3.5 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all flex flex-col justify-between",
            selectedFilter === 'all'
              ? "bg-primary/10 border-primary ring-2 ring-primary/20 shadow-sm"
              : "bg-card hover:bg-muted/40 border-border"
          )}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground">
            <span>全利用者</span>
            <Users className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-1">
            <span className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-foreground">{counts.all}</span>
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">名</span>
          </div>
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setSelectedFilter('overdue')}
          className={cn(
            "p-3.5 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all flex flex-col justify-between",
            counts.overdue > 0 ? "border-red-300 bg-red-50/40" : "bg-card border-border",
            selectedFilter === 'overdue' && "ring-2 ring-red-400 bg-red-100/60 border-red-400"
          )}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold text-red-700">
            <span>期日超過</span>
            <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-red-600" />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-1">
            <span className={cn("text-2xl font-extrabold", counts.overdue > 0 ? "text-red-700" : "text-muted-foreground")}>
              {counts.overdue}
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs text-red-600">名</span>
          </div>
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setSelectedFilter('warning')}
          className={cn(
            "p-3.5 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all flex flex-col justify-between",
            counts.warning > 0 ? "border-amber-300 bg-amber-50/40" : "bg-card border-border",
            selectedFilter === 'warning' && "ring-2 ring-amber-400 bg-amber-100/60 border-amber-400"
          )}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold text-amber-700">
            <span>期日接近 (30日)</span>
            <Clock className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-600" />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-1">
            <span className={cn("text-2xl font-extrabold", counts.warning > 0 ? "text-amber-700" : "text-muted-foreground")}>
              {counts.warning}
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs text-amber-600">名</span>
          </div>
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setSelectedFilter('active')}
          className={cn(
            "p-3.5 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all flex flex-col justify-between",
            selectedFilter === 'active'
              ? "bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-400 ring-2 ring-emerald-300"
              : "bg-card hover:bg-muted/40 border-border"
          )}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold text-emerald-700">
            <span>現行運用中</span>
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600" />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-1">
            <span className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-emerald-800">{counts.active}</span>
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">名</span>
          </div>
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setSelectedFilter('draft')}
          className={cn(
            "p-3.5 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all flex flex-col justify-between",
            selectedFilter === 'draft'
              ? "bg-blue-50 border-blue-400 ring-2 ring-blue-300"
              : "bg-card hover:bg-muted/40 border-border"
          )}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold text-blue-700">
            <span>下書き作成中</span>
            <FileText className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-600" />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-1">
            <span className="text-2xl font-extrabold text-blue-800">{counts.draft}</span>
            <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">名</span>
          </div>
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setSelectedFilter('no_plan')}
          className={cn(
            "p-3.5 rounded-xl border text-left transition-all flex flex-col justify-between",
            counts.noPlan > 0 ? "border-slate-300 bg-slate-50" : "bg-card border-border",
            selectedFilter === 'no_plan' && "ring-2 ring-slate-400 bg-slate-100 border-slate-400"
          )}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold text-slate-700">
            <span>未作成 (要策定)</span>
            <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-slate-500" />
          </div>
          <div className="mt-2 flex items-baseline gap-1">
            <span className={cn("text-2xl font-extrabold", counts.noPlan > 0 ? "text-slate-800" : "text-muted-foreground")}>
              {counts.noPlan}
            </span>
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-600">名</span>
          </div>
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* 2. 検索・操作ツールバー */}
      <Card className="shadow-xs border-border/80 bg-card">
        <CardContent className="p-3.5 sm:p-4">
          <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row gap-3 items-stretch md:items-center justify-between">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2.5 flex-1">
              {/* 名前検索 */}
              <div className="relative min-w-[200px] flex-1 sm:flex-initial">
                <Search className="absolute left-3 top-2.5 h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                <Input
                  type="text"
                  placeholder="利用者を検索..."
                  value={searchQuery}
                  onChange={e => setSearchQuery(e.target.value)}
                  className="pl-9 h-9 text-sm"
                />
              </div>

              {/* 利用者セレクト */}
              <select
                value={selectedClientFilter}
                onChange={e => setSelectedClientFilter(e.target.value)}
                className="h-9 rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 text-sm shadow-xs focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring"
              >
                <option value="">全利用者を表示</option>
                {clients.map(c => (
                  <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.full_name}</option>
                ))}
              </select>

              {(searchQuery || selectedClientFilter || selectedFilter !== 'all') && (
                <Button
                  variant="ghost"
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => {
                    setSearchQuery('');
                    setSelectedClientFilter('');
                    setSelectedFilter('all');
                  }}
                  className="h-9 px-2.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                >
                  条件クリア
                </Button>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* 表示モード＆展開切替 */}
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 justify-end shrink-0 pt-2 md:pt-0 border-t md:border-t-0 border-border/60">
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={Object.keys(expandedClients).length > 0 ? collapseAll : expandAll}
                className="h-9 text-xs text-muted-foreground"
              >
                <History className="mr-1.5 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                {Object.keys(expandedClients).length > 0 ? '全履歴を閉じる' : '全履歴を展開'}
              </Button>

              <div className="flex items-center rounded-lg border border-input bg-muted/30 p-0.5">
                <Button
                  variant={viewMode === 'cards' ? 'secondary' : 'ghost'}
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => setViewMode('cards')}
                  className={cn("h-7 px-2.5 text-xs", viewMode === 'cards' && "font-bold shadow-xs")}
                  title="カード表示"
                >
                  <LayoutGrid className="h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-1" />
                  カード
                </Button>
                <Button
                  variant={viewMode === 'table' ? 'secondary' : 'ghost'}
                  size="sm"
                  onClick={() => setViewMode('table')}
                  className={cn("h-7 px-2.5 text-xs", viewMode === 'table' && "font-bold shadow-xs")}
                  title="コンパクト一覧表示"
                >
                  <List className="h-3.5 w-3.5 mr-1" />
                  一覧表
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* 3. メイン表示エリア */}
      {filteredData.length === 0 ? (
        <Card className="shadow-xs p-12 text-center text-muted-foreground">
          <p className="text-base font-medium">条件に一致する計画書・利用者は見つかりませんでした。</p>
          <Button
            variant="link"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => {
              setSelectedFilter('all');
              setSearchQuery('');
              setSelectedClientFilter('');
            }}
            className="mt-2 text-primary"
          >
            すべての利用者を表示する
          </Button>
        </Card>
      ) : viewMode === 'cards' ? (
        /* ======================== カードビュー（利用者軸カード） ======================== */
        <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 xl:grid-cols-3">
          {filteredData.map(item => {
            const { client, primaryPlan, activePlan, draftPlan, historyPlans, isOverdue, isWarning, diffDays, dueDateStr } = item;
            const isExpanded = !!expandedClients[client.id];

            let domainsData = {};
            if (primaryPlan?.domains_data) {
              try {
                domainsData = JSON.parse(primaryPlan.domains_data);
              } catch (e) {}
            }

            return (
              <Card
                key={client.id}
                className={cn(
                  "shadow-xs hover:shadow-md transition-all flex flex-col justify-between border",
                  isOverdue && "border-red-300 bg-red-50/15",
                  isWarning && "border-amber-300 bg-amber-50/15",
                  !primaryPlan && "border-dashed border-slate-300 bg-slate-50/30"
                )}
              >
                <div>
                  {/* カードヘッダー */}
                  <CardHeader className="p-4 pb-3 border-b border-border/50 bg-muted/10">
                    <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 min-w-0">
                        <div className="h-8 w-8 rounded-full bg-primary/10 flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                          <User className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                        </div>
                        <div className="min-w-0">
                          <h3 className="font-bold text-base text-foreground truncate flex items-center gap-1.5">
                            {client.full_name}
                            <span className="text-xs font-normal text-muted-foreground">様</span>
                          </h3>
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                            <span>計画書: 全{item.totalPlansCount}件</span>
                          </div>
                        </div>
                      </div>

                      {/* 状態バッジ */}
                      <div className="flex flex-col items-end gap-1 shrink-0">
                        {primaryPlan ? (
                          <Badge
                            variant={primaryPlan.status === 'draft' ? 'outline' : 'default'}
                            className={cn(
                              "text-[11px] px-2 py-0.5 font-bold",
                              primaryPlan.status === 'draft'
                                ? "bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border-amber-300"
                                : "bg-emerald-600 text-white"
                            )}
                          >
                            {primaryPlan.status === 'draft' ? '下書き作成中' : '現行運用中'}
                          </Badge>
                        ) : (
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[11px] bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 border-slate-300">
                            未作成
                          </Badge>
                        )}

                        {isOverdue && (
                          <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-red-100 text-red-700 font-bold border border-red-200">
                            ⚠ モニタリング{Math.abs(diffDays || 0)}日超過
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {isWarning && (
                          <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 font-bold border border-amber-200">
                            期日接近 (残り{diffDays}日)
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </CardHeader>

                  {/* カードボディ（現行・最新計画書） */}
                  <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-3">
                    {primaryPlan ? (
                      <>
                        <div className="space-y-1.5 text-xs">
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-muted-foreground">
                            <span>計画期間:</span>
                            <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">
                              {primaryPlan.start_date || primaryPlan.plan_date} 〜 {primaryPlan.end_date || '未設定'}
                            </span>
                          </div>

                          <div className="flex items-center justify-between text-muted-foreground">
                            <span>作成日: {primaryPlan.plan_date}</span>
                            {primaryPlan.delivery_date ? (
                              <span className="text-emerald-700 font-medium">交付済 ({primaryPlan.delivery_date})</span>
                            ) : primaryPlan.consent_date ? (
                              <span className="text-blue-700 font-medium">同意済 ({primaryPlan.consent_date})</span>
                            ) : (
                              <span className="text-amber-700 font-medium">未同意・未交付</span>
                            )}
                          </div>

                          {dueDateStr && (
                            <div className="flex items-center justify-between pt-1 border-t border-border/40 text-[11px]">
                              <span className="text-muted-foreground">次回モニタリング予定:</span>
                              <span className={cn("font-bold", isOverdue ? "text-red-600" : isWarning ? "text-amber-700" : "text-foreground")}>
                                {dueDateStr}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          )}
                        </div>

                        {/* 課題・目標プレビュー */}
                        <div className="rounded-lg bg-muted/30 p-2.5 text-xs text-muted-foreground line-clamp-2">
                          <span className="font-bold text-foreground/80 mr-1">課題:</span>
                          {(domainsData as any)['健康・生活']?.issues || (domainsData as any)['本人・家族の希望']?.wishes || '設定された課題を入力中...'}
                        </div>

                        {/* アクションボタン */}
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2 pt-1">
                          <Link
                            href={`/plans/${primaryPlan.id}`}
                            className={cn(buttonVariants({ size: "sm", variant: "default" }), "flex-1 h-8 text-xs font-bold")}
                          >
                            計画書を開く
                            <ArrowRight className="ml-1 h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                          </Link>
                          <Link
                            href={`/plans/${primaryPlan.id}/edit`}
                            className={cn(buttonVariants({ size: "sm", variant: "outline" }), "h-8 text-xs")}
                          >
                            編集
                          </Link>
                          {primaryPlan.status === 'draft' && (
                            <PlanActionButtons
                              planId={primaryPlan.id}
                              clientId={client.id}
                              status={primaryPlan.status}
                              consentDate={primaryPlan.consent_date}
                              compact={true}
                            />
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </>
                    ) : (
                      /* 計画書未作成時の案内 */
                      <div className="py-4 text-center space-y-3">
                        <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                          有効な個別支援計画書がまだありません。
                        </p>
                        <Link
                          href={`/plans/new?clientId=${client.id}`}
                          className={cn(buttonVariants({ size: "sm", className: "w-full font-bold" }))}
                        >
                          <PlusCircle className="mr-1.5 h-4 w-4" />
                          この利用者の計画書を作成
                        </Link>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </CardContent>
                </div>

                {/* カードフッター: 過去履歴アコーディオン（ここがスッキリ改善のキモ！） */}
                <div className="border-t border-border/60 bg-muted/5">
                  <div className="p-2.5 px-4 flex items-center justify-between">
                    {historyPlans.length > 0 ? (
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() => toggleExpand(client.id)}
                        className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold text-primary hover:underline"
                      >
                        <History className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        <span>過去の計画書 ({historyPlans.length}件)</span>
                        {isExpanded ? <ChevronUp className="h-3.5 w-3.5" /> : <ChevronDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />}
                      </button>
                    ) : (
                      <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">過去履歴なし</span>
                    )}

                    <Link
                      href={`/clients/${client.id}/documents?tab=plan`}
                      className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground flex items-center gap-1 hover:underline"
                      title="この利用者の書類カルテを開く"
                    >
                      <span>台帳カルテ</span>
                      <ExternalLink className="h-3 w-3" />
                    </Link>
                  </div>

                  {/* 展開された過去履歴リスト */}
                  {isExpanded && historyPlans.length > 0 && (
                    <div className="px-4 pb-3 pt-1 space-y-2 border-t border-border/40 bg-muted/20">
                      <div className="text-[11px] font-bold text-muted-foreground">過去の履歴アーカイブ:</div>
                      <div className="space-y-1.5 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto pr-1">
                        {historyPlans.map((hist, idx) => (
                          <div
                            key={hist.id}
                            className="p-2 rounded-md bg-card border border-border/60 text-xs flex items-center justify-between gap-2 hover:bg-muted/40 transition-colors"
                          >
                            <div className="min-w-0">
                              <div className="font-semibold text-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5">
                                <span>第{historyPlans.length - idx}期</span>
                                <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-normal">({hist.plan_date})</span>
                              </div>
                              <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground truncate">
                                期間: {hist.start_date || hist.plan_date} 〜 {hist.end_date || '未定'}
                              </div>
                            </div>

                            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 shrink-0">
                              <Link
                                href={`/plans/${hist.id}`}
                                className={cn(buttonVariants({ size: "sm", variant: "ghost" }), "h-7 px-2 text-[11px]")}
                              >
                                閲覧
                              </Link>
                              <Link
                                href={`/plans/${hist.id}/edit`}
                                className={cn(buttonVariants({ size: "sm", variant: "ghost" }), "h-7 px-2 text-[11px]")}
                              >
                                編集
                              </Link>
                            </div>
                          </div>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              </Card>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      ) : (
        /* ======================== テーブルビュー（一覧表形式） ======================== */
        <Card className="shadow-xs overflow-hidden">
          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-sm text-left border-collapse">
              <thead className="bg-muted/50 text-xs text-muted-foreground border-b uppercase">
                <tr>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4 font-bold">利用者名</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3 font-bold">現行計画ステータス</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3 font-bold">計画期間</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3 font-bold">同意・交付状況</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3 font-bold">次回モニタリング</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-3 font-bold text-center">履歴</th>
                  <th className="py-3 px-4 font-bold text-right">操作</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-border/60">
                {filteredData.map(item => {
                  const { client, primaryPlan, historyPlans, isOverdue, isWarning, diffDays, dueDateStr } = item;
                  const isExpanded = !!expandedClients[client.id];

                  return (
                    <tr key={client.id} className={cn(
                      "hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors",
                      isOverdue && "bg-red-50/20",
                      isWarning && "bg-amber-50/20"
                    )}>
                      {/* 利用者名 */}
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 font-bold text-foreground">
                        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                          <User className="h-4 w-4 text-primary shrink-0" />
                          <span>{client.full_name}</span>
                        </div>
                      </td>

                      {/* ステータス */}
                      <td className="py-3 px-3">
                        {primaryPlan ? (
                          <Badge
                            variant={primaryPlan.status === 'draft' ? 'outline' : 'default'}
                            className={cn(
                              "text-xs px-2 py-0.5",
                              primaryPlan.status === 'draft'
                                ? "bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border-amber-300"
                                : "bg-emerald-600 text-white"
                            )}
                          >
                            {primaryPlan.status === 'draft' ? '下書き' : '有効'}
                          </Badge>
                        ) : (
                          <Badge variant="outline" className="text-xs bg-slate-100 text-slate-700">
                            未作成
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      {/* 計画期間 */}
                      <td className="py-3 px-3 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                        {primaryPlan ? (
                          <span>{primaryPlan.start_date || primaryPlan.plan_date} 〜 {primaryPlan.end_date || '未設定'}</span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-slate-400">-</span>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      {/* 同意・交付 */}
                      <td className="py-3 px-3 text-xs">
                        {primaryPlan ? (
                          primaryPlan.delivery_date ? (
                            <span className="text-emerald-700 font-semibold">交付済 ({primaryPlan.delivery_date})</span>
                          ) : primaryPlan.consent_date ? (
                            <span className="text-blue-700 font-semibold">同意済 ({primaryPlan.consent_date})</span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-amber-700">未同意・未交付</span>
                          )
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-slate-400">-</span>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      {/* 次回モニタリング */}
                      <td className="py-3 px-3 text-xs">
                        {dueDateStr ? (
                          <div className="flex flex-col">
                            <span className={cn("font-bold", isOverdue ? "text-red-600" : isWarning ? "text-amber-700" : "text-foreground")}>
                              {dueDateStr}
                            </span>
                            {isOverdue && (
                              <span className="text-[10px] text-red-600 font-bold">⚠ {Math.abs(diffDays || 0)}日超過</span>
                            )}
                            {isWarning && (
                              <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-600 font-medium">残り{diffDays}日</span>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-slate-400">-</span>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      {/* 履歴件数 */}
                      <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center">
                        {historyPlans.length > 0 ? (
                          <Button
                            variant="ghost"
                            size="sm"
                            onClick={() => toggleExpand(client.id)}
                            className="h-7 px-2 text-xs text-primary"
                          >
                            <span>{historyPlans.length}件</span>
                            {isExpanded ? <ChevronUp className="h-3 w-3 ml-1" /> : <ChevronDown className="h-3 w-3 ml-1" />}
                          </Button>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">0件</span>
                        )}
                      </td>

                      {/* 操作 */}
                      <td className="py-3 px-4 text-right">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1.5">
                          {primaryPlan ? (
                            <>
                              <Link
                                href={`/plans/${primaryPlan.id}`}
                                className={cn(buttonVariants({ size: "sm", variant: "outline" }), "h-7 text-xs font-bold")}
                              >
                                開く
                              </Link>
                              <Link
                                href={`/plans/${primaryPlan.id}/edit`}
                                className={cn(buttonVariants({ size: "sm", variant: "ghost" }), "h-7 text-xs")}
                              >
                                編集
                              </Link>
                            </>
                          ) : (
                            <Link
                              href={`/plans/new?clientId=${client.id}`}
                              className={cn(buttonVariants({ size: "sm", variant: "default" }), "h-7 text-xs font-bold")}
                            >
                              作成
                            </Link>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

// 和暦変換ユーティリティ
function formatJapaneseEra(dateStr?: string): { era: string; year: string; month: string; day: string } {
  if (!dateStr) return { era: '', year: '', month: '', day: '' };
  try {
    const d = new Date(dateStr);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return { era: '', year: '', month: '', day: '' };
    const year = d.getFullYear();
    const month = String(d.getMonth() + 1);
    const day = String(d.getDate());

    if (year >= 2019) {
      const reiwaYear = year === 2019 ? '元' : String(year - 2018);
      return { era: '令和', year: reiwaYear, month, day };
    } else if (year >= 1989) {
      const heiseiYear = year === 1989 ? '元' : String(year - 1988);
      return { era: '平成', year: heiseiYear, month, day };
    } else {
      const showaYear = year === 1926 ? '元' : String(year - 1925);
      return { era: '昭和', year: showaYear, month, day };
    }
  } catch {
    return { era: '', year: '', month: '', day: '' };
  }
}

// 生年月日のフォーマットと年齢計算
function formatBirthdateAndAge(birthdateStr?: string): { eraText: string; ageText: string } {
  if (!birthdateStr) return { eraText: '昭和 / 平成　　年　　月　　日生', ageText: '　　歳' };
  try {
    const d = new Date(birthdateStr);
    if (isNaN(d.getTime())) return { eraText: birthdateStr, ageText: '' };
    const year = d.getFullYear();
    const month = d.getMonth() + 1;
    const day = d.getDate();

    let eraLabel = '西暦';
    let eraYear: string | number = year;
    if (year >= 2019) {
      eraLabel = '令和';
      eraYear = year === 2019 ? '元' : year - 2018;
    } else if (year >= 1989) {
      eraLabel = '平成';
      eraYear = year === 1989 ? '元' : year - 1988;
    } else if (year >= 1926) {
      eraLabel = '昭和';
      eraYear = year === 1926 ? '元' : year - 1925;
    }

    const today = new Date();
    let age = today.getFullYear() - year;
    const m = today.getMonth() + 1 - month;
    if (m < 0 || (m === 0 && today.getDate() < day)) {
      age--;
    }

    return {
      eraText: `${eraLabel} ${eraYear} 年 ${month} 月 ${day} 日生`,
      ageText: `${age} 歳`
    };
  } catch {
    return { eraText: birthdateStr, ageText: '' };
  }
}

// 文字数に応じた枠内自動縮小（Auto-fit）ヘルパー
function getAutoFitClass(
  text: string | undefined | null,
  thresholds: { normal: number; small: number; tiny?: number } = { normal: 60, small: 110, tiny: 160 }
): string {
  const len = (text || '').trim().length;
  if (thresholds.tiny && len > thresholds.tiny) {
    return 'text-[6pt] leading-[1.05] tracking-tight';
  }
  if (len > thresholds.small) {
    return 'text-[6.5pt] leading-[1.1] tracking-tight';
  }
  if (len > thresholds.normal) {
    return 'text-[7.5pt] leading-[1.15]';
  }
  return 'text-[8pt] leading-snug';
}

            </div>

            {/* 2行目：事業所No.・電話/FAX・説明者 */}
            <div className="col-span-5 whitespace-nowrap text-[7pt] h-4 flex items-center">
              <span className="text-gray-700 shrink-0">事業所No. </span>
              <span className="font-mono font-bold tracking-wider ml-1">{facility?.facility_number || '0000000000'}</span>
            </div>
            <div className="col-span-4 whitespace-nowrap text-gray-700 overflow-hidden h-4">
              <AutoFitText
                text={`Tel. ${facility?.phone_number || '00-0000-0000'} / Fax. ${facility?.fax_number || facility?.phone_number || '00-0000-0000'}`}
                maxFontSize={6.5}
                minFontSize={4.5}
              />
            </div>
            <div className="col-span-3 text-right whitespace-nowrap text-[7pt] h-4 overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-end">
              <span className="shrink-0">説明者：</span>
              <div className="max-w-[70%] overflow-hidden h-full">
                <AutoFitText text={creatorName} maxFontSize={7.0} minFontSize={5.0} className="font-bold" />
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

File: src/app/plans/[id]/PlanProcessTimeline.tsx

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { 
  ClipboardList, 
  Users, 
  LineChart, 
  FileSignature, 
  Plus, 
  Calendar, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  Clock, 
  AlertCircle,
  Edit,
  Trash2,
  Printer,
  BookOpen,
  ShieldCheck,
  Loader2
} from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { 
  saveAssessment, 
  saveServiceConference, 
  savePlanMonitoring,
  deleteAssessment,
  deleteServiceConference,
  deletePlanMonitoring,
  generateGroundedMonitoringDraft
} from "../actions";
import { toast } from "sonner";

interface ProcessTimelineProps {
  clientId: string;
  planId: string;
  planDate: string;
  consentDate?: string;
  deliveryDate?: string;
  assessments: any[];
  conferences: any[];
  monitorings: any[];
}

export function PlanProcessTimeline({
  clientId,
  planId,
  planDate,
  consentDate,
  deliveryDate,
  assessments,
  conferences,
  monitorings,
}: ProcessTimelineProps) {
  const [activeModal, setActiveModal] = useState<'none' | 'assessment' | 'conference' | 'monitoring'>('none');
  const [editingItem, setEditingItem] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [generatingGrounded, setGeneratingGrounded] = useState(false);
  const [groundedMeta, setGroundedMeta] = useState<{
    period_start: string;
    period_end: string;
    attendance_count: number;
    support_record_count: number;
    cited_record_dates: string[];
    masked_source_preview: string;
  } | null>(null);
  const [showMaskedSource, setShowMaskedSource] = useState(false);

  // プロセス進行ステータス判定
  const hasAssessment = assessments.length > 0;
  const hasConference = conferences.length > 0;
  const hasConsent = !!consentDate;
  const hasDelivery = !!deliveryDate;
  const hasMonitoring = monitorings.length > 0;

  // 法定プロセスの時系列整合性チェック（アセスメント ≦ 原案作成 ≦ 担当者会議 ≦ 本人同意 ≦ 交付）
  const sequenceWarnings: string[] = [];
  const sortedAssessments = [...assessments].sort((a, b) => (a.assessment_date || '').localeCompare(b.assessment_date || ''));
  const sortedConferences = [...conferences].sort((a, b) => (a.conference_date || '').localeCompare(b.conference_date || ''));
  const latestAssessmentDate = sortedAssessments.length > 0 ? sortedAssessments[sortedAssessments.length - 1].assessment_date : null;
  const latestConferenceDate = sortedConferences.length > 0 ? sortedConferences[sortedConferences.length - 1].conference_date : null;

  if (latestAssessmentDate && planDate && latestAssessmentDate > planDate) {
    sequenceWarnings.push(`アセスメント日（${latestAssessmentDate}）が計画原案作成日（${planDate}）より後になっています。`);
  }
  if (planDate && latestConferenceDate && planDate > latestConferenceDate) {
    sequenceWarnings.push(`計画原案作成日（${planDate}）がサービス担当者会議日（${latestConferenceDate}）より後になっています。`);
  }
  if (latestConferenceDate && consentDate && latestConferenceDate > consentDate) {
    sequenceWarnings.push(`担当者会議日（${latestConferenceDate}）が本人同意日（${consentDate}）より後になっています（実地指導で虚偽記録・指導対象）。`);
  }
  if (consentDate && deliveryDate && consentDate > deliveryDate) {
    sequenceWarnings.push(`本人同意日（${consentDate}）が交付日（${deliveryDate}）より後になっています。`);
  }

  const handleOpenCreate = (type: 'assessment' | 'conference' | 'monitoring') => {
    setEditingItem(null);
    setActiveModal(type);
  };

  const handleOpenEdit = (type: 'assessment' | 'conference' | 'monitoring', item: any) => {
    setEditingItem(item);
    setActiveModal(type);
  };

  const handleSaveAssessment = async (e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    const formData = new FormData(e.currentTarget);
    formData.append('clientId', clientId);
    formData.append('supportPlanId', planId);
    if (editingItem?.id) {
      formData.append('id', editingItem.id);
    }

    try {
      const res = await saveAssessment(formData);
      if (!res.success) {
        toast.error(res.error || 'アセスメント記録の保存に失敗しました');
        return;
      }
      toast.success(editingItem?.id ? 'アセスメント記録を更新しました' : 'アセスメント記録を保存しました');
      setActiveModal('none');
      setEditingItem(null);
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(err.message || '保存に失敗しました');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveConference = async (e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    const formData = new FormData(e.currentTarget);
    formData.append('clientId', clientId);
    formData.append('supportPlanId', planId);
    if (editingItem?.id) {
      formData.append('id', editingItem.id);
    }

    try {
      const res = await saveServiceConference(formData);
      if (!res.success) {
        toast.error(res.error || 'サービス担当者会議録の保存に失敗しました');
        return;
      }
      toast.success(editingItem?.id ? 'サービス担当者会議録を更新しました' : 'サービス担当者会議録を保存しました');
      setActiveModal('none');
      setEditingItem(null);
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(err.message || '保存に失敗しました');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSaveMonitoring = async (e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    const formData = new FormData(e.currentTarget);
    formData.append('clientId', clientId);
    formData.append('supportPlanId', planId);
    if (editingItem?.id) {
      formData.append('id', editingItem.id);
    }

    try {
      const res = await savePlanMonitoring(formData);
      if (!res.success) {
        toast.error(res.error || 'モニタリング記録の保存に失敗しました');
        return;
      }
      toast.success(editingItem?.id ? 'モニタリング記録を更新しました' : 'モニタリング記録を保存しました');
      setActiveModal('none');
      setEditingItem(null);
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(err.message || '保存に失敗しました');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteAssessment = async (id: string) => {
    if (!confirm('このアセスメント記録を削除しますか？')) return;
    try {
      const res = await deleteAssessment(id, planId);
      if (!res.success) {
        toast.error(res.error || '削除に失敗しました');
        return;
      }
      toast.success('アセスメント記録を削除しました');
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(err.message || '削除に失敗しました');
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteConference = async (id: string) => {
    if (!confirm('このサービス担当者会議録を削除しますか？')) return;
    try {
      const res = await deleteServiceConference(id, planId);
      if (!res.success) {
        toast.error(res.error || '削除に失敗しました');
        return;
      }
      toast.success('サービス担当者会議録を削除しました');
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(err.message || '削除に失敗しました');
    }
  };

  const handleDeleteMonitoring = async (id: string) => {
    if (!confirm('このモニタリング記録を削除しますか？')) return;
    try {
      const res = await deletePlanMonitoring(id, planId);
      if (!res.success) {
        toast.error(res.error || '削除に失敗しました');
        return;
      }
      toast.success('モニタリング記録を削除しました');
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(err.message || '削除に失敗しました');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 print:hidden">
      {/* 法定プロセス進捗バー */}
      <Card className="border-blue-200 bg-blue-50/40">
        <CardHeader className="pb-3">
          <CardTitle className="text-lg flex items-center gap-2 text-blue-900">
            <ClipboardList className="h-5 w-5 text-blue-600" />
            個別支援計画の法定策定プロセス（実地指導対応）
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            実地指導では「アセスメント → 原案作成 → 担当者会議 → 本案・同意 → 定期モニタリング」の一連の記録が揃っているかが厳格に確認されます。
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-3">
            <div className={`p-3 rounded-lg border flex items-center gap-3 ${hasAssessment ? 'bg-green-50 border-green-200 text-green-900' : 'bg-white border-amber-200 text-amber-900'}`}>
              {hasAssessment ? <CheckCircle2 className="h-6 w-6 text-green-600 shrink-0" /> : <Clock className="h-6 w-6 text-amber-500 shrink-0" />}
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold">1. アセスメント</p>
                <p className="text-sm font-bold">{hasAssessment ? `${assessments.length}件 実施済` : '未登録'}</p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className={`p-3 rounded-lg border flex items-center gap-3 ${hasConference ? 'bg-green-50 border-green-200 text-green-900' : 'bg-white border-amber-200 text-amber-900'}`}>
              {hasConference ? <CheckCircle2 className="h-6 w-6 text-green-600 shrink-0" /> : <Clock className="h-6 w-6 text-amber-500 shrink-0" />}
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold">2. 担当者会議</p>
                <p className="text-sm font-bold">{hasConference ? `${conferences.length}件 開催済` : '未登録'}</p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className={`p-3 rounded-lg border flex items-center gap-3 ${hasConsent && hasDelivery ? 'bg-green-50 border-green-200 text-green-900' : hasConsent ? 'bg-amber-50 border-amber-200 text-amber-900' : 'bg-white border-red-200 text-red-900'}`}>
              {hasConsent && hasDelivery ? (
                <CheckCircle2 className="h-6 w-6 text-green-600 shrink-0" />
              ) : hasConsent ? (
                <AlertCircle className="h-6 w-6 text-amber-500 shrink-0" />
              ) : (
                <AlertCircle className="h-6 w-6 text-red-500 shrink-0" />
              )}
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold">3. 本人同意・交付</p>
                <p className="text-xs font-bold">
                  {hasConsent ? `同意: ${consentDate}` : '同意日未入力'}
                </p>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                  {hasDelivery ? `交付: ${deliveryDate}` : '交付日未入力 (実地指導確認)'}
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className={`p-3 rounded-lg border flex items-center gap-3 ${hasMonitoring ? 'bg-green-50 border-green-200 text-green-900' : 'bg-white border-slate-200 text-slate-700'}`}>
              {hasMonitoring ? <CheckCircle2 className="h-6 w-6 text-green-600 shrink-0" /> : <Clock className="h-6 w-6 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />}
              <div>
                <p className="text-xs font-semibold">4. 定期モニタリング</p>
                <p className="text-sm font-bold">{hasMonitoring ? `${monitorings.length}件 記録済` : '未記録'}</p>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {sequenceWarnings.length > 0 && (
            <div className="mt-4 p-3 bg-red-50 border border-red-300 rounded-lg text-red-900 text-xs space-y-1">
              <div className="font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 text-sm text-red-700">
                <AlertCircle className="h-4 w-4 shrink-0 text-red-600" />
                【実地指導 指摘警告】支援プロセスの日付順序に不整合があります
              </div>
              <ul className="list-disc pl-5 space-y-0.5">
                {sequenceWarnings.map((w, i) => (
                  <li key={i}>{w}</li>
                ))}
              </ul>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-red-700 mt-1">
                ※ 指定基準上、アセスメント ≦ 原案作成 ≦ 担当者会議 ≦ 本人同意 ≦ 交付 の順序で行う必要があります。
              </p>
            </div>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* 3つのプロセス管理タブ / リスト */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-6">
        
        {/* 1. アセスメント記録 */}
        <Card className="shadow-sm">
          <CardHeader className="pb-3 border-b flex flex-row items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <CardTitle className="text-base flex items-center gap-2">
                <ClipboardList className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" /> アセスメント記録
              </CardTitle>
            </div>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => handleOpenCreate('assessment')}>
              <Plus className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" /> 追加
            </Button>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="pt-4 space-y-3">
            {assessments.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground py-4 text-center">記録がありません</p>
            ) : (
              assessments.map((item) => (
                <div key={item.id} className="p-3 bg-muted/40 rounded-md border text-sm space-y-1 relative group">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-primary">{item.assessment_date}</span>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mr-1">{item.assessor_name || '担当者未記載'}</span>
                      <Button
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="sm"
                        className="h-6 w-6 p-0 text-muted-foreground hover:text-blue-600"
                        onClick={() => handleOpenEdit('assessment', item)}
                        title="編集"
                      >
                        <Edit className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      </Button>
                      <Button
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="sm"
                        className="h-6 w-6 p-0 text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive"
                        onClick={() => handleDeleteAssessment(item.id)}
                        title="削除"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  {item.user_wishes && <p className="text-xs text-foreground"><span className="text-muted-foreground">本人の意向:</span> {item.user_wishes}</p>}
                  {item.strengths && <p className="text-xs text-foreground"><span className="text-muted-foreground">強み・特技:</span> {item.strengths}</p>}
                  {item.challenges && <p className="text-xs text-destructive"><span className="text-muted-foreground">課題:</span> {item.challenges}</p>}
                </div>
              ))
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* 2. 担当者会議（カンファレンス）記録 */}
        <Card className="shadow-sm">
          <CardHeader className="pb-3 border-b flex flex-row items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <CardTitle className="text-base flex items-center gap-2">
                <Users className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" /> 担当者会議 (カンファレンス)
              </CardTitle>
            </div>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => handleOpenCreate('conference')}>
              <Plus className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" /> 追加
            </Button>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="pt-4 space-y-3">
            {conferences.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground py-4 text-center">議事録がありません</p>
            ) : (
              conferences.map((item) => (
                <div key={item.id} className="p-3 bg-muted/40 rounded-md border text-sm space-y-1 relative group">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-primary">{item.conference_date}</span>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                      <span className="text-xs bg-primary/10 text-primary px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-medium">
                        {item.conference_type === 'plan_creation' ? '原案協議' : item.conference_type === 'renewal' ? '更新協議' : 'モニタリング'}
                      </span>
                      <Link href={`/plans/conferences/${item.id}`} target="_blank">
                        <Button
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="sm"
                          className="h-6 w-6 p-0 text-muted-foreground hover:text-primary"
                          title="A4公文書印刷"
                        >
                          <Printer className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        </Button>
                      </Link>
                      <Button
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="sm"
                        className="h-6 w-6 p-0 text-muted-foreground hover:text-blue-600"
                        onClick={() => handleOpenEdit('conference', item)}
                        title="編集"
                      >
                        <Edit className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      </Button>
                      <Button
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="sm"
                        className="h-6 w-6 p-0 text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive"
                        onClick={() => handleDeleteConference(item.id)}
                        title="削除"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  {item.attendees && <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">出席者: {item.attendees}</p>}
                  {item.discussion_summary && <p className="text-xs text-foreground"><span className="text-muted-foreground">要点:</span> {item.discussion_summary}</p>}
                  {item.conclusions && <p className="text-xs font-medium text-blue-900"><span className="text-muted-foreground">結論:</span> {item.conclusions}</p>}
                </div>
              ))
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>

        {/* 3. モニタリング記録 */}
        <Card className="shadow-sm">
          <CardHeader className="pb-3 border-b flex flex-row items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <CardTitle className="text-base flex items-center gap-2">
                <LineChart className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" /> 定期モニタリング
              </CardTitle>
            </div>
            <Button size="sm" variant="outline" onClick={() => handleOpenCreate('monitoring')}>
              <Plus className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" /> 追加
            </Button>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="pt-4 space-y-3">
            {monitorings.length === 0 ? (
              <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground py-4 text-center">記録がありません</p>
            ) : (
              monitorings.map((item) => (
                <div key={item.id} className="p-3 bg-muted/40 rounded-md border text-sm space-y-1 relative group">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                    <span className="font-semibold text-primary">{item.monitoring_date}</span>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1">
                      <span className={`text-xs px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded font-medium ${item.progress_status === 'smooth' ? 'bg-green-100 text-green-800' : 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800'}`}>
                        {item.progress_status === 'smooth' ? '順調' : '要見直し'}
                      </span>
                      <Link href={`/plans/monitorings/${item.id}`} target="_blank">
                        <Button
                          variant="ghost"
                          size="sm"
                          className="h-6 w-6 p-0 text-muted-foreground hover:text-primary"
                          title="A4公文書印刷"
                        >
                          <Printer className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        </Button>
                      </Link>
                      <Button
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="sm"
                        className="h-6 w-6 p-0 text-muted-foreground hover:text-blue-600"
                        onClick={() => handleOpenEdit('monitoring', item)}
                        title="編集"
                      >
                        <Edit className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      </Button>
                      <Button
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="sm"
                        className="h-6 w-6 p-0 text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive"
                        onClick={() => handleDeleteMonitoring(item.id)}
                        title="削除"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  {item.goal_achievement && <p className="text-xs text-foreground"><span className="text-muted-foreground">達成度:</span> {item.goal_achievement}</p>}
                  {item.client_feedback && <p className="text-xs text-foreground"><span className="text-muted-foreground">本人の感想:</span> {item.client_feedback}</p>}
                  {item.next_action_plan && <p className="text-xs text-foreground"><span className="text-muted-foreground">今後の方針:</span> {item.next_action_plan}</p>}
                </div>
              ))
            )}
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      </div>

      {/* アセスメント追加・編集モーダル */}
      {activeModal === 'assessment' && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <Card key={editingItem?.id || 'new_assessment'} className="w-full max-w-xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto bg-background">
            <CardHeader className="border-b">
              <CardTitle>{editingItem ? 'アセスメント記録の編集' : 'アセスメント記録の登録'}</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <form onSubmit={handleSaveAssessment}>
              <CardContent className="pt-4 space-y-4">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <Label htmlFor="assessmentDate">実施日 *</Label>
                    <Input id="assessmentDate" name="assessmentDate" type="date" required defaultValue={editingItem?.assessment_date || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <Label htmlFor="assessorName">アセスメント担当者</Label>
                    <Input id="assessorName" name="assessorName" placeholder="氏名" defaultValue={editingItem?.assessor_name || ''} />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label htmlFor="userWishes">本人の希望・ニーズ</Label>
                  <Textarea id="userWishes" name="userWishes" rows={2} placeholder="どんな仕事をしたいか、将来どうなりたいか" defaultValue={editingItem?.user_wishes || ''} />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label htmlFor="strengths">得意なこと・強み</Label>
                  <Textarea id="strengths" name="strengths" rows={2} placeholder="集中力がある、手先が器用など" defaultValue={editingItem?.strengths || ''} />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label htmlFor="challenges">課題・配慮が必要なこと</Label>
                  <Textarea id="challenges" name="challenges" rows={2} placeholder="疲れやすさ、対人面の不安、環境刺激など" defaultValue={editingItem?.challenges || ''} />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label htmlFor="livingStatus">生活状況・健康状態</Label>
                  <Textarea id="livingStatus" name="livingStatus" rows={2} placeholder="睡眠、通院、服薬状況など" defaultValue={editingItem?.living_status || ''} />
                </div>
              </CardContent>
              <div className="p-4 border-t flex justify-end gap-2 bg-muted/20">
                <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => { setActiveModal('none'); setEditingItem(null); }}>キャンセル</Button>
                <Button type="submit" disabled={loading}>{loading ? '保存中...' : (editingItem ? '変更を保存する' : '保存する')}</Button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </Card>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 担当者会議録追加・編集モーダル */}
      {activeModal === 'conference' && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <Card key={editingItem?.id || 'new_conference'} className="w-full max-w-xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto bg-background">
            <CardHeader className="border-b">
              <CardTitle>{editingItem ? 'サービス担当者会議（カンファレンス）議事録の編集' : 'サービス担当者会議（カンファレンス）議事録の登録'}</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <form onSubmit={handleSaveConference}>
              <CardContent className="pt-4 space-y-4">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <Label htmlFor="conferenceDate">開催日 *</Label>
                    <Input 
                      id="conferenceDate" 
                      name="conferenceDate" 
                      type="date" 
                      required 
                      defaultValue={editingItem?.conference_date || planDate || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)} 
                    />
                    {planDate && (
                      <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                        ※過去の会議録を登録する場合、計画原案作成日（{planDate}）も自動で整合されます
                      </p>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <Label htmlFor="conferenceType">会議種別</Label>
                    <select id="conferenceType" name="conferenceType" defaultValue={editingItem?.conference_type || 'plan_creation'} className="w-full h-10 px-3 rounded-md border bg-background text-sm">
                      <option value="plan_creation">個別支援計画（原案）協議</option>
                      <option value="renewal">計画更新・見直し協議</option>
                      <option value="monitoring">中間評価・ケース会議</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label htmlFor="attendees">出席者（氏名・所属・役職） *</Label>
                  <Input id="attendees" name="attendees" required placeholder="例: サビ管〇〇、職業指導員△△、相談支援専門員××" defaultValue={editingItem?.attendees || ''} />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label htmlFor="discussionSummary">協議内容の要点 *</Label>
                  <Textarea id="discussionSummary" name="discussionSummary" rows={3} required placeholder="原案の目標設定、作業内容の適合性、各職種からの意見など" defaultValue={editingItem?.discussion_summary || ''} />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label htmlFor="conclusions">結論・決定事項 *</Label>
                  <Textarea id="conclusions" name="conclusions" rows={2} required placeholder="原案通り承認、または目標修正の合意事項など" defaultValue={editingItem?.conclusions || ''} />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label htmlFor="recordedBy">記録者</Label>
                  <Input id="recordedBy" name="recordedBy" placeholder="記録者氏名" defaultValue={editingItem?.recorded_by || ''} />
                </div>
              </CardContent>
              <div className="p-4 border-t flex justify-end gap-2 bg-muted/20">
                <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => { setActiveModal('none'); setEditingItem(null); }}>キャンセル</Button>
                <Button type="submit" disabled={loading}>{loading ? '保存中...' : (editingItem ? '変更を保存する' : '保存する')}</Button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </Card>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* モニタリング記録追加・編集モーダル */}
      {activeModal === 'monitoring' && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <Card key={editingItem?.id || 'new_monitoring'} className="w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto bg-background">
            <CardHeader className="border-b flex flex-row items-center justify-between gap-2 flex-wrap">
              <div>
                <CardTitle>{editingItem ? '定期モニタリング記録の編集' : '定期モニタリング記録の登録'}</CardTitle>
                <CardDescription className="text-xs mt-1">
                  直近6ヶ月間の支援記録・勤怠実績のみをソースに事実限定でモニタリング下書きを自動生成できます
                </CardDescription>
              </div>
              <Button
                type="button"
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                disabled={generatingGrounded}
                className="text-xs font-semibold text-indigo-800 border-indigo-300 bg-indigo-50/80 hover:bg-indigo-100 flex items-center gap-1.5"
                onClick={async () => {
                  setGeneratingGrounded(true);
                  try {
                    const dateInput = document.getElementById('monitoringDate') as HTMLInputElement | null;
                    const refDate = dateInput?.value || editingItem?.monitoring_date || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10);
                    const res = await generateGroundedMonitoringDraft(clientId, planId, refDate);
                    if (!res.success || !res.data) {
                      toast.error(res.error || '過去記録ノートからの要約生成に失敗しました');
                      return;
                    }
                    const d = res.data;
                    const progressSelect = document.getElementById('progressStatus') as HTMLSelectElement | null;
                    const goalTextarea = document.getElementById('goalAchievement') as HTMLTextAreaElement | null;
                    const feedbackTextarea = document.getElementById('clientFeedback') as HTMLTextAreaElement | null;
                    const nextPlanTextarea = document.getElementById('nextActionPlan') as HTMLTextAreaElement | null;

                    if (progressSelect && d.progress_status) progressSelect.value = d.progress_status;
                    if (goalTextarea) goalTextarea.value = d.goal_achievement;
                    if (feedbackTextarea) feedbackTextarea.value = d.client_feedback;
                    if (nextPlanTextarea) nextPlanTextarea.value = d.next_action_plan;

                    setGroundedMeta({
                      period_start: d.period_start,
                      period_end: d.period_end,
                      attendance_count: d.attendance_count,
                      support_record_count: d.support_record_count,
                      cited_record_dates: d.cited_record_dates || [],
                      masked_source_preview: d.masked_source_preview || '',
                    });
                    toast.success(
                      `直近6ヶ月の勤怠（${d.attendance_count}件）・支援記録（${d.support_record_count}件）から事実限定要約を反映しました（PIIマスク済）`
                    );
                  } catch (err: any) {
                    toast.error(err?.message || '要約生成中にエラーが発生しました');
                  } finally {
                    setGeneratingGrounded(false);
                  }
                }}
              >
                {generatingGrounded ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600 animate-spin" />
                    過去6ヶ月記録を照合中...
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <BookOpen className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-indigo-600" />
                    過去6ヶ月記録ノートから事実限定要約（PIIマスク済）
                  </>
                )}
              </Button>
            </CardHeader>
            <form onSubmit={handleSaveMonitoring}>
              <CardContent className="pt-4 space-y-4">
                {groundedMeta && (
                  <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50/90 border border-emerald-200 rounded-lg text-xs space-y-1.5">
                    <div className="flex items-center justify-between flex-wrap gap-2">
                      <span className="font-bold text-emerald-950 flex items-center gap-1">
                        <ShieldCheck className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                        過去記録ノート参照済（{groundedMeta.period_start}〜{groundedMeta.period_end} / 勤怠{groundedMeta.attendance_count}件・支援記録{groundedMeta.support_record_count}件 / [利用者A]マスキング済）
                      </span>
                      <Button
                        type="button"
                        variant="ghost"
                        size="sm"
                        className="h-6 px-2 text-[11px] text-emerald-800 hover:bg-emerald-100"
                        onClick={() => setShowMaskedSource(!showMaskedSource)}
                      >
                        {showMaskedSource ? 'ソースを閉じる' : 'PIIマスク済ソースを表示'}
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                    {showMaskedSource && (
                      <pre className="p-2 bg-slate-900 text-slate-100 rounded text-[11px] max-h-40 overflow-y-auto whitespace-pre-wrap font-mono">
                        {groundedMeta.masked_source_preview}
                      </pre>
                    )}
                  </div>
                )}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <Label htmlFor="monitoringDate">モニタリング実施日 *</Label>
                    <Input id="monitoringDate" name="monitoringDate" type="date" required defaultValue={editingItem?.monitoring_date || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <Label htmlFor="monitoringPeriodMonth">対象月</Label>
                    <Input id="monitoringPeriodMonth" name="monitoringPeriodMonth" type="month" defaultValue={editingItem?.monitoring_period_month || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 7)} />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <Label htmlFor="progressStatus">目標の達成・進捗状況</Label>
                    <select id="progressStatus" name="progressStatus" defaultValue={editingItem?.progress_status || 'smooth'} className="w-full h-10 px-3 rounded-md border bg-background text-sm">
                      <option value="smooth">順調・達成見込み</option>
                      <option value="partially_delayed">一部停滞・見直し推奨</option>
                      <option value="needs_change">計画変更が必要</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <Label htmlFor="evaluatorName">評価者（サビ管等）</Label>
                    <Input id="evaluatorName" name="evaluatorName" placeholder="氏名" defaultValue={editingItem?.evaluator_name || ''} />
                  </div>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label htmlFor="goalAchievement">短期目標・長期目標の振り返り（通所安定度・作業達成度・体調変化）</Label>
                  <Textarea id="goalAchievement" name="goalAchievement" rows={5} placeholder="目標に対する達成状況、できるようになった作業など" defaultValue={editingItem?.goal_achievement || ''} />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label htmlFor="clientFeedback">本人の意向・感想（記録抜粋）</Label>
                  <Textarea id="clientFeedback" name="clientFeedback" rows={2} placeholder="本人が感じていること、続けたい点、不安な点" defaultValue={editingItem?.client_feedback || ''} />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label htmlFor="nextActionPlan">今後の支援方針・計画の見直し要否</Label>
                  <Textarea id="nextActionPlan" name="nextActionPlan" rows={2} placeholder="次回に向けた具体的アクション、計画見直しの要否" defaultValue={editingItem?.next_action_plan || ''} />
                </div>
              </CardContent>
              <div className="p-4 border-t flex justify-end gap-2 bg-muted/20">
                <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => { setActiveModal('none'); setEditingItem(null); setGroundedMeta(null); }}>キャンセル</Button>
                <Button type="submit" disabled={loading}>{loading ? '保存中...' : (editingItem ? '変更を保存する' : '保存する')}</Button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </Card>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
