import { db, resolveServiceModeForConference } from "@/lib/db";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { notFound, redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { ConferenceReportSheet } from "@/components/documents/ConferenceReportSheet";

interface PageProps {
  params: Promise<{
    id: string;
  }>;
}

export default async function ConferencePage({ params }: PageProps) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) redirect("/login");

  const { id } = await params;
  resolveServiceModeForConference(id);

  const conference = db.prepare(`
    SELECT * FROM service_conferences WHERE id = ?
  `).get(id) as any;

  if (!conference) {
    notFound();
  }

  const client = db.prepare(`
    SELECT * FROM clients WHERE id = ?
  `).get(conference.client_id) as any;

  if (!client) {
    notFound();
  }

  const plan = conference.support_plan_id
    ? db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM support_plans WHERE id = ?`).get(conference.support_plan_id) as any
    : null;

  const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings LIMIT 1`).get() as any || {
    facility_name: "就労継続支援A型事業所",
    facility_number: "2810000000",
    corporate_name: "株式会社サンプル",
    postal_code: "650-0000",
    address: "兵庫県神戸市中央区",
    tel: "078-000-0000",
    service_manager_name: "サービス管理責任者",
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-muted/20 py-6 print:bg-white print:py-0">
      <ConferenceReportSheet
        facility={facility}
        client={client}
        plan={plan}
        conference={conference}
        returnUrl={plan ? `/plans/${plan.id}` : `/clients/${client.id}`}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

    id: string;
  }>;
}

  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) redirect("/login");

  const { id } = await params;
  resolveServiceModeForPlanMonitoring(id);

  const monitoring = db.prepare(`
    SELECT * FROM plan_monitorings WHERE id = ?
  `).get(id) as any;

  if (!monitoring) {
    notFound();
  }

  const client = db.prepare(`
    SELECT * FROM clients WHERE id = ?
  `).get(monitoring.client_id) as any;

  if (!client) {
    notFound();
  }

  const plan = monitoring.support_plan_id
    ? db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM support_plans WHERE id = ?`).get(monitoring.support_plan_id) as any
    : null;

  const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings LIMIT 1`).get() as any || {
    facility_name: "就労継続支援A型事業所",
    facility_number: "2810000000",
    corporate_name: "株式会社サンプル",
    postal_code: "650-0000",
    address: "兵庫県神戸市中央区",
    tel: "078-000-0000",
    service_manager_name: "サービス管理責任者",
  };

  return (
    <div className="min-h-screen bg-muted/20 py-6 print:bg-white print:py-0">
      <MonitoringReportSheet
        facility={facility}
        client={client}
        plan={plan}
        monitoring={monitoring}
        returnUrl={plan ? `/plans/${plan.id}` : `/clients/${client.id}`}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Card, CardContent, CardDescription, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { generateSupportPlan, saveSupportPlan } from "../actions";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ChevronLeft, Sparkles, ShieldCheck, Save, Loader2 } from "lucide-react";
import { cn, toLocalISODate } from "@/lib/utils";
import { PlanEditor } from "../components/PlanEditor";

export function NewPlanClient({ initialClients, defaultClientId }: { initialClients: any[], defaultClientId?: string }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [isGenerating, setIsGenerating] = useState(false);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
  const [result, setResult] = useState<any>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const [selectedClientId, setSelectedClientId] = useState<string>(defaultClientId || "");

  const [clientData, setClientData] = useState({
    full_name: "",
    address: "",
    phone_number: "",
    facility_name: "",
    diseases: "",
    disability_class: "",
    disability_certificate: "未所持",
    family_names: "",
  });
  
  const [recordsText, setRecordsText] = useState("");
  const [planMetadata, setPlanMetadata] = useState({
    plan_date: toLocalISODate(new Date()),
    start_date: "",
    end_date: "",
    consent_date: "",
    delivery_date: "",
    creator_name: "",
    is_self_plan: false,
  });

  useEffect(() => {
    if (defaultClientId) {
      handleClientSelect(defaultClientId);
    } else if (initialClients && initialClients.length > 0) {
      handleClientSelect(initialClients[0].id);
    }
  }, [initialClients, defaultClientId]);

  const [monitoringText, setMonitoringText] = useState("");
  const [previousPlanContext, setPreviousPlanContext] = useState("");

  const handleClientSelect = async (id: string) => {
    setSelectedClientId(id);
    const target = initialClients.find(c => c.id === id);
    if (target) {
      setClientData({
        full_name: target.full_name || "",
        address: target.address || "",
        phone_number: target.phone_number || "",
        facility_name: target.facility_name || "",
        diseases: "", 
        disability_class: target.disability_class || "",
        disability_certificate: target.disability_certificate || "未所持",
        family_names: "",
      });
    }

    // Fetch previous plan for context
    try {
      const { getLatestSupportPlan } = await import("../actions");
      const prev = await getLatestSupportPlan(id);
      if (prev && prev.domains_data) {
        const data = JSON.parse(prev.domains_data);
        const ctx = `
長期目標: ${data.long_term_goal || ''}
短期目標: ${data.short_term_goal || ''}
生活課題: ${data.life_issues || ''}
就労課題: ${data.work_issues || ''}
        `.trim();
        setPreviousPlanContext(ctx);
      } else {
        setPreviousPlanContext("");
      }
    } catch(e) {
      console.error(e);
      setPreviousPlanContext("");
    }
  };

  const handleGenerate = async () => {
    if (!selectedClientId) {
      setError("利用者が選択されていません。");
      return;
    }
    if (!recordsText.trim()) {
      setError("支援記録やメモが入力されていません。AIに読み込ませる情報をテキストエリアに入力してください。");
      return;
    }

    setIsGenerating(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await generateSupportPlan(recordsText, clientData, selectedClientId, monitoringText, previousPlanContext);
      if (res.success) {
        setResult(res);
        if ((res as any).isFallback) {
          toast.info((res as any).fallbackNotice || "標準テンプレートから個別支援計画原案を生成しました。");
        } else {
          toast.success("個別支援計画の原案を生成しました。内容を確認・編集してください。");
        }
      } else {
        const errMsg = (res as any).error || "原案の生成に失敗しました";
        setError(errMsg);
        toast.error(errMsg);
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || "エラーが発生しました");
      toast.error(err.message || "エラーが発生しました");
    } finally {
      setIsGenerating(false);
    }
  };

  const handleSave = async () => {
    if (!selectedClientId || !result || !result.plan) return;
    setIsSaving(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const res = await saveSupportPlan(selectedClientId, result.plan, {
        ...planMetadata,
        monitoring_result: monitoringText,
      });
      if (!res.success) {
        setError(res.error || "保存時にエラーが発生しました");
        toast.error(res.error || "保存時にエラーが発生しました");
        return;
      }
      toast.success("個別支援計画書（原案）を保存しました");
      router.push("/plans");
      router.refresh();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setError(err.message || "保存時にエラーが発生しました");
      toast.error(err.message || "保存時にエラーが発生しました");
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl space-y-6">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
        <Link href="/plans" className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "icon" }))}>
          <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
        </Link>
        <div>
          <h1 className="text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">個別支援計画の新規作成</h1>
          <p className="mt-2 text-lg text-muted-foreground">
            支援記録等を入力すると、AIが安全に個別支援計画書の原案を生成します。
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="grid gap-6 md:grid-cols-2">
        {/* 左側: 入力エリア */}
        <div className="space-y-6">
          <Card className="shadow-sm border-primary/20">
            <CardHeader className="bg-primary/5 border-b pb-4">
              <CardTitle className="text-xl flex items-center gap-2">
                <ShieldCheck className="text-green-600 h-5 w-5" />
                対象の利用者情報
              </CardTitle>
              <CardDescription className="text-base">
                対象者を選択すると情報が自動セットされます。（AIにはこれらの情報がマスキングされて送られます）
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="pt-6 space-y-4">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label className="font-bold">対象の利用者を選択</Label>
                <select 
                  className="flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background"
                  value={selectedClientId} 
                  onChange={e => handleClientSelect(e.target.value)}
                >
                  {initialClients.length === 0 && <option value="">利用者が登録されていません</option>}
                  {initialClients.map(c => (
                    <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.full_name}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
              
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4 pt-4 border-t">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>氏名</Label>
                  <Input value={clientData.full_name} onChange={e => setClientData({...clientData, full_name: e.target.value})} />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>電話番号</Label>
                  <Input value={clientData.phone_number} onChange={e => setClientData({...clientData, phone_number: e.target.value})} />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>障害支援区分</Label>
                  <select 
                    className="flex h-10 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-1 text-base shadow-sm transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
                    value={clientData.disability_class} 
                    onChange={e => setClientData({...clientData, disability_class: e.target.value})}
                  >
                    <option value="">未設定</option>
                    <option value="区分1">区分1</option>
                    <option value="区分2">区分2</option>
                    <option value="区分3">区分3</option>
                    <option value="区分4">区分4</option>
                    <option value="区分5">区分5</option>
                    <option value="区分6">区分6</option>
                    <option value="非該当">非該当</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>疾患名・障害名</Label>
                  <Input value={clientData.diseases} onChange={e => setClientData({...clientData, diseases: e.target.value})} />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>所持している障害手帳</Label>
                  <Input value={clientData.disability_certificate} placeholder="例: 身体障害者手帳2級" onChange={e => setClientData({...clientData, disability_certificate: e.target.value})} />
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="shadow-sm">
            <CardHeader className="border-b pb-4">
              <CardTitle className="text-xl">モニタリング結果・次期の課題（AIへの指示）</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                前回の個別支援計画の評価や、次回更新に向けた課題を記述してください。AIがこれを踏まえて新しい計画案を作成します。
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="pt-6 space-y-4">
              {previousPlanContext ? (
                <div className="p-3 bg-muted/50 rounded-md text-sm whitespace-pre-wrap text-muted-foreground border">
                  <strong>【前回の計画内容（参考）】</strong><br/>
                  {previousPlanContext}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="p-3 bg-muted/30 rounded-md text-sm text-muted-foreground border">
                  前回の計画データがありません。
                </div>
              )}
              <Textarea 
                className="min-h-[120px] text-base leading-relaxed" 
                value={monitoringText}
                onChange={e => setMonitoringText(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="例: 長期目標の〇〇については達成できたため、次は△△を目指す。作業スピードは上がっているが、遅刻が目立つため生活リズムの改善を課題とする。"
              />
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          <Card className="shadow-sm">
            <CardHeader className="border-b pb-4">
              <CardTitle className="text-xl">支援記録（日々の様子や面談メモ）</CardTitle>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="pt-6">
              <Textarea 
                className="min-h-[200px] text-base leading-relaxed" 
                value={recordsText}
                onChange={e => setRecordsText(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="面談記録や日々の様子などを自由に入力してください..."
              />
              
              <Button 
                className={cn("w-full h-14 mt-6 text-lg font-bold transition-all", isGenerating ? "bg-primary/80 cursor-not-allowed" : "")} 
                onClick={handleGenerate}

                      <Input value={planMetadata.creator_name} onChange={e => setPlanMetadata({...planMetadata, creator_name: e.target.value})} />
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      <Label>利用者同意日（署名日）</Label>
                      <Input 
                        type="date" 
                        value={planMetadata.consent_date} 
                        onChange={e => {
                          const val = e.target.value;
                          setPlanMetadata(prev => ({
                            ...prev,
                            consent_date: val,
                            // 同意日が入力された際、原案日や開始日が未設定または今日の場合は連動提案
                            plan_date: prev.plan_date === toLocalISODate() && val ? val : prev.plan_date,
                          }));
                        }} 
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      <Label>計画書交付日（本人控）</Label>
                      <Input type="date" value={planMetadata.delivery_date} onChange={e => setPlanMetadata({...planMetadata, delivery_date: e.target.value})} />
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      <Label>計画期間（開始）</Label>
                      <Input 
                        type="date" 
                        value={planMetadata.start_date} 
                        onChange={e => {
                          const val = e.target.value;
                          setPlanMetadata(prev => ({
                            ...prev,
                            start_date: val,
                            // 開始日が過去の場合、原案作成日も合わせやすくする
                            plan_date: prev.plan_date === toLocalISODate() && val ? val : prev.plan_date,
                          }));
                        }} 
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-2">
                      <Label>計画期間（終了）</Label>
                      <Input type="date" value={planMetadata.end_date} onChange={e => setPlanMetadata({...planMetadata, end_date: e.target.value})} />
                    </div>
                    <div className="col-span-2 pt-2 border-t mt-2">
                      <label className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                        <input
                          type="checkbox"
                          checked={planMetadata.is_self_plan}
                          onChange={e => setPlanMetadata({...planMetadata, is_self_plan: e.target.checked})}
                          className="h-4 w-4 rounded border-gray-300 text-blue-600 focus:ring-blue-500"
                        />
                        <span className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">
                          セルフプラン方式（利用者本人・家族による作成 / 神戸市等の独自運用）
                        </span>
                      </label>
                      <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground ml-6 mt-0.5">
                        ※相談支援事業所が関与せず、本人が作成したサービス等利用計画案に基づき個別支援計画を作成する場合にチェックします。
                      </p>
                    </div>
                  </CardContent>
                </Card>

                <PlanEditor 
                  planData={result.plan} 
                  onChange={(newPlan) => setResult({...result, plan: newPlan})} 
                />
              </div>
              
              <div className="flex justify-end pt-4 pb-8">
                 <Button onClick={handleSave} disabled={isSaving} className="h-14 px-8 text-lg w-full md:w-auto">
                   {isSaving ? "保存中..." : (
                     <>
                       <Save className="mr-2 h-5 w-5" />

                     </>
                   )}
                 </Button>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

import { Header } from "@/components/Header"
import { db, resolveServiceModeForClient } from "@/lib/db"
import { NewPlanClient } from "./NewPlanClient"

export default async function NewPlanPage({ searchParams }: { searchParams: Promise<{ clientId?: string }> | { clientId?: string } }) {
  const resolvedParams = await Promise.resolve(searchParams);
  if (resolvedParams?.clientId) {
    resolveServiceModeForClient(resolvedParams.clientId);
  }
  const clients = db.prepare("SELECT * FROM clients WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (status IS NULL OR status = 'active') ORDER BY created_at DESC").all() as any[];

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background/50">
      <Header activePage="plans" />

      <main className="flex-1 p-6 md:p-12">
        <NewPlanClient initialClients={clients} defaultClientId={resolvedParams?.clientId} />
      </main>
    </div>
  )
}

import { Header } from "@/components/Header";
import { SupportSubNav } from "@/components/NavigationTabs";
import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { PlusCircle, FileText } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { PlansClient, PlanRecord, ClientRecord } from "./PlansClient";

export default async function PlansPage(props: { searchParams?: Promise<{ clientId?: string; status?: string }> }) {
  const searchParams = await props.searchParams;
  const selectedClientId = searchParams?.clientId || "";
  const selectedStatus = searchParams?.status || "all";

  // アクティブな利用者を取得
  const clients = db.prepare(
    "SELECT id, full_name, recipient_number, status FROM clients WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (status IS NULL OR status = 'active') ORDER BY full_name"
  ).all() as ClientRecord[];

  // 計画書一覧（モニタリング最終日をサブクエリで取得）
  const plans = db.prepare(`
    SELECT p.*, c.full_name as client_full_name,
           (SELECT MAX(monitoring_date) FROM plan_monitorings WHERE support_plan_id = p.id) as latest_monitoring_date
    FROM support_plans p
    JOIN clients c ON p.client_id = c.id
    WHERE p.deleted_at IS NULL AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY p.plan_date DESC, p.created_at DESC
  `).all() as PlanRecord[];

  const selectedClient = clients.find(c => c.id === selectedClientId);

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background/50">
      <Header activePage="plans" />
      <SupportSubNav />

      <main className="flex-1 p-3.5 sm:p-6 md:p-10">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl space-y-6">
          {/* ページタイトル & 新規作成ボタン */}
          <div className="flex flex-col gap-4 sm:flex-row sm:items-center sm:justify-between">
            <div>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <span className="text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold bg-primary/10 text-primary border border-primary/20">
                  個別支援計画・モニタリング管理
                </span>
                {selectedClient && (
                  <span className="text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border border-blue-200">
                    {selectedClient.full_name} 様で絞り込み中
                  </span>
                )}
              </div>
              <h1 className="mt-1.5 text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-foreground">
                個別支援計画 管理
              </h1>
              <p className="mt-1 text-xs sm:text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                全利用者の計画書を「1人1枠」に集約。最新の現行計画とモニタリング期日を即座に把握し、過去履歴は折りたたみアコーディオンでスッキリ整理・抽出できます。
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row items-stretch sm:items-center gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto shrink-0">
              {selectedClientId && (
                <Link 
                  href={`/clients/${selectedClientId}/documents?tab=plan`}
                  className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", className: "h-11 sm:h-12 text-sm justify-center font-bold" }))}
                >
                  <FileText className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                  計画書履歴台帳
                </Link>
              )}
              <Link
                href={selectedClientId ? `/plans/new?clientId=${selectedClientId}` : "/plans/new"}
                className={cn(buttonVariants({ className: "h-11 sm:h-12 px-6 text-sm sm:text-base shadow-sm justify-center font-bold" }))}
              >
                <PlusCircle className="mr-2 h-5 w-5" />
                新規計画書の作成 (AIアシスト)
              </Link>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* ハイブリッド管理UI（KPIサマリー、カード/一覧表切替、利用者軸アコーディオン、検索） */}
          <PlansClient
            clients={clients}
            plans={plans}
            initialClientId={selectedClientId}
            initialStatus={selectedStatus}
          />
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

'use server';

import { db, resolveServiceModeForTableRecord, sanitizeForeignKeyId } from '@/lib/db';
import { getRole, assertCanAccessClient } from '@/lib/auth';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';
import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';

// ==========================================
// 1. 委員会・研修・訓練記録
// ==========================================

export async function saveCommitteeRecord(formData: FormData): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string; id?: string }> {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role) return { success: false, error: '認証されていません' };

    const rawId = (formData.get('id') as string)?.trim() || '';
    if (rawId) {
      resolveServiceModeForTableRecord('committee_records', rawId);
    }
    const id = rawId || uuidv4();
    const category = formData.get('category') as string;
    const recordType = formData.get('recordType') as string;
    const heldDate = formData.get('heldDate') as string;
    const title = formData.get('title') as string;
    const location = (formData.get('location') as string) || '';
    const attendees = (formData.get('attendees') as string) || '';
    const agenda = (formData.get('agenda') as string) || '';
    const contentDetails = (formData.get('contentDetails') as string) || '';
    const instructorOrChair = (formData.get('instructorOrChair') as string) || '';
    const materialsAttached = (formData.get('materialsAttached') as string) || '';

    if (!category || !recordType || !heldDate || !title) {
      return { success: false, error: '分類、種別、開催日、件名は必須です' };
    }

    const existing = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM committee_records WHERE id = ?').get(id);
    if (existing) {
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE committee_records SET
          category = ?, record_type = ?, held_date = ?, title = ?,
          location = ?, attendees = ?, agenda = ?, content_details = ?,
          instructor_or_chair = ?, materials_attached = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE id = ?
      `).run(category, recordType, heldDate, title, location, attendees, agenda, contentDetails, instructorOrChair, materialsAttached, id);
    } else {
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO committee_records (
          id, category, record_type, held_date, title, location,
          attendees, agenda, content_details, instructor_or_chair, materials_attached
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(id, category, recordType, heldDate, title, location, attendees, agenda, contentDetails, instructorOrChair, materialsAttached);
    }

    try {
      revalidatePath('/records/committees');
      revalidatePath('/');
    } catch (e) {}
    return { success: true, id };
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('委員会記録保存エラー:', err);
    return { success: false, error: err.message || '委員会・研修記録の保存に失敗しました' };
  }
}

export async function getCommitteeRecords(category?: string) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role) return [];

    let query = 'SELECT * FROM committee_records WHERE deleted_at IS NULL';
    const params: any[] = [];

    if (category && category !== 'all') {
      query += ' AND category = ?';
      params.push(category);
    }

    query += ' ORDER BY held_date DESC';
    return db.prepare(query).all(...params) as any[];
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('委員会記録取得エラー:', err);
    return [];
  }
}

export async function deleteCommitteeRecord(id: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (role !== 'admin') return { success: false, error: '管理者権限が必要です' };
    resolveServiceModeForTableRecord('committee_records', id);

    db.prepare('UPDATE committee_records SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?').run(id);
    try {
      revalidatePath('/records/committees');
      revalidatePath('/');
    } catch (e) {}
    return { success: true };
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('委員会記録削除エラー:', err);
    return { success: false, error: err.message || '削除に失敗しました' };
  }
}

export async function saveIncidentReport(formData: FormData): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string; id?: string }> {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role) return { success: false, error: '認証されていません' };

    const rawId = (formData.get('id') as string)?.trim() || '';
    if (rawId) {
      resolveServiceModeForTableRecord('incident_reports', rawId);
    }
    const id = rawId || uuidv4();
    const reportType = formData.get('reportType') as string;
    const occurredAt = formData.get('occurredAt') as string;
    const rawClientId = (formData.get('clientId') as string)?.trim() || null;
    if (rawClientId) {
      await assertCanAccessClient(rawClientId);
    }
    const clientId = sanitizeForeignKeyId('clients', rawClientId);

    const location = (formData.get('location') as string) || '';
    const situationDetails = (formData.get('situationDetails') as string) || '';
    const causeAnalysis = (formData.get('causeAnalysis') as string) || '';
    const immediateResponse = (formData.get('immediateResponse') as string) || '';
    const preventiveMeasures = (formData.get('preventiveMeasures') as string) || '';
    const reporterName = (formData.get('reporterName') as string) || '';
    const managerComment = (formData.get('managerComment') as string) || '';
    const isReportedToGov = formData.get('isReportedToGov') === '1' ? 1 : 0;
    const govReportedAt = (formData.get('govReportedAt') as string) || null;
    const govReportedTo = (formData.get('govReportedTo') as string) || null;
    const govReportedBy = (formData.get('govReportedBy') as string) || null;
    const familyNotifiedAt = (formData.get('familyNotifiedAt') as string) || null;
    const familyNotifiedBy = (formData.get('familyNotifiedBy') as string) || null;
    const familyContactMethod = (formData.get('familyContactMethod') as string) || null;
    const medicalInstitutionVisited = formData.get('medicalInstitutionVisited') === '1' ? 1 : 0;
    const medicalInstitutionName = (formData.get('medicalInstitutionName') as string) || null;
    const doctorInstructions = (formData.get('doctorInstructions') as string) || null;

    if (!reportType || !occurredAt || !situationDetails || !reporterName) {
      return { success: false, error: '種別、発生日時、詳細、報告者名は必須です' };
    }

    const existing = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM incident_reports WHERE id = ?').get(id);
    if (existing) {
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE incident_reports SET
          report_type = ?, occurred_at = ?, client_id = ?, location = ?,
          situation_details = ?, cause_analysis = ?, immediate_response = ?,
          preventive_measures = ?, reporter_name = ?, manager_comment = ?,
          is_reported_to_gov = ?, gov_reported_at = ?, gov_reported_to = ?,
          gov_reported_by = ?, family_notified_at = ?, family_notified_by = ?,
          family_contact_method = ?, medical_institution_visited = ?,
          medical_institution_name = ?, doctor_instructions = ?,
          updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE id = ?
      `).run(
        reportType, occurredAt, clientId, location, situationDetails,
        causeAnalysis, immediateResponse, preventiveMeasures, reporterName,
        managerComment, isReportedToGov, govReportedAt, govReportedTo,
        govReportedBy, familyNotifiedAt, familyNotifiedBy,
        familyContactMethod, medicalInstitutionVisited,
        medicalInstitutionName, doctorInstructions, id
      );
    } else {
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO incident_reports (
          id, report_type, occurred_at, client_id, location,
          situation_details, cause_analysis, immediate_response,
          preventive_measures, reporter_name, manager_comment, is_reported_to_gov,
          gov_reported_at, gov_reported_to, gov_reported_by,
          family_notified_at, family_notified_by, family_contact_method,
          medical_institution_visited, medical_institution_name, doctor_instructions
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(
        id, reportType, occurredAt, clientId, location, situationDetails,
        causeAnalysis, immediateResponse, preventiveMeasures, reporterName,
        managerComment, isReportedToGov, govReportedAt, govReportedTo,
        govReportedBy, familyNotifiedAt, familyNotifiedBy,
        familyContactMethod, medicalInstitutionVisited,
        medicalInstitutionName, doctorInstructions
      );
    }

    try {
      const { logAudit } = await import('@/lib/audit');
      await logAudit({
        action: existing ? 'update' : 'create',
        targetTable: 'incident_reports',
        targetId: id,
        details: { reportType, occurredAt, reporterName, familyNotifiedAt }
      });
    } catch (e) {}

    try {
      revalidatePath('/records/incidents');
    } catch (e) {}
    return { success: true, id };
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('事故報告保存エラー:', err);
    return { success: false, error: err.message || '事故・ヒヤリハット報告書の保存に失敗しました' };
  }
}

export async function getIncidentReports(reportType?: string) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role) return [];

    let query = `
      SELECT r.*, c.full_name as client_name
      FROM incident_reports r
      LEFT JOIN clients c ON r.client_id = c.id
      WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL
    `;
    const params: any[] = [];

    if (reportType && reportType !== 'all') {
      query += ' AND r.report_type = ?';
      params.push(reportType);
    }

    query += ' ORDER BY r.occurred_at DESC';
    return db.prepare(query).all(...params) as any[];
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('事故報告取得エラー:', err);
    return [];
  }
}

export async function deleteIncidentReport(id: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (role !== 'admin') return { success: false, error: '管理者権限が必要です' };
    resolveServiceModeForTableRecord('incident_reports', id);

    db.prepare('UPDATE incident_reports SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?').run(id);
    try {
      revalidatePath('/records/incidents');
    } catch (e) {}
    return { success: true };
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('事故報告削除エラー:', err);
    return { success: false, error: err.message || '削除に失敗しました' };
  }
}

// ==========================================
// 3. 実地指導コンプライアンス状況チェック（ダッシュボード・期限リマインダー用）
// ==========================================

export interface ComplianceItemStatus {
  category: string;
  label: string;
  period: string;
  lastHeldDate: string | null;
  deadlineDate: string;
  daysRemaining: number;
  status: 'ok' | 'notice' | 'warning' | 'overdue';
  statusText: string;
}

export async function checkMandatoryComplianceStatus(baseDateStr?: string): Promise<{
  missingCommittees: { label: string; period: string; category: string }[];
  items: ComplianceItemStatus[];
  urgentCount: number;
}> {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) return { missingCommittees: [], items: [], urgentCount: 0 };

  const baseDate = baseDateStr ? new Date(baseDateStr) : new Date();
  const todayStr = baseDate.toISOString().slice(0, 10);

  const mandatoryItems = [
    { category: 'abuse_prevention', label: '虐待防止委員会・職員研修', period: '1年に1回以上', intervalMonths: 12 },
    { category: 'restraint_reduction', label: '身体拘束適正化検討委員会・研修', period: '6ヶ月に1回以上', intervalMonths: 6 },
    { category: 'infection_control', label: '感染症対策委員会・研修・訓練', period: '6ヶ月に1回以上', intervalMonths: 6 },
    { category: 'bcp', label: 'BCP（業務継続計画）研修・訓練', period: '1年に1回以上', intervalMonths: 12 },
  ];

  const missingCommittees: { label: string; period: string; category: string }[] = [];
  const items: ComplianceItemStatus[] = [];
  let urgentCount = 0;

  for (const item of mandatoryItems) {
    const latest = db.prepare(`
      SELECT id, held_date FROM committee_records
      WHERE category = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
      ORDER BY held_date DESC
      LIMIT 1
    `).get(item.category) as { id: string; held_date: string } | undefined;

    let deadlineDateStr: string;
    let daysRemaining: number;
    let status: 'ok' | 'notice' | 'warning' | 'overdue';
    let statusText: string;

    if (!latest || !latest.held_date) {
      // 過去に一度も開催記録がない
      deadlineDateStr = todayStr;
      daysRemaining = -999;
      status = 'overdue';
      statusText = '未実施（減算対象）';
      missingCommittees.push({ label: item.label, period: item.period, category: item.category });
      urgentCount++;
    } else {
      const heldD = new Date(latest.held_date);
      const deadline = new Date(heldD);
      deadline.setMonth(deadline.getMonth() + item.intervalMonths);
      deadlineDateStr = deadline.toISOString().slice(0, 10);

      const diffTime = deadline.getTime() - baseDate.getTime();
      daysRemaining = Math.ceil(diffTime / (1000 * 60 * 60 * 24));

      if (daysRemaining < 0) {
        status = 'overdue';
        statusText = `期限超過 (${Math.abs(daysRemaining)}日超過)`;
        missingCommittees.push({ label: item.label, period: item.period, category: item.category });
        urgentCount++;
      } else if (daysRemaining <= 30) {
        status = 'warning';
        statusText = `あと${daysRemaining}日（期限切迫）`;
        urgentCount++;
      } else if (daysRemaining <= 60) {
        status = 'notice';
        statusText = `あと${daysRemaining}日（準備期間）`;
      } else {
        status = 'ok';
        statusText = `充足（あと${daysRemaining}日）`;
      }
    }

    items.push({
      category: item.category,
      label: item.label,
      period: item.period,
      lastHeldDate: latest?.held_date || null,
      deadlineDate: deadlineDateStr,
      daysRemaining,
      status,
      statusText
    });
  }

  return { missingCommittees, items, urgentCount };
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";

  ShieldAlert,

  FileText, 
  Printer,

  Trash2
} from "lucide-react";
import { saveCommitteeRecord, deleteCommitteeRecord } from "../actions";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { toLocalISODate } from "@/lib/utils";

interface CommitteesClientProps {
  records: any[];
  missingCommittees: { label: string; period: string; category: string }[];
}

const CATEGORY_NAMES: Record<string, string> = {
  abuse_prevention: '虐待防止',
  restraint_reduction: '身体拘束適正化',
  infection_control: '感染症対策',
  bcp: 'BCP (業務継続計画)',
  safety_hygiene: '安全衛生・防災',
};

const TYPE_NAMES: Record<string, string> = {
  committee: '委員会',
  training: '職員研修',
  drill: '避難・防護訓練',
};

export function CommitteesClient({ records, missingCommittees }: CommitteesClientProps) {
  const [selectedCategory, setSelectedCategory] = useState<string>('all');
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const filteredRecords = selectedCategory === 'all' 
    ? records 
    : records.filter(r => r.category === selectedCategory);

  const handleSave = async (e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    const formData = new FormData(e.currentTarget);

    try {
      const res = await saveCommitteeRecord(formData);
      if (res?.success === false) {
        toast.error(res.error || '保存に失敗しました');
        return;
      }
      toast.success('委員会・研修記録を保存しました');
      setIsModalOpen(false);
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(err.message || '保存に失敗しました');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id: string) => {
    if (!confirm('この記録を削除しますか？')) return;
    try {
      const res = await deleteCommitteeRecord(id);
      if (res?.success === false) {
        toast.error(res.error || '削除に失敗しました');
        return;
      }
      toast.success('削除しました');
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(err.message || '削除に失敗しました');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* 監査警告バナー（未実施項目がある場合） */}
      {missingCommittees.length > 0 ? (
        <Card className="border-amber-300 bg-amber-50/70">
          <CardHeader className="pb-2">
            <CardTitle className="text-base text-amber-900 flex items-center gap-2">
              <AlertTriangle className="h-5 w-5 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
              実地指導・運営指導 遵守警告（未実施の法定項目があります）
            </CardTitle>
            <CardDescription className="text-amber-800">
              以下の項目は法令により定期開催・記録が義務付けられています。未実施の場合、基本報酬の減算や指導対象となる恐れがあります。
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="pt-2">
            <ul className="list-disc list-inside space-y-1 text-sm font-medium text-amber-950">
              {missingCommittees.map((item, idx) => (
                <li key={idx}>
                  {item.label}（法定基準: {item.period}に1回以上開催）
                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <Card className="border-green-300 bg-green-50/50">
          <CardContent className="pt-4 pb-4 flex items-center gap-3">
            <CheckCircle2 className="h-6 w-6 text-green-600 shrink-0" />
            <p className="text-sm font-medium text-green-900">
              すべての法定委員会・研修・訓練が規定の期間内に開催・記録されています。実地指導要件を満たしています。
            </p>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* コントロールヘッダー */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4 print:hidden">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <Button 
            size="sm" 
            variant={selectedCategory === 'all' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            onClick={() => setSelectedCategory('all')}
          >
            すべて ({records.length})
          </Button>
          {Object.entries(CATEGORY_NAMES).map(([key, label]) => (
            <Button
              key={key}
              size="sm"
              variant={selectedCategory === key ? 'default' : 'outline'}
              onClick={() => setSelectedCategory(key)}
            >
              {label} ({records.filter(r => r.category === key).length})
            </Button>
          ))}
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => window.print()}>
            <Printer className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" /> 印刷

          <Button size="sm" onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(true)}>
            <Plus className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" /> 記録を新規登録
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 記録一覧 */}
      <div className="space-y-4">
        {filteredRecords.length === 0 ? (
          <Card className="p-8 text-center text-muted-foreground">

'use client';

import { deleteComplaintRecord } from './actions';

export function DeleteComplaintButton({ recordId }: { recordId: string }) {
  const handleSubmit = (e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    if (!window.confirm('この苦情対応記録を削除してもよろしいですか？\n※削除された記録は一覧から非表示になります。')) {
      e.preventDefault();
    }
  };

  return (
    <form action={deleteComplaintRecord.bind(null, recordId)} onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
      <SubmitButton variant="ghost" size="sm" className="text-red-600 hover:text-red-800 text-xs h-7 px-2">
        削除
      </SubmitButton>
    </form>
  );
}


================================================================================
File: src/app/records/complaints/actions.ts
================================================================================

'use server'

import { db, resolveServiceModeForTableRecord } from "@/lib/db"
import { randomUUID } from "crypto"
import { redirect } from "next/navigation"
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth"

export async function saveComplaintRecord(formData: FormData): Promise<void> {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) {
    redirect('/login');
  }

  try {
    const receivedDate = formData.get('received_date') as string;
    const complaintContent = formData.get('complaint_content') as string;

    if (!receivedDate || !receivedDate.trim()) {
      redirect('/records/complaints?error=' + encodeURIComponent('受付日は必須入力です。'));
    }
    if (!complaintContent || !complaintContent.trim()) {
      redirect('/records/complaints?error=' + encodeURIComponent('苦情内容は必須入力です。'));
    }

    const isThirdPartyReported = formData.get('third_party_reported') === 'on';
    const thirdPartyReportDate = formData.get('third_party_report_date') as string;
    if (isThirdPartyReported && (!thirdPartyReportDate || thirdPartyReportDate.trim() === '')) {
      redirect('/records/complaints?error=' + encodeURIComponent('「第三者委員への報告」を行う場合は、報告日を必ず入力してください（実地指導での客観的記録要件）。'));
    }

    const existingId = (formData.get('id') as string)?.trim() || '';
    if (existingId) {
      resolveServiceModeForTableRecord('complaint_records', existingId);
    }
    const isEdit = !!existingId;
    const id = existingId || randomUUID();

    if (isEdit) {
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE complaint_records SET
          received_date = ?, complainant_name = ?, complainant_relation = ?,
          complaint_content = ?, investigation_content = ?, response_content = ?, response_date = ?, improvement_measures = ?,
          handled_by = ?, third_party_reported = ?, third_party_report_date = ?, status = ?,
          updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE id = ?
      `).run(
        formData.get('received_date') || null,
        formData.get('complainant_name') || null,
        formData.get('complainant_relation') || null,
        formData.get('complaint_content') || null,
        formData.get('investigation_content') || null,
        formData.get('response_content') || null,
        formData.get('response_date') || null,
        formData.get('improvement_measures') || null,
        formData.get('handled_by') || null,
        formData.get('third_party_reported') === 'on' ? 1 : 0,
        formData.get('third_party_report_date') || null,
        formData.get('status') || '対応中',
        id
      );
    } else {
      const stmt = db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO complaint_records (
          id, received_date, complainant_name, complainant_relation,
          complaint_content, investigation_content, response_content, response_date, improvement_measures,
          handled_by, third_party_reported, third_party_report_date, status
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `);

      stmt.run(
        id,
        formData.get('received_date') || null,
        formData.get('complainant_name') || null,
        formData.get('complainant_relation') || null,
        formData.get('complaint_content') || null,
        formData.get('investigation_content') || null,
        formData.get('response_content') || null,
        formData.get('response_date') || null,
        formData.get('improvement_measures') || null,
        formData.get('handled_by') || null,
        formData.get('third_party_reported') === 'on' ? 1 : 0,
        formData.get('third_party_report_date') || null,
        formData.get('status') || '対応中'
      );
    }

    try {
      const { logAudit } = await import('@/lib/audit');
      await logAudit({
        action: 'create',
        targetTable: 'complaint_records',
        targetId: id,
        details: { received_date: formData.get('received_date'), complainant_name: formData.get('complainant_name') }
      });
    } catch (e) {}
  } catch (error: any) {
    if (error?.digest?.startsWith('NEXT_REDIRECT')) throw error;
    console.error("Failed to save complaint record:", error);
    redirect('/records/complaints?error=' + encodeURIComponent('登録に失敗しました: ' + error.message));
  }
  redirect('/records/complaints?msg=' + encodeURIComponent('苦情対応記録を登録しました'));
}

export async function deleteComplaintRecord(id: string): Promise<void> {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (role !== 'admin' && role !== 'service_manager') {
    redirect('/records/complaints?error=' + encodeURIComponent('削除には管理者権限が必要です'));
  }

  try {
    resolveServiceModeForTableRecord('complaint_records', id);
    db.prepare('UPDATE complaint_records SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?').run(id);
  } catch (error: any) {
    if (error?.digest?.startsWith('NEXT_REDIRECT')) throw error;
    console.error("Failed to delete complaint record:", error);
    redirect('/records/complaints?error=' + encodeURIComponent('削除に失敗しました'));
  }
  redirect('/records/complaints?msg=' + encodeURIComponent('苦情対応記録を削除しました'));
}

File: src/app/records/incidents/IncidentsClient.tsx

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { 
  AlertOctagon, 
  AlertCircle, 
  MessageSquareWarning, 
  Plus, 
  Printer, 
  Trash2,
  CheckCircle2,
  Edit
} from "lucide-react";
import { saveIncidentReport, deleteIncidentReport } from "../actions";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { toLocalISODateTime } from "@/lib/utils";

interface IncidentsClientProps {
  reports: any[];
  clients: any[];
}

const TYPE_CONFIG = {
  accident: { label: '事故・怪我', color: 'bg-red-100 text-red-800 border-red-200', icon: AlertOctagon },
  near_miss: { label: 'ヒヤリハット', color: 'bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border-amber-200', icon: AlertCircle },
  complaint: { label: '苦情・要望', color: 'bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border-blue-200', icon: MessageSquareWarning },
};

export function IncidentsClient({ reports, clients }: IncidentsClientProps) {
  const [selectedType, setSelectedType] = useState<string>('all');
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingReport, setEditingReport] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const filteredReports = selectedType === 'all'
    ? reports
    : reports.filter(r => r.report_type === selectedType);

  const handleOpenCreate = () => {
    setEditingReport(null);
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenEdit = (r: any) => {
    setEditingReport(r);
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSave = async (e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    const formData = new FormData(e.currentTarget);
    if (editingReport?.id) {
      formData.append('id', editingReport.id);
    }

    try {
      const res = await saveIncidentReport(formData);
      if (res?.success === false) {
        toast.error(res.error || '保存に失敗しました');
        return;
      }
      toast.success(editingReport?.id ? '報告書を更新しました' : '報告書を保存しました');
      setIsModalOpen(false);
      setEditingReport(null);
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(err.message || '保存に失敗しました');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id: string) => {
    if (!confirm('この報告書を削除しますか？')) return;
    try {
      const res = await deleteIncidentReport(id);
      if (res?.success === false) {
        toast.error(res.error || '削除に失敗しました');
        return;
      }
      toast.success('削除しました');
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(err.message || '削除に失敗しました');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* フィルタ & アクション */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-4 print:hidden">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <Button 
            size="sm" 
            variant={selectedType === 'all' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            onClick={() => setSelectedType('all')}
          >
            すべて ({reports.length})
          </Button>
          <Button 
            size="sm" 
            variant={selectedType === 'accident' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            onClick={() => setSelectedType('accident')}
          >
            事故 ({reports.filter(r => r.report_type === 'accident').length})
          </Button>
          <Button 
            size="sm" 
            variant={selectedType === 'near_miss' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            onClick={() => setSelectedType('near_miss')}
          >
            ヒヤリハット ({reports.filter(r => r.report_type === 'near_miss').length})
          </Button>
          <Button 
            size="sm" 
            variant={selectedType === 'complaint' ? 'default' : 'outline'}
            onClick={() => setSelectedType('complaint')}
          >
            苦情・相談 ({reports.filter(r => r.report_type === 'complaint').length})
          </Button>
        </div>

        <div className="flex gap-2 w-full sm:w-auto">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => window.print()}>
            <Printer className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" /> 印刷
          </Button>
          <Button size="sm" onClick={handleOpenCreate}>
            <Plus className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" /> 報告書を作成
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* レポート一覧 */}
      <div className="space-y-4">
        {filteredReports.length === 0 ? (
          <Card className="p-8 text-center text-muted-foreground">
            記録がありません。「報告書を作成」ボタンから事故やヒヤリハット、苦情対応を記録してください。
          </Card>
        ) : (
          filteredReports.map((r) => {
            const config = TYPE_CONFIG[r.report_type as keyof typeof TYPE_CONFIG] || TYPE_CONFIG.accident;
            const Icon = config.icon;

            return (
              <Card key={r.id} className="shadow-sm">
                <CardHeader className="bg-muted/20 pb-3">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-start">
                    <div>
                      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 mb-1">
                        <span className={`text-xs px-2.5 py-0.5 rounded-full font-bold border flex items-center gap-1 ${config.color}`}>
                          <Icon className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                          {config.label}
                        </span>
                        {r.is_reported_to_gov === 1 && (
                          <span className="text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-red-600 text-white font-bold">
                            自治体報告済
                          </span>
                        )}
                        <span className="text-sm font-semibold text-muted-foreground">
                          発生日時: {r.occurred_at}
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <CardTitle className="text-lg">
                        {r.client_name ? `対象利用者: ${r.client_name} 様` : '対象者: なし / 施設全体'}
                      </CardTitle>
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1 print:hidden">
                      <Button 
                        variant="ghost" 
                        size="sm" 
                        className="h-8 px-2 text-muted-foreground hover:text-blue-600 gap-1 text-xs"
                        onClick={() => handleOpenEdit(r)}
                        title="編集"
                      >
                        <Edit className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                        <span>編集</span>
                      </Button>
                      <Button 
                        variant="ghost" 
                        size="icon" 
                        className="h-8 w-8 text-muted-foreground hover:text-destructive"
                        onClick={() => handleDelete(r.id)}
                        title="削除"
                      >
                        <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                      </Button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </CardHeader>
                <CardContent className="pt-4 space-y-4 text-sm">
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                    <p><span className="font-semibold text-foreground">発生場所:</span> {r.location || '事業所内'}</p>
                    <p><span className="font-semibold text-foreground">報告者:</span> {r.reporter_name}</p>
                  </div>

                  <div>
                    <p className="text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground">【発生状況・詳細】</p>
                    <p className="mt-0.5 whitespace-pre-wrap">{r.situation_details}</p>
                  </div>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                    {r.cause_analysis && (
                      <div className="p-3 bg-muted/20 rounded border">
                        <p className="text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground">【原因分析・背景】</p>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-xs whitespace-pre-wrap">{r.cause_analysis}</p>
                      </div>
                    )}
                    {r.immediate_response && (
                      <div className="p-3 bg-muted/20 rounded border">
                        <p className="text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground">【直後の応急対応・処置】</p>
                        <p className="mt-1 text-xs whitespace-pre-wrap">{r.immediate_response}</p>
                      </div>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {r.preventive_measures && (
                    <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50/50 rounded border border-blue-200">
                      <p className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-900">【再発防止策・改善措置】</p>
                      <p className="mt-1 text-xs text-blue-950 whitespace-pre-wrap">{r.preventive_measures}</p>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {r.family_notified_at && (
                    <div className="p-3 bg-amber-50/60 rounded border border-amber-200 text-xs">
                      <p className="font-bold text-amber-900 mb-1">【ご家族・緊急連絡先への通知エビデンス】</p>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-amber-950">
                        <p><span className="font-semibold">通知日時:</span> {r.family_notified_at}</p>
                        <p><span className="font-semibold">通知担当者:</span> {r.family_notified_by || '未入力'}</p>
                        <p><span className="font-semibold">連絡手段:</span> {r.family_contact_method || '電話等'}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {r.medical_institution_visited === 1 && (
                    <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50/60 rounded border border-blue-200 text-xs">
                      <p className="font-bold text-blue-900 mb-1">【医療機関受診・医師指示エビデンス】</p>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-2 gap-2 text-blue-950">
                        <p><span className="font-semibold">受診先医療機関:</span> {r.medical_institution_name || '受診済'}</p>
                        <p><span className="font-semibold">医師指示事項:</span> {r.doctor_instructions || '指示記録あり'}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {r.is_reported_to_gov === 1 && (
                    <div className="p-3 bg-red-50/60 rounded border border-red-200 text-xs">
                      <p className="font-bold text-red-900 mb-1">【指定権者（自治体）への事故報告エビデンス】</p>
                      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-2 text-red-950">
                        <p><span className="font-semibold">報告日時:</span> {r.gov_reported_at || '記録あり'}</p>
                        <p><span className="font-semibold">報告先自治体・窓口:</span> {r.gov_reported_to || '未入力'}</p>
                        <p><span className="font-semibold">報告担当職員:</span> {r.gov_reported_by || '未入力'}</p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}

                  {r.manager_comment && (
                    <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 rounded border text-xs">
                      <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">管理者コメント・承認確認:</span> {r.manager_comment}
                    </div>
                  )}
                </CardContent>
              </Card>
            );
          })
        )}
      </div>

      {/* 新規登録・編集モーダル */}
      {isModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <Card key={editingReport?.id || 'new_incident'} className="w-full max-w-2xl max-h-[90vh] flex flex-col shadow-xl">
            <CardHeader className="border-b bg-muted/20">
              <CardTitle>{editingReport ? '事故・ヒヤリハット報告書の編集' : '事故・ヒヤリハット報告書の作成'}</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription>
                法令遵守および再発防止のため、発生状況と家族・行政への報告エビデンスを客観的かつ具体的に記録してください。
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <form onSubmit={handleSave} className="overflow-y-auto flex-1">
              <CardContent className="pt-4 space-y-4">
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <Label htmlFor="reportType">種別 *</Label>
                    <select id="reportType" name="reportType" required defaultValue={editingReport?.report_type || 'accident'} className="w-full h-10 px-3 rounded-md border bg-background text-sm">
                      <option value="accident">事故・怪我（要通院等）</option>
                      <option value="near_miss">ヒヤリハット（未然防止）</option>
                      <option value="complaint">苦情・要望対応</option>
                    </select>
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <Label htmlFor="occurredAt">発生日時 *</Label>
                    <Input id="occurredAt" name="occurredAt" type="datetime-local" required defaultValue={editingReport?.occurred_at ? editingReport.occurred_at.slice(0, 16) : toLocalISODateTime()} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <Label htmlFor="clientId">対象利用者</Label>
                    <select id="clientId" name="clientId" defaultValue={editingReport?.client_id || ''} className="w-full h-10 px-3 rounded-md border bg-background text-sm">
                      <option value="">（対象者なし・全般）</option>
                      {clients.map(c => (
                        <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.full_name}</option>
                      ))}
                    </select>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <Label htmlFor="location">発生場所</Label>
                    <Input id="location" name="location" defaultValue={editingReport?.location || '作業室内'} />
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <Label htmlFor="reporterName">報告者名 *</Label>
                    <Input id="reporterName" name="reporterName" required placeholder="氏名" defaultValue={editingReport?.reporter_name || ''} />
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label htmlFor="situationDetails">発生状況・詳細 *</Label>
                  <Textarea id="situationDetails" name="situationDetails" rows={3} required placeholder="いつ、どこで、誰が、何をして、どうなったかを客観的に記載" defaultValue={editingReport?.situation_details || ''} />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label htmlFor="immediateResponse">直後の応急処置・対応</Label>
                  <Textarea id="immediateResponse" name="immediateResponse" rows={2} placeholder="応急手当、病院搬送、家族・関係機関への連絡など" defaultValue={editingReport?.immediate_response || ''} />
                </div>

                {/* 家族連絡エビデンス（実地指導・安全配慮義務） */}
                <div className="p-3 border rounded-md bg-amber-50/40 space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <Label className="font-bold text-amber-950 text-xs">ご家族・緊急連絡先への連絡記録（安全配慮義務・指導監査対応）</Label>
                    <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">事故時は速やかな連絡と記録が必須</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <Label htmlFor="familyNotifiedAt" className="text-xs">連絡日時</Label>
                      <Input id="familyNotifiedAt" name="familyNotifiedAt" type="datetime-local" className="h-8 text-xs bg-white" defaultValue={editingReport?.family_notified_at ? editingReport.family_notified_at.slice(0, 16) : ''} />
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <Label htmlFor="familyNotifiedBy" className="text-xs">連絡担当者</Label>
                      <Input id="familyNotifiedBy" name="familyNotifiedBy" placeholder="連絡を行った職員名" className="h-8 text-xs bg-white" defaultValue={editingReport?.family_notified_by || ''} />
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <Label htmlFor="familyContactMethod" className="text-xs">連絡方法・内容</Label>
                      <Input id="familyContactMethod" name="familyContactMethod" placeholder="電話（母へ容態報告等）" className="h-8 text-xs bg-white" defaultValue={editingReport?.family_contact_method || ''} />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* 医療機関受診・医師指示エビデンス（実地指導・事故対応記録） */}
                <div className="p-3 border rounded-md bg-blue-50/40 space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                    <input type="checkbox" id="medicalInstitutionVisited" name="medicalInstitutionVisited" value="1" defaultChecked={editingReport?.medical_institution_visited === 1} className="h-4 w-4 rounded border-gray-300" />
                    <Label htmlFor="medicalInstitutionVisited" className="text-sm font-semibold text-blue-950">
                      医療機関受診・救急搬送を実施（医師の診断・指示記録あり）
                    </Label>
                  </div>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3 pt-1">
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <Label htmlFor="medicalInstitutionName" className="text-xs">受診先医療機関・医師名</Label>
                      <Input id="medicalInstitutionName" name="medicalInstitutionName" placeholder="例: ○○総合病院 救急外来（○○医師）" className="h-8 text-xs bg-white" defaultValue={editingReport?.medical_institution_name || ''} />
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <Label htmlFor="doctorInstructions" className="text-xs">医師の診断結果・指示事項</Label>
                      <Input id="doctorInstructions" name="doctorInstructions" placeholder="例: 右手首捻挫・湿布処置、1週間安静指示など" className="h-8 text-xs bg-white" defaultValue={editingReport?.doctor_instructions || ''} />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label htmlFor="causeAnalysis">原因分析（なぜ起きたか）</Label>
                  <Textarea id="causeAnalysis" name="causeAnalysis" rows={2} placeholder="環境的要因、心理的・体調的要因、手順の不備など" defaultValue={editingReport?.cause_analysis || ''} />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label htmlFor="preventiveMeasures">再発防止策・今後の改善 *</Label>
                  <Textarea id="preventiveMeasures" name="preventiveMeasures" rows={2} required placeholder="再発を防ぐための具体的手順見直し、職員間での共有事項など" defaultValue={editingReport?.preventive_measures || ''} />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label htmlFor="managerComment">管理者・サビ管確認コメント</Label>
                  <Input id="managerComment" name="managerComment" placeholder="管理者の確認所見" defaultValue={editingReport?.manager_comment || ''} />
                </div>

                {/* 自治体報告エビデンス（実地指導・重大事故報告義務対応） */}
                <div className="p-3 border rounded-md bg-red-50/40 space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center space-x-2">
                    <input type="checkbox" id="isReportedToGov" name="isReportedToGov" value="1" defaultChecked={editingReport?.is_reported_to_gov === 1} className="h-4 w-4 rounded border-gray-300" />
                    <Label htmlFor="isReportedToGov" className="text-sm font-semibold text-red-950">
                      指定権者（自治体・障害福祉窓口）へ事故報告書を提出済（実地指導・法令遵守）
                    </Label>
                  </div>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3 pt-1">
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <Label htmlFor="govReportedAt" className="text-xs">報告日時</Label>
                      <Input id="govReportedAt" name="govReportedAt" type="datetime-local" className="h-8 text-xs bg-white" defaultValue={editingReport?.gov_reported_at ? editingReport.gov_reported_at.slice(0, 16) : ''} />
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <Label htmlFor="govReportedTo" className="text-xs">報告先自治体・担当窓口</Label>
                      <Input id="govReportedTo" name="govReportedTo" placeholder="例: 市障害福祉課 ○○様" className="h-8 text-xs bg-white" defaultValue={editingReport?.gov_reported_to || ''} />
                    </div>
                    <div className="space-y-1">
                      <Label htmlFor="govReportedBy" className="text-xs">報告担当職員</Label>
                      <Input id="govReportedBy" name="govReportedBy" placeholder="例: 管理者 ○○" className="h-8 text-xs bg-white" defaultValue={editingReport?.gov_reported_by || ''} />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>
              </CardContent>

              <div className="p-4 border-t flex justify-end gap-2 bg-muted/20">
                <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={() => { setIsModalOpen(false); setEditingReport(null); }}>キャンセル</Button>
                <Button type="submit" disabled={loading}>{loading ? '保存中...' : (editingReport ? '変更を保存する' : '保存する')}</Button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </Card>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

import { Header } from "@/components/Header";
import { SupportSubNav } from "@/components/NavigationTabs";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { getIncidentReports } from "../actions";
import { IncidentsClient } from "./IncidentsClient";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";

export default async function IncidentsPage() {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) {
    redirect("/login");
  }

  const reports = await getIncidentReports();
  const clients = db.prepare('SELECT id, full_name FROM clients WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY full_name ASC').all() as any[];

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background/50">
      <div className="print:hidden">
        <Header activePage="records/incidents" />
        <SupportSubNav />
      </div>

      <main className="flex-1 p-3.5 sm:p-6 md:p-12">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-5xl space-y-6">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground">
                事故・ヒヤリハット・苦情対応記録
              </h1>
              <p className="mt-1 sm:mt-2 text-sm sm:text-base text-muted-foreground">
                施設内で発生した事故、怪我、ヒヤリハット、利用者・家族からの苦情を記録し、再発防止と運営指導（実地指導）に備えます。
              </p>
            </div>
          </div>

          <IncidentsClient reports={reports} clients={clients} />
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}
