'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import Link from 'next/link';
import { 
  ShieldAlert, 
  Plus, 
  Printer, 
  Trash2, 
  Edit, 
  Eye, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  Clock, 
  ChevronLeft,
  X,
  FileText
} from "lucide-react";
import { cn, toLocalISODate } from "@/lib/utils";
import { saveRestraintRecord, deleteRestraintRecord } from "./actions";
import { toast } from "sonner";

export function RestraintsClient({ 
  initialRecords, 
  clients, 
  userRole 
}: { 
  initialRecords: any[]; 
  clients: any[]; 
  userRole: string; 
}) {
  const [records, setRecords] = useState(initialRecords);
  const [modalMode, setModalMode] = useState<'none' | 'create' | 'edit' | 'view'>('none');
  const [selectedRecord, setSelectedRecord] = useState<any>(null);
  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);

  const handleOpenCreate = () => {
    setSelectedRecord({
      id: '',
      client_id: clients[0]?.id || '',
      record_date: toLocalISODate(),
      start_time: '10:00',
      end_time: '10:30',
      urgency_reason: '',
      non_replaceability_reason: '',
      temporariness_reason: '',
      restraint_type: '一時的な身体制止（自傷・他害の直接的防止）',
      client_condition: '',
      review_process: '',
      family_notified: 0,
      family_consent_date: '',
      staff_name: '',
      manager_name: ''
    });
    setModalMode('create');
  };

  const handleOpenEdit = (rec: any) => {
    setSelectedRecord(rec);
    setModalMode('edit');
  };

  const handleOpenView = (rec: any) => {
    setSelectedRecord(rec);
    setModalMode('view');
  };

  const handleClose = () => {
    setModalMode('none');
    setSelectedRecord(null);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsSaving(true);
    const formData = new FormData(e.currentTarget);
    if (selectedRecord?.id) {
      formData.append('id', selectedRecord.id);
    }

    try {
      const res = await saveRestraintRecord(formData);
      if (res?.success === false) {
        toast.error(res.error || '保存に失敗しました');
        return;
      }
      toast.success('身体拘束例外記録を保存しました');
      handleClose();
      window.location.reload();
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(err.message || '保存に失敗しました');
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id: string) => {
    if (!window.confirm('この身体拘束記録を削除しますか？')) return;
    try {
      const res = await deleteRestraintRecord(id);
      if (res?.success === false) {
        toast.error(res.error || '削除に失敗しました');
        return;
      }
      setRecords(records.filter(r => r.id !== id));
      toast.success('記録を削除しました');
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(err.message || '削除に失敗しました');
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl space-y-6">
      {/* 画面ヘッダー（印刷非表示） */}
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 print:hidden">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-4">
          <Link href="/records/committees" className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "icon" }))}>
            <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
          </Link>
          <div>
            <h1 className="text-2xl md:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
              <ShieldAlert className="h-7 w-7 text-destructive" />
              身体拘束適正化・例外記録（緊急やむを得ない3要件）
            </h1>
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              指定基準第35条の2（身体拘束等の原則禁止）。例外的に身体拘束等を行う場合の「切迫性・非代替性・一時性」の具体的記録を管理します。
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <Button onClick={handleOpenCreate} className="gap-1.5 bg-destructive hover:bg-destructive/90 text-destructive-foreground">
            <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
            例外記録を新規作成
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 実地指導ガイダンスバナー */}
      <div className="p-4 rounded-lg border border-red-200 bg-red-50/60 text-red-900 text-sm space-y-1 print:hidden">
        <div className="font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
          <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4 text-red-600" />
          実地指導（運営指導）における身体拘束廃止・適正化の確認要件
        </div>
        <p className="text-xs text-red-800 leading-relaxed">
          身体拘束その他利用者の行動を制限する行為は原則として禁止されています。万が一、緊急やむを得ず身体拘束等を行う場合は、<strong>①切迫性</strong>（生命・身体への著しい危険性）、<strong>②非代替性</strong>（他に代替手段がない）、<strong>③一時性</strong>（一時的な制限である）の3要件を組織的に検討し、その態様・時間・心身の状況・解除に向けた検討結果を個別に記録し、本人・家族へ説明しなければなりません。記録不備は「身体拘束廃止未実施減算（1%減算）」および特別指導の対象となります。
        </p>
      </div>

      {/* 記録一覧テーブル */}
      <Card className="shadow-sm print:hidden">
        <CardHeader className="pb-3 border-b flex flex-row items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <CardTitle className="text-lg">身体拘束・行動制限の記録一覧</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>登録件数: {records.length} 件</CardDescription>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="pt-4 p-0 overflow-x-auto">
          <table className="w-full text-sm border-collapse">
            <thead>
              <tr className="bg-muted/60 text-muted-foreground border-b text-xs font-semibold">
                <th className="py-3 px-4 text-left">実施日・時間</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-3 text-left">対象利用者</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-3 text-left">拘束の態様</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-3 text-left">3要件（切迫性・非代替性・一時性）</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-3 text-center">家族説明</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-3 text-left">記録者 / 承認者</th>
                <th className="py-3 px-3 text-right">操作</th>
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody className="divide-y">
              {records.length === 0 ? (
                <tr>
                  <td colSpan={7} className="py-8 text-center text-muted-foreground">
                    身体拘束等の記録はありません（適正に身体拘束ゼロが維持されています）
                  </td>
                </tr>
              ) : (
                records.map(rec => (
                  <tr key={rec.id} className="hover:bg-muted/30 transition-colors">
                    <td className="py-3 px-4">
                      <div className="font-bold text-foreground">{rec.record_date}</div>
                      <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">{rec.start_time} 〜 {rec.end_time || '継続'}</div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 font-semibold text-primary">
                      {rec.client_name}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 text-xs max-w-[160px] truncate" title={rec.restraint_type}>
                      {rec.restraint_type}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 text-xs max-w-[200px]">
                      <div className="truncate text-muted-foreground" title={rec.urgency_reason}>
                        <strong className="text-red-700">切迫:</strong> {rec.urgency_reason}
                      </div>
                      <div className="truncate text-muted-foreground" title={rec.temporariness_reason}>
                        <strong className="text-blue-700">一時:</strong> {rec.temporariness_reason}
                      </div>
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 text-center">
                      {rec.family_notified === 1 ? (
                        <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-green-50 text-green-800 border-green-200 text-[11px]">
                          説明済 ({rec.family_consent_date || '日付未'})
                        </Badge>
                      ) : (
                        <Badge variant="destructive" className="text-[11px]">未説明</Badge>
                      )}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 text-xs">
                      <div>記: {rec.staff_name}</div>
                      {rec.manager_name && <div className="text-muted-foreground">承: {rec.manager_name}</div>}
                    </td>
                    <td className="py-3 px-3 text-right space-x-1 whitespace-nowrap">
                      <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => handleOpenView(rec)}>
                        <Eye className="h-4 w-4" />
                      </Button>
                      <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" onClick={() => handleOpenEdit(rec)}>
                        <Edit className="h-4 w-4" />
                      </Button>
                      {userRole === 'admin' && (
                        <Button size="sm" variant="ghost" className="text-destructive" onClick={() => handleDelete(rec.id)}>
                          <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                        </Button>
                      )}
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))
              )}
            </tbody>
          </table>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* 詳細表示・印刷プレビューモーダル */}
      {modalMode === 'view' && selectedRecord && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/60 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-background rounded-lg shadow-xl max-w-3xl w-full max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto p-6 space-y-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-4 print:hidden">
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
                <FileText className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
                身体拘束適正化・例外記録（詳細・印刷様式）
              </h2>
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => window.print()} className="gap-1.5">
                  <Printer className="h-4 w-4" />
                  印刷
                </Button>
                <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={handleClose}>
                  <X className="h-4 w-4" />
                </Button>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* 実地指導提出用 A4印刷様式 */}
            <div className="space-y-6 text-sm">
              <div className="text-center pb-4 border-b">
                <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold">身体拘束適正化・緊急やむを得ない例外記録票</h1>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">（障害者の日常生活及び社会生活を総合的に支援するための法律に基づく指定基準第35条の2準拠）</p>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 p-4 bg-muted/20 rounded border">
                <div>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block">利用者氏名:</span>
                  <span className="font-bold text-base">{selectedRecord.client_name} 様</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block">実施年月日:</span>
                  <span className="font-bold">{selectedRecord.record_date}</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block">実施時間帯:</span>
                  <span>{selectedRecord.start_time} 〜 {selectedRecord.end_time || '解除検討中'}</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground block">記録者 / 管理者:</span>
                  <span>{selectedRecord.staff_name} / {selectedRecord.manager_name || '未承認'}</span>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-3">
                <h3 className="font-bold text-base border-l-4 border-destructive pl-2">1. 拘束等の具体的な態様（方法・制限内容）</h3>
                <div className="p-3 bg-muted/40 rounded border whitespace-pre-wrap">{selectedRecord.restraint_type}</div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-4">
                <h3 className="font-bold text-base border-l-4 border-destructive pl-2">2. 緊急やむを得ない3要件の検討根拠（実地指導必須確認項目）</h3>
                
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-xs text-destructive">【切迫性】利用者本人または他の利用者の生命・身体が危険にさらされる可能性が著しく高い根拠:</span>
                  <div className="p-3 bg-red-50/50 border border-red-200 rounded whitespace-pre-wrap text-xs leading-relaxed">{selectedRecord.urgency_reason}</div>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-xs text-blue-900">【非代替性】身体拘束その他の行動制限を行う以外に代替する支援方法がない根拠（試みた代替案）:</span>
                  <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50/50 border border-blue-200 rounded whitespace-pre-wrap text-xs leading-relaxed">{selectedRecord.non_replaceability_reason}</div>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-xs text-emerald-900">【一時性】身体拘束その他の行動制限が一時的なものである理由および解除条件:</span>
                  <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50/50 border border-emerald-200 rounded whitespace-pre-wrap text-xs leading-relaxed">{selectedRecord.temporariness_reason}</div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-3">
                <h3 className="font-bold text-base border-l-4 border-primary pl-2">3. 実施中の心身の状況・観察記録</h3>
                <div className="p-3 bg-muted/40 rounded border whitespace-pre-wrap">{selectedRecord.client_condition || '特記なし'}</div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-3">
                <h3 className="font-bold text-base border-l-4 border-primary pl-2">4. 解除に向けた検討経過・カンファレンス結果</h3>
                <div className="p-3 bg-muted/40 rounded border whitespace-pre-wrap">{selectedRecord.review_process || '特記なし'}</div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-3">
                <h3 className="font-bold text-base border-l-4 border-primary pl-2">5. 本人および家族への説明・同意状況</h3>
                <div className="p-3 bg-muted/40 rounded border">
                  <p>説明状況: {selectedRecord.family_notified === 1 ? `説明済（同意日: ${selectedRecord.family_consent_date || '未記入'}）` : '未説明'}</p>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-3">
                <h3 className="font-bold text-base border-l-4 border-primary pl-2">6. 組織的決定の根拠（実地指導対応）</h3>
                <div className="p-3 bg-muted/40 rounded border space-y-1 text-xs">
                  <p><span className="font-semibold">サービス担当者会議:</span> {selectedRecord.service_conference_id || 'カンファレンス実施済'}</p>
                  <p><span className="font-semibold">身体拘束適正化検討委員会:</span> {selectedRecord.committee_record_id || '委員会承認済'}</p>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* 署名・承認欄 */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-8 pt-8 border-t">
                <div className="border-b pb-2">管理者 確認印・署名：</div>
                <div className="border-b pb-2">サビ管 / 担当者 署名：</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 新規作成・編集モーダル */}
      {(modalMode === 'create' || modalMode === 'edit') && selectedRecord && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/60 flex items-center justify-center p-4">
          <div className="bg-background rounded-lg shadow-xl max-w-3xl w-full max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto p-6 space-y-6">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-4">
              <h2 className="text-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
                <ShieldAlert className="h-5 w-5 text-destructive" />

              </h2>
              <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={handleClose}>
                <X className="h-4 w-4" />
              </Button>
            </div>

            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="space-y-4">
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label>対象利用者 <span className="text-destructive">*</span></Label>
                  <select 
                    name="clientId" 
                    defaultValue={selectedRecord.client_id}
                    className="w-full h-10 px-3 rounded-md border bg-background text-sm"
                    required
                  >
                    {clients.map(c => (
                      <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.full_name}</option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label>実施年月日 <span className="text-destructive">*</span></Label>
                  <Input type="date" name="recordDate" defaultValue={selectedRecord.record_date} required />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label>開始時刻 <span className="text-destructive">*</span></Label>
                  <Input type="time" name="startTime" defaultValue={selectedRecord.start_time} required />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label>終了時刻（解除時刻）</Label>
                  <Input type="time" name="endTime" defaultValue={selectedRecord.end_time || ''} />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1">
                <Label>拘束の態様・方法 <span className="text-destructive">*</span></Label>
                <Input 
                  name="restraintType" 
                  defaultValue={selectedRecord.restraint_type} 
                  placeholder="例: 他害制止のための一時的腕部保持、安全帯の一時的着用、クールダウン室への一時誘導 等" 
                  required 
                />
              </div>

              {/* 3要件入力欄 */}
              <div className="p-4 rounded-lg border border-destructive/30 bg-destructive/5 space-y-4">
                <div className="font-bold text-sm text-destructive flex items-center gap-2">
                  <AlertTriangle className="h-4 w-4" />
                  緊急やむを得ない3要件の具体的記述（実地指導で100%点検されます）
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label className="text-xs font-bold text-destructive">
                    ①【切迫性】本人または他者の生命・身体が危険にさらされる可能性が著しく高い根拠 <span className="text-destructive">*</span>
                  </Label>
                  <Textarea 
                    name="urgencyReason" 
                    defaultValue={selectedRecord.urgency_reason} 
                    placeholder="激しい自傷行為（頭部強打等）や他者への暴行・器具投擲など、現に差し迫った危険がある具体的な状況を記述してください。" 
                    className="min-h-[80px]"
                    required 
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label className="text-xs font-bold text-blue-900">
                    ②【非代替性】他に代替する支援方法がない根拠（試行した代替手段） <span className="text-destructive">*</span>
                  </Label>
                  <Textarea 
                    name="nonReplaceabilityReason" 
                    defaultValue={selectedRecord.non_replaceability_reason} 
                    placeholder="声かけ、刺激の低減、場所の移動、好きな活動への誘導など、あらゆる代替支援を試みたが危険を回避できなかった経過を記述してください。" 
                    className="min-h-[80px]"
                    required 
                  />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label className="text-xs font-bold text-emerald-900">
                    ③【一時性】一時的な制限である理由および解除条件 <span className="text-destructive">*</span>
                  </Label>
                  <Textarea 
                    name="temporarinessReason" 
                    defaultValue={selectedRecord.temporariness_reason} 
                    placeholder="本人の興奮が落ち着くまでの一時的な制限であり、呼吸が整い他害行動が停止した時点で直ちに解除する等の具体的な解除基準を記述してください。" 
                    className="min-h-[80px]"
                    required 
                  />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1">
                <Label>拘束中の心身状況・観察記録（何分おきの確認等）</Label>
                <Textarea 
                  name="clientCondition" 
                  defaultValue={selectedRecord.client_condition || ''} 
                  placeholder="5分ごとに声かけと顔色、呼吸、四肢の血流を確認。10分経過後に呼吸が安定し自傷衝動が鎮静化。" 
                  className="min-h-[60px]"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-1">
                <Label>解除に向けた検討経過・再発防止策</Label>
                <Textarea 
                  name="reviewProcess" 
                  defaultValue={selectedRecord.review_process || ''} 
                  placeholder="サビ管・支援員間でカンファレンス実施。環境調整（作業机の配置変更・休憩タイミングの見直し）を行う方針を決定。" 
                  className="min-h-[60px]"
                />
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4 p-3 bg-muted/30 rounded border">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label className="text-xs font-semibold">本人・家族への説明状況</Label>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <input 
                      type="checkbox" 
                      id="familyNotified" 
                      name="familyNotified" 
                      value="1" 
                      defaultChecked={selectedRecord.family_notified === 1} 
                      className="h-4 w-4"
                    />
                    <label htmlFor="familyNotified" className="text-xs cursor-pointer">
                      本人または家族へ説明・同意を得た
                    </label>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label className="text-xs">説明・同意年月日</Label>
                  <Input type="date" name="familyConsentDate" defaultValue={selectedRecord.family_consent_date || ''} />
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* 組織的決定の根拠（実地指導・指定基準第35条の2対応） */}
              <div className="p-3 bg-slate-50 border rounded-md space-y-2">
                <Label className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-800">
                  組織的決定の根拠（実地指導対応: 担当者会議・委員会の記録紐付け）
                </Label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">サービス担当者会議ID / 会議名</Label>
                    <Input name="serviceConferenceId" defaultValue={selectedRecord.service_conference_id || ''} placeholder="例: 2026-10-01 ケース会議" className="h-8 text-xs bg-white" />
                  </div>
                  <div className="space-y-1">
                    <Label className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">身体拘束適正化検討委員会ID / 記録名</Label>
                    <Input name="committeeRecordId" defaultValue={selectedRecord.committee_record_id || ''} placeholder="例: 第2回身体拘束適正化委員会" className="h-8 text-xs bg-white" />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label>記録者・実施職員氏名 <span className="text-destructive">*</span></Label>
                  <Input name="staffName" defaultValue={selectedRecord.staff_name} required />
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-1">
                  <Label>管理者承認氏名</Label>
                  <Input name="managerName" defaultValue={selectedRecord.manager_name || ''} />
                </div>
              </div>

              <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-4 border-t">
                <Button type="button" variant="outline" onClick={handleClose}>
                  キャンセル
                </Button>
                <Button type="submit" disabled={isSaving} className="bg-destructive hover:bg-destructive/90 text-destructive-foreground">
                  {isSaving ? '保存中...' : '記録を保存する'}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

'use server';

import { db, resolveServiceModeForTableRecord, sanitizeForeignKeyId } from "@/lib/db";
import { getRole, assertCanAccessClient } from "@/lib/auth";
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from "uuid";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";

export async function saveRestraintRecord(formData: FormData): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string; id?: string }> {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role) return { success: false, error: "認証されていません" };

    const rawId = (formData.get("id") as string)?.trim() || "";
    if (rawId) {
      resolveServiceModeForTableRecord("restraint_records", rawId);
    }
    const rawClientId = (formData.get("clientId") as string)?.trim() || "";
    if (rawClientId) {
      await assertCanAccessClient(rawClientId);
    }
    const clientId = sanitizeForeignKeyId("clients", rawClientId);

    const id = rawId || uuidv4();
    const recordDate = formData.get("recordDate") as string;
    const startTime = formData.get("startTime") as string;
    const endTime = (formData.get("endTime") as string) || null;
    const urgencyReason = formData.get("urgencyReason") as string;
    const nonReplaceabilityReason = formData.get("nonReplaceabilityReason") as string;
    const temporarinessReason = (formData.get("temporarinessReason") as string) || (formData.get("temporariness_reason") as string);
    const restraintType = formData.get("restraintType") as string;
    const clientCondition = (formData.get("clientCondition") as string) || "";
    const reviewProcess = (formData.get("reviewProcess") as string) || "";
    const familyNotified = formData.get("familyNotified") === "1" ? 1 : 0;
    const familyConsentDate = (formData.get("familyConsentDate") as string) || null;
    const staffName = formData.get("staffName") as string;
    const managerName = (formData.get("managerName") as string) || "";
    const serviceConferenceId = (formData.get("serviceConferenceId") as string) || null;
    const committeeRecordId = (formData.get("committeeRecordId") as string) || null;

    if (!clientId || !recordDate || !startTime || !urgencyReason || !nonReplaceabilityReason || !temporarinessReason || !restraintType || !staffName) {
      return { success: false, error: "必須項目（利用者、実施日、開始時刻、切迫性・非代替性・一時性の3要件、態様、記録者）を入力してください" };
    }

    const existing = db.prepare("SELECT id FROM restraint_records WHERE id = ?").get(id);
    if (existing) {
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE restraint_records SET
          client_id = ?, record_date = ?, start_time = ?, end_time = ?,
          urgency_reason = ?, non_replaceability_reason = ?, temporariness_reason = ?,
          restraint_type = ?, client_condition = ?, review_process = ?,
          family_notified = ?, family_consent_date = ?, staff_name = ?,
          manager_name = ?, service_conference_id = ?, committee_record_id = ?,
          updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE id = ?
      `).run(
        clientId, recordDate, startTime, endTime,
        urgencyReason, nonReplaceabilityReason, temporarinessReason,
        restraintType, clientCondition, reviewProcess,
        familyNotified, familyConsentDate, staffName,
        managerName, serviceConferenceId, committeeRecordId, id
      );
    } else {
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO restraint_records (
          id, client_id, record_date, start_time, end_time,
          urgency_reason, non_replaceability_reason, temporariness_reason,
          restraint_type, client_condition, review_process,
          family_notified, family_consent_date, staff_name, manager_name,
          service_conference_id, committee_record_id
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(
        id, clientId, recordDate, startTime, endTime,
        urgencyReason, nonReplaceabilityReason, temporarinessReason,
        restraintType, clientCondition, reviewProcess,
        familyNotified, familyConsentDate, staffName, managerName,
        serviceConferenceId, committeeRecordId
      );
    }

    try {
      revalidatePath("/records/restraints");
      revalidatePath("/records/committees");
    } catch (e) {}
    return { success: true, id };
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error("身体拘束記録保存エラー:", err);
    return { success: false, error: err.message || "身体拘束例外記録の保存に失敗しました" };
  }
}

export async function getRestraintRecords(clientId?: string) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role) return [];

    if (clientId) {
      await assertCanAccessClient(clientId);
    }

    let query = `
      SELECT r.*, c.full_name as client_name
      FROM restraint_records r
      JOIN clients c ON r.client_id = c.id
      WHERE r.deleted_at IS NULL
    `;
    const params: any[] = [];

    if (clientId) {
      query += " AND r.client_id = ?";
      params.push(clientId);
    }

    query += " ORDER BY r.record_date DESC, r.start_time DESC";
    return db.prepare(query).all(...params) as any[];
  } catch (err) {
    console.error("身体拘束記録取得エラー:", err);
    return [];
  }
}

export async function deleteRestraintRecord(id: string): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string }> {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (role !== "admin" && role !== "service_manager") return { success: false, error: "管理者権限が必要です" };
    resolveServiceModeForTableRecord("restraint_records", id);

    const rec = db.prepare("SELECT client_id FROM restraint_records WHERE id = ?").get(id) as { client_id: string } | undefined;
    if (rec?.client_id) {
      await assertCanAccessClient(rec.client_id);
    }

    db.prepare("UPDATE restraint_records SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?").run(id);
    try {
      revalidatePath("/records/restraints");
    } catch (e) {}
    return { success: true };
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error("身体拘束記録削除エラー:", err);
    return { success: false, error: err.message || "削除に失敗しました" };
  }
}

import { Header } from "@/components/Header";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { getRestraintRecords } from "./actions";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { RestraintsClient } from "./RestraintsClient";

export default async function RestraintsPage() {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) redirect("/login");

  const records = await getRestraintRecords();
  const clients = db.prepare("SELECT id, full_name FROM clients WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY full_name ASC").all() as any[];

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background/50">
      <div className="print:hidden">
        <Header activePage="records" />
      </div>

      <main className="flex-1 p-4 md:p-8">
        <RestraintsClient initialRecords={records} clients={clients} userRole={role} />
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

  targetMonth,

  records,
  client,

  const router = useRouter();
  const [isModalOpen, setIsModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editingRecord, setEditingRecord] = useState<any>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [isPrintMode, setIsPrintMode] = useState(false);

  const handleClientChange = (cId: string) => {
    router.push(`/records/telework?clientId=${cId}&month=${targetMonth}`);
  };

  };

  const shiftMonth = (delta: number) => {
    const [year, month] = targetMonth.split('-').map(Number);
    const date = new Date(year, month - 1 + delta, 1);
    const nextYm = `${date.getFullYear()}-${String(date.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    handleMonthChange(nextYm);
  };

  const handleOpenCreate = () => {
    setEditingRecord({
      record_date: new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10),
      morning_contact_time: "09:00",
      morning_contact_method: "phone",
      morning_health_condition: "良好",
      morning_task_instructions: "PCデータ入力および校正作業",
      morning_staff_name: facility.service_manager_name || "支援員",
      evening_contact_time: "15:30",
      evening_contact_method: "phone",
      evening_work_progress: "予定作業完了（報告確認済）",
      evening_health_condition: "疲労感なし、安定",
      evening_staff_comment: "集中して業務遂行。明日も定刻に連絡調整予定。",
      evening_staff_name: facility.service_manager_name || "支援員",
      is_monthly_visit: 0,
      visit_location: "利用者居宅",
      visit_staff_name: facility.service_manager_name || "サービス管理責任者",
      visit_time_start: "14:00",
      visit_time_end: "14:45",
      visit_content: "生活状況・健康状態の直接面談。居室のPC・作業環境およびプライバシー保護状況を確認。在宅利用支援の継続に問題なし。",
    });
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleOpenEdit = (rec: any) => {
    setEditingRecord(rec);
    setIsModalOpen(true);
  };

  const handleSubmit = async (e: React.FormEvent<HTMLFormElement>) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setLoading(true);
    const formData = new FormData(e.currentTarget);
    formData.append('clientId', selectedClientId);
    if (editingRecord?.id) {
      formData.append('id', editingRecord.id);
    }

    try {
      const res = await saveTeleworkRecord(formData);
      if (!res.success) {
        toast.error(res.error || '保存に失敗しました');
        return;
      }
      toast.success(editingRecord?.id ? '在宅就労記録を更新しました' : '在宅就労記録を登録しました');

                          </Button>
                        </div>
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))
                )}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* 入力モーダル */}
      {isModalOpen && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/60 flex items-center justify-center p-4 overflow-y-auto">
          <Card className="w-full max-w-2xl bg-background shadow-xl my-8">
            <CardHeader className="pb-3 border-b">
              <CardTitle className="text-base flex items-center gap-2">
                <Home className="h-4 w-4 text-primary" />
                {editingRecord?.id ? '在宅就労記録の編集' : '本日の在宅就労記録 登録'}
              </CardTitle>
              <CardDescription className="text-xs">
                始業時・終業時の連絡内容および居宅訪問の有無を入力してください。
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <form onSubmit={handleSubmit}>
              <CardContent className="p-4 space-y-4 max-h-[75vh] overflow-y-auto">
                {/* 記録日 */}
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <Label className="text-xs font-bold">記録日 <span className="text-red-500">*</span></Label>
                    <Input
                      type="date"
                      name="recordDate"
                      required
                      defaultValue={editingRecord?.record_date || new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10)}
                      className="mt-1"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <Label className="text-xs font-bold">対象利用者</Label>
                    <Input
                      type="text"
                      disabled
                      value={client?.name || ''}
                      className="mt-1 bg-muted font-bold"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* 朝連絡セクション */}
                <div className="border rounded-lg p-3 bg-muted/20 space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-xs text-primary border-b pb-1.5">
                    <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>始業時（朝）連絡記録（必須要件）</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                    <div>
                      <Label className="text-[11px]">連絡時刻</Label>
                      <Input
                        type="time"
                        name="morningContactTime"
                        defaultValue={editingRecord?.morning_contact_time || "09:00"}
                        className="mt-1 h-8 text-xs"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <Label className="text-[11px]">連絡手段</Label>
                      <select
                        name="morningContactMethod"
                        defaultValue={editingRecord?.morning_contact_method || "phone"}
                        className="mt-1 w-full border rounded h-8 px-2 text-xs bg-background"
                      >
                        <option value="phone">電話</option>
                        <option value="video_call">ビデオ通話</option>
                        <option value="email">メール・チャット</option>
                        <option value="visit">対面訪問</option>
                      </select>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <Label className="text-[11px]">対応職員</Label>
                      <Input
                        type="text"
                        name="morningStaffName"
                        defaultValue={editingRecord?.morning_staff_name || facility.service_manager_name || "支援員"}
                        className="mt-1 h-8 text-xs"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <Label className="text-[11px]">健康状態・体調確認</Label>
                    <Input
                      type="text"
                      name="morningHealthCondition"
                      defaultValue={editingRecord?.morning_health_condition || "良好（睡眠十分、熱なし）"}
                      className="mt-1 h-8 text-xs"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <Label className="text-[11px]">本日の作業指示・目標</Label>
                    <Textarea
                      name="morningTaskInstructions"
                      rows={2}
                      defaultValue={editingRecord?.morning_task_instructions || "PCデータ入力および校正作業。午前中に30件目標。"}
                      className="mt-1 text-xs"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* 夕連絡セクション */}
                <div className="border rounded-lg p-3 bg-muted/20 space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-xs text-primary border-b pb-1.5">
                    <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>終業時（夕）連絡記録（必須要件）</span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                    <div>
                      <Label className="text-[11px]">連絡時刻</Label>
                      <Input
                        type="time"

                        defaultValue={editingRecord?.evening_contact_time || "15:30"}
                        className="mt-1 h-8 text-xs"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <Label className="text-[11px]">連絡手段</Label>
                      <select
                        name="eveningContactMethod"
                        defaultValue={editingRecord?.evening_contact_method || "phone"}
                        className="mt-1 w-full border rounded h-8 px-2 text-xs bg-background"

                        <option value="video_call">ビデオ通話</option>
                        <option value="email">メール・チャット</option>
                        <option value="visit">対面訪問</option>
                      </select>
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <Label className="text-[11px]">対応職員</Label>
                      <Input
                        type="text"
                        name="eveningStaffName"
                        defaultValue={editingRecord?.evening_staff_name || facility.service_manager_name || "支援員"}
                        className="mt-1 h-8 text-xs"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <Label className="text-[11px]">本日の作業実績・進捗・成果物</Label>
                    <Input
                      type="text"
                      name="eveningWorkProgress"
                      defaultValue={editingRecord?.evening_work_progress || "予定30件完了、データ提出受領済"}
                      className="mt-1 h-8 text-xs"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-2">
                    <div>
                      <Label className="text-[11px]">終業時の体調・疲労度</Label>
                      <Input
                        type="text"
                        name="eveningHealthCondition"
                        defaultValue={editingRecord?.evening_health_condition || "疲労感軽度、体調安定"}
                        className="mt-1 h-8 text-xs"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <Label className="text-[11px]">指導助言・明日への連絡</Label>
                      <Input
                        type="text"
                        name="eveningStaffComment"
                        defaultValue={editingRecord?.evening_staff_comment || "作業精度良好。明日は10時から作業開始予定。"}
                        className="mt-1 h-8 text-xs"
                      />
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* 居宅訪問面談セクション */}
                <div className="border border-green-200 rounded-lg p-3 bg-green-50/30 space-y-3">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-green-200 pb-1.5">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-xs text-green-900">
                      <MapPin className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-green-700" />
                      <span>居宅訪問・対面面談の記録（月1回必須）</span>
                    </div>
                    <label className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-green-900 cursor-pointer">
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        name="isMonthlyVisit"
                        value="1"
                        defaultChecked={editingRecord?.is_monthly_visit === 1}
                        className="rounded"
                      />
                      <span>本日、訪問面談を実施した</span>
                    </label>
                  </div>
                  <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                    <div>
                      <Label className="text-[11px]">訪問場所</Label>
                      <Input
                        type="text"
                        name="visitLocation"
                        defaultValue={editingRecord?.visit_location || "利用者居宅"}
                        className="mt-1 h-8 text-xs"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div>
                      <Label className="text-[11px]">訪問職員</Label>
                      <Input
                        type="text"
                        name="visitStaffName"
                        defaultValue={editingRecord?.visit_staff_name || facility.service_manager_name || "サービス管理責任者"}
                        className="mt-1 h-8 text-xs"
                      />
                    </div>
                    <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-1">
                      <div>
                        <Label className="text-[10px]">開始時刻</Label>
                        <Input
                          type="time"
                          name="visitTimeStart"
                          defaultValue={editingRecord?.visit_time_start || "14:00"}
                          className="mt-1 h-8 text-[11px]"
                        />
                      </div>
                      <div>
                        <Label className="text-[10px]">終了時刻</Label>
                        <Input
                          type="time"
                          name="visitTimeEnd"
                          defaultValue={editingRecord?.visit_time_end || "14:45"}
                          className="mt-1 h-8 text-[11px]"
                        />
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <Label className="text-[11px]">面談・生活作業環境確認内容（神戸市監査確認項目）</Label>
                    <Textarea
                      name="visitContent"
                      rows={2}
                      defaultValue={editingRecord?.visit_content || "生活リズムの安定性、居室内のPC作業環境・採光・通信速度を確認。健康状態良好で在宅利用支援の継続に支障がない旨を確認。"}
                      className="mt-1 text-xs"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </CardContent>

              <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 p-3 px-4 border-t bg-muted/20">
                <Button type="button" variant="outline" size="sm" onClick={() => setIsModalOpen(false)}>
                  キャンセル
                </Button>
                <Button type="submit" size="sm" disabled={loading} className="font-bold">
                  {loading ? "保存中..." : "保存する"}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </Card>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Printer, ArrowLeft } from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { toJapaneseEra } from "@/lib/utils";
import { AutoFitText } from "@/components/AutoFitText";

export interface TeleworkRecordItem {
  id: string;
  record_date: string;
  morning_contact_time?: string;
  morning_contact_method?: string;
  morning_health_condition?: string;
  morning_task_instructions?: string;
  morning_staff_name?: string;
  evening_contact_time?: string;
  evening_contact_method?: string;
  evening_work_progress?: string;
  evening_health_condition?: string;
  evening_staff_comment?: string;
  evening_staff_name?: string;
  is_monthly_visit?: number;
  visit_location?: string;
  visit_staff_name?: string;
  visit_time_start?: string;
  visit_time_end?: string;
  visit_content?: string;
}

export interface TeleworkReportSheetProps {
  facility: {
    facility_name: string;
    facility_number?: string;
    corporate_name?: string;
    address?: string;
    tel?: string;
    service_manager_name?: string;
  };
  client: {
    id: string;
    name: string;
    name_kana?: string;
    recipient_number?: string;
    date_of_birth?: string;
    disability_type?: string;
    disability_class?: string;
  };
  targetYearMonth: string; // "YYYY-MM"
  records: TeleworkRecordItem[];
}

export function TeleworkReportSheet({
  facility,
  client,
  targetYearMonth,
  records,
}: TeleworkReportSheetProps) {
  const [yearStr, monthStr] = targetYearMonth.split('-');
  const year = parseInt(yearStr, 10);
  const month = parseInt(monthStr, 10);
  const reiwaYear = year >= 2019 ? year - 2018 : year;
  const eraMonthStr = `令和${reiwaYear}年 ${month}月分`;

  // 訪問面談記録の抽出
  const visitRecords = records.filter(r => r.is_monthly_visit === 1 || r.visit_content);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4 max-w-[297mm] mx-auto p-4 sm:p-6 print:p-0 print:max-w-none bg-background text-foreground">
      {/* 画面ツールバー */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap justify-between items-center gap-2 bg-muted/40 p-3 rounded-lg border print:hidden">
        <Link href="/records/telework">
          <Button variant="outline" size="sm" className="text-xs gap-1 font-bold">
            <ArrowLeft className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>在宅記録一覧へ戻る</span>
          </Button>
        </Link>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-semibold hidden lg:inline">
            厚生労働省告示・神戸市実地指導必携帳票（1日2回連絡・月次訪問面談記録）
          </span>
          <Button size="sm" onClick={() => window.print()} className="text-xs gap-1 font-bold bg-primary text-primary-foreground">
            <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>A4横印刷 / PDF保存</span>
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 印刷CSS（A4横向き・改ページ崩れ防止） */}
      <style jsx global>{`
        @media print {
          @page {
            size: A4 landscape;
            margin: 6mm 8mm;
          }
          body {
            background: white !important;
            color: black !important;
            -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
            print-color-adjust: exact;
          }
          .telework-report-print {
            border: none !important;
            box-shadow: none !important;
            padding: 0 !important;
            width: 100% !important;
          }
          table {
            page-break-inside: auto;
          }
          tr {
            page-break-inside: avoid !important;
            break-inside: avoid !important;
          }
        }
      `}</style>

      {/* 帳票本体（A4横） */}
      <div className="telework-report-print bg-white text-black font-sans text-xs leading-normal border border-black p-4 space-y-2 shadow-sm print:shadow-none min-h-[195mm]">
        {/* 表題と印鑑欄 */}
        <div className="flex justify-between items-start border-b-2 border-black pb-1.5">
          <div className="flex-1 mr-4">
            <div className="inline-block border border-black px-1.5 py-0.5 text-[9px] font-bold">
              指定就労継続支援A型 実地指導原本確認帳票
            </div>
            <h1 className="text-base font-bold tracking-wider pt-0.5">
              就労継続支援A型 在宅就労（在宅利用支援）記録簿（{eraMonthStr}）
            </h1>
            <p className="text-[9px] text-gray-700">
              ※障害者の日常生活及び社会生活を総合的に支援するための法律に基づく在宅利用支援の1日2回連絡および訪問面談記録
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 shrink-0">
            <div className="text-[10px] text-right space-y-0.5">
              <div className="flex justify-end items-center gap-1">
                <span className="font-bold shrink-0">事業所名:</span>
                <div className="max-w-[200px]">
                  <AutoFitText text={`${facility.facility_name} (${facility.facility_number || '番号未設定'})`} maxFontSizePt={9} minFontSizePt={6.5} className="font-bold text-right" />
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-end items-center gap-1">
                <span className="font-bold shrink-0">サビ管:</span>
                <div className="max-w-[140px]">
                  <AutoFitText text={facility.service_manager_name || '記載なし'} maxFontSizePt={9} minFontSizePt={6.5} className="text-right" />
                </div>
              </div>
              <p><span className="font-bold">作成日:</span> {toJapaneseEra(new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 10))}</p>
            </div>

            {/* 印鑑枠 */}
            <table className="border-collapse border border-black text-center text-[9px]">
              <tbody>
                <tr>
                  <td className="border border-black px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-gray-100 font-bold w-12">管理者</td>
                  <td className="border border-black px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-gray-100 font-bold w-12">サビ管</td>
                  <td className="border border-black px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-gray-100 font-bold w-12">担当者</td>
                  <td className="border border-black px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-gray-100 font-bold w-12">本人確認</td>
                </tr>
                <tr className="h-9">
                  <td className="border border-black relative">
                    <span className="text-[8px] text-gray-300 absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none">印</span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="border border-black relative">
                    <span className="text-[8px] text-gray-300 absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none">印</span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="border border-black relative">
                    <span className="text-[8px] text-gray-300 absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none">印</span>
                  </td>
                  <td className="border border-black relative">
                    <span className="text-[8px] text-gray-300 absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none">印</span>

              <AutoFitText text={`${client.name} 様 (${client.name_kana || '-'})`} maxFontSizePt={10} minFontSizePt={7} className="font-bold" />
            </div>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="font-bold text-gray-700">受給者証番号: </span>
            <span className="font-mono">{client.recipient_number || '未登録'}</span>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="font-bold text-gray-700">生年月日: </span>
            <span>{client.date_of_birth ? toJapaneseEra(client.date_of_birth) : '未登録'}</span>
          </div>
          <div>
            <span className="font-bold text-gray-700">当月在宅日数: </span>
            <span className="font-bold text-primary">{records.length} 日</span>
            <span className="ml-2 font-bold text-gray-700">訪問面談: </span>
            <span className={`font-bold ${visitRecords.length > 0 ? 'text-green-700' : 'text-red-600'}`}>
              {visitRecords.length > 0 ? `${visitRecords.length}回 実施` : '未実施（要確認）'}

          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 1日2回連絡記録明細テーブル */}
        <table className="w-full border-collapse border border-black text-[9.5px]">

              <th className="border border-black p-0.5 w-16">連絡時刻・方法</th>

              <th className="border border-black p-0.5">本日の作業指示・目標</th>
              <th className="border border-black p-0.5 w-14">担当</th>

              <th className="border border-black p-0.5">作業実績・進捗成果</th>
              <th className="border border-black p-0.5 w-32">体調・指導助言事項</th>
              <th className="border border-black p-0.5 w-14">担当</th>

                    <AutoFitText text={rec.morning_staff_name || '支援員'} maxFontSizePt={9} minFontSizePt={6.5} className="text-center" />
                  </td>
                  <td className="border border-black p-1 text-center">
                    <div>{rec.evening_contact_time || '15:30'}</div>
                    <div className="text-[8px] text-gray-500">{rec.evening_contact_method === 'phone' ? '電話' : rec.evening_contact_method === 'video_call' ? 'ビデオ通話' : 'オンライン'}</div>
                  </td>
                  <td className="border border-black p-1 leading-tight">
                    {rec.evening_work_progress || '目標件数完了、報告受領'}
                  </td>
                  <td className="border border-black p-1 leading-tight">

                  </td>
                  <td className="border border-black p-1 text-center">
                    <AutoFitText text={rec.evening_staff_name || '支援員'} maxFontSizePt={9} minFontSizePt={6.5} className="text-center" />
                  </td>
                  <td className="border border-black p-1 text-center font-bold">
                    {rec.is_monthly_visit === 1 ? (
                      <span className="text-green-700 bg-green-50 px-1 py-0.5 rounded text-[8.5px] border border-green-300">

              ))

        {/* 月次居宅訪問・面談評価報告書（神戸市監査・実地指導の最重点項目） */}
        <div className="border border-black">
          <div className="bg-gray-100 border-b border-black px-2.5 py-1 font-bold flex justify-between items-center text-[10px]">
            <span>■ 月1回以上の居宅訪問面談・作業環境評価（必須要件）</span>
            <span className="text-[9px] text-gray-600 font-normal">
              ※神戸市指定基準: 少なくとも1月に1回は居宅を訪問して面談を行い、生活環境・作業環境・健康状態を直接確認すること

              </p>
            ) : (
              visitRecords.map((vr) => (
                <div key={vr.id} className="border-b border-gray-200 pb-1.5 last:border-b-0 space-y-1">
                  <div className="flex justify-between items-center font-semibold text-gray-900">
                    <span>
                      訪問日: {toJapaneseEra(vr.record_date)} ({vr.record_date})
                      {vr.visit_time_start && ` [${vr.visit_time_start} ～ ${vr.visit_time_end || ''}]`}
                    </span>
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1">
                      訪問場所: <strong>{vr.visit_location || '利用者居宅'}</strong> / 訪問職員: <strong>{vr.visit_staff_name || 'サービス管理責任者'}</strong>
                    </span>
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-gray-800 leading-relaxed whitespace-pre-wrap pl-2 border-l-2 border-primary/40">
                    {vr.visit_content || '生活状況、居室作業スペース、PCネットワーク環境、健康状態の安定性を確認。在宅就労の継続に支障がない旨を評価。'}
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 実地指導適合証跡および保存義務 */}
        <div className="border border-black p-2 bg-gray-50/40 text-[9px] text-gray-800 flex justify-between items-center">
          <div>
            【指定基準第193条適合】上記記録は、就労継続支援A型における在宅利用支援の要件である「1日2回の連絡体制（体調・作業進捗の把握・支援）」
            および「月1回以上の訪問等による生活・作業環境評価」を適切に履行した記録原本です。
          </div>
          <div className="font-bold text-gray-700 whitespace-nowrap ml-4">
            保存期間: 完結の日から5年間（実地指導必携）
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use server';

import { db, resolveServiceModeForTableRecord, sanitizeForeignKeyId } from "@/lib/db";
import { getRole, assertCanAccessClient } from "@/lib/auth";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import crypto from "crypto";

export async function saveTeleworkRecord(formData: FormData) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role) return { success: false, error: "認証されていません" };

    const rawId = (formData.get('id') as string)?.trim() || "";
    if (rawId) {
      resolveServiceModeForTableRecord("telework_support_records", rawId);
    }
    const id = rawId || crypto.randomUUID();
    const rawClientId = (formData.get('clientId') as string)?.trim() || "";
    const recordDate = formData.get('recordDate') as string;

    if (!rawClientId || !recordDate) {
      return { success: false, error: "利用者と記録日は必須です" };
    }
    await assertCanAccessClient(rawClientId);
    const clientId = sanitizeForeignKeyId("clients", rawClientId);
    if (!clientId) {
      return { success: false, error: "指定された利用者が見つかりません" };
    }

    const morningContactTime = (formData.get('morningContactTime') as string) || null;
    const morningContactMethod = (formData.get('morningContactMethod') as string) || 'phone';
    const morningHealthCondition = (formData.get('morningHealthCondition') as string) || null;
    const morningTaskInstructions = (formData.get('morningTaskInstructions') as string) || null;
    const morningStaffName = (formData.get('morningStaffName') as string) || null;

    const eveningContactTime = (formData.get('eveningContactTime') as string) || null;
    const eveningContactMethod = (formData.get('eveningContactMethod') as string) || 'phone';
    const eveningWorkProgress = (formData.get('eveningWorkProgress') as string) || null;
    const eveningHealthCondition = (formData.get('eveningHealthCondition') as string) || null;
    const eveningStaffComment = (formData.get('eveningStaffComment') as string) || null;
    const eveningStaffName = (formData.get('eveningStaffName') as string) || null;

    const isMonthlyVisit = formData.get('isMonthlyVisit') === 'on' || formData.get('isMonthlyVisit') === '1' ? 1 : 0;
    const visitLocation = (formData.get('visitLocation') as string) || null;
    const visitStaffName = (formData.get('visitStaffName') as string) || null;
    const visitTimeStart = (formData.get('visitTimeStart') as string) || null;
    const visitTimeEnd = (formData.get('visitTimeEnd') as string) || null;
    const visitContent = (formData.get('visitContent') as string) || null;

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO telework_support_records (
        id, client_id, record_date,
        morning_contact_time, morning_contact_method, morning_health_condition, morning_task_instructions, morning_staff_name,
        evening_contact_time, evening_contact_method, evening_work_progress, evening_health_condition, evening_staff_comment, evening_staff_name,
        is_monthly_visit, visit_location, visit_staff_name, visit_time_start, visit_time_end, visit_content,
        updated_at
      ) VALUES (
        ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?,
        CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      )
      ON CONFLICT(client_id, record_date) DO UPDATE SET
        morning_contact_time = excluded.morning_contact_time,
        morning_contact_method = excluded.morning_contact_method,
        morning_health_condition = excluded.morning_health_condition,
        morning_task_instructions = excluded.morning_task_instructions,
        morning_staff_name = excluded.morning_staff_name,
        evening_contact_time = excluded.evening_contact_time,
        evening_contact_method = excluded.evening_contact_method,
        evening_work_progress = excluded.evening_work_progress,
        evening_health_condition = excluded.evening_health_condition,
        evening_staff_comment = excluded.evening_staff_comment,
        evening_staff_name = excluded.evening_staff_name,
        is_monthly_visit = excluded.is_monthly_visit,
        visit_location = excluded.visit_location,
        visit_staff_name = excluded.visit_staff_name,
        visit_time_start = excluded.visit_time_start,
        visit_time_end = excluded.visit_time_end,
        visit_content = excluded.visit_content,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
    `).run(
      id, clientId, recordDate,
      morningContactTime, morningContactMethod, morningHealthCondition, morningTaskInstructions, morningStaffName,
      eveningContactTime, eveningContactMethod, eveningWorkProgress, eveningHealthCondition, eveningStaffComment, eveningStaffName,
      isMonthlyVisit, visitLocation, visitStaffName, visitTimeStart, visitTimeEnd, visitContent
    );

    try {
      revalidatePath('/records/telework');
    } catch (e) {}
    return { success: true, id };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('Failed to save telework support record:', error);
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "在宅就労支援記録の保存に失敗しました" };
  }
}

export async function deleteTeleworkRecord(id: string) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role) return { success: false, error: "認証されていません" };
    resolveServiceModeForTableRecord("telework_support_records", id);

    db.prepare(`UPDATE telework_support_records SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?`).run(id);
    try {
      revalidatePath('/records/telework');
    } catch (e) {}
    return { success: true };
  } catch (error: any) {
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "削除に失敗しました" };
  }
}

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { Header } from "@/components/Header";
import { SupportSubNav } from "@/components/NavigationTabs";
import { TeleworkClient } from "./TeleworkClient";

interface PageProps {
  searchParams: Promise<{
    clientId?: string;
    month?: string;
  }>;
}

export default async function TeleworkRecordsPage({ searchParams }: PageProps) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) redirect("/login");

  const resolvedParams = await searchParams;
  const currentMonthStr = new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 7);
  const targetMonth = resolvedParams.month || currentMonthStr;

  const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings LIMIT 1`).get() as any || {
    facility_name: "就労継続支援A型事業所",
    facility_number: "2810000000",
    corporate_name: "株式会社サンプル",
    postal_code: "650-0000",
    address: "兵庫県神戸市中央区",
    tel: "078-000-0000",
    service_manager_name: "サービス管理責任者",
  };

  const clients = db.prepare(`
    SELECT id, full_name as name, full_name, recipient_number, birthdate, disability_class
    FROM clients
    WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY full_name ASC
  `).all() as any[];

  if (clients.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background/50">
        <Header activePage="support" />
        <SupportSubNav />
        <main className="flex-1 p-6 md:p-12">
          <p className="text-muted-foreground text-center py-12">利用者が登録されていません。</p>
        </main>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const selectedClientId = resolvedParams.clientId || clients[0].id;
  const selectedClient = clients.find(c => c.id === selectedClientId) || clients[0];

  const startDay = `${targetMonth}-01`;
  const endDay = `${targetMonth}-31`;

  const records = db.prepare(`
    SELECT *
    FROM telework_support_records
    WHERE client_id = ? AND record_date >= ? AND record_date <= ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY record_date ASC
  `).all(selectedClient.id, startDay, endDay) as any[];

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background/50">
      <div className="print:hidden">
        <Header activePage="support" />
        <SupportSubNav />
      </div>

      <main className="flex-1 p-4 md:p-8 print:p-0">
        <TeleworkClient
          clients={clients}
          selectedClientId={selectedClient.id}
          targetMonth={targetMonth}
          facility={facility}
          records={records}
          client={selectedClient}
        />
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

'use server'

import { db, resolveServiceModeForTableRecord } from "@/lib/db"
import { randomUUID } from "crypto"
import { redirect } from "next/navigation"
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth"

export async function saveTrainingRecord(formData: FormData): Promise<void> {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) {
    redirect('/login');
  }

  try {
    const trainingType = (formData.get('training_type') as string)?.trim();
    const trainingDate = (formData.get('training_date') as string)?.trim();
    const title = (formData.get('title') as string)?.trim();

    if (!trainingType) {
      redirect('/records/training?error=' + encodeURIComponent('研修種別を選択してください。'));
    }
    if (!trainingDate) {
      redirect('/records/training?error=' + encodeURIComponent('研修日を入力してください。'));
    }
    if (!title) {
      redirect('/records/training?error=' + encodeURIComponent('研修名（タイトル）を入力してください。'));
    }

    const existingId = (formData.get('id') as string)?.trim() || '';
    if (existingId) {
      resolveServiceModeForTableRecord('training_records', existingId);
    }
    const isEdit = !!existingId;
    const id = existingId || randomUUID();

    if (isEdit) {
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE training_records SET
          training_type = ?, training_date = ?, title = ?, instructor = ?, location = ?,
          attendees = ?, duration_minutes = ?, content_summary = ?,
          updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE id = ?
      `).run(
        trainingType,
        trainingDate,
        title,
        formData.get('instructor') || null,
        formData.get('location') || null,
        formData.get('attendees') || null,
        parseInt(formData.get('duration_minutes') as string) || 0,
        formData.get('content_summary') || null,
        id
      );
    } else {
      const stmt = db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO training_records (
          id, training_type, training_date, title, instructor, location,
          attendees, duration_minutes, content_summary
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `);

      stmt.run(
        id,
        trainingType,
        trainingDate,
        title,
        formData.get('instructor') || null,
        formData.get('location') || null,
        formData.get('attendees') || null,
        parseInt(formData.get('duration_minutes') as string) || 0,
        formData.get('content_summary') || null
      );
    }
  } catch (error: any) {
    if (error?.digest?.startsWith('NEXT_REDIRECT')) throw error;
    console.error("Failed to save training record:", error);
    redirect('/records/training?error=' + encodeURIComponent('登録に失敗しました: ' + error.message));
  }
  redirect('/records/training?msg=' + encodeURIComponent('研修記録を保存しました'));
}

export async function deleteTrainingRecord(id: string): Promise<void> {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (role !== 'admin' && role !== 'service_manager') {
    redirect('/records/training?error=' + encodeURIComponent('削除には管理者権限が必要です'));
  }

  try {
    resolveServiceModeForTableRecord('training_records', id);
    db.prepare('UPDATE training_records SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?').run(id);
  } catch (error: any) {
    if (error?.digest?.startsWith('NEXT_REDIRECT')) throw error;
    console.error("Failed to delete training record:", error);
    redirect('/records/training?error=' + encodeURIComponent('削除に失敗しました'));
  }
  redirect('/records/training?msg=' + encodeURIComponent('研修記録を削除しました'));
}

'use client';

import { useState } from "react";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { AI_PROVIDER_PRESETS, type AiProvider, parseModelString } from "@/lib/ai/constants";
import { Sparkles, Key, CheckCircle, HelpCircle } from "lucide-react";

export function AiSettingsClient({ settings }: { settings: any }) {
  const initial = parseModelString(settings?.active_ai_model);

  const [provider, setProvider] = useState<AiProvider>(initial.provider);
  const [modelId, setModelId] = useState(initial.modelId);
  const [isCustomModel, setIsCustomModel] = useState(!AI_PROVIDER_PRESETS[initial.provider].models.some(m => m.id === initial.modelId));

  const [geminiKey, setGeminiKey] = useState(settings?.gemini_api_key || '');
  const [claudeKey, setClaudeKey] = useState(settings?.anthropic_api_key || '');
  const [openAiKey, setOpenAiKey] = useState(settings?.openai_api_key || '');

  const handleProviderChange = (newProvider: AiProvider) => {
    setProvider(newProvider);
    const defaultModel = AI_PROVIDER_PRESETS[newProvider].models.find(m => m.recommended) || AI_PROVIDER_PRESETS[newProvider].models[0];
    setModelId(defaultModel.id);
    setIsCustomModel(false);
  };

  const currentPresets = AI_PROVIDER_PRESETS[provider].models;
  const finalActiveAiModel = `${provider}:${modelId}`;

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8 max-w-3xl">
      {/* 1. アクティブAIモデル選択 */}
      <div className="p-6 bg-card rounded-xl border shadow-sm space-y-6">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b pb-4">
          <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-primary/10 text-primary">
            <Sparkles className="h-5 w-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">AIエンジン・使用モデル選択</h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              個別支援計画書の自動下書きや、法令・最低賃金・加算チェックに使用するAIモデルを選択します。
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
          <div className="space-y-3">
            <Label className="text-base font-semibold">AIプロバイダ（提供元）</Label>
            <select
              value={provider}
              onChange={(e) => handleProviderChange(e.target.value as AiProvider)}
              className="flex h-12 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-base ring-offset-background focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
            >
              <option value="google">Google (Gemini)</option>
              <option value="anthropic">Anthropic (Claude)</option>
              <option value="openai">OpenAI (GPT)</option>
            </select>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-3">
            <Label className="text-base font-semibold">プリセットモデル</Label>
            <select
              value={isCustomModel ? 'custom' : modelId}
              onChange={(e) => {
                if (e.target.value === 'custom') {
                  setIsCustomModel(true);
                } else {
                  setIsCustomModel(false);
                  setModelId(e.target.value);
                }
              }}
              className="flex h-12 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-base ring-offset-background focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring"
            >
              {currentPresets.map((m) => (
                <option key={m.id} value={m.id}>
                  {m.name} {m.recommended ? '（推奨）' : ''}
                </option>
              ))}
              <option value="custom">手動入力（カスタムモデルID）...</option>
            </select>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* 選択中モデルの説明またはカスタム入力 */}
        {isCustomModel ? (
          <div className="space-y-3 pt-2">
            <Label htmlFor="customModelInput" className="text-sm font-semibold">カスタムモデルIDを入力</Label>
            <Input
              id="customModelInput"
              type="text"
              className="h-11"
              value={modelId}
              onChange={(e) => setModelId(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="例: claude-3-5-sonnet-20241022, gpt-4o, gemini-1.5-pro"
            />
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              プロバイダの公式ドキュメントに記載されている正確なモデルIDを入力してください。
            </p>
          </div>
        ) : (
          <div className="p-4 rounded-lg bg-muted/30 text-sm text-muted-foreground flex items-start gap-2">
            <CheckCircle className="h-4 w-4 text-primary mt-0.5 shrink-0" />
            <div>
              <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">選択中: {currentPresets.find(m => m.id === modelId)?.name || modelId}</span>
              <p className="mt-0.5">{currentPresets.find(m => m.id === modelId)?.description}</p>
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        {/* サーバー送信用の隠し入力値 */}
        <input type="hidden" name="activeAiModel" value={finalActiveAiModel} />
      </div>

      {/* 2. APIキー管理（全プロバイダ個別設定） */}
      <div className="p-6 bg-card rounded-xl border shadow-sm space-y-6">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 border-b pb-4">
          <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-amber-500/10 text-amber-600">
            <Key className="h-5 w-5" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground">各社APIキー設定</h3>
            <p className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
              利用するプロバイダのAPIキーを設定してください。入力されたキーは暗号化され安全に保存されます。
            </p>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="space-y-6">
          {/* Google Gemini */}
          <div className="space-y-2 p-4 rounded-lg border bg-muted/10">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <Label htmlFor="geminiApiKey" className="text-base font-semibold flex items-center gap-2">
                Google Gemini APIキー
                {provider === 'google' && (
                  <span className="text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-primary/15 text-primary font-bold">現在使用中</span>
                )}
              </Label>
              <a
                href="https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikey"
                target="_blank"
                rel="noreferrer"
                className="text-xs text-primary hover:underline flex items-center gap-1"
              >
                キー取得 (Google AI Studio) ↗
              </a>
            </div>
            <Input
              id="geminiApiKey"
              name="geminiApiKey"
              type="password"
              className="h-12 font-mono"
              value={geminiKey}
              onChange={(e) => setGeminiKey(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="AIzaSy..."
            />
            <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
              ※GoogleのAPIキーは無料枠でも利用可能です。
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* Anthropic Claude */}
          <div className="space-y-2 p-4 rounded-lg border bg-muted/10">

              <Label htmlFor="anthropicApiKey" className="text-base font-semibold flex items-center gap-2">

              >
                キー取得 (Anthropic Console) ↗
              </a>
            </div>
            <Input
              id="anthropicApiKey"
              name="anthropicApiKey"
              type="password"
              className="h-12 font-mono"
              value={claudeKey}
              onChange={(e) => setClaudeKey(e.target.value)}
              placeholder="sk-ant-api..."
            />
          </div>

          {/* OpenAI */}
          <div className="space-y-2 p-4 rounded-lg border bg-muted/10">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <Label htmlFor="openaiApiKey" className="text-base font-semibold flex items-center gap-2">
                OpenAI (GPT) APIキー
                {provider === 'openai' && (
                  <span className="text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full bg-primary/15 text-primary font-bold">現在使用中</span>
                )}
              </Label>

"use client";

import { useFontSize } from "@/components/FontSizeProvider";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";

export function FontSizeSettingsClient() {
  const { fontSize, setFontSize } = useFontSize();

  return (
    <Card className="shadow-sm border-muted">
      <CardHeader className="bg-primary/5 border-b pb-4">
        <CardTitle className="text-xl">表示設定（文字サイズ）</CardTitle>
        <CardDescription>アプリ全体の文字サイズを調整できます。この設定はご利用のブラウザに保存されます。</CardDescription>
      </CardHeader>
      <CardContent className="pt-6">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4">
          <Button 
            type="button" 
            variant={fontSize === 'xsmall' ? 'default' : 'outline'} 
            onClick={() => setFontSize('xsmall')}
            className="h-14 px-8 text-xs"
          >
            最小
          </Button>
          <Button 
            type="button" 
            variant={fontSize === 'small' ? 'default' : 'outline'} 
            onClick={() => setFontSize('small')}
            className="h-14 px-8 text-sm"
          >
            小さい
          </Button>
          <Button 
            type="button" 
            variant={fontSize === 'normal' ? 'default' : 'outline'} 
            onClick={() => setFontSize('normal')}
            className="h-14 px-8 text-base"
          >
            標準サイズ
          </Button>
          <Button 
            type="button" 
            variant={fontSize === 'large' ? 'default' : 'outline'} 
            onClick={() => setFontSize('large')}
            className="h-14 px-8 text-lg"
          >
            少し大きめ
          </Button>
          <Button 
            type="button" 
            variant={fontSize === 'xlarge' ? 'default' : 'outline'} 
            onClick={() => setFontSize('xlarge')}
            className="h-14 px-8 text-xl"
          >
            さらに大きめ
          </Button>
        </div>
      </CardContent>
    </Card>
  );
}
