'use server';

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { getServiceMode } from "@/lib/serviceModeServer";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { z } from 'zod';

function maskApiKey(key: string | null | undefined): string | null {
  if (!key) return null;
  if (key.length <= 4) return '****';
  return '****' + key.slice(-4);
}

import { facilitySettingsSchema, getFirstZodErrorMessage } from "@/lib/validations";

export async function getFacilitySettings() {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (role !== 'admin') return null;

  const settings = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as Record<string, any> | undefined;
  if (settings) {
    if (settings.gemini_api_key) settings.gemini_api_key = maskApiKey(settings.gemini_api_key);
    if (settings.openai_api_key) settings.openai_api_key = maskApiKey(settings.openai_api_key);
    if (settings.anthropic_api_key) settings.anthropic_api_key = maskApiKey(settings.anthropic_api_key);
  }
  return settings;
}

export async function getRawApiKey(provider: string): Promise<string | null> {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (role !== 'admin') return null;

  const settings = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as Record<string, any> | undefined;
  if (!settings) return null;
  
  let key: string | null = null;
  if (provider === 'gemini') key = settings.gemini_api_key || null;
  if (provider === 'openai') key = settings.openai_api_key || null;
  if (provider === 'anthropic') key = settings.anthropic_api_key || null;
  return maskApiKey(key);
}

export async function updateFacilitySettings(formData: FormData) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (role !== 'admin') {
    redirect('/settings?error=' + encodeURIComponent('管理者権限が必要です'));
  }

  // M-6: Zodバリデーション
  const parseResult = facilitySettingsSchema.safeParse({
    facilityNumber: formData.get("facilityNumber"),
    corporationName: formData.get("corporationName"),
    facilityName: formData.get("facilityName"),
    postalCode: formData.get("postalCode") || '',
    address: formData.get("address") || '',
    phoneNumber: formData.get("phoneNumber") || '',
    prefCode: formData.get("prefCode") || '',
    cityCode: formData.get("cityCode") || '',
  });

  if (!parseResult.success) {
    const errorMsg = getFirstZodErrorMessage(parseResult.error);
    redirect('/settings?error=' + encodeURIComponent(errorMsg));
  }
  const validated = parseResult.data;

  let saveErrorMsg: string | null = null;
  try {
    const facility_number = validated.facilityNumber;
    const corporation_name = validated.corporationName;
    const facility_name = validated.facilityName;
    const postal_code = validated.postalCode;
    const address = validated.address;
    const phone_number = validated.phoneNumber;
    const pref_code = validated.prefCode;
    const city_code = validated.cityCode;
    const capacity_class = formData.get("capacityClass") as string;
    const staffing_class = formData.get("staffingClass") as string;
    const region_class = formData.get("regionClass") as string;
    const treatment_addition_class = formData.get("treatmentAdditionClass") as string;
    const active_ai_model = (formData.get("activeAiModel") as string)?.trim() || 'google:gemini-3.8-flash';
    let gemini_api_key = (formData.get("geminiApiKey") as string)?.trim() || null;
    let openai_api_key = (formData.get("openaiApiKey") as string)?.trim() || null;
    let anthropic_api_key = (formData.get("anthropicApiKey") as string)?.trim() || null;

    const currentSettings = db.prepare(`SELECT * FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as Record<string, any> | undefined;
    if (currentSettings) {
      if (gemini_api_key && gemini_api_key.startsWith('****')) gemini_api_key = currentSettings.gemini_api_key;
      if (openai_api_key && openai_api_key.startsWith('****')) openai_api_key = currentSettings.openai_api_key;
      if (anthropic_api_key && anthropic_api_key.startsWith('****')) anthropic_api_key = currentSettings.anthropic_api_key;
    }

    const has_bcp = formData.get("hasBcp") === "on" ? 1 : 0;
    const has_abuse_prevention = formData.get("hasAbusePrevention") === "on" ? 1 : 0;
    const has_restraint_reduction = formData.get("hasRestraintReduction") === "on" ? 1 : 0;
    const has_information_disclosure = formData.get("hasInformationDisclosure") === "on" ? 1 : 0;

    // Additions
    const welfare_specialist_addition = formData.get("welfareSpecialistAddition") as string || 'none';
    const wage_improvement_addition = formData.get("wageImprovementAddition") === "on" ? 1 : 0;
    const visual_auditory_addition = formData.get("visualAuditoryAddition") as string || 'none';
    const higher_brain_addition = formData.get("higherBrainAddition") === "on" ? 1 : 0;
    const severe_disability_addition = formData.get("severeDisabilityAddition") as string || 'none';
    const meal_provision_addition = formData.get("mealProvisionAddition") === "on" ? 1 : 0;
    const transportation_addition = formData.get("transportationAddition") as string || 'none';
    const visit_support_addition = formData.get("visitSupportAddition") === "on" ? 1 : 0;
    const show_quick_attendance_checker = formData.get("showQuickAttendanceChecker") === "on" ? 1 : 0;

    const serviceMode = await getServiceMode();
    const isTypeB = serviceMode === 'type_b';

    // B型の場合は最低賃金・労基法割増率・雇用保険は非適用（0）とし、工賃・B型加算を反映
    const employment_insurance_rate = isTypeB ? 0 : (parseFloat(formData.get("employmentInsuranceRate") as string) || 0.006);
    const regional_minimum_wage = isTypeB ? 0 : (parseInt(formData.get("regionalMinimumWage") as string) || 0);

    const business_start_time = (formData.get("businessStartTime") as string) || '09:00';
    const business_end_time = (formData.get("businessEndTime") as string) || '18:00';
    const service_start_time = (formData.get("serviceStartTime") as string) || '09:30';
    const service_end_time = (formData.get("serviceEndTime") as string) || '15:30';
    const regular_hours_per_week = parseFloat(formData.get("regularHoursPerWeek") as string) || 40;

    const has_capacity_reduction = formData.get("hasCapacityReduction") === "on" ? 1 : 0;
    const has_staffing_reduction = formData.get("hasStaffingReduction") === "on" ? 1 : 0;
    const overtime_rate = isTypeB ? 0 : (parseFloat(formData.get("overtimeRate") as string) || 0.25);
    const overtime_over60_rate = isTypeB ? 0 : (parseFloat(formData.get("overtimeOver60Rate") as string) || 0.50);
    const night_rate = isTypeB ? 0 : (parseFloat(formData.get("nightRate") as string) || 0.25);
    const holiday_rate = isTypeB ? 0 : (parseFloat(formData.get("holidayRate") as string) || 0.35);
    const legal_holiday = isTypeB ? '0' : ((formData.get("legalHoliday") as string) || '0');
    const monitoring_interval_months = parseInt(formData.get("monitoringIntervalMonths") as string, 10) || 6;
    const alert_days_certificate = parseInt(formData.get("alertDaysCertificate") as string, 10) || 60;
    const alert_days_plan = parseInt(formData.get("alertDaysPlan") as string, 10) || 30;

    // B型専用目標工賃および加算
    const target_wage_monthly_target = isTypeB 
      ? (parseInt(formData.get("targetWageMonthlyTarget") as string, 10) || 20000)
      : (parseInt(formData.get("targetWageMonthlyTarget") as string, 10) || 0);
    const target_wage_instructor_addition = isTypeB ? (formData.get("targetWageInstructorAddition") === "on" ? 1 : 0) : 0;
    const target_wage_achievement_addition = isTypeB ? (formData.get("targetWageAchievementAddition") === "on" ? 1 : 0) : 0;
    const community_cooperation_addition = isTypeB ? (formData.get("communityCooperationAddition") === "on" ? 1 : 0) : 0;

    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE facility_settings SET
        facility_number = ?,
        corporation_name = ?,
        facility_name = ?,
        postal_code = ?,
        address = ?,
        phone_number = ?,
        pref_code = ?,
        city_code = ?,
        capacity_class = ?,
        staffing_class = ?,
        region_class = ?,
        treatment_addition_class = ?,
        active_ai_model = ?,
        gemini_api_key = ?,
        openai_api_key = ?,
        anthropic_api_key = ?,
        employment_insurance_rate = ?,
        regional_minimum_wage = ?,
        business_start_time = ?,
        business_end_time = ?,
        service_start_time = ?,
        service_end_time = ?,
        regular_hours_per_week = ?,
        overtime_rate = ?,
        overtime_over60_rate = ?,
        night_rate = ?,
        holiday_rate = ?,
        legal_holiday = ?,
        monitoring_interval_months = ?,
        alert_days_certificate = ?,
        alert_days_plan = ?,
        has_capacity_reduction = ?,
        has_staffing_reduction = ?,
        has_bcp = ?,
        has_abuse_prevention = ?,
        has_restraint_reduction = ?,
        has_information_disclosure = ?,
        welfare_specialist_addition = ?,
        wage_improvement_addition = ?,
        visual_auditory_addition = ?,
        higher_brain_addition = ?,
        severe_disability_addition = ?,
        meal_provision_addition = ?,
        transportation_addition = ?,
        visit_support_addition = ?,
        show_quick_attendance_checker = ?,
        target_wage_monthly_target = ?,
        target_wage_instructor_addition = ?,
        target_wage_achievement_addition = ?,
        community_cooperation_addition = ?,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      WHERE id = 'default'
    `).run(
      facility_number,
      corporation_name,
      facility_name,
      postal_code,
      address,
      phone_number,
      pref_code,
      city_code,
      capacity_class,
      staffing_class,
      region_class,
      treatment_addition_class,
      active_ai_model,
      gemini_api_key,
      openai_api_key,
      anthropic_api_key,
      employment_insurance_rate,
      regional_minimum_wage,
      business_start_time,
      business_end_time,
      service_start_time,
      service_end_time,
      regular_hours_per_week,
      overtime_rate,
      overtime_over60_rate,
      night_rate,
      holiday_rate,
      legal_holiday,
      monitoring_interval_months,
      alert_days_certificate,
      alert_days_plan,
      has_capacity_reduction,
      has_staffing_reduction,
      has_bcp,
      has_abuse_prevention,
      has_restraint_reduction,
      has_information_disclosure,
      welfare_specialist_addition,
      isTypeB ? 0 : wage_improvement_addition,
      visual_auditory_addition,
      higher_brain_addition,
      severe_disability_addition,
      meal_provision_addition,
      transportation_addition,
      visit_support_addition,
      show_quick_attendance_checker,
      target_wage_monthly_target,
      target_wage_instructor_addition,
      target_wage_achievement_addition,
      community_cooperation_addition
    );

    try {
      const { logAudit } = await import('@/lib/audit');
      await logAudit({
        action: 'update',
        targetTable: 'facility_settings',
        targetId: 'default',
        details: { facility_number, corporation_name, facility_name, region_class }
      });
    } catch (e) {}

    revalidatePath('/settings');
    revalidatePath('/attendance');
    revalidatePath('/billing/kokuho');
    revalidatePath('/');
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.error("Failed to update facility settings:", e);
    saveErrorMsg = e.message || 'システム設定の保存に失敗しました';
  }

  if (saveErrorMsg) {
    redirect('/settings?error=' + encodeURIComponent(saveErrorMsg));
  }
  redirect('/settings?success=true&msg=' + encodeURIComponent('システム設定を保存しました'));
}

import { 
  ServiceTypeKey, 
  getAdditionMasterForService, 
  saveFacilityAdditions,
  getFacilityAdditions
} from '@/lib/compliance/facilityAdditionsManager';

export interface SaveAdditionsResult {
  success: boolean;
  message?: string;
  error?: string;
}

/**
 * サービス別 加算・減算体制届出設定の保存 Server Action
 */
export async function saveFacilityAdditionsAction(
  serviceType: ServiceTypeKey,
  formData: FormData
): Promise<SaveAdditionsResult> {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (role !== 'admin' && role !== 'service_manager') {
    return { success: false, error: '管理者またはサービス管理責任者の権限が必要です。' };
  }

  try {
    const master = getAdditionMasterForService(serviceType);
    const updates: Record<string, { isEnabled: boolean; value?: string; notes?: string }> = {};

    for (const item of master) {
      const isEnabledValue = formData.get(`enabled_${item.key}`);
      const isEnabled = isEnabledValue === '1' || isEnabledValue === 'true' || isEnabledValue === 'on';

      let selectedValue = '';
      if (item.type === 'select') {
        const val = formData.get(`value_${item.key}`);
        selectedValue = val ? String(val) : (item.defaultValue || '');
      } else {
        selectedValue = isEnabled ? (item.defaultValue || 'enabled') : 'none';
      }

      const notes = formData.get(`notes_${item.key}`);

      updates[item.key] = {
        isEnabled,
        value: selectedValue,
        notes: notes ? String(notes) : undefined,
      };
    }

    saveFacilityAdditions(serviceType, updates);

    // 関連パスをキャッシュ破棄
    if (serviceType === 'type_a' || serviceType === 'type_b') {
      revalidatePath('/settings');
      revalidatePath('/attendance');
      revalidatePath('/billing/kokuho');
      revalidatePath('/billing/provision-records');
      revalidatePath('/billing/payroll');
      revalidatePath('/');
    } else if (serviceType === 'gh') {
      revalidatePath('/gh/settings');
      revalidatePath('/gh/residents/provision-records');
      revalidatePath('/gh/billing');
      revalidatePath('/gh/dashboard');
    } else if (serviceType === 'houday') {
      revalidatePath('/houday/settings');
      revalidatePath('/houday/attendance/provision-records');
      revalidatePath('/houday/billing');
      revalidatePath('/houday/dashboard');
    }

    return { 
      success: true, 
      message: '加算・減算の体制届出設定を正常に更新しました。日常記録画面および国保連CSV出力に即時反映されます。' 
    };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error('saveFacilityAdditionsAction error:', error);
    return { 
      success: false, 
      error: error.message || '加算・減算設定の保存中にエラーが発生しました。' 
    };
  }
}

      if (res && !res.success) {

'use server';

import { db, resolveServiceModeForTableRecord } from "@/lib/db";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from "uuid";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";

export async function saveLaborAgreement(formData: FormData) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (role !== 'admin') return { success: false, error: '管理者権限が必要です' };

    const rawId = formData.get('id') as string;
    const id = rawId || uuidv4();
    if (rawId) {
      await resolveServiceModeForTableRecord('labor_agreements', rawId);
    }
    const agreementType = (formData.get('agreementType') as string) || 'article24_deduction';
    const title = formData.get('title') as string;
    const concludedDate = formData.get('concludedDate') as string;
    const validFrom = formData.get('validFrom') as string;
    const validTo = formData.get('validTo') as string;
    const representativeName = (formData.get('representativeName') as string) || '';
    const representativeSelectionMethod = (formData.get('representativeSelectionMethod') as string) || '';
    const rawItems = (formData.get('deductionItems') as string) || '';
    const notes = (formData.get('notes') as string) || '';

    if (!title || !concludedDate || !validFrom || !validTo) {
      return { success: false, error: '協定名、締結日、有効期間は必須です' };
    }

    // 控除項目を配列JSONとして保存
    const deductionItems = JSON.stringify(
      rawItems.split(/[,、\n\r]+/).map(s => s.trim()).filter(s => s.length > 0)
    );

    const existing = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM labor_agreements WHERE id = ?').get(id);
    if (existing) {
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE labor_agreements SET
          agreement_type = ?, title = ?, concluded_date = ?, valid_from = ?,
          valid_to = ?, representative_name = ?, representative_selection_method = ?,
          deduction_items = ?, notes = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        WHERE id = ?
      `).run(
        agreementType, title, concludedDate, validFrom, validTo,
        representativeName, representativeSelectionMethod, deductionItems,
        notes, id
      );
    } else {
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO labor_agreements (
          id, agreement_type, title, concluded_date, valid_from,
          valid_to, representative_name, representative_selection_method,
          deduction_items, notes
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
      `).run(
        id, agreementType, title, concludedDate, validFrom, validTo,
        representativeName, representativeSelectionMethod, deductionItems,
        notes
      );
    }

    revalidatePath('/settings/agreements');
    revalidatePath('/billing/payroll');
    return { success: true, id };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Failed to save labor agreement:", error);
    return { success: false, error: error.message || '労使協定の保存に失敗しました' };
  }
}

export async function getLaborAgreements(type?: string) {
  try {
    let query = 'SELECT * FROM labor_agreements WHERE deleted_at IS NULL';
    const params: any[] = [];
    if (type) {
      query += ' AND agreement_type = ?';
      params.push(type);
    }
    query += ' ORDER BY valid_to DESC, concluded_date DESC';
    return db.prepare(query).all(...params) as any[];
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Failed to get labor agreements:", error);
    return [];
  }
}

export async function deleteLaborAgreement(id: string) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (role !== 'admin') return { success: false, error: '管理者権限が必要です' };

    await resolveServiceModeForTableRecord('labor_agreements', id);
    db.prepare('UPDATE labor_agreements SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?').run(id);
    revalidatePath('/settings/agreements');
    revalidatePath('/billing/payroll');
    return { success: true };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Failed to delete labor agreement:", error);
    return { success: false, error: error.message || '労使協定の削除に失敗しました' };
  }
}

      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

  const [activeTab, setActiveTab] = useState<'download' | 'cloud' | 'restore' | 'logs'>('download');

  // 手動ダウンロード用
  const [downloadPassphrase, setDownloadPassphrase] = useState('');
  const [downloadPassphraseConfirm, setDownloadPassphraseConfirm] = useState('');
  const [showDownloadPassphrase, setShowDownloadPassphrase] = useState(false);
  const [isDownloading, setIsDownloading] = useState(false);

  // クラウド同期用
  const [cloudProvider, setCloudProvider] = useState<'none' | 'google_drive_folder' | 's3'>(
    data?.settings?.cloud_provider || 'none'
  );
  const [localSyncPath, setLocalSyncPath] = useState(data?.settings?.local_sync_path || '');
  const [s3Endpoint, setS3Endpoint] = useState(data?.settings?.s3_endpoint || '');
  const [s3Bucket, setS3Bucket] = useState(data?.settings?.s3_bucket || '');
  const [s3Region, setS3Region] = useState(data?.settings?.s3_region || 'auto');
  const [s3AccessKeyId, setS3AccessKeyId] = useState(data?.settings?.s3_access_key_id || '');
  const [s3SecretAccessKey, setS3SecretAccessKey] = useState(data?.settings?.s3_secret_access_key || '');
  const [autoSyncEnabled, setAutoSyncEnabled] = useState(data?.settings?.auto_sync_enabled === 1);
  const [autoSyncInterval, setAutoSyncInterval] = useState(data?.settings?.auto_sync_interval_hours || 24);

  const [cloudSyncPassphrase, setCloudSyncPassphrase] = useState('');
  const [isSavingSettings, setIsSavingSettings] = useState(false);
  const [isTestingConnection, setIsTestingConnection] = useState(false);
  const [isSyncingCloud, setIsSyncingCloud] = useState(false);

  // リストア（インポート）用
  const [restoreFile, setRestoreFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
  const [restorePassphrase, setRestorePassphrase] = useState('');
  const [showRestorePassphrase, setShowRestorePassphrase] = useState(false);
  const [isRestoring, setIsRestoring] = useState(false);
  const [restoreSuccessResult, setRestoreSuccessResult] = useState<any>(null);

  // メッセージ・通知
  const [statusMessage, setStatusMessage] = useState<{ type: 'success' | 'error' | 'info'; text: string } | null>(null);

  // データ再読み込み
  const refreshData = async () => {
    try {
      const refreshed = await getBackupInfoAction();
      setData(refreshed);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error(e);
    }
  };

  // 手動ダウンロード実行
  const handleDownload = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setStatusMessage(null);

    if (downloadPassphrase.length < 8) {
      setStatusMessage({ type: 'error', text: '暗号化パスフレーズは8文字以上で入力してください。' });
      return;
    }

    if (downloadPassphrase !== downloadPassphraseConfirm) {
      setStatusMessage({ type: 'error', text: 'パスフレーズ（確認用）が一致しません。' });
      return;
    }

    setIsDownloading(true);
    try {
      const res = await fetch('/api/backup/download', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
        body: JSON.stringify({ passphrase: downloadPassphrase }),
      });

      if (!res.ok) {
        const errorData = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));
        throw new Error(errorData.error || 'ダウンロードに失敗しました。');
      }

      // ファイル名をContent-Dispositionから取得
      const disposition = res.headers.get('Content-Disposition');
      let fileName = 'welfare_database_backup.enc';
      if (disposition && disposition.includes('filename=')) {
        const match = disposition.match(/filename="?([^"]+)"?/);
        if (match && match[1]) fileName = match[1];
      }

      const blob = await res.blob();
      const url = window.URL.createObjectURL(blob);
      const a = document.createElement('a');
      a.href = url;
      a.download = fileName;
      document.body.appendChild(a);
      a.click();
      a.remove();
      window.URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

      setStatusMessage({
        type: 'success',
        text: `暗号化バックアップファイル「${fileName}」のダウンロードが完了しました。USBメモリや安全な外部保管場所に保存してください。`,
      });

      setDownloadPassphrase('');
      setDownloadPassphraseConfirm('');
      await refreshData();
    } catch (err: any) {
      setStatusMessage({ type: 'error', text: err.message || 'ダウンロード中にエラーが発生しました。' });
    } finally {
      setIsDownloading(false);
    }
  };

  // クラウド接続テスト
  const handleTestConnection = async () => {
    setStatusMessage(null);
    setIsTestingConnection(true);
    try {
      const res = await testCloudConnectionAction({
        cloud_provider: cloudProvider,
        local_sync_path: localSyncPath,
        s3_endpoint: s3Endpoint,
        s3_bucket: s3Bucket,
        s3_region: s3Region,
        s3_access_key_id: s3AccessKeyId,
        s3_secret_access_key: s3SecretAccessKey,
      });

      if (res.success) {
        setStatusMessage({ type: 'success', text: res.message });
      } else {
        setStatusMessage({ type: 'error', text: res.message });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setStatusMessage({ type: 'error', text: err.message || '接続テストに失敗しました。' });
    } finally {
      setIsTestingConnection(false);
    }
  };

  // クラウド設定保存
  const handleSaveSettings = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setStatusMessage(null);
    setIsSavingSettings(true);
    try {
      const res = await saveBackupSettingsAction({
        cloud_provider: cloudProvider,
        local_sync_path: localSyncPath,
        s3_endpoint: s3Endpoint,
        s3_bucket: s3Bucket,
        s3_region: s3Region,
        s3_access_key_id: s3AccessKeyId,
        s3_secret_access_key: s3SecretAccessKey,
        auto_sync_enabled: autoSyncEnabled,
        auto_sync_interval_hours: autoSyncInterval,
      });

      if (res.success) {
        setStatusMessage({ type: 'success', text: res.message });
        await refreshData();
      } else {
        setStatusMessage({ type: 'error', text: res.message });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setStatusMessage({ type: 'error', text: err.message || '設定の保存に失敗しました。' });
    } finally {
      setIsSavingSettings(false);
    }
  };

  // 今すぐクラウド同期実行
  const handleTriggerCloudSync = async () => {
    setStatusMessage(null);
    if (cloudSyncPassphrase.length < 8) {
      setStatusMessage({ type: 'error', text: '暗号化用パスフレーズ（8文字以上）を入力してください。' });
      return;
    }

    setIsSyncingCloud(true);
    try {
      const res = await triggerManualCloudSyncAction(cloudSyncPassphrase);
      if (res.success) {
        setStatusMessage({ type: 'success', text: res.message });
        setCloudSyncPassphrase('');
        await refreshData();
      } else {
        setStatusMessage({ type: 'error', text: res.message });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setStatusMessage({ type: 'error', text: err.message || '同期中にエラーが発生しました。' });
    } finally {
      setIsSyncingCloud(false);
    }
  };

  // リストア（復元）実行
  const handleRestore = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    setStatusMessage(null);

    if (!restoreFile) {
      setStatusMessage({ type: 'error', text: '暗号化バックアップファイル（.enc）を選択してください。' });
      return;
    }

    if (!restorePassphrase) {
      setStatusMessage({ type: 'error', text: '復号用のパスフレーズを入力してください。' });
      return;
    }

    const confirmResult = window.confirm(
      '【重要・確認】\nバックアップデータから復元を実行します。\n現在のデータベースは自動的にロールバック用ファイルとして退避されますが、復元を実行してよろしいですか？'
    );
    if (!confirmResult) return;

    setIsRestoring(true);
    try {
      const formData = new FormData();
      formData.append('file', restoreFile);
      formData.append('passphrase', restorePassphrase);

      const res = await restoreDatabaseAction(formData);

      if (res.success) {
        setRestoreSuccessResult(res);
        setStatusMessage({ type: 'success', text: res.message });
        setRestorePassphrase('');
        setRestoreFile(null);
        await refreshData();
      } else {
        setStatusMessage({ type: 'error', text: res.message });
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      setStatusMessage({ type: 'error', text: err.message || '復元処理に失敗しました。' });
    } finally {
      setIsRestoring(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      {/* データベースステータス ＆ セキュリティカード */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
        <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm flex items-center space-x-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-blue-50 text-blue-600 rounded-lg">
            <Server className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-medium">DBサイズ / 更新日時</div>
            <div className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-800">{data.dbSizeFormatted}</div>
            <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 truncate">{data.dbLastModified}</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm flex items-center space-x-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-600 rounded-lg">
            <Database className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-medium">登録データ件数</div>
            <div className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-800">{data.clientCount} <span className="text-xs font-normal text-gray-500">名</span></div>
            <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-400">支援記録 {data.recordCount}件 / 請求 {data.billingCount}件</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm flex items-center space-x-3">
          <div className="p-3 bg-indigo-50 text-indigo-600 rounded-lg">
            <ShieldCheck className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div>
            <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-medium">暗号化セキュリティ</div>
            <div className="text-sm font-bold text-indigo-700">AES-256-GCM</div>
            <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-500">PBKDF2 10万回 / 改ざん検知</div>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="bg-white p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm flex items-center space-x-3">
          <div className={`p-3 rounded-lg ${
            data?.settings?.last_sync_status === 'success'
              ? 'bg-green-50 text-green-600'
              : data?.settings?.last_sync_status === 'failed'
              ? 'bg-red-50 text-red-600'
              : 'bg-gray-100 text-gray-500'
          }`}>
            <Cloud className="w-6 h-6" />
          </div>
          <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
            <div className="text-xs text-gray-500 font-medium">クラウド同期状態</div>
            <div className="text-sm font-semibold truncate">
              {data?.settings?.last_sync_status === 'success' && <span className="text-green-600">正常同期完了</span>}
              {data?.settings?.last_sync_status === 'failed' && <span className="text-red-600">同期エラー</span>}
              {!data?.settings?.last_sync_status && <span className="text-gray-400">未実行</span>}
            </div>
            <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 truncate">
              {data?.settings?.last_sync_at ? data.settings.last_sync_at : '同期履歴なし'}
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* メッセージアラート */}
      {statusMessage && (
        <div
          className={`p-4 rounded-xl flex items-start gap-3 border ${
            statusMessage.type === 'success'
              ? 'bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-200 text-emerald-800'
              : statusMessage.type === 'error'
              ? 'bg-rose-50 border-rose-200 text-rose-800'
              : 'bg-blue-50 border-blue-200 text-blue-800'
          }`}
        >
          {statusMessage.type === 'success' && <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 shrink-0 text-emerald-600 mt-0.5" />}
          {statusMessage.type === 'error' && <AlertCircle className="w-5 h-5 shrink-0 text-rose-600 mt-0.5" />}
          {statusMessage.type === 'info' && <Info className="w-5 h-5 shrink-0 text-blue-600 mt-0.5" />}
          <div className="text-sm font-medium">{statusMessage.text}</div>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* タブナビゲーション */}
      <div className="flex border-b border-gray-200 space-x-1 sm:space-x-4 bg-gray-50 p-1 rounded-xl">
        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('download')}
          className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-all ${
            activeTab === 'download'
              ? 'bg-white text-indigo-600 shadow-sm'
              : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100'
          }`}
        >
          <HardDriveDownload className="w-4 h-4" />
          手動バックアップ（暗号化ダウンロード）
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('cloud')}
          className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-all ${
            activeTab === 'cloud'
              ? 'bg-white text-indigo-600 shadow-sm'
              : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100'
          }`}
        >
          <CloudUpload className="w-4 h-4" />
          クラウド自動・即時同期
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('restore')}
          className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-all ${
            activeTab === 'restore'
              ? 'bg-white text-rose-600 shadow-sm'
              : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100'
          }`}
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-4 h-4" />
          データ復元（インポート）
        </button>

        <button
          onClick={() => setActiveTab('logs')}
          className={`flex items-center gap-2 px-4 py-2.5 rounded-lg text-sm font-medium transition-all ${
            activeTab === 'logs'
              ? 'bg-white text-indigo-600 shadow-sm'
              : 'text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 hover:bg-gray-100'
          }`}
        >
          <History className="w-4 h-4" />
          実行履歴ログ
        </button>
      </div>

      {/* タブ 1: 手動ダウンロード */}
      {activeTab === 'download' && (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm p-6 space-y-6">
          <div className="border-b border-gray-100 pb-4">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 flex items-center gap-2">
              <HardDriveDownload className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-600" />
              ワンクリック暗号化バックアップのダウンロード
            </h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
              現在のデータベースを即座に暗号化し、ローカルPCや外付けUSBメモリに保存するための単一ファイル（.enc）としてダウンロードします。
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="bg-indigo-50 border border-indigo-100 rounded-xl p-4 text-sm text-indigo-900 space-y-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-semibold text-indigo-800">
              <Lock className="w-4 h-4" />
              高セキュリティ暗号化（AES-256-GCM）仕様について
            </div>
            <p className="text-xs text-indigo-700 leading-relaxed">
              利用者様の受給者証番号、障害支援区分、マイナンバー、給与口座などの機密個人情報を守るため、バックアップファイルは強力に暗号化されます。パスフレーズを紛失すると復元できなくなりますので、安全な管理台帳に控えておいてください。
            </p>
          </div>

          <form onSubmit={handleDownload} className="max-w-xl space-y-4">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">
                暗号化パスフレーズ（8文字以上） <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </label>
              <div className="relative">
                <input
                  type={showDownloadPassphrase ? 'text' : 'password'}
                  value={downloadPassphrase}
                  onChange={(e) => setDownloadPassphrase(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="例: パスフレーズを入力"
                  required
                  minLength={8}
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 pr-10 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 text-sm"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowDownloadPassphrase(!showDownloadPassphrase)}
                  className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 pr-3 flex items-center text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600"
                >
                  {showDownloadPassphrase ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">
                パスフレーズ（確認用） <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </label>
              <input
                type={showDownloadPassphrase ? 'text' : 'password'}
                value={downloadPassphraseConfirm}
                onChange={(e) => setDownloadPassphraseConfirm(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="同じパスフレーズを再入力"
                required
                minLength={8}
                className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-indigo-500 focus:border-indigo-500 text-sm"
              />
            </div>

            <div className="pt-2">
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isDownloading || !downloadPassphrase}
                className="w-full sm:w-auto px-6 py-2.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white font-medium rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:shadow transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                {isDownloading ? (
                  <>
                    <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                    暗号化バックアップ生成中...
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <HardDriveDownload className="w-4 h-4" />
                    暗号化バックアップファイル（.enc）をダウンロード
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* タブ 2: クラウド自動・即時同期 */}
      {activeTab === 'cloud' && (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm p-6 space-y-6">
          <div className="border-b border-gray-100 pb-4">
            <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 flex items-center gap-2">
              <CloudUpload className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-600" />
              クラウド自動・即時同期バックアップ
            </h2>
            <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
              Google Drive / OneDrive の同期フォルダ、または S3互換クラウドストレージ（AWS S3、Cloudflare R2等）に暗号化ファイルを自動転送します。
            </p>
          </div>

          {/* 今すぐ同期セクション */}
          <div className="bg-gray-50 border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-5 space-y-3">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                  <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 text-indigo-600" />
                  今すぐクラウドへバックアップ同期
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 mt-0.5">
                  現在のクラウド設定先に、最新の暗号化バックアップを直ちにアップロードします。
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row gap-3 pt-1">
              <input
                type="password"
                value={cloudSyncPassphrase}
                onChange={(e) => setCloudSyncPassphrase(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="暗号化パスフレーズ（8文字以上）"
                className="flex-1 px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm bg-white"
              />
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={handleTriggerCloudSync}
                disabled={isSyncingCloud || !cloudSyncPassphrase || cloudProvider === 'none'}
                className="px-5 py-2 bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white text-sm font-medium rounded-lg shadow-sm transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2 disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                {isSyncingCloud ? (
                  <>
                    <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                    同期中...
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <CloudUpload className="w-4 h-4" />
                    今すぐクラウド同期を実行
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
            {cloudProvider === 'none' && (
              <p className="text-xs text-amber-600 flex items-center gap-1">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> 下記のクラウド連携設定を行ってから実行してください。
              </p>
            )}
          </div>

          {/* クラウド設定フォーム */}
          <form onSubmit={handleSaveSettings} className="space-y-5">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-2">
                連携クラウドプロバイダーの選択
              </label>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                <label
                  className={`p-3.5 border rounded-xl flex items-center gap-3 cursor-pointer transition ${
                    cloudProvider === 'google_drive_folder'
                      ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50/50 text-indigo-900 ring-2 ring-indigo-500/20'
                      : 'border-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-50 text-gray-700'
                  }`}
                >
                  <input
                    type="radio"
                    name="cloud_provider"
                    value="google_drive_folder"
                    checked={cloudProvider === 'google_drive_folder'}
                    onChange={() => setCloudProvider('google_drive_folder')}
                    className="text-indigo-600 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                  />
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-sm font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <FolderSync className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
                      Google Drive / OneDrive
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 mt-0.5">PC内同期フォルダ指定（最も簡単）</div>
                  </div>
                </label>

                <label
                  className={`p-3.5 border rounded-xl flex items-center gap-3 cursor-pointer transition ${
                    cloudProvider === 's3'
                      ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50/50 text-indigo-900 ring-2 ring-indigo-500/20'
                      : 'border-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-50 text-gray-700'
                  }`}
                >
                  <input
                    type="radio"
                    name="cloud_provider"
                    value="s3"
                    checked={cloudProvider === 's3'}
                    onChange={() => setCloudProvider('s3')}
                    className="text-indigo-600 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                  />
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-sm font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <Cloud className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                      S3互換ストレージ
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-500 mt-0.5">AWS S3 / Cloudflare R2 / Wasabi</div>
                  </div>
                </label>

                <label
                  className={`p-3.5 border rounded-xl flex items-center gap-3 cursor-pointer transition ${
                    cloudProvider === 'none'
                      ? 'border-indigo-600 bg-indigo-50/50 text-indigo-900 ring-2 ring-indigo-500/20'
                      : 'border-gray-200 hover:bg-gray-50 text-gray-700'
                  }`}
                >
                  <input
                    type="radio"
                    name="cloud_provider"
                    value="none"
                    checked={cloudProvider === 'none'}
                    onChange={() => setCloudProvider('none')}
                    className="text-indigo-600 focus:ring-indigo-500"
                  />
                  <div>
                    <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-700">利用しない</div>
                    <div className="text-[11px] text-gray-400 mt-0.5">手動ダウンロードのみ運用</div>
                  </div>
                </label>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Google Drive / OneDrive フォルダ設定 */}
            {cloudProvider === 'google_drive_folder' && (
              <div className="bg-gray-50 p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 space-y-3">
                <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-800 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <FolderSync className="w-4 h-4 text-blue-600" />
                  同期先フォルダの指定
                </h4>
                <p className="text-xs text-gray-500 leading-relaxed">
                  PCにインストールされている「Google ドライブ」や「OneDrive」の同期フォルダパスを指定してください。バックアップ生成時に暗号化ファイルがこのフォルダに出力され、クラウドへ自動同期されます（ディスク圧迫を防ぐため最新30世代を保持し古いファイルは自動クリーンアップされます）。
                </p>
                <div>
                  <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-1">
                    フォルダパス（フルパス）
                  </label>
                  <input
                    type="text"
                    value={localSyncPath}
                    onChange={(e) => setLocalSyncPath(e.target.value)}
                    placeholder="例: G:\マイドライブ\福祉バックアップ または C:\Users\ユーザー名\OneDrive\WelfareBackup"
                    className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm bg-white"
                  />
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* S3互換設定 */}
            {cloudProvider === 's3' && (
              <div className="bg-gray-50 p-4 rounded-xl border border-gray-200 space-y-3">
                <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-gray-800 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <Cloud className="w-4 h-4 text-emerald-600" />
                  S3互換ストレージ接続情報
                </h4>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3">
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-1">
                      エンドポイントURL
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={s3Endpoint}
                      onChange={(e) => setS3Endpoint(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="例: https://<account>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com"
                      className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm bg-white"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-1">
                      バケット名
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={s3Bucket}
                      onChange={(e) => setS3Bucket(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="例: welfare-backup-bucket"
                      className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm bg-white"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-1">
                      アクセスキーID (Access Key ID)
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="text"
                      value={s3AccessKeyId}
                      onChange={(e) => setS3AccessKeyId(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="AKIA..."
                      className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm bg-white font-mono"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <label className="block text-xs font-semibold text-gray-700 mb-1">
                      シークレットアクセスキー (Secret Access Key)
                    </label>
                    <input
                      type="password"
                      value={s3SecretAccessKey}
                      onChange={(e) => setS3SecretAccessKey(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="wJalrXUtnFEMI/K7MDENG/bPxRfiCYEXAMPLEKEY"
                      className="w-full px-3 py-2 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-sm bg-white font-mono"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* 定期自動同期の有効化設定 */}
            <div className="border border-gray-200 rounded-xl p-4 space-y-3 bg-white">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div>
                  <div className="text-sm font-semibold text-gray-800">定期自動同期バックアップ</div>
                  <div className="text-xs text-gray-500">
                    ローカルPCでの運用中に、設定したインターバル（間隔）でクラウド同期を自動実行します。
                  </div>
                </div>
                <label className="relative inline-flex items-center cursor-pointer">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    checked={autoSyncEnabled}
                    onChange={(e) => setAutoSyncEnabled(e.target.checked)}
                    className="sr-only peer"
                  />
                  <div className="w-11 h-6 bg-gray-200 peer-focus:outline-none rounded-full peer peer-checked:after:translate-x-full peer-checked:after:border-white after:content-[''] after:absolute after:top-[2px] after:left-[2px] after:bg-white after:border-gray-300 after:border after:rounded-full after:h-5 after:w-5 after:transition-all peer-checked:bg-indigo-600"></div>
                </label>
              </div>

              {autoSyncEnabled && (
                <div className="pt-2 border-t border-gray-100 flex items-center gap-3">
                  <label className="text-xs font-medium text-gray-700">自動実行間隔:</label>
                  <select
                    value={autoSyncInterval}
                    onChange={(e) => setAutoSyncInterval(Number(e.target.value))}
                    className="px-3 py-1.5 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg text-xs bg-white"
                  >
                    <option value={12}>12時間ごと</option>
                    <option value={24}>24時間ごと（1日1回・推奨）</option>
                    <option value={72}>3日ごと</option>
                    <option value={168}>7日ごと（週1回）</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>

            {/* アクションボタン群 */}
            <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3 pt-2">
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isSavingSettings}
                className="px-5 py-2.5 bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white text-sm font-medium rounded-lg shadow-sm transition disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                {isSavingSettings ? '設定保存中...' : 'クラウド設定を保存'}
              </button>

              {cloudProvider !== 'none' && (
                <button
                  type="button"

        </div>
      )}

      {/* タブ 3: データ復元（インポート） */}
      {activeTab === 'restore' && (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm p-6 space-y-6">

            </p>
          </div>

            </div>

            </p>
          </div>

          {restoreSuccessResult && (
            <div className="bg-emerald-50 border border-emerald-200 rounded-xl p-4 text-emerald-900 space-y-2">
              <div className="flex items-center gap-2 font-bold text-emerald-800">
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-5 h-5 text-emerald-600" />
                データベースの復元が完了しました
              </div>
              <p className="text-xs text-emerald-700">
                {restoreSuccessResult.message}
              </p>
              {restoreSuccessResult.details && (
                <div className="text-xs bg-white/70 p-3 rounded-lg border border-emerald-100 flex gap-4">
                  <div>事業所名: <strong>{restoreSuccessResult.details.facilityName}</strong></div>
                  <div>登録利用者数: <strong>{restoreSuccessResult.details.clientCount}名</strong></div>
                  <div>職員数: <strong>{restoreSuccessResult.details.staffCount}名</strong></div>
                </div>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          <form onSubmit={handleRestore} className="max-w-xl space-y-5">
            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">
                復元する暗号化バックアップファイル（.enc） <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </label>
              <div className="border-2 border-dashed border-gray-300 rounded-xl p-6 text-center hover:border-indigo-400 transition bg-gray-50/50">
                <input
                  type="file"
                  accept=".enc"
                  onChange={(e) => setRestoreFile(e.target.files ? e.target.files[0] : null)}
                  className="hidden"
                  id="backup-file-input"
                />
                <label htmlFor="backup-file-input" className="cursor-pointer flex flex-col items-center">
                  <FileCode className="w-10 h-10 text-gray-400 mb-2" />
                  <span className="text-sm font-medium text-indigo-600 hover:text-indigo-800">
                    {restoreFile ? restoreFile.name : 'ファイルを選択するか、ここにドラッグ＆ドロップ'}
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-xs text-gray-400 mt-1">
                    {restoreFile ? `${(restoreFile.size / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB` : '拡張子 .enc のファイルのみ受付'}
                  </span>
                </label>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div>
              <label className="block text-sm font-medium text-gray-700 mb-1">
                復号パスフレーズ <span className="text-red-500">*</span>
              </label>
              <div className="relative">
                <input
                  type={showRestorePassphrase ? 'text' : 'password'}
                  value={restorePassphrase}
                  onChange={(e) => setRestorePassphrase(e.target.value)}
                  placeholder="バックアップ時に設定したパスフレーズを入力"
                  required
                  className="w-full px-3 py-2 pr-10 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg focus:ring-2 focus:ring-rose-500 focus:border-rose-500 text-sm"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowRestorePassphrase(!showRestorePassphrase)}
                  className="absolute inset-y-0 right-0 pr-3 flex items-center text-gray-400 hover:text-gray-600"
                >
                  {showRestorePassphrase ? <EyeOff className="w-4 h-4" /> : <Eye className="w-4 h-4" />}
                </button>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="pt-2">
              <button
                type="submit"
                disabled={isRestoring || !restoreFile || !restorePassphrase}
                className="w-full sm:w-auto px-6 py-2.5 bg-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-700 text-white font-medium rounded-lg shadow-sm hover:shadow transition flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-sm disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                {isRestoring ? (
                  <>
                    <RefreshCw className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                    暗号復号＆整合性検証・復元中...
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <RotateCcw className="w-4 h-4" />
                    データベースを復元（インポート）する
                  </>
                )}
              </button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </div>
      )}

      {/* タブ 4: バックアップ履歴ログ */}
      {activeTab === 'logs' && (
        <div className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-gray-200 shadow-sm p-6 space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b border-gray-100 pb-4">
            <div>
              <h2 className="text-lg font-bold text-gray-900 flex items-center gap-2">
                <History className="w-5 h-5 text-indigo-600" />
                バックアップ ＆ 復元 実行履歴ログ（監査証跡）
              </h2>
              <p className="text-sm text-gray-500 mt-1">
                いつ、どのようなバックアップやリストアが実行されたかの全履歴です。
              </p>
            </div>
            <button
              onClick={refreshData}
              className="px-3 py-1.5 text-xs text-gray-600 hover:text-gray-900 border border-gray-300 rounded-lg flex items-center gap-1 hover:bg-gray-50"
            >
              <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> 履歴更新
            </button>
          </div>

          <div className="overflow-x-auto">
            <table className="w-full text-left text-sm border-collapse">
              <thead>
                <tr className="bg-gray-50 text-gray-600 text-xs border-b border-gray-200">
                  <th className="py-2.5 px-3 font-semibold">実行日時</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5 px-3 font-semibold">種別</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5 px-3 font-semibold">保存先</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5 px-3 font-semibold">ファイル名</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5 px-3 font-semibold">サイズ</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5 px-3 font-semibold">ステータス</th>
                  <th className="py-2.5 px-3 font-semibold">詳細メッセージ</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody className="divide-y divide-gray-100 text-xs">
                {(!data?.backupLogs || data.backupLogs.length === 0) ? (
                  <tr>
                    <td colSpan={7} className="py-8 text-center text-gray-400">
                      バックアップまたは復元の履歴はまだありません。
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ) : (
                  (data.backupLogs || []).map((log) => (
                    <tr key={log.id} className="hover:bg-gray-50/60">
                      <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-gray-700 whitespace-nowrap">
                        {log.created_at}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-2.5 px-3 whitespace-nowrap font-medium">
                        {log.backup_type === 'manual_download' && (
                          <span className="text-indigo-600 flex items-center gap-1">
                            <HardDriveDownload className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> 手動DL
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {log.backup_type === 'manual_cloud' && (
                          <span className="text-emerald-600 flex items-center gap-1">
                            <CloudUpload className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> クラウド即時同期
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {log.backup_type === 'auto_cloud' && (
                          <span className="text-blue-600 flex items-center gap-1">
                            <Cloud className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> クラウド定期自動同期
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {log.backup_type === 'restore' && (
                          <span className="text-rose-600 flex items-center gap-1">
                            <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> データ復元
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-gray-600 whitespace-nowrap">
                        {log.destination === 'browser' && 'ブラウザ'}
                        {log.destination === 'google_drive' && 'Google Drive'}
                        {log.destination === 's3' && 'S3ストレージ'}
                        {log.destination === 'local_restore' && 'ローカルDB復元'}
                        {!log.destination && '-'}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-gray-600 font-mono text-[11px] truncate max-w-[180px]">
                        {log.file_name || '-'}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-gray-600 whitespace-nowrap">
                        {log.file_size_bytes ? `${(log.file_size_bytes / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB` : '-'}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-2.5 px-3 whitespace-nowrap">
                        {log.status === 'success' ? (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-semibold bg-green-50 text-green-700 border border-green-200">
                            <CheckCircle2 className="w-3 h-3" /> 成功
                          </span>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full text-[10px] font-semibold bg-red-50 text-red-700 border border-red-200">
                            <AlertCircle className="w-3 h-3" /> 失敗
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td className="py-2.5 px-3 text-gray-500 max-w-[280px] truncate" title={log.message || ''}>
                        {log.message || '-'}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ))
                )}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

'use server';

import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import { db, getActiveDbPath } from '@/lib/db';
import { getRole } from '@/lib/auth';
import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';
import {
  getBackupSettings,
  getBackupLogs,
  generateEncryptedBackup,
  syncEncryptedBackupToCloud,
  testCloudConnection,
  restoreFromEncryptedBackup,
  BackupSettingsRecord,
  BackupLogRecord
} from '@/lib/backup/backupService';

export interface DatabaseStatusInfo {
  dbSizeBytes: number;
  dbSizeFormatted: string;
  dbLastModified: string;
  clientCount: number;
  recordCount: number;
  billingCount: number;
  backupLogs: BackupLogRecord[];
  settings: BackupSettingsRecord;
}

/**
 * バックアップ画面用の初期データ（設定・ログ・現行DBステータス）を取得します。
 */
export async function getBackupInfoAction(): Promise<DatabaseStatusInfo> {
  const settings = getBackupSettings();
  const backupLogs = getBackupLogs(30);

  const activeDbPath = getActiveDbPath();
  let dbSizeBytes = 0;
  let dbLastModified = '-';

  if (fs.existsSync(activeDbPath)) {
    const stat = fs.statSync(activeDbPath);
    dbSizeBytes = stat.size;
    dbLastModified = stat.mtime.toLocaleString('ja-JP');
  }

  // 件数集計
  let clientCount = 0;
  let recordCount = 0;
  let billingCount = 0;

  try {
    const c = db.prepare('SELECT count(*) as cnt FROM clients WHERE deleted_at IS NULL').get() as { cnt: number };
    clientCount = c ? c.cnt : 0;
  } catch (e) {}

  try {
    const r = db.prepare('SELECT count(*) as cnt FROM support_records').get() as { cnt: number };
    recordCount = r ? r.cnt : 0;
  } catch (e) {}

  try {
    const b = db.prepare('SELECT count(*) as cnt FROM monthly_provision_records').get() as { cnt: number };
    billingCount = b ? b.cnt : 0;
  } catch (e) {}

  const dbSizeFormatted = (dbSizeBytes / (1024 * 1024)).toFixed(2) + ' MB';

  // セキュリティのため、シークレットアクセスキーの一部をマスクしてクライアントに返却
  const sanitizedSettings = { ...settings };
  if (sanitizedSettings.s3_secret_access_key && sanitizedSettings.s3_secret_access_key.length > 8) {
    sanitizedSettings.s3_secret_access_key = 
      sanitizedSettings.s3_secret_access_key.slice(0, 4) + '********' + sanitizedSettings.s3_secret_access_key.slice(-4);
  }

  return {
    dbSizeBytes,
    dbSizeFormatted,
    dbLastModified,
    clientCount,
    recordCount,
    billingCount,
    backupLogs,
    settings: sanitizedSettings
  };
}

/**
 * クラウドバックアップ設定を保存します。
 */
export async function saveBackupSettingsAction(data: {
  cloud_provider: 'none' | 'google_drive_folder' | 's3';
  local_sync_path?: string;
  s3_endpoint?: string;
  s3_bucket?: string;
  s3_region?: string;
  s3_access_key_id?: string;
  s3_secret_access_key?: string;
  auto_sync_enabled: boolean;
  auto_sync_interval_hours: number;
}) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (role !== 'admin') {
    return { success: false, message: '設定変更には管理者権限が必要です。' };
  }

  try {
    const current = getBackupSettings();
    let secretKey = data.s3_secret_access_key?.trim();

    // マスク文字列のまま送信された場合は既存のシークレットキーを維持
    if (secretKey && secretKey.includes('********')) {
      secretKey = current.s3_secret_access_key || '';
    }

    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE backup_settings
      SET 
        cloud_provider = ?,
        local_sync_path = ?,
        s3_endpoint = ?,
        s3_bucket = ?,
        s3_region = ?,
        s3_access_key_id = ?,
        s3_secret_access_key = ?,
        auto_sync_enabled = ?,
        auto_sync_interval_hours = ?,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      WHERE id = 'default'
    `).run(
      data.cloud_provider,
      data.local_sync_path?.trim() || null,
      data.s3_endpoint?.trim() || null,
      data.s3_bucket?.trim() || null,
      data.s3_region?.trim() || 'auto',
      data.s3_access_key_id?.trim() || null,
      secretKey || null,
      data.auto_sync_enabled ? 1 : 0,
      Number(data.auto_sync_interval_hours) || 24
    );

    revalidatePath('/settings/backup');
    return { success: true, message: 'バックアップ設定を更新しました。' };
  } catch (error: any) {
    return { success: false, message: error.message || '設定の保存に失敗しました。' };
  }
}

/**
 * クラウドストレージ接続テストを実行します。
 */
export async function testCloudConnectionAction(data: {
  cloud_provider: 'none' | 'google_drive_folder' | 's3';
  local_sync_path?: string;
  s3_endpoint?: string;
  s3_bucket?: string;
  s3_region?: string;
  s3_access_key_id?: string;
  s3_secret_access_key?: string;
}) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (role !== 'admin') {
    return { success: false, message: '接続テストには管理者権限が必要です。' };
  }

  try {
    const current = getBackupSettings();
    let secretKey = data.s3_secret_access_key?.trim();
    if (secretKey && secretKey.includes('********')) {
      secretKey = current.s3_secret_access_key || '';
    }

    const result = await testCloudConnection({
      cloud_provider: data.cloud_provider,
      local_sync_path: data.local_sync_path,
      s3_endpoint: data.s3_endpoint,
      s3_bucket: data.s3_bucket,
      s3_region: data.s3_region,
      s3_access_key_id: data.s3_access_key_id,
      s3_secret_access_key: secretKey
    });

    return result;
  } catch (error: any) {
    return { success: false, message: error.message || '接続テストに失敗しました。' };
  }
}

/**
 * 手動で「今すぐクラウドへバックアップ同期」を実行します。
 */
export async function triggerManualCloudSyncAction(passphrase: string) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (role !== 'admin') {
    return { success: false, message: 'バックアップ実行には管理者権限が必要です。' };
  }

  if (!passphrase || passphrase.length < 8) {
    return { success: false, message: '暗号化パスフレーズは8文字以上で指定してください。' };
  }

  try {
    // 暗号化バックアップ生成
    const backup = await generateEncryptedBackup(passphrase);

    // クラウド保存
    const result = await syncEncryptedBackupToCloud(backup.buffer, backup.fileName, 'manual_cloud');

    revalidatePath('/settings/backup');
    return result;
  } catch (error: any) {
    return { success: false, message: error.message || 'クラウドバックアップに失敗しました。' };
  }
}

/**
 * バックアップファイルからの復元（インポート）を実行します。
 */
export async function restoreDatabaseAction(formData: FormData) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (role !== 'admin') {
    return { success: false, message: 'データベースの復元には管理者権限が必要です。' };
  }

  const file = formData.get('file') as File | null;
  const passphrase = formData.get('passphrase') as string | null;

  if (!file || file.size === 0) {
    return { success: false, message: '復元対象の暗号化バックアップファイル（.enc）を選択してください。' };
  }

  if (!passphrase || passphrase.trim() === '') {
    return { success: false, message: '復号用のパスフレーズを入力してください。' };
  }

  try {
    const arrayBuffer = await file.arrayBuffer();
    const buffer = Buffer.from(arrayBuffer);

    // 復元処理
    const result = await restoreFromEncryptedBackup(buffer, passphrase);

    // キャッシュを全画面再検証
    revalidatePath('/', 'layout');
    return result;
  } catch (error: any) {
    return { success: false, message: error.message || '復元処理に失敗しました。' };
  }
}

'use client';
import React, { useTransition } from 'react';
import { Trash2, Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { deleteGhRoom } from '@/app/(gh)/gh/settings/actions';

interface DeleteGhRoomButtonProps {
  roomId: string;
  roomNumber: string;
  isOccupied: boolean;
}

export function DeleteGhRoomButton({
  roomId,
  roomNumber,
  isOccupied,
}: DeleteGhRoomButtonProps) {
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();

  const handleDelete = () => {
    if (isOccupied) {
      alert(`居室「${roomNumber}号室」は現在入居中のため削除できません。\n先に入居者を退去または別の居室へ移動してください。`);
      return;
    }

    const ok = window.confirm(
      `【確認】空室の居室「${roomNumber}号室」をマスターから削除しますか？`
    );
    if (!ok) return;

    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await deleteGhRoom(roomId);
      if (res && !res.success) {
        alert(res.error || '居室の削除に失敗しました');
      }
    });
  };

  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={handleDelete}
      disabled={isPending || isOccupied}
      title={isOccupied ? '入居中のため削除不可' : '居室を削除'}
      className="p-1.5 text-slate-400 hover:text-rose-600 hover:bg-rose-50 rounded-lg transition-colors border border-transparent hover:border-rose-200 disabled:opacity-30 disabled:hover:bg-transparent disabled:hover:text-slate-400 disabled:cursor-not-allowed ml-2"
    >
      {isPending ? (
        <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin text-rose-600" />
      ) : (
        <Trash2 className="w-4 h-4" />
      )}
    </button>
  );
}

                </select>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">利用者の障害特性や生産活動内容に応じた計算方式を選択できます。</p>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="regularHoursPerWeek" className="font-bold text-sm">
                  常勤職員 週所定労働時間 (時間)
                </Label>
                <Input

              就労継続支援B型 基本報酬 ＆ 目標工賃達成加算設定
            </CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              令和6年度報酬改定（6:1配置・サービス費Ⅰ〜Ⅵ・目標工賃達成指導員配置加算89単位）に準拠します。
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="pt-6">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-6">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="staffingClass" className="font-semibold text-sm">人員配置基準区分</Label>
                <select 
                  id="staffingClass" 
                  name="staffingClass" 
                  className="flex h-12 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-base"
                  defaultValue={settings.staffing_class || "7.5:1"}
                >
                  <option value="6:1">6:1（令和6年新設・基本報酬最上位）</option>
                  <option value="7.5:1">7.5:1（基本報酬手厚い配置）</option>
                  <option value="10:1">10:1（標準配置）</option>
                </select>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="regionClass" className="font-semibold text-sm">地域区分（級地）</Label>
                <select 
                  id="regionClass"

                  className="flex h-12 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-base"

                >
                  <option value="1級地 (11.20円)">1級地 (11.20円)</option>

                  <option value="新加算Ⅰ">新加算Ⅰ（加算率 11.2%）</option>

                  <option value="新加算Ⅲ">新加算Ⅲ（加算率 9.2%）</option>
                  <option value="新加算Ⅳ">新加算Ⅳ（加算率 7.4%）</option>
                  <option value="なし">加算なし</option>

              </div>

              {/* B型特有加算チェックボックス群 */}
              <div className="space-y-3 flex flex-col justify-center">
                <Label className="font-semibold text-sm">目標工賃達成指導員配置加算 (89単位/日)</Label>
                <label className="flex items-center space-x-3 bg-white p-3 rounded-md border cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    name="targetWageInstructorAddition"
                    defaultChecked={settings.target_wage_instructor_addition === 1}
                    className="w-5 h-5 accent-emerald-600"
                  />
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">目標工賃達成指導員配置加算を算定する</span>
                </label>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">常勤換算1名以上の指導員を追加配置し工賃向上に取り組む場合に算定。</p>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-3 flex flex-col justify-center">
                <Label className="font-semibold text-sm">目標工賃達成加算 (10単位/日)</Label>
                <label className="flex items-center space-x-3 bg-white p-3 rounded-md border cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"
                    name="targetWageAchievementAddition"
                    defaultChecked={settings.target_wage_achievement_addition === 1}
                    className="w-5 h-5 accent-emerald-600"
                  />
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800">目標工賃達成加算を算定する</span>
                </label>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">前年度の工賃実績が目標を達成している場合に算定。</p>
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-3 flex flex-col justify-center">
                <Label className="font-semibold text-sm">地域協働加算 (30単位/日)</Label>
                <label className="flex items-center space-x-3 bg-white p-3 rounded-md border cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-50 transition-colors">
                  <input
                    type="checkbox"

              </div>
            </div>
          </CardContent>

        {/* 5. コンプライアンス減算回避（BCP・虐待防止・身体拘束・情報公表） */}
        <ComplianceSection settings={settings} />

"use server"

import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { getCorporateDb } from "@/app/(corporate)/corporate/lib/db";

export async function updateCorporateSettings(formData: FormData) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (role !== 'admin') {
    redirect('/settings?error=' + encodeURIComponent('管理者権限が必要です'));
  }

  const corporation_name = (formData.get('corporation_name') as string)?.trim() || '社会福祉法人 かがやき会';
  const facility_name = (formData.get('facility_name') as string)?.trim() || '法人統括本部';
  const representative_name = (formData.get('representative_name') as string)?.trim() || '';
  const postal_code = (formData.get('postal_code') as string)?.trim() || '';
  const address = (formData.get('address') as string)?.trim() || '';
  const phone_number = (formData.get('phone_number') as string)?.trim() || '';
  const fax_number = (formData.get('fax_number') as string)?.trim() || '';
  
  const zengin_bank_code = (formData.get('zengin_bank_code') as string)?.trim() || '0001';
  const zengin_branch_code = (formData.get('zengin_branch_code') as string)?.trim() || '100';
  const zengin_account_type = (formData.get('zengin_account_type') as string)?.trim() || '1';
  const zengin_account_number = (formData.get('zengin_account_number') as string)?.trim() || '1234567';
  const zengin_client_name = (formData.get('zengin_client_name') as string)?.trim() || '';
  const zengin_client_code = (formData.get('zengin_client_code') as string)?.trim() || '';

  try {
    const db = getCorporateDb();
    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE corporate_settings
      SET 
        corporation_name = ?,
        facility_name = ?,
        representative_name = ?,
        postal_code = ?,
        address = ?,
        phone_number = ?,
        fax_number = ?,
        zengin_bank_code = ?,
        zengin_branch_code = ?,
        zengin_account_type = ?,
        zengin_account_number = ?,
        zengin_client_name = ?,
        zengin_client_code = ?,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      WHERE id = 'default'
    `).run(
      corporation_name,
      facility_name,
      representative_name,
      postal_code,
      address,
      phone_number,
      fax_number,
      zengin_bank_code,
      zengin_branch_code,
      zengin_account_type,
      zengin_account_number,
      zengin_client_name,
      zengin_client_code
    );

    revalidatePath('/settings');
    revalidatePath('/corporate/dashboard');
    revalidatePath('/corporate/billing');
    revalidatePath('/');
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to update corporate settings:', error);
    redirect('/settings?error=' + encodeURIComponent('法人統括設定の保存に失敗しました'));
  }

  redirect('/settings?msg=' + encodeURIComponent('法人統括の基本設定を正常に更新しました'));
}
