'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { Building2, Plus, Trash2, Edit2, Check, X, Users, UserCheck } from "lucide-react";
import { createDepartment, updateDepartment, deleteDepartment } from "./actions";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";

export function DepartmentsClient({ initialDepartments }: { initialDepartments: any[] }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [departments, setDepartments] = useState(initialDepartments);
  const [newName, setNewName] = useState('');
  const [newDesc, setNewDesc] = useState('');
  const [newType, setNewType] = useState<'main' | 'satellite'>('main');
  const [newCapacity, setNewCapacity] = useState<number>(10);
  const [isSubmitting, setIsSubmitting] = useState(false);
  const [editingId, setEditingId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [editName, setEditName] = useState('');
  const [editDesc, setEditDesc] = useState('');
  const [editType, setEditType] = useState<'main' | 'satellite'>('main');
  const [editCapacity, setEditCapacity] = useState<number>(10);

  const handleCreate = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!newName.trim()) {
      alert("部署・拠点名を入力してください");
      return;
    }

    setIsSubmitting(true);
    try {
      const fd = new FormData();
      fd.append('name', newName.trim());
      fd.append('description', newDesc.trim());
      fd.append('facility_type', newType);
      fd.append('capacity', newCapacity.toString());
      const res: any = await createDepartment(fd);
      if (res && !res.success) {
        alert(res.error || "登録に失敗しました");
        return;
      }
      setNewName('');
      setNewDesc('');
      setNewType('main');
      setNewCapacity(10);
      router.refresh();
    } catch (e: any) {
      alert(e.message || "登録に失敗しました");
    } finally {
      setIsSubmitting(false);
    }
  };

  const startEdit = (dep: any) => {
    setEditingId(dep.id);
    setEditName(dep.name);
    setEditDesc(dep.description || '');
    setEditType(dep.facility_type === 'satellite' ? 'satellite' : 'main');
    setEditCapacity(dep.capacity ?? 10);
  };

  const cancelEdit = () => {
    setEditingId(null);
    setEditName('');
    setEditDesc('');
  };

  const handleUpdate = async (id: string) => {
    if (!editName.trim()) {
      alert("部署・拠点名を入力してください");
      return;
    }
    try {
      const res: any = await updateDepartment(id, editName.trim(), editDesc.trim(), editType, editCapacity);
      if (res && !res.success) {
        alert(res.error || "更新に失敗しました");
        return;
      }
      setEditingId(null);
      router.refresh();
    } catch (e: any) {
      alert(e.message || "更新に失敗しました");
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id: string, name: string) => {
    if (!confirm(`部署「${name}」を削除してもよろしいですか？\n※所属している利用者や職員の所属は「未所属」に戻ります。`)) {
      return;
    }
    try {
      const res: any = await deleteDepartment(id);
      if (res && !res.success) {
        alert(res.error || "削除に失敗しました");
        return;
      }
      router.refresh();
    } catch (e: any) {
      alert(e.message || "削除に失敗しました");
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      {/* 新規追加カード */}
      <Card className="shadow-sm border-primary/20">
        <CardHeader className="bg-primary/5 pb-4">
          <CardTitle className="text-xl flex items-center gap-2">
            <Plus className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
            新しい部署・拠点を登録
          </CardTitle>
          <CardDescription>
            物理的に離れた別拠点や業務部門の名前を登録します。登録した部署は利用者・職員の所属やシフト表に自動連動します。
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="pt-6">
          <form onSubmit={handleCreate} className="space-y-4">
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
              <div className="space-y-2 md:col-span-1">
                <Label htmlFor="depName" className="font-bold">
                  部署・拠点名 <span className="text-destructive">*</span>
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="depName"
                  placeholder="例: ぽん酢工房、フードラボ"
                  value={newName}
                  onChange={e => setNewName(e.target.value)}
                  className="h-11"
                  required
                />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2 md:col-span-1">
                <Label htmlFor="depType" className="font-bold">
                  拠点区分
                </Label>
                <select
                  id="depType"
                  value={newType}
                  onChange={e => setNewType(e.target.value as 'main' | 'satellite')}
                  className="flex h-11 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-2 text-sm ring-offset-background focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-ring focus-visible:ring-offset-2"
                >
                  <option value="main">🏢 本所（主たる事業所）</option>
                  <option value="satellite">📡 サテライト（従たる事業所）</option>
                </select>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2 md:col-span-1">
                <Label htmlFor="depCapacity" className="font-bold">
                  内勤受入上限（人）
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="depCapacity"
                  type="number"
                  min="1"
                  max="100"
                  value={newCapacity}
                  onChange={e => setNewCapacity(parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 10)}
                  className="h-11 font-bold"
                  placeholder="10"
                />
                <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">※内勤超過時にアラートを出します</p>
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-2 md:col-span-1">
                <Label htmlFor="depDesc" className="font-bold">
                  所在地・備考 <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-normal">（任意）</span>
                </Label>
                <Input
                  id="depDesc"
                  placeholder="例: ○○ビル2F、調理加工 等"
                  value={newDesc}
                  onChange={e => setNewDesc(e.target.value)}
                  className="h-11"
                />
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex justify-end">
              <Button type="submit" disabled={isSubmitting} className="h-11 px-6 font-bold shadow-xs">
                <Plus className="mr-2 h-4 w-4" />
                拠点・部署を追加する
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* 登録済み一覧カード */}
      <Card className="shadow-sm">
        <CardHeader className="border-b pb-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
            <div>
              <CardTitle className="text-xl flex items-center gap-2">
                <Building2 className="h-5 w-5 text-primary" />
                登録済み 部署・拠点一覧
              </CardTitle>
              <CardDescription className="mt-1">
                本所・サテライトの各拠点と内勤上限人数（定員）を管理します。
              </CardDescription>
            </div>
            <Badge variant="outline" className="text-sm px-3 py-1 font-bold">
              全 {departments.length} 拠点
            </Badge>
          </div>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent className="p-0">
          {departments.length === 0 ? (
            <div className="p-12 text-center text-muted-foreground space-y-2">
              <Building2 className="h-12 w-12 mx-auto text-muted-foreground/40 mb-3" />
              <p className="font-bold text-base text-foreground">登録されている部署・拠点はまだありません</p>
              <p className="text-sm">上のフォームから部署・拠点名を登録してください。</p>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <Table>
              <TableHeader className="bg-muted/40">
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead className="w-12 text-center">#</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="min-w-[150px]">部署・拠点名</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="w-[120px]">拠点区分</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="w-[120px] text-center">内勤上限定員</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="min-w-[180px]">所在地・業務内容</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-center w-[140px]">所属メンバー</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="text-right w-[140px]">操作</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {departments.map((dep, index) => {
                  const isEditing = editingId === dep.id;

                  return (
                    <TableRow key={dep.id} className="hover:bg-muted/30">
                      <TableCell className="text-center font-bold text-muted-foreground">
                        {index + 1}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        {isEditing ? (
                          <Input
                            value={editName}
                            onChange={e => setEditName(e.target.value)}
                            className="h-9 font-bold"
                            placeholder="部署名"
                            autoFocus
                          />
                        ) : (
                          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                            <span className="font-bold text-base text-foreground">{dep.name}</span>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        {isEditing ? (
                          <select
                            value={editType}
                            onChange={e => setEditType(e.target.value as 'main' | 'satellite')}
                            className="h-9 text-xs rounded border border-input bg-background px-2"
                          >
                            <option value="main">本所</option>
                            <option value="satellite">サテライト</option>
                          </select>
                        ) : (
                          <Badge variant={dep.facility_type === 'satellite' ? 'secondary' : 'default'} className="font-bold text-xs">
                            {dep.facility_type === 'satellite' ? '📡 サテライト' : '🏢 本所'}
                          </Badge>
                        )}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-center">
                        {isEditing ? (
                          <Input
                            type="number"
                            min="1"
                            max="100"
                            value={editCapacity}
                            onChange={e => setEditCapacity(parseInt(e.target.value, 10) || 10)}
                            className="h-9 text-center font-black w-20 mx-auto"
                          />
                        ) : (
                          <span className="font-black text-sm text-foreground bg-primary/10 border border-primary/20 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
                            {dep.capacity ?? 10} 名
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell>
                        {isEditing ? (
                          <Input
                            value={editDesc}
                            onChange={e => setEditDesc(e.target.value)}
                            className="h-9 text-sm"
                            placeholder="所在地・備考"
                          />
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                            {dep.description || <span className="italic text-muted-foreground/50">未設定</span>}
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-center">
                        <div className="flex items-center justify-center gap-2 text-xs">
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold text-blue-700 bg-blue-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-blue-200">
                            <Users className="w-3 h-3" /> 利用者 {dep.client_count || 0}名
                          </span>
                          <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 font-semibold text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-emerald-200">
                            <UserCheck className="w-3 h-3" /> 職員 {dep.staff_count || 0}名
                          </span>
                        </div>
                      </TableCell>
                      <TableCell className="text-right">
                        {isEditing ? (
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                            <Button
                              size="sm"
                              variant="default"
                              className="h-8 px-2.5 text-xs bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 gap-1"
                              onClick={() => handleUpdate(dep.id)}
                            >
                              <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> 保存
                            </Button>
                            <Button
                              size="sm"
                              variant="ghost"
                              className="h-8 px-2 text-xs"
                              onClick={cancelEdit}
                            >
                              <X className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            </Button>
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <div className="flex items-center justify-end gap-1">
                            <Button
                              size="sm"
                              variant="outline"
                              className="h-8 px-2.5 text-xs gap-1"
                              onClick={() => startEdit(dep)}
                            >
                              <Edit2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" /> 編集
                            </Button>
                            <Button
                              size="sm"
                              variant="ghost"
                              className="h-8 w-8 p-0 text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10"
                              onClick={() => handleDelete(dep.id, dep.name)}
                              title="削除"
                            >
                              <Trash2 className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                            </Button>
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  );
                })}
              </TableBody>
            </Table>
          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

'use server';

import { db, resolveServiceModeForDepartment } from "@/lib/db";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { randomUUID } from "crypto";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";

export async function getDepartments() {
  try {
    const departments = db.prepare(`
      SELECT d.*,
             (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM clients WHERE department_id = d.id AND deleted_at IS NULL) as client_count,
             (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM staff WHERE department_id = d.id AND deleted_at IS NULL) as staff_count
      FROM departments d
      WHERE d.deleted_at IS NULL
      ORDER BY d.sort_order ASC, d.created_at ASC
    `).all() as any[];
    return departments;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Failed to get departments:", error);
    return [];
  }
}

export async function createDepartment(formData: FormData) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (role !== 'admin') return { success: false, error: "管理者権限が必要です" };

    const name = (formData.get('name') as string || '').trim();
    const description = (formData.get('description') as string || '').trim();
    const facilityType = (formData.get('facility_type') as string || 'main').trim();
    const capacity = parseInt(formData.get('capacity') as string || '10', 10) || 10;

    if (!name) {
      return { success: false, error: "部署・拠点名は必須です" };
    }

    const id = randomUUID();
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO departments (id, name, description, facility_type, capacity, sort_order)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sort_order), 0) + 1 FROM departments))
    `).run(id, name, description || null, facilityType, capacity);

    revalidatePath('/settings');
    revalidatePath('/settings/departments');
    revalidatePath('/clients');
    revalidatePath('/staff');
    revalidatePath('/attendance');
    revalidatePath('/attendance/shifts');
    revalidatePath('/daily-logs');
    revalidatePath('/support-records');
    revalidatePath('/support-records/ledger');
    revalidatePath('/');

    return { success: true, id };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Failed to create department:", error);
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "部署・拠点の登録に失敗しました" };
  }
}

export async function updateDepartment(id: string, name: string, description?: string, facilityType: string = 'main', capacity: number = 10) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (role !== 'admin') return { success: false, error: "管理者権限が必要です" };

    const trimmedName = name.trim();
    if (!trimmedName) return { success: false, error: "部署・拠点名は必須です" };

    await resolveServiceModeForDepartment(id);
    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE departments 
      SET name = ?, description = ?, facility_type = ?, capacity = ?
      WHERE id = ?
    `).run(trimmedName, description?.trim() || null, facilityType, capacity, id);

    revalidatePath('/settings');
    revalidatePath('/settings/departments');
    revalidatePath('/clients');
    revalidatePath('/staff');
    revalidatePath('/attendance');
    revalidatePath('/attendance/shifts');
    revalidatePath('/daily-logs');
    revalidatePath('/support-records');
    revalidatePath('/support-records/ledger');
    revalidatePath('/');

    return { success: true };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Failed to update department:", error);
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "部署・拠点の更新に失敗しました" };
  }
}

export async function deleteDepartment(id: string) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (role !== 'admin') return { success: false, error: "管理者権限が必要です" };

    await resolveServiceModeForDepartment(id);
    // 所属している利用者や職員のdepartment_idをNULLに更新
    db.transaction(() => {
      db.prepare('UPDATE clients SET department_id = NULL WHERE department_id = ?').run(id);
      db.prepare('UPDATE staff SET department_id = NULL WHERE department_id = ?').run(id);
      db.prepare('UPDATE departments SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?').run(id);
    })();

    revalidatePath('/settings');
    revalidatePath('/settings/departments');
    revalidatePath('/clients');
    revalidatePath('/staff');
    revalidatePath('/attendance');
    revalidatePath('/attendance/shifts');
    revalidatePath('/daily-logs');
    revalidatePath('/support-records');
    revalidatePath('/support-records/ledger');
    revalidatePath('/');

    return { success: true };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Failed to delete department:", error);
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "部署・拠点の削除に失敗しました" };
  }
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { toast } from 'sonner';
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { 
  Dialog, 
  DialogContent, 
  DialogDescription, 
  DialogHeader, 
  DialogTitle, 
  DialogFooter 
} from "@/components/ui/dialog";
import { 
  Building2, 
  ShieldCheck, 
  Sparkles, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  ExternalLink, 
  Check, 
  X, 
  Code, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  Plus, 
  Info,
  Loader2
} from "lucide-react";
import { 
  JurisdictionRecord, 
  updateJurisdictionRules, 
  proposeAiRuleDraft, 
  approveDraftRules, 
  rejectDraftRules,
  createJurisdiction
} from "./actions";
import { EffectiveLocalRules } from "@/lib/rules/ruleEngine";

interface Props {
  jurisdictions: JurisdictionRecord[];
  facilityRules: EffectiveLocalRules;
  facilityLocation: { prefCode?: string; cityCode?: string; facilityName?: string };
}

export function JurisdictionsClient({ jurisdictions: initialJurisdictions, facilityRules, facilityLocation }: Props) {
  const [jurisdictions, setJurisdictions] = useState<JurisdictionRecord[]>(initialJurisdictions);
  const [selectedJur, setSelectedJur] = useState<JurisdictionRecord | null>(null);

  // モーダル管理
  const [isEditModalOpen, setIsEditModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [editJsonText, setEditJsonText] = useState('');
  
  const [isAiDraftModalOpen, setIsAiDraftModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [aiSourceUrl, setAiSourceUrl] = useState('');
  const [aiNoticeText, setAiNoticeText] = useState('');
  const [isAiLoading, setIsAiLoading] = useState(false);

  const [isCreateModalOpen, setIsCreateModalOpen] = useState(false);
  const [newJurType, setNewJurType] = useState<'prefecture' | 'city'>('city');
  const [newJurCode, setNewJurCode] = useState('');
  const [newJurName, setNewJurName] = useState('');

  const [isProcessing, setIsProcessing] = useState(false);

  // 編集モーダルを開く
  const handleOpenEdit = (jur: JurisdictionRecord) => {
    setSelectedJur(jur);
    try {
      setEditJsonText(JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(jur.local_rules_json), null, 2));
    } catch {
      setEditJsonText(jur.local_rules_json);
    }
    setIsEditModalOpen(true);
  };

  // ルール手動保存
  const handleSaveRules = async () => {
    if (!selectedJur) return;
    setIsProcessing(true);
    try {
      const res = await updateJurisdictionRules(selectedJur.id, editJsonText);
      if (res.success) {
        toast.success(`${selectedJur.name}のルール設定を保存しました`);
        setJurisdictions(prev => prev.map(j => j.id === selectedJur.id ? { ...j, local_rules_json: editJsonText } : j));
        setIsEditModalOpen(false);
      } else {
        toast.error(res.error || '保存に失敗しました');
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast.error(e.message);
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  // AI改定案作成モーダルを開く
  const handleOpenAiDraft = (jur: JurisdictionRecord) => {
    setSelectedJur(jur);
    setAiSourceUrl(jur.draft_source_url || '');
    setAiNoticeText('');
    setIsAiDraftModalOpen(true);
  };

  // AI改定案作成実行 (Draft生成)
  const handleGenerateAiDraft = async () => {
    if (!selectedJur) return;
    if (!aiSourceUrl && !aiNoticeText) {
      toast.error('一次情報URLまたは通達テキストのいずれかを入力してください');
      return;
    }

    setIsAiLoading(true);
    try {
      const res = await proposeAiRuleDraft({
        jurisdictionId: selectedJur.id,
        sourceUrl: aiSourceUrl,
        noticeText: aiNoticeText
      });

      if (res.success) {
        toast.success('AIによるルール改定案（Draft）を作成しました。画面上で内容を確認して承認してください。');
        setIsAiDraftModalOpen(false);
        // リロードまたはstate更新
        window.location.reload();
      } else {
        toast.error(res.error || '改定案の作成に失敗しました');
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast.error(e.message);
    } finally {
      setIsAiLoading(false);
    }
  };

  // 承認（Human-in-the-loop Approve）
  const handleApproveDraft = async (jur: JurisdictionRecord) => {
    if (!confirm(`【確認】${jur.name}のAIルール改定案を正式に承認し、本番システムに適用しますか？`)) {
      return;
    }

    setIsProcessing(true);
    try {
      const res = await approveDraftRules(jur.id);
      if (res.success) {
        toast.success(`${jur.name}のルール改定案を承認・適用しました`);
        window.location.reload();
      } else {
        toast.error(res.error || '承認に失敗しました');
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast.error(e.message);
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  // 破棄（Human-in-the-loop Reject）
  const handleRejectDraft = async (jur: JurisdictionRecord) => {
    if (!confirm(`【確認】${jur.name}のルール改定案を破棄しますか？`)) {
      return;
    }

    setIsProcessing(true);
    try {
      const res = await rejectDraftRules(jur.id);
      if (res.success) {
        toast.info('ルール改定案を破棄しました');
        window.location.reload();
      } else {
        toast.error(res.error || '破棄に失敗しました');
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast.error(e.message);
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  // 新規自治体追加
  const handleCreateJurisdiction = async () => {
    if (!newJurCode || !newJurName) {
      toast.error('コードと名称を入力してください');
      return;
    }

    setIsProcessing(true);
    try {
      const res = await createJurisdiction({
        jurisdiction_type: newJurType,
        jurisdiction_code: newJurCode,
        name: newJurName,
        initial_rules_json: '{}'
      });

      if (res.success) {
        toast.success(`自治体「${newJurName}」を追加しました`);
        setIsCreateModalOpen(false);
        window.location.reload();
      } else {
        toast.error(res.error || '追加に失敗しました');
      }
    } catch (e: any) {
      toast.error(e.message);
    } finally {
      setIsProcessing(false);
    }
  };

  // 未承認のDraftがある自治体一覧
  const pendingDrafts = jurisdictions.filter(j => j.draft_rules_json);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-8">
      {/* 1. 現在適用されている合成ルールの可視化カード */}
      <Card className="border-indigo-200 bg-linear-to-r from-indigo-50/50 via-white to-blue-50/40 shadow-sm">
        <CardHeader>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <ShieldCheck className="h-6 w-6 text-indigo-600" />
              <CardTitle className="text-xl">現在有効な適用ルール（合成評価結果）</CardTitle>
            </div>
            <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-white border-indigo-200 text-indigo-800 text-xs px-2.5 py-1">
              指定権者優先（市 ＞ 県 ＞ 国基準）
            </Badge>
          </div>
          <CardDescription>
            事業所情報（都道府県コード: {facilityLocation.prefCode || '未設定'} / 市区町村コード: {facilityLocation.cityCode || '未設定'}）に基づき、
            国基準・都道府県・市区町村の各設定を動的にカスケード適用した現在のシステム有効値です。
          </CardDescription>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
            <div className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 space-y-2">
              <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-emerald-500"></span>
                個別支援計画ルール
              </h4>
              <ul className="text-xs space-y-1 text-slate-600">
                <li>・プロセス日付順序厳格検証: <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{facilityRules.plans.strict_date_sequence ? '有効（厳格）' : '無効'}</span></li>
                <li>・事前同意必須チェック: <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{facilityRules.plans.require_user_consent_before_start ? '必須' : '任意'}</span></li>
                <li>・モニタリング周期: <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{facilityRules.plans.monitoring_frequency_months}ヶ月ごと</span></li>
              </ul>
            </div>

            <div className="rounded-lg border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 space-y-2">
              <h4 className="text-sm font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-blue-500"></span>
                請求・加算ルール
              </h4>
              <ul className="text-xs space-y-1 text-slate-600">
                <li>・欠席時対応加算の月上限: <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">月{facilityRules.billing.absence_addition_max_days_per_month}回まで</span></li>

                <li>・施設外就労支援: <span className="font-semibold text-slate-900">{facilityRules.billing.allow_facility_outreach ? '算定可' : '算定不可'}</span></li>

                帳票・給与ルール

              </ul>
            </div>
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* 2. 未承認のAI改定提案（Human-in-the-loop） */}
      {pendingDrafts.length > 0 && (
        <div className="space-y-4">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-amber-900 font-bold text-lg">
            <AlertTriangle className="h-5 w-5 text-amber-600" />
            AIによる未適用のルール改定提案が {pendingDrafts.length} 件あります（要承認）
          </div>

          {pendingDrafts.map(jur => (
            <Card key={jur.id} className="border-amber-300 bg-amber-50/40 shadow-sm">
              <CardHeader className="pb-3">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Sparkles className="h-5 w-5 text-amber-600" />
                    <CardTitle className="text-base text-amber-950">
                      【要確認】{jur.name} （コード: {jur.jurisdiction_code}） の改定案

                  </div>
                  {jur.draft_updated_at && (
                    <span className="text-xs text-amber-800 font-medium">
                      提案日時: {new Date(jur.draft_updated_at).toLocaleString('ja-JP')}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>
                <CardDescription className="text-amber-900 mt-1 font-medium">
                  {jur.draft_summary || '一次情報に基づいてAIがルール変更案を作成しました。'}
                </CardDescription>
              </CardHeader>
              <CardContent className="space-y-4">
                {jur.draft_source_url && (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 text-xs bg-white p-2.5 rounded border border-amber-200">
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 shrink-0">根拠一次情報:</span>
                    <a 
                      href={jur.draft_source_url} 
                      target="_blank" 
                      rel="noopener noreferrer"
                      className="text-blue-600 hover:underline inline-flex items-center gap-1 truncate font-medium"
                    >
                      {jur.draft_source_url}
                      <ExternalLink className="h-3 w-3 shrink-0" />
                    </a>
                  </div>
                )}

                <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-3 text-xs">
                  <div>
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-700 block mb-1">現在の設定 JSON:</span>
                    <pre className="bg-slate-100 p-3 rounded border text-slate-800 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto font-mono">
                      {JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(jur.local_rules_json || '{}'), null, 2)}
                    </pre>
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="font-bold text-amber-900 block mb-1">AIが提案した新設定 JSON (Draft):</span>
                    <pre className="bg-amber-100/70 p-3 rounded border border-amber-300 text-amber-950 max-h-48 overflow-y-auto font-mono">
                      {JSON.stringify(JSON.parse(jur.draft_rules_json || '{}'), null, 2)}
                    </pre>
                  </div>
                </div>

                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-end gap-3 pt-2">
                  <Button 
                    variant="outline" 
                    size="sm" 
                    className="text-slate-600 hover:text-destructive"
                    onClick={() => handleRejectDraft(jur)}
                    disabled={isProcessing}
                  >
                    <X className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" />
                    この改定案を破棄
                  </Button>
                  <Button 
                    size="sm" 
                    className="bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-bold shadow-xs"
                    onClick={() => handleApproveDraft(jur)}
                    disabled={isProcessing}
                  >
                    <Check className="h-4 w-4 mr-1" />
                    内容を確認し、本番ルールとして承認・適用
                  </Button>
                </div>
              </CardContent>
            </Card>
          ))}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* 3. 登録自治体マスター一覧 */}
      <Card>
        <CardHeader className="flex flex-row items-center justify-between">
          <div>
            <CardTitle className="text-lg">自治体マスター・設定JSON一覧</CardTitle>
            <CardDescription>
              国基準および各都道府県・指定市区町村ごとの独自ルール設定です。
            </CardDescription>
          </div>
          <Button 
            size="sm" 
            variant="outline" 
            className="gap-1.5"
            onClick={() => setIsCreateModalOpen(true)}
          >
            <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
            自治体を追加
          </Button>
        </CardHeader>
        <CardContent>
          <div className="space-y-3">
            {jurisdictions.map(jur => {
              const isFacilityJurisdiction = 
                jur.jurisdiction_code === '00' || 
                jur.jurisdiction_code === facilityLocation.prefCode || 
                jur.jurisdiction_code === facilityLocation.cityCode;

              return (
                <div 
                  key={jur.id} 
                  className="p-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200/90 bg-white hover:border-slate-300 hover:shadow-xs transition-all flex flex-col lg:flex-row lg:items-center justify-between gap-4"
                >
                  <div className="min-w-0 flex-1 space-y-2">
                    <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                      <span className="font-bold text-base text-slate-900">{jur.name}</span>
                      <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs font-medium">
                        {jur.jurisdiction_type === 'national' ? '国基準' : jur.jurisdiction_type === 'prefecture' ? '都道府県' : '市区町村'}
                      </Badge>
                      <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground font-mono bg-slate-100 px-2 py-0.5 rounded">
                        コード: {jur.jurisdiction_code}
                      </span>
                      {isFacilityJurisdiction && (
                        <Badge className="bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800 border-indigo-300 text-[11px] font-semibold">
                          自事業所に適用中
                        </Badge>
                      )}
                      {jur.draft_rules_json && (
                        <Badge className="bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border-amber-300 text-[11px] font-bold animate-pulse">
                          改定案あり
                        </Badge>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs text-slate-500 font-mono bg-slate-50 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-md border border-slate-200/60 max-w-3xl">
                      <Code className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-400 shrink-0" />
                      <span className="truncate">{jur.local_rules_json}</span>
                    </div>
                  </div>

                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0 flex-wrap sm:flex-nowrap">
                    <Button 
                      size="sm" 
                      variant="outline" 
                      className="h-9 px-3 gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold border-amber-300 bg-amber-50/70 text-amber-900 hover:bg-amber-100 hover:text-amber-950 whitespace-nowrap shadow-xs"
                      onClick={() => handleOpenAiDraft(jur)}
                    >
                      <Sparkles className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
                      <span>AIに通達を読ませて改定案を作成</span>
                    </Button>
                    <Button 
                      size="sm" 
                      variant="outline" 
                      className="h-9 px-3 gap-1.5 text-xs font-semibold border-slate-300 bg-white hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 whitespace-nowrap shadow-xs"
                      onClick={() => handleOpenEdit(jur)}
                    >
                      <Code className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-slate-600 shrink-0" />
                      <span>JSON設定を編集</span>
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              );
            })}
          </div>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* 手動JSON編集モーダル */}
      <Dialog open={isEditModalOpen} onOpenChange={setIsEditModalOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle>{selectedJur?.name} のルール設定（JSON）</DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              指定自治体固有のルールパラメータをJSON形式で直接編集します。
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="space-y-4 py-2">
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label>設定JSON</Label>
              <Textarea 
                value={editJsonText} 
                onChange={e => setEditJsonText(e.target.value)}
                rows={12}
                className="font-mono text-xs"
              />
            </div>
          </div>
          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setIsEditModalOpen(false)}>キャンセル</Button>
            <Button onClick={handleSaveRules} disabled={isProcessing}>保存</Button>
          </DialogFooter>
        </DialogContent>
      </Dialog>

      {/* AI改定案作成モーダル */}
      <Dialog open={isAiDraftModalOpen} onOpenChange={setIsAiDraftModalOpen}>
        <DialogContent className="max-w-2xl">
          <DialogHeader>
            <DialogTitle className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <Sparkles className="h-5 w-5 text-amber-600" />
              AIによる自治体ルール改定案の作成
            </DialogTitle>
            <DialogDescription>
              自治体（{selectedJur?.name}）が発行した通達テキストや公的一次情報URLを入力してください。
            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>

          <div className="rounded-md bg-amber-50 p-3 border border-amber-200 text-xs text-amber-900 space-y-1">
            <div className="font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5">
              <ShieldCheck className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-700 shrink-0" />
              安心設計: 勝手な自動アップデートは行われません
            </div>
            <p>
              AIが生成した内容は「改定案（Draft）」として画面に提示されます。
              内容と根拠URLを人が目視確認し、「承認」ボタンを押すまで本番システムには一切反映されません。
            </p>
          </div>

          <div className="space-y-4 py-2">
            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label>公的一次情報のURL（例: https://www.city.kobe.lg.jp/...）</Label>
              <Input 
                placeholder="https://..." 
                value={aiSourceUrl} 
                onChange={e => setAiSourceUrl(e.target.value)} 
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-1.5">
              <Label>通達文 / PDF抽出テキスト / 改定サマリー</Label>
              <Textarea 
                placeholder="自治体から届いた文書やPDFの抜粋を貼り付けてください..." 
                rows={6}
                value={aiNoticeText}
                onChange={e => setAiNoticeText(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <DialogFooter>
            <Button variant="outline" onClick={() => setIsAiDraftModalOpen(false)} disabled={isAiLoading}>
              キャンセル
            </Button>
            <Button 
              onClick={handleGenerateAiDraft}

                </>
              )}
            </Button>
          </DialogFooter>

      </Dialog>

      {/* 新規自治体追加モーダル */}
      <Dialog open={isCreateModalOpen} onOpenChange={setIsCreateModalOpen}>
        <DialogContent>
          <DialogHeader>

            </DialogDescription>
          </DialogHeader>
          <div className="space-y-4 py-2">

              <Label>種別</Label>

                className="w-full p-2 border rounded-md text-sm bg-white"
                value={newJurType}

              >
                <option value="city">市区町村</option>

            </div>

              <Label>自治体コード（JISコード / 5桁または2桁）</Label>
              <Input

'use server'

import { db } from '@/lib/db';
import { getRole } from '@/lib/auth';
import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';
import { getEffectiveRules, getFacilityEffectiveRules, DEFAULT_NATIONAL_RULES, EffectiveLocalRules } from '@/lib/rules/ruleEngine';
import { getAiModelInstance } from '@/lib/ai/modelFactory';
import { generateObject } from 'ai';
import { z } from 'zod';

export interface JurisdictionRecord {
  id: string;
  jurisdiction_type: 'national' | 'prefecture' | 'city';
  jurisdiction_code: string;
  name: string;
  local_rules_json: string;
  draft_rules_json: string | null;
  draft_source_url: string | null;
  draft_summary: string | null;
  draft_updated_at: string | null;
  created_at: string;
  updated_at: string;
}

/**
 * 自治体マスター一覧と現在の有効ルールを取得
 */
export async function getJurisdictionsData(): Promise<{
  jurisdictions: JurisdictionRecord[];
  facilityRules: EffectiveLocalRules;
  facilityLocation: { prefCode?: string; cityCode?: string; facilityName?: string };
}> {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role) {
      return {
        jurisdictions: [],
        facilityRules: DEFAULT_NATIONAL_RULES,
        facilityLocation: {},
      };
    }

    const jurisdictions = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM jurisdictions 
      ORDER BY 
        CASE jurisdiction_type 
          WHEN 'national' THEN 1 
          WHEN 'prefecture' THEN 2 
          WHEN 'city' THEN 3 
          ELSE 4 
        END,
        jurisdiction_code ASC
    `).all() as JurisdictionRecord[];

    const facility = db.prepare(`
      SELECT pref_code, city_code, facility_name FROM facility_settings LIMIT 1
    `).get() as { pref_code?: string; city_code?: string; facility_name?: string } | undefined;

    const facilityRules = getFacilityEffectiveRules();

    return {
      jurisdictions,
      facilityRules,
      facilityLocation: {
        prefCode: facility?.pref_code,
        cityCode: facility?.city_code,
        facilityName: facility?.facility_name,
      },
    };
  } catch (e) {
    console.error('Failed to get jurisdictions data:', e);
    return {
      jurisdictions: [],
      facilityRules: DEFAULT_NATIONAL_RULES,
      facilityLocation: {},
    };
  }
}

/**
 * 手動でのルールJSON更新
 */
export async function updateJurisdictionRules(id: string, rulesJson: string) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (role !== 'admin') return { success: false, error: '管理者権限が必要です' };

  try {
    // JSON構文検証
    JSON.parse(rulesJson);
  } catch (e) {
    return { success: false, error: 'JSONの構文に誤りがあります' };
  }

  try {
    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE jurisdictions 
      SET local_rules_json = ?, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP 
      WHERE id = ?
    `).run(rulesJson, id);

    revalidatePath('/settings/jurisdictions');
    revalidatePath('/settings');
    return { success: true };
  } catch (e: any) {
    return { success: false, error: e.message };
  }
}

/**
 * 新規自治体マスターの追加
 */
export async function createJurisdiction(data: {
  jurisdiction_type: 'prefecture' | 'city';
  jurisdiction_code: string;
  name: string;
  initial_rules_json?: string;
}) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (role !== 'admin') return { success: false, error: '管理者権限が必要です' };

  const id = `${data.jurisdiction_type}_${data.jurisdiction_code}`;
  const rules = data.initial_rules_json || '{}';

  try {
    JSON.parse(rules);
  } catch (e) {
    return { success: false, error: 'JSONの構文に誤りがあります' };
  }

  try {
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO jurisdictions (id, jurisdiction_type, jurisdiction_code, name, local_rules_json)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(id, data.jurisdiction_type, data.jurisdiction_code, data.name, rules);

    revalidatePath('/settings/jurisdictions');
    return { success: true };
  } catch (e: any) {
    return { success: false, error: e.message };
  }
}

/**
 * AIによるルール変更案（Draft）の作成
 * ※【絶対ルール】この処理では local_rules_json を直接更新しません。
 * draft_rules_json, draft_source_url に保存し、ユーザーの承認（Approve）を待ちます。
 */
export async function proposeAiRuleDraft(params: {
  jurisdictionId: string;
  sourceUrl: string;
  noticeText: string;
}) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (role !== 'admin') return { success: false, error: '管理者権限が必要です' };

  const jur = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM jurisdictions WHERE id = ?').get(params.jurisdictionId) as JurisdictionRecord | undefined;
  if (!jur) {
    return { success: false, error: '指定された自治体が見つかりません' };
  }

  try {
    const aiModel = getAiModelInstance({ useSearchGrounding: true });

    const prompt = `
あなたは厚生労働省の指定基準、報酬告示、自治体の福祉指導監査基準の専門家です。
以下の自治体向けに、提供された一次情報（自治体通達テキストまたはURL情報）からルール変更案を抽出し、JSON形式で提案してください。

【対象自治体】
名称: ${jur.name} (${jur.jurisdiction_code})
種別: ${jur.jurisdiction_type}
現在の設定JSON:
${jur.local_rules_json}

【参照一次情報URL】
${params.sourceUrl}

【自治体通達テキスト・情報】
${params.noticeText}

【抽出・適用可能なキーの仕様】
- plans:
  - strict_date_sequence: boolean (アセスメント日 <= 原案日 <= 会議日 <= 同意日 <= 交付日の時系列順序の厳格チェック)
  - monitoring_frequency_months: number (モニタリング周期月数。通常6ヶ月)
  - require_user_consent_before_start: boolean (事前同意の厳格必須)
  - require_delivery_record: boolean (交付記録の必須)
- billing:
  - absence_addition_max_days_per_month: number (欠席時対応加算の月上限回数。通常4)
  - telework_requires_daily_report: boolean (在宅勤務利用者の日報提出・確認義務)
  - allow_facility_outreach: boolean (施設外支援の算定可否)
- payroll:
  - strict_minimum_wage_enforcement: boolean (最低賃金の厳格強制)
- reports:
  - offsite_work_format: string ("standard", "kobe_custom", "hyogo_standard", "tokyo_custom" 等)

提供されたテキストや根拠URLから変更が必要な部分のみを更新した「新しい設定JSON全体」と、変更サマリーを作成してください。
`.trim();

    const { object } = await generateObject({
      model: aiModel,
      schema: z.object({
        summary: z.string().describe('改定内容と根拠の日本語サマリー'),
        proposedRulesJson: z.string().describe('改定後の完全なJSON文字列'),
        verifiedSourceUrl: z.string().describe('参照した公的一次情報URL'),
      }),
      prompt,
    });

    // JSON構文の検証
    JSON.parse(object.proposedRulesJson);

    // Draftとして保存（本番ルールは書き換えない！）
    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE jurisdictions 
      SET 
        draft_rules_json = ?, 
        draft_source_url = ?, 
        draft_summary = ?, 
        draft_updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      WHERE id = ?
    `).run(object.proposedRulesJson, object.verifiedSourceUrl || params.sourceUrl, object.summary, params.jurisdictionId);

    revalidatePath('/settings/jurisdictions');
    return { 
      success: true, 
      summary: object.summary,
      draftJson: object.proposedRulesJson
    };
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.error('Error generating rule draft:', e);
    return { success: false, error: 'AIによるルール案作成に失敗しました: ' + e.message };
  }
}

/**
 * ユーザーによる変更案の承認（Human-in-the-loop Approve）
 * ユーザーが明示的にクリックした場合にのみ、draft を本番 local_rules_json に反映します。
 */
export async function approveDraftRules(jurisdictionId: string) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (role !== 'admin') return { success: false, error: '管理者権限が必要です' };

  const jur = db.prepare('SELECT draft_rules_json FROM jurisdictions WHERE id = ?').get(jurisdictionId) as { draft_rules_json: string | null } | undefined;
  if (!jur || !jur.draft_rules_json) {
    return { success: false, error: '適用可能な変更案（Draft）が存在しません' };
  }

  try {
    JSON.parse(jur.draft_rules_json);
  } catch (e) {
    return { success: false, error: 'DraftのJSON構文が無効です' };
  }

  try {
    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE jurisdictions 
      SET 
        local_rules_json = draft_rules_json,
        draft_rules_json = NULL,
        draft_source_url = NULL,
        draft_summary = NULL,
        draft_updated_at = NULL,
        updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
      WHERE id = ?
    `).run(jurisdictionId);

    revalidatePath('/settings/jurisdictions');
    revalidatePath('/settings');
    return { success: true };
  } catch (e: any) {
    return { success: false, error: e.message };
  }
}

/**
 * ユーザーによる変更案の破棄（Human-in-the-loop Reject）
 */
export async function rejectDraftRules(jurisdictionId: string) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (role !== 'admin') return { success: false, error: '管理者権限が必要です' };

  try {
    db.prepare(`
      UPDATE jurisdictions 
      SET 
        draft_rules_json = NULL,
        draft_source_url = NULL,
        draft_summary = NULL,
        draft_updated_at = NULL
      WHERE id = ?
    `).run(jurisdictionId);

    revalidatePath('/settings/jurisdictions');
    return { success: true };
  } catch (e: any) {
    return { success: false, error: e.message };
  }
}

'use server';

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import iconv from "iconv-lite";
import { parse } from "csv-parse/sync";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";

export async function uploadMasterCsv(formData: FormData) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (role !== 'admin') return { success: false, error: "管理者権限が必要です", count: 0 };

    const file = formData.get("file") as File;
    if (!file) return { success: false, error: "ファイルが選択されていません", count: 0 };

    // File size check (50MB)
    if (file.size > 50 * 1024 * 1024) {
      return { success: false, error: "ファイルサイズが上限（50MB）を超えています", count: 0 };
    }

    // File extension check (.csv only)
    if (!file.name.toLowerCase().endsWith('.csv')) {
      return { success: false, error: "CSVファイル（.csv）のみアップロード可能です", count: 0 };
    }

    const buffer = Buffer.from(await file.arrayBuffer());
    
    // WAM NET CSV is typically Shift_JIS
    const decodedStr = iconv.decode(buffer, 'Shift_JIS');

    // Parse CSV
    const records = parse(decodedStr, {
      skip_empty_lines: true,
      relax_column_count: true,
    });

    // Bulk insert
    const stmt = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO service_code_master (service_type_code, service_item_code, service_name, unit_score)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
      ON CONFLICT(service_type_code, service_item_code) 
      DO UPDATE SET service_name = excluded.service_name, unit_score = excluded.unit_score
    `);

    const insertMany = db.transaction((rows: any[]) => {
      let importedCount = 0;
      for (const row of rows) {
        const serviceType = row[1]?.trim();
        const serviceItem = row[2]?.trim();
        const serviceName = row[6]?.trim() || row[7]?.trim(); // Fallback
        
        // Service Type 43 (就労継続支援A型) and 45/37 (就労継続支援B型)
        const validServiceTypes = ['43', '45', '37'];
        if (validServiceTypes.includes(serviceType) && serviceItem && serviceItem.length === 4) {
          let unitScore = 0;
          for (let i = 7; i <= 15; i++) {
            if (row[i]) {
              const parsed = parseInt(row[i].trim(), 10);
              if (!isNaN(parsed) && parsed > 0 && parsed < 10000) {
                unitScore = parsed;
                break;
              }
            }
          }
          
          stmt.run(serviceType, serviceItem, serviceName, unitScore);
          importedCount++;
        }
      }
      return importedCount;
    });

    const count = insertMany(records);
    revalidatePath('/settings/master');
    return { success: true, count };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Failed to upload master CSV:", error);
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "CSVのインポートに失敗しました", count: 0 };
  }
}

export async function getMasterStats() {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (role !== 'admin') return null;
    
    const countRow = db.prepare(`SELECT COUNT(*) as count FROM service_code_master`).get() as { count: number };
    const latestRow = db.prepare(`SELECT created_at FROM service_code_master ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 1`).get() as { created_at: string } | undefined;
    
    return {
      count: countRow.count,
      lastUpdated: latestRow?.created_at || null
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Failed to get master stats:", error);
    return null;
  }
}

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { deleteOffsiteWorkplace } from './actions';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

export function DeleteWorkplaceButton({ id, name }: { id: string; name: string }) {
  const [isDeleting, setIsDeleting] = useState(false);

  const handleDelete = async () => {
    if (!confirm(`就労先「${name}」を削除してもよろしいですか？`)) {
      return;
    }

    try {
      setIsDeleting(true);
      const res: any = await deleteOffsiteWorkplace(id);
      if (res && !res.success) {
        toast.error(res.error || '削除に失敗しました');
        return;
      }
      toast.success('就労先を削除しました');
    } catch (err: any) {
      toast.error(err.message || '削除に失敗しました');
    } finally {
      setIsDeleting(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <Button
      variant="ghost"
      size="icon"
      type="button"
      disabled={isDeleting}
      onClick={handleDelete}
      className="text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/10"
      title="削除"
    >
      <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
    </Button>
  );
}

'use server';

import { db, resolveServiceModeForTableRecord } from '@/lib/db';
import { randomUUID } from 'crypto';
import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache';
import { getRole } from '@/lib/auth';

export async function getOffsiteWorkplaces() {
  try {
    return db.prepare('SELECT * FROM offsite_workplaces WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC').all() as any[];
  } catch (e) {
    console.error("Failed to get offsite workplaces:", e);
    return [];
  }
}

export async function addOffsiteWorkplace(formData: FormData) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (role !== 'admin' && role !== 'service_manager') {
      return { success: false, error: '管理者またはサビ管権限が必要です' };
    }

    const name = formData.get('name') as string;
    const company_name = formData.get('company_name') as string;
    const address = formData.get('address') as string;
    const contact_person = formData.get('contact_person') as string;
    const contact_phone = formData.get('contact_phone') as string;

    if (!name) return { success: false, error: '就労先名が必要です' };

    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO offsite_workplaces (id, name, company_name, address, contact_person, contact_phone)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `).run(randomUUID(), name, company_name, address, contact_person, contact_phone);

    try {
      revalidatePath('/settings/offsite');
    } catch (e) {}

    return { success: true };
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.error("Failed to add offsite workplace:", e);
    return { success: false, error: e.message || '施設外就労先の追加に失敗しました' };
  }
}

export async function deleteOffsiteWorkplace(id: string) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (role !== 'admin' && role !== 'service_manager') {
      return { success: false, error: '管理者またはサビ管権限が必要です' };
    }

    await resolveServiceModeForTableRecord('offsite_workplaces', id);

    // Check if it's used
    const used = db.prepare('SELECT id FROM attendance_records WHERE offsite_workplace_id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1').get(id);
    if (used) {
      return { success: false, error: 'すでに実績記録（勤怠）で使用されているため削除できません。' };
    }

    db.prepare('UPDATE offsite_workplaces SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?').run(id);

    try {
      revalidatePath('/settings/offsite');
    } catch (e) {}

    return { success: true };
  } catch (e: any) {
    console.error("Failed to delete offsite workplace:", e);
    return { success: false, error: e.message || '施設外就労先の削除に失敗しました' };
  }
}

import { Header } from "@/components/Header"
import { ManagementSubNav } from "@/components/NavigationTabs"
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card"
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { getFacilitySettings } from "./actions"
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth"
import { getServiceMode } from "@/lib/serviceModeServer"
import { loginAsAdminToSettings } from "@/app/login/actions"
import Link from "next/link"
import { db } from "@/lib/db"
import { ShieldAlert } from "lucide-react"
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

import { SettingsTypeA } from "./components/SettingsTypeA"
import { SettingsTypeB } from "./components/SettingsTypeB"
import { SettingsGH } from "./components/SettingsGH"
import { SettingsHouday } from "./components/SettingsHouday"
import { SettingsCorporate } from "./components/SettingsCorporate"

export default async function SettingsPage(props: { searchParams?: Promise<{ success?: string; msg?: string; error?: string }> }) {
  const role = await getRole();
  const serviceMode = await getServiceMode();
  const isAdmin = role === 'admin';

  if (!isAdmin) {
    return (
      <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background/50">
        <Header activePage="settings" />
        <main className="flex-1 p-6 md:p-12 flex items-center justify-center">
          <Card className="max-w-md w-full shadow-md border-amber-200 bg-amber-50/40">
            <CardHeader className="text-center">
              <div className="mx-auto mb-3 flex h-14 w-14 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-amber-100 text-amber-800">
                <ShieldAlert className="h-7 w-7" />
              </div>
              <CardTitle className="text-xl font-bold text-amber-950">管理者権限が必要です</CardTitle>
              <CardDescription className="text-sm text-amber-900 mt-2 font-medium">
                事業所の基本情報や各種加算体制等のシステム設定は「管理者」のみ変更可能です。（現在のログイン権限: {role === 'service_manager' ? 'サービス管理責任者' : '一般支援員'}）
              </CardDescription>
            </CardHeader>
            <CardContent className="space-y-3 pt-2">
              <form action={loginAsAdminToSettings}>
                <Button type="submit" className="w-full h-12 text-base font-bold shadow-sm">
                  管理者としてログインして設定を開く
                </Button>
              </form>
              <Link
                href="/"
                className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant: "outline" }), "w-full h-12 text-base flex items-center justify-center")}
              >
                ホーム画面に戻る
              </Link>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>
        </main>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const searchParams = await props.searchParams;
  const errorMsg = searchParams?.error;
  const successMsg = searchParams?.msg;

  // A型 / B型用の施設設定取得
  const settings = (serviceMode === 'type_a' || serviceMode === 'type_b') ? (await getFacilitySettings() || {}) : {};

  // A型用: 重度障害者支援加算の50%要件チェック用の集計
  let severeStats = undefined;
  if (serviceMode === 'type_a') {
    try {
      const clients = db.prepare('SELECT disability_class FROM clients WHERE deleted_at IS NULL').all() as any[];
      const totalClients = clients.length;
      let class3PlusCount = 0;
      let class4PlusCount = 0;
      for (const c of clients) {
        const dc = c.disability_class || '';
        if (dc.includes('3') || dc.includes('4') || dc.includes('5') || dc.includes('6')) {
          class3PlusCount++;
        }
        if (dc.includes('4') || dc.includes('5') || dc.includes('6')) {
          class4PlusCount++;
        }
      }
      const ratioClass3Plus = totalClients > 0 ? Math.round((class3PlusCount / totalClients) * 100) : 0;
      const ratioClass4Plus = totalClients > 0 ? Math.round((class4PlusCount / totalClients) * 100) : 0;
      const severeSetting = settings.severe_disability_addition || 'none';
      const isSevereWarning = 
        (severeSetting === 'I' && ratioClass4Plus < 50) ||
        (severeSetting === 'II' && ratioClass3Plus < 50);

      severeStats = {
        totalClients,
        ratioClass4Plus,
        ratioClass3Plus,
        class4PlusCount,
        class3PlusCount,
        isSevereWarning,
      };
    } catch (e) {
      // ignore
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background/50">
      <Header activePage="settings" />
      <ManagementSubNav />
      <main className="flex-1 p-3.5 sm:p-6 md:p-12">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-4xl space-y-8">
          {/* 制度別 物理完全分離ディスパッチャ（Vertical Slice Architecture） */}
          {serviceMode === 'type_a' && (
            <SettingsTypeA
              settings={settings}
              errorMsg={errorMsg}
              successMsg={successMsg}
              severeStats={severeStats}
            />
          )}

          {serviceMode === 'type_b' && (
            <SettingsTypeB
              settings={settings}
              errorMsg={errorMsg}
              successMsg={successMsg}
            />
          )}

          {serviceMode === 'gh' && (
            <SettingsGH
              errorMsg={errorMsg}
              successMsg={successMsg}
            />
          )}

          {serviceMode === 'houday' && (
            <SettingsHouday
              errorMsg={errorMsg}
              successMsg={successMsg}
            />
          )}

          {serviceMode === 'corporate' && (
            <SettingsCorporate
              errorMsg={errorMsg}
              successMsg={successMsg}
            />
          )}
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

export function StaffClient({ initialStaff, isAdmin, departments = [] }: { initialStaff: any[], isAdmin: boolean, departments?: any[] }) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);

  const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);

    qualifications: "",

    ptoGranted: 0,

    employmentType: "常勤",
    fteRatio: 1.0,

    jobCategory: "その他",
    workStartTime: "09:00",

    if (role === 'life_support_worker') return '生活支援員';
    if (role === 'service_manager') return 'サービス管理責任者';
