    if (role === 'admin_and_service_manager') return '管理者 兼 サービス管理責任者';
    if (role === 'wage_improvement_instructor') return '賃金向上達成指導員';
    if (role === 'visual_auditory_specialist') return '視覚・聴覚言語障害者支援指導員';
    if (role === 'severe_disability_specialist') return '重度者支援専門員';
    if (role === 'driver') return '送迎ドライバー';
    if (role === 'cook') return '調理員';
    if (role === 'clerk') return '事務員';
    return jobCat || 'その他';
  };

  const handleEdit = (staff: any) => {
    let holidays = [];
    try { holidays = JSON.parse(staff.regular_holidays || "[]"); } catch (e) {}
    const effJobCat = getEffectiveJobCategory(staff.job_category, staff.role);
    setFormData({
      name: staff.name,
      role: normalizeRole(staff.role, effJobCat),
      departmentId: staff.department_id || "",
      qualifications: staff.qualifications || "",
      weeklyHours: staff.weekly_hours || 40,
      ptoGranted: staff.pto_granted || 0,
      regularHolidays: holidays,
      employmentType: staff.employment_type || "常勤",
      fteRatio: staff.fte_ratio !== undefined ? staff.fte_ratio : 1.0,
      hireDate: staff.hire_date || "",
      jobCategory: effJobCat,
      workStartTime: staff.work_start_time || "09:00",
      workEndTime: staff.work_end_time || "18:00",
      breakTimeMinutes: staff.break_time_minutes !== undefined && staff.break_time_minutes !== null ? staff.break_time_minutes : 60,
      isConcurrent: !!staff.is_concurrent,
      concurrentFacility: staff.concurrent_facility || ""
    });
    setEditingId(staff.id);
    setIsEditing(true);
  };

  const handleAdd = () => {
    setFormData({
      name: "",
      role: "staff",
      departmentId: "",
      qualifications: "",
      weeklyHours: 40,
      ptoGranted: 0,
      regularHolidays: [],
      employmentType: "常勤",
      fteRatio: 1.0,
      hireDate: "",
      jobCategory: "職業指導員",
      workStartTime: "09:00",
      workEndTime: "18:00",
      breakTimeMinutes: 60,
      isConcurrent: false,
      concurrentFacility: ""
    });
    setEditingId(null);
    setIsEditing(true);
  };

  const handleJobCategoryChange = (newCat: string) => {
    setFormData(prev => {
      let newRole = prev.role;
      if (newCat === '管理者' || newCat === '管理者 兼 サービス管理責任者') {
        newRole = 'admin';
      } else if (newCat === 'サービス管理責任者') {
        newRole = 'service_manager';
      } else if (prev.role === 'admin' || prev.role === 'service_manager') {
        newRole = 'staff';
      }
      return {
        ...prev,
        jobCategory: newCat,
        role: newRole
      };
    });
  };

  const handleCancel = () => {
    setIsEditing(false);
    setEditingId(null);
  };

  const departmentItems = [
    { value: "none", label: "未所属（事業所全体・共通）" },
    ...departments.map((d: any) => ({ value: d.id, label: d.name }))
  ];

  const jobCategoryItems = [
    { value: "職業指導員", label: "職業指導員（直接処遇・基本配置対象）" },
    { value: "生活支援員", label: "生活支援員（直接処遇・基本配置対象）" },
    { value: "サービス管理責任者", label: "サービス管理責任者（専任）" },
    { value: "管理者", label: "管理者（専任）" },
    { value: "管理者 兼 サービス管理責任者", label: "管理者 兼 サービス管理責任者" },
    { value: "賃金向上達成指導員", label: "賃金向上達成指導員（加算専任・別枠配置）" },
    { value: "視覚・聴覚言語障害者支援指導員", label: "視覚・聴覚言語障害者支援指導員（加算別枠）" },
    { value: "重度者支援専門員", label: "重度者支援専門員（加算別枠）" },
    { value: "送迎ドライバー", label: "送迎ドライバー（運転手・別枠）" },
    { value: "調理員", label: "調理員（食事提供・別枠）" },
    { value: "事務員", label: "事務員（総務・経理・別枠）" },
    { value: "その他", label: "その他（直接処遇外）" }
  ];

  const roleItems = [
    { value: "admin", label: "管理者（全機能・設定・請求・マスタ等の編集）" },
    { value: "service_manager", label: "サービス管理責任者（個別支援計画・支援の管理）" },
    { value: "staff", label: "一般職員（日々の支援記録・日報・出退勤入力）" }
  ];

  const employmentTypeItems = [
    { value: "常勤", label: "常勤" },
    { value: "非常勤", label: "非常勤" }
  ];

  const toggleHoliday = (val: string) => {
    setFormData(prev => ({
      ...prev,
      regularHolidays: prev.regularHolidays.includes(val) 
        ? prev.regularHolidays.filter(d => d !== val)
        : [...prev.regularHolidays, val]
    }));
  };

  const handleSave = async (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    if (!isAdmin) {
      toast.error("管理者権限が必要です");
      return;
    }
    if (isSaving) return;

    try {
      setIsSaving(true);
      if (editingId) {
        const res = await updateStaff(editingId, formData);
        if (res.success) {
          toast.success("職員情報を更新しました");
          setIsEditing(false);
          router.refresh();
        } else {
          toast.error(res.error || "更新に失敗しました");
        }
      } else {
        const res = await createStaff(formData);
        if (res.success) {
          toast.success("職員を登録しました");
          setIsEditing(false);
          router.refresh();
        } else {
          toast.error(res.error || "登録に失敗しました");
        }
      }
    } catch (err) {
      console.error(err);
      toast.error("エラーが発生しました");
    } finally {
      setIsSaving(false);
    }
  };

  const handleDelete = async (id: string, name: string) => {
    if (!isAdmin) return;
    if (!confirm(`職員「${name}」を削除しますか？この操作は元に戻せません。`)) return;
    
    const res = await deleteStaff(id);
    if (res.success) {
      toast.success("削除しました");
      router.refresh();
    } else {
      toast.error(res.error || "削除に失敗しました");
    }
  };

  const sortedStaff = useMemo(() => {
    return [...initialStaff].sort((a, b) => {
      if (sortOrder === 'hire_asc' || sortOrder === 'hire_desc') {
        const dateA = a.hire_date || '';
        const dateB = b.hire_date || '';
        if (!dateA && !dateB) return (a.name || '').localeCompare(b.name || '', 'ja');
        if (!dateA) return 1;
        if (!dateB) return -1;
        const cmp = dateA.localeCompare(dateB);
        return sortOrder === 'hire_asc' ? cmp : -cmp;
      }
      if (sortOrder === 'name_asc') {
        return (a.name || '').localeCompare(b.name || '', 'ja');
      }
      return (a.created_at || '').localeCompare(b.created_at || '');
    });
  }, [initialStaff, sortOrder]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6">
      <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row justify-between items-start sm:items-center gap-3">
        <h2 className="text-2xl font-bold">職員マスタ</h2>
        {!isEditing && (
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5 flex-wrap">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 bg-background border rounded-lg px-2.5 py-1.5 shadow-2xs">
              <ArrowUpDown className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-muted-foreground shrink-0" />
              <span className="text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground whitespace-nowrap">並び順:</span>
              <select
                value={sortOrder}
                onChange={e => setSortOrder(e.target.value as any)}
                className="bg-transparent text-xs font-semibold focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
              >
                <option value="hire_asc">入社日順 (古い順)</option>
                <option value="hire_desc">入社日順 (新しい順)</option>
                <option value="name_asc">五十音順 (氏名)</option>
                <option value="created_asc">登録順</option>
              </select>
            </div>
            {isAdmin && (
              <Button onClick={handleAdd} className="gap-2 shadow-xs">
                <Plus className="h-4 w-4" />
                新規登録
              </Button>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      {isEditing ? (
        <Card className="border-primary/20 shadow-md">
          <CardHeader>
            <CardTitle>{editingId ? "職員情報の編集" : "職員の新規登録"}</CardTitle>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent>
            <form onSubmit={handleSave} className="space-y-4">
              <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2">
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>氏名</Label>
                  <Input 
                    required 
                    value={formData.name}
                    onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, name: e.target.value})}
                    placeholder="例: 山田 太郎"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>所属部署・拠点</Label>
                  <Select 
                    items={departmentItems}
                    value={formData.departmentId || "none"} 
                    onValueChange={v => setFormData({...formData, departmentId: v === "none" ? "" : (v as string)})}
                  >
                    <SelectTrigger className="w-full">
                      <SelectValue placeholder="未所属（事業所共通）">
                        {(val: string) => {
                          if (!val || val === "none") return "未所属（事業所全体・共通）";
                          const found = departments.find((d: any) => d.id === val);
                          return found ? found.name : val;
                        }}
                      </SelectValue>
                    </SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent className="min-w-[280px] sm:min-w-[340px]">
                      <SelectItem value="none">未所属（事業所全体・共通）</SelectItem>
                      {departments.map((d: any) => (
                        <SelectItem key={d.id} value={d.id}>{d.name}</SelectItem>
                      ))}
                    </SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>職種区分 (業務・法令人員配置用)</Label>
                  <Select 
                    items={jobCategoryItems}
                    value={formData.jobCategory} 
                    onValueChange={(v: string | null) => handleJobCategoryChange(v || "職業指導員")}
                  >
                    <SelectTrigger className="w-full">
                      <SelectValue>
                        {(val: string) => {
                          const found = jobCategoryItems.find(item => item.value === val);
                          return found ? found.label : val;
                        }}
                      </SelectValue>
                    </SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent className="min-w-[300px] sm:min-w-[380px]">
                      {jobCategoryItems.map(item => (
                        <SelectItem key={item.value} value={item.value}>{item.label}</SelectItem>
                      ))}
                    </SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <Label>システム操作権限 (ログイン権限)</Label>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">※職種から自動設定</span>
                  </div>
                  <Select 
                    items={roleItems}
                    value={formData.role || "staff"} 
                    onValueChange={v => setFormData({...formData, role: v as string})}
                  >
                    <SelectTrigger className="w-full">
                      <SelectValue>
                        {(val: string) => {
                          const found = roleItems.find(item => item.value === val);
                          return found ? found.label : val;
                        }}
                      </SelectValue>
                    </SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent className="min-w-[280px] sm:min-w-[340px]">
                      {roleItems.map(item => (
                        <SelectItem key={item.value} value={item.value}>{item.label}</SelectItem>
                      ))}
                    </SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2 md:col-span-2">
                  <Label>保有資格 (任意)</Label>
                  <Input 
                    value={formData.qualifications}
                    onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, qualifications: e.target.value})}
                    placeholder="例: 介護福祉士、社会福祉士、精神保健福祉士、公認心理師"
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>雇用形態</Label>
                  <Select 
                    items={employmentTypeItems}
                    value={formData.employmentType} 
                    onValueChange={(v: string | null) => setFormData({...formData, employmentType: v || "常勤"})}
                  >
                    <SelectTrigger className="w-full">
                      <SelectValue />
                    </SelectTrigger>
                    <SelectContent className="min-w-[200px]">
                      <SelectItem value="常勤">常勤</SelectItem>
                      <SelectItem value="非常勤">非常勤</SelectItem>
                    </SelectContent>
                  </Select>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>常勤換算値</Label>
                  <Input 
                    type="number"
                    min="0"
                    step="0.1"
                    value={formData.fteRatio}
                    onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, fteRatio: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0})}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>雇用開始日</Label>
                  <Input 
                    type="date"
                    value={formData.hireDate}
                    onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, hireDate: e.target.value})}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>契約週労働時間 (常勤換算用)</Label>
                  <Input 
                    type="number"
                    min="1"
                    max="60"
                    step="0.5"
                    value={formData.weeklyHours}
                    onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, weeklyHours: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 40})}
                    placeholder="例: 40"
                  />
                </div>
                                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>有給休暇 付与日数 (今年度)</Label>
                  <Input 
                    type="number" 
                    min="0"
                    value={formData.ptoGranted}
                    onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, ptoGranted: parseInt(e.target.value) || 0})}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>所定勤務時間（始業 〜 終業）</Label>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Input 
                      type="time" 
                      value={formData.workStartTime}
                      onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, workStartTime: e.target.value})}
                      className="w-full"
                    />
                    <span className="text-muted-foreground font-medium">〜</span>
                    <Input 
                      type="time" 
                      value={formData.workEndTime}
                      onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, workEndTime: e.target.value})}
                      className="w-full"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">※シフト未登録時の標準時間として自動推計（個別日変更可）</span>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-2">
                  <Label>休憩時間 (分)</Label>
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <Input 
                      type="number" 
                      min="0"
                      max="180"
                      step="5"
                      value={formData.breakTimeMinutes}
                      onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, breakTimeMinutes: parseInt(e.target.value) || 0})}
                      className="w-full"
                    />
                    <span className="text-sm text-muted-foreground whitespace-nowrap">分</span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                {/* 兼務設定（他事業所との兼務・二重計上防止） */}
                <div className="space-y-3 md:col-span-2 p-4 bg-purple-50/60 rounded-lg border border-purple-200">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                    <input 
                      type="checkbox" 
                      id="isConcurrent"
                      className="w-4 h-4 rounded border-purple-300 text-purple-600 focus:ring-purple-500 cursor-pointer"
                      checked={formData.isConcurrent}
                      onChange={e => setFormData({
                        ...formData, 
                        isConcurrent: e.target.checked,
                        fteRatio: e.target.checked && formData.fteRatio === 1.0 ? 0.5 : formData.fteRatio
                      })}
                    />
                    <label htmlFor="isConcurrent" className="text-sm font-bold text-purple-900 cursor-pointer">
                      グループホームや他事業所と兼務している（人員配置二重計上防止・按分設定）
                    </label>
                  </div>
                  
                  {formData.isConcurrent && (
                    <div className="grid gap-4 md:grid-cols-2 pt-2 border-t border-purple-200/60">
                      <div className="space-y-1.5">
                        <Label className="text-xs text-purple-900 font-semibold">兼務先事業所名（例: グループホーム須磨、B型等）</Label>
                        <Input 
                          value={formData.concurrentFacility}
                          onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, concurrentFacility: e.target.value})}
                          placeholder="例: グループホーム〇〇"
                          className="bg-white"
                        />
                      </div>
                      <div className="space-y-1.5">
                        <Label className="text-xs text-purple-900 font-semibold">
                          A型事業所への配置割合 (常勤換算按分比率: 0.1〜1.0)
                        </Label>
                        <Input 
                          type="number"
                          min="0.1"
                          max="1.0"
                          step="0.05"
                          value={formData.fteRatio}
                          onChange={e => setFormData({...formData, fteRatio: parseFloat(e.target.value) || 0.5})}
                          className="bg-white"
                        />
                        <span className="text-[11px] text-purple-700">
                          ※半々兼務なら 0.5、週3日A型なら 0.6 を指定
                        </span>
                      </div>
                      <div className="md:col-span-2 text-xs text-purple-800 bg-white/70 p-2.5 rounded border border-purple-200">
                        <p className="font-semibold">💡 実地指導（行政指導）対策・法令遵守メモ:</p>
                        <p className="mt-1">
                          職員シフト表で「GH勤務」または「他事業所」と入力した日は、A型の人員配置計算から<strong>自動的に除外</strong>され二重計上（法令違反・返還対象）を確実に防ぎます。またシフト未登録時の自動推計でも上記の配置割合（{formData.fteRatio}）で按分計算されます。
                        </p>
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>

                <div className="space-y-2 md:col-span-2">
                  <Label>公休（曜日固定）</Label>
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-4 pt-2">
                    {DAYS.map(day => (
                      <label key={day.value} className="flex items-center gap-2 cursor-pointer">
                        <input 
                          type="checkbox" 
                          className="w-4 h-4 rounded border-gray-300 text-primary focus:ring-primary"
                          checked={formData.regularHolidays.includes(day.value)}
                          onChange={() => toggleHoliday(day.value)}
                        />
                        <span className="text-sm">{day.label}</span>
                      </label>
                    ))}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-end gap-2 pt-4">
                <Button type="button" variant="outline" disabled={isSaving} onClick={handleCancel}>キャンセル</Button>
                <Button type="submit" disabled={isSaving}>
                  {isSaving ? "保存中..." : "保存する"}
                </Button>
              </div>
            </form>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      ) : (
        <Card>
          <CardContent className="p-0">
            <div className="overflow-x-auto">
              <table className="w-full text-sm text-left min-w-[700px]">
                <thead className="bg-muted text-muted-foreground">
                  <tr>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">氏名</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">職種 / 操作権限</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">保有資格</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">所定勤務 / 休憩</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">契約週時間 / 常勤換算</th>
                    <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">有給付与</th>
                    {isAdmin && <th className="px-4 py-3 font-medium text-right">操作</th>}
                  </tr>
                </thead>
                <tbody className="divide-y divide-border">
                  {sortedStaff.length === 0 ? (
                    <tr>
                      <td colSpan={6} className="px-4 py-8 text-center text-muted-foreground">
                        登録されている職員はいません
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  ) : (
                    sortedStaff.map(staff => {
                      const effJobCat = getEffectiveJobCategory(staff.job_category, staff.role);
                      const effRole = normalizeRole(staff.role, effJobCat);

                      return (
                        <tr key={staff.id} className="hover:bg-muted/50">
                          <td className="px-4 py-3 font-medium">
                            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1">
                              <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                                <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{staff.name}</span>
                                {staff.department_name ? (
                                  <span className="inline-flex items-center w-fit px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[11px] font-medium bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200">
                                    {staff.department_name}
                                  </span>
                                ) : (
                                  <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">未所属（共通）</span>
                                )}
                                {staff.hire_date && (
                                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] font-medium text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded border border-emerald-200" title="入社年月日">
                                    <Calendar className="w-3 h-3 text-emerald-600" />
                                    入社: {staff.hire_date}
                                  </span>
                                )}
                              </div>
                              {staff.is_concurrent ? (
                                <span 
                                  className="inline-flex items-center w-fit px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px] font-semibold bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 border border-purple-200"
                                  title="他事業所兼務（GH勤務等でシフト除外、推計時按分）"
                                >
                                  兼務: {staff.concurrent_facility || '他事業所'} (A型比率: {staff.fte_ratio !== undefined ? staff.fte_ratio : 1.0})
                                </span>
                              ) : null}
                            </div>
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3">
                            <div className="flex flex-col gap-1.5 items-start">
                              <span className={cn(
                                "inline-flex items-center px-2 py-0.5 rounded text-xs font-semibold",
                                effJobCat === '職業指導員' ? "bg-blue-100 text-blue-800 border border-blue-200" :
                                effJobCat === '生活支援員' ? "bg-green-100 text-green-800 border border-green-200" :
                                effJobCat === 'サービス管理責任者' ? "bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 border border-purple-200" :
                                effJobCat === '管理者' ? "bg-red-100 text-red-800 border border-red-200" :
                                effJobCat === '管理者 兼 サービス管理責任者' ? "bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800 border border-indigo-200" :
                                effJobCat === '賃金向上達成指導員' ? "bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 border border-amber-300" :
                                effJobCat === '視覚・聴覚言語障害者支援指導員' ? "bg-cyan-100 text-cyan-800 border border-cyan-200" :
                                effJobCat === '重度者支援専門員' ? "bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border border-rose-200" :
                                effJobCat === '送迎ドライバー' ? "bg-orange-100 text-orange-800 border border-orange-200" :
                                effJobCat === '調理員' ? "bg-yellow-100 text-yellow-800 border border-yellow-200" :
                                effJobCat === '事務員' ? "bg-slate-100 text-slate-800 border border-slate-200" :
                                "bg-gray-100 text-gray-800"
                              )}>
                                {effJobCat}
                              </span>
                              {effRole === 'admin' ? (
                                <span className="inline-flex items-center text-[11px] text-red-700 font-medium bg-red-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-red-200">
                                  🛡️ 管理者権限
                                </span>
                              ) : effRole === 'service_manager' ? (
                                <span className="inline-flex items-center text-[11px] text-purple-700 font-medium bg-purple-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-purple-200">
                                  📋 サビ管権限
                                </span>
                              ) : (
                                <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                                  一般職員権限
                                </span>
                              )}
                            </div>
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3">{staff.qualifications || '-'}</td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3">
                            <div className="flex flex-col">
                              <span className="font-semibold text-foreground">{staff.work_start_time || '09:00'} 〜 {staff.work_end_time || '18:00'}</span>
                              <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">休憩: {staff.break_time_minutes !== undefined && staff.break_time_minutes !== null ? staff.break_time_minutes : 60}分</span>
                            </div>
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3">
                            <div className="flex flex-col">
                              <div className="flex items-center">
                                <span className="font-medium">{staff.weekly_hours || 40}h/週</span>
                                <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground ml-1.5">({((staff.weekly_hours || 40) / 40).toFixed(2)} FTE)</span>
                              </div>
                              {staff.is_concurrent ? (
                                <span className="text-[10px] text-purple-700 font-medium">
                                  A型按分: {(((staff.weekly_hours || 40) / 40) * (staff.fte_ratio !== undefined ? staff.fte_ratio : 1.0)).toFixed(2)} FTE
                                </span>
                              ) : null}
                            </div>
                          </td>
                          <td className="px-4 py-3 text-center">
                            <div className="flex flex-col">
                              <span className="font-medium text-primary">残: {Math.max(0, (staff.pto_granted || 0) - (staff.pto_used || 0))}日</span>
                              <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">
                                付与:{staff.pto_granted || 0} / 消化:{staff.pto_used || 0}
                              </span>
                            </div>
                          </td>
                          {isAdmin && (
                            <td className="px-4 py-3 text-right">
                              <div className="flex justify-end gap-2">
                                <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" onClick={() => handleEdit(staff)}>
                                  <Pencil className="h-4 w-4" />
                                </Button>
                                <Button variant="ghost" size="icon" className="text-destructive" onClick={() => handleDelete(staff.id, staff.name)}>
                                  <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" />
                                </Button>
                              </div>
                            </td>
                          )}
                        </tr>
                      );
                    })
                  )}
                </tbody>
              </table>
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

'use server';

import { db, resolveServiceModeForStaff, sanitizeForeignKeyId } from "@/lib/db";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { randomUUID } from "crypto";
import { revalidatePath } from "next/cache";
import { consumeStaffPtoDays, restoreStaffPtoDays } from "@/app/attendance/pto/actions";

// === Staff Master ===

export async function getStaffList() {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role) return [];

    const staff = db.prepare(`
      SELECT s.*, d.name as department_name
      FROM staff s
      LEFT JOIN departments d ON s.department_id = d.id
      WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL 
      ORDER BY 
        CASE WHEN s.hire_date IS NOT NULL AND s.hire_date != '' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END ASC,
        s.hire_date ASC,
        s.created_at ASC
    `).all() as any[];
    const ptoUsage = await getStaffPtoUsage();
    
    return staff.map(s => ({
      ...s,
      pto_used: ptoUsage[s.id] || 0
    }));
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Failed to fetch staff:", error);
    return [];
  }
}

export async function getStaffPtoUsage() {
  try {
    const rows = db.prepare(`
      SELECT staff_id, COUNT(*) as used_days
      FROM staff_shifts
      WHERE is_holiday = 1 AND holiday_type = '有給休暇'
      GROUP BY staff_id
    `).all() as any[];
    
    const usageMap: Record<string, number> = {};
    for (const row of rows) {
      usageMap[row.staff_id] = row.used_days;
    }
    return usageMap;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Failed to fetch PTO usage:", error);
    return {};
  }
}

export async function createStaff(data: { 
  name: string; 
  role: string; 
  qualifications: string; 
  ptoGranted?: number; 
  regularHolidays?: string[]; 
  weeklyHours?: number; 
  employmentType?: string; 
  fteRatio?: number; 
  hireDate?: string; 
  jobCategory?: string; 
  departmentId?: string; 
  workStartTime?: string; 
  workEndTime?: string; 
  breakTimeMinutes?: number;
  isConcurrent?: boolean;
  concurrentFacility?: string;
}) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (role !== 'admin') return { success: false, error: "管理者権限が必要です" };

    if (!data.name || data.name.trim() === '') {
      return { success: false, error: "職員名は必須です" };
    }

    const safeDepartmentId = sanitizeForeignKeyId('departments', data.departmentId);
    const id = randomUUID();
    const stmt = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO staff (
        id, name, role, qualifications, weekly_hours, pto_granted, 
        regular_holidays, employment_type, fte_ratio, hire_date, 
        job_category, department_id, work_start_time, work_end_time, 
        break_time_minutes, is_concurrent, concurrent_facility
      )
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `);
    stmt.run(
      id, 
      data.name, 
      data.role || 'staff', 
      data.qualifications || '', 
      data.weeklyHours || 40, 
      data.ptoGranted || 0, 
      JSON.stringify(data.regularHolidays || []), 
      data.employmentType || "常勤", 
      data.fteRatio !== undefined ? data.fteRatio : 1.0, 
      data.hireDate || null, 
      data.jobCategory || "その他", 
      safeDepartmentId,
      data.workStartTime || '09:00',
      data.workEndTime || '18:00',
      data.breakTimeMinutes !== undefined ? data.breakTimeMinutes : 60,
      data.isConcurrent ? 1 : 0,
      data.concurrentFacility || null
    );

    try {
      const { logAudit } = await import('@/lib/audit');
      await logAudit({
        action: 'create',
        targetTable: 'staff',
        targetId: id,
        details: { name: data.name, role: data.role, jobCategory: data.jobCategory, departmentId: safeDepartmentId }
      });
    } catch (e) {}

    revalidatePath('/staff');
    revalidatePath('/staff/shifts');
    revalidatePath('/attendance');
    revalidatePath('/');
    return { success: true, id };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Failed to create staff:", error);
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "職員の登録に失敗しました" };
  }
}

  name: string; 
  role: string; 
  qualifications: string; 
  ptoGranted?: number; 
  regularHolidays?: string[]; 
  weeklyHours?: number; 
  employmentType?: string; 
  fteRatio?: number;

export async function deleteStaff(id: string) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (role !== 'admin') return { success: false, error: "管理者権限が必要です" };

    await resolveServiceModeForStaff(id);
    // M-1 職員の論理削除（過去のシフト・支援記録との整合性を維持）
    db.prepare('UPDATE staff SET deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = ?').run(id);

    try {
      const { logAudit } = await import('@/lib/audit');
      await logAudit({
        action: 'delete',
        targetTable: 'staff',
        targetId: id,
        details: { deleted: true }
      });
    } catch (e) {}

    revalidatePath('/staff');
    revalidatePath('/staff/shifts');
    revalidatePath('/attendance');
    revalidatePath('/');
    return { success: true };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Failed to delete staff:", error);
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "職員の削除に失敗しました" };
  }
}

export async function getStaffShifts(yearMonth: string) {
  // yearMonth format: YYYY-MM
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role) return [];

    const rows = db.prepare(`
      SELECT * FROM staff_shifts 
      WHERE target_date LIKE ?
    `).all(`${yearMonth}-%`);
    
    return rows;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Failed to fetch staff shifts:", error);
    return [];
  }
}

export async function saveStaffShift(staffId: string, targetDate: string, data: { 
  scheduled_in: string | null; 
  scheduled_out: string | null; 
  is_holiday: boolean; 
  holiday_type?: string | null;
  is_other_facility?: boolean;
  other_facility_name?: string | null;
  is_offsite?: boolean | number;
  offsite_workplace_id?: string | null;
  offsite_workplace_name?: string | null;
  work_type?: string | null;
  offsite_start_time?: string | null;
  offsite_end_time?: string | null;
  in_facility_start_time?: string | null;
  in_facility_end_time?: string | null;
}) {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role) return { success: false, error: "認証されていません" };

    await resolveServiceModeForStaff(staffId);
    const safeStaffId = sanitizeForeignKeyId('staff', staffId);
    if (!safeStaffId) {
      return { success: false, error: "対象の職員が見つかりません" };
    }
    const safeWorkplaceId = sanitizeForeignKeyId('offsite_workplaces', data.offsite_workplace_id);

    let prevWasPto = false;
    let newIsPto = false;

    db.transaction(() => {
      const existing = db.prepare('SELECT id, is_holiday, holiday_type FROM staff_shifts WHERE staff_id = ? AND target_date = ?').get(safeStaffId, targetDate) as any;
      const isPtoType = (hType?: string | null) => Boolean(hType && ['有給休暇', '有給', '有休'].includes(hType));
      prevWasPto = Boolean(existing && existing.is_holiday === 1 && isPtoType(existing.holiday_type));
      newIsPto = Boolean(data.is_holiday && isPtoType(data.holiday_type));

      const isOffsite = data.is_offsite ? 1 : (data.work_type === 'out_facility' || data.work_type === 'both' ? 1 : 0);
      const workType = data.work_type || (isOffsite ? 'out_facility' : 'in_facility');
      
      if (existing) {
        db.prepare(`
          UPDATE staff_shifts 
          SET scheduled_in = ?, scheduled_out = ?, is_holiday = ?, holiday_type = ?, 
              is_other_facility = ?, other_facility_name = ?,
              is_offsite = ?, offsite_workplace_id = ?, offsite_workplace_name = ?,
              work_type = ?, offsite_start_time = ?, offsite_end_time = ?,
              in_facility_start_time = ?, in_facility_end_time = ?
          WHERE id = ?
        `).run(
          data.scheduled_in, 
          data.scheduled_out, 
          data.is_holiday ? 1 : 0, 
          data.holiday_type || null, 
          data.is_other_facility ? 1 : 0,
          data.other_facility_name || null,
          isOffsite,
          safeWorkplaceId,
          data.offsite_workplace_name || null,
          workType,
          data.offsite_start_time || null,
          data.offsite_end_time || null,
          data.in_facility_start_time || null,
          data.in_facility_end_time || null,
          existing.id
        );
      } else {
        db.prepare(`
          INSERT INTO staff_shifts (
            id, staff_id, target_date, scheduled_in, scheduled_out, is_holiday, holiday_type, 
            is_other_facility, other_facility_name, is_offsite, offsite_workplace_id, offsite_workplace_name,
            work_type, offsite_start_time, offsite_end_time, in_facility_start_time, in_facility_end_time
          )
          VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        `).run(
          randomUUID(), 
          safeStaffId, 
          targetDate, 
          data.scheduled_in, 
          data.scheduled_out, 
          data.is_holiday ? 1 : 0, 
          data.holiday_type || null, 
          data.is_other_facility ? 1 : 0,
          data.other_facility_name || null,
          isOffsite,
          safeWorkplaceId,
          data.offsite_workplace_name || null,
          workType,
          data.offsite_start_time || null,
          data.offsite_end_time || null,
          data.in_facility_start_time || null,
          data.in_facility_end_time || null
        );
      }
    })();

    // 職員有休の自動消費・返還連動
    try {
      if (!prevWasPto && newIsPto) {
        await consumeStaffPtoDays(safeStaffId, 1);
      } else if (prevWasPto && !newIsPto) {
        await restoreStaffPtoDays(safeStaffId, 1);
      }
    } catch (ptoErr) {
      console.error("職員有休自動消費/返還エラー:", ptoErr);
    }

    revalidatePath('/staff/shifts');
    revalidatePath('/staff');
    revalidatePath('/attendance');
    revalidatePath('/');
    return { success: true };
  } catch (error: any) {
    console.error("Failed to save shift:", error);
    return { success: false, error: error.message || "シフトの保存に失敗しました" };
  }
}
