'use client';

import { useState, useMemo } from "react";
import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Printer } from "lucide-react";
import { saveStaffShift } from "../actions";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { AutoFitText } from "@/components/AutoFitText";

export function StaffShiftsClient({ 
  initialStaff, 
  initialShifts, 
  targetYearMonth, 
  isAdmin, 
  facilitySettings,
  initialStaffingMap = {},
  departments = [],
  clients = [],
  clientShifts = []
}: { 
  initialStaff: any[], 
  initialShifts: any[], 
  targetYearMonth: string, 
  isAdmin: boolean, 
  facilitySettings?: any,
  initialStaffingMap?: Record<string, any>,
  departments?: any[],
  clients?: any[],
  clientShifts?: any[]
}) {
  const [currentMonth, setCurrentMonth] = useState(targetYearMonth);
  // local state to hold changes before saving
  const [shiftsData, setShiftsData] = useState<Record<string, Record<string, any>>>(() => {
    const data: Record<string, Record<string, any>> = {};
    initialShifts.forEach(s => {
      if (!data[s.staff_id]) data[s.staff_id] = {};
      data[s.staff_id][s.target_date] = s;
    });
    return data;
  });

  const isDirectCareStaff = (staff: any) => {
    const jobCat = staff.job_category || '';
    const role = staff.role || '';
    return ['職業指導員', '生活支援員'].includes(jobCat) || ['vocational_instructor', 'life_support_worker'].includes(role);
  };

  const staffingClass = facilitySettings?.staffing_class || '10:1';
  const ratioDenominator = staffingClass === '7.5:1' ? 7.5 : 10;
  const regularHoursPerWeek = facilitySettings?.regular_hours_per_week ? Number(facilitySettings.regular_hours_per_week) : 40;
  const dailyStandardMinutes = Math.max(240, Math.round((regularHoursPerWeek / 5) * 60)); // 1日8時間=480分

  const daysInMonth = useMemo(() => {
    const [year, month] = currentMonth.split('-').map(Number);
    return new Date(year, month, 0).getDate();
  }, [currentMonth]);

  const daysArray = useMemo(() => {
    return Array.from({ length: daysInMonth }, (_, i) => {
      const day = i + 1;
      const dateStr = `${currentMonth}-${day.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
      const [year, month] = currentMonth.split('-').map(Number);
      const dayOfWeek = new Date(year, month - 1, day).getDay(); // 0 is Sun, 6 is Sat
      return { day, dateStr, dayOfWeek };
    });
  }, [currentMonth, daysInMonth]);
  const clientShiftsMap = useMemo(() => {
    const map: Record<string, Record<string, any>> = {};
    clientShifts.forEach((s: any) => {
      if (!map[s.client_id]) map[s.client_id] = {};
      map[s.client_id][s.target_date] = s;
    });
    return map;
  }, [clientShifts]);

  // 各日の人員配置状況を内勤（事業所本体）と施設外就労（引率職員）で完全分離してリアルタイム算出
  const dailyStaffingAnalysis = useMemo(() => {
    const result: Record<string, {
      totalClientCount: number;
      inFacilityClientCount: number;
      offsiteClientCount: number;
      inFacilityRequiredMinutes: number;
      inFacilityRequiredFte: number;
      inFacilityStaffMinutes: number;
      inFacilityStaffCount: number;
      isInFacilityCompliant: boolean;
      inFacilityShortageMinutes: number;
      offsiteStaffCount: number;
      offsiteStaffMinutes: number;
      isOffsiteCompliant: boolean;
      totalRequiredMinutes: number;
      totalStaffMinutes: number;
      isOverallCompliant: boolean;
      clientCount: number;
      requiredMinutes: number;
      actualStaffMinutes: number;
      isCompliant: boolean;
      shortageMinutes: number;
    }> = {};

    daysArray.forEach(d => {
      // 1. 利用者数の集計（内勤 vs 施設外就労）
      let inFacilityClientCount = 0;
      let offsiteClientCount = 0;

      if (clients && clients.length > 0) {
        clients.forEach((c: any) => {
          const cShift = clientShiftsMap[c.id]?.[d.dateStr];
          let isAttending = false;
          let isOffsiteClient = false;

          if (cShift) {
            if (!cShift.is_holiday && (cShift.scheduled_in || cShift.work_type)) {
              isAttending = true;
              if (cShift.work_type === 'both') {
                offsiteClientCount++;
                inFacilityClientCount++;
              } else if (cShift.work_type === 'out_facility' || cShift.is_offsite === 1) {
                offsiteClientCount++;
              } else {
                inFacilityClientCount++;
              }
            }
          } else {
            try {
              const arr = JSON.parse(c.regular_holidays || '[]');
              const dObj = new Date(d.dateStr);
              if (!arr.includes(dObj.getDay().toString())) {
                isAttending = true;
                inFacilityClientCount++;
              }
            } catch(e) {}
          }
        });
      } else {
        const initialInfo = initialStaffingMap[d.dateStr];
        inFacilityClientCount = initialInfo?.inFacilityClientCount ?? initialInfo?.clientPresentCount ?? 0;
        offsiteClientCount = initialInfo?.offsiteClientCount ?? 0;
      }

      const totalClientCount = inFacilityClientCount + offsiteClientCount;

      // 2. 内勤の必要職員時間（施設外利用者は内勤必要人数の分母から除外）
      const inFacilityRequiredFte = inFacilityClientCount > 0 
        ? Math.round((inFacilityClientCount / ratioDenominator) * 100) / 100 
        : 0;
      const inFacilityRequiredMinutes = Math.round(inFacilityRequiredFte * dailyStandardMinutes);

      const totalRequiredFte = totalClientCount > 0
        ? Math.round((totalClientCount / ratioDenominator) * 100) / 100
        : 0;
      const totalRequiredMinutes = Math.round(totalRequiredFte * dailyStandardMinutes);

      // 3. 職員の勤務時間を集計（内勤直接処遇 vs 施設外引率職員）
      let inFacilityStaffMinutes = 0;
      let inFacilityStaffCount = 0;
      let offsiteStaffMinutes = 0;
      let offsiteStaffCount = 0;

      initialStaff.forEach(s => {
        if (!isDirectCareStaff(s)) return;

        let shift = shiftsData[s.id]?.[d.dateStr];
        if (!shift) {
          try {
            const arr = JSON.parse(s.regular_holidays || "[]");
            const dObj = new Date(d.dateStr);
            if (arr.includes(dObj.getDay().toString())) {
              shift = { is_holiday: 1, holiday_type: '公休' };
            } else {
              shift = {
                is_holiday: 0,
                scheduled_in: s.work_start_time || "09:00",
                scheduled_out: s.work_end_time || "18:00"
              };
            }
          } catch(e) {
            shift = {
              is_holiday: 0,
              scheduled_in: s.work_start_time || "09:00",
              scheduled_out: s.work_end_time || "18:00"
            };
          }
        }

        const isOther = shift?.is_other_facility || ['GH', 'GH勤務', 'グループホーム', '他事業所', '他事業所勤務'].includes(shift?.holiday_type);
        if (isOther || shift?.is_holiday) return;

        // 施設外就労引率職員判定
        const isOffsiteStaff = shift?.is_offsite === 1 || ['施設外', '施設外引率', '引率'].includes(shift?.holiday_type);

        if (shift.scheduled_in && shift.scheduled_out) {
          const [sh, sm] = shift.scheduled_in.split(':').map(Number);
          const [eh, em] = shift.scheduled_out.split(':').map(Number);
          if (!isNaN(sh) && !isNaN(eh)) {
            let inM = sh * 60 + sm;
            let outM = eh * 60 + em;
            if (outM < inM) outM += 24 * 60;
            let dur = outM - inM;
            const breakM = shift.break_minutes ?? s.break_time_minutes ?? (dur >= 360 ? 60 : 0);
            dur -= breakM;
            if (s.is_concurrent && s.fte_ratio && s.fte_ratio < 1.0) {
              dur = Math.round(dur * s.fte_ratio);
            }
            if (dur > 0) {
              const hasSplitTimes = shift.work_type === 'both' || (shift.offsite_start_time && shift.offsite_end_time);

              if (hasSplitTimes && shift.offsite_start_time && shift.offsite_end_time) {
                // 施設外時間と内勤時間を正確に分割按分
                const [osh, osm] = shift.offsite_start_time.split(':').map(Number);
                const [oeh, oem] = shift.offsite_end_time.split(':').map(Number);
                let offsiteM = (oeh * 60 + oem) - (osh * 60 + osm);
                if (offsiteM < 0) offsiteM += 24 * 60;
                offsiteM = Math.min(dur, Math.max(0, offsiteM));
                const inFacilityM = Math.max(0, dur - offsiteM);

                if (offsiteM > 0) {
                  offsiteStaffMinutes += offsiteM;
                  offsiteStaffCount++;
                }
                if (inFacilityM > 0) {
                  inFacilityStaffMinutes += inFacilityM;
                  inFacilityStaffCount++;
                }
              } else if (isOffsiteStaff) {
                // 終日施設外就労引率職員（※内勤時間には加算しない）
                offsiteStaffMinutes += dur;
                offsiteStaffCount++;
              } else {
                // 終日内勤直接処遇職員
                inFacilityStaffMinutes += dur;
                inFacilityStaffCount++;
              }
            }
          }
        }
      });

      const totalStaffMinutes = inFacilityStaffMinutes + offsiteStaffMinutes;

      // 4. 判定ロジック
      // ① 内勤基準判定（時間充足 ＆ 開所中常時1名以上の直接処遇職員配置）
      const isInFacilityCompliant = inFacilityClientCount === 0 || 
        (inFacilityStaffCount >= 1 && inFacilityStaffMinutes >= inFacilityRequiredMinutes);
      const inFacilityShortageMinutes = Math.max(0, inFacilityRequiredMinutes - inFacilityStaffMinutes);

      // ② 施設外就労基準判定（施設外利用者がいる場合は現場専任引率職員1名以上必須）
      const isOffsiteCompliant = offsiteClientCount === 0 || offsiteStaffCount >= 1;

      // ③ 全体総合判定
      const isOverallCompliant = isInFacilityCompliant && isOffsiteCompliant && 
        (totalClientCount === 0 || totalStaffMinutes >= totalRequiredMinutes);

      result[d.dateStr] = {
        totalClientCount,
        inFacilityClientCount,
        offsiteClientCount,
        inFacilityRequiredMinutes,
        inFacilityRequiredFte,
        inFacilityStaffMinutes,
        inFacilityStaffCount,
        isInFacilityCompliant,
        inFacilityShortageMinutes,
        offsiteStaffCount,
        offsiteStaffMinutes,
        isOffsiteCompliant,
        totalRequiredMinutes,
        totalStaffMinutes,
        isOverallCompliant,
        // 互換用
        clientCount: totalClientCount,
        requiredMinutes: inFacilityRequiredMinutes,
        actualStaffMinutes: inFacilityStaffMinutes,
        isCompliant: isOverallCompliant,
        shortageMinutes: inFacilityShortageMinutes,
      };
    });

    return result;
  }, [daysArray, initialStaffingMap, shiftsData, initialStaff, ratioDenominator, dailyStandardMinutes, clients, clientShiftsMap]);

  const totalShortageDays = useMemo(() => {
    return Object.values(dailyStaffingAnalysis).filter(a => a.totalClientCount > 0 && !a.isOverallCompliant).length;
  }, [dailyStaffingAnalysis]);

  // 各拠点（部署）ごとの常時配置診断
  const dailyDeptCoverage = useMemo(() => {
    if (!departments || departments.length === 0) return {};
    const result: Record<string, {
      allOk: boolean;
      missingDepts: string[];
      hasAnyClient: boolean;
      details: string;
    }> = {};

    daysArray.forEach(d => {
      let hasAnyClient = false;
      const missingDepts: string[] = [];

      departments.forEach((dept: any) => {
        // 当該部署の利用者の通所予定数
        let deptClientCount = 0;
        clients.filter((c: any) => c.department_id === dept.id).forEach((c: any) => {
          const cShift = clientShiftsMap[c.id]?.[d.dateStr];
          if (cShift && cShift.scheduled_in && !cShift.is_holiday) deptClientCount++;
          else if (!cShift) {
            try {
              const arr = JSON.parse(c.regular_holidays || '[]');
              const dObj = new Date(d.dateStr);
              if (!arr.includes(dObj.getDay().toString())) deptClientCount++;
            } catch(e) {}
          }
        });

        if (deptClientCount > 0) {
          hasAnyClient = true;
          // 当該部署の直接処遇職員の出勤人数
          let deptStaffCount = 0;
          initialStaff.filter((s: any) => s.department_id === dept.id && isDirectCareStaff(s)).forEach((s: any) => {
            const shift = shiftsData[s.id]?.[d.dateStr];
            let vShift = shift;
            if (!shift) {
              try {
                const arr = JSON.parse(s.regular_holidays || '[]');
                const dObj = new Date(d.dateStr);
                if (arr.includes(dObj.getDay().toString())) {
                  vShift = { is_holiday: 1, holiday_type: '公休' };
                } else {
                  vShift = {
                    is_holiday: 0,
                    scheduled_in: s.work_start_time || '09:00',
                    scheduled_out: s.work_end_time || '18:00'
                  };
                }
              } catch(e) {
                vShift = {
                  is_holiday: 0,
                  scheduled_in: s.work_start_time || '09:00',
                  scheduled_out: s.work_end_time || '18:00'
                };
              }
            }
            const isOther = vShift?.is_other_facility || ['GH', 'GH勤務', 'グループホーム', '他事業所', '他事業所勤務'].includes(vShift?.holiday_type);
            const isOffsite = vShift?.is_offsite === 1 || ['施設外', '施設外引率', '引率'].includes(vShift?.holiday_type);
            if (vShift && !vShift.is_holiday && !isOther && !isOffsite && (vShift.scheduled_in || !shift)) {
              deptStaffCount++;
            }
          });

          if (deptStaffCount === 0) {
            missingDepts.push(dept.name);
          }
        }
      });

      result[d.dateStr] = {
        allOk: missingDepts.length === 0,
        missingDepts,
        hasAnyClient,
        details: missingDepts.length > 0 ? `【常時配置違反】${missingDepts.join('・')}に直接処遇職員が配置されていません` : '全拠点で直接処遇職員が配置されています'
      };
    });

    return result;
  }, [daysArray, departments, clients, clientShiftsMap, initialStaff, shiftsData]);

  const getDayColor = (dayOfWeek: number) => {
    if (dayOfWeek === 0) return "text-red-500 bg-red-50";
    if (dayOfWeek === 6) return "text-blue-500 bg-blue-50";
    return "";
  };

  const handleCellChange = async (staffId: string, dateStr: string, value: string) => {
    if (!isAdmin) return;

    let is_holiday = false;
    let holiday_type = null;
    let is_other_facility = false;
    let other_facility_name: string | null = null;
    let is_offsite = false;
    let work_type: string | null = null;
    let offsite_start_time: string | null = null;
    let offsite_end_time: string | null = null;
    let in_facility_start_time: string | null = null;
    let in_facility_end_time: string | null = null;
    let scheduled_in = null;
    let scheduled_out = null;
    let displayValue = value.trim();

    const parseTime = (t: string) => {
      t = t.replace('時', ':').replace('分', '').trim();
      if (!t.includes(':')) {
        if (t.length <= 2) t = t + '00';
        if (t.length === 3 || t.length === 4) {
          const padded = t.padStart(4, '0');
          t = `${padded.substring(0,2)}:${padded.substring(2,4)}`;
        }
      }
      if (t.includes(':')) {
        const [h, m] = t.split(':');
        return `${h.padStart(2, '0')}:${(m || '00').padEnd(2, '0')}`;
      }
      return t;
    };

    const ghKeywords = ['GH', 'gh', 'Gh', 'GH勤務', 'グループホーム', '他事業所', '他事業所勤務', '他', '他所', '外部'];
    const isGhOnly = ghKeywords.includes(displayValue);

    const offsiteKeywords = ['施設外', '施設外引率', '引率', '外勤', '施設外就労', '施設外就労引率'];
    const isOffsiteOnly = offsiteKeywords.includes(displayValue);

    // 外勤・内勤併用パターン（例: 外10-12 内13-18, 併用）
    const isBothPattern = (displayValue.includes('外') && displayValue.includes('内')) || 
                          displayValue === '併用' || displayValue === '両方';

    if (isGhOnly) {
      is_holiday = false;
      is_other_facility = true;
      other_facility_name = (displayValue.toUpperCase().startsWith('GH') || displayValue.includes('グループホーム')) ? 'GH勤務' : '他事業所勤務';
      holiday_type = other_facility_name;
    } else if (isBothPattern) {
      is_holiday = false;
      is_offsite = true;
      work_type = 'both';
      holiday_type = '併用';

      const offMatch = displayValue.match(/(?:外|施設外|引率)[:\s]*([0-9:]{1,5})[-~～]([0-9:]{1,5})/);
      const inMatch = displayValue.match(/(?:内|施設内|内勤)[:\s]*([0-9:]{1,5})[-~～]([0-9:]{1,5})/);

      if (offMatch && inMatch) {
        offsite_start_time = parseTime(offMatch[1]);
        offsite_end_time = parseTime(offMatch[2]);
        in_facility_start_time = parseTime(inMatch[1]);
        in_facility_end_time = parseTime(inMatch[2]);
        scheduled_in = offsite_start_time < in_facility_start_time ? offsite_start_time : in_facility_start_time;
        scheduled_out = offsite_end_time > in_facility_end_time ? offsite_end_time : in_facility_end_time;
      } else if (displayValue === '併用' || displayValue === '両方') {
        offsite_start_time = '10:00';
        offsite_end_time = '12:00';
        in_facility_start_time = '13:00';
        in_facility_end_time = '18:00';
        scheduled_in = '10:00';
        scheduled_out = '18:00';
      } else {
        toast.error('入力形式が正しくありません (例: 外10-12 内13-18)');
        return;
      }
    } else if (isOffsiteOnly) {
      is_holiday = false;
      is_offsite = true;
      work_type = 'out_facility';
      holiday_type = '施設外引率';
      scheduled_in = '09:00';
      scheduled_out = '18:00';
    } else if (displayValue === '休' || displayValue === '公休' || displayValue === '有給休暇' || displayValue === '有休' || displayValue === '特休' || displayValue === '年休' || displayValue === '時間休') {
      is_holiday = true;
      holiday_type = (displayValue === '有休' || displayValue === '年休') ? '有給休暇' : displayValue;
    } else if (displayValue.includes('-') || displayValue.includes('\n') || displayValue.includes('~') || displayValue.includes('～')) {
      let cleanVal = displayValue;
      if (cleanVal.toUpperCase().includes('GH') || cleanVal.includes('グループホーム') || cleanVal.includes('他事業所')) {
        is_other_facility = true;
        other_facility_name = (cleanVal.toUpperCase().includes('GH') || cleanVal.includes('グループホーム')) ? 'GH勤務' : '他事業所勤務';
        holiday_type = other_facility_name;
        cleanVal = cleanVal.replace(/GH勤務|グループホーム|他事業所勤務|他事業所|GH|gh/gi, '').trim();
      } else if (cleanVal.includes('施設外') || cleanVal.includes('引率') || cleanVal.includes('外勤') || cleanVal.includes('外')) {
        is_offsite = true;
        work_type = 'out_facility';
        holiday_type = '施設外引率';
        cleanVal = cleanVal.replace(/施設外就労引率|施設外就労|施設外引率|施設外|引率|外勤|外/g, '').trim();
      }
      let parts = cleanVal.split(/[-~～\n]/).filter(p => p.trim() !== '');
      if (parts.length === 2) {
        scheduled_in = parseTime(parts[0]);
        scheduled_out = parseTime(parts[1]);
        if (!is_offsite) {
          work_type = 'in_facility';
        }
      } else if (parts.length === 0 && is_offsite) {
        scheduled_in = '09:00';
        scheduled_out = '18:00';
      }
    } else if (displayValue === '') {
      // Clear shift
      is_holiday = false;
      is_other_facility = false;
      is_offsite = false;
      work_type = null;
      offsite_start_time = null;
      offsite_end_time = null;
      in_facility_start_time = null;
      in_facility_end_time = null;
      other_facility_name = null;
      scheduled_in = null;
      scheduled_out = null;
    } else {
      toast.error('入力形式が正しくありません (例: 0900-1800, 外10-12 内13-18, 施設外, GH, 公休, 有休)');
      return;
    }

    const newData = { ...shiftsData };
    if (!newData[staffId]) newData[staffId] = {};
    newData[staffId][dateStr] = { 
      staff_id: staffId, 
      target_date: dateStr, 
      is_holiday, 
      holiday_type, 
      scheduled_in, 
      scheduled_out,
      is_other_facility: is_other_facility ? 1 : 0,
      other_facility_name,
      is_offsite: is_offsite ? 1 : 0,
      work_type,
      offsite_start_time,
      offsite_end_time,
      in_facility_start_time,
      in_facility_end_time
    };
    setShiftsData(newData);

    const res = await saveStaffShift(staffId, dateStr, { 
      scheduled_in, 
      scheduled_out, 
      is_holiday, 
      holiday_type,
      is_other_facility,
      other_facility_name,
      is_offsite,
      work_type,
      offsite_start_time,
      offsite_end_time,
      in_facility_start_time,
      in_facility_end_time
    });
    if (!res.success) {
      toast.error(`保存に失敗しました: ${dateStr}`);
    } else {
      if (is_other_facility) {
        toast.info(`${dateStr}: 他事業所勤務として保存しました（A型人員配置から自動除外）`);
      } else if (work_type === 'both') {
        toast.info(`${dateStr}: 施設外(${offsite_start_time}~${offsite_end_time})＋内勤(${in_facility_start_time}~${in_facility_end_time})の併用として保存しました（時間分割按分配置）`);
      } else if (is_offsite) {
        toast.info(`${dateStr}: 施設外就労引率職員として保存しました（内勤配置から分離）`);
      }
    }
  };

  const formatCellValue = (shift: any) => {
    if (!shift) return "";
    if (shift.is_other_facility || ['GH', 'GH勤務', 'グループホーム', '他事業所', '他事業所勤務'].includes(shift.holiday_type)) {
      return shift.other_facility_name || shift.holiday_type || "GH勤務";
    }
    const isBoth = shift.work_type === 'both' || (shift.offsite_start_time && shift.in_facility_start_time);
    if (isBoth) {
      const formatTime = (t: string) => {
        if (!t) return '';
        const [h, m] = t.split(':');
        return `${parseInt(h, 10)}:${m}`;
      };
      const offStr = shift.offsite_start_time ? `外${formatTime(shift.offsite_start_time)}-${formatTime(shift.offsite_end_time)}` : '';
      const inStr = shift.in_facility_start_time ? `内${formatTime(shift.in_facility_start_time)}-${formatTime(shift.in_facility_end_time)}` : '';
      return `${offStr}\n${inStr}`.trim();
    }
    if (shift.is_offsite || ['施設外', '施設外引率', '引率'].includes(shift.holiday_type)) {
      return shift.holiday_type || "施設外引率";
    }
    if (shift.is_holiday) return shift.holiday_type || "公休";
    if (shift.scheduled_in && shift.scheduled_out) {
      const formatTime = (t: string) => {
        if (!t) return '';
        const [h, m] = t.split(':');
        return `${parseInt(h, 10)}:${m}`;
      };
      return `${formatTime(shift.scheduled_in)}\n${formatTime(shift.scheduled_out)}`;
    }
    return "";
  };

  const handlePrevMonth = () => {
    const [y, m] = currentMonth.split('-').map(Number);
    const prev = new Date(y, m - 2, 1);
    const newYm = `${prev.getFullYear()}-${(prev.getMonth() + 1).toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
    window.location.href = `/staff/shifts?month=${newYm}`;
  };

  const handleNextMonth = () => {
    const [y, m] = currentMonth.split('-').map(Number);
    const next = new Date(y, m, 1);
    const newYm = `${next.getFullYear()}-${(next.getMonth() + 1).toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
    window.location.href = `/staff/shifts?month=${newYm}`;
  };

  const ShiftCell = ({ shift, val, isAdmin, staffId, dateStr }: any) => {
    const [isEditing, setIsEditing] = useState(false);
    const [editValue, setEditValue] = useState("");

    const isOther = shift?.is_other_facility || ['GH', 'GH勤務', 'グループホーム', '他事業所', '他事業所勤務'].includes(shift?.holiday_type) || val.includes('GH') || val.includes('他事業所');
    const isBoth = shift?.work_type === 'both' || (shift?.offsite_start_time && shift?.in_facility_start_time) || (val.includes('外') && val.includes('内'));
    const isOffsite = !isBoth && (shift?.is_offsite || ['施設外', '施設外引率', '引率'].includes(shift?.holiday_type) || val.includes('施設外') || val.includes('引率'));

    const handleClick = () => {
      if (!isAdmin) return;
      setEditValue(val.replace('\n', ' '));
      setIsEditing(true);
    };

    const handleBlur = () => {
      setIsEditing(false);
      const originalEquivalent = val.replace('\n', ' ');
      if (editValue !== originalEquivalent) {
        handleCellChange(staffId, dateStr, editValue);
      }
    };

    const handleKeyDown = (e: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
      if (e.key === 'Enter') {
        e.preventDefault();
        (e.target as HTMLInputElement).blur();
      }
    };

    const handleQuickSelect = (quickVal: string) => {
      setIsEditing(false);
      handleCellChange(staffId, dateStr, quickVal);
    };

    if (isEditing) {
      return (
        <div className="relative z-20">
          <input 
            autoFocus
            type="text"
            className="w-full h-12 text-center text-[11px] bg-white border-2 border-primary focus:outline-none shadow-md"
            value={editValue}
            placeholder="09-18, 外10-12 内13-18, 施設外, GH, 公休"
            onChange={e => setEditValue(e.target.value)}
            onBlur={handleBlur}
            onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
          />
          <div className="absolute top-full left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 mt-1 bg-popover border rounded-md shadow-lg p-1.5 flex gap-1 text-[10px] whitespace-nowrap z-50">
            <button 
              type="button" 
              className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-emerald-100 hover:bg-emerald-200 text-emerald-950 rounded font-semibold border border-emerald-300"
              onMouseDown={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); handleQuickSelect('外10-12 内13-18'); }}
              title="午前施設外引率・午後内勤の併用（時間分割按分）"
            >
              外10-12/内13-18
            </button>
            <button 
              type="button" 
              className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-emerald-100 hover:bg-emerald-200 text-emerald-950 rounded font-semibold border border-emerald-300"
              onMouseDown={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); handleQuickSelect('内10-12 外13-18'); }}
              title="午前内勤・午後施設外引率の併用（時間分割按分）"
            >
              内10-12/外13-18
            </button>
            <button 
              type="button" 
              className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-amber-100 hover:bg-amber-200 text-amber-950 rounded font-semibold border border-amber-300"
              onMouseDown={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); handleQuickSelect('施設外引率'); }}
              title="施設外就労引率専任（内勤人員配置からは除外）"
            >
              施設外引率
            </button>
            <button 
              type="button" 
              className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-purple-100 hover:bg-purple-200 text-purple-900 rounded font-semibold border border-purple-300"
              onMouseDown={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); handleQuickSelect('GH勤務'); }}
              title="グループホーム等他事業所勤務（A型人員配置から自動除外）"
            >
              GH勤務
            </button>
            <button 
              type="button" 
              className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-red-100 hover:bg-red-200 text-red-900 rounded border border-red-300"
              onMouseDown={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); handleQuickSelect('公休'); }}
            >
              公休
            </button>
            <button 
              type="button" 
              className="px-2 py-0.5 bg-blue-50 hover:bg-blue-100 text-blue-900 rounded border border-blue-200"
              onMouseDown={(e) => { e.preventDefault(); handleQuickSelect('09:00-18:00'); }}
            >
              09-18
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      );
    }

    let cellClass = "w-full h-12 print:h-auto print:min-h-0 print:py-0.5 flex flex-col items-center justify-center text-center text-[11px] print:text-[8pt] leading-tight cursor-pointer hover:bg-black/5 transition-colors";
    let title = "";

    if (isOther) {
      cellClass += " bg-purple-50 text-purple-900 font-semibold";
      title = "グループホーム等他事業所勤務（A型人員配置から自動除外）";
    } else if (isBoth) {
      cellClass += " bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-900 font-semibold";
      title = "施設外・内勤併用（時間分割按分配置）";
    } else if (isOffsite) {
      cellClass += " bg-amber-50 text-amber-900 font-semibold";
      title = "施設外就労引率専従職員（事業所本体の人員配置計算からは除外）";
    }

    return (
      <div 
        className={cellClass}
        onClick={handleClick}
        title={title}
      >
        {isOther ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center py-0.5">
            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-purple-200 text-purple-950 rounded text-[10px] print:text-[7pt] font-bold leading-none shadow-xs">
              {val || 'GH勤務'}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[8px] print:text-[6.5pt] text-purple-700 mt-0.5 font-medium">除外</span>
          </div>
        ) : isBoth ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center py-0.5 leading-tight">
            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.2 bg-emerald-200 text-emerald-950 rounded text-[9px] print:text-[7pt] font-bold leading-none shadow-xs mb-0.5">
              外内併用
            </span>
            <span className="text-[9px] print:text-[7pt] text-emerald-800 font-medium whitespace-pre-line leading-tight">
              {val}
            </span>
          </div>
        ) : isOffsite ? (
          <div className="flex flex-col items-center py-0.5">
            <span className="px-1.5 py-0.5 bg-amber-200 text-amber-950 rounded text-[10px] print:text-[7pt] font-bold leading-none shadow-xs">
              {val || '施設外引率'}
            </span>
            <span className="text-[8px] print:text-[6.5pt] text-amber-700 mt-0.5 font-medium">引率専従</span>
          </div>
        ) : val ? (
          val.split('\n').map((line: string, i: number) => <div key={i}>{line}</div>)
        ) : (
          <span className="text-muted-foreground/30">-</span>
        )}
      </div>
    );
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-6 print:space-y-0 print:m-0 print:p-0">
      <style dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: `
        @page {
          size: A4 landscape;
          margin: 6mm 6mm;
        }
        @media print {
          body {
            background: white !important;
            color: black !important;
            -webkit-print-color-adjust: exact;
            print-color-adjust: exact;
          }
          /* 印刷不要な全UI要素・アラート・フッター診断を徹底非表示 */
          header, nav, aside, .print\\:hidden, [class*="print:hidden"], tfoot, .screen-only-element {
            display: none !important;
            visibility: hidden !important;
            height: 0 !important;
            overflow: hidden !important;
          }
          .print\\:block {
            display: block !important;
          }
          table {
            width: 100% !important;
            min-width: 0 !important;
            font-size: 7pt !important;
            line-height: 1.05 !important;
            table-layout: fixed !important;
            page-break-inside: auto;
          }
          tr {
            page-break-inside: avoid !important;
            break-inside: avoid !important;
          }
          th, td {
            min-width: 0 !important;
            padding: 1px 0.5px !important;
            overflow: hidden !important;
          }
        }
      `}} />

      {/* 印刷用公式ヘッダー（通常時は非表示） */}
      <div className="hidden print:block mb-2 border-b-2 border-slate-900 pb-1">
        <div className="flex justify-between items-start">
          <div className="flex-1 mr-4">
            <span className="text-[8px] font-mono text-slate-500">様式第一号（就労継続支援Ａ型）</span>
            <h1 className="text-base font-bold text-slate-900">従業者の勤務の体制及び勤務形態一覧表</h1>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[9px] text-slate-700">
              <span className="shrink-0">事業所名:</span>
              <div className="max-w-[240px]">
                <AutoFitText text={facilitySettings?.facility_name || '就労継続支援A型事業所'} maxFontSizePt={9} minFontSizePt={6.5} className="font-bold" />
              </div>
              <span className="shrink-0 text-slate-500">（番号: {facilitySettings?.facility_number || '2810099999'}）</span>
            </div>
          </div>
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3 shrink-0">
            <div className="text-right">
              <div className="text-xs font-bold text-slate-900 font-mono">
                {currentMonth.replace('-', '年')}月分
              </div>
              <div className="text-[8px] text-slate-500">
                配置基準: {staffingClass} / 週所定: {regularHoursPerWeek}時間
              </div>
            </div>
            <div className="flex gap-1">
              <div className="text-center">
                <div className="border border-slate-400 bg-slate-50 px-1.5 py-0 text-[7px] font-bold">管理者</div>
                <div className="h-8 w-8 border-b border-l border-r border-slate-400 flex items-center justify-center text-[7px] text-slate-400">印</div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-center">
                <div className="border border-slate-400 bg-slate-50 px-1.5 py-0 text-[7px] font-bold">作成者</div>
                <div className="h-8 w-8 border-b border-l border-r border-slate-400 flex items-center justify-center text-[7px] text-slate-400">印</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-col md:flex-row justify-between items-start md:items-center gap-4 bg-white p-4 rounded-md border shadow-sm print:hidden">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
          <h2 className="text-xl font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
            <Button variant="outline" size="icon" onClick={handlePrevMonth}>
              <ChevronLeft className="h-4 w-4" />
            </Button>
            {currentMonth.replace('-', '年')}月 職員シフト
            <Button variant="outline" size="icon" onClick={handleNextMonth}>
              <ChevronRight className="h-4 w-4" />
            </Button>
          </h2>
          <span className="text-xs bg-muted px-2 py-1 rounded border text-muted-foreground font-medium">
            配置基準: {staffingClass}
          </span>
          {totalShortageDays > 0 ? (
            <span className="text-xs bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border border-rose-300 font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded flex items-center gap-1 animate-pulse">
              <span>⚠️ 人員不足日: {totalShortageDays}日</span>
            </span>
          ) : (
            <span className="text-xs bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-300 font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded flex items-center gap-1">
              <span>✓ 全日人員基準充足</span>
            </span>
          )}
          {departments && departments.length > 0 && Object.values(dailyDeptCoverage).some(c => c.hasAnyClient && !c.allOk) && (
            <span className="text-xs bg-rose-200 text-rose-950 border border-rose-400 font-bold px-2.5 py-1 rounded flex items-center gap-1 animate-pulse">
              <span>⚠️ 拠点常時配置不足あり</span>
            </span>
          )}
        </div>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-3 w-full md:w-auto justify-between md:justify-end">
          <div className="text-xs text-muted-foreground hidden lg:block text-right">
            直接処遇職員の合計時間が法定時間を満たしているか下部で自動判定されます。<br/>
            マスをクリックして入力（例: 0900-1800 / 公休 / 有休 / GH勤務）
          </div>
          <Button 
            onClick={() => window.print()}
            variant="outline" 
            className="gap-1.5 border-slate-300 bg-white hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-800 shadow-xs shrink-0 font-bold"
          >
            <Printer className="h-4 w-4 text-slate-600" />
            職員シフト表を印刷 (A4横)
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <Card className="overflow-x-auto shadow-md print:shadow-none print:border-none print:rounded-none">
        <CardContent className="p-0">
          <table className="w-full text-xs text-center border-collapse min-w-[800px] print:min-w-0">
            <thead>
              <tr>
                <th className="sticky left-0 z-10 bg-muted/80 backdrop-blur-sm p-3 border-b border-r min-w-[120px] font-bold shadow-[2px_0_5px_-2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] print:shadow-none print:w-[13%] print:bg-slate-100 print:p-1">
                  職員名
                </th>
                {daysArray.map(d => (
                  <th key={d.day} className={`p-2 border-b border-r min-w-[60px] print:min-w-0 print:p-0.5 print:text-[8pt] ${getDayColor(d.dayOfWeek)}`}>
                    {d.day}日<br/>
                    <span className="text-[10px] print:text-[7pt] font-normal">
                      {['日','月','火','水','木','金','土'][d.dayOfWeek]}
                    </span>
                  </th>
                ))}
              </tr>
            </thead>
            <tbody>
              {initialStaff.map(staff => (
                <tr key={staff.id} className="hover:bg-muted/30">
                  <td className="sticky left-0 z-10 bg-white p-3 border-b border-r font-medium text-left shadow-[2px_0_5px_-2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] min-w-[130px] print:shadow-none print:p-1 print:min-w-0 print:text-[8.5pt]">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                      <AutoFitText maxFontSize={9} minFontSize={6} mode="single-line" className="font-bold inline-block max-w-full">
                        {staff.name}
                      </AutoFitText>
                      {staff.department_name && (
                        <span className="inline-flex items-center px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[10px] print:text-[7pt] font-medium bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-700 border border-emerald-200">
                          {staff.department_name}
                        </span>
                      )}
                      {staff.is_concurrent ? (
                        <span 
                          className="inline-flex items-center px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded text-[10px] print:text-[7pt] font-semibold bg-purple-100 text-purple-800 border border-purple-200" 
                          title={`兼務先: ${staff.concurrent_facility || '他事業所'} (A型配置割合: ${staff.fte_ratio || 1.0})`}
                        >
                          兼務: {staff.concurrent_facility || 'GH'} ({staff.fte_ratio || 1.0})
                        </span>
                      ) : null}
                    </div>
                    <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground mt-1 font-normal bg-muted/30 p-1 rounded print:hidden">
                      <div>有給残: {Math.max(0, (staff.pto_granted || 0) - (staff.pto_used || 0))}日</div>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  {daysArray.map(d => {
                    const shift = shiftsData[staff.id]?.[d.dateStr];
                    let virtualShift = shift;
                    if (!shift) {
                      try {
                        const arr = JSON.parse(staff.regular_holidays || "[]");
                        const dObj = new Date(d.dateStr);
                        if (arr.includes(dObj.getDay().toString())) {
                          virtualShift = { is_holiday: 1, holiday_type: '公休' };
                        } else {
                          virtualShift = {
                            is_holiday: 0,
                            scheduled_in: staff.work_start_time || "09:00",
                            scheduled_out: staff.work_end_time || "18:00"
                          };
                        }
                      } catch(e) {
                        virtualShift = {
                          is_holiday: 0,
                          scheduled_in: staff.work_start_time || "09:00",
                          scheduled_out: staff.work_end_time || "18:00"
                        };
                      }
                    }
                    
                    const val = formatCellValue(virtualShift);
                    const isOther = virtualShift?.is_other_facility || ['GH', 'GH勤務', 'グループホーム', '他事業所', '他事業所勤務'].includes(virtualShift?.holiday_type);

                    return (
                      <td key={d.day} className={`p-0 border-b border-r align-middle ${isOther ? 'bg-purple-50/50' : virtualShift?.is_holiday ? 'bg-red-50/50' : ''}`}>
                        <ShiftCell 
                          shift={virtualShift} 
                          val={val} 
                          isAdmin={isAdmin} 
                          staffId={staff.id} 
                          dateStr={d.dateStr} 
                        />
                      </td>
                    );
                  })}
                </tr>
              ))}
            </tbody>
            <tfoot className="print:hidden screen-only-element hidden-on-print">
              {/* 利用者内訳 (内勤 / 施設外) */}
              <tr className="bg-muted/40 font-medium border-t-2 border-primary/20">
                <td className="sticky left-0 z-10 bg-muted/90 p-2 border-b border-r font-bold text-left text-xs shadow-[2px_0_5px_-2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)]">
                  <div className="flex flex-col">
                    <span>利用者数 (内勤/施設外)</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-normal text-muted-foreground">本体内勤 ＋ 施設外就労</span>
                  </div>
                </td>
                {daysArray.map(d => {
                  const s = dailyStaffingAnalysis[d.dateStr];
                  return (
                    <td key={d.day} className="p-1 border-b border-r text-center text-[11px]">
                      {s && s.totalClientCount > 0 ? (
                        <div className="flex flex-col items-center">
                          <span className="font-bold text-slate-800">{s.inFacilityClientCount}名</span>
                          {s.offsiteClientCount > 0 && (
                            <span className="text-[9px] text-amber-700 font-semibold bg-amber-50 px-1 rounded">
                              外:{s.offsiteClientCount}名
                            </span>
                          )}
                        </div>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground/40">-</span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                  );
                })}
              </tr>

              {/* 内勤 法定必要時間 */}
              <tr className="bg-muted/30 font-medium">
                <td className="sticky left-0 z-10 bg-muted/90 p-2 border-b border-r font-bold text-left text-xs shadow-[2px_0_5px_-2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)]">
                  <div className="flex flex-col">
                    <span>内勤 法定必要時間</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-normal text-muted-foreground">本体利用({staffingClass})基準</span>
                  </div>
                </td>
                {daysArray.map(d => {
                  const s = dailyStaffingAnalysis[d.dateStr];
                  return (
                    <td key={d.day} className="p-1 border-b border-r text-center text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                      {s && s.inFacilityClientCount > 0 ? (
                        <span>{Math.floor(s.inFacilityRequiredMinutes / 60)}h{s.inFacilityRequiredMinutes % 60 ? `${s.inFacilityRequiredMinutes % 60}m` : ''}</span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground/40">-</span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                  );
                })}
              </tr>

              {/* 内勤 シフト配置時間 */}
              <tr className="bg-muted/20 font-medium">
                <td className="sticky left-0 z-10 bg-muted/90 p-2 border-b border-r font-bold text-left text-xs shadow-[2px_0_5px_-2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)]">
                  <div className="flex flex-col">
                    <span>内勤 シフト配置時間</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-normal text-muted-foreground">本体直接処遇 ({staffingClass})</span>
                  </div>
                </td>
                {daysArray.map(d => {
                  const s = dailyStaffingAnalysis[d.dateStr];
                  return (
                    <td key={d.day} className="p-1 border-b border-r text-center text-[11px]">
                      {s && s.inFacilityStaffMinutes > 0 ? (
                        <span className="font-semibold">{Math.floor(s.inFacilityStaffMinutes / 60)}h{s.inFacilityStaffMinutes % 60 ? `${s.inFacilityStaffMinutes % 60}m` : ''}</span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-muted-foreground/40">-</span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                  );
                })}
              </tr>

              {/* 内勤 人員基準判定 */}
              <tr className="bg-muted/30 font-bold">
                <td className="sticky left-0 z-10 bg-muted/95 p-2 border-b border-r font-bold text-left text-xs shadow-[2px_0_5px_-2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] text-foreground">
                  <div className="flex flex-col">
                    <span>① 内勤 配置判定</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-normal text-muted-foreground">本体常時1名＆時間充足</span>
                  </div>
                </td>
                {daysArray.map(d => {
                  const s = dailyStaffingAnalysis[d.dateStr];
                  if (!s || s.inFacilityClientCount === 0) {
                    return (
                      <td key={d.day} className="p-1 border-b border-r text-center text-[11px] text-muted-foreground/40">
                        -
                      </td>
                    );
                  }
                  if (s.inFacilityStaffCount === 0) {
                    return (
                      <td key={d.day} className="p-1 border-b border-r text-center align-middle bg-rose-200/90" title="内勤利用者がいるのに事業所本体に直接処遇職員が0名です（開所中常時1名以上配置必須）">
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-rose-950 font-black bg-rose-300 border border-rose-500 px-1 py-0.5 rounded block whitespace-nowrap animate-pulse">
                          ⚠️本体不在
                        </span>
                      </td>
                    );
                  }
                  return (
                    <td key={d.day} className={`p-1 border-b border-r text-center align-middle ${s.isInFacilityCompliant ? 'bg-emerald-50/50' : 'bg-rose-100/80'}`}>
                      {s.isInFacilityCompliant ? (
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-800 font-bold bg-emerald-100 border border-emerald-300 px-1 py-0.5 rounded block whitespace-nowrap">
                          ✓内勤充足
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-rose-950 font-black bg-rose-200 border border-rose-400 px-1 py-0.5 rounded block whitespace-nowrap animate-pulse">
                          ⚠️不足(-{Math.floor(s.inFacilityShortageMinutes / 60)}h)
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                  );
                })}
              </tr>

              {/* 施設外就労 引率専任配置判定 */}
              <tr className="bg-amber-50/40 font-bold border-t">
                <td className="sticky left-0 z-10 bg-amber-50/90 p-2 border-b border-r font-bold text-left text-xs shadow-[2px_0_5px_-2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] text-amber-950">
                  <div className="flex flex-col">
                    <span>② 施設外 引率判定</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-normal text-amber-800">専任引率職員の配置</span>
                  </div>
                </td>
                {daysArray.map(d => {
                  const s = dailyStaffingAnalysis[d.dateStr];
                  if (!s || s.offsiteClientCount === 0) {
                    return (
                      <td key={d.day} className="p-1 border-b border-r text-center text-[11px] text-muted-foreground/40">
                        -
                      </td>
                    );
                  }
                  return (
                    <td key={d.day} className={`p-1 border-b border-r text-center align-middle ${s.isOffsiteCompliant ? 'bg-amber-50' : 'bg-rose-200'}`}>
                      {s.isOffsiteCompliant ? (
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-amber-900 font-bold bg-amber-100 border border-amber-300 px-1 py-0.5 rounded block whitespace-nowrap">
                          ✓引率{s.offsiteStaffCount}名
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-rose-950 font-black bg-rose-300 border border-rose-500 px-1 py-0.5 rounded block whitespace-nowrap animate-pulse">
                          ⚠️引率未配置
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                  );
                })}
              </tr>

              {/* 全体 人員基準判定 */}
              <tr className="bg-muted/70 font-black border-t-2 border-primary/30">
                <td className="sticky left-0 z-10 bg-muted p-2 border-b border-r font-black text-left text-xs shadow-[2px_0_5px_-2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] text-foreground">
                  <div className="flex flex-col">
                    <span>③ 全体 総合配置判定</span>
                    <span className="text-[10px] font-normal text-muted-foreground">内勤・施設外・全体比率</span>
                  </div>
                </td>
                {daysArray.map(d => {
                  const s = dailyStaffingAnalysis[d.dateStr];
                  if (!s || s.totalClientCount === 0) {
                    return (
                      <td key={d.day} className="p-1 border-b border-r text-center text-[11px] text-muted-foreground/40">
                        -
                      </td>
                    );
                  }
                  return (
                    <td key={d.day} className={`p-1 border-b border-r text-center align-middle ${s.isOverallCompliant ? 'bg-emerald-100/60' : 'bg-rose-200/90'}`}>
                      {s.isOverallCompliant ? (
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-900 font-black bg-emerald-200 border border-emerald-400 px-1 py-0.5 rounded block whitespace-nowrap">
                          ✓総合充足
                        </span>
                      ) : (
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-rose-950 font-black bg-rose-300 border border-rose-500 px-1 py-0.5 rounded block whitespace-nowrap animate-pulse">
                          ⚠️要改善
                        </span>
                      )}
                    </td>
                  );
                })}
              </tr>

              {/* 拠点常時配置診断（サテライト型対応） */}
              {departments && departments.length > 0 && (
                <tr className="bg-muted/40 font-bold border-t">
                  <td className="sticky left-0 z-10 bg-muted p-2 border-b border-r font-black text-left text-xs shadow-[2px_0_5px_-2px_rgba(0,0,0,0.1)] text-foreground">
                    <div className="flex flex-col">
                      <span>拠点常時配置診断</span>
                      <span className="text-[10px] font-normal text-muted-foreground">各拠点1名以上必須</span>
                    </div>
                  </td>
                  {daysArray.map(d => {
                    const cov = dailyDeptCoverage[d.dateStr];
                    if (!cov || !cov.hasAnyClient) {
                      return (
                        <td key={d.day} className="p-1 border-b border-r text-center text-[10px] text-muted-foreground/40">
                          -
                        </td>
                      );
                    }
                    if (!cov.allOk) {
                      return (
                        <td key={d.day} className="p-1 border-b border-r text-center align-middle bg-rose-200/90" title={cov.details}>
                          <span className="text-[10px] text-rose-950 font-black bg-rose-300 border border-rose-500 px-1 py-0.5 rounded block whitespace-nowrap animate-pulse">
                            ⚠️不在
                          </span>
                        </td>
                      );
                    }
                    return (
                      <td key={d.day} className="p-1 border-b border-r text-center align-middle bg-emerald-50/50" title={cov.details}>
                        <span className="text-[10px] text-emerald-800 font-bold bg-emerald-100 border border-emerald-300 px-1 py-0.5 rounded block whitespace-nowrap">
                          ✓全拠点OK
                        </span>
                      </td>
                    );
                  })}
                </tr>
              )}
            </tfoot>
          </table>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

import { Header } from "@/components/Header";
import { AttendanceSubNav } from "@/components/NavigationTabs";
import { getStaffList, getStaffShifts } from "../actions";
import { StaffShiftsClient } from "./StaffShiftsClient";
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth";
import { redirect } from "next/navigation";
import { toLocalISODate } from "@/lib/utils";
import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { getMonthlyDailyStaffingMap } from "@/lib/compliance/staffingCalculator";

export default async function StaffShiftsPage({ searchParams }: { searchParams: Promise<{ month?: string }> }) {
  const role = await getRole();
  if (!role) {
    redirect("/login");
  }
  
  const params = await searchParams;
  let targetYearMonth = params.month;
  
  if (!targetYearMonth) {
    const today = new Date();
    targetYearMonth = `${today.getFullYear()}-${(today.getMonth() + 1).toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
  }

  const staff = await getStaffList();
  const shifts = await getStaffShifts(targetYearMonth);
  const isAdmin = role === 'admin';

  const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT staffing_class, regular_hours_per_week FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any;
  const staffingMap = getMonthlyDailyStaffingMap(targetYearMonth);
  const departments = db.prepare('SELECT id, name FROM departments WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY sort_order ASC, created_at ASC').all() as any[];
  const clients = db.prepare("SELECT id, full_name as name, regular_holidays, department_id FROM clients WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND (status IS NULL OR status = 'active')").all() as any[];
  const clientShifts = db.prepare('SELECT client_id, target_date, scheduled_in, scheduled_out, is_holiday FROM client_shifts WHERE target_date LIKE ?').all(`${targetYearMonth}-%`) as any[];

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background">
      <Header activePage="attendance" />
      <AttendanceSubNav isStaff={role === 'staff'} />
      <main className="flex-1 p-2 sm:p-4 md:p-8 w-full max-w-[100vw] overflow-x-hidden">
        <StaffShiftsClient 
          initialStaff={staff} 
          initialShifts={shifts} 
          targetYearMonth={targetYearMonth}
          isAdmin={isAdmin} 
          facilitySettings={facility}
          initialStaffingMap={staffingMap}
          departments={departments}
          clients={clients}
          clientShifts={clientShifts}
        />
      </main>
    </div>
  );
}

File: src/app/support-records/SupportCalendarMonthPicker.tsx
================================================================================

'use client';

import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { ChevronLeft, ChevronRight, Calendar as CalendarIcon } from "lucide-react";

interface Props {
  currentDateStr: string;   // e.g. "2026-10-05"
  todayStr: string;         // e.g. "2026-10-05"
  basePath?: string;        // e.g. "/support-records/ledger"
}

export function SupportCalendarMonthPicker({ currentDateStr, todayStr, basePath = "/support-records/ledger" }: Props) {
  const router = useRouter();

  const targetDate = new Date(currentDateStr);
  const currentYear = targetDate.getFullYear();
  const currentMonth = targetDate.getMonth();
  const currentMonthStr = `${currentYear}-${String(currentMonth + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;

  const prevMonthDate = new Date(currentYear, currentMonth - 1, 1);
  const nextMonthDate = new Date(currentYear, currentMonth + 1, 1);
  const prevMonthStr = `${prevMonthDate.getFullYear()}-${String(prevMonthDate.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-01`;
  const nextMonthStr = `${nextMonthDate.getFullYear()}-${String(nextMonthDate.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-01`;

  const getPastMonthStr = (monthsAgo: number) => {
    const d = new Date();
    d.setMonth(d.getMonth() - monthsAgo);
    return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-01`;
  };

  const handleMonthChange = (e: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.target.value) {
      router.push(`${basePath}?date=${e.target.value}-01`);
    }
  };

  const handleJump = (dateStr: string) => {
    router.push(`${basePath}?date=${dateStr}`);
  };

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
      {/* 年月表示と前後ボタン */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
        <div className="flex items-center bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border rounded-lg p-0.5 shadow-xs">
          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => handleJump(prevMonthStr)}
            className="h-8 px-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:text-slate-900"
            title="前月へ"
          >
            <ChevronLeft className="w-4 h-4 mr-0.5" />
            前月
          </Button>

          <Button
            variant={currentMonthStr === todayStr.substring(0, 7) ? "secondary" : "ghost"}
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => handleJump(todayStr)}
            className="h-8 px-2.5 text-xs font-bold"
            title="現在の月に戻る"
          >
            今月
          </Button>

          <Button
            variant="ghost"
            size="sm"
            onClick={() => handleJump(nextMonthStr)}
            className="h-8 px-2 text-xs font-semibold text-slate-700 hover:text-slate-900"
            title="次月へ"
          >
            次月
            <ChevronRight className="w-4 h-4 ml-0.5" />
          </Button>
        </div>

        {/* 年月ピッカー（直接年月を指定して過去へジャンプ） */}
        <div className="relative flex items-center">
          <input
            type="month"
            value={currentMonthStr}
            onChange={handleMonthChange}
            className="h-8 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border rounded-lg shadow-xs focus:ring-2 focus:ring-primary focus:outline-none cursor-pointer"
            title="年月を直接選択して過去の実績へジャンプ"
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* 過去月クイックショートカット */}
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto text-[11px] text-slate-500">
        <span className="shrink-0 text-slate-400 flex items-center gap-1 mr-0.5">
          <CalendarIcon className="w-3 h-3" />
          過去実績:
        </span>
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          className="h-7 px-2 text-[11px] border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100"
          onClick={() => handleJump(getPastMonthStr(1))}
        >
          先月
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          className="h-7 px-2 text-[11px] border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100"
          onClick={() => handleJump(getPastMonthStr(2))}
        >
          2ヶ月前
        </Button>
        <Button
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          className="h-7 px-2 text-[11px] border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100"
          onClick={() => handleJump(getPastMonthStr(3))}
        >
          3ヶ月前
        </Button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

File: src/app/support-records/SupportRecordForm.tsx
