'use client'

import { useState, useEffect, useTransition } from 'react'
import { useRouter } from 'next/navigation'
import { toast } from 'sonner'
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card"
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input"
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label"
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge"
import { 
  saveSupportRecord, 
  getClientDayScheduleAndAttendance, 
  ClientScheduleAndAttendance 
} from "./actions"
import { 
  Clock, 
  Calendar, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  AlertTriangle, 
  RefreshCw, 
  Save, 
  ArrowRight,
  Info
} from "lucide-react"

interface StaffMember {
  id: string
  full_name: string
  job_category: string
  role?: string
}

interface ClientOption {
  id: string
  full_name: string
}

interface ActivePlan {
  id: string
  start_date: string
  end_date: string
  short_term_goal?: string
}

export function SupportRecordForm({
  activeClients,
  staffMembers,
  defaultDate,
  defaultClientId,
  clientActivePlans,
  departmentId
}: {
  activeClients: ClientOption[]
  staffMembers: StaffMember[]
  defaultDate: string
  defaultClientId: string
  clientActivePlans: Record<string, ActivePlan | null>
  departmentId?: string
}) {
  const router = useRouter()
  const [recordDate, setRecordDate] = useState(defaultDate)
  const [clientId, setClientId] = useState(defaultClientId)

  useEffect(() => {
    if (defaultDate) setRecordDate(defaultDate)
  }, [defaultDate])

  useEffect(() => {
    if (defaultClientId) setClientId(defaultClientId)
  }, [defaultClientId])
  const [serviceStartTime, setServiceStartTime] = useState('')
  const [serviceEndTime, setServiceEndTime] = useState('')
  const [serviceLocation, setServiceLocation] = useState('施設内')
  
  // バイタル
  const [temperature, setTemperature] = useState('')
  const [bloodPressure, setBloodPressure] = useState('')
  const [sleep, setSleep] = useState('')
  const [mood, setMood] = useState('')

  // 担当職員・作業内容
  const [staffId, setStaffId] = useState('')
  const [taskContent, setTaskContent] = useState('')
  const [staffComment, setStaffComment] = useState('')

  // スケジュール・打刻連携データ
  const [dayInfo, setDayInfo] = useState<ClientScheduleAndAttendance | null>(null)
  const [isLoadingDayInfo, setIsLoadingDayInfo] = useState(false)
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition()

  // 確認モーダル（打刻時間との不一致時）
  const [showConfirmModal, setShowConfirmModal] = useState(false)
  const [isUserOverridden, setIsUserOverridden] = useState(false)

  // 利用者または日付が変更された際に打刻・シフト・既存記録を取得
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!clientId || !recordDate) {
      setDayInfo(null)
      return
    }

    let isMounted = true
    setIsLoadingDayInfo(true)

    getClientDayScheduleAndAttendance(clientId, recordDate).then(info => {
      if (!isMounted) return
      setIsLoadingDayInfo(false)
      setDayInfo(info)

      if (info) {
        // 既存の記録がある場合はそれを優先復元
        if (info.existingRecord) {
          setServiceStartTime(info.existingRecord.serviceStartTime || '')
          setServiceEndTime(info.existingRecord.serviceEndTime || '')
          setServiceLocation(info.existingRecord.serviceLocation || '施設内')
          setTaskContent(info.existingRecord.taskContent || '')
          setStaffComment(info.existingRecord.staffComment || '')
          setStaffId(info.existingRecord.staffId || '')
          if (info.existingRecord.vitals) {
            setTemperature(info.existingRecord.vitals.temperature || '')
            setBloodPressure(info.existingRecord.vitals.bloodPressure || '')
            setSleep(info.existingRecord.vitals.sleep || '')
            setMood(info.existingRecord.vitals.mood || '')
          }
          setIsUserOverridden(false)
        } else {
          // 新規記録の場合、推奨値（打刻優先 → シフト → 基本設定）をスマート自動セット
          setServiceStartTime(info.recommendedStartTime || '')
          setServiceEndTime(info.recommendedEndTime || '')
          setServiceLocation(info.recommendedLocation || '施設内')
          setIsUserOverridden(false)
        }
      }
    })

    return () => {
      isMounted = false
    }
  }, [clientId, recordDate])

  // 打刻時間との差異チェック
  const hasClockTimes = !!(dayInfo?.clockIn && dayInfo?.clockOut)
  const isTimeMismatched = hasClockTimes && (
    serviceStartTime !== dayInfo?.clockIn || 
    serviceEndTime !== dayInfo?.clockOut
  )

  // ワンクリックで打刻時間に合わせる
  const handleSyncToAttendance = () => {
    if (dayInfo?.clockIn) setServiceStartTime(dayInfo.clockIn)
    if (dayInfo?.clockOut) setServiceEndTime(dayInfo.clockOut)
    setIsUserOverridden(false)
  }

  // ワンクリックでシフト予定時間に合わせる
  const handleSyncToShift = () => {
    if (dayInfo?.scheduledIn) setServiceStartTime(dayInfo.scheduledIn)
    if (dayInfo?.scheduledOut) setServiceEndTime(dayInfo.scheduledOut)
    setIsUserOverridden(false)
  }

  // フォーム送信ハンドラ
  const handleSubmitClick = (e: React.FormEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault()

    // もし打刻実績があり、入力時間と食い違っている場合、かつまだ確認していない場合は確認ダイアログを表示
    if (isTimeMismatched && !isUserOverridden) {
      setShowConfirmModal(true)
      return
    }

    submitForm(serviceStartTime, serviceEndTime)
  }

  const submitForm = (startTime: string, endTime: string) => {
    const formData = new FormData()
    formData.append('recordDate', recordDate)
    formData.append('clientId', clientId)
    formData.append('serviceStartTime', startTime)
    formData.append('serviceEndTime', endTime)
    formData.append('serviceLocation', serviceLocation)
    formData.append('temperature', temperature)
    formData.append('bloodPressure', bloodPressure)
    formData.append('sleep', sleep)
    formData.append('mood', mood)
    formData.append('staffId', staffId)
    formData.append('taskContent', taskContent)
    formData.append('staffComment', staffComment)
    if (departmentId) {
      formData.append('departmentId', departmentId)
    }

    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await saveSupportRecord(formData)
      if (!res.success) {
        toast.error(res.error || '支援記録の保存に失敗しました')
      } else {
        if (res.warning) {
          toast.warning(`支援記録を保存しました（※${res.warning}）`)
        } else {
          toast.success('支援記録を保存しました')
        }
        router.refresh()
      }
    })
  }

  // 確認モーダルでの「打刻時間に合わせて保存」
  const handleConfirmSyncAndSave = () => {
    setShowConfirmModal(false)
    const targetStart = dayInfo?.clockIn || serviceStartTime
    const targetEnd = dayInfo?.clockOut || serviceEndTime
    setServiceStartTime(targetStart)
    setServiceEndTime(targetEnd)
    submitForm(targetStart, targetEnd)
  }

  // 確認モーダルでの「このまま（電話相談等）保存」
  const handleConfirmAsIsSave = () => {
    setShowConfirmModal(false)
    setIsUserOverridden(true)
    submitForm(serviceStartTime, serviceEndTime)
  }

  const activePlan = clientId ? clientActivePlans[clientId] : null
  const selectedClient = activeClients.find(c => c.id === clientId)

  return (
    <>
      <Card className="shadow-sm print:hidden border-indigo-100">
        <CardHeader className="bg-primary/5 border-b pb-4">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <div>
              <CardTitle className="text-xl flex items-center gap-2">
                <span>支援記録の入力・登録</span>
                {dayInfo?.existingRecord && (
                  <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs bg-amber-100 text-amber-800 border-amber-300">
                    同日の記録を編集中
                  </Badge>
                )}
              </CardTitle>
              <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-1">
                当日のタイムカード打刻およびシフト予定を自動照合し、ヒューマンエラーを防止します。
              </p>
            </div>
            {isLoadingDayInfo && (
              <span className="text-xs text-muted-foreground flex items-center gap-1.5 animate-pulse">
                <RefreshCw className="w-3.5 h-3.5 animate-spin" /> 打刻・シフト照合中...
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
        </CardHeader>

        <CardContent className="pt-6">
          <form onSubmit={handleSubmitClick} className="space-y-5">
            {/* 個別支援計画の目標表示（実地指導対策） */}
            {activePlan ? (
              <div className="p-3 bg-indigo-50/80 border border-indigo-200 rounded-lg text-xs space-y-1">
                <div className="font-bold text-indigo-950 flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-bold">
                    🎯 {selectedClient?.full_name} 様の個別支援計画 策定目標（計画目標に即した直接支援）
                  </span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-indigo-700 bg-white px-2 py-0.5 rounded border border-indigo-200">
                    期間: {activePlan.start_date} 〜 {activePlan.end_date}
                  </span>
                </div>
                <div className="text-indigo-900 pt-0.5">
                  <span className="font-semibold text-indigo-700">【短期目標】:</span> {activePlan.short_term_goal || '（目標未設定）'}
                </div>
              </div>
            ) : clientId ? (
              <div className="p-3 bg-amber-50/90 border border-amber-300 rounded-lg text-xs space-y-1 text-amber-900">
                <div className="font-bold flex items-center gap-1.5 text-amber-900">
                  <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
                  <span>【警告・個別支援計画未作成】{selectedClient?.full_name} 様の有効な個別支援計画が存在しません</span>
                </div>
                <p className="text-[11px] text-amber-800">
                  ※テスト・移行運用のため記録の入力・保存は可能です。本番請求時には「個別支援計画未作成減算（-30%）」の対象となるため、後ほど計画を作成・有効化してください。
                </p>
              </div>
            ) : null}

            {/* 日付・利用者選択 */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 gap-4">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="recordDate" className="font-semibold">日付 <span className="text-destructive">*</span></Label>
                <Input 
                  type="date" 
                  id="recordDate" 
                  name="recordDate" 
                  required 
                  value={recordDate}
                  onChange={(e) => setRecordDate(e.target.value)} 
                />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="clientId" className="font-semibold">利用者 <span className="text-destructive">*</span></Label>
                <select 
                  id="clientId" 
                  name="clientId" 
                  required 
                  value={clientId}
                  onChange={(e) => setClientId(e.target.value)}
                  className="flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  <option value="">選択してください</option>
                  {activeClients.map(c => (
                    <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>{c.full_name}</option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* タイムカード打刻・シフト予定のスマート照合バナー */}
            {clientId && dayInfo && (
              <div className="p-3 rounded-lg border bg-slate-50/90 text-xs space-y-2">
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
                    <span className="font-bold text-slate-800 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-blue-600" />
                      当日の打刻・シフト状況:
                    </span>
                    {dayInfo.hasAttendance && dayInfo.clockIn ? (
                      <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300 font-bold">
                        タイムカード打刻: {dayInfo.clockIn} 〜 {dayInfo.clockOut || '退勤未打刻'}
                      </Badge>
                    ) : (
                      <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-amber-50 text-amber-800 border-amber-300">
                        タイムカード打刻: なし
                      </Badge>
                    )}

                    {dayInfo.hasShift && dayInfo.scheduledIn && (
                      <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-blue-50 text-blue-800 border-blue-200">
                        シフト予定: {dayInfo.scheduledIn} 〜 {dayInfo.scheduledOut || '--:--'}
                      </Badge>
                    )}
                  </div>

                  {/* 連動ボタン群 */}
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-2">
                    {dayInfo.hasAttendance && dayInfo.clockIn && (
                      <Button 
                        type="button" 
                        variant="outline" 
                        size="sm" 
                        onClick={handleSyncToAttendance}
                        className="h-auto py-1 px-2.5 text-xs bg-white text-emerald-700 hover:bg-emerald-50 border-emerald-300"
                      >
                        <RefreshCw className="w-3 h-3 mr-1 shrink-0" />
                        打刻時間（{dayInfo.clockIn}〜{dayInfo.clockOut || ''}）に合わせる
                      </Button>
                    )}
                    {dayInfo.hasShift && dayInfo.scheduledIn && (
                      <Button 
                        type="button" 
                        variant="outline" 
                        size="sm" 
                        onClick={handleSyncToShift}
                        className="h-auto py-1 px-2.5 text-xs bg-white text-blue-700 hover:bg-blue-50 border-blue-200"
                      >
                        <RefreshCw className="w-3 h-3 mr-1 shrink-0" />
                        シフト予定に合わせる
                      </Button>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* 打刻とのズレ警告アシスト */}
                {isTimeMismatched && (
                  <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-2 p-2.5 rounded bg-amber-50 border border-amber-300 text-amber-950 font-medium">
                    <span className="flex items-center gap-1.5 text-xs">
                      <AlertTriangle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
                      入力中のサービス時間（{serviceStartTime}〜{serviceEndTime}）が打刻時間（{dayInfo.clockIn}〜{dayInfo.clockOut}）と異なっています。
                    </span>
                    <Button 
                      type="button" 
                      size="sm" 
                      onClick={handleSyncToAttendance}
                      className="w-full sm:w-auto h-7 text-xs bg-amber-600 hover:bg-amber-700 text-white font-bold shrink-0"
                    >
                      打刻時間に修正
                    </Button>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* サービス提供時間・提供場所 */}
            <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-4">
              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="serviceStartTime" className="font-semibold">サービス提供開始時刻</Label>
                <Input 
                  type="time" 
                  id="serviceStartTime" 
                  name="serviceStartTime" 
                  value={serviceStartTime}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setServiceStartTime(e.target.value)
                    setIsUserOverridden(true)
                  }}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="serviceEndTime" className="font-semibold">サービス提供終了時刻</Label>
                <Input 
                  type="time" 
                  id="serviceEndTime" 
                  name="serviceEndTime" 
                  value={serviceEndTime}
                  onChange={(e) => {
                    setServiceEndTime(e.target.value)
                    setIsUserOverridden(true)
                  }}
                />
              </div>

              <div className="space-y-2">
                <Label htmlFor="serviceLocation" className="font-semibold">提供場所</Label>
                <select 
                  id="serviceLocation" 
                  name="serviceLocation" 
                  value={serviceLocation}
                  onChange={(e) => setServiceLocation(e.target.value)}
                  className="flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
                >
                  <option value="施設内">施設内</option>
                  <option value="施設外">施設外</option>
                  <option value="在宅">在宅</option>
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* バイタルサイン */}
            <div className="space-y-3">
              <h3 className="text-sm font-semibold border-b pb-1 flex items-center justify-between text-slate-800">
                <span>バイタルサイン等（健康管理）</span>
                <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground font-normal">※ 任意入力（実地指導での体調把握記録に対応）</span>
              </h3>
              <div className="grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4">
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <Label htmlFor="temperature" className="text-xs">体温 (℃)</Label>
                  <Input 
                    id="temperature" 
                    name="temperature" 
                    type="number" 
                    step="0.1" 
                    min="34" 
                    max="42" 
                    placeholder="36.5" 
                    value={temperature}
                    onChange={(e) => setTemperature(e.target.value)}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <Label htmlFor="bloodPressure" className="text-xs">血圧</Label>
                  <Input 
                    id="bloodPressure" 
                    name="bloodPressure" 
                    placeholder="例: 120/80" 
                    pattern="[0-9]{2,3}/[0-9]{2,3}" 
                    title="収縮期/拡張期の形式で入力してください（例: 120/80）" 
                    value={bloodPressure}
                    onChange={(e) => setBloodPressure(e.target.value)}
                  />
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <Label htmlFor="sleep" className="text-xs">睡眠</Label>
                  <select 
                    id="sleep" 
                    name="sleep" 
                    value={sleep}
                    onChange={(e) => setSleep(e.target.value)}
                    className="flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring"
                  >
                    <option value="">選択</option>
                    <option value="良好">良好</option>
                    <option value="普通">普通</option>
                    <option value="不良">不良</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  <Label htmlFor="mood" className="text-xs">気分</Label>
                  <select 
                    id="mood" 
                    name="mood" 
                    value={mood}
                    onChange={(e) => setMood(e.target.value)}
                    className="flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring"
                  >
                    <option value="">選択</option>
                    <option value="良好">良好</option>
                    <option value="普通">普通</option>
                    <option value="不良">不良</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* 担当職員 */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="staffId" className="font-semibold">担当職員（直接支援員）</Label>
              <select 
                id="staffId" 
                name="staffId" 
                value={staffId}
                onChange={(e) => setStaffId(e.target.value)}
                className="flex h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-transparent px-3 py-1 text-sm shadow-sm transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-50"
              >
                <option value="">選択してください</option>
                {staffMembers.map(s => (
                  <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>{s.full_name} ({s.job_category || '直接処遇職員'})</option>
                ))}
              </select>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground">
                ※ 法令上の専任・専従義務遵守のため、直接処遇職員（職業指導員・生活支援員）のみ選択できます（サビ管・管理者・賃金向上指導員等は直接支援担当者として登録できません）。
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* 作業内容・支援員コメント */}
            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="taskContent" className="font-semibold">作業内容</Label>
              <Textarea 
                id="taskContent" 
                name="taskContent" 
                placeholder="本日の具体的な作業内容を記載してください" 
                className="min-h-[80px]" 
                value={taskContent}
                onChange={(e) => setTaskContent(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>

            <div className="space-y-2">
              <Label htmlFor="staffComment" className="font-semibold">支援員からのコメント（特記事項など）</Label>
              <Textarea 
                id="staffComment" 
                name="staffComment" 
                placeholder="支援員としての所見や引き継ぎ事項などを記載してください" 
                className="min-h-[80px]" 
                value={staffComment}
                onChange={(e) => setStaffComment(e.target.value)}
              />
            </div>

            {/* 保存ボタン */}
            <div className="pt-2 flex justify-end">
              <Button type="submit" disabled={isPending} className="px-6 font-bold flex items-center gap-2">
                <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
                {isPending ? '保存中...' : (dayInfo?.existingRecord ? '支援記録を上書き・更新' : '支援記録を登録・保存')}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </form>
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* 最後の砦：打刻時間と異なる場合の確認モーダル */}
      {showConfirmModal && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4 print:hidden animate-in fade-in duration-200">
          <div className="bg-white rounded-lg max-w-lg w-full p-6 shadow-xl border space-y-4">
            <div className="flex items-start gap-3">
              <div className="p-2 bg-amber-100 rounded-full text-amber-700 shrink-0">
                <AlertTriangle className="w-6 h-6" />
              </div>
              <div className="space-y-1">
                <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-slate-900">
                  サービス提供時間の確認
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  タイムカードの打刻時間と入力されたサービス時間が異なっています。
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="p-3 bg-amber-50/80 border border-amber-200 rounded-md text-xs space-y-2 text-amber-950">
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                <span>タイムカード打刻時間:</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-sm text-emerald-700">
                  {dayInfo?.clockIn} 〜 {dayInfo?.clockOut}
                </span>
              </div>
              <div className="flex justify-between items-center">
                <span>現在入力中のサービス時間:</span>
                <span className="font-bold text-sm text-amber-800">
                  {serviceStartTime} 〜 {serviceEndTime}
                </span>
              </div>
              <p className="text-[11px] text-amber-800 pt-1 border-t border-amber-200">
                ※遅刻・早退の修正忘れを防ぐため、通常はタイムカードの打刻時間と一致させることが推奨されます。
              </p>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-col gap-2 pt-2">
              <Button 
                onClick={handleConfirmSyncAndSave}
                className="w-full bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-bold text-sm h-10"
              >
                <CheckCircle2 className="w-4 h-4 mr-2" />
                打刻時間（{dayInfo?.clockIn}〜{dayInfo?.clockOut}）に合わせて保存（推奨）
              </Button>

              <Button 
                variant="outline" 
                onClick={handleConfirmAsIsSave}
                className="w-full text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-100 text-xs h-9"
              >
                このまま（出勤前の電話相談・送迎支援など）保存する
              </Button>

              <Button 
                variant="ghost" 
                onClick={() => setShowConfirmModal(false)}
                className="w-full text-muted-foreground text-xs h-8"
              >
                キャンセル（入力画面に戻る）
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </>
  )
}


================================================================================

'use server'

import { revalidatePath } from 'next/cache'
import { redirect } from 'next/navigation'
import { db, sanitizeForeignKeyId } from '@/lib/db'
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid'
import { getRole, assertCanAccessClient } from '@/lib/auth'
import { isMonthLocked } from '@/app/billing/actions'
import { logAudit } from '@/lib/audit'
import { supportRecordSchema, getFirstZodErrorMessage } from '@/lib/validations'

export async function saveSupportRecord(formData: FormData): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string; warning?: string }> {
  try {
    const role = await getRole()
    if (!role) return { success: false, error: '認証されていません。ログインしてください。' }

    const parseResult = supportRecordSchema.safeParse({
      clientId: formData.get('clientId'),
      recordDate: formData.get('recordDate'),
      taskContent: formData.get('taskContent') as string || '',
      staffComment: formData.get('staffComment') as string || '',
      staffId: formData.get('staffId') as string || null,
    })

    if (!parseResult.success) {
      const msg = getFirstZodErrorMessage(parseResult.error);
      return { success: false, error: msg };
    }
    const parsedData = parseResult.data;
    await assertCanAccessClient(parsedData.clientId);

    const safeStaffId = sanitizeForeignKeyId('staff', parsedData.staffId);
    const temperature = formData.get('temperature') as string || '';
    const bloodPressure = formData.get('bloodPressure') as string || '';
    const sleep = formData.get('sleep') as string || '';
    const mood = formData.get('mood') as string || '';
    const serviceStartTime = formData.get('serviceStartTime') as string || null;
    const serviceEndTime = formData.get('serviceEndTime') as string || null;
    const serviceLocation = formData.get('serviceLocation') as string || null;

    // M-7: バイタルデータの範囲チェック
    if (temperature && temperature.trim() !== '') {
      const temp = parseFloat(temperature);
      if (isNaN(temp) || temp < 34.0 || temp > 42.0) {
        return { success: false, error: '体温は34.0～42.0℃の範囲で入力してください' };
      }
    }

    const vitalsJson = JSON.stringify({
      temperature,
      bloodPressure,
      sleep,
      mood
    });

    // 月次確定ロックチェック
    const yearMonth = parsedData.recordDate.substring(0, 7);
    if (await isMonthLocked(yearMonth)) {
      return { success: false, error: `【警告】${yearMonth}月は請求データが月次確定ロックされているため、支援記録を登録・更新できません。変更が必要な場合は管理者にロック解除を依頼してください。` };
    }

    // S-05: 個別支援計画の有効期間チェック（移行・テスト運用の利便性のため、ブロックせず警告通知にとどめて保存を許可）
    const activePlan = db.prepare(`
      SELECT id, plan_date, start_date, end_date, status
      FROM support_plans
      WHERE client_id = ? 
        AND status = 'active'
        AND start_date <= ?
        AND end_date >= ?
        AND deleted_at IS NULL
    `).get(parsedData.clientId, parsedData.recordDate, parsedData.recordDate) as any;

    let planWarning = '';
    if (!activePlan) {
      const client = db.prepare('SELECT full_name, service_start_date FROM clients WHERE id = ?').get(parsedData.clientId) as any;
      planWarning = `【注意・個別支援計画未作成】${client?.full_name || '対象者'}さんの記録日（${parsedData.recordDate}）に有効な個別支援計画が存在しません（未作成のまま本番請求すると「個別支援計画未作成減算（-30%）」の対象となります。後ほど計画を作成・有効化してください）。`;
    }

    // 実地指導・監査対応: 出勤実績との整合性チェック（移行・テスト運用の利便性のため警告通知にとどめて保存を許可）
    const attendance = db.prepare(`
      SELECT status, is_absence_addition 
      FROM attendance_records 
      WHERE client_id = ? AND record_date = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
    `).get(parsedData.clientId, parsedData.recordDate) as any;

    let attendanceWarning = '';
    if (!attendance || (attendance.status !== 'present' && attendance.status !== 'out_facility' && attendance.is_absence_addition !== 1)) {
      const client = db.prepare('SELECT full_name FROM clients WHERE id = ?').get(parsedData.clientId) as any;
      attendanceWarning = `【注意・勤怠未登録】${client?.full_name || '対象者'}さんの記録日（${parsedData.recordDate}）の出勤実績が確認できません（後ほど出退勤打刻・利用実績を登録してください）。`;
    }

    // 法令専任チェック: サービス管理責任者、管理者、賃金向上達成指導員等の直接処遇外職種は直接支援記録の担当者として登録不可（警告通知）
    let staffWarning = '';
    if (safeStaffId) {
      const assignedStaff = db.prepare('SELECT name, job_category, role FROM staff WHERE id = ?').get(safeStaffId) as any;
      if (assignedStaff) {
        const nonDirectCategories = [
          'サービス管理責任者', '管理者', '管理者 兼 サービス管理責任者', 
          '賃金向上達成指導員', '視覚・聴覚言語障害者支援指導員', '重度者支援専門員', 
          '送迎ドライバー', '調理員', '事務員'
        ];
        const isDirectCare = (
          (assignedStaff.job_category === '職業指導員' || assignedStaff.job_category === '生活支援員') ||
          (assignedStaff.role === 'vocational_instructor' || assignedStaff.role === 'life_support_worker')
        ) && !nonDirectCategories.includes(assignedStaff.job_category);

        if (!isDirectCare) {
          staffWarning = `【注意・専任基準】担当の${assignedStaff.name}さん（${assignedStaff.job_category || assignedStaff.role}）は法令上の専任義務がある役職です（実地指導では職業指導員・生活支援員の記録が求められます）。`;
        }
      }
    }

    // 現場UX改善: 同日記録がある場合の追記対応
    const existing = db.prepare(`
      SELECT vitals, task_content, staff_comment 
      FROM support_records 
      WHERE client_id = ? AND record_date = ?
    `).get(parsedData.clientId, parsedData.recordDate) as any;

    let finalStaffComment = parsedData.staffComment;
    let finalTaskContent = parsedData.taskContent;
    const isAppend = formData.get('isAppend') === 'true';

    if (existing && isAppend) {
      if (existing.staff_comment && parsedData.staffComment && existing.staff_comment !== parsedData.staffComment) {
        finalStaffComment = `${existing.staff_comment}\n---\n【追記】${parsedData.staffComment}`;
      } else {
        finalStaffComment = parsedData.staffComment || existing.staff_comment || '';
      }
      if (!finalTaskContent && existing.task_content) {
        finalTaskContent = existing.task_content;
      }
    }

    const stmt = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO support_records (
        id, client_id, record_date, vitals, task_content, staff_comment, staff_id,
        service_start_time, service_end_time, service_location
      ) VALUES (
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?
      )
      ON CONFLICT(client_id, record_date) DO UPDATE SET
        vitals = excluded.vitals,
        task_content = excluded.task_content,
        staff_comment = excluded.staff_comment,
        staff_id = excluded.staff_id,
        service_start_time = excluded.service_start_time,
        service_end_time = excluded.service_end_time,
        service_location = excluded.service_location,
        deleted_at = NULL
    `);

    stmt.run(
      uuidv4(),
      parsedData.clientId,
      parsedData.recordDate,
      vitalsJson,
      finalTaskContent,
      finalStaffComment,
      safeStaffId,
      serviceStartTime,
      serviceEndTime,
      serviceLocation
    );

    // 監査ログに記録
    await logAudit({
      action: 'update',
      targetTable: 'support_records',
      targetId: `${parsedData.clientId}:${parsedData.recordDate}`,
      details: { clientId: parsedData.clientId, date: parsedData.recordDate }
    });

    try {
      revalidatePath('/support-records');
      revalidatePath('/support-records/ledger');
    } catch (e) {}
    const allWarnings = [planWarning, attendanceWarning, staffWarning].filter(Boolean).join(' / ');
    return {
      success: true,
      warning: allWarnings || undefined
    };
  } catch (error: any) {
    if (error && error.message && error.message.includes('NEXT_REDIRECT')) {
      throw error;
    }
    console.error('支援記録保存エラー:', error);
    return { success: false, error: error.message || '支援記録の保存に失敗しました' };
  }
}

export interface ClientScheduleAndAttendance {
  hasAttendance: boolean;
  clockIn: string | null;
  clockOut: string | null;
  attendanceStatus: string | null;
  isOffsite: boolean;
  isTelework: boolean;
  isAbsenceAddition: boolean;
  hasShift: boolean;
  scheduledIn: string | null;
  scheduledOut: string | null;
  shiftWorkType: string | null;
  defaultStartTime: string;
  defaultEndTime: string;
  recommendedStartTime: string;
  recommendedEndTime: string;
  recommendedLocation: '施設内' | '施設外' | '在宅';
  recommendedSource: 'attendance' | 'shift' | 'default';
  existingRecord: {
    id: string;
    taskContent: string;
    staffComment: string;
    serviceStartTime: string | null;
    serviceEndTime: string | null;
    serviceLocation: string | null;
    staffId: string | null;
    vitals: any;
  } | null;
}

/**
 * 現場UX向上 & ヒューマンエラー防止:
 * 利用者と日付から、タイムカード打刻実績・シフト予定・既存支援記録を取得し、
 * 最適な推奨初期値と打刻との差異チェック情報を提供する
 */
export async function getClientDayScheduleAndAttendance(
  clientId: string,
  recordDate: string
): Promise<ClientScheduleAndAttendance | null> {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role || !clientId || !recordDate) return null;
    await assertCanAccessClient(clientId);

    const client = db.prepare(`
      SELECT id, full_name, work_start_time, work_end_time 
      FROM clients 
      WHERE id = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
    `).get(clientId) as any;

    if (!client) return null;

    // 1. 打刻実績
    const att = db.prepare(`
      SELECT clock_in, clock_out, status, is_offsite, is_telework, is_absence_addition
      FROM attendance_records
      WHERE client_id = ? AND record_date = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
    `).get(clientId, recordDate) as any;

    // 2. シフト予定
    const shift = db.prepare(`
      SELECT scheduled_in, scheduled_out, work_type, is_offsite
      FROM client_shifts
      WHERE client_id = ? AND target_date = ?
    `).get(clientId, recordDate) as any;

    // 3. 既存の支援記録
    const existing = db.prepare(`
      SELECT id, task_content, staff_comment, service_start_time, service_end_time, service_location, staff_id, vitals
      FROM support_records
      WHERE client_id = ? AND record_date = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
    `).get(clientId, recordDate) as any;

    let parsedVitals = null;
    if (existing?.vitals) {
      try {
        parsedVitals = JSON.parse(existing.vitals);
      } catch {}
    }

    const defaultStartTime = client.work_start_time || '09:00';
    const defaultEndTime = client.work_end_time || '15:00';

    let recommendedStartTime = defaultStartTime;
    let recommendedEndTime = defaultEndTime;
    let recommendedLocation: '施設内' | '施設外' | '在宅' = '施設内';
    let recommendedSource: 'attendance' | 'shift' | 'default' = 'default';

    if (att && (att.clock_in || att.clock_out)) {
      recommendedStartTime = att.clock_in || shift?.scheduled_in || defaultStartTime;
      recommendedEndTime = att.clock_out || shift?.scheduled_out || defaultEndTime;
      recommendedSource = 'attendance';
      if (att.is_telework === 1) {
        recommendedLocation = '在宅';
      } else if (att.is_offsite === 1 || att.status === 'out_facility') {
        recommendedLocation = '施設外';
      } else {
        recommendedLocation = '施設内';
      }
    } else if (shift && (shift.scheduled_in || shift.scheduled_out)) {
      recommendedStartTime = shift.scheduled_in || defaultStartTime;
      recommendedEndTime = shift.scheduled_out || defaultEndTime;
      recommendedSource = 'shift';
      if (shift.work_type === 'out_facility' || shift.is_offsite === 1) {
        recommendedLocation = '施設外';
      } else {
        recommendedLocation = '施設内';
      }
    }

    return {
      hasAttendance: !!att,
      clockIn: att?.clock_in || null,
      clockOut: att?.clock_out || null,
      attendanceStatus: att?.status || null,
      isOffsite: att?.is_offsite === 1,
      isTelework: att?.is_telework === 1,
      isAbsenceAddition: att?.is_absence_addition === 1,
      hasShift: !!shift,
      scheduledIn: shift?.scheduled_in || null,
      scheduledOut: shift?.scheduled_out || null,
      shiftWorkType: shift?.work_type || null,
      defaultStartTime,
      defaultEndTime,
      recommendedStartTime,
      recommendedEndTime,
      recommendedLocation,
      recommendedSource,
      existingRecord: existing ? {
        id: existing.id,
        taskContent: existing.task_content || '',
        staffComment: existing.staff_comment || '',
        serviceStartTime: existing.service_start_time || null,
        serviceEndTime: existing.service_end_time || null,
        serviceLocation: existing.service_location || null,
        staffId: existing.staff_id || null,
        vitals: parsedVitals
      } : null
    };
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('スケジュール・打刻取得エラー:', error);
    return null;
  }
}

export async function updateSupportRecordInline(payload: {
  clientId: string;
  recordDate: string;
  serviceStartTime?: string | null;
  serviceEndTime?: string | null;
  serviceLocation?: string | null;
  temperature?: string;
  bloodPressure?: string;
  sleep?: string;
  mood?: string;
  taskContent: string;
  staffComment: string;
  staffId?: string | null;
}): Promise<{ success: boolean; error?: string; warning?: string }> {
  try {
    const role = await getRole();
    if (!role) return { success: false, error: 'ログインが必要です' };
    await assertCanAccessClient(payload.clientId);

    if (!payload.taskContent || payload.taskContent.trim() === '') {
      return { success: false, error: '作業内容を入力してください' };
    }

    // M-7: バイタルチェック
    if (payload.temperature && payload.temperature.trim() !== '') {
      const temp = parseFloat(payload.temperature);
      if (isNaN(temp) || temp < 34.0 || temp > 42.0) {
        return { success: false, error: '体温は34.0～42.0℃の範囲で入力してください' };
      }
    }

    // 月次確定ロック
    const yearMonth = payload.recordDate.substring(0, 7);
    if (await isMonthLocked(yearMonth)) {
      return { success: false, error: `【警告】${yearMonth}月は請求データが月次確定ロックされているため、支援記録を登録・更新できません。` };
    }

    // 個別支援計画チェック（移行・テスト運用の利便性のため、ブロックせず保存を許可）
    const activePlan = db.prepare(`
      SELECT id FROM support_plans
      WHERE client_id = ? AND status = 'active' AND start_date <= ? AND end_date >= ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
    `).get(payload.clientId, payload.recordDate, payload.recordDate) as any;

    // 勤怠チェック（移行・テスト運用の利便性のため、ブロックせず保存を許可）
    const attendance = db.prepare(`
      SELECT status, is_absence_addition FROM attendance_records
      WHERE client_id = ? AND record_date = ? AND deleted_at IS NULL
    `).get(payload.clientId, payload.recordDate) as any;

    let inlineWarning: string | undefined;
    if (!activePlan) {
      inlineWarning = '※有効な個別支援計画が未作成です（本番請求時は未作成減算対象）';
    } else if (!attendance || (attendance.status !== 'present' && attendance.status !== 'out_facility' && attendance.is_absence_addition !== 1)) {
      inlineWarning = '※出勤実績が未登録です';
    }

    const vitalsJson = JSON.stringify({
      temperature: payload.temperature || '',
      bloodPressure: payload.bloodPressure || '',
      sleep: payload.sleep || '',
      mood: payload.mood || ''
    });

    const safeStaffId = sanitizeForeignKeyId('staff', payload.staffId);

    const stmt = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO support_records (
        id, client_id, record_date, vitals, task_content, staff_comment, staff_id,
        service_start_time, service_end_time, service_location
      ) VALUES (
        ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?
      )
      ON CONFLICT(client_id, record_date) DO UPDATE SET
        vitals = excluded.vitals,
        task_content = excluded.task_content,
        staff_comment = excluded.staff_comment,
        staff_id = excluded.staff_id,
        service_start_time = excluded.service_start_time,
        service_end_time = excluded.service_end_time,
        service_location = excluded.service_location,
        deleted_at = NULL
    `);

    stmt.run(
      uuidv4(),
      payload.clientId,
      payload.recordDate,
      vitalsJson,
      payload.taskContent,
      payload.staffComment,
      safeStaffId,
      payload.serviceStartTime || null,
      payload.serviceEndTime || null,
      payload.serviceLocation || null
    );

    await logAudit({
      action: 'update',
      targetTable: 'support_records',
      targetId: `${payload.clientId}:${payload.recordDate}`,
      details: { clientId: payload.clientId, date: payload.recordDate }
    });

    try {
      revalidatePath('/support-records');
      revalidatePath('/support-records/ledger');
    } catch (e) {}
    return { success: true, warning: inlineWarning };
  } catch (err: any) {
    console.error('支援記録保存エラー:', err);
    return { success: false, error: err.message || '保存に失敗しました' };
  }
}

'use client';

import { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { useRouter } from "next/navigation";
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle, CardDescription } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button, buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label";
import { Textarea } from "@/components/ui/textarea";
import { 
  Clock, 
  CheckCircle2, 
  AlertCircle, 
  Edit3, 
  PlusCircle, 
  Calendar as CalendarIcon,
  X,
  Save,
  Loader2,
  CalendarDays
} from "lucide-react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { PrintButton } from "@/components/PrintButton";
import { updateSupportRecordInline } from "../actions";

export interface StaffMember {
  id: string;
  full_name: string;
  job_category?: string;
  role?: string;
}

export interface LedgerRecord {
  id: string;
  client_id: string;
  client_full_name: string;
  client_status: string;
  record_date: string;
  service_start_time: string | null;
  service_end_time: string | null;
  service_location: string | null;
  vitals: string | null;
  task_content: string | null;
  staff_comment: string | null;
  staff_id: string | null;
  staff_full_name: string | null;
}

export interface MissingClient {
  client_id: string;
  client_full_name: string;
  client_status: string;
  record_date: string;
  attendance_status: string;
  clock_in: string | null;
  clock_out: string | null;
  is_absence_addition: number;
}

interface ModalTarget {
  isNew: boolean;
  clientId: string;
  clientName: string;
  recordDate: string;
  serviceStartTime: string;
  serviceEndTime: string;
  serviceLocation: string;
  temperature: string;
  bloodPressure: string;
  sleep: string;
  mood: string;
  taskContent: string;
  staffComment: string;
  staffId: string;
}

export function SupportLedgerClient({
  records,
  missingClients,
  staffMembers,
  selectedMonth,
  selectedDate,
  selectedClientId,
  selectedClientName,
}: {
  records: LedgerRecord[];
  missingClients: MissingClient[];
  staffMembers: StaffMember[];
  selectedMonth: string;
  selectedDate: string | null;
  selectedClientId: string;
  selectedClientName: string;
}) {
  const router = useRouter();
  const [modalTarget, setModalTarget] = useState<ModalTarget | null>(null);
  const [errorMsg, setErrorMsg] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [isSaving, startSavingTransition] = useTransition();

  // 既存レコードの編集モーダルを開く
  const handleOpenEdit = (record: LedgerRecord) => {
    let parsedVitals: any = {};
    if (record.vitals) {
      try {
        if (record.vitals.startsWith('{')) {
          parsedVitals = JSON.parse(record.vitals);
        }
      } catch {}
    }

    setModalTarget({
      isNew: false,
      clientId: record.client_id,
      clientName: record.client_full_name,
      recordDate: record.record_date,
      serviceStartTime: record.service_start_time || '10:00',
      serviceEndTime: record.service_end_time || '15:00',
      serviceLocation: record.service_location || '施設内',
      temperature: parsedVitals.temperature || '',
      bloodPressure: parsedVitals.bloodPressure || '',
      sleep: parsedVitals.sleep || '',
      mood: parsedVitals.mood || '',
      taskContent: record.task_content || '',
      staffComment: record.staff_comment || '',
      staffId: record.staff_id || (staffMembers[0]?.id || ''),
    });
    setErrorMsg(null);
  };

  // 未作成者の新規作成モーダルを開く
  const handleOpenCreateForMissing = (missing: MissingClient) => {
    const isOutFacility = missing.attendance_status === 'out_facility';
    const isAbsence = missing.is_absence_addition === 1;

    setModalTarget({
      isNew: true,
      clientId: missing.client_id,
      clientName: missing.client_full_name,
      recordDate: missing.record_date,
      serviceStartTime: missing.clock_in || (isAbsence ? '' : '10:00'),
      serviceEndTime: missing.clock_out || (isAbsence ? '' : '15:00'),
      serviceLocation: isOutFacility ? '施設外' : '施設内',
      temperature: '',
      bloodPressure: '',
      sleep: '',
      mood: '',
      taskContent: isAbsence ? '欠席時対応（体調不良等の電話連絡・状況確認）' : '施設内作業',
      staffComment: '',
      staffId: staffMembers[0]?.id || '',
    });
    setErrorMsg(null);
  };

  // 保存処理
  const handleSave = () => {
    if (!modalTarget) return;

    if (!modalTarget.taskContent || modalTarget.taskContent.trim() === '') {
      setErrorMsg('作業内容を入力してください');
      return;
    }

    startSavingTransition(async () => {
      const res = await updateSupportRecordInline({
        clientId: modalTarget.clientId,
        recordDate: modalTarget.recordDate,
        serviceStartTime: modalTarget.serviceStartTime || null,
        serviceEndTime: modalTarget.serviceEndTime || null,
        serviceLocation: modalTarget.serviceLocation || null,
        temperature: modalTarget.temperature,
        bloodPressure: modalTarget.bloodPressure,
        sleep: modalTarget.sleep,
        mood: modalTarget.mood,
        taskContent: modalTarget.taskContent,
        staffComment: modalTarget.staffComment,
        staffId: modalTarget.staffId || null,
      });

      if (!res.success) {
        setErrorMsg(res.error || '保存に失敗しました');
      } else {
        setModalTarget(null);
        router.refresh();
      }
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-4">
      {/* ⚠️ 未作成のアラートバナー（対象日に未作成の出勤者がいる場合） */}
      {missingClients.length > 0 && (
        <Card className="border-amber-300 bg-amber-50/60 print:hidden shadow-xs">
          <CardHeader className="py-3 px-4 pb-2">
            <CardTitle className="text-sm font-bold text-amber-900 flex items-center gap-2">
              <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 text-amber-600 shrink-0" />
              <span>
                {selectedDate ? `【${selectedDate}】` : '対象期間内'}に支援記録が未作成の利用者が {missingClients.length} 名います
              </span>
            </CardTitle>
            <CardDescription className="text-xs text-amber-800">
              出勤または欠席時対応加算の対象ですが、支援記録が登録されていません。「作成」からその場で入力できます。
            </CardDescription>
          </CardHeader>
          <CardContent className="px-4 py-2 pt-0">
            <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2 pt-1">
              {missingClients.map(mc => (
                <div 
                  key={`${mc.client_id}-${mc.record_date}`}
                  className="flex items-center gap-2 bg-white px-2.5 py-1 rounded-md border border-amber-200 text-xs shadow-2xs"
                >
                  <span className="font-semibold text-slate-800">{mc.client_full_name}</span>
                  <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground font-mono">({mc.record_date.slice(5)})</span>
                  <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] py-0 px-1 border-amber-400 text-amber-800 bg-amber-50">
                    {mc.attendance_status === 'out_facility' ? '施設外' : mc.is_absence_addition === 1 ? '欠席加算' : '出勤'}
                  </Badge>
                  <Button
                    size="sm"
                    variant="outline"
                    className="h-6 px-2 text-[11px] bg-amber-500 hover:bg-amber-600 text-white font-semibold border-amber-600 cursor-pointer"
                    onClick={() => handleOpenCreateForMissing(mc)}
                  >
                    <PlusCircle className="w-3 h-3 mr-0.5" />
                    作成
                  </Button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          </CardContent>
        </Card>
      )}

      {/* 📑 月間支援記録台帳 テーブルカード */}
      <Card className="shadow-sm print:shadow-none print:border-none border-teal-200/80">
        <CardHeader className="bg-primary/5 border-b pb-4 print:hidden flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3">
          <div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <CardTitle className="text-xl text-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
                <CalendarDays className="w-5 h-5 text-teal-600" />
                <span>
                  {selectedDate ? (
                    <>【{selectedDate}】の支援記録</>
                  ) : selectedMonth === 'all' ? (
                    <>全期間の支援記録台帳</>
                  ) : (
                    <>{selectedMonth} の月間支援記録台帳</>
                  )}
                  {selectedClientId && `（${selectedClientName}）`}
                </span>
              </CardTitle>
              <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-white font-mono text-xs border-teal-300">
                {records.length} 件
              </Badge>
            </div>
            <CardDescription className="mt-1 text-xs">
              {selectedDate ? (
                <span>カレンダーで選択した日付の記録です。右端の「編集」からその場で内容を修正・保存できます。</span>
              ) : (
                <span>各行の「編集」から内容を確認・直接修正できます。実地指導用の5年間保存帳票として印刷可能です。</span>
              )}
            </CardDescription>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
            {selectedDate && (
              <Link
                href={`/support-records/ledger?month=${selectedMonth}${selectedClientId ? `&clientId=${selectedClientId}` : ''}`}
                className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm", className: "h-8 px-2.5 text-xs bg-white border-teal-300" })}
              >
                <CalendarIcon className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1 text-teal-600" />
                この月の全件表示に戻す
              </Link>
            )}
            <PrintButton label="支援記録簿を印刷" />
          </div>
        </CardHeader>

        <CardContent className="p-0 overflow-x-auto">
          {records && records.length > 0 ? (
            <Table className="min-w-[750px]">
              <TableHeader className="bg-muted/50">
                <TableRow>
                  <TableHead className="py-3 w-[110px]">日付</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="py-3 w-[150px]">利用者名</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="py-3 w-[160px]">時間 / 場所</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="py-3 w-[140px]">バイタル</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="py-3">作業内容 / 支援員コメント / 担当者</TableHead>
                  <TableHead className="py-3 w-[90px] text-center print:hidden">操作</TableHead>
                </TableRow>
              </TableHeader>
              <TableBody>
                {records.map(record => {
                  let parsedVitals: any = null;
                  let vitalsFallbackStr: string | null = null;
                  try {
                    if (record.vitals && record.vitals.startsWith('{')) {
                      parsedVitals = JSON.parse(record.vitals);
                    } else if (record.vitals) {
                      vitalsFallbackStr = record.vitals;
                    }
                  } catch (e) {
                    vitalsFallbackStr = "（データ読取エラー）";
                  }

                  return (
                    <TableRow key={record.id} className="hover:bg-muted/20">
                      {/* 日付 */}
                      <TableCell className="py-3 font-medium font-mono text-sm whitespace-nowrap">

                          href={`/support-records/ledger?date=${record.record_date}${selectedClientId ? `&clientId=${selectedClientId}` : ''}`}
                          className="text-primary hover:underline font-bold"
                          title="この日のみに絞り込む"
                        >
                          {record.record_date}

                      {/* 利用者名 */}
                      <TableCell className="py-3">

                            {parsedVitals.sleep && <div>睡眠: {parsedVitals.sleep}</div>}
                            {parsedVitals.mood && <div>気分: {parsedVitals.mood}</div>}
                          </div>
                        ) : (
                          <span className="text-muted-foreground">{vitalsFallbackStr || '-'}</span>
                        )}
                      </TableCell>

                      {/* 作業内容・支援員コメント・担当者 */}
                      <TableCell className="py-3">
                        <div className="text-sm space-y-1">
                          <div>
                            <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground">【作業内容】</span>
                            <div className="text-foreground whitespace-pre-wrap">{record.task_content}</div>
                          </div>
                          {record.staff_comment && (
                            <div className="mt-1 pt-1 border-t border-dashed">
                              <span className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground">【支援員コメント】</span>

                        </div>
                      </TableCell>

                      {/* 操作（確認・直接編集） */}
                      <TableCell className="py-3 text-center print:hidden">
                        <Button
                          variant="outline"
                          size="sm"
                          className="h-8 px-2.5 text-xs font-semibold hover:bg-teal-50 hover:text-teal-700 hover:border-teal-400 cursor-pointer"
                          onClick={() => handleOpenEdit(record)}
                        >
                          <Edit3 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1 text-teal-600" />
                          編集
                        </Button>
                      </TableCell>
                    </TableRow>
                  );
                })}

          ) : (
            <div className="p-12 text-center text-muted-foreground">

          )}
        </CardContent>
      </Card>

      {/* 📝 確認・直接編集モーダルダイアログ */}
      {modalTarget && (
        <div className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center bg-black/50 p-4">
          <div className="w-full max-w-xl rounded-lg bg-background p-6 shadow-xl border max-h-[90vh] overflow-y-auto">
            <div className="flex items-center justify-between border-b pb-3 mb-4">
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-lg font-bold text-foreground flex items-center gap-2">
                  <Edit3 className="w-5 h-5 text-teal-600" />
                  <span>支援記録の{modalTarget.isNew ? '新規作成' : '確認・直接編集'}</span>
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                  利用者: <strong className="text-foreground">{modalTarget.clientName}</strong>　
                  日付: <strong className="text-foreground font-mono">{modalTarget.recordDate}</strong>
                </p>
              </div>
              <Button
                variant="ghost"
                size="sm"
                className="h-8 w-8 p-0"
                onClick={() => setModalTarget(null)}
              >
                <X className="w-4 h-4" />
              </Button>
            </div>

            {errorMsg && (
              <div className="mb-4 rounded-md bg-destructive/15 p-3 text-sm text-destructive flex items-center gap-2">
                <AlertCircle className="w-4 h-4 shrink-0" />
                <span>{errorMsg}</span>
              </div>
            )}

            <div className="space-y-4">
              {/* 時間・場所 */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-1 sm:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
                <div>
                  <Label className="text-xs font-semibold">提供開始時間</Label>
                  <Input
                    type="time"
                    value={modalTarget.serviceStartTime}
                    onChange={(e) => setModalTarget({ ...modalTarget, serviceStartTime: e.target.value })}
                    className="h-9 text-xs font-mono mt-1"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <Label className="text-xs font-semibold">提供終了時間</Label>
                  <Input
                    type="time"
                    value={modalTarget.serviceEndTime}
                    onChange={(e) => setModalTarget({ ...modalTarget, serviceEndTime: e.target.value })}
                    className="h-9 text-xs font-mono mt-1"
                  />
                </div>
                <div>
                  <Label className="text-xs font-semibold">提供場所</Label>
                  <select
                    value={modalTarget.serviceLocation}
                    onChange={(e) => setModalTarget({ ...modalTarget, serviceLocation: e.target.value })}
                    className="h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-1 text-xs shadow-xs focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring mt-1"
                  >
                    <option value="施設内">施設内</option>
                    <option value="施設外">施設外（施設外就労）</option>
                    <option value="在宅">在宅</option>
                  </select>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* バイタル情報 */}
              <div className="rounded-md border p-3 bg-muted/20 space-y-2">
                <Label className="text-xs font-semibold text-muted-foreground block">
                  バイタル・健康状態
                </Label>
                <div className="grid grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4 gap-2">
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground block">体温 (℃)</span>
                    <Input
                      placeholder="36.5"
                      value={modalTarget.temperature}
                      onChange={(e) => setModalTarget({ ...modalTarget, temperature: e.target.value })}
                      className="h-8 text-xs mt-0.5"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground block">血圧</span>
                    <Input
                      placeholder="120/80"
                      value={modalTarget.bloodPressure}
                      onChange={(e) => setModalTarget({ ...modalTarget, bloodPressure: e.target.value })}
                      className="h-8 text-xs mt-0.5"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground block">睡眠</span>
                    <Input
                      placeholder="良好・7時間"
                      value={modalTarget.sleep}
                      onChange={(e) => setModalTarget({ ...modalTarget, sleep: e.target.value })}
                      className="h-8 text-xs mt-0.5"
                    />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground block">気分</span>
                    <Input
                      placeholder="安定・良好"
                      value={modalTarget.mood}
                      onChange={(e) => setModalTarget({ ...modalTarget, mood: e.target.value })}
                      className="h-8 text-xs mt-0.5"
                    />
                  </div>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* 作業内容 */}
              <div>
                <Label className="text-xs font-semibold flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span>作業内容 <span className="text-destructive">*</span></span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-normal">実地指導での必須記載項目</span>
                </Label>
                <Textarea
                  value={modalTarget.taskContent}
                  onChange={(e) => setModalTarget({ ...modalTarget, taskContent: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="例: パソコン入力作業（データ入力50件）、ラベル貼り作業。集中して作業に取り組まれた。"
                  rows={3}
                  className="mt-1 text-xs resize-none"
                />
              </div>

              {/* 支援員コメント */}
              <div>
                <Label className="text-xs font-semibold flex items-center justify-between">
                  <span>支援員コメント・特記事項</span>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-normal">様子や声かけ、気づきなど</span>
                </Label>
                <Textarea
                  value={modalTarget.staffComment}
                  onChange={(e) => setModalTarget({ ...modalTarget, staffComment: e.target.value })}
                  placeholder="例: 午前中は集中して作業を継続。午後少し疲労が見られたため小休憩を促した。"
                  rows={2}
                  className="mt-1 text-xs resize-none"
                />
              </div>

              {/* 担当支援スタッフ */}
              <div>
                <Label className="text-xs font-semibold">担当支援スタッフ</Label>
                <select
                  value={modalTarget.staffId}
                  onChange={(e) => setModalTarget({ ...modalTarget, staffId: e.target.value })}
                  className="h-9 w-full rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-3 py-1 text-xs shadow-xs focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring mt-1"
                >
                  <option value="">未指定</option>
                  {staffMembers.map(s => (
                    <option key={s.id} value={s.id}>
                      {s.full_name} {s.job_category ? `(${s.job_category})` : ''}
                    </option>
                  ))}
                </select>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* モーダル下部ボタン */}
            <div className="mt-6 flex items-center justify-end gap-2 border-t pt-4">
              <Button
                variant="outline"
                size="sm"
                onClick={() => setModalTarget(null)}
                disabled={isSaving}
              >
                キャンセル
              </Button>
              <Button
                size="sm"
                className="bg-teal-600 hover:bg-teal-700 text-white font-semibold flex items-center gap-1.5"
                onClick={handleSave}
                disabled={isSaving}
              >
                {isSaving ? (
                  <>
                    <Loader2 className="w-4 h-4 animate-spin" />
                    保存中...
                  </>
                ) : (
                  <>
                    <Save className="w-4 h-4" />
                    保存する
                  </>
                )}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}


================================================================================
File: src/app/support-records/ledger/page.tsx
