import { Header } from "@/components/Header"
import { SupportSubNav } from "@/components/NavigationTabs"
import { Card, CardContent, CardHeader, CardTitle } from "@/components/ui/card"
import { buttonVariants } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { Label } from "@/components/ui/label"
import { toLocalISODate } from "@/lib/utils"
import { db } from "@/lib/db"
import { 
  Filter, 
  Calendar as CalendarIcon,
  Edit3,
  CalendarClock
} from "lucide-react"
import Link from "next/link"
import { SupportCalendarMonthPicker } from "../SupportCalendarMonthPicker"
import { SupportLedgerClient } from "./SupportLedgerClient"
import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth"
import { getActiveDepartments } from "@/lib/location"

export default async function SupportRecordsLedgerPage(props: { 
  searchParams?: Promise<{ 
    month?: string; 
    clientId?: string; 
    date?: string; 
    departmentId?: string;
  }> 
}) {
  const role = await getRole();
  const searchParams = await props.searchParams;

  const isGeneralStaff = role === 'staff';
  const rawDepartmentId = searchParams?.departmentId;
  const activeDepartments = getActiveDepartments();
  const activeDepartmentId = isGeneralStaff
    ? (rawDepartmentId && activeDepartments.some(d => d.id === rawDepartmentId) ? rawDepartmentId : activeDepartments[0]?.id)
    : (rawDepartmentId && activeDepartments.some(d => d.id === rawDepartmentId) ? rawDepartmentId : 'all');

  const now = new Date();
  const todayStr = toLocalISODate(now);

  const targetDateParam = searchParams?.date;
  const targetMonthParam = searchParams?.month;
  const targetClientParam = searchParams?.clientId || "";

  // カレンダー基準日
  let calendarBaseDate = targetDateParam;
  if (!calendarBaseDate) {
    if (targetMonthParam && targetMonthParam !== 'all') {
      calendarBaseDate = `${targetMonthParam}-01`;
    } else {
      calendarBaseDate = todayStr;
    }
  }

  // カレンダー表示用の年月
  const targetDate = new Date(calendarBaseDate);
  const currentYear = targetDate.getFullYear();
  const currentMonth = targetDate.getMonth(); // 0-11
  const currentMonthStr = `${currentYear}-${String(currentMonth + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`;
  const currentMonthStart = `${currentMonthStr}-01`;
  const nextMonthObj = new Date(currentYear, currentMonth + 1, 1);
  const nextMonthStart = toLocalISODate(nextMonthObj);

  // 選択中の月（パラメータまたはカレンダー年月）
  const selectedMonth = targetMonthParam || currentMonthStr;

  // 全利用者（退職者含む、拠点フィルタ対応）
  const allClientsRaw = db.prepare('SELECT id, full_name, status, department_id FROM clients WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY full_name').all() as any[];
  const allClients = activeDepartmentId === 'all'
    ? allClientsRaw
    : allClientsRaw.filter(c => c.department_id === activeDepartmentId);

  const selectedClientName = targetClientParam 
    ? allClients.find(c => c.id === targetClientParam)?.full_name 
    : "全利用者";

  // 直接支援スタッフ（生活支援員・職業指導員）
  const staffMembers = db.prepare(`
    SELECT id, name as full_name, job_category, role 
    FROM staff 
    WHERE deleted_at IS NULL 
      AND (
        job_category IN ('職業指導員', '生活支援員')
        OR role IN ('vocational_instructor', 'life_support_worker')
      )
      AND (
        job_category NOT IN (
          '管理者', 'サービス管理責任者', '管理者 兼 サービス管理責任者', 
          '賃金向上達成指導員', '視覚・聴覚言語障害者支援指導員', '重度者支援専門員', 
          '送迎ドライバー', '調理員', '事務員'
        )
        OR job_category IS NULL
      )
    ORDER BY name
  `).all() as any[];

  // 過去に記録が存在する年月の一覧（最大72ヶ月）
  const dbMonths = db.prepare(`
    SELECT DISTINCT substr(record_date, 1, 7) as ym 
    FROM support_records 
    WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY ym DESC 
    LIMIT 72
  `).all() as { ym: string }[];

  const availableMonths = dbMonths.map(m => m.ym);
  if (!availableMonths.includes(currentMonthStr)) {
    availableMonths.unshift(currentMonthStr);
  }

  // --- カレンダー用の月間データ集計 ---
  let monthSupportQuery = `
    SELECT s.id, s.client_id, s.record_date
    FROM support_records s
    JOIN clients c ON s.client_id = c.id
    WHERE s.record_date >= ? AND s.record_date < ? AND s.deleted_at IS NULL
  `;
  const monthSupportParams: any[] = [currentMonthStart, nextMonthStart];
  if (activeDepartmentId !== 'all') {
    monthSupportQuery += ` AND c.department_id = ?`;
    monthSupportParams.push(activeDepartmentId);
  }
  const monthSupportRecords = db.prepare(monthSupportQuery).all(...monthSupportParams) as any[];

  let monthAttendanceQuery = `
    SELECT a.id, a.client_id, a.record_date, a.status, a.is_absence_addition
    FROM attendance_records a
    JOIN clients c ON a.client_id = c.id
    WHERE a.record_date >= ? AND a.record_date < ? AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
  `;
  const monthAttendanceParams: any[] = [currentMonthStart, nextMonthStart];
  if (activeDepartmentId !== 'all') {
    monthAttendanceQuery += ` AND c.department_id = ?`;
    monthAttendanceParams.push(activeDepartmentId);
  }
  const monthAttendanceRecords = db.prepare(monthAttendanceQuery).all(...monthAttendanceParams) as any[];

  // 月間カレンダーグリッドの作成
  const daysInMonth = new Date(currentYear, currentMonth + 1, 0).getDate();
  const firstDayOfMonth = new Date(currentYear, currentMonth, 1).getDay();

  const calendarCells = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < firstDayOfMonth; i++) {
    calendarCells.push(null);
  }
  for (let i = 1; i <= daysInMonth; i++) {
    const dStr = `${currentYear}-${String(currentMonth + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(i).padStart(2, '0')}`;
    const daySupportCount = monthSupportRecords.filter(r => r.record_date === dStr).length;
    
    // 出勤（または欠席時対応加算）の対象人数
    const dayAtt = monthAttendanceRecords.filter(r => r.record_date === dStr);
    const activeAttCount = dayAtt.filter(r => ['present', 'out_facility'].includes(r.status) || r.is_absence_addition === 1).length;

    calendarCells.push({
      day: i,
      dateStr: dStr,
      supportCount: daySupportCount,
      attendanceCount: activeAttCount,
      isComplete: activeAttCount > 0 && daySupportCount >= activeAttCount,
      hasMissing: activeAttCount > daySupportCount,
      isToday: dStr === todayStr,
      isSelected: dStr === targetDateParam
    });
  }

  // 月間統計サマリー
  const monthlyStats = {
    totalRecords: monthSupportRecords.length,
    totalAttendance: monthAttendanceRecords.filter(r => ['present', 'out_facility'].includes(r.status)).length,
    totalAbsenceAddition: monthAttendanceRecords.filter(r => r.is_absence_addition === 1).length,
  };

  // --- 台帳一覧クエリ ---
  let ledgerQuery = `
    SELECT s.*, c.full_name as client_full_name, c.status as client_status, c.department_id as client_department_id, st.name as staff_full_name
    FROM support_records s
    JOIN clients c ON s.client_id = c.id
    LEFT JOIN staff st ON s.staff_id = st.id
    WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL
  `;
  const ledgerParams: any[] = [];

  if (activeDepartmentId !== 'all') {
    ledgerQuery += ` AND c.department_id = ?`;
    ledgerParams.push(activeDepartmentId);
  }

  if (targetDateParam) {
    ledgerQuery += ` AND s.record_date = ?`;
    ledgerParams.push(targetDateParam);
  } else if (selectedMonth && selectedMonth !== 'all') {
    const [yStr, mStr] = selectedMonth.split('-');
    const y = parseInt(yStr, 10);
    const m = parseInt(mStr, 10);
    const startOfMonth = `${selectedMonth}-01`;
    const nextM = new Date(y, m, 1);
    const endOfMonth = `${nextM.getFullYear()}-${String(nextM.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-01`;

    ledgerQuery += ` AND s.record_date >= ? AND s.record_date < ?`;
    ledgerParams.push(startOfMonth, endOfMonth);
  }

  if (targetClientParam) {
    ledgerQuery += ` AND s.client_id = ?`;
    ledgerParams.push(targetClientParam);
  }

  ledgerQuery += ` ORDER BY s.record_date DESC, c.full_name ASC`;
  if (!targetDateParam && selectedMonth === 'all' && !targetClientParam) {
    ledgerQuery += ` LIMIT 500`;
  }

  const ledgerRecords = db.prepare(ledgerQuery).all(...ledgerParams) as any[];

  // --- 未作成者（特定日選択時） ---
  let missingClients: any[] = [];
  if (targetDateParam) {
    let attendedQuery = `
      SELECT a.client_id, a.record_date, a.status as attendance_status, a.clock_in, a.clock_out, a.is_absence_addition,
             c.full_name as client_full_name, c.status as client_status, c.department_id as client_department_id
      FROM attendance_records a
      JOIN clients c ON a.client_id = c.id
      WHERE a.record_date = ? 
        AND a.deleted_at IS NULL
        AND (a.status IN ('present', 'out_facility') OR a.is_absence_addition = 1)
    `;
    const attendedParams: any[] = [targetDateParam];
    if (activeDepartmentId !== 'all') {
      attendedQuery += ` AND c.department_id = ?`;
      attendedParams.push(activeDepartmentId);
    }
    const attendedClientsOnDate = db.prepare(attendedQuery).all(...attendedParams) as any[];

    const recordedClientIds = new Set(ledgerRecords.map(r => r.client_id));
    missingClients = attendedClientsOnDate.filter(a => !recordedClientIds.has(a.client_id));
    if (targetClientParam) {
      missingClients = missingClients.filter(m => m.client_id === targetClientParam);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="flex min-h-screen flex-col bg-background/50">
      <div className="print:hidden">
        <Header activePage="support-records" />
        <SupportSubNav />
      </div>

      <main className="flex-1 p-3.5 sm:p-6 md:p-12 print:p-0">
        <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl space-y-6">
          {/* ページ上部タイトル */}
          <div className="print:hidden flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4 border-b pb-3">
            <div>
              <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground flex items-center gap-2.5">
                <CalendarClock className="h-7 w-7 sm:h-8 sm:w-8 text-teal-600 shrink-0" />
                <span>月間支援記録台帳・過去データ検索（実地指導・印刷用）</span>
              </h1>
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                カレンダーや検索条件から過去・現在の記録を瞬時に確認・直接編集できます。実地指導用の帳票印刷にも対応しています。
              </p>
            </div>
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
              <Link
                href={`/support-records?departmentId=${activeDepartmentId}`}
                className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm", className: "h-9 px-3 text-xs font-semibold" })}
              >
                <Edit3 className="w-3.5 h-3.5 mr-1 text-emerald-600" />
                日々の支援を記録する（入力画面へ）
              </Link>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 🏢 拠点切り替えタブ */}
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2 p-2 bg-muted/30 border rounded-xl shadow-2xs print:hidden overflow-x-auto whitespace-nowrap">
            <span className="text-xs font-bold text-muted-foreground px-2 shrink-0">台帳対象拠点:</span>
            {!isGeneralStaff && (
              <Link
                href={`/support-records/ledger?month=${selectedMonth}${targetDateParam ? `&date=${targetDateParam}` : ''}&departmentId=all`}
                className={buttonVariants({
                  variant: activeDepartmentId === 'all' ? 'default' : 'outline',
                  size: 'sm',
                  className: `h-8 px-3.5 text-xs font-bold shrink-0 ${activeDepartmentId === 'all' ? 'shadow-xs' : ''}`
                })}
              >
                すべて表示
              </Link>
            )}
            {activeDepartments.map(dep => (
              <Link
                key={dep.id}
                href={`/support-records/ledger?month=${selectedMonth}${targetDateParam ? `&date=${targetDateParam}` : ''}&departmentId=${dep.id}`}
                className={buttonVariants({
                  variant: activeDepartmentId === dep.id ? 'default' : 'outline',
                  size: 'sm',
                  className: `h-8 px-3.5 text-xs font-bold shrink-0 ${
                    activeDepartmentId === dep.id
                      ? 'bg-sky-600 hover:bg-sky-700 text-white shadow-xs'
                      : 'border-sky-200 text-sky-800 hover:bg-sky-50'
                  }`
                })}
              >
                {dep.facility_type === 'satellite' ? '🛰️' : '🏢'} {dep.name}{isGeneralStaff ? '担当' : ''}
              </Link>
            ))}
            <span className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground ml-auto hidden sm:inline shrink-0">
              現在: <strong className="text-foreground">{activeDepartmentId === 'all' ? '全拠点' : activeDepartments.find(d => d.id === activeDepartmentId)?.name || ''}</strong> の台帳データを表示中
            </span>
          </div>

          {/* 印刷用ヘッダー（ブラウザ印刷時のみ表示） */}
          <div className="hidden print:block mb-6 border-b pb-4">
            <h1 className="text-2xl font-bold text-center">
              {(() => {
                const fac = db.prepare("SELECT service_type, facility_name FROM facility_settings LIMIT 1").get() as any;
                const isB = fac?.service_type === 'type_b' || fac?.service_type === 'B' || fac?.facility_name?.includes('B型');
                return isB ? '就労継続支援B型 日次支援記録台帳' : '就労継続支援A型 日次支援記録台帳';
              })()}
            </h1>
            <div className="flex justify-between items-end mt-4 text-xs">
              <div>
                <div>対象期間: {targetDateParam ? targetDateParam : selectedMonth === 'all' ? '全期間' : `${selectedMonth}月分`}</div>
                <div>対象者: {selectedClientName}</div>
              </div>
              <div className="text-right">
                <div>印刷日: {todayStr}</div>
                <div>抽出件数: {ledgerRecords.length} 件</div>
              </div>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* 1. 📅 支援記録カレンダー ＆ 検索バー（一体型カード） */}
          <Card className="shadow-sm print:hidden border-teal-200/60">
            <CardHeader className="bg-teal-50/30 border-b pb-4 space-y-3">
              <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-4">
                <div>
                  <CardTitle className="text-xl flex items-center gap-2 text-teal-950">
                    <CalendarIcon className="w-5 h-5 text-teal-600" />
                    <span>{currentYear}年{currentMonth + 1}月 の支援記録カレンダー</span>
                  </CardTitle>
                  <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                    日付をクリックすると、下の台帳がその日の記録に瞬時に切り替わり、その場で確認・直接編集できます。
                  </p>
                </div>
                <div className="flex items-center gap-3 text-xs shrink-0">
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1 font-medium text-emerald-800">
                    <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-emerald-500 inline-block"></span> 記録完了
                  </span>
                  <span className="flex items-center gap-1 font-medium text-amber-800">
                    <span className="w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full bg-amber-500 inline-block"></span> 記録未作成あり
                  </span>
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* 年月ピッカー・前後月ショートカット */}
              <SupportCalendarMonthPicker currentDateStr={calendarBaseDate} todayStr={todayStr} basePath="/support-records/ledger" />

              {/* 月間実績サマリーバナー */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 p-2.5 bg-white dark:bg-slate-900 border rounded-lg text-center text-xs shadow-2xs">
                <div className="border-r border-slate-100">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground block">月間 支援記録数</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold text-teal-700">{monthlyStats.totalRecords} 件</span>
                </div>
                <div className="border-r border-slate-100">
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground block">延べ 出勤実績</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold text-emerald-700">{monthlyStats.totalAttendance} 名</span>
                </div>
                <div>
                  <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground block">欠席時対応加算 算定</span>
                  <span className="text-sm font-bold text-amber-700">{monthlyStats.totalAbsenceAddition} 件</span>
                </div>
              </div>
            </CardHeader>

            <CardContent className="p-4 sm:p-6 space-y-4">
              {/* カレンダー曜日ヘッダー */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1 text-center mb-2 font-medium text-sm text-muted-foreground">
                <div className="text-red-500">日</div>
                <div>月</div>
                <div>火</div>
                <div>水</div>
                <div>木</div>
                <div>金</div>
                <div className="text-blue-500">土</div>
              </div>

              {/* カレンダーグリッド */}
              <div className="grid grid-cols-7 gap-1 sm:gap-2">
                {calendarCells.map((cell, index) => {
                  if (!cell) {
                    return <div key={`empty-${index}`} className="h-16 sm:h-20 bg-muted/10 rounded-md border border-transparent" />
                  }

                  const dayOfWeek = new Date(cell.dateStr).getDay();
                  const isSun = dayOfWeek === 0;
                  const isSat = dayOfWeek === 6;

                  return (
                    <Link
                      key={cell.dateStr}
                      href={`/support-records/ledger?date=${cell.dateStr}${targetClientParam ? `&clientId=${targetClientParam}` : ''}`}
                      className={`h-16 sm:h-20 p-1 sm:p-1.5 rounded-md border flex flex-col justify-between transition-all hover:shadow-md cursor-pointer ${
                        cell.isSelected
                          ? "ring-2 ring-teal-600 border-teal-600 bg-teal-50 shadow-sm"
                          : cell.isToday
                          ? "border-teal-400 bg-teal-50/40"
                          : "border-border/60 hover:border-border bg-card"
                      }`}
                    >
                      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                        <span className={`text-xs sm:text-sm font-bold ${
                          cell.isSelected ? "text-teal-700" : isSun ? "text-red-500" : isSat ? "text-blue-500" : "text-foreground"
                        }`}>
                          {cell.day}
                        </span>
                        {cell.isToday && (
                          <span className="text-[9px] px-1 py-0.2 rounded bg-teal-600 text-white font-semibold">
                            今日
                          </span>
                        )}
                      </div>

                      <div className="flex flex-col gap-0.5 mt-auto">
                        {cell.attendanceCount > 0 && (
                          <span className="text-[9px] text-muted-foreground hidden sm:block truncate">
                            出勤:{cell.attendanceCount}
                          </span>
                        )}
                        {cell.supportCount > 0 ? (
                          cell.isComplete ? (
                            <span className="text-[9px] sm:text-[10px] font-semibold bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 border border-emerald-200 px-1 rounded-sm text-center">
                              ✓ 記録:{cell.supportCount}
                            </span>
                          ) : (
                            <span className="text-[9px] sm:text-[10px] font-semibold bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 border border-amber-300 px-1 rounded-sm text-center">
                              記:{cell.supportCount}/{cell.attendanceCount}
                            </span>
                          )
                        ) : cell.attendanceCount > 0 ? (
                          <span className="text-[8px] sm:text-[9px] font-bold bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border border-rose-300 px-0.5 rounded-sm text-center animate-pulse">
                            未作:{cell.attendanceCount}
                          </span>
                        ) : null}
                      </div>
                    </Link>
                  )
                })}
              </div>

              {/* カレンダー下部の検索・絞り込みフォーム */}
              <div className="pt-3 border-t">
                <form method="GET" className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3">
                  <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-3">
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <CalendarIcon className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                      <Label htmlFor="filterMonth" className="text-xs font-semibold">対象年月:</Label>
                      <select
                        id="filterMonth"
                        name="month"
                        defaultValue={selectedMonth}
                        className="h-8 rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-2.5 py-1 text-xs shadow-xs focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring font-mono"
                      >
                        <option value="all">全期間（最新500件）</option>
                        {availableMonths.map(ym => (
                          <option key={ym} value={ym}>
                            {ym} {ym === currentMonthStr ? '(当月)' : ''}
                          </option>
                        ))}
                      </select>
                    </div>

                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <Filter className="h-4 w-4 text-muted-foreground" />
                      <Label htmlFor="filterClient" className="text-xs font-semibold">対象利用者:</Label>
                      <select
                        id="filterClient"
                        name="clientId"
                        defaultValue={targetClientParam}
                        className="h-8 rounded-md border border-input bg-background px-2.5 py-1 text-xs shadow-xs focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring"
                      >
                        <option value="">全利用者</option>
                        {allClients.map(c => (
                          <option key={c.id} value={c.id}>
                            {c.full_name} {c.status === 'terminated' ? '(退職済)' : ''}
                          </option>
                        ))}
                      </select>
                    </div>

                    <button
                      type="submit"
                      className="inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md text-xs font-medium transition-colors focus-visible:outline-none focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-ring bg-teal-600 text-white shadow-xs hover:bg-teal-700 h-8 px-3 cursor-pointer"
                    >
                      台帳を絞り込み
                    </button>

                    {(targetDateParam || selectedMonth !== currentMonthStr || targetClientParam) && (
                      <Link
                        href={`/support-records/ledger?month=${currentMonthStr}`}
                        className="text-xs text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground underline ml-1"
                      >
                        当月・全件に戻す
                      </Link>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </form>
              </div>
            </CardContent>
          </Card>

          {/* 2. 📑 月間支援記録台帳（確認・直接編集モーダル対応） */}
          <SupportLedgerClient
            records={ledgerRecords}
            missingClients={missingClients}
            staffMembers={staffMembers}
            selectedMonth={selectedMonth}
            selectedDate={targetDateParam || null}
            selectedClientId={targetClientParam}
            selectedClientName={selectedClientName}
          />
        </div>
      </main>
    </div>
  )
}

export default async function SupportRecordsPage(props: {

    success?: string; 
    msg?: string; 
    error?: string;

    clientId?: string;
    date?: string;
    departmentId?: string;

  const role = await getRole();

  const errorMsg = searchParams?.error;
  const successMsg = searchParams?.msg;
  const warningMsg = searchParams?.warning;

  const isGeneralStaff = role === 'staff';

  const activeDepartments = getActiveDepartments();
  const activeDepartmentId = isGeneralStaff
    ? (rawDepartmentId && activeDepartments.some(d => d.id === rawDepartmentId) ? rawDepartmentId : activeDepartments[0]?.id)
    : (rawDepartmentId && activeDepartments.some(d => d.id === rawDepartmentId) ? rawDepartmentId : 'all');

  const now = new Date();
  const todayStr = toLocalISODate(now);
  const selectedDateStr = searchParams?.date || todayStr;
  const selectedClientId = searchParams?.clientId || "";

  // 利用者（退職者除く、拠点フィルタ対応）
  const allClients = db.prepare('SELECT id, full_name, status, department_id FROM clients WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY full_name').all() as any[];
  const allActiveClients = allClients.filter(c => c.status === 'active' || !c.status);
  const activeClients = activeDepartmentId === 'all'

    : allActiveClients.filter(c => c.department_id === activeDepartmentId);

  // 直接支援スタッフ
  const staffMembers = db.prepare(`

      AND (

        OR role IN ('vocational_instructor', 'life_support_worker')

          '賃金向上達成指導員', '視覚・聴覚言語障害者支援指導員', '重度者支援専門員',

        )
        OR job_category IS NULL
      )
    ORDER BY name
  `).all() as any[];

  // 実地指導連動: 全利用者の有効な個別支援計画目標を辞書マップで取得
  const allActivePlans = db.prepare(`
    SELECT client_id, id, start_date, end_date, domains_data 
    FROM support_plans 
    WHERE status = 'active' AND deleted_at IS NULL
    ORDER BY start_date DESC
  `).all() as any[];

  const clientActivePlans: Record<string, { id: string; start_date: string; end_date: string; short_term_goal?: string } | null> = {};
  for (const c of activeClients) {
    const plan = allActivePlans.find(p => p.client_id === c.id);
    if (plan) {
      let shortGoal = '';
      if (plan.domains_data) {
        try {
          const parsed = JSON.parse(plan.domains_data);
          shortGoal = parsed.short_term_goal || parsed.shortTermGoal || '';
        } catch {}
      }
      clientActivePlans[c.id] = {
        id: plan.id,
        start_date: plan.start_date,
        end_date: plan.end_date,
        short_term_goal: shortGoal
      };
    } else {

    }
  }

  let recentRecordsQuery = `

              <h1 className="text-2xl sm:text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-foreground flex items-center gap-2.5">

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
              <Link
                href={`/support-records/ledger?date=${selectedDateStr}&departmentId=${activeDepartmentId}`}
                className={buttonVariants({ variant: "outline", size: "sm", className: "h-9 px-3.5 text-xs font-bold border-teal-300 text-teal-800 bg-teal-50 hover:bg-teal-100" })}
              >

'use client';

import { useEffect } from 'react';
import { useSearchParams, useRouter, usePathname } from 'next/navigation';
import { toast } from 'sonner';

export default function ActionToast() {
  const searchParams = useSearchParams();
  const router = useRouter();
  const pathname = usePathname();

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!searchParams) return;
    
    const success = searchParams.get('success');
    const error = searchParams.get('error');
    const msg = searchParams.get('msg');
    
    if (success === 'true') {
      toast.success(msg || '保存しました');
      // Remove query params
      const newParams = new URLSearchParams(searchParams.toString());
      newParams.delete('success');
      newParams.delete('msg');
      router.replace(`${pathname}?${newParams.toString()}`);
    }

    if (error) {
      toast.error(error);
      const newParams = new URLSearchParams(searchParams.toString());
      newParams.delete('error');
      router.replace(`${pathname}?${newParams.toString()}`);
    }
  }, [searchParams, pathname, router]);

  return null;
}

'use client';

import React, { useRef, useLayoutEffect, useState, useEffect, ElementType } from 'react';
import { cn } from '@/lib/utils';

export interface AutoFitTextProps {
  text?: string | null;
  children?: React.ReactNode;
  defaultText?: string;
  className?: string;
  minFontSize?: number; // 最小フォントサイズ（デフォルト: 5.5）
  maxFontSize?: number; // 最大フォントサイズ（デフォルト: 8.5）
  minFontSizePt?: number; // エイリアス
  maxFontSizePt?: number; // エイリアス
  unit?: 'pt' | 'px'; // 単位（デフォルト: 'pt'）
  multiLine?: boolean; // 複数行の高さフィット判定を行うか（デフォルト: false）
  mode?: 'single-line' | 'multi-line'; // エイリアス
  as?: ElementType; // レンダリング要素（デフォルト: 'span'）
  title?: string;
}

/**
 * 枠（コンテナ）の幅や高さに合わせて、テキストが絶対に溢れず・途切れないように
 * 二分探索（Binary Search）を用いてフォントサイズをミリ単位で自動調整する高精度コンポーネント。
 * 全国の自治体・事業所のあらゆる長文データ（事業所名、住所、氏名、支援目標等）に対応。
 */
export function AutoFitText({
  text,
  children,
  defaultText = '',
  className,
  minFontSize: minFontSizeProp,
  maxFontSize: maxFontSizeProp,
  minFontSizePt,
  maxFontSizePt,
  unit = 'pt',
  multiLine: multiLineProp = false,
  mode,
  as: Component = 'span',
  title,
}: AutoFitTextProps) {
  const containerRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const textRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  
  const minFontSize = minFontSizePt ?? minFontSizeProp ?? 5.5;
  const maxFontSize = maxFontSizePt ?? maxFontSizeProp ?? 8.5;
  const multiLine = mode ? mode === 'multi-line' : multiLineProp;

  // text または children から文字列コンテンツを抽出
  const rawContent = (text !== undefined && text !== null && text !== '') 
    ? text 
    : (children !== undefined && children !== null && children !== '') 
      ? (typeof children === 'string' ? children : String(children))
      : defaultText;
  const content = rawContent || '';

  // SSR時の初期推定サイズ（文字長ベースの高速フォールバック）
  const getInitialFontSize = () => {
    const len = content.length;
    if (multiLine) return maxFontSize;
    if (len > 35) return Math.max(minFontSize, minFontSize + 0.5);
    if (len > 25) return Math.max(minFontSize, (minFontSize + maxFontSize) / 2);
    if (len > 18) return Math.max(minFontSize, maxFontSize - 1);
    return maxFontSize;
  };

  const [currentFontSize, setCurrentFontSize] = useState<number>(getInitialFontSize);

  const calculateFit = () => {
    const container = containerRef.current;
    const textEl = textRef.current;
    if (!container || !textEl || !content) return;

    // コンテナ幅・高さがゼロ（非表示時など）はスキップ
    if (container.clientWidth === 0 || (multiLine && container.clientHeight === 0)) return;

    let low = minFontSize;
    let high = maxFontSize;
    let optimal = minFontSize;

    // 二分探索（最大8ステップで 0.1pt 精度で瞬時に最適サイズを算出）
    for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
      const mid = Math.round(((low + high) / 2) * 10) / 10;
      textEl.style.fontSize = `${mid}${unit}`;

      const overflows = multiLine
        ? textEl.scrollHeight > container.clientHeight || textEl.scrollWidth > container.clientWidth
        : textEl.scrollWidth > container.clientWidth;

      if (overflows) {
        high = mid - 0.1;
      } else {
        optimal = mid;
        low = mid + 0.1;
      }

      if (high - low < 0.1) break;
    }

    textEl.style.fontSize = `${optimal}${unit}`;
    setCurrentFontSize(optimal);
  };

  useLayoutEffect(() => {
    calculateFit();
  }, [content, minFontSize, maxFontSize, unit, multiLine]);

  // リサイズおよび印刷ダイアログ（beforeprint）の監視
  useEffect(() => {
    const container = containerRef.current;
    if (!container) return;

    let resizeObserver: ResizeObserver | null = null;
    if (typeof ResizeObserver !== 'undefined') {
      resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(() => {
        calculateFit();
      });
      resizeObserver.observe(container);
    }

    const handleBeforePrint = () => {
      calculateFit();
    };

    window.addEventListener('beforeprint', handleBeforePrint);
    window.addEventListener('resize', calculateFit);

    return () => {
      if (resizeObserver) resizeObserver.disconnect();
      window.removeEventListener('beforeprint', handleBeforePrint);
      window.removeEventListener('resize', calculateFit);
    };
  }, [content]);

  return (
    <div
      ref={containerRef}
      className={cn(
        "w-full h-full flex items-center overflow-hidden",
        multiLine ? "block" : "whitespace-nowrap"
      )}
    >
      <Component
        ref={textRef as any}
        style={{ fontSize: `${currentFontSize}${unit}` }}
        className={cn(
          "inline-block leading-tight transition-none",
          !multiLine && "whitespace-nowrap",
          className
        )}
        title={title || (typeof content === 'string' ? content : undefined)}
      >
        {content}
      </Component>
    </div>
  );
}

export default AutoFitText;

          })}

          {/* 全メニュー展開ボタン */}
          <button

              <Menu className="h-5 w-5" />

            {/* 1. 日常業務 */}

File: src/components/FontSizeProvider.tsx
================================================================================

"use client";

import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

type FontSize = 'xsmall' | 'small' | 'normal' | 'large' | 'xlarge';

interface FontSizeContextType {
  fontSize: FontSize;
  setFontSize: (size: FontSize) => void;
}

const FontSizeContext = createContext<FontSizeContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export function FontSizeProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  const [fontSize, setFontSize] = useState<FontSize>('normal');
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('app-font-size') as FontSize | null;
    if (saved && ['xsmall', 'small', 'normal', 'large', 'xlarge'].includes(saved)) {
      setFontSize(saved);
    }
    setMounted(true);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!mounted) return;
    localStorage.setItem('app-font-size', fontSize);
    
    // root html element
    const html = document.documentElement;
    if (fontSize === 'xsmall') {
      html.style.fontSize = '80%';
    } else if (fontSize === 'small') {
      html.style.fontSize = '90%';
    } else if (fontSize === 'normal') {
      html.style.fontSize = '100%';
    } else if (fontSize === 'large') {
      html.style.fontSize = '115%';
    } else if (fontSize === 'xlarge') {
      html.style.fontSize = '130%';
    }
  }, [fontSize, mounted]);

  return (
    <FontSizeContext.Provider value={{ fontSize, setFontSize }}>
      {children}
    </FontSizeContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useFontSize() {
  const context = useContext(FontSizeContext);
  if (context === undefined) {
    throw new Error('useFontSize must be used within a FontSizeProvider');
  }
  return context;
}

import { getRole } from "@/lib/auth"
import { getServiceMode } from "@/lib/serviceModeServer"
import { HeaderClient } from "./HeaderClient"
import { getGlobalAlertSummary } from "@/lib/compliance/staffingCalculator"
import { getFacilityName } from "@/lib/facilityHelper"

export async function Header({ activePage }: { activePage: string }) {
  const role = await getRole() || 'admin';
  const isStaff = role === 'staff';
  const alerts = getGlobalAlertSummary();
  const serviceMode = await getServiceMode();
  const facilityName = getFacilityName(serviceMode);

  return (
    <HeaderClient 
      activePage={activePage} 
      isStaff={isStaff} 
      role={role} 
      alerts={alerts} 
      serviceMode={serviceMode} 
      facilityName={facilityName}
    />
  );
}

                        {isTypeB ? '工賃計算（時給/日給/出来高）、工賃明細・支払台帳出力' : '最低賃金チェック、給与明細・台帳出力'}

        <div className="ml-auto flex items-center gap-2 shrink-0">
          {/* デバイス表示モード切替（PC / スマホ / タブレット） */}
          <UIModeSelector />

          {/* 全画面統合アラート通知ベル */}
          <DropdownMenu>

              className={cn(
                "relative inline-flex items-center justify-center rounded-md border text-xs font-semibold h-8 px-2.5 gap-1.5 transition-colors cursor-pointer outline-none",

              )}

              </span>
              {alerts.length > 0 && (
                <span className="sm:hidden absolute -top-1 -right-1 flex h-4 w-4 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-rose-600 text-[10px] text-white font-bold">
                  {alerts.length}
                </span>
              )}
            </DropdownMenuTrigger>
            <DropdownMenuContent align="end" className="w-80 max-h-[80vh] overflow-y-auto p-2">
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between pb-2 mb-1 border-b px-1 font-bold text-xs">
                <span>システム警告・アラート一覧</span>
                <span className={cn(
                  "px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded text-[10px]",
                  alerts.length > 0 ? "bg-rose-100 text-rose-800" : "bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800"
                )}>
                  {alerts.length > 0 ? `${alerts.length}件の要対応` : '全て良好'}
                </span>
              </div>
              {alerts.length === 0 ? (
                <div className="py-4 text-center text-xs text-muted-foreground">
                  ✓ 現在、緊急の警告・未作成事項はありません
                </div>
              ) : (
                <div className="space-y-1.5">
                  {alerts.map((alert) => (
                    <DropdownMenuItem key={alert.id} className="p-0">
                      <Link 
                        href={alert.href}
                        className={cn(
                          "block w-full p-2 rounded-md border text-left cursor-pointer transition-colors",
                          alert.severity === 'critical' 
                            ? "border-rose-300 bg-rose-50/70 hover:bg-rose-100/70 text-rose-950" 
                            : "border-amber-300 bg-amber-50/70 hover:bg-amber-100/70 text-amber-950"
                        )}
                      >
                        <div className="font-bold text-xs flex items-center gap-1.5">
                          <span>{alert.severity === 'critical' ? '⚠️' : 'ℹ️'}</span>
                          <span>{alert.title}</span>
                        </div>
                        <div className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground/90 mt-0.5 leading-snug">
                          {alert.message}
                        </div>
                      </Link>
                    </DropdownMenuItem>
                  ))}
                </div>
              )}
            </DropdownMenuContent>
          </DropdownMenu>

          <Link
            href="/settings"
            title="システム設定"
            className={cn(
              "flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-medium border transition-colors",
              activePage === 'settings'
                ? "bg-primary text-white border-primary shadow-sm"
                : "bg-background text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground hover:bg-muted border-border"
            )}
          >
            <Settings className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
            <span className="hidden sm:inline-block">システム設定</span>
          </Link>

          <Link
            href="/login"
            title="クリックして権限を切り替え"
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-muted hover:bg-muted/80 text-foreground transition-colors border border-border"
          >
            <span className={cn(
              "h-2 w-2 rounded-full",
              role === 'admin' ? "bg-blue-600" : role === 'service_manager' ? "bg-emerald-600" : "bg-slate-400"
            )} />
            <span>{role === 'admin' ? '管理者' : role === 'service_manager' ? 'サビ管' : '支援員'}</span>
          </Link>

          <form action={logout} className="m-0 p-0 shrink-0">
            <Button 
              type="submit" 
              variant="outline" 
              size="sm" 
              className="gap-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-rose-700 border-rose-200 bg-rose-50/80 hover:bg-rose-100 hover:text-rose-900 h-8 px-3 shadow-2xs transition-colors cursor-pointer"
              title="システムからログアウト"
            >
              <LogOut className="h-3.5 w-3.5 text-rose-600" />
              <span>ログアウト</span>
            </Button>
          </form>
        </div>
      </div>
    </header>
  )
}

"use client";

import { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { SubNav, SubNavItem } from "./SubNav";
import { 
  Building2, FileText, CalendarClock, Users, 
  CreditCard, Banknote, ShieldAlert, Award, 
  FileSpreadsheet, Settings, Clock, Sparkles, Home, LogOut
} from "lucide-react";
import { getClientServiceMode, ServiceMode } from "@/lib/serviceMode";

function useServiceModeClient(): ServiceMode {
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<ServiceMode>(() => getClientServiceMode());
  useEffect(() => {
    setMode(getClientServiceMode());
  }, []);
  return mode;
}

/**
 * 施設外就労グループのサブタブ
 */
export function OffsiteSubNav({ className }: { className?: string }) {

'use client';

import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Printer } from "lucide-react";

interface PrintButtonProps {
  label?: string;
  className?: string;
  variant?: "default" | "destructive" | "outline" | "secondary" | "ghost" | "link";
  size?: "default" | "sm" | "lg" | "icon";
}

export function PrintButton({ 
  label = "印刷", 
  className = "",
  variant = "outline",
  size = "sm"
}: PrintButtonProps) {
  return (
    <Button
      type="button"
      variant={variant}
      size={size}
      className={className}
      onClick={() => window.print()}
    >
      <Printer className="mr-1.5 h-4 w-4" />
      {label}
    </Button>
  );
}

File: src/components/QuickSetupGuide.tsx

'use client';

import { useState } from 'react';
import Link from 'next/link';
import { Card, CardContent } from "@/components/ui/card";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { CheckCircle2, Circle, ArrowRight, Building2, ShieldCheck, Users, Sparkles, ChevronDown, ChevronUp } from "lucide-react";

interface SetupStep {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  isCompleted: boolean;
  href: string;
  actionText: string;
}

interface QuickSetupGuideProps {
  facilitySettings: any;
  staffCount: number;
  clientCount: number;
}

export function QuickSetupGuide({ facilitySettings, staffCount, clientCount }: QuickSetupGuideProps) {
  const [isCollapsed, setIsCollapsed] = useState(false);

  // ステップ1: 事業所・法人基本情報
  const isStep1Done = !!(
    facilitySettings?.facility_number &&
    facilitySettings.facility_number !== '0000000000' &&
    facilitySettings?.facility_name &&
    facilitySettings.facility_name !== '未設定'
  );

  // ステップ2: 運営基準・最低賃金・加算
  const isStep2Done = !!(
    facilitySettings?.staffing_class &&
    facilitySettings?.regional_minimum_wage &&
    Number(facilitySettings.regional_minimum_wage) > 0
  );

  // ステップ3: 職員・利用者マスタ登録
  const isStep3Done = staffCount > 0 && clientCount > 0;

  const steps: SetupStep[] = [
    {
      id: 'step1',
      title: '1. 事業所・法人の基本情報',
      description: isStep1Done 
        ? `${facilitySettings.facility_name} (${facilitySettings.facility_number}) 設定済`
        : '事業所番号（10桁）、法人名、所在地、連絡先を登録します。',
      isCompleted: isStep1Done,
      href: '/settings',
      actionText: isStep1Done ? '変更' : '基本設定へ',
    },
    {
      id: 'step2',
      title: '2. 人員配置基準・最低賃金・加算体制',
      description: isStep2Done
        ? `配置基準: ${facilitySettings.staffing_class} / 最低賃金: ¥${facilitySettings.regional_minimum_wage} 設定済`
        : '配置基準（7.5:1/10:1）、地域別最低賃金、送迎・食事・処遇改善加算を設定します。',
      isCompleted: isStep2Done,
      href: '/settings',
      actionText: isStep2Done ? '変更' : '加算設定へ',
    },
    {
      id: 'step3',
      title: '3. 職員および利用者の登録',
      description: isStep3Done
        ? `職員 ${staffCount}名 / 利用者 ${clientCount}名 登録済`
        : `職員(${staffCount}名)・利用者(${clientCount}名)の登録。CSV一括インポートも可能です。`,
      isCompleted: isStep3Done,
      href: staffCount === 0 ? '/staff' : '/clients',
      actionText: isStep3Done ? '一覧へ' : (staffCount === 0 ? '職員登録へ' : '利用者登録へ'),
    },
  ];

  const completedCount = steps.filter(s => s.isCompleted).length;
  const progressPercent = Math.round((completedCount / steps.length) * 100);

  // すべて完了している場合は完全に非表示にする
  if (completedCount === steps.length) {
    return null;
  }

  // 未完了時にユーザーが折りたたんだ場合のコンパクトバー
  if (isCollapsed) {
    return (
      <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl mb-4">
        <div className="bg-indigo-50/80 border border-indigo-200 rounded-lg p-3 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-indigo-900 font-semibold shadow-2xs">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600" />
            <span>初期セットアップガイド: {completedCount} / {steps.length} ステップ完了 ({progressPercent}%)</span>
          </div>
          <Button 
            variant="ghost" 
            size="sm" 
            onClick={() => setIsCollapsed(false)}
            className="h-6 text-xs text-indigo-800 hover:text-indigo-950 font-medium flex items-center gap-1"
          >
            <span>ガイドを表示</span>
            <ChevronDown className="h-3 w-3" />
          </Button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl mb-6">
      <Card className="border-indigo-200 bg-gradient-to-r from-indigo-50/90 via-purple-50/40 to-blue-50/60 shadow-sm overflow-hidden">
        <div className="p-4 sm:p-5">
          <div className="flex flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-center justify-between gap-3 border-b border-indigo-100 pb-3.5 mb-3.5">
            <div className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
              <div className="p-2 rounded-lg bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-2xs">
                <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4" />
              </div>
              <div>
                <h3 className="text-base font-bold text-indigo-950 flex items-center gap-2">
                  初期セットアップガイド（クイックスタート）
                  <span className="text-xs bg-indigo-100 text-indigo-800 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full font-semibold">
                    進捗: {completedCount} / 3 ステップ ({progressPercent}%)
                  </span>
                </h3>
                <p className="text-xs text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                  初めてご利用される事業所様向けの初期設定ガイドです。ステップ順に設定を完了してください。
                </p>
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <div className="w-32 bg-indigo-100 rounded-full h-2 overflow-hidden shrink-0">
                <div 
                  className="bg-indigo-600 h-full rounded-full transition-all duration-500" 
                  style={{ width: `${progressPercent}%` }}
                />
              </div>
              <Button 
                variant="ghost" 
                size="sm" 
                onClick={() => setIsCollapsed(true)}
                className="h-7 w-7 p-0 text-muted-foreground hover:text-foreground"
                title="折りたたむ"
              >
                <ChevronUp className="h-4 w-4" />
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-3">
            {steps.map((step) => (
              <div 
                key={step.id} 
                className={`p-3.5 rounded-xl border transition-all flex flex-col justify-between ${
                  step.isCompleted 
                    ? 'bg-white/80 border-emerald-200 shadow-2xs' 
                    : 'bg-white border-indigo-200 shadow-xs ring-1 ring-indigo-200/50'
                }`}
              >
                <div>
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2 mb-1.5">
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-gray-900 flex items-center gap-1.5">
                      {step.isCompleted ? (
                        <CheckCircle2 className="h-4 w-4 text-emerald-600 shrink-0" />
                      ) : (
                        <Circle className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-500 shrink-0" />
                      )}
                      <span>{step.title}</span>
                    </span>
                    {step.isCompleted && (
                      <span className="text-[10px] bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-800 font-bold px-1.5 py-0.2 rounded">
                        完了
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <p className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground leading-relaxed">
                    {step.description}
                  </p>
                </div>

                <div className="pt-3 mt-2 border-t border-gray-100 flex justify-end">
                  <Link href={step.href}>
                    <Button 
                      size="sm" 
                      variant={step.isCompleted ? "outline" : "default"}
                      className={`h-7 text-xs font-semibold gap-1 px-3 ${
                        step.isCompleted ? 'border-gray-300 text-gray-700' : 'bg-indigo-600 hover:bg-indigo-700 text-white'
                      }`}
                    >
                      <span>{step.actionText}</span>
                      <ArrowRight className="h-3 w-3" />
                    </Button>
                  </Link>
                </div>
              </div>
            ))}
          </div>
        </div>
      </Card>
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import React from 'react';
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { ChevronDown, Sparkles, Building, Briefcase, Coins, Home, Smile } from "lucide-react";
import { ServiceMode, SERVICE_MODE_DEFINITIONS } from "@/lib/serviceMode";
import { switchServiceMode } from "@/app/login/actions";
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
} from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu";

interface ServiceModeDropdownProps {
  currentMode: ServiceMode;
  className?: string;
  variant?: 'light' | 'dark' | 'transparent';
}

const MODE_ICONS: Record<ServiceMode, React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>> = {
  type_a: Briefcase,
  type_b: Coins,
  gh: Home,
  houday: Smile,
  corporate: Building,
};

export function ServiceModeDropdown({ 
  currentMode, 
  className,
  variant = 'light' 
}: ServiceModeDropdownProps) {
  const currentMeta = SERVICE_MODE_DEFINITIONS[currentMode] || SERVICE_MODE_DEFINITIONS.type_a;

  return (
    <DropdownMenu>
      <DropdownMenuTrigger asChild>
        <button
          type="button"
          className={cn(
            "flex items-center gap-2 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all shadow-2xs outline-none cursor-pointer select-none",
            variant === 'transparent'
              ? "bg-white/20 hover:bg-white/30 text-white border border-white/30"
              : variant === 'dark'
              ? "bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-700 text-white border border-slate-700"
              : currentMode === 'type_b'
              ? "bg-emerald-50 text-emerald-800 border-emerald-300 hover:bg-emerald-100" 
              : currentMode === 'gh'
              ? "bg-amber-50 text-amber-900 border-amber-300 hover:bg-amber-100"
              : currentMode === 'houday'
              ? "bg-sky-50 text-sky-800 border-sky-300 hover:bg-sky-100"
              : currentMode === 'corporate'
              ? "bg-purple-950 text-purple-200 border-purple-800 hover:bg-purple-900"
              : "bg-blue-50 text-blue-800 border-blue-300 hover:bg-blue-100",
            className
          )}
        >
          <span className={cn(
            "w-2.5 h-2.5 rounded-full shrink-0", 
            currentMode === 'type_b' ? "bg-emerald-600" :
            currentMode === 'gh' ? "bg-amber-600" :
            currentMode === 'houday' ? "bg-sky-500" :
            currentMode === 'corporate' ? "bg-purple-500" :
            "bg-blue-600"
          )} />
          <span>サービス切替: {currentMeta.selectorLabel}</span>
          <ChevronDown className="w-3.5 h-3.5 opacity-60" />
        </button>
      </DropdownMenuTrigger>

      <DropdownMenuContent align="end" className="w-80 p-2 z-50">
        <div className="flex items-center justify-between px-2.5 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold text-slate-500 border-b border-slate-100 mb-1.5">
          <span>システム事業所・サービス切替</span>
          <span className="text-[10px] text-slate-400 font-normal">クリックで切替</span>
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-1">
          {(Object.keys(SERVICE_MODE_DEFINITIONS) as ServiceMode[]).map((mode) => {
            const item = SERVICE_MODE_DEFINITIONS[mode];
            const isCurrent = currentMode === mode;
            const Icon = MODE_ICONS[mode] || Sparkles;

            return (
              <DropdownMenuItem
                key={mode}
                disabled={isCurrent}
                onClick={async () => {
                  if (!isCurrent) {
                    await switchServiceMode(mode);
                  }
                }}
                className={cn(
                  "w-full flex items-start gap-2.5 p-2.5 rounded-lg cursor-pointer transition-colors",
                  isCurrent 
                    ? "bg-slate-100 font-bold text-slate-900 cursor-default" 
                    : "hover:bg-slate-50 text-slate-700 hover:text-slate-900"
                )}
              >
                <Icon className={cn(
                  "w-4 h-4 mt-0.5 shrink-0",
                  mode === 'type_b' ? "text-emerald-600" :
                  mode === 'gh' ? "text-amber-600" :
                  mode === 'houday' ? "text-sky-600" :
                  mode === 'corporate' ? "text-purple-600" :
                  "text-blue-600"
                )} />
                <div className="flex-1">
                  <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                    <span className="text-sm font-semibold">{item.selectorLabel}</span>
                    {isCurrent && (
                      <span className="text-[10px] px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-200 text-slate-700 font-bold">
                        選択中
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="text-[11px] text-muted-foreground mt-0.5">
                    {item.description}
                  </div>
                </div>
              </DropdownMenuItem>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      </DropdownMenuContent>
    </DropdownMenu>
  );
}

File: src/components/SubNav.tsx

"use client";

import Link from "next/link";
import { usePathname } from "next/navigation";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import React from "react";

export interface SubNavItem {
  label: string;
  href: string;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
  badge?: string | number;
  matchPrefix?: boolean;
}

interface SubNavProps {
  items: SubNavItem[];
  className?: string;
}

export function SubNav({ items, className }: SubNavProps) {
  const pathname = usePathname();

  return (
    <div className={cn("w-full border-b border-border/80 bg-muted/30 -mt-2 mb-6 py-2 px-1", className)}>
      <div className="max-w-6xl mx-auto flex items-center gap-1.5 overflow-x-auto no-scrollbar">
        {items.map((item) => {
          const isActive = item.matchPrefix
            ? pathname === item.href || (item.href !== "/" && pathname.startsWith(item.href))
            : pathname === item.href;

          return (
            <Link
              key={item.href}
              href={item.href}
              className={cn(
                "inline-flex items-center gap-2 whitespace-nowrap rounded-md px-3.5 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium transition-all duration-150 shrink-0",
                isActive
                  ? "bg-white text-primary shadow-xs border border-border/60 font-bold"
                  : "text-muted-foreground hover:bg-white/60 hover:text-foreground"
              )}
            >
              {item.icon && <span className={cn("shrink-0", isActive ? "text-primary" : "text-muted-foreground")}>{item.icon}</span>}
              <span>{item.label}</span>
              {item.badge !== undefined && (
                <span className={cn(
                  "ml-1 rounded-full px-1.5 py-0.2 text-[11px] font-bold",
                  isActive ? "bg-primary/10 text-primary" : "bg-muted text-muted-foreground"
                )}>
                  {item.badge}
                </span>
              )}
            </Link>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';
import { useFormStatus } from 'react-dom';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';
import { Loader2 } from 'lucide-react';

export function SubmitButton({
  children = '保存する',
  loadingText = '処理中...',
  className = '',
  disabled,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<typeof Button> & { loadingText?: string }) {
  const { pending } = useFormStatus();

  return (
    <Button
      type="submit"
      disabled={pending || disabled}
      className={className}
      {...props}
    >
      {pending ? (
        <>
          <Loader2 className="mr-2 h-4 w-4 animate-spin" />
          {loadingText}
        </>
      ) : (
        children
      )}
    </Button>
  );
}

"use client";

import React from "react";
import { useUIMode, UIModePreference } from "./UIModeProvider";
import { Smartphone, Monitor, Tablet, Check } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

export function UIModeBanner() {
  const { modePreference, setModePreference, activeMode } = useUIMode();

  const handleSelectMode = (mode: UIModePreference) => {
    try {
      if (typeof window !== "undefined" && "vibrate" in navigator) {
        navigator.vibrate(30);
      }
    } catch {}

    setModePreference(mode);
  };

  return (
    <div 
      suppressHydrationWarning 
      className="flex items-center justify-between sm:justify-end gap-2 bg-slate-100/80 border border-slate-200 rounded-xl px-3 py-2 mb-4 print:hidden"
    >
      <span className="text-xs text-slate-500 font-bold shrink-0">表示切替:</span>
      <div className="flex items-center gap-1 bg-white p-1 rounded-lg border border-slate-200 shadow-2xs">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => handleSelectMode("mobile")}
          className={cn(
            "flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer touch-manipulation active:scale-95 select-none",
            activeMode === "mobile"
              ? "bg-blue-600 text-white shadow-xs"
              : "text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50"
          )}
        >
          <Smartphone className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
          <span>スマホ</span>
          {activeMode === "mobile" && <Check className="w-3 h-3 ml-0.5 stroke-[3]" />}
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => handleSelectMode("tablet")}
          className={cn(
            "flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer touch-manipulation active:scale-95 select-none",
            activeMode === "tablet"
              ? "bg-indigo-600 text-white shadow-xs"
              : "text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50"
          )}
        >
          <Tablet className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
          <span>タブレット</span>
          {activeMode === "tablet" && <Check className="w-3 h-3 ml-0.5 stroke-[3]" />}
        </button>

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => handleSelectMode("desktop")}
          className={cn(
            "flex items-center gap-1.5 px-3 py-1.5 rounded-md text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer touch-manipulation active:scale-95 select-none",
            activeMode === "desktop"
              ? "bg-slate-900 text-white shadow-xs"
              : "text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900 hover:bg-slate-50"
          )}
        >
          <Monitor className="w-3.5 h-3.5 shrink-0" />
          <span>PC</span>
          {activeMode === "desktop" && <Check className="w-3 h-3 ml-0.5 stroke-[3]" />}
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}


================================================================================
File: src/components/UIModeProvider.tsx
================================================================================

"use client";

import React, { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState, useCallback } from "react";

export type UIModePreference = "auto" | "mobile" | "tablet" | "desktop";
export type ActiveUIMode = "mobile" | "tablet" | "desktop";

interface UIModeContextType {
  modePreference: UIModePreference;
  setModePreference: (mode: UIModePreference) => void;
  activeMode: ActiveUIMode;
  isMobile: boolean;
  isTablet: boolean;
  isDesktop: boolean;
  mounted: boolean;
}

const UIModeContext = createContext<UIModeContextType | undefined>(undefined);

export function UIModeProvider({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  // SSRハイドレーション不一致を防ぐため、初期値はサーバー・クライアント共通の定数とする
  const [modePreference, setModePreferenceState] = useState<UIModePreference>("auto");
  const [windowWidth, setWindowWidth] = useState<number>(1200);
  const [mounted, setMounted] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    setMounted(true);

    try {
      const saved = localStorage.getItem("app-ui-mode") as UIModePreference;
      if (saved && ["auto", "mobile", "tablet", "desktop"].includes(saved)) {
        setModePreferenceState(saved);
      }
    } catch {}

    setWindowWidth(window.innerWidth);

    const handleResize = () => {
      setWindowWidth(window.innerWidth);
    };
    window.addEventListener("resize", handleResize);
    return () => window.removeEventListener("resize", handleResize);
  }, []);

  const setModePreference = useCallback((mode: UIModePreference) => {
    setModePreferenceState(mode);
    try {
      if (typeof window !== "undefined") {
        localStorage.setItem("app-ui-mode", mode);
      }
    } catch {}
  }, []);

  // 実効モードの判定（未マウント時はサーバーと完全に一致させる）
  const activeMode: ActiveUIMode = React.useMemo(() => {
    if (!mounted) return "desktop";

    if (modePreference === "mobile") return "mobile";
    if (modePreference === "tablet") return "tablet";
    if (modePreference === "desktop") return "desktop";

    // "auto" の場合は画面幅で判定
    if (windowWidth < 768) return "mobile";
    if (windowWidth < 1024) return "tablet";
    return "desktop";
  }, [mounted, modePreference, windowWidth]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!mounted) return;
    const root = document.documentElement;
    root.setAttribute("data-ui-mode", activeMode);
    root.setAttribute("data-ui-pref", modePreference);

    // スマホ・タブレット等のブラウザでPC表示が選択された場合、viewportメタタグを動的に切り替える
    try {
      let viewportMeta = document.querySelector('meta[name="viewport"]') as HTMLMetaElement | null;
      if (!viewportMeta) {
        viewportMeta = document.createElement("meta");
        viewportMeta.name = "viewport";
        document.head.appendChild(viewportMeta);
      }

      if (activeMode === "desktop") {
        // PC通常モード: 標準スケール（1.0倍・ピンチ拡大縮小可能）
        viewportMeta.content = "width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, minimum-scale=0.5, maximum-scale=5.0, user-scalable=yes";
      } else if (activeMode === "tablet") {
        // タブレット面談モード
        viewportMeta.content = "width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, minimum-scale=0.5, maximum-scale=5.0, user-scalable=yes";
      } else {
        // 現場スマホモード: 通常のスマホ最適化幅（親指操作・縦スクロール）
        viewportMeta.content = "width=device-width, initial-scale=1, maximum-scale=5, user-scalable=yes, viewport-fit=cover";
      }

      // ブラウザにリサイズイベントを通知してCSS/JSコンポーネントを即時再計算
      setTimeout(() => {
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event("resize"));
      }, 50);
    } catch (e) {
      console.error("viewport update error:", e);
    }
  }, [activeMode, modePreference, mounted]);

  const value = React.useMemo(
    () => ({
      modePreference,
      setModePreference,
      activeMode,
      isMobile: activeMode === "mobile",
      isTablet: activeMode === "tablet",
      isDesktop: activeMode === "desktop",
      mounted,
    }),
    [modePreference, setModePreference, activeMode, mounted]
  );

  return <UIModeContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</UIModeContext.Provider>;
}

export function useUIMode() {
  const context = useContext(UIModeContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error("useUIMode must be used within a UIModeProvider");
  }
  return context;
}

"use client";

import React from "react";
import { useUIMode, UIModePreference } from "./UIModeProvider";
import { Monitor, Smartphone, Tablet, Sparkles } from "lucide-react";
import {
  DropdownMenu,
  DropdownMenuContent,
  DropdownMenuItem,
  DropdownMenuTrigger,
  DropdownMenuSeparator,
  DropdownMenuLabel,
} from "@/components/ui/dropdown-menu";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";
import { toast } from "sonner";

export function UIModeSelector() {
  const { modePreference, setModePreference, activeMode, mounted } = useUIMode();

  const getIcon = (pref: UIModePreference, active: string) => {
    if (!mounted) {
      return <Monitor className="h-4 w-4 text-slate-700" />;
    }
    if (pref === "mobile" || (pref === "auto" && active === "mobile")) {
      return <Smartphone className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-600" />;
    }
    if (pref === "tablet" || (pref === "auto" && active === "tablet")) {
      return <Tablet className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600" />;
    }
    return <Monitor className="h-4 w-4 text-slate-700" />;
  };

  const getShortLabel = () => {
    if (!mounted) return "表示";
    if (modePreference === "auto") {
      return activeMode === "mobile" ? "スマホ" : activeMode === "tablet" ? "タブレット" : "PC";
    }
    if (modePreference === "mobile") return "スマホ";
    if (modePreference === "tablet") return "タブレット";
    return "PC";
  };

  const getFullLabel = () => {
    if (!mounted) return "表示";
    if (modePreference === "auto") {
      return `自動 (${getShortLabel()})`;
    }
    if (modePreference === "mobile") return "スマホ";
    if (modePreference === "tablet") return "タブレット";
    return "PC";
  };

  const handleSelectMode = (mode: UIModePreference, label: string) => {
    try {
      if (typeof window !== "undefined" && "vibrate" in navigator) {
        navigator.vibrate(50);
      }
    } catch {}

    setModePreference(mode);

    if (mode === modePreference && mode === activeMode) {
      toast.info(`現在は「${label}」表示です`);
      return;
    }

    toast.success(`「${label}」に切り替えました`);
  };

  return (
    <DropdownMenu>
      <DropdownMenuTrigger
        className={cn(
          "inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 px-2.5 py-1.5 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold border transition-all cursor-pointer outline-none select-none shrink-0 shadow-2xs touch-manipulation active:scale-95",
          modePreference !== "auto"
            ? "bg-primary text-white border-primary shadow-xs"
            : "bg-blue-50/90 border-blue-300 text-blue-900 hover:bg-blue-100"
        )}
        title="表示モード切替（PC / スマホ / タブレット）"
      >
        <div className={cn(
          "p-0.5 rounded",
          modePreference !== "auto" ? "text-white" : ""
        )}>
          {getIcon(modePreference, activeMode)}
        </div>
        <span className="text-xs font-bold">
          <span className="hidden md:inline">{getFullLabel()}</span>
          <span className="md:hidden">{getShortLabel()}</span>
        </span>
      </DropdownMenuTrigger>
      <DropdownMenuContent align="end" className="w-64 p-1.5 z-50">
        <DropdownMenuLabel className="text-[11px] font-bold text-slate-500 px-2 py-1">
          デバイス表示モード切替
        </DropdownMenuLabel>
        <DropdownMenuSeparator />

        <DropdownMenuItem
          onClick={() => handleSelectMode("auto", "自動判別 (Auto)")}
          className={cn(
            "flex items-center justify-between p-2 rounded-md cursor-pointer text-xs font-medium",
            modePreference === "auto" ? "bg-accent font-bold text-primary" : ""
          )}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Sparkles className="h-4 w-4 text-amber-500" />
            <div>
              <div className="font-bold">自動判別 (Auto)</div>
              <div className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground">端末の画面幅に合わせて自動切替</div>
            </div>
          </div>
          {modePreference === "auto" && <span className="text-primary text-xs font-bold">✓</span>}
        </DropdownMenuItem>

        <DropdownMenuItem
          onClick={() => handleSelectMode("mobile", "スマホ")}
          className={cn(
            "flex items-center justify-between p-2 rounded-md cursor-pointer text-xs font-medium",
            modePreference === "mobile" ? "bg-accent font-bold text-primary" : ""
          )}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Smartphone className="h-4 w-4 text-blue-600" />
            <div className="font-bold">スマホ</div>
          </div>
          {modePreference === "mobile" && <span className="text-primary text-xs font-bold">✓</span>}
        </DropdownMenuItem>

        <DropdownMenuItem
          onClick={() => handleSelectMode("tablet", "タブレット")}
          className={cn(
            "flex items-center justify-between p-2 rounded-md cursor-pointer text-xs font-medium",
            modePreference === "tablet" ? "bg-accent font-bold text-primary" : ""
          )}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Tablet className="h-4 w-4 text-indigo-600" />
            <div className="font-bold">タブレット</div>
          </div>
          {modePreference === "tablet" && <span className="text-primary text-xs font-bold">✓</span>}
        </DropdownMenuItem>

        <DropdownMenuItem
          onClick={() => handleSelectMode("desktop", "PC")}
          className={cn(
            "flex items-center justify-between p-2 rounded-md cursor-pointer text-xs font-medium",
            modePreference === "desktop" ? "bg-accent font-bold text-primary" : ""
          )}
        >
          <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
            <Monitor className="h-4 w-4 text-slate-700" />
            <div className="font-bold">PC</div>
          </div>
          {modePreference === "desktop" && <span className="text-primary text-xs font-bold">✓</span>}
        </DropdownMenuItem>
      </DropdownMenuContent>
    </DropdownMenu>
  );
}

/**
 * シート（メニュー）内に埋め込めるフル幅のセグメント切替コントロール
 */
export function UIModeSegmentedControl() {
  const { modePreference, setModePreference, activeMode } = useUIMode();

  const options: { id: UIModePreference; label: string; icon: any }[] = [
    { id: "auto", label: "自動", icon: Sparkles },
    { id: "mobile", label: "スマホ", icon: Smartphone },
    { id: "tablet", label: "タブレット", icon: Tablet },
    { id: "desktop", label: "PC", icon: Monitor },
  ];

  const handleSelect = (id: UIModePreference, label: string) => {
    try {
      if (typeof window !== "undefined" && "vibrate" in navigator) {
        navigator.vibrate(50);
      }
    } catch {}

    setModePreference(id);

    if (id === modePreference && id === activeMode) {
      toast.info(`現在はすでに「${label}」です`);
      return;
    }

    toast.success(`表示モードを「${label}」に切り替えました`, {
      duration: 3000,
      description: id === "desktop"
        ? "PC用フル画面を展開中。指で拡大・縮小や横スクロールが可能です。"
        : id === "tablet"
        ? "タブレット面談・署名モードに切り替えました。"
        : id === "auto"
        ? "端末の画面幅に合わせて自動切替します。"
        : "現場スマホ片手操作モードに切り替えました。",
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="bg-slate-100 p-1 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-1 border border-slate-200 shadow-2xs">
      {options.map((opt) => {
        const Icon = opt.icon;
        const isSelected = modePreference === opt.id;
        return (
          <button
            key={opt.id}
            type="button"
            onClick={() => handleSelect(opt.id, opt.label)}
            className={cn(
              "flex-1 flex items-center justify-center gap-1.5 py-2.5 px-1 rounded-lg text-xs font-bold transition-all cursor-pointer touch-manipulation active:scale-95 select-none",
              isSelected
                ? "bg-white text-primary shadow-xs border border-slate-300 ring-2 ring-primary/20"
                : "text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900"
            )}
          >
            <Icon className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            <span>{opt.label}</span>
          </button>
        );
      })}
    </div>
  );
}

"use client";

import React from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Clock, MapPin, Bus, Utensils, AlertCircle, Edit, CheckCircle2 } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

interface AttendanceRecordItem {
  id: string;
  client_id: string;
  client_full_name: string;
  record_date: string;
  status: string;
  clock_in?: string;
  clock_out?: string;
  break_time_minutes?: number;
  work_type?: string;
  is_offsite?: number;
  offsite_workplace_name?: string;
  offsite_staff_name?: string;
  offsite_staff_id?: string;
  is_absence_addition?: number;
  pickup_service?: number;
  dropoff_service?: number;
  meal_provided?: number;
  temperature?: number;
  note?: string;
}

interface MobileAttendanceCardListProps {
  records: AttendanceRecordItem[];
  selectedDateStr: string;
}

export function MobileAttendanceCardList({ records, selectedDateStr }: MobileAttendanceCardListProps) {
  if (!records || records.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="py-8 text-center text-sm text-muted-foreground bg-slate-50 rounded-lg border border-dashed">
        記録がありません
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3 p-1">
      {records.map((record) => {
        const isOffsite =
          record.work_type === "out_facility" ||
          record.work_type === "both" ||
          record.is_offsite === 1;
        const isMissingStaff = isOffsite && record.status === "present" && !record.offsite_staff_id;

        return (
          <div
            key={record.id}
            className={cn(
              "bg-white rounded-xl border p-3.5 shadow-xs transition-all active:scale-[0.99] touch-manipulation",
              isMissingStaff ? "border-amber-300 bg-amber-50/30" : "border-slate-200"
            )}
          >
            {/* 上段: 利用者名 & ステータスバッジ */}
            <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-2">
              <div className="flex-1 min-w-0">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 flex-wrap">
                  <span className="font-bold text-base text-slate-900 truncate">
                    {record.client_full_name}
                  </span>
                  {isMissingStaff && (
                    <Badge variant="outline" className="bg-rose-100 text-rose-800 border-rose-300 text-[10px] px-1 py-0">
                      ⚠️引率不在
                    </Badge>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* 勤務形態 & 送迎バッジ */}
                <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1 mt-1.5">
                  {record.status === "present" && (
                    <Badge variant="outline" className="border-emerald-500 text-emerald-800 bg-emerald-50 font-bold text-xs">
                      出勤
                    </Badge>
                  )}
                  {record.status === "absent" && record.is_absence_addition === 1 && (
                    <Badge variant="destructive" className="font-bold text-xs">
                      欠席（加算あり）
                    </Badge>
                  )}
                  {record.status === "absent" && record.is_absence_addition !== 1 && (
                    <Badge variant="outline" className="border-amber-400 text-amber-900 bg-amber-50 text-xs font-bold">
                      欠勤（加算なし）
                    </Badge>
                  )}
                  {record.status === "holiday" && (
                    <Badge variant="secondary" className="text-xs font-bold">
                      公休
                    </Badge>
                  )}
                  {record.status === "pto" && (
                    <Badge variant="outline" className="border-blue-400 text-blue-900 bg-blue-50 text-xs font-bold">
                      有給
                    </Badge>
                  )}

                  {/* 勤務形態 */}
                  {record.status === "present" && record.work_type === "out_facility" && (
                    <Badge variant="secondary" className="bg-orange-100 text-orange-900 border-orange-300 text-[11px] font-semibold">
                      終日施設外
                    </Badge>
                  )}
                  {record.status === "present" && record.work_type === "both" && (
                    <Badge variant="secondary" className="bg-amber-100 text-amber-900 border-amber-300 text-[11px] font-semibold">
                      内勤＋施設外
                    </Badge>
                  )}
                  {record.status === "present" && record.work_type === "remote" && (
                    <Badge className="bg-indigo-600 text-white text-[11px]">在宅</Badge>
                  )}

                  {/* 送迎・食事 */}
                  {record.pickup_service === 1 && (
                    <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] border-blue-200 text-blue-800 bg-blue-50 flex items-center gap-0.5">
                      <Bus className="w-2.5 h-2.5" /> 迎
                    </Badge>
                  )}
                  {record.dropoff_service === 1 && (
                    <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] border-blue-200 text-blue-800 bg-blue-50 flex items-center gap-0.5">
                      <Bus className="w-2.5 h-2.5" /> 送
                    </Badge>
                  )}
                  {record.meal_provided === 1 && (
                    <Badge variant="outline" className="text-[10px] border-amber-200 text-amber-800 bg-amber-50 flex items-center gap-0.5">
                      <Utensils className="w-2.5 h-2.5" /> 食
                    </Badge>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* 編集ボタン（親指で押しやすい最低44pxターゲット） */}
              <Link href={`/attendance?date=${selectedDateStr}&editId=${record.id}`} className="shrink-0">
                <Button
                  size="sm"
                  variant="outline"
                  className="h-10 px-3 text-xs font-bold border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100 text-slate-700 flex items-center gap-1 shadow-2xs"
                >
                  <Edit className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  編集
                </Button>
              </Link>
            </div>

            {/* 中段: 時間・休憩・現場詳細 */}
            {record.status === "present" && (
              <div className="mt-2.5 pt-2 border-t border-slate-100 flex items-center justify-between text-xs text-slate-600">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5 font-mono font-bold text-slate-800">
                  <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5 text-slate-400" />
                  <span>
                    {record.clock_in ? record.clock_in.substring(0, 5) : "--:--"} 〜{" "}
                    {record.clock_out ? record.clock_out.substring(0, 5) : "--:--"}
                  </span>
                  {record.break_time_minutes !== undefined && record.break_time_minutes > 0 && (
                    <span className="text-[11px] font-normal text-muted-foreground ml-1">
                      (休 {record.break_time_minutes}分)
                    </span>
                  )}
                </div>

                {isOffsite && record.offsite_workplace_name && (
                  <div className="flex items-center gap-1 text-[11px] text-slate-600 truncate max-w-[150px]">
                    <MapPin className="w-3 h-3 text-orange-600 shrink-0" />
                    <span className="truncate">{record.offsite_workplace_name}</span>
                  </div>
                )}
              </div>
            )}

            {/* 引率職員名があれば表示 */}
            {isOffsite && record.offsite_staff_name && (
              <div className="mt-1 text-[11px] text-emerald-800 bg-emerald-50 px-2 py-0.5 rounded flex items-center gap-1">
                <span>引率担当:</span>
                <span className="font-bold">{record.offsite_staff_name}</span>
              </div>
            )}

            {/* メモ・特記事項があれば表示 */}
            {record.note && (
              <div className="mt-1 text-xs text-slate-500 italic bg-slate-50 p-1.5 rounded">
                {record.note}
              </div>
            )}
          </div>
        );
      })}
