"use client";

import React, { useState, useTransition } from "react";
import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Input } from "@/components/ui/input";
import { toggleQuickAttendanceField } from "@/app/attendance/actions";
import { toast } from "sonner";
import { Bus, Clock, Search, CheckCircle2, User } from "lucide-react";
import { cn } from "@/lib/utils";

interface ClientQuickItem {
  id: string;
  fullName: string;
  departmentName?: string;
  clockIn?: string;
  clockOut?: string;
  pickup?: boolean;
  dropoff?: boolean;
  status?: string;
}

interface MobileQuickCheckInProps {
  clients: ClientQuickItem[];
  todayStr: string;
  hasTransportation?: boolean;
}

export function MobileQuickCheckIn({ 
  clients, 
  todayStr,
  hasTransportation = true
}: MobileQuickCheckInProps) {
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [isPending, startTransition] = useTransition();
  const [localData, setLocalData] = useState<Record<string, Partial<ClientQuickItem>>>({});

  const filteredClients = clients.filter((c) =>
    c.fullName.toLowerCase().includes(search.toLowerCase())
  );

  const handleToggle = (
    clientId: string,
    actionType: "clock_in" | "clock_out" | "toggle_pickup" | "toggle_dropoff"
  ) => {
    // 楽観的UI更新
    const now = new Date();
    const timeStr = `${String(now.getHours()).padStart(2, "0")}:${String(now.getMinutes()).padStart(2, "0")}`;

    setLocalData((prev) => {
      const current = prev[clientId] || {};
      const base = clients.find((c) => c.id === clientId);

      if (actionType === "clock_in") {
        return { ...prev, [clientId]: { ...current, clockIn: current.clockIn ?? base?.clockIn ? undefined : timeStr } };
      }
      if (actionType === "clock_out") {
        return { ...prev, [clientId]: { ...current, clockOut: current.clockOut ?? base?.clockOut ? undefined : timeStr } };
      }
      if (actionType === "toggle_pickup") {
        const val = current.pickup !== undefined ? !current.pickup : !base?.pickup;
        return { ...prev, [clientId]: { ...current, pickup: val } };
      }
      if (actionType === "toggle_dropoff") {
        const val = current.dropoff !== undefined ? !current.dropoff : !base?.dropoff;
        return { ...prev, [clientId]: { ...current, dropoff: val } };
      }
      return prev;
    });

    startTransition(async () => {
      const res = await toggleQuickAttendanceField(clientId, todayStr, actionType);
      if (!res.success) {
        toast.error(`更新に失敗しました: ${res.error}`);
      } else {
        const actionLabels = {
          clock_in: "出勤打刻",
          clock_out: "退勤打刻",
          toggle_pickup: "朝のお迎え送迎",
          toggle_dropoff: "夕方の送り送迎",
        };
        toast.success(`${actionLabels[actionType]}を更新しました`);
      }
    });
  };

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      {/* 検索入力欄 */}
      <div className="relative">
        <Search className="w-4 h-4 absolute left-3 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 text-muted-foreground" />
        <Input
          type="text"
          placeholder="利用者を検索..."
          value={search}
          onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)}
          className="pl-9 h-11 text-sm bg-white rounded-xl shadow-2xs border-slate-200"
        />
      </div>

      {/* 利用者クイックアクションカードリスト */}
      <div className="space-y-2.5">
        {filteredClients.map((client) => {
          const state = {
            clockIn: localData[client.id]?.clockIn !== undefined ? localData[client.id]?.clockIn : client.clockIn,
            clockOut: localData[client.id]?.clockOut !== undefined ? localData[client.id]?.clockOut : client.clockOut,
            pickup: localData[client.id]?.pickup !== undefined ? localData[client.id]?.pickup : client.pickup,
            dropoff: localData[client.id]?.dropoff !== undefined ? localData[client.id]?.dropoff : client.dropoff,
          };

          return (
            <div
              key={client.id}
              className="bg-white rounded-xl border border-slate-200 p-3 shadow-2xs flex flex-col gap-2.5"
            >
              {/* 利用者名・部署 */}
              <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
                <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
                  <div className="h-7 w-7 rounded-full bg-primary/10 text-primary font-black text-xs flex items-center justify-center shrink-0">
                    <User className="w-4 h-4" />
                  </div>
                  <div>
                    <span className="font-bold text-sm text-slate-900 block leading-tight">
                      {client.fullName}
                    </span>
                    {client.departmentName && (
                      <span className="text-[10px] text-muted-foreground font-medium">
                        {client.departmentName}
                      </span>
                    )}
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* 現在の打刻状況バッジ */}
                <div className="text-right text-[11px] font-mono font-bold text-slate-700">
                  {state.clockIn ? (
                    <span className="text-emerald-700 bg-emerald-50 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded border border-emerald-200">
                      {state.clockIn.substring(0, 5)}〜{state.clockOut ? state.clockOut.substring(0, 5) : "--:--"}
                    </span>
                  ) : (
                    <span className="text-slate-400">未打刻</span>
                  )}
                </div>
              </div>

              {/* ワンタップボタングループ（親指で押しやすい最低44px） */}
              <div className={cn(
                "gap-1.5 pt-1 border-t border-slate-100",
                hasTransportation ? "grid grid-cols-4" : "grid grid-cols-2"
              )}>
                {/* 迎（送迎あり時のみ表示） */}
                {hasTransportation && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleToggle(client.id, "toggle_pickup")}
                    className={cn(
                      "h-11 rounded-lg border font-bold text-xs flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-0.5 transition-all touch-manipulation active:scale-95",
                      state.pickup
                        ? "bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-700 shadow-xs"
                        : "bg-slate-50 text-slate-600 border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100"
                    )}
                  >
                    <Bus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>{state.pickup ? "迎 済" : "迎"}</span>
                  </button>
                )}

                {/* 出勤 */}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleToggle(client.id, "clock_in")}
                  className={cn(
                    "h-11 rounded-lg border font-bold text-xs flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-0.5 transition-all touch-manipulation active:scale-95",
                    state.clockIn
                      ? "bg-emerald-600 text-white border-emerald-700 shadow-xs"
                      : "bg-slate-50 text-slate-600 border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100"
                  )}
                >
                  <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{state.clockIn ? state.clockIn.substring(0, 5) : "出勤"}</span>
                </button>

                {/* 退勤 */}
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => handleToggle(client.id, "clock_out")}
                  className={cn(
                    "h-11 rounded-lg border font-bold text-xs flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-0.5 transition-all touch-manipulation active:scale-95",
                    state.clockOut
                      ? "bg-indigo-600 text-white border-indigo-700 shadow-xs"
                      : "bg-slate-50 text-slate-600 border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100"
                  )}
                >
                  <Clock className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                  <span>{state.clockOut ? state.clockOut.substring(0, 5) : "退勤"}</span>
                </button>

                {/* 送（送迎あり時のみ表示） */}
                {hasTransportation && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={() => handleToggle(client.id, "toggle_dropoff")}
                    className={cn(
                      "h-11 rounded-lg border font-bold text-xs flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-0.5 transition-all touch-manipulation active:scale-95",
                      state.dropoff
                        ? "bg-blue-600 text-white border-blue-700 shadow-xs"
                        : "bg-slate-50 text-slate-600 border-slate-200 hover:bg-slate-100"
                    )}
                  >
                    <Bus className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
                    <span>{state.dropoff ? "送 済" : "送"}</span>
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>
          );
        })}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

File: src/components/tablet/SignaturePad.tsx
================================================================================

"use client";

import React, { useRef, useState, useEffect, useCallback } from "react";
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button";
import { Eraser, Check, RotateCcw } from "lucide-react";

interface SignaturePadProps {
  onSave?: (dataUrl: string) => void;
  onClear?: () => void;
  width?: number;
  height?: number;
  className?: string;
  initialImage?: string;
}

export function SignaturePad({
  onSave,
  onClear,
  width = 500,
  height = 180,
  className = "",
  initialImage,
}: SignaturePadProps) {
  const canvasRef = useRef<HTMLCanvasElement | null>(null);
  const [isDrawing, setIsDrawing] = useState(false);
  const [hasSignature, setHasSignature] = useState(false);

  // キャンバスの初期化
  const initCanvas = useCallback(() => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;

    // 高解像度ディスプレイ対応（Retina / タブレット対応）
    const ratio = Math.max(window.devicePixelRatio || 1, 1);
    canvas.width = width * ratio;
    canvas.height = height * ratio;
    canvas.style.width = `${width}px`;
    canvas.style.height = `${height}px`;

    ctx.scale(ratio, ratio);
    ctx.lineCap = "round";
    ctx.lineJoin = "round";
    ctx.strokeStyle = "#0f172a"; // slate-900 (濃い墨色)
    ctx.lineWidth = 2.5;

    // 白背景で塗りつぶし（透過PNGではなく白背景付きにすると帳票印刷で綺麗に映る）
    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);

    if (initialImage) {
      const img = new Image();
      img.onload = () => {
        ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, width, height);
        setHasSignature(true);
      };
      img.src = initialImage;
    }
  }, [width, height, initialImage]);

  useEffect(() => {
    initCanvas();
  }, [initCanvas]);

  // 描画座標の取得
  const getCoordinates = (e: React.MouseEvent | React.TouchEvent) => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return { x: 0, y: 0 };
    const rect = canvas.getBoundingClientRect();

    if ("touches" in e) {
      const touch = e.touches[0];
      return {
        x: touch.clientX - rect.left,
        y: touch.clientY - rect.top,
      };
    } else {
      return {
        x: (e as React.MouseEvent).clientX - rect.left,
        y: (e as React.MouseEvent).clientY - rect.top,
      };
    }
  };

  const startDrawing = (e: React.MouseEvent | React.TouchEvent) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;

    const { x, y } = getCoordinates(e);
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, y);
    setIsDrawing(true);
  };

  const draw = (e: React.MouseEvent | React.TouchEvent) => {
    if (!isDrawing) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;

    const { x, y } = getCoordinates(e);
    ctx.lineTo(x, y);
    ctx.stroke();
    setHasSignature(true);
  };

  const stopDrawing = (e: React.MouseEvent | React.TouchEvent) => {
    if (!isDrawing) return;
    e.preventDefault();
    setIsDrawing(false);
  };

  const handleClear = () => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
    if (!ctx) return;

    ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
    setHasSignature(false);
    if (onClear) onClear();
  };

  const handleSave = () => {
    const canvas = canvasRef.current;
    if (!canvas) return;
    const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL("image/png");
    if (onSave) {
      onSave(dataUrl);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div className={`flex flex-col items-center gap-3 ${className}`}>
      <div className="relative border-2 border-slate-300 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-white shadow-inner touch-none select-none">
        <canvas
          ref={canvasRef}
          onMouseDown={startDrawing}
          onMouseMove={draw}
          onMouseUp={stopDrawing}
          onMouseLeave={stopDrawing}
          onTouchStart={startDrawing}
          onTouchMove={draw}
          onTouchEnd={stopDrawing}
          className="cursor-crosshair block"
          style={{ width: `${width}px`, height: `${height}px` }}
        />
        {!hasSignature && (
          <div className="absolute inset-0 flex items-center justify-center pointer-events-none text-slate-300 font-bold text-sm tracking-widest">
            ✍️ 指またはスタイラスペンでここに署名してください
          </div>
        )}
      </div>

      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 w-full justify-between max-w-[500px]">
        <Button
          type="button"
          variant="outline"
          size="sm"
          onClick={handleClear}
          className="gap-1.5 text-xs text-slate-600 border-slate-300 hover:bg-slate-100"
        >
          <RotateCcw className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
          書き直す（クリア）
        </Button>

        {onSave && (
          <Button
            type="button"
            size="sm"
            onClick={handleSave}
            disabled={!hasSignature}
            className="gap-1.5 text-xs bg-primary hover:bg-primary/90 text-white font-bold px-4 shadow-sm"
          >
            <Check className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
            サインを確定する
          </Button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

'use client';

import React from 'react';

export function PrintButton({
  label = '印刷プレビュー',
  className = 'px-4 py-2 bg-slate-800 hover:bg-slate-900 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-colors flex items-center gap-1.5 shadow',
}: {
  label?: string;
  className?: string;
}) {

    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={() => window.print()}
      className={className}
    >
      <Printer className="w-3.5 h-3.5" />
      {label}
    </button>
  );
}

export function ActionAlertButton({
  label,
  message,
  className,
  icon,
}: {
  label: string;
  message: string;
  className?: string;
  icon?: React.ReactNode;
}) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={() => alert(message)}
      className={className || 'px-4 py-2 bg-purple-700 hover:bg-purple-800 text-white rounded-xl text-xs font-bold transition-all shadow flex items-center gap-2'}
    >
      {icon}
      {label}
    </button>
  );
}

import { mergeProps } from "@base-ui/react/merge-props"
import { useRender } from "@base-ui/react/use-render"
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

const badgeVariants = cva(
  "group/badge inline-flex h-5 w-fit shrink-0 items-center justify-center gap-1 overflow-hidden rounded-4xl border border-transparent px-2 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-all focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-[3px] focus-visible:ring-ring/50 has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-1.5 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-1.5 aria-invalid:border-destructive aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 [&>svg]:pointer-events-none [&>svg]:size-3!",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "bg-primary text-primary-foreground [a]:hover:bg-primary/80",
        secondary:
          "bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground [a]:hover:bg-secondary/80",
        destructive:
          "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive focus-visible:ring-destructive/20 dark:bg-destructive/20 dark:focus-visible:ring-destructive/40 [a]:hover:bg-destructive/20",
        outline:
          "border-border text-foreground [a]:hover:bg-muted [a]:hover:text-muted-foreground",
        ghost:
          "hover:bg-muted hover:text-muted-foreground dark:hover:bg-muted/50",
        link: "text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
    },
  }
)

function Badge({
  className,
  variant = "default",
  render,
  ...props
}: useRender.ComponentProps<"span"> & VariantProps<typeof badgeVariants>) {
  return useRender({
    defaultTagName: "span",
    props: mergeProps<"span">(
      {
        className: cn(badgeVariants({ variant }), className),
      },
      props
    ),
    render,
    state: {
      slot: "badge",
      variant,
    },
  })
}

export { Badge, badgeVariants }

import * as React from "react"
import { Button as ButtonPrimitive } from "@base-ui/react/button"
import { cva, type VariantProps } from "class-variance-authority"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

const buttonVariants = cva(
  "group/button inline-flex shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-lg border border-transparent bg-clip-padding text-sm font-medium whitespace-nowrap transition-all outline-none select-none focus-visible:border-ring focus-visible:ring-3 focus-visible:ring-ring/50 active:not-aria-[haspopup]:translate-y-px disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:opacity-50 aria-invalid:border-destructive aria-invalid:ring-3 aria-invalid:ring-destructive/20 dark:aria-invalid:border-destructive/50 dark:aria-invalid:ring-destructive/40 [&_svg]:pointer-events-none [&_svg]:shrink-0 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-4",
  {
    variants: {
      variant: {
        default: "bg-primary text-primary-foreground hover:bg-primary/80",
        outline:
          "border-border bg-background hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground aria-expanded:bg-muted aria-expanded:text-foreground dark:border-input dark:bg-input/30 dark:hover:bg-input/50",
        secondary:
          "bg-secondary text-secondary-foreground hover:bg-[color-mix(in_oklch,var(--secondary),var(--foreground)_5%)] aria-expanded:bg-secondary aria-expanded:text-secondary-foreground",
        ghost:
          "hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground aria-expanded:bg-muted aria-expanded:text-foreground dark:hover:bg-muted/50",
        destructive:
          "bg-destructive/10 text-destructive hover:bg-destructive/20 focus-visible:border-destructive/40 focus-visible:ring-destructive/20 dark:bg-destructive/20 dark:hover:bg-destructive/30 dark:focus-visible:ring-destructive/40",
        link: "text-primary underline-offset-4 hover:underline",
      },
      size: {
        default:
          "h-8 gap-1.5 px-2.5 has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-2 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-2",
        xs: "h-6 gap-1 rounded-[min(var(--radius-md),10px)] px-2 text-xs in-data-[slot=button-group]:rounded-lg has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-1.5 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-1.5 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-3",
        sm: "h-7 gap-1 rounded-[min(var(--radius-md),12px)] px-2.5 text-[0.8rem] in-data-[slot=button-group]:rounded-lg has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-1.5 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-1.5 [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-3.5",
        lg: "h-9 gap-1.5 px-2.5 has-data-[icon=inline-end]:pr-2 has-data-[icon=inline-start]:pl-2",
        icon: "size-8",
        "icon-xs":
          "size-6 rounded-[min(var(--radius-md),10px)] in-data-[slot=button-group]:rounded-lg [&_svg:not([class*='size-'])]:size-3",
        "icon-sm":
          "size-7 rounded-[min(var(--radius-md),12px)] in-data-[slot=button-group]:rounded-lg",
        "icon-lg": "size-9",
      },
    },
    defaultVariants: {
      variant: "default",
      size: "default",
    },
  }
)

function Button({
  className,
  variant = "default",
  size = "default",
  asChild,
  children,
  render,
  nativeButton,
  ...props
}: ButtonPrimitive.Props & VariantProps<typeof buttonVariants> & { asChild?: boolean }) {
  const finalRender = asChild && React.isValidElement(children) ? children : render
  const finalChildren = asChild && React.isValidElement(children) ? undefined : children

  // If rendering a non-button element (e.g. via asChild with Link / a tag),
  // nativeButton must be false, otherwise Base UI throws an accessibility violation
  const isNative = nativeButton ?? (
    finalRender
      ? (React.isValidElement(finalRender) && typeof finalRender.type === "string" && finalRender.type === "button")
      : true
  )

  return (
    <ButtonPrimitive
      data-slot="button"
      className={cn(buttonVariants({ variant, size, className }))}
      render={finalRender}
      nativeButton={isNative}
      {...props}
    >
      {finalChildren}
    </ButtonPrimitive>
  )
}

export { Button, buttonVariants }

"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { Dialog as DialogPrimitive } from "@base-ui/react/dialog"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { XIcon } from "lucide-react"

function Dialog({ ...props }: DialogPrimitive.Root.Props) {
  return <DialogPrimitive.Root data-slot="dialog" {...props} />
}

function DialogTrigger({
  asChild,
  children,
  render,
  ...props
}: DialogPrimitive.Trigger.Props & { asChild?: boolean }) {
  const finalRender = asChild && React.isValidElement(children) ? children : render
  const finalChildren = asChild && React.isValidElement(children) ? undefined : children

  return (
    <DialogPrimitive.Trigger
      data-slot="dialog-trigger"
      render={finalRender}
      {...props}
    >
      {finalChildren}
    </DialogPrimitive.Trigger>
  )
}

function DialogPortal({ ...props }: DialogPrimitive.Portal.Props) {
  return <DialogPrimitive.Portal data-slot="dialog-portal" {...props} />
}

function DialogClose({
  asChild,
  children,
  render,
  ...props
}: DialogPrimitive.Close.Props & { asChild?: boolean }) {
  const finalRender = asChild && React.isValidElement(children) ? children : render
  const finalChildren = asChild && React.isValidElement(children) ? undefined : children

  return (
    <DialogPrimitive.Close
      data-slot="dialog-close"
      render={finalRender}
      {...props}
    >
      {finalChildren}
    </DialogPrimitive.Close>
  )
}

function DialogOverlay({
  className,
  ...props
}: DialogPrimitive.Backdrop.Props) {
  return (
    <DialogPrimitive.Backdrop
      data-slot="dialog-overlay"
      className={cn(
        "fixed inset-0 isolate z-50 bg-black/10 duration-100 supports-backdrop-filter:backdrop-blur-xs data-open:animate-in data-open:fade-in-0 data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function DialogContent({
  className,
  children,
  showCloseButton = true,
  ...props
}: DialogPrimitive.Popup.Props & {
  showCloseButton?: boolean
}) {
  return (
    <DialogPortal>
      <DialogOverlay />
      <DialogPrimitive.Popup
        data-slot="dialog-content"
        className={cn(
          "fixed top-1/2 left-1/2 z-50 grid w-full max-w-[calc(100%-2rem)] -translate-x-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 gap-4 rounded-xl bg-popover p-4 text-sm text-popover-foreground ring-1 ring-foreground/10 duration-100 outline-none sm:max-w-sm data-open:animate-in data-open:fade-in-0 data-open:zoom-in-95 data-closed:animate-out data-closed:fade-out-0 data-closed:zoom-out-95",
          className
        )}
        {...props}
      >
        {children}
        {showCloseButton && (
          <DialogPrimitive.Close
            data-slot="dialog-close"
            render={
              <Button
                variant="ghost"
                className="absolute top-2 right-2"
                size="icon-sm"
              />
            }
          >
            <XIcon
            />
            <span className="sr-only">Close</span>
          </DialogPrimitive.Close>
        )}
      </DialogPrimitive.Popup>
    </DialogPortal>
  )
}

function DialogHeader({ className, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"div">) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="dialog-header"
      className={cn("flex flex-col gap-2", className)}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function DialogFooter({
  className,
  showCloseButton = false,
  children,
  ...props
}: React.ComponentProps<"div"> & {
  showCloseButton?: boolean
}) {
  return (
    <div
      data-slot="dialog-footer"
      className={cn(
        "-mx-4 -mb-4 flex flex-col-reverse gap-2 rounded-b-xl border-t bg-muted/50 p-4 sm:flex-row sm:justify-end",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    >
      {children}
      {showCloseButton && (
        <DialogPrimitive.Close render={<Button variant="outline" />}>
          Close
        </DialogPrimitive.Close>
      )}
    </div>
  )
}

function DialogTitle({ className, ...props }: DialogPrimitive.Title.Props) {
  return (
    <DialogPrimitive.Title
      data-slot="dialog-title"
      className={cn(
        "font-heading text-base leading-none font-medium",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function DialogDescription({
  className,
  ...props
}: DialogPrimitive.Description.Props) {
  return (
    <DialogPrimitive.Description
      data-slot="dialog-description"
      className={cn(
        "text-sm text-muted-foreground *:[a]:underline *:[a]:underline-offset-3 *:[a]:hover:text-foreground",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

export {
  Dialog,
  DialogClose,
  DialogContent,
  DialogDescription,
  DialogFooter,
  DialogHeader,
  DialogOverlay,
  DialogPortal,
  DialogTitle,
  DialogTrigger,
}

import * as React from "react"
import { Input as InputPrimitive } from "@base-ui/react/input"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"

function Input({ className, type, ...props }: React.ComponentProps<"input">) {
  return (
    <InputPrimitive
      type={type}
      data-slot="input"
      className={cn(

"use client"

import * as React from "react"
import { Dialog as SheetPrimitive } from "@base-ui/react/dialog"

import { cn } from "@/lib/utils"
import { Button } from "@/components/ui/button"
import { XIcon } from "lucide-react"

function Sheet({ ...props }: SheetPrimitive.Root.Props) {
  return <SheetPrimitive.Root data-slot="sheet" {...props} />
}

function SheetTrigger({
  asChild,
  children,
  render,
  ...props
}: SheetPrimitive.Trigger.Props & { asChild?: boolean }) {
  const finalRender = asChild && React.isValidElement(children) ? children : render
  const finalChildren = asChild && React.isValidElement(children) ? undefined : children

  return (
    <SheetPrimitive.Trigger
      data-slot="sheet-trigger"
      render={finalRender}
      {...props}
    >
      {finalChildren}
    </SheetPrimitive.Trigger>
  )
}

function SheetClose({
  asChild,
  children,
  render,
  ...props
}: SheetPrimitive.Close.Props & { asChild?: boolean }) {
  const finalRender = asChild && React.isValidElement(children) ? children : render
  const finalChildren = asChild && React.isValidElement(children) ? undefined : children

  return (
    <SheetPrimitive.Close
      data-slot="sheet-close"
      render={finalRender}
      {...props}
    >
      {finalChildren}
    </SheetPrimitive.Close>
  )
}

function SheetPortal({ ...props }: SheetPrimitive.Portal.Props) {
  return <SheetPrimitive.Portal data-slot="sheet-portal" {...props} />
}

function SheetOverlay({ className, ...props }: SheetPrimitive.Backdrop.Props) {
  return (
    <SheetPrimitive.Backdrop
      data-slot="sheet-overlay"
      className={cn(
        "fixed inset-0 z-50 bg-black/10 transition-opacity duration-150 data-ending-style:opacity-0 data-starting-style:opacity-0 supports-backdrop-filter:backdrop-blur-xs",
        className
      )}
      {...props}
    />
  )
}

function SheetContent({
  className,
  children,
  side = "right",
  showCloseButton = true,
  ...props
}: SheetPrimitive.Popup.Props & {
  side?: "top" | "right" | "bottom" | "left"
  showCloseButton?: boolean
}) {
  return (
    <SheetPortal>
      <SheetOverlay />
      <SheetPrimitive.Popup
        data-slot="sheet-content"
        data-side={side}
        className={cn(
          "fixed z-50 flex flex-col gap-4 bg-popover bg-clip-padding text-sm text-popover-foreground shadow-lg transition duration-200 ease-in-out data-ending-style:opacity-0 data-starting-style:opacity-0 data-[side=bottom]:inset-x-0 data-[side=bottom]:bottom-0 data-[side=bottom]:h-auto data-[side=bottom]:border-t data-[side=bottom]:data-ending-style:translate-y-[2.5rem] data-[side=bottom]:data-starting-style:translate-y-[2.5rem] data-[side=left]:inset-y-0 data-[side=left]:left-0 data-[side=left]:h-full data-[side=left]:w-3/4 data-[side=left]:border-r data-[side=left]:data-ending-style:translate-x-[-2.5rem] data-[side=left]:data-starting-style:translate-x-[-2.5rem] data-[side=right]:inset-y-0 data-[side=right]:right-0 data-[side=right]:h-full data-[side=right]:w-3/4 data-[side=right]:border-l data-[side=right]:data-ending-style:translate-x-[2.5rem] data-[side=right]:data-starting-style:translate-x-[2.5rem] data-[side=top]:inset-x-0 data-[side=top]:top-0 data-[side=top]:h-auto data-[side=top]:border-b data-[side=top]:data-ending-style:translate-y-[-2.5rem] data-[side=top]:data-starting-style:translate-y-[-2.5rem] data-[side=left]:sm:max-w-sm data-[side=right]:sm:max-w-sm",
          className
        )}
        {...props}

/**
 * モデル文字列（例: "google:gemini-3.5-flash"）をプロバイダとモデルIDに分解
 */
export function parseModelString(modelStr: string | null | undefined): { provider: AiProvider; modelId: string } {
  const fallback = { provider: 'google' as AiProvider, modelId: 'gemini-3.5-flash' };
  if (!modelStr || typeof modelStr !== 'string') return fallback;

  const trimmed = modelStr.trim();
  if (trimmed.includes(':')) {
    const parts = trimmed.split(':');
    const provider = parts[0].toLowerCase() as AiProvider;
    const modelId = parts.slice(1).join(':');
    if (['google', 'anthropic', 'openai'].includes(provider)) {
      return { provider, modelId };
    }
  }

  // プレフィックスなしのレガシーモデル判定
  if (trimmed.startsWith('gemini')) return { provider: 'google', modelId: trimmed };
  if (trimmed.startsWith('claude')) return { provider: 'anthropic', modelId: trimmed };
  if (trimmed.startsWith('gpt') || trimmed.startsWith('o1') || trimmed.startsWith('o3')) return { provider: 'openai', modelId: trimmed };

  return fallback;
}

import { db } from "@/lib/db";
import { createGoogleGenerativeAI } from "@ai-sdk/google";
import { createAnthropic } from "@ai-sdk/anthropic";
import { createOpenAI } from "@ai-sdk/openai";
import { AiProvider, parseModelString, AI_PROVIDER_PRESETS } from "./constants";

export * from "./constants";

/**
 * データベースの事業所設定または環境変数からAPIキーを取得
 */
export function getApiKeyForProvider(provider: AiProvider): string | null {
  try {
    const settings = db.prepare(`
      SELECT gemini_api_key, openai_api_key, anthropic_api_key 
      FROM facility_settings 
      WHERE id = 'default'
    `).get() as any;

    if (provider === 'google') {
      return settings?.gemini_api_key || process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY || null;
    }
    if (provider === 'anthropic') {
      return settings?.anthropic_api_key || process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY || null;
    }
    if (provider === 'openai') {
      return settings?.openai_api_key || process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY || null;
    }
  } catch (e) {
    console.error(`Failed to fetch API key for ${provider}:`, e);
  }

  // フォールバック（環境変数）
  if (provider === 'google') return process.env.GEMINI_API_KEY || null;
  if (provider === 'anthropic') return process.env.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY || null;
  if (provider === 'openai') return process.env.OPENAI_API_KEY || null;
  return null;
}

export interface ModelFactoryOptions {
  overrideModelString?: string;
  useSearchGrounding?: boolean;
}

/**
 * AIモデルインスタンスを生成するファクトリ関数
 */
export function getAiModelInstance(options: ModelFactoryOptions = {}) {
  let modelString = options.overrideModelString;
  if (!modelString) {
    try {
      const facility = db.prepare(`SELECT active_ai_model FROM facility_settings WHERE id = 'default'`).get() as any;
      modelString = facility?.active_ai_model;
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('Could not read active_ai_model from DB, using fallback:', e);
    }
  }

  const { provider, modelId } = parseModelString(modelString);
  const apiKey = getApiKeyForProvider(provider);

  if (!apiKey) {
    const providerNames: Record<AiProvider, string> = {
      google: 'Google Gemini',
      anthropic: 'Anthropic Claude',
      openai: 'OpenAI'
    };
    throw new Error(
      `${providerNames[provider]} のAPIキーが設定されていません。` +
      `「設定（/settings）」画面のAI設定からAPIキーを登録するか、環境変数（${provider.toUpperCase()}_API_KEY）を設定してください。`
    );
  }

  switch (provider) {
    case 'google': {
      const google = createGoogleGenerativeAI({ apiKey });
      if (options.useSearchGrounding) {
        // @ts-ignore - Google search grounding option
        return google(modelId, { useSearchGrounding: true });
      }
      return google(modelId);
    }
    case 'anthropic': {
      const anthropic = createAnthropic({ apiKey });
      return anthropic(modelId);
    }
    case 'openai': {
      const openai = createOpenAI({ apiKey });
      return openai(modelId);
    }
    default:
      throw new Error(`未対応のAIプロバイダです: ${provider}`);
  }
}

import { db } from './db';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';
import { getRole } from './auth';

export interface AuditLogEntry {
  userId?: string;
  userName?: string;
  action: 'create' | 'update' | 'delete' | 'lock' | 'unlock' | 'export';
  targetTable: string;
  targetId?: string;
  details?: Record<string, any> | string;
  ipAddress?: string;
}

export async function logAudit(entry: AuditLogEntry) {
  try {
    let role = null;
    try {
      role = await getRole();
    } catch {
      // Background or script context
    }

    const detailsStr = typeof entry.details === 'object' ? JSON.stringify(entry.details) : (entry.details || null);
    const userId = entry.userId || (role ? `role:${role}` : 'system');
    const userName = entry.userName || (role ? `職員(${role})` : 'システム');

    const stmt = db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO audit_logs (id, user_id, user_name, action, target_table, target_id, details, ip_address)
      VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    `);

    stmt.run(
      uuidv4(),
      userId,
      userName,
      entry.action,
      entry.targetTable,
      entry.targetId || null,
      detailsStr,
      entry.ipAddress || null
    );
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Failed to write audit log:', error);
  }
}

export function getAuditLogs(limit = 100) {
  return db.prepare('SELECT * FROM audit_logs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ?').all(limit);
}

import { cookies, headers } from 'next/headers';
import { getIronSession } from 'iron-session';

export type UserRole = 'admin' | 'service_manager' | 'staff' | null;

export interface SessionData {
  role: UserRole;
  userId?: string;
  userName?: string;
  departmentId?: string;
}

const cookiePassword = process.env.SECRET_COOKIE_PASSWORD || 'default_fallback_secret_cookie_password_must_be_at_least_32_characters_long';

const sessionOptions = {
  password: cookiePassword,
  cookieName: 'welfare_app_session',
  cookieOptions: {
    secure: process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production',
  },
};

export async function setRole(role: 'admin' | 'service_manager' | 'staff', departmentId?: string) {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  cookieStore.set('app_role', role, { path: '/' });
  const session = await getIronSession<SessionData>(cookieStore, sessionOptions);
  session.role = role;
  if (departmentId !== undefined) {
    session.departmentId = departmentId;
  }
  await session.save();
}

export async function getSessionData(): Promise<SessionData | null> {
  try {
    const cookieStore = await cookies();
    const session = await getIronSession<SessionData>(cookieStore, sessionOptions);
    if (session.role) {
      return session;
    }
    const appRole = cookieStore.get('app_role')?.value as UserRole;
    if (appRole === 'admin' || appRole === 'service_manager' || appRole === 'staff') {
      return { role: appRole, departmentId: session.departmentId };
    }
    return null;
  } catch (e) {
    return null;
  }
}

export async function getRole(): Promise<UserRole> {
  try {
    const sessionData = await getSessionData();
    return sessionData?.role || 'admin';
  } catch (e) {
    return 'admin';
  }
}

export async function logout() {
  const cookieStore = await cookies();
  cookieStore.delete('app_role');
  const session = await getIronSession<SessionData>(cookieStore, sessionOptions);
  session.destroy();
}

/**
 * IDORガード ＆ DBモード自動解決:
 * 実行ユーザーが対象クライアントの拠点にアクセス権を持つか検証すると同時に、
 * 複数タブ操作等で service_mode Cookie と対象 clientId の所属DB（A型/B型）がズレていた場合に
 * 自動的に対象クライアントが所属するDBへリクエストコンテキストとCookieを同期する
 */
export async function assertCanAccessClient(clientId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  const { db, resolveServiceModeForClient, SERVICE_MODE_COOKIE } = await import('@/lib/db');
  const resolvedMode = resolveServiceModeForClient(clientId);

  try {
    const cookieStore = await cookies();
    const currentCookieMode = cookieStore.get(SERVICE_MODE_COOKIE)?.value;
    if (currentCookieMode && currentCookieMode !== resolvedMode) {
      cookieStore.set(SERVICE_MODE_COOKIE, resolvedMode, {
        path: '/',
        maxAge: 60 * 60 * 24 * 365,
        sameSite: 'lax',
      });
    }
  } catch (e) {
    // Server Component からの呼び出し等で cookie.set が不可の場合はリクエストスコープのオーバーライドのみで動作
  }

  const session = await getSessionData();
  const role = session?.role || await getRole();
  if (!role) {
    throw new Error('認証されていません。ログインしてください。');
  }
  if (role === 'admin') {
    return true;
  }
  if (!session?.departmentId || session.departmentId === 'all') {
    return true;
  }
  
  const client = db.prepare('SELECT department_id FROM clients WHERE id = ?').get(clientId) as any;
  if (client && client.department_id && client.department_id !== session.departmentId) {
    throw new Error('【アクセス権限エラー】他拠点の利用者データへのアクセス権限がありません。');
  }
  return true;
}

/**
 * IDORガード: 実行ユーザーが対象拠点にアクセス権を持つか検証
 */
export async function assertCanAccessDepartment(departmentId: string): Promise<boolean> {
  if (departmentId && departmentId !== 'all') {
    const { resolveServiceModeForDepartment } = await import('@/lib/db');
    resolveServiceModeForDepartment(departmentId);
  }
  const session = await getSessionData();
  const role = session?.role || await getRole();
  if (!role) {
    throw new Error('認証されていません。ログインしてください。');
  }
  if (role === 'admin') {
    return true;
  }
  if (!session?.departmentId || session.departmentId === 'all') {
    return true;
  }
  if (departmentId !== 'all' && departmentId !== session.departmentId) {
    throw new Error('【アクセス権限エラー】他拠点のデータへのアクセス権限がありません。');
  }
  return true;
}

import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';
import { db, getActiveDbPath, getServiceModeSync } from '@/lib/db';
import Database from 'better-sqlite3';
import { format } from 'date-fns';
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from 'uuid';
import { encryptBuffer, decryptBuffer, validateBackupHeader, isSqliteBuffer } from './crypto';
import { uploadToS3 } from './s3Client';

export interface BackupSettingsRecord {
  id: string;
  cloud_provider: 'none' | 'google_drive_folder' | 's3';
  local_sync_path?: string | null;
  s3_endpoint?: string | null;
  s3_bucket?: string | null;
  s3_region?: string | null;
  s3_access_key_id?: string | null;
  s3_secret_access_key?: string | null;

  auto_sync_interval_hours: number;
  last_sync_at?: string | null;
  last_sync_status?: string | null;
  last_sync_message?: string | null;
  updated_at?: string;
}

export interface BackupLogRecord {
  id: string;
  backup_type: 'manual_download' | 'manual_cloud' | 'auto_cloud' | 'restore';
  destination?: string | null;
  file_name?: string | null;
  file_size_bytes?: number | null;
  status: 'success' | 'failed';
  message?: string | null;
  created_at: string;
}

/**
 * バックアップ設定を取得します
 */
export function getBackupSettings(): BackupSettingsRecord {
  const settings = db.prepare('SELECT * FROM backup_settings WHERE id = ?').get('default') as BackupSettingsRecord | undefined;
  if (!settings) {
    db.prepare(`
      INSERT INTO backup_settings (id, cloud_provider, auto_sync_enabled, auto_sync_interval_hours)
      VALUES ('default', 'none', 0, 24)
    `).run();
    return db.prepare('SELECT * FROM backup_settings WHERE id = ?').get('default') as BackupSettingsRecord;
  }
  return settings;
}

/**
 * バックアップログ一覧を取得します（直近50件）
 */
export function getBackupLogs(limit = 50): BackupLogRecord[] {
  return db.prepare('SELECT * FROM backup_logs ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT ?').all(limit) as BackupLogRecord[];
}

/**
 * データベースの整合性スナップショットを取得し、AES-256-GCMで暗号化したバッファを生成します。
 */
export async function generateEncryptedBackup(passphrase: string): Promise<{
  buffer: Buffer;
  fileName: string;
  sizeBytes: number;
}> {
  if (!passphrase || passphrase.length < 8) {
    throw new Error('暗号化パスフレーズは8文字以上である必要があります。');
  }

  // 一時ファイルのパス
  const tempSnapshotPath = path.join(process.cwd(), `temp_snapshot_${Date.now()}_${Math.random().toString(36).slice(2, 7)}.sqlite`);

  try {
    // WAL整合性を考慮したフラッシュとSQLiteオンラインバックアップAPI
    try {
      db.pragma('wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)');
    } catch (e) {}

    await db.backup(tempSnapshotPath);

    // スナップショットをバッファとして読み込み
    const rawBuffer = fs.readFileSync(tempSnapshotPath);

    // AES-256-GCM で暗号化
    const encryptedBuffer = encryptBuffer(rawBuffer, passphrase);

    // ファイル名生成: welfare_backup_[type_a|type_b]_YYYYMMDD_HHmmss.enc
    const currentMode = getServiceModeSync();
    const timestampStr = format(new Date(), 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss');
    const fileName = `welfare_backup_${currentMode}_${timestampStr}.enc`;

    return {
      buffer: encryptedBuffer,
      fileName,
      sizeBytes: encryptedBuffer.length
    };
  } finally {
    // 一時ファイルの後始末
    if (fs.existsSync(tempSnapshotPath)) {
      try {
        fs.unlinkSync(tempSnapshotPath);
      } catch (e) {
        console.warn('一時バックアップファイルの削除に失敗しました:', e);
      }
    }
  }
}

/**
 * クラウドストレージ（ローカル同期フォルダまたはS3）へバックアップを保存します。
 */
export async function syncEncryptedBackupToCloud(
  encryptedBuffer: Buffer,
  fileName: string,
  backupType: 'manual_cloud' | 'auto_cloud'
): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; destination: string }> {
  const settings = getBackupSettings();

  if (settings.cloud_provider === 'none') {
    throw new Error('クラウドバックアップ先が設定されていません。[設定]から同期先（Google DriveフォルダまたはS3）を選択してください。');
  }

  const logId = uuidv4();
  let destination = '';

  try {
    if (settings.cloud_provider === 'google_drive_folder') {
      destination = 'google_drive_folder';
      const syncPath = settings.local_sync_path;
      if (!syncPath || syncPath.trim() === '') {
        throw new Error('Google Drive / OneDrive の同期先フォルダパスが指定されていません。');
      }

      // パストラバーサル防止 & パス正規化
      const resolvedSyncPath = path.resolve(syncPath);
      const safeFileName = path.basename(fileName);
      if (!safeFileName || safeFileName.includes('..') || !safeFileName.endsWith('.enc')) {
        throw new Error('不正なバックアップファイル名です。');
      }

      // フォルダが存在しない場合は作成
      if (!fs.existsSync(resolvedSyncPath)) {
        fs.mkdirSync(resolvedSyncPath, { recursive: true });
      }

      const syncPathWithSep = resolvedSyncPath.endsWith(path.sep) ? resolvedSyncPath : resolvedSyncPath + path.sep;
      const targetFilePath = path.join(resolvedSyncPath, safeFileName);
      if (!targetFilePath.startsWith(syncPathWithSep)) {
        throw new Error('不正なファイルパス（パストラバーサル）が検出されました。');
      }
      fs.writeFileSync(targetFilePath, encryptedBuffer);

      // 自動クリーンアップ: 同期先フォルダ内の古いバックアップファイル（.enc）を検索し、最新30世代のみ保持
      try {
        const files = fs.readdirSync(resolvedSyncPath)
          .filter(f => f.startsWith('welfare_backup_') && f.endsWith('.enc'))
          .map(f => ({
            name: f,
            time: fs.statSync(path.join(resolvedSyncPath, f)).mtime.getTime()
          }))
          .sort((a, b) => b.time - a.time);

        // 30世代を超えたファイルを削除
        if (files.length > 30) {
          const filesToDelete = files.slice(30);
          for (const f of filesToDelete) {
            try {
              fs.unlinkSync(path.join(resolvedSyncPath, f.name));
            } catch (err) {
              console.warn(`古いバックアップファイルの削除失敗: ${f.name}`, err);
            }
          }
        }
      } catch (cleanErr) {
        console.warn('バックアップ世代整理中の軽微な警告:', cleanErr);
      }

      const msg = `Google Drive / クラウド同期フォルダへの保存が完了しました (${(encryptedBuffer.length / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB)`;

      // 設定およびログ更新
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE backup_settings 
        SET last_sync_at = datetime('now', 'localtime'), last_sync_status = 'success', last_sync_message = ?
        WHERE id = 'default'
      `).run(msg);

      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO backup_logs (id, backup_type, destination, file_name, file_size_bytes, status, message)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'success', ?)
      `).run(logId, backupType, 'google_drive', fileName, encryptedBuffer.length, msg);

      return { success: true, message: msg, destination };

    } else if (settings.cloud_provider === 's3') {
      destination = 's3';
      if (!settings.s3_endpoint || !settings.s3_bucket || !settings.s3_access_key_id || !settings.s3_secret_access_key) {
        throw new Error('S3ストレージの接続情報（エンドポイント、バケット名、アクセスキー）が未設定です。');
      }

      const s3Result = await uploadToS3({
        endpoint: settings.s3_endpoint,
        bucket: settings.s3_bucket,
        region: settings.s3_region || 'auto',
        accessKeyId: settings.s3_access_key_id,
        secretAccessKey: settings.s3_secret_access_key,
        key: `backups/${fileName}`,
        body: encryptedBuffer,
        contentType: 'application/octet-stream'
      });

      if (!s3Result.success) {
        throw new Error(s3Result.message);
      }

      const msg = `S3互換クラウドストレージへの暗号化バックアップ転送が完了しました (${(encryptedBuffer.length / 1024).toFixed(1)} KB)`;

      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE backup_settings 
        SET last_sync_at = datetime('now', 'localtime'), last_sync_status = 'success', last_sync_message = ?
        WHERE id = 'default'
      `).run(msg);

      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO backup_logs (id, backup_type, destination, file_name, file_size_bytes, status, message)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'success', ?)
      `).run(logId, backupType, 's3', fileName, encryptedBuffer.length, msg);

      return { success: true, message: msg, destination };
    }

    throw new Error('未対応のクラウドプロバイダーです。');
  } catch (error: any) {
    const errorMsg = error.message || 'クラウド同期に失敗しました。';

    try {
      db.prepare(`
        UPDATE backup_settings 
        SET last_sync_at = datetime('now', 'localtime'), last_sync_status = 'failed', last_sync_message = ?
        WHERE id = 'default'
      `).run(errorMsg);

      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO backup_logs (id, backup_type, destination, file_name, file_size_bytes, status, message)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, 'failed', ?)
      `).run(logId, backupType, destination, fileName, encryptedBuffer.length, errorMsg);
    } catch (e) {}

    return { success: false, message: errorMsg, destination };
  }
}

/**
 * クラウド接続テスト
 */
export async function testCloudConnection(targetSettings: Partial<BackupSettingsRecord>): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string }> {
  if (targetSettings.cloud_provider === 'google_drive_folder') {
    const syncPath = targetSettings.local_sync_path;
    if (!syncPath || syncPath.trim() === '') {
      return { success: false, message: 'フォルダパスを入力してください。' };
    }

    try {
      const resolvedSyncPath = path.resolve(syncPath);
      const syncPathWithSep = resolvedSyncPath.endsWith(path.sep) ? resolvedSyncPath : resolvedSyncPath + path.sep;
      if (!fs.existsSync(resolvedSyncPath)) {
        fs.mkdirSync(resolvedSyncPath, { recursive: true });
      }
      const testFile = path.join(resolvedSyncPath, `.test_write_${Date.now()}.tmp`);
      if (!testFile.startsWith(syncPathWithSep)) {
        return { success: false, message: '不正なフォルダパスです。' };
      }
      fs.writeFileSync(testFile, 'write_test_ok');
      fs.unlinkSync(testFile);
      return { success: true, message: `フォルダへの書き込み・アクセス確認に成功しました: ${resolvedSyncPath}` };
    } catch (err: any) {
      return { success: false, message: `フォルダへのアクセスに失敗しました: ${err.message}` };
    }
  } else if (targetSettings.cloud_provider === 's3') {
    if (!targetSettings.s3_endpoint || !targetSettings.s3_bucket || !targetSettings.s3_access_key_id || !targetSettings.s3_secret_access_key) {
      return { success: false, message: 'S3の全項目（エンドポイント、バケット、アクセスキー、シークレットキー）を入力してください。' };
    }

    try {
      const testResult = await uploadToS3({
        endpoint: targetSettings.s3_endpoint,
        bucket: targetSettings.s3_bucket,
        region: targetSettings.s3_region || 'auto',
        accessKeyId: targetSettings.s3_access_key_id,
        secretAccessKey: targetSettings.s3_secret_access_key,
        key: 'backups/.connection_test.txt',
        body: Buffer.from('welfare-app connection test ' + new Date().toISOString(), 'utf-8'),
        contentType: 'text/plain'
      });

      if (testResult.success) {
        return { success: true, message: 'S3バケットへのテスト書き込み・認証に成功しました。' };
      } else {
        return { success: false, message: testResult.message };
      }
    } catch (err: any) {
      return { success: false, message: `S3接続テスト失敗: ${err.message}` };
    }
  }

  return { success: false, message: '同期先プロバイダーを選択してください。' };
}

/**
 * 暗号化バックアップデータからのデータベース復元（インポート・リストア）
 * フェイルセーフ設計:
 * 1. ヘッダー・フォーマットチェック
 * 2. 復号テスト＆破損・改ざん検証 (AES-256-GCM AuthTag)
 * 3. SQLiteヘッダーチェック
 * 4. 一時DBファイル展開による主要テーブル構造検証
 * 5. 現行DBの自動退避スナップショット作成 (ロールバック用)
 * 6. データベースファイルの置換と再接続
 */
export async function restoreFromEncryptedBackup(
  encryptedBuffer: Buffer,
  passphrase: string
): Promise<{
  success: boolean;
  message: string;
  details?: {
    clientCount: number;
    staffCount: number;
    facilityName: string;
    backupSavedTime?: string;
  };
}> {
  if (!passphrase) {
    throw new Error('復号パスフレーズを入力してください。');
  }

  // 1. ヘッダー検証
  if (!validateBackupHeader(encryptedBuffer)) {
    throw new Error('選択されたファイルは当システムの暗号化バックアップ形式ではありません。');
  }

  // 2. 復号処理 (認証タグ検証)
  let decryptedBuffer: Buffer;
  try {
    decryptedBuffer = decryptBuffer(encryptedBuffer, passphrase);
  } catch (err: any) {
    throw new Error(err.message || '復号に失敗しました。パスフレーズが一致しません。');
  }

  // 3. SQLiteファイル検証
  if (!isSqliteBuffer(decryptedBuffer)) {
    throw new Error('復号されたデータは有効なSQLiteデータベースではありません。');
  }

  // 4. 一時ファイルでの整合性・テーブル存在検証
  const tempVerifyPath = path.join(process.cwd(), `temp_restore_verify_${Date.now()}.sqlite`);
  let clientCount = 0;
  let staffCount = 0;
  let facilityName = '事業所';
  let targetTableNames: string[] = [];

  let verifyDb: Database.Database | null = null;
  const cleanupTempVerifyFiles = () => {
    if (verifyDb) {
      try { verifyDb.close(); } catch (e) {}
      verifyDb = null;
    }
    for (const suffix of ['', '-shm', '-wal']) {
      const p = `${tempVerifyPath}${suffix}`;
      if (fs.existsSync(p)) {
        try { fs.unlinkSync(p); } catch (e) {}
      }
    }
  };

  try {
    fs.writeFileSync(tempVerifyPath, decryptedBuffer);
    verifyDb = new Database(tempVerifyPath, { readonly: true });

    // 主要テーブルの存在確認
    const tables = verifyDb.prepare("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'").all() as { name: string }[];
    targetTableNames = tables.map(t => t.name);
    const tableNames = new Set(targetTableNames);

    const requiredTables = ['clients', 'facility_settings', 'staff', 'attendance_records'];
    const missing = requiredTables.filter(t => !tableNames.has(t));
    if (missing.length > 0) {
      throw new Error(`バックアップデータ内に必須テーブル（${missing.join(', ')}）が見つかりません。整合性に問題があります。`);
    }

    // 件数や事業所名の確認
    try {
      const cRow = verifyDb.prepare('SELECT count(*) as cnt FROM clients').get() as { cnt: number };
      clientCount = cRow ? cRow.cnt : 0;

      const sRow = verifyDb.prepare('SELECT count(*) as cnt FROM staff').get() as { cnt: number };
      staffCount = sRow ? sRow.cnt : 0;

      const fRow = verifyDb.prepare('SELECT facility_name FROM facility_settings LIMIT 1').get() as { facility_name: string } | undefined;
      if (fRow && fRow.facility_name) {
        facilityName = fRow.facility_name;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('復元データプレビュー読み取り中の軽微な警告:', e);
    }

    // 事業種別（A型 / B型）の厳格なクロスチェック
    const activeServiceMode = getServiceModeSync(); // 現在のセッションの事業種別
    let backupServiceMode: string | null = null;
    try {
      const metaRow = verifyDb.prepare("SELECT meta_value FROM app_system_meta WHERE meta_key = 'service_mode'").get() as { meta_value: string } | undefined;
      if (metaRow && metaRow.meta_value) {
        backupServiceMode = metaRow.meta_value;
      } else {
        const fRow = verifyDb.prepare("SELECT service_type, facility_name FROM facility_settings LIMIT 1").get() as any;
        if (fRow && fRow.service_type) {
          backupServiceMode = fRow.service_type;
        } else if (fRow && fRow.facility_name && (fRow.facility_name.includes('B型') || fRow.facility_name.includes('就労Ｂ'))) {
          backupServiceMode = 'type_b';
        } else {
          backupServiceMode = 'type_a';
        }
      }
    } catch (e) {
      backupServiceMode = 'type_a';
    }

    if (backupServiceMode && backupServiceMode !== activeServiceMode) {
      const currentName = activeServiceMode === 'type_b' ? '就労継続支援B型' : '就労継続支援A型';
      const targetName = backupServiceMode === 'type_b' ? '就労継続支援B型' : '就労継続支援A型';
      const activeDbPath = getActiveDbPath();
      throw new Error(
        `【事業種別不一致エラー】\n` +
        `選択されたバックアップファイルは「${targetName}」専用データです。\n` +
        `現在操作中の「${currentName}」データベース（${path.basename(activeDbPath)}）への復元は、データの混線・破壊を防止するため固く禁止されています。\n` +
        `ヘッダーまたはログイン画面から「${targetName}」に切り替えてから復元を実行してください。`
      );
    }

    verifyDb.close();
    verifyDb = null;
  } catch (err: any) {
    cleanupTempVerifyFiles();
    throw err;
  }

  // 5. 現行DBの自動退避（フェイルセーフスナップショット）
  const activeDbPath = getActiveDbPath();
  const dbBaseName = path.basename(activeDbPath);
  const backupTimestamp = format(new Date(), 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss');
  const rollbackSnapshotPath = path.join(process.cwd(), `${dbBaseName}.before_restore_${backupTimestamp}`);

  try {
    // 現行DBファイルを退避（安全バックアップ）
    if (fs.existsSync(activeDbPath)) {
      try {
        db.pragma('wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)');
        fs.copyFileSync(activeDbPath, rollbackSnapshotPath);
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    // 6. ATTACH DATABASE を用いた完全オンライン復元処理
    // 稼働中プロセスのファイルハンドルを維持したまま、トランザクション内で全テーブルを安全に同期
    const safeTempPath = tempVerifyPath.replace(/\\/g, '/').replace(/'/g, "''");
    db.exec(`ATTACH DATABASE '${safeTempPath}' AS restore_src;`);

    // テーブル名の安全なホワイトリスト検証（SQLインジェクション対策）
    const validTablePattern = /^[a-zA-Z0-9_]+$/;
    const existingMainTables = new Set(
      (db.prepare("SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name NOT LIKE 'sqlite_%'").all() as { name: string }[]).map(t => t.name)
    );

    db.pragma('foreign_keys = OFF');
    try {
      db.transaction(() => {
        for (const tableName of targetTableNames) {
          // メインDBに実在し、英数字・アンダースコアのみの正規テーブル名のみ許可
          if (!validTablePattern.test(tableName) || !existingMainTables.has(tableName)) {
            console.warn(`許可されていないテーブル名の同期をスキップ: ${tableName}`);
            continue;
          }
          try {
            db.prepare(`DELETE FROM main.${tableName}`).run();
            db.prepare(`INSERT INTO main.${tableName} SELECT * FROM restore_src.${tableName}`).run();
          } catch (tblErr) {
            console.warn(`テーブル ${tableName} の同期中に警告:`, tblErr);
          }
        }
      })();
    } finally {
      db.pragma('foreign_keys = ON');
      try {
        db.exec("DETACH DATABASE restore_src;");
      } catch (e) {}
    }

    // WALフラッシュ
    try {
      db.pragma('wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE)');
    } catch (e) {}

    const msg = `データベースの復元が正常に完了しました（事業所: ${facilityName}、利用者数: ${clientCount}名、職員数: ${staffCount}名）。万が一のため直前のデータは「${path.basename(rollbackSnapshotPath)}」として自動保存されています。`;

    // 復元ログを記録
    try {
      db.prepare(`
        INSERT INTO backup_logs (id, backup_type, destination, file_name, file_size_bytes, status, message)
        VALUES (?, 'restore', 'local_restore', ?, ?, 'success', ?)
      `).run(uuidv4(), `restore_${backupTimestamp}.enc`, encryptedBuffer.length, msg);
    } catch (e) {}

    return {
      success: true,
      message: msg,
      details: {
        clientCount,
        staffCount,
        facilityName
      }
    };
  } catch (restoreErr: any) {
    // 置換中に致命的エラーが起きた場合は自動ロールバックを試行
    if (fs.existsSync(rollbackSnapshotPath)) {
      try {
        fs.copyFileSync(rollbackSnapshotPath, activeDbPath);
      } catch (rbErr) {}
    }
    throw new Error(`復元処理中にエラーが発生したため、変更をロールバックしました: ${restoreErr.message}`);
  } finally {
    cleanupTempVerifyFiles();
  }
}

File: src/lib/backup/crypto.ts

import crypto from 'crypto';

// マジックヘッダー: 14バイト ASCII
export const BACKUP_MAGIC_HEADER = 'WELFARE_ENC_V1';
const HEADER_BUFFER = Buffer.from(BACKUP_MAGIC_HEADER, 'utf-8'); // 14 bytes
const SALT_LENGTH = 16;
const IV_LENGTH = 12; // GCM推奨 96-bit
const TAG_LENGTH = 16; // GCM推奨 128-bit
const PBKDF2_ITERATIONS = 100000;
const KEY_LENGTH = 32; // 256 bits

// SQLite3のマジックヘッダー: "SQLite format 3\0" (16 bytes)
export const SQLITE_HEADER = Buffer.from('SQLite format 3\0', 'utf-8');

/**
 * パスフレーズを用いてバッファをAES-256-GCMで暗号化します。
 * 出力フォーマット:
 * [14B HEADER][16B SALT][12B IV][16B AUTH_TAG][CIPHERTEXT...]
 */
export function encryptBuffer(buffer: Buffer, passphrase: string): Buffer {
  if (!passphrase || passphrase.length < 8) {
    throw new Error('暗号化パスフレーズは8文字以上である必要があります。');
  }

  // ランダムなSaltとIVを生成
  const salt = crypto.randomBytes(SALT_LENGTH);
  const iv = crypto.randomBytes(IV_LENGTH);

  // PBKDF2による256ビット鍵の導出 (SHA-256, 100,000回ストレッチング)
  const key = crypto.pbkdf2Sync(passphrase, salt, PBKDF2_ITERATIONS, KEY_LENGTH, 'sha256');

  // AES-256-GCM 暗号化初期化
  const cipher = crypto.createCipheriv('aes-256-gcm', key, iv);
  
  // AAD (Additional Authenticated Data) としてヘッダーをバインド
  cipher.setAAD(HEADER_BUFFER);

  const encrypted = Buffer.concat([cipher.update(buffer), cipher.final()]);
  const authTag = cipher.getAuthTag();

  // ヘッダー + Salt + IV + AuthTag + 暗号化データを結合
  return Buffer.concat([
    HEADER_BUFFER,
    salt,
    iv,
    authTag,
    encrypted
  ]);
}

/**
 * 暗号化されたバッファのヘッダーが正当か検証します。
 */
export function validateBackupHeader(buffer: Buffer): boolean {
  const minLength = HEADER_BUFFER.length + SALT_LENGTH + IV_LENGTH + TAG_LENGTH;
  if (!buffer || buffer.length < minLength) {
    return false;
  }
  const fileHeader = buffer.subarray(0, HEADER_BUFFER.length);
  return fileHeader.equals(HEADER_BUFFER);
}

/**
 * バッファがSQLite3データベースファイルであるか検証します。
 */
export function isSqliteBuffer(buffer: Buffer): boolean {
  if (!buffer || buffer.length < SQLITE_HEADER.length) {
    return false;
  }
  const fileHeader = buffer.subarray(0, SQLITE_HEADER.length);
  return fileHeader.equals(SQLITE_HEADER);
}

/**
 * AES-256-GCMで暗号化されたバッファを復号します。
 * パスフレーズの誤り、改ざん、ファイル破損がある場合は例外をスローします。
 */
export function decryptBuffer(encryptedBuffer: Buffer, passphrase: string): Buffer {
  if (!passphrase) {
    throw new Error('復号用のパスフレーズを入力してください。');
  }

  if (!validateBackupHeader(encryptedBuffer)) {
    throw new Error('無効なバックアップファイルです。当システムの暗号化バックアップ形式ではありません。');
  }

  let offset = 0;
  // ヘッダーをスキップ
  offset += HEADER_BUFFER.length;

  // Salt
  const salt = encryptedBuffer.subarray(offset, offset + SALT_LENGTH);
  offset += SALT_LENGTH;

  // IV
  const iv = encryptedBuffer.subarray(offset, offset + IV_LENGTH);
  offset += IV_LENGTH;

  // AuthTag
  const authTag = encryptedBuffer.subarray(offset, offset + TAG_LENGTH);
  offset += TAG_LENGTH;

  // 暗号文本体
  const ciphertext = encryptedBuffer.subarray(offset);

  // 鍵導出
  const key = crypto.pbkdf2Sync(passphrase, salt, PBKDF2_ITERATIONS, KEY_LENGTH, 'sha256');

  // 復号
  try {
    const decipher = crypto.createDecipheriv('aes-256-gcm', key, iv);
    decipher.setAAD(HEADER_BUFFER);
    decipher.setAuthTag(authTag);

    const decrypted = Buffer.concat([decipher.update(ciphertext), decipher.final()]);
    return decrypted;
  } catch (err: any) {
    throw new Error('復号に失敗しました。パスフレーズが間違っているか、ファイルが破損・改ざんされている可能性があります。');
  }
}

File: src/lib/backup/s3Client.ts

import crypto from 'crypto';

export interface S3UploadOptions {
  endpoint: string; // 例: https://s3.ap-northeast-1.amazonaws.com または https://<account_id>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com
  bucket: string;
  region?: string;
  accessKeyId: string;
  secretAccessKey: string;
  key: string; // オブジェクトキー（ファイル名など）
  body: Buffer;
  contentType?: string;
}

function hmac(key: Buffer | string, data: string): Buffer {
  return crypto.createHmac('sha256', key).update(data, 'utf-8').digest();
}

function hash(data: Buffer | string): string {
  return crypto.createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex');
}

/**
 * AWS Signature Version 4 (SigV4) を使用して、
 * S3互換ストレージ (AWS S3, Cloudflare R2, MinIO, Wasabi等) にオブジェクトをPUTアップロードします。
 * 追加ライブラリ不要で、Node.js標準のcryptoとfetchのみで動作します。
 */
export async function uploadToS3(options: S3UploadOptions): Promise<{ success: boolean; message: string; httpStatus?: number }> {
  const {
    endpoint,
    bucket,
    region = 'auto',
    accessKeyId,
    secretAccessKey,
    key,
    body,
    contentType = 'application/octet-stream'
  } = options;

  if (!endpoint || !bucket || !accessKeyId || !secretAccessKey) {
    throw new Error('S3接続設定（エンドポイント、バケット名、アクセスキー、シークレットキー）が不足しています。');
  }

  // URLとホスト名の解析
  let cleanEndpoint = endpoint.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '');
  if (!cleanEndpoint.startsWith('http://') && !cleanEndpoint.startsWith('https://')) {
    cleanEndpoint = 'https://' + cleanEndpoint;
  }

  const urlObj = new URL(cleanEndpoint);
  // パス形式か仮想ホスト形式か（汎用的にパス形式またはURLにバケットを付与）
  // Cloudflare R2やAWS S3等に対応: https://endpoint/bucket/key
  const fullUrl = `${cleanEndpoint}/${bucket}/${encodeURIComponent(key).replace(/%2F/g, '/')}`;
  const requestUrl = new URL(fullUrl);

  const host = requestUrl.host;
  const path = requestUrl.pathname;

  const now = new Date();
  const amzDate = now.toISOString().replace(/[:-]|\.\d{3}/g, ''); // YYYYMMDDTHHmmssZ
  const dateStamp = amzDate.substring(0, 8); // YYYYMMDD

  const payloadHash = hash(body);

  // Canonical Headers (アルファベット昇順、小文字)
  const canonicalHeaders = 
    `content-type:${contentType}\n` +
    `host:${host}\n` +
    `x-amz-content-sha256:${payloadHash}\n` +
    `x-amz-date:${amzDate}\n`;

  const signedHeaders = 'content-type;host;x-amz-content-sha256;x-amz-date';

  // Canonical Request
  const canonicalRequest = [
    'PUT',
    path,
    '', // query string
    canonicalHeaders,
    signedHeaders,
    payloadHash
  ].join('\n');

  // String to Sign
  const service = 's3';
  const credentialScope = `${dateStamp}/${region}/${service}/aws4_request`;
  const stringToSign = [
    'AWS4-HMAC-SHA256',
    amzDate,
    credentialScope,
    hash(canonicalRequest)
  ].join('\n');

  // 署名鍵の導出
  const kDate = hmac('AWS4' + secretAccessKey, dateStamp);
  const kRegion = hmac(kDate, region);
  const kService = hmac(kRegion, service);
  const kSigning = hmac(kService, 'aws4_request');

  // 署名計算
  const signature = crypto.createHmac('sha256', kSigning).update(stringToSign, 'utf-8').digest('hex');

  // Authorization ヘッダー
  const authorizationHeader = `AWS4-HMAC-SHA256 Credential=${accessKeyId}/${credentialScope}, SignedHeaders=${signedHeaders}, Signature=${signature}`;

  try {
    const res = await fetch(requestUrl.toString(), {
      method: 'PUT',
      headers: {
        'Host': host,
        'Content-Type': contentType,
        'x-amz-date': amzDate,
        'x-amz-content-sha256': payloadHash,
        'Authorization': authorizationHeader
      },
      body: new Uint8Array(body)
    });

    if (res.ok) {
      return { success: true, message: 'S3へのアップロードに成功しました。', httpStatus: res.status };
    } else {
      const errorText = await res.text();
      return {
        success: false,
        message: `S3エラー (${res.status} ${res.statusText}): ${errorText.slice(0, 200)}`,
        httpStatus: res.status
      };
    }
  } catch (err: any) {
    return {
      success: false,
      message: `S3通信エラー: ${err.message || '接続に失敗しました'}`
    };
  }
}


================================================================================
File: src/lib/billing/burdenCalculator.ts
================================================================================

export const COPAY_RATE = 0.1; // 原則1割負担（障害福祉サービス法定自己負担率）

export interface BurdenInput {
  payment_limit: number;
  our_total_cost: number; // 自事業所の総費用（10割分）
  other_total_cost: number; // 他事業所の総費用（10割分）
  is_manager?: boolean; // 自事業所が上限額管理事業所であるか（デフォルト: true）
}

export interface BurdenResult {
  total_cost: number;
  total_burden: number; // 1割負担の本来の合計額
  our_burden: number; // 当事業所の最終的な請求額（自己負担分）
  other_burden: number; // 他事業所の負担額（通知用）
  is_over_limit: boolean; // 上限管理が発生したか
}

/**
 * 複数事業所利用時の利用者負担額を按分計算するロジック
 * 
 * 国保連の上限額管理仕様:
 * - 1割負担額が上限月額を超過する場合、各事業所の総費用に応じて按分
 * - 端数（1円単位）が発生した場合、指定された「上限管理事業所」が端数を引き受ける
 */
export function calculateBurden(input: BurdenInput): BurdenResult {
  const { payment_limit, our_total_cost, other_total_cost } = input;
  
  const total_cost = our_total_cost + other_total_cost;
  // 原則1割負担
  const total_burden = Math.floor(total_cost * COPAY_RATE);
  
  let our_burden = 0;
  let other_burden = 0;
  let is_over_limit = false;

  if (total_burden <= payment_limit) {
    // 上限到達していない場合、自事業所の総費用の1割をそのまま請求
    our_burden = Math.floor(our_total_cost * COPAY_RATE);
    other_burden = Math.floor(other_total_cost * COPAY_RATE);
  } else {
    // 上限を超過した場合、按分計算（比例配分）
    is_over_limit = true;
    if (total_cost > 0) {
      // 各事業所の按分額 = 上限月額 × (各事業所の総費用 / 全体の総費用)
      our_burden = Math.floor((payment_limit * our_total_cost) / total_cost);
      other_burden = Math.floor((payment_limit * other_total_cost) / total_cost);
      
      // 端数調整: 切り捨てにより合計が上限月額に満たない場合、
      // 上限管理事業所（is_manager）が端数を引き受ける（未指定時は費用比較）
      const remainder = payment_limit - (our_burden + other_burden);
      if (remainder > 0) {
        const isManager = input.is_manager ?? (our_total_cost >= other_total_cost);
        if (isManager) {
          our_burden += remainder;
        } else {
          other_burden += remainder;
        }
      }
    }
  }

  // バリデーション: 計算結果が上限額を上回っていないか安全チェック
  if (our_burden > payment_limit) {
    console.error("バリデーションエラー: 按分結果が上限月額を超過しています", { our_burden, payment_limit });
    our_burden = payment_limit; // 最終防衛線
  }

  return {
    total_cost,
    total_burden,
    our_burden,
    other_burden,
    is_over_limit
  };
}

File: src/lib/billing/kokuhoCsvParser.ts

export interface KokuhoErrorRecord {
  errorCode: string;
  targetName: string;
  errorMessage: string;
  lineNo: number;
}

/**
 * 国保連から返戻されるエラーCSV（75100000.CSV等）を解析する
 * 今回はプロトタイプのため、単純なカンマ区切り（エラーコード, 対象者, メッセージ）を想定
 */
export function parseKokuhoErrorCsv(csvText: string): KokuhoErrorRecord[] {
  // CR, LF, CRLF のすべてに対応して行に分割し、空行を除外
  const lines = csvText.split(/\r?\n/).filter(line => line.trim() !== '');
  const records: KokuhoErrorRecord[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < lines.length; i++) {
    const cols: string[] = [];
    let currentField = '';
    let inQuotes = false;
    
    for (let char of lines[i]) {
      if (char === '"') {
        inQuotes = !inQuotes;
      } else if (char === ',' && !inQuotes) {
        cols.push(currentField.trim());
        currentField = '';
      } else {
        currentField += char;
      }
    }
    cols.push(currentField.trim());
    
    // プロトタイプ想定のフォーマット: エラーコード, 対象者名, エラーメッセージ
    if (cols.length >= 3) {
      records.push({
        lineNo: i + 1,
        errorCode: cols[0],
        targetName: cols[1],
        errorMessage: cols[2]
      });
    } else {
      // 想定外のフォーマットへのフォールバック
      records.push({
        lineNo: i + 1,
        errorCode: 'UNKNOWN',
        targetName: '-',
        errorMessage: cols.join(',')
      });
    }
  }

  return records;
}
